AR, SAC and VC are currently being edited by Horst Lasic (VC) and myself. The files are NOT reproductions of the text as printed in JNA, but contain already a number of corrections based on the manuscripts. Due to technical problems, these corrections are not yet marked - the foot-notes have not yet been added to the files. More useful files shall be provided once the critical editions are completed.

KBhA.txt was originally produced by Tadashi Tani and kindly converted to ASCII by Kyō Kanō. I have then converted this file, which used the Kyōto-Harvard convention for encoding diacritics, to conform with the @-convention that is used consistently in all the other files. The file contains a number of foot-notes within the text which contain abbreviations of textual editions - some of these abbreviations may have been mistakenly converted and appear odd at the moment (e.g. RNA > r@n@a@). If anything, this proves the limitations of Kyōto-Harvard. With the exception of this file, where the use of brackets and other formatting devices is not yet consistent (I shall work on this in the near future), all other files adhere to the following standard:

Page- and line-numbers are given in square brackets [ ].
Folio-numbers of the manuscript are given in round brackets ( ).
Notes from the editor or from the typist are given in fuzzy brackets  .
Pointed brackets are used to indicate emendations to the text.

NOTE: A more comprehensive list of specifications that should be observed in Sanskrit e-texts is provided on my home-page, http:||www.ipc.hiroshima-u.ac.jp|~kellner|etext.htm. These specifications are subjective and have grown out of my personal experience.

I hope that these files prove useful, despite their present limitations. Any suggestions on how to improve their usefulness would be greatly appreciated.

Birgit Kellner, 01-06-1997.

 Notes  from the editor or from the typist are excluded for the practical usage.

KṢAṆABHAṄGĀDHYĀYA

pakṣadharmatādhikāro nāma prathamaḥ pādaḥ

Text des ersten pāda stammt von Kyumas Diss (7.Sept.99 kra)

    [namo buddhāya.]

    ādityabandhoḥ kiraṇair ivānyair ātanyamāne kṣaṇabhāji loke |
    suptā ivāniṣṭavilāpino 'tas talaprahārād iva cetayantām ||
    yat sat tat kṣaṇikaṃ yathā jaladharaḥ santaś ca bhāvā ime
    sattā śaktir ihārthakarmaṇi miteḥ siddheṣu siddhā ca sā |
    nāpy ekaiva vidhānyadāpi parakṛn naiva kriyā vā bhaved
    dvedhāpi kṣaṇabhaṅgasaṅgatir ataḥ sādhye ca viśrāmyati|| NOTEREF _Ref461335725     a

   atra prathamapādopadarśitaḥ svabhāvahetuḥ. ayaṃ na tāvad asiddhaḥ. ,tathā hi yadi nāma pratidarśanaṃ sattvalakṣaṇabhedaḥ, tathāpīhārthakriyāsāmarthyam eva sattvam abhipretaṃ NOTEREF _Ref461335859     c hetutayopāttam. NOTEREF _Ref461335813     b tac ca nāsambhavi sarvathā śakyam abhidhātum abhimataṃ vā keṣāṃ cit. tallakṣaṇāsahiṣṇavo hi yadi param avyāptim asmaddūṣaṇam abhidadhyuḥ. tatra ya evaite bhāvāḥ pramāṇasamadhigatārthakriyāviśeṣavyāpārāḥ, ta eva pakṣīkṛtā iti na svarūpeṇāśrayadvāreṇa vāsiddhiśaṅkā. ye punar arthakriyāsāmarthyasambhave 'pi tattvato 'navadhāritatadbhāvāḥ, teṣām idānīṃ pakṣād bahirbhāve 'pi paścān nirūpayato yady arthakriyopalambho bhaviṣyati, bhaviṣyaty anumānāntaram. tadabhāve tu sādhyāpratipattir iṣṭaiva liṅgāntaravat.
    nanv evam avyāpinī kṣaṇikatāsiddhir iti cet, na, yat kiṃ cit kva cit kadā cit kva cid arthakriyāyām upayogi, tasya sarvasya tadbhāvasādhanāt, iṣṭatvāc ca, kva cid upayoginy eva viśeṣacintāyāḥ prakramārhatvāt. tasmān nāniṣṭarūpaparihāreṇa. na ca hetunirūpaṇāśaktau. nāpi sarvatra sādhyadharmavati dharmiṇi sakṛdanumānapravṛttivirahakṛtaṃ prādeśikatvaṃ sādhyasiddheḥ, īśvarādyanumānavat. etena niścitārthakriyāśaktayo bhāvabhedā dharmiṇaḥ, arthakriyāsāmarthyasāmānyaṃ hetur iti darśitam.
    athavā ime pratyakṣādigocarāḥ sarva eva bhāvā dharmiṇaḥ, arthakriyāsāmarthyaṃ hetuḥ, tatra pramāṇāviṣayasya kva cid api vidhisādhanānumāne dharmīkartum aśakyatvāt, pramāṇaviṣaye ca sarvatrānumānavṛtteḥ. kāparā vyāptiḥ sādhyasiddheḥ. pramāṇagocaratayā dharmiṇo nāśrayāsiddhiḥ sādhanasya. nāpi svarūpāsiddhiḥ, yato yeṣu tāvad avivādena bahirarthakriyopalambhaḥ, teṣu cintaiva nāsti. yeṣv api na sākṣāt tadavadhāraṇam, tatrāpi pramāṇajananād evārthakriyāsāmarthyavyavasthānam anavadyam. adhyakṣe sākṣāt, anumāne ca kārye pāramparyeṇeti.
 atra ke cid ācakṣate. yatkāryakāriṇaḥ kāraṇasya sāmarthyavyavasthānaṃ tasyaiva kathaṃ sattvasiddhiḥ. tadasiddhau mūlasyāpi nārthasāmarthyam. atha yathāṅkurāpekṣayā bījasya sāmarthyam, tathāṅkurasya patrakāṇḍādyapekṣayāstu. buddher api buddhyantarasmṛtyabhilāpapravṛttyādyapekṣayā svaparopakārādyapekṣayā ceti.
    syād etat. kevalaṃ kāryaparamparānusaraṇaparyavasānābhāve yad ekam api kiṃ cid arthakriyākāri kalayitvā kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanam, tan na syāt. yad eva vā kāryaparyavasāne 'narthakriyākāri, tenaiva pūrveṣāṃ tadbhāvaprasaṅge naikam apy arthakriyāśaktaṃ sidhyatī NOTEREF _Ref461335918     dti nāsiddhiparihāraḥ.
    yat punar etad bhinnavyāvṛttikatayā sattāsiddhāv api na kāryatvakṣatir ity ucyate, tad api na samyak. vyāvṛttibhede 'pi hi sattvāsiddhau kṛtakatvasyāpi kathaṃ siddhiḥ. abhūtvā bhavanaṃ hi kṛtakatvam. bhavanaṃ ca bhavatām arthakriyākāritvam eva. tato 'rthakāritvasandehe bhavatīty eva na śakyam. apekṣitaparavyāpāratvaṃ svabhāvaniṣpattau kṛtakatvam NOTEREF _Ref461335999     f ity api nāsato dharmaḥ. sattā cārthakriyaiva. NOTEREF _Ref461335980     e evaṃ pratyayabhedabheditvādayo 'pi saddharmā na sattāniścaye 'bhidhātuṃ śakyanta iti.
    atrocyate. na tāvad aṅkurādayaḥ parito nirastavibhramāśaṅke 'bhyāsaviśeṣāsāditapaṭimni pratyakṣacetasi parisphuranto na santaḥ śakyante 'bhidhātum adarśane 'pi phalasya. anyathārthakriyāyām api na kaś cid āśvāsa iti saditaravyavahāravirahān nirīhaṃ jagaj jāyeta. NOTEREF _Ref461336074     g
    ,atha sattvalakṣaṇaṃ tāvad bhavatām arthasāmarthyam eve NOTEREF _Ref461336271     iti cet, tat kim idānīṃ samayasiddhena lakṣaṇena pratyakṣabādho 'bhidheyaḥ. tad yadi bhavato 'pi lakṣaṇadoṣa evānena krameṇa vaktum iṣṭaḥ, abhidhīyatām. asmākaṃ tu na tallakṣaṇaprasādhanāya parikarabandhaḥ, kiṃ tu tallakṣaṇena kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanāya. atas tallakṣaṇānavadhāraṇaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanapratibandham ādadhīta kārye. kāryāntaradarśane tu tatrāpi tadanumānaprasavaḥ krameṇa kena vāryate. idānīṃ tv arthakriyāsamarthasyaiva pakṣīkaraṇāt pakṣabahirbhūte sādhyasādhanayor asiddhāv api na kaś cid doṣa ity uktaprāyam.
    tasmāt sāmayikalakṣaṇakṣatāv api kiṃ punar aniścayamātre paṭutarapratyakṣabalāvalambitavastubhāve 'ṅkurādivastuni vastudharmasya kāryatvasya na virodha iti tadapekṣayā bījādikam arthakriyāsāmarthyasamarthanasaham eva, katham asiddhiḥ. NOTEREF _Ref461336216     h
    nanv arthakriyāsāmarthyam itarad vā vastulakṣaṇam aspṛśatendriyajñānena kathaṃ vastutvam avasthāpitam ity ucyate, tad api yat kiṃ cit, anubhave pramāṇāntaracintāyā niravakāśatvāt. dṛśyate hi śāstrīyalakṣaṇānullekhe 'py abhyāsabhāvitapratyakṣodayamātrād vastutvam avasāya pravṛttir avisaṃvādabhāginīti kim atra kriyatām. evaṃ tu syāt. yadi paramārthato 'rthakriyāsāmarthyam eva vastutvam, tadedam ato jāyata iti janmādhikaraṇaṃ vastūllikhatādhyakṣeṇārthakriyāsāmarthyam evollikhitaṃ tadakṣaravirahe 'pi. athānyad eva vastulakṣaṇam, tadā tad evollikhitam, yathā triguṇīmayatvam itarad vānullikhatā tadabahirbhūtaṃ nīlaṃ nīlagrāhiṇā gṛhītam eva. tat siddham adhyakṣeṇa vastutvam aṅkurādeḥ kāryatāsaṃvāde 'pi kāryāntarādarśane 'pi kāraṇasya bījāder arthasāmarthyam avasthāpayatīti.
    kāryavat tarhi bījādikam api pratyakṣodayād evāstu vastusat. kim arthasāmarthyagaveṣaṇeneti cet, na vai vastuvyavahāre pratyakṣapāṭavaṃ paribhūyārthaśaktim anusarāmaḥ, tasyā api pratyakṣādhīnatvāt. kiṃ tu kṣaṇabhaṅgam aṅgīkārayitum. pratyakṣakṛto hi vastuvyavahāra uktakrameṇa tadatallakṣaṇasādhāraṇo na kṣaṇikatvasādhanāya niyamena prabhavati. arthakriyāsāmarthyaṃ tu vastulakṣaṇam abhavad api yatra svayaṃ vartate, tatrāvaśyaṃ tad anupanīya na svarūpasattām āviśati. tataḥ sādhanatvenāsya prastāvo 'tra na vastulakṣaṇatveneti sthitam.
    evaṃ jñāne 'pi svarūpasaṃvedanaṃ sattvāvyabhicārīti sarvaṃ pūrvavat. tad anenāpi viṣayasya sāmarthyasiddhir avyāhateti veditavyam. pareṇa hi paravedane bhrāntiśaṅkāvakāśaḥ. svarūpavedane punaḥ sarvathā tadabhāva eva. atha svavedane vipratipadyeta, tadaikārthasamavāyināpi jñānena vedanasvīkāre 'ṅkurādivad eva pareṇāpi svarūpopadhānān na kaś cid doṣaḥ. anyathā dṛṣṭārthavyavahārahāniḥ sarvathā prasajyeta.
    nanu viṣayajñānayor hetuphalabhāva eva katham avagantavyaḥ, upalambhāt pūrvaṃ viṣayasyānupalambhāt. vyatirekabalād iti brūmaḥ. sati ca bāhye 'rthe sthiretaratvanirṇayārambhaḥ.
    tasmād arthakriyākadambakapakṣīkaraṇavat pramāṇagocaracakrapakṣīkaraṇe 'pi nāśrayasvarūpadvārā dvividhāpy asiddhir asthirasādhanasya.
    athārthaśakteḥ sarvathā sūkṣmavicārāsahatvāt aśaktaṃ sarvam NOTEREF _Ref461336340     j iti kva pakṣīkaraṇaṃ kiṃ vā sādhanam  NOTEREF _Ref461336340     jiti cet, NOTEREF _Ref461336340     j nanu bījāder aṅkurādiṣu dṛṣṭā śaktiḥ. NOTEREF _Ref461336403     k na hi dṛṣṭe 'nupapannaṃ nāma. NOTEREF _Ref461336427     l sarvasya hi vicāranāmnaḥ pramāṇasyānubhava eva sīmā. kiṃ caivam anicchan prāmāṇikaḥ kathaṃ dhūmād api dahanam anumāsyati. jalajvalanayor vātātapaśītārtaḥ sadṛśīṃ pravṛttim ālambeta, apravṛttiṃ vā. bhavān eva kathaṃ vā mithyāśaktim āropayatā pareṇa sādhana upanyaste tadabhāvaṃ vidvān evaitatparijayāśaṃsī dūṣaṇopanyāse tvarito 'si. tatrāpy asiddhyādikam eva vaktum ādriyase, na tu jātyuttaram. tad etad āyātam, nātmany api pratyaya iti. tasmād brūyāḥ kiṃ cit kena cit pratāritaḥ. durapahnavā tu śaktir artheṣu. matā sā cet saṃvṛtyā NOTEREF _Ref461336548     m na paramārthena,  NOTEREF _Ref461336548     mastu yathā tathā NOTEREF _Ref461336548     m saṃvṛtyā paramārthena vā, kim atra nirbandhena.
    atha sāṃvṛtaśaktisamanvayinī kṣaṇikatāpi sāṃvṛtī syān na pāramārthikīti matiḥ. tatrāpy ucyate. iha tattvābhyāso 'bhyudayaniḥśreyasaphalahetur iti nityānityādivicāram ārabhante santaḥ, tadaniścaye 'bhyāsānupapatteḥ. sa cābhyāso nityeśvarādidattasāhāyakas tannirapekṣo vā tatphalahetuḥ syād itīdṛśi prakaraṇe pramāṇaparīkṣādakṣāṇāṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgāvatāraḥ. atra yadi paramapuruṣārthasādhanam aniṣṭaparihāreṇa śaktisthitināntarīyakatayā saṃvṛtir eva, iyaṃ kṣaṇikatāpi saṃvṛtir evāstu, paramapuruṣārthopayogenaiva kṣaṇikatāyām ādarāt. kim asmākaṃ paramārthacintayā, yatra na pramāṇaprameyavibhāgaḥ sādhyasādhanavyavahāro vā kaś cit. atha paramārthe 'py evaṃ sambhavati, tadā tadākṛṣṭaḥ śaktisambhavas tadanvayī vā kṣaṇabhaṅgo na pāramārthikatvam atipatati. pramāṇaprameyavibhāgādyabhāve tu sarvathā caitanyavyāvṛttau svavinmātravyavasthitau vā pakṣadharmatvādyabhāvaniścayakālavat kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhir abhavanty api na pīḍayati. tatra kṣaṇikatāsiddhir atāttvikīti yas trāsayati, sa svargāpavargaphalaprāptir apāramārthikīti kiṃ na trasyati. tasmād yāvat sādhyasādhanabhāvavyavahāraḥ, tāvat parīkṣākṣamam ity eva pāramārthikatvam, phalabhāṣiṇaṃ prati sūkṣmavicārāntarasyāsatkalpatvād iti alaṃ vistareṇa.
    etena yad asthānābhiniveśinā nyāyabhūṣaṇakāreṇa bhāṣyakārīyakāryakāraṇabhāvadūṣaṇaprabandham utthāpya varṇitam, tat sarvaṃ nirupayogam iti pratipāditam. tathā hi yady etāvataḥ śramasyāsiddhatodbhāvanāyām eva nopayogaḥ, kim anena kartavyam. asiddhiś ca parihṛtā, puruṣārthasamīhayā vastutattvanirūpaṇapravṛttasya śaktisiddhināntarīyakavyāpāratvāt. tata eva tathā kramākramābhyāṃ kāryotpattir vyāptety etad apy asiddham NOTEREF _Ref461336624     n iti yad uktam, tad api niravakāśam.
    yad apy anena tat tad āśaṅkyottarābhimānāt paryante sāṃvṛtatvād
    arthakriyāsamarthaṃ yat tad atra paramārthasad NOTEREF _Ref461336665     o
ityuktivaiyarthyam udbhāvya likhitam. yathā saṃvṛtyārthakriyāsamartham, tathā tat paramārthasad iti cet, NOTEREF _Ref461336683     p sāmānyāvayavisaṃyogādeḥ kiṃ na tathā sattvam iṣṭam. tasya saṃvṛtyāpy asāmarthyam iti cet, na, anvayavyatirekapratibhāsasyobhayatra tulyatvāt. tathā hi yatra yatra cakṣuḥ pravartate, tatra tatra taimirikakeśādivan na stambhādipratibhāso bhavatīti stambhādeḥ sāmarthyagatiḥ.  tathā mahiṣādiṣu gavādyanvayabuddhir na bhavati. paramāṇumātreṣu saṃyogādirahiteṣu cāvayavisaṃyogabuddhir na bhavatīti sāmānyāder api sāmarthyagatir NOTEREF _Ref461336736     q iti.
    tad apy asāram. na hi saṃvṛtir ity eva parigrahas tyāgo vā, bālasaṃvṛter api grahaṇaprasaṅgāt, paṇḍitasaṃvṛter api paramapuruṣārthasādhanapravaṇāyās tyāgaprasaṅgāt. avicāritaramyā hi pratītiḥ saṃvṛtiḥ. NOTEREF _Ref461338057     r asti ca bālakasya darpaṇatalāvalīnasatyavadanagraho vicāravidhuraḥ puruṣārthasādhanagraho vā paṇḍitānāṃ tvadvicāreṇa vidhuritaḥ, na ca tyājyaḥ, tatparityāge kṣaṇabhaṅgaparīkṣānapekṣāyā iṣṭatvāt.
    atha bauddhasyaivāyaṃ vicāro mama tv atrāniṣṭir eva. tato bauddhasyaiva siddhāntavirodhaḥ sādhanasya ca vādyasiddhatādoṣa iti cet, sa tāvad ayaṃ vicāraḥ pramāṇam apramāṇaṃ vā. pramāṇatve tavāyaṃ na mameti vibhāgānupapattiḥ. pratyuta pramāṇābahirbhāvasvīkāre nādhikāraḥ prativāde 'pi tavety āyātam. athāpramāṇam, tadā yadi nāmāgamapradeśapratipādito 'rthaḥ kaś cin na samarthaḥ prakṛtasya tu na kṣatiḥ, tad etad āyātaṃ
    yadi kiṃ cit kva cic chāstre na yuktaṃ pratiṣidhyate |
      bruvāṇo yuktam apy anyad iti rājakulasthitir|| NOTEREF _Ref461336769     s
iti. sautrāntikasamayasthitasya hi kṣaṇabhaṅgaṃ prasādhayataḥ sthityantaravirodho na bādhakaḥ. anyathā

[kāryakāraṇabhāvasiddhau] iti, tadā tv avyabhicāraḥ | evaṃ yadi pratyabhijñāne 'pi lakṣaṇabhedo darśitaḥ syād darśayituṃ vā śakyo vyabhicārāvyabhicāropayogī, tadā yuktam etat | na caivam asti, sarvatrātyantasadṛśavastuni pṛthag-janapratyabhijñāyā eka-rasatvāt | yadi cāvaśyam etāvatā kālena bhrāntabhraṃśo bhavatīti kālaniyamaḥ syāt, tadāpy ucitam etat | yāvatā cchinnodbhinnakeśapāśādau purṣāyuṣakṣayeṇāpi naikatā-bhramabhraṃśo 'vaśyaṃ yatnavato bhavaty eva iti cet? na, tatrāpi niyamābhāvāt | prayatamānasyāpi hi vacanamātram apramāṇam upapatty antaraṃ ca durlabham | yadi copapattyantaraṃ pratyabhijñā-siddhaikatvabādhakam, prastute 'pi kiṃ naivam āsthīyate? kevalaṃ pratyabhijñāyātītam anumānaṃ varākam asamartham idānīṃ keśādau tava vacanamātram api samartham iti mahatī parāmarśaśaktiḥ | bhinne 'pi keśādāv abhedādhyavasāya darśanād bhavatu tatra yathākathañcid bhedasampratyaya iti cet? na, anyatrāpi bahulaṃ tathā darśanāt | na hi stambham ekam apanīya niveśite sadṛśe stambhāntare na bhavaty eva pratyabhijñānam || evaṃ ghaṭapaṭasphaṭikādiṣv api yatra yāvad atyantasadṛśa-lābhaḥ | bhinnakāladarśane cāyaṃ nyāyaḥ | samasamayaṃ tu ayo-golakayugalopalambhe 'pi bhavaty eva bhedavyavasāyaḥ | tasmāt kālabhedenaikābhimate 'pi stambhādau bhinna eva kim ayam ekatvādhyavasāyaḥ stambhāntareṇeva? athābhinna iti saṃśayaḥ pratyabhijñāyāḥ prāmāṇyapratiṣedhī kathaṃ niṣedhyaḥ? atha kṣaṇabhedenābhedasyādṛṣṭapūrvatvān na saṃśaya iti cet | naitad api sādhu | na hy adṛṣṭam ity eva nāstīti śakyate vaktum, sato 'pi sūkṣmatayā 'nupalakṣaṇāt | tatkṣaṇodayavyaya dehopacayāpacayavat | tato 'nupalakṣaṇe 'pi bhedasya sattāṅgollekhaśekharo durnivāraḥ saṃśayaḥ | etāvad vimarśābhāve tu itara-janasya niścala ekāvasāyaḥ syāt | yāuktas tu so 'pi saṃśaya eva | kiṃ ca kṣaṇabhedenāpi bhedaḥ pramāṇaparidṛṣṭatvād dṛṣṭa eva |
