anabhyāsadarśāyām ekatāgrahaḥ tatra stambhādau tv abhyāsavato 'pi iti cet, nanu kṣaṇabhedabhāvini viśeṣe sarvatraivāsmādarśo 'nabhyāsa ity upapāditam eva | ambhaḥ stambhādau tu tatkriyā-sārthasāmānyālambanaḥ sarvatrābhyāsaḥ sthūlaviṣayaḥ | tasmān na pratyakṣeṇa kṣaṇadvaye abhedasādhanavyāpāraḥ svīkartuṃ śakyaḥ | ekāvasāyamātraṃ tu sad api vyabhicārād asamartham |
nanu sarvatra nīlādau pṛṣṭhabhāvinā vikalpena pratyakṣasya vyāpāro 'nugamyamānaḥ prāmāṇyam upanayati | tad-ekatāvasāyo 'py ekaviṣayam eva prāmāṇyam asya dīpayatv iti cet, na khalu sarvatra pṛṣṭhabhāvivikalpaviṣaye prāmāṇyam indriya-jñānasya | marīciviṣayasyāpi jalāvasāye jalaviṣaye prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt | vikalpāpekṣaṃ tu prāmāṇyam iti tadanudaye na prāmāṇyam iti nyāyaḥ | tad-udaye tu saṃvādāpekṣam eva tat | na caikādhyavasāyasya saṃvādaḥ sa ity āveditam etat |
nanu yatra bādhaḥ tatrāprāmāṇyam abādhite prāmāṇyam iti kiṃ na paryāptam? iyaṃ gatir avanatagaganapratibhāse 'pi deśakālanarāntaravyāpinī sambhavati, nirūpyamāṇā truṭyati iti pratyabhijñāyām api samānam |
kiṃ cāyam abādho nāma bādhāviraho bādhānupalabdhir veti vikalpayoḥ kramād asiddhir anekāntaś ca duṣpratividhānaḥ | anupalabdhimātreṇa niṣedhāsiddheḥ, bādhakasya ca anumānasyābhidhāsyamānatvāt | atha pratyakṣasamākhyāteyaṃ pratyabhijñā, katham anumānena bādhyate? na cābādhyatvapratijñānād bādhakasya sadbhāva-cintāvakāśe 'numānasyāpy avakāśaḥ svayam eva dattaḥ | prāmāṇyasyaiva siddhi-bādhanayor adhikārāt pratyakṣam evāsyā bādhakam astv iti cet, saṃvādadraḍhimni pratyakṣaśatenāpi kim asyāḥ? tataḥ pratyakṣeṇāpi bādhanam asyāḥ saṃvādaśaithilyaṃ sambhāvayadanumānam api sannidhāpayati |

[15] api ca māyākaraḥ śirasi nimajjitaṃ golakam āsyena niḥsārayatīti pratyabhijñā śirasi chidraprasaṅgasaṅgatenānumānena bādhyamānā kiṃ nopalabdhā? bādhyamānā na pratyakṣam iti prastute 'py astu | ataḥ pratyakṣatvakīrtanam asyā yācitakamaṇḍanamātram atrāṇam | yathā cāvanatākāśapratibhāsaḥ sarvasampratipattāv api nābādhya eva, tathā nāvisaṃvādy evety api vyaktam | tadvad eva caikatā-grahaḥ sarvasampratipattāv api nāvisaṃvādī | na hi tadaparādhyavasāyodayam antareṇa praṇatāmbarasaṃvedane sa evāyam iti pratyaye 'paraḥ saṃvādo 'rthakriyādisvabhāvaḥ sambhavati | ataś ca bādhakābhāve 'pi nāmāprāmāṇyavyavahāro 'śakyasādhanaḥ | tad-vad eva saṃvādena prāmāṇyam anuaśāsataḥ tadabhāvāt prāmāṇyavyavahāro 'pi kutaḥ pratyabhijñāyāḥ? ubayaniścayābhāve ca tad-ubhayāvalambī saṃśayaḥ siddhaḥ | tal-lakṣaṇe kadalakāṇḍādau vyabhicāradarśanāt paripṛṣṭāniṣṭāṅgaś ca | tatkutaḥ prāmāṇyam?

[15,11] kiṃ ca, ya evam āha visaṃvādinī yā sā pratyabhijñaiva na bhavati tadābhāsatvād iti, tenaśabdādau prameyatvaṃ hetū-kṛtya yat sādhyavyabhicāri prameyatvaṃ, tat-prameyatvam eva na bhavati tadābhāsatvād ity api vaktavyam eva |
atha pramāṇaviṣayatvamātraṃ prameyatvam, tac ca vyabhicāriṇo 'py akṣīṇam | evaṃ tarhi pūrvāpraikīkaraṇamātraṃ pratyabhijñārthaḥ | tac ca vyabhicāriṇyā apy asti | pratyabhijñā nāma kriyātāṃ mā vā, kevalaṃ sā pramāṇam eva na bhavatīti vaktavyam | prameyatvam api yad-vyabhicāri, tat liṅgam eva na bhavatīty api brūhi | eka-lakṣaṇatayā yathaikatra vyabhicāras tathānyatrāpi sambhavan na nivāryata iti pratyabhijñāne 'pi nāśakyam ||

[15,12] kiṃ ca, ya evam āha: visaṃvādinī yā sāpratyabhijñaiva na bhavati tadābhāsatvād iti, tena śabdādau prameyatvaṃ hetū-kṛtya yat sādhyavyabhicāri prameyatvaṃ, tat-prameyatvam eva na bhavati tadābhāsatvād ity api vaktavyam eva |
atha pramāṇaviṣayatvamātraṃ prameyatvam, tac ca vyabhicāriṇo 'py akṣīṇam | evaṃ tarhi pūrvāpraikīkaraṇamātraṃ pratyabhijñārthaḥ | tac ca vyabhicāriṇyā apy asti | pratyabhijñā nāma kriyātāṃ mā vā, kevalaṃ sā pramāṇam eva na bhavatīti vaktavyam | prameyatvam api yad-vyabhicāri, tat liṅgam eva na bhavatīty api brūhi | eka-lakṣaṇatayā yathaikatra vyabhicāras tathānyatrāpi sambhavan na nivāryata iti pratyabhijñāne 'pi nāśakyam || nanv agnir atrety anumānam ananumānaṃ ca hetvābhāsakāle samānākāram | tatkathamekatrāśvaso nānyatra? hetu-dvāreṇa viśeṣāt | yathā hi ekaṃ trirūpa-liṅganiścaya-janitam anyad anyathā, yathā kāryakāraṇabhāvapratītir eva kācit pariśuddhā yā adhyakṣānupalabdhisādhanā, kācid anyatheti darśitam | tathā ca sati bhinna-lakṣaṇatvāt nāśvāsānāśvāsasaṅkaraḥ | tathā na pratyabhijñāyāṃ śakyam, anupahatendriyasyeva tajjñānasya vā vyabhicāriṇyām api vyāpārāt | nāparaḥ parair api paridīpite viśeṣaḥ | dīrghakālānubandhamātraṃ tu bahala-

[16] vyāmohād adṛṣṭādi-hetuprabhāvād viparyayasāmagrī-samavadhānaparilambe 'py upapattimat,yathoktaṃ prāk | yad vā yataḥ kutaścit parokṣārthapratipattim anumānam anumatya yatra vyabhicāraḥ, tal-liṅgam eva na bhavati, anumānaṃ veti nirvṛttim ālambamānaḥ pakṣadharmatvādikaṃ liṅga-lakṣaṇaṃ tat-prabhavam anumānaṃ kiṃ artham abhidadhyāt?
atha vyabhicāriṇo 'pi vyabhicāradarśanam asamartham, sāmagrī-lābhavilambe vyabhicārādadarśanamātreṇa liṅgatvaprasaṅgād vaktavyam eva lakṣaṇam, yad-īkṣaṇān nirvṛttir anīkṣaṇād anāśvāsaś ca jāyate? tato na prekṣas tadanurūpānuṣṭhāna prārambham āsādayet | santi hi pratyanīkadarśanasthānāṃ sādhanāni cirakākābhyāsabhavitā samasamādhi-balonmīlad adhyakṣagocaravyabhicārāṇi kṣaṇikatādisādhanavat | tatkim idānīṃ vyabhicārād adarśanamātreṇa bhāvinyāḥ pramāṇānupapatteḥ sādhanāny eva bhavantu tadanurūpānuṣṭhānena (7b) vā viphalamāyā-samāviśatu prekṣaḥ | pakṣadharmatvādi-lakṣaṇe tu tal-lakṣaṇanirūpaṇāyāṃ tadaprāptau tadaiva hastakatyāgān nāyā-samāviśati | tal-lakṣaṇaprāptau vā tad eva upādadīta | tan na vyabhicārāvalambanaṃ sādhu, vyatirekanirākaraṇāyaiva vivekārambhāt || tatkathaṃ lakṣaṇam avācyam iti cet, etat sarvaṃ pratyabhijñāyām api ālocayan yāvan na lakṣaṇabhedaṃ paśyasi, tāvannaikasyāṃ vyabhicārādarśī vyabhicārād adarśanamātreṇāparasyām āśvāsam ekāntena kartum arhasi | tasmāl lakṣaṇayukte bādhāsambhave tal-lakṣaṇam eva dūṣitaṃ syād iti sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ | tad iyaṃ pratyabhijñā vyapanayatu vyabhicāraśaṅkāṃ, kalaṅkitā tayā na kālāntarasthitim arthasya sthāpayituṃ prabhavati, nāpy anumānam anavakāśayitum | tatkathaṃ tadapekṣayā pratyakṣabādhitaḥ pakṣa ucyate? sapakṣe vā jaladhare katham anvayābhāvaḥ?
atha mā bhūt pratyabhijñāyāḥ prāmāṇyam, tadanusārī sthiratāniścayo vā | kṣaṇikatvāvadhāraṇaṃ tu sapakṣīkṛte kathaṃ yataḥ sapakṣe sattvaṃ hetor upapadyate? ucyate, iha jaladharasya jaladhāraṇakriyā-samarthas tāvad ekārthasvabhāvo 'śakyaparihāraḥ | kṣaṇāntare ca dvitīyādau tatkriyāyāḥ kṛtatvāt punaḥ kartum aśakyatvāt taj-jātīyām anya-jātīyāṃ vā kuryāt | na kuryād vā kām api kriyām iti pakṣaḥ | evaṃ tat kriyākaraṇakṣaṇāt prāg api

[17] vaktavyam | tatra yadi tatkaraṇasamarthasvabhāvo 'mbhodharaḥ, tatkṣaṇavat kṣaṇāntare 'pi kathaṃ kadācit kriyā-vicchedaḥ? kṣaṇāntaranivartanīyakriyā-samarthasvabhāvatve vā kṣaṇāntaravat tatrāpi kṣaṇe sa-jātīyetarakriyā-prasavaprasaṅgaḥ | kṣaṇāntare 'pi hi tac chāmarthyasya sambhavāj jananaṃ tac cānyadāpy akṣīṇam |

kāryāṇi hi vilambante kāraṇāsannidhānataḥ |
samarthahetu-sadbhāve kṣepas teṣāṃ tu kiṃ kṛtaḥ || (TS 395)

etenākaraṇapakṣo 'pi pratikṣiptaḥ | yadā vilambo 'py asahyaḥ, tadā dūrotsāritam akaraṇam | asāmarthye vā samīhitasamaye 'py akaraṇaprasaṅgaḥ, sadaikasvabhāvatvāt | svabhāvabhraṃśe ca prati-kṣaṇaṃ kṣayaḥ siddho jaladharasya | tatra prayogaḥ, yad yadā yaj jananasamarthaṃ tat tadā taj janayaty eva | yathā 'ntyā kāraṇasāmagrī svakāryam, sa eva vā jaladharas tad avasthāyāṃ vāri dhārayan kṛṣī-balavilocanotsavādi-kāryam, vārivitaraṇakāle vā tatkriyām, śaktaś cāyam ubhayadaśāyām ubhayakāryam arjitum iti svabhāvahetuprasaṅga | jananam antareṇa sāmarthyavyavasthāyāṃ sarvasya sarvatra śaktivyavahāraprasaṅgaḥ | niyataś cāyaṃ pratipanno vyavahāraḥ | na cāsya jananād anyan nimittam upapadyate | tato jananavinābhāve vipakṣe niyamavattve (8a) lakṣaṇavyāpakaviyogenātmasattayā viyujyamāno janana eva viśrāmyatīti samarthavyavahāragocaratvamātrānubandhi janakatvaṃ siddham iti vyāptisiddhiḥ ||
evaṃ yad yadā yatkaraṇasamarthaṃ tat-tadā tatkaroty eva | yathā 'ntyā kāraṇasāmagrī | śaktaś cāyaṃ sakalakriyātikramakāle 'pīti | anyadā sarvathā 'karaṇapakṣe yojyam | asamarthasvabhāvatve tu yad yatrāśaktaṃ na tat tatkaroti, yathā śālyaṅkuraṃ kodravaḥ |aśaktaś cāyam udavāhano 'karaṇakṣaṇavat kṣaṇāntare 'pi, iti vyāpakaviruddhopalabdheḥ na kadācit kuryād iti hetv-arthaḥ | viparyayaprayogaś ca, yad yan na karoti na tat tatra śaktam, yathā śālyaṅkuram akurvan kodravaḥ | na karoti ca prathamakṣaṇasādhyāṃ kriyāṃ dvitīyādikṣaṇe, dvitīyādi-kṣaṇasādhyaṃ

[18,1] vā prathamakṣaṇa, iti vyāpakānupalabdhir jaladharasya tat-tatkriyāsu samarthāsamarthasvabhāvatayā prati-kṣaṇaṃ bhedam utpādayatīti || evaṃ sarvathā 'karaṇāpekṣayā yad yatra karoti na tat tatra samarthaṃ yathā śālyaṅkuram akurvan kodravaḥ | na karoticākaraṇakāle karaṇakālakāryaṃ kriyām iti | sāmarthyāpekṣayā,
yad yat karoti na tat tatrāśaktam, antyasāmagrīvat | karoti cāyaṃ toyadharas toyadhāraṇam iti viruddhavyāptopalabdhir asamarthakṣaṇād bhinatti karaṇasamartham | yathā hi jananena vyāpyate samarthasthiti-yogyatā, tathā jananaṃ tayāpi (|) tad asāmarthyaviruddhaṃ yat sāmarthyaṃ tena vyāptaṃ karaṇam upalabhyamānasāmarthyaṃ kadarthayatīti samarthāsamarthasvabhāvatayā svabhāvabhedaḥ siddhas toyadasya | tatkathaṃ sattvād anyad anumānaṃ nāstīty ucyate?
atra ca samarthavyavahārayogyatā-jananayor bhinnavyāvṛttikatayā sādhyāviśiṣṭatā hetor ity avāntaraiḥ kīrtitaṃ dūṣaṇam anavakāśaṃ veditavyam | tasmād ekārthakāriṇiḥ kṣaṇāntarāpekṣayā samarthetarasvabhāvatayā bheda eveti kṣaṇabhaṅgitayā sapakṣatām āvahati | balāhake sattvasiddhir aviruddhā |
nanu kṣaṇabhedeṣv avatiṣṭhamānasyāpi bhāvasya sahakārisaṃgamāpekṣayā karaṇākaraṇam upapadyamānaṃ kathaṃ svabhāvabhedam āpādayituṃ prabhavati? tato yathoktaprasaṅgamaulahetuṣv anekāntaḥ | kiṃ punar asya samarthasvabhāvasya sahakāribhiḥ kartavyam, yad ayam anapekṣya sahakāriṇo na svakāryakarmaṇi pravṛttim ālambate? anupakāriṇy apekṣāyā ayogāt | svayam asamarthas tu sāmarthyam arthayamānaḥ sahakāriṇo 'pekṣata iti yuktam etat | tato 'kiñcit karāḥ ca sahakāriṇo 'pekṣā-gocarāś ceti vyāhatam |
atra śaṃkaraḥ, sahakāriviraho hi tasyāsāmarthyam ucyate | tac cāsya sahakārisākalyahetubhir apanīyate, tayor ekatra (8b) sahasthitivirodhāt | sākalyahetubhyaś ca vaikalyasyaiva vyāvṛttiḥ, na tadvataḥ sākalyasya sahakārivirahavyāvṛttirūpatvāt | na ca sahakārisākalyavaikalyayor āvirbhāvatirobhāvābhyāṃ tad-vatas tadbhāvasiddhiḥ, tasya tābhyām anyatvāt | ata eva sahakārivirahavyāvṛtti-hetor na tad-vatas tirobhāvasiddhir iti ||

[19,1] etad eva nyāyabhūṣaṇakāro 'py āha, sahakāriṇas tasya kam upakāraṃ kurvanti yena tair vinā na karotīti cet, kāryam eva kurvanti | anyopakārakaraṇe hi sahakāritvam eva na syāt | tathā hi yadi tam eva kurvanti tadā tatkāriṇa eva syuḥ na tat-sahakāriṇaḥ | tena sahaikaṃ kāryaṃ kurvanto hi tat-sahakāriṇo 'bhidhīyanta iti | tathā bhavatu nāmānupakārako 'pi sahakārī, tathā yadi tasya prāg eva śaktir asti kiṃ na karoti? nāsti cet, paścād aśaktaḥ kathaṃ karoti? paścāc chaktaś cet, śaktāśaktayoḥ kathaṃ na nānātvam? viruddhadharmādhyāsasya bhedakatvād ity āśaṅkya sahakārisākalyaṃ hi tasya śaktiḥ | tad-vaikalyaṃ cāśaktiḥ | tena sahakārivaikalye prāg aśakta ucyate | paścāt sākalye ca śaktaḥ | dharmadharmiṇoś ca bhedaḥ prasādhitaḥ | tena śakty utpāde 'pi nāvaśyaṃ tad utpādaḥ | aśaktinivṛttāv api nāvaśyaṃ tadvato nivṛttiḥ, pratibandhābhāvād iti |
tad etat sarvam apohaprastāve dharmadharmiṇor abhedapratipādanenaiva nirastaṃ veditavyam, sākalyavaikalyayor āvirbhāvatirobhāvābhyāṃ dharmiṇa eva tathāvasthānāt | astu vā dharmadharmiṇor bheda eva (|) nāpi sahakāriṇām akiñcit-paratve vipratipādyāmahe | kevalaṃ na tāvanta eva sahakāriṇaḥ kāryakāriṇaḥ | nāpi sākalyam eva kāryam arjati, kiṃ tu so 'pi bhāvaḥ | tadarthaṃ tair eva prayattam iti na vistareṇopayogaḥ | tasya ca bhāvasya yādṛśaś caramakṣaṇe 'kṣepakriyā-dharmā svabhāvaḥ(,) tādṛśa eva cet, prathamakṣaṇe 'pi, tadaiva prasahya kurvāṇo gīrvāṇaśāpenāpi nāpahastayituṃ śaktaḥ | kiṃ punas tavāmunā marmapīḍā-janitaviklavavikrośamātreṇa? yathā hi śaktāśaktayā bhaṅgaprasaṅgaparihārāya sākalyavaikalya-lakṣaṇadharmāntarasvabhāve śaktyaśaktī bhinnasvabhāve kalpite, tathā na so 'py akṣepakriyā-dharmā svabhāvo bhāvād bhinna evābhidhātuṃ śakyaḥ, bhāvasyākartṛtvaprasaṅgāt |
atha yathā śaktyaśaktī bhinnau dharmau pratijānīmahe, na ca tayor udayavyayābhyāṃ bhāvasya kiñcit, tathā 'kṣepakriyā-dharmatvaṃ kṣepakriyā-dharmatvaṃ ca dharmāntaram eva | tac ca sahakārisannidhānapratyayabhāvākṣepam udety vyeti ceti | tathaiva bhāvasya na kiñcid ity ucyate |
ucyatām | kevalam astu nedānīṃ kārya-janma, kāraṇābhimatasya tādavasthyāt | tathā hi na sahakāriṇa eva, nāpi sākalyam eva janakaṃ tathā sākalye (9a) sati

[20,1] jātam akṣepakriyā-dharmatvam api na prakṛtaṃ bhāvam anapekṣya janakam, janakatve 'pi svayam eva bhāvasya janakatvasvīkārāt | kiṃ tu prakṛto pi bhāvaḥ kartā svīkartavyaḥ | sa ca pracīnadaśāto 'natiricyamānamūrtiḥ kurvan pūrvam api kuryāt, akurvan vā paścād api na kuryād iti tadavasthaḥ paribhavaḥ | yadi tu kādācitkaṃ sākalyādivastv-antaram eva hetuḥ, tadā kāryam api tad apekṣyaṃ kādācitkam iti nyāyyam etat | evaṃ yāvad yāvad dharmāntaraparikalpaḥ, tāvat tāvad udāsīno bhāvaḥ | atha akṣepakriyā-dharmatvaṃ jātaṃ, kāryaṃ tu tato notpādyata iti ko 'yaṃ nyāyaḥ? tad avaśyaṃ kāryeṇa janitavyam | tac cākṣepakriyā-dharmatvaṃ prāṅ-nāsīd iti kāryodayasyāpi nāvakāśaḥ | evaṃ tarhi kāryotpādanāntarīyakam akṣepakāritvam, akṣepakāritvanāntarīyakaś ca kāryotpāda iti vyaktam itaretarāśrayatvam | anyathā na yadi kāryotpādanāntarīyakam akṣepakāritvam, nākṣepakāritvena kāryodayākṣepaḥ | yadi ca nākṣepakāritvanāntarīyakaḥ kāryotpādo 'kṣepakāritvāt prāg api syāt | ekārthatve tu sākalye jāte saty akṣepakāritvaṃ dharmāntaraṃ jātam iti kim anayā bhāṣayābhihitaṃ kāryam utpannam iti? tathā ca sati na prakṛtadoṣaparihāraḥ | na hi kārya-janmani vivādaḥ, yat svarūpāpekṣas tu kāryodayaḥ tasya sarvadā tādavasthyāt kathaṃ kadācitkateti cintyate |
tasmād akṣepakriyā-dharmeti janayaīti vā yat svarūpapuraskāreṇeyam abhikhyā tasya prāg api sattve katham ajani kadācit? akṣepakriyā-dharmakapratyanīkasvabhāvasya vā prācyasya paścād anuvṛttau kathaṃ kadācid api kāryasambhavaḥ? atha yadi sa evaikaḥ kartā syāt? yuktam etat kiṃ tu sāmagrī janikā tat-sahakāryantaravirahavelāyāṃ balīyaso 'pi na kāryaprasava iti kim atra viruddham? ekārthakaraṇāc ca sahakāritvam uktam, nopakāreṇeti |
atrocyate | yadi militāḥ santaḥ kāryaṃ kurvate, tadaikārthakaraṇa-lakṣaṇaṃ sahakāritvam eṣām astu, ko niṣeddhā? militair eva tu tat kāryaṃ kartavyam iti kuto labhyate? pūrvāparakāryayor ekatve tāvad bhāvasya sarvadā jananājananayor anyataraniyamaprasaṅgasya durnirvāratvāt | tasmāt sāmagrī janikā, naikaṃ janakam iti sthiravādināṃ manorathasyānyaviṣayaḥ | dṛśyate tāvad evam iti cetata eva na sthairyapakṣaḥ kṣama iti

[21,1] brumaḥ | sarvo hi prasaṅgo viparyayaparyavasānaḥ | tato yadi nityatā syāt janayituḥ, janyaṃ sarvadā syān na vā kadācid apīti |
na caivam, sākalya eva kadācitkāryotpattir iti niyamena svabhāvabhaṅgaḥ |
nanu yadi kvacin nityaṃ sarvadā kāraṇam upalabdhaṃ syāt, tadā kvacin nityatvābhyupagame sadā kartṛtvaprasaṅgaḥ saṃgacchate | yāvatā sarvadā tasyābhāvāt katham etādṛśaṃ prasañjayituṃ śakyate?
(9b) tad etad api grāmyam | tathā hi nityatve satīti | asyāyam arthaḥ | parakālabhāvī janako yaḥ svabhāvo bhāvasya, sa eva yadi pūrvakālabhāvī, pūrvakālabhāvī vā yo 'janakaḥ svabhāvaḥ sa eva yadi parakālabhāvī, tadā tad upalabdham eva jananam ajananaṃ vā syād iti | tathā ca sati siddhayor ekatvārope siddham eva jananam ajananaṃ vā prasajyeta | na pūrvaparasvabhāvayor ekatvasambhavān nityatve satīty ucyata iti kim atra viruddham?
atha pūrvaparayor ekatvaṃ na upalabdhaṃ katham āropyata iti manīṣā? evaṃ sati śuktāv api rajatāropeṇa na bhāvyam | na hi rajatasvarūpā śuktiḥ kvacid upalabdhigocaraḥ | āropyamāṇaṃ tu rajataṃ kadācid upalabdham eveti nāropakṣatir iti bhavatām api kṛtāntaḥ | tathā prasute 'pi pūrvāparasvabhāvayor ekatvaṃ nopalabhe | āropyamāṇau tu mithaḥ pūrvāparasvabhāvau siddhāv eva | tad-ārope karaṇākaraṇe api prasajyamāne samañjase eva, guñjāpuñje jvalanāropaviddhau dāhavat |
tad etad atilāghavam āviṣkṛtam-ātmanaḥ śaṅkareṇa | tad ayaṃ jātyandhānāṃ nīlādiprativedhavad asambandho niṣedhaḥ saugatānām asanto 'kṣaṇikā ity abhidadhānena | tasmāt sthitam etat, sthirātmatve militvaiva kāryakāraṇaniyamo bhāgyahīnamanorājyakam arthaṃ paripuṣṇaāti paravyāmohanād anyam anupayuktāprastutābhidhānāt? kṣaṇikatvavādinā hi śaktāśaktasvabhāvatayā viruddham ārdhyāsād bhedam āropayatā yādṛśī śaktir-aśaktiś ca vivakṣitā tat-pratividhānam ācaritum acitam asya | tadapahāya svayaṃ kṛta

[22,1] saṅketena parihāram āracayatīti mahan-naipuṇyaṃ naiyāyikapravarasya | yo hi dhūmād atrāgninā bhāvyam ity āha, tatrāpi yadi kaścid gardabhādau dūmaśabdaṃ saṃketya vahnim apahnavīta, na kaścid doṣaḥ | kṣaṇikavādī hi yaj janayaīti samākhyayā yad anantarabhāvi kāryaṃ tat-svarūpaṃ śaktam ity āha | na cedam apūrvaṃ saṃketamātram | loke 'pi hi jananadvāraka eva śaktavyavahāraḥ | yady api sākalyavata eva jananaṃ tathāpi na sākalyadvāreṇa śakta-ucyate, kiṃ tu jananāt | kṣepavati sākalye 'pi śaktavyavahārasyāñjasasyābhāvāt, anadhyavasitasahakāriviśeṣasākalyasyāpi jananadarśane idam atra śaktam iti vyavahārāt | tādṛśaṃ ca svarūpaṃ śaktir ucyate | asya śaktir iti bhedanirdeśe 'py svarūpam itivad abhinnaiva | sa ca janayitāṃ svabhāvaḥ prāg apy asti, na ca janayatīti niyataṃ mātā ca bandhyā ceti prāptam iti | atra prakaraṇe yadi nāma tvayā kvacit śakti-śabdaniveśanaṃ kṛtam, tadāvirbhāvatirobhāvābhyāṃ ca na bhāvasya kiñcit | tataḥ prastute kim āyātam? yat khalu janayitṛ-rūpa-janayitṛ-bhāvād abhinnaṃ tayor yadi nodayavyayau kutaḥ (10a) kādācitkatā kāryasya? udayavyayayoge vā svabhāvabhedas tadavasthaḥ |
yadi tu tad api na janayadrūpaṃ bhinnam eva, tadā tasyāpi nodayavyayābhyāṃ bhāvatruṭiḥ | kevalam ajanaka eva bhāvaḥ syād iti mūlanāśaḥ | tasmād brūyāḥ kiñcit kiñcitkarasya kvacit kāryakālabhedena śaktāśaktasvabhāvayor viruddhadharmādhyāsād bheda eva |
ata eva yad āha bhūṣaṇakāraḥ, tatra kālabhedenāvirodhāt | yathā kriyotpatteḥ pūrvaṃ niṣkriyaḥ sphaṭikaḥ, sa eva paścāt sakriyaḥ | sādhyatvād adṛṣṭānta iti cet, na pramāṇasiddhasya sādhyatvāyogāt | evaṃ hi viruddhadharmādhyāsād bhedo 'py asiddha ity api bruvāṇaḥ kathaṃ vāryate? tasmād yayor dharmayor yathā virodho dṛṣṭaḥ, tayos tathaivābhyupagantavyaḥ | yathā sa eva hetuḥ svakārya prati śaktaḥ, kāryāntaraṃ praty aśakta ity ekasyaiva viṣayabhedaṃ prati śaktyaśaktī na viruddhe, tathā kālabhedenāpi śakti-bhede śaktimad abhedasya pramāṇasiddher ubhayatrāviśeṣād iti | etad apy asāram | etayā hiṇḍīrapiṇḍāḍambaraṃ viḍambayate | tathā hi na khalu pramāṇasiddhir nāma pratyakṣānumāne paribhūyābhidhātuṃ śakyate | tatra ca pratyakṣam iti na pratyabhijñā-vikalpād anyat | sā ca nivāritā |

[23,1] yac cānumānam āha śaṅkaraḥ sthirasiddhau notpattyanantaraṃ vināśī bhāvaḥ prameyatvāt | vastuvyāvṛttivad iti | avidyamānavipakṣatvād anvayy eva hetuḥ | prameyatvasya kṣaṇikatvena virodhābhāvāt sandigdhavyatirekam iti cet, na khalu kṣaṇikatve kasyacit prameyatvaṃ sidhyati, kṣaṇasthitidharmaṇaḥ pramāṇakāle 'tipātāt, atītasya ca pratyakṣatve 'tiprasaṅgāt |
tad api manorathamātram | tathā hi | mā bhūtītasaya grahṇam | vartamānaya ca kṣaṇikasyaiva kṣaṇikena jñānena grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati | tasmād avirodha eva prameyatvakṣaṇikatvayoḥ | atha kāraṇaṃ viṣaya iti jñānāt prāg apekṣitasattāko 'rthaḥ kṣaṇāntare 'nanuvartamāno na grāhya eva syāt, kṣaṇāntānuvṛttau vā akṣaṇikatvam eveti cet, tat kim iyaṃ rājñām-ājñā yad ajanakena grāhyeṇa na bhavitavyam iti?
ayam asya samayaeveti cet, nyāyasyāyam avasaro na samayasya | tasmāt samayam anapekṣya vādavyasaninā nyāyopanyāsena paro bodhayitavyaḥ |

samayasya hi sādhanatve sarvasiddher nyāyo nāma na kiñcit |
nyāyas tu samayabādhanāyaiva kathaṃ samayam eva śaraṇīkuryāt ||

katham ajanitena grahaṇam atiprasaṅgaś caivam iti cet? janitenāpi kathaṃ grahaṇam? jāyamānaṃ hi jñānaṃ viṣayam anubhavad upajāyate | tac ca janmaviṣayakṛtam anyakṛtaṃ vā syāt, ko viṣeśaḥ? atiprasaṅgas tu sādhāraṇaḥ, cakṣurādināpi tasya jananāt |
tasyāviṣayasvabhāvatvād iti cet, nanu gṛhyamāṇa eva viṣayo vyavahriyate, na jātiniyataḥ kaścid viṣayo nāma | tato 'viṣayatvād ity agṛhyamāṇatvān na gṛhyata iti kvedam uttaraṃ sambadhyate | tathā hi svabhāvād eva nendriyaṃ gṛhyata iti cet, na, yogināṃ darśanasvīkārāt |
pṛthag-janāpekṣayā niyama eṣa iti cet? pṛthag-janāpekṣayā tarhi sūkṣmādayo 'pi svabhāvenaiva gṛhyata iti nātiprasaṅgaḥ | atha vā,

pūrvakaiva tu sāmagrī sajñānaṃ viṣayakṣaṇam |
sāloka-rūpavat kuryād yena syāt sahavedanam ||

[24,1] tena vā svaviṣayaniyatam utpāditaṃ jñānaṃ tad-ekagrāhi, tatkāraṇasāmagryā vā tan-niyatam utpāditam iti nirviṣeṣaḥ | atas tasyā eva te artha-jñāne grāhyagrāhakabhāvaniyata-janmanī katham atiprasajyeyātām?
atha sākāravedanavādino hi viṣayād eva tat-svarūpasaṃvitter utpattir abhimatā, tatrātītagrahaṇe 'tiprasaṅgaḥ, grahaṇakṣaṇānuvṛttau ca sthirasiddhir iti vivakṣitam | tat kim ayaṃ prasaṅgahetur yat paropagamanam anapekṣya na bhavati? tathā ca sati viparyayaparyavasānāt tava sthirasiddhir atītagrahaṇaṃ veti na grāhyāt tat-svarūpa-jñānotpattir iti syāt | evaṃ ca sati vyaktam anyad bhuktam anyad vāntam iti nyāyaḥ | sthiram ārabdhaḥ sādhayituṃ tad-viparyayeṇa sākārabodhaṃ vidhurayatīti |
atha sautrāntikasyedam ubhayam asamañjasam itīyan mātram ucyate, tad api nāsti | sākāravedanodayapakṣasthitau hi dvitīyakṣaṇānuvṛttāv apy arthasya jaḍatayā prakāśānupapatteḥ viparyayasarūpasvarūpasaṃvedanam eva jñāsya viṣayavedanam | evaṃ ca na vartamānānurodhaḥ, atīte 'pi tat-pratyāsatter apracyuteḥ | na cātiprasaṅgaḥ, viṣayāntareṇa sārūpyasamarpaṇāt | na ca tan-matanirvāhaḥ prakṛtaḥ | bhavatas tu tan-matāśrayeṇāpi prameyatvahetuḥ sthirasiddhaye na prabhavatīti anekāntaparihārād iti | tataḥ sthiravapuṣi pramāṇāntarasiddher ayogāt vajro 'pi pakṣakukṣau nikṣiptaḥ, kiṃ punaḥ sphaṭiko varākaḥ? tad ayaṃ sakryākryāvasthayor bhidyamānaḥ kathaṃ kāmabhedenāvirodhe dṛṣṭāntībhavitum arhatīti? yac ca viṣayabhedeneva kālabhedenāpi śaktyaśaktyor avirodhapratipādanam, tad apy anaupayikam | pratiyogī hi dharmo virodhakaḥ sarvatra | na ca svakāryakaraṇasya parakāryākaraṇam pratyaīkam | kiṃ tu svakāryākaraṇam eva | evaṃ parakāryākaraṇasyāpi parakāryakaraṇaṃ pratyanīkam | na svakāryakaraṇam | svakāryaṃ na karotīti vyavacchettṛm eva hi svakāryaṃ karotīty ucyate | pratyakṣavyāpāraś ca te svakāryakariṇaṃ parakāryakāriṇaṃ ca bhāvabhedāvasthāpayati | kālabhede tu naikāntāvyavashāpakaṃ pratyakṣam, pratyabhijñāyā dūṣitatvāt | tataḥ svakāryasya karaṇaṃ ca pariśiṣyamāṇaṃ na virodhaparihārāya paryāpnoti |

[25,1] kākānekātvāpekṣasvakāryakāraṇaṃ viruddham iti cet? syād iyam apekṣā parabhāgabhāgino yadi viṣayabhedavadabhedāpādakapramāṇavṛttiḥ syād ity uktaprāyam |
bhavato 'pi tadanapekṣya viroddhasthitau kiṃ pramāṇam iti cet?
uktam eva yad yadā yaj jananasamarthaṃ (11a) tat-tadā janayaty evety-ādi, sahakāryapekṣāyāś ca tat-sannidhānāsannidhānayoḥ kāryāj janana(: kāryārjjana)-prasaṅgena nirastatvāt | tasmāt janayas-rūpam eva śaktir vivakṣitā kṣaṇabhaṅgavādinaḥ | tasyāś ca bhede kathaṃ na bhāvabhraṃśaḥ? |
yac ca nyāyabhūṣaṇena pralapitam, yady asya bhinnā śaktiḥ śaktimato 'bhyupagamyate, tathāpi nāvaśyaṃ śaktāśaktayor bhedaḥ | kasmāt? tvan-mate 'pi dharmabhedād dharmi-bhedaniyamāsiddheḥ | tathā ca bhinne 'pi kārye sahakāriṇāṃ pṛthag-upayogaṃ darśayatā 'bhihitam; mṛtpiṇḍāder mṛt-svabhāvebhya ityādi ḥetubinduṃ lekhitvā | yathā ca tatra mṛd-ātmādisvabhāvabhede 'pi na kāryabhedaḥ, tathā śaktāśaktādisvabhāvabhede 'py abhedo bhaviṣyati, abādhitatvādhyavasāyasya samānatvād iti,
tad apy anena pratyādiṣṭam | santi hi dharmā ye parasparavirodhino 'virodhinaś ca | na tu dharmā ity eva virodhāvirodhaḥ | na hi brāhmaṇyaṃ vaiyākaraṇatvenāviruddham iti cāṇḍālatvenāy aviruddham ity abhidhātuṃ śakyam | na cātra brāhmaṇyavyāptaṃ cāṇḍālatvam | na ca vaiyākaraṇatvenāpi viruddham | yathā cātra svapratiyogi-brahmaṇyetaratvam eva virodham ādhatte na vaiyākaraṇatvena, tathā janayadrūpam ajananatayaiva viruddhabhāvān na vastu-santānabhedena | nīla-catur-asrāditā tu śvetaparimaṇḍalatādibhir virodham āsādayatu, na tu kvacit kāryakāraṇādibhiḥ | ato yadi virodhagandhāsambhavāt saṃsthānamṛt-svabhāvayor abhinnena dharmiṇā bhāvyam, tat kim atyantapratyanīkayor ekakāryaṃ prati janayadrūpetarayor apīti kaḥ sacetanakaś cintayet? viruddhāviruddhatvam eva katham avagantavyam iti?
yad vyavacchedena yadvidhānam, yad vidhānena vā yad vyavacchedaḥ, tat tena viruddham | na ca mṛn-mayam iti vidhānena pṛthūdaratāvyavacchedaśaṅkāpi sambhavati | taj janakābhidhānena cātaj janakatvaṃ vyavacchidyata eva, ataj janakatvena ca taj janakatvam | na taj janakam ity eva hy ataj janakam iti nañ-samāsavākyam api vismāri |

[26,1] tasmād yayor dharmayor yathā virodho dṛṣṭaḥ tathaivābhyupagantavya ity evam eva viśeṣam abhipretya yuktaḥ, naikakālāpekṣayā, samānapramāṇayor apravṛtteḥ | yena hi kālabhedenābhinam eva vastu sakriyākriya[ā]-nīlānīlatvādi yuktam abhyupagataṃ, yasya vā tad-ātmani pramāṇaṃ pravṛttaṃ, tasya kvacid vivādasambhave kālabhedenāvirodhaḥ tadvatīti yuktam | tac ca dvayam api nāstīti vyaktam | ata ekatvādhyavasāyasyābādhitaviṣayaviśeṣaṇam asiddham | ekatvādhyavasāyamātraṃ punar anaikāntikaṃ bādhakāpekṣam eva | anyathā keśādāv api na bādhakam apekṣeta | bādhakaṃ coktam | yad apy ayaṃ svapnāyamāna iva viplavate |
atha naivābhinnātmanaḥ kasyacit svabhāvabheda iṣyate, evaṃ tarhi sakāripṛthag-upapayogakathanaṃ bālonmattapralapitaṃ syād iti | tena yadi (11b) dharmadharmiṇos tādātmyatiraskāreṇa bhedāpādanamātram iṣṭam, tadā na prakṛtopayogi | tathā hi dharmiṇaḥ sakāśād dharmā bhedabhāgino bhavantu na vā? santi tāvat kecid anyonyavirodhino ye svādhikaraṇaṃ abhittvā nocchvasituṃ śaknuvantīti vivakṣitaṃ kṣaṇikavādinaḥ | tatrānena tādṛśā dharmā eva na santi, santo 'pi vā kālādy upādhisāpekṣā bhedasādhava ity eva vaktuṃ nyāy[y]am | pṛthag-upyogāt sahakāriṇāṃ dharmiṇaḥ pṛthag eva ta iti kim anena?
yadi tu svabhāvyabhāja eva bhedakā na bhidyamānā iti samayo 'sya syāt, yukutam etat | yāvatā balanādayo 'py avalanato bhedakā dṛṣṭā eva | te ca kriyādirūpatvād bhinnā eva | tasmāt kalpanoparacitavibhāgā bhavantu saugatamatena, bhavan-matena vā, tāttvikabhedo dharmadharmiṇoḥ kim idānīṃ naikāntena? prastāvāntaraṃ hi tat | duṣpariharās tu dharmā dharmiṇaṃ bhindānā ye virodhasthāyina iti siddhaṃ sādhyam | atha kāryād abhedaś ca svabhāvānāṃ pṛthak sahakāri-kāraṇakalāpopayogaviṣayatvaṃ ceti duḥśliṣṭatāmātram udbhāvyate paranayasya? taāpi prastutakṣater abhāvāt kim anena? bhedavatām api bhedakatvād dharmāṇāṃ duḥśliṣṭatābhāsatā ca bhinnasamayasthānāṃ parasparam agaṇiteṣu sthāneṣu sambhavati | tattvaṃ tu kīdṛg iti tat-tat-sthānanirūpaṇe vyaktībhaviṣyati |

[27,1] tatra yadi prastutānupayogi yat kiñcid vistārayatā sthātavyam ity abhimatam, sarvasya śakyam etat | na caitāvvataiva dharmadharmivādaparisamāptiḥ | tat kim asya garbhārbhakam-anatiśayānasya nindā-vacane nirbandhena? tathā ca sati tasmān na dharmabhedād eva dharmi-bheda iti nigamanam apy asyāyuktam | bauddhaḥ kila [na] dharāṇāṃ bhedamātreṇa dharmi-bhedam āha | kiṃ tu virodhena | anyathā kṛtakatvānityatvādīnām api dharmabhedam ācakṣīta | anenāpi svayaṃ viruddhadharmādhyāsād ity akṣaram utthāpitam | tad yadi virodhabhedamātrayor viśeṣaṃ na paśyati, yuktam āheti kim aparaṃ vaktavyam?
yad apy ayam evāha; yo hy anantarakāryakaraṇasvabhāvaḥ sa katham ādau tat kāryaṃ kuryāt? atha kuryān na tarhi uttarakāryakaraṇasvabhāvaḥ | na hi nīlotpādanasvabhāvaḥ pītādikam api karoti | na ca prathamottarakāryotpādanasvabhāvabhedāt tadvato 'pi bhedaḥ svabhāvabhedasya vyabhicāritvenoktatvād iti |
tad api niḥsāram | yadi hi svabhāvaśabdena svalakṣaṇam abhipretam, tadā tadbhede bheda eva vastūnām, kva vyabhicāravārtā? tasmāt svabhāvabheda iti kalpitadharmān nānātvaṃ yuktam | na ca tanmātreṇa dharmi-bhedam āpādayati paraḥ | kiṃ tu virodhena | na ca tad-virodhe 'pi dharmi-bhedavyabhicāro 'sti | virodho hi na bhedaṃ vyabhicarati | bhedas tu virodhaṃ vyabhicaratīty uktaprāyam |
nanu yadi kalpitā eva te dharmāḥ kva virodhaḥ, kva vā (12a) bheda iti cet?
iha dvividham abhidheyaṃ kalpitaśabdasya, tat-tad-vyāvṛttavastu-sambhave bhedamātraṃ kalpanāvabhāsi, tad api kalpitaṃ kuvalayanīlatvādivat | kalpanā-mātraniveśi ca kalpitaṃ kari-keśaratriguṇī-mayatvādivat | tatra yady antimaḥ kalpitārthaḥ syāt, na bhedanirodhād iti yuktam | pracīne tu kalpitārthe vastu-svabhāvasyaivādhyavasānād bhedo virodho vā vyavasthāpyamānaḥ saṃvādam ādāyaiva vartata iti na doṣaḥ |
yac cedam, uttarakṣaṇe yat kāryaṃ kartum asya svabhāvaḥ, tat kathaṃ prathamakṣaṇe kuryāt?
anyathottarakāryakāritaiva na svabhāvasyeti, tad apy aparibhāvya bhāṣitam | sthirasvabhāvatve hi bhāvasyottarakālam evedaṃ kāryam, na pūrvakālam iti kuta etat? tad abhāvāc ca kāraṇam apy uttarakāryakaraṇasvabhāvam iti kutaḥ? arthānurodhinyo hi vācaḥ śobhā-bhājaḥ, na vāg-anurodhād arthatathā-bhāvo rājavat | kiṃ kurmaḥ, uttaram eva tasya janmeti cet astu |

[28,1] sthiratve tu tad anupapadyamānam asthiratām ādiśatu | sthiratve 'py eṣa eva svabhāvaḥ, tasya yad uttarakṣaṇa eva karotīti cet, hatedānīṃ pramāṇapratyāśā, pramāṇabādhite 'pi svabhāvālambanena nistaraṇāt | dhūmād atrāgnir agner abhāvād vā neha dhūma ity ukte 'pi hi śakyam abhidhātuṃ, svabhāva evāyam asya yad idānīm atra niragnir api dhūma iti | tasmāt pramāṇasiddhe svabhāvāvalambanam, na svabhāvāvalambanena pramāṇavilopaḥ | pramāṇanirṇayaś ca vihita eva | nīlotpādanasvabhāvaś ca na pītādikaṃ karotīty asamīkṣākhyānam | upādānatvena hi tatkaraṇaniṣedho, na tu sahakāri-kāraṇatvenāpi, sahakāritayā tatrāpi kathañcid upayogasyāśakyabādhanatvāt | na cānyavarṇasyānyavarṇopādānatāniṣedha eva | dṛśyate hi pītaiva haridrā cūrṇasahakārikā raktasyopādānaṃ bhavantīti nidarśanam asaṅgatam | yadi ca yathā na nīlaḥ pītam utpādayati tathā nottara-janakaḥ pūrvam utpādayati?
tad alam evaṃ-vidhapralāpeṣu nirbandena | sthitam etat parasparaviruddhadharmādhyāsād deśabhedavat kālabhede 'pi janakājanakasvabhāvayor bheda eva ||
etena yad api nyāyamañjarīkāraḥ prāha – nanu kāryotpattihetur yeṣāṃ sannidhim apekṣate te khalv apekṣitasannidhayaḥ, sahakāripratyayās tasya kiṃ kurvanti? na kiñcit | kevalaṃ kāryam eva yeṣāṃ bhāvābhāvāv anuvidhatte te kāryeṇaivāpekṣitasannidhayaḥ sannipatantaḥ tad eva kāryaṃ vivakṣitaṃ hetunā saha kurvantīti sahakāriṇa ucyante na tu yena saha kurvanti tasyaiva kartāro bhavantaḥ sahakāriṇo bhavitum arhanti | (12b) tasmād akṣaṇikasya svakāryanimāṇe dvividhaṃ sāmarthyam, ekaṃ nijaṃ sāmarthyam, dvitīyaṃ cāgantukaṃ sahakāryantaram, tayor abhāve tatkāryānutpatteḥ | tasmād eva hi dvividhāt sāmarthyāt kāryotpatter abhyupagamāt | ekam akṣaṇikaṃ gṛhītvā tasmād eva kārtotpattiṃ sambhāvayantaḥ sāmarthyam eva hetūnām avijñātavantaḥ pare | yasmād akṣaṇikasyāpi kramavatīṣu tāsu tāsv arthakriyāsu kartavyāsu kramavat-sahakāryantaram eva sāmarthyam aṅgī-kurmaḥ | tathā ca kramavat-sahakārinānātvād api kramavatkāryanānātvopapatter aśakyaṃ bhāvānāṃ prati-kṣaṇam anyatvam upapādayitum iti |

[29,1] tad apy apāstam | yady api hetv-antarakalpitaṃ sāmarthyam avijñātam asmākaṃ tathāpi yaj janayatīti vyavahāragocarībhūyam āpannaṃ svarūpam avaśyam abhyupagantavyam, bhāvasya svalakṣaṇākhyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ saṃkhyātam asman-mate | tat kiṃ prāg api paścād evaveti vikalpya dāṣaṇam udīritam?
tatra kim anenoktaṃ bhavatīti niveditam | yat tu kāryeṇaivāpekṣitasannidhaya ity upaskṛtam, tad api nirūpayogam | yadi hi kāryam eva sva-janmani svatantraṃ syāt, yuktam etat, kevalam evaṃ sati sahakāriṇām api sāmarthya-rūpatākalpanam aphalam iti, hetoḥ sāmarthyam anapekṣya svātantryād eva kāryaṃ kadācid bhavati kadācin na bhavatīti kiṃ hetu-sāmarthyasamarthanavyasanena, vyavahāramātraṃ vā sāmarthyam iti, na ti kvacit kiñcit samarthaṃ nāmeti prāptam | astu ko doṣa iti cet?
santo hetavaḥ sarvathā 'samarthāḥ, asat tu kāryaṃ svatantram iti viśuddhā buddhiḥ | utpattau tu sad rūpaṃ kāryaṃ kim artham arthāntaram apekṣata iti nirūpaya tāvat |
tasmāt sāmagrīm apekṣate kāryam ity anenākṣareṇa sāmagry eva jananasamarthā kāryasyety evārthaḥ na ca sā samagrebhyo bhinnā | tataḥ samagrā eva janakāḥ | bhinnatve 'pi vā 'rthāntaram iva sākalyam api sahakārīti na viśeṣaḥ | tato yāvantaḥ sahakāriṇas tāvantaḥ praty-ekaṃ samarthā iti prāg vidyamānānāṃ kathaṃ kriyātikramaḥ? sākalyam eva hi paścād upapattimad iti samayaḥ, tad api vā tebhya eva sahakāribhyo labhyasambhavaṃ prāg api teṣv asatsu kathaṃ sattāviyuktaṃ kadācid yāvad ekasyāpi prāg-bhāvaḥ?
atha kāryasyaivāyam aparadho yad amīṣv asamartheṣu kadācin notpadyata iti cet?

sarvāvasthā-samane 'pi kāraṇe yady akāryatā |
svatantraṃ kāryam evaṃ syāt tan na kāryaṃ tathā sati || (PVA II 396)

iti kiṃ na paśyasi?
syād etat | na tad bhāve 'vaśyaṃ bhavatīti tatkāryam ucyate kiṃ tu tad abhāve na bhavaty eveti vyatirekapradhānyādīti cet?

[30,1]  tad bhāve 'pi na bhāvaś ced abhāve bhāvitā kutaḥ |
tad abhāva prayuktasya so 'bhāva iti tat kutaḥ || (PVA II 411)

yadi hi svayaṃ bhavanaṃ bhāvayad eva kāryaṃ hetuḥ, tadā tad abhāva prayukto 'syābhāva ity api syāt | yadā tu hetau jananonmukhe 'pi svātantrryād eva na bhūtam iti kathaṃ tad abhāvaprayojako 'syābhāva iti pratītiḥ? tasmād yadi kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ (13a) tadā niyataṃ yathaiva tad abhāve niyamena na bhavati, tathaiva tad bhāve 'pi nyamena bhavet | abhavac ca na tatkāraṇatām ātmanaḥ kṣamate | tad ayaṃ prayatnaparamparayāpi hetunāṃ samarthāsamartha-lakṣaṇodayavyayayogo jāragarbha iva gopayitum aśakyaś catur-buddhiṣu ||

[30,9] yad apy āha Śaṅkaraḥ | na ca sarvatra sahakāri-bhedena kāryabhedād api kāraṇasya bhedaḥ sidhyati | yathaikatve 'pi sahakāri-bhedād vijñānavartivikāra-jvālāntarāṇi pradīpaḥ karoti, na cāsau bhidyate, tad abhedasya pramāṇasiddhatvād iti | apūrvo 'yam asya dabhārambhaḥ | yad ayam akṣepakriyā-dharmā svabhāvaḥ śakti-śabdavācyaḥ, sa kiṃ prāg apy asti, yadi vā sampraty eveti vikalpya codya śaktivācyaṃ mama sahakārisākalyam iti bravīti, śaktyaśakti-lakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhyāsād bheda ity abhimatena kāryabhedāt kāraṇabheda iti samādhatte, kaḥ khalu kāryabhedāt kāraṇabhedaṃ vaktum upakrānto yatraivam ucyate, sahakāri-bhedena yaḥ kāryabhedaḥ sa na kāraṇabheda iti, api tu yasya yadā yaj jananasvabhāvaḥ so 'vaśyaṃ tat karoty eva |

[30,18] na hi pradīpa eva vijñānādi-kāryāṇi sakṛt kartuṃ samarthaḥ kṣepeṇa janayati | tad-vad vā kramabhāviny api kāryāṇi sajātīyavijātīyāni kiṃ na tadaiva karoti | atas teṣām anya eva kārako dīpa iti yuktam | evam anyatrāpy eṣa eva nyāyaḥ |
yat punar āha, pradīpādivyaktīnām iva praty-ekam utpattivināśakāraṇānupalabdher abhrāntaṃ sphaṭikāder avasthitivijñānam iti, tad apy andhaśarakṣepāyate, pradīpe 'py anyānyasyotpatti-kāraṇasyānupalabdheḥ | vārtisnehādayo hi pradīpahetavaḥ, te ca prati-kṣaṇaṃ prati-lavādi vānyānyī bhavanty adhyavasāyaḥ kasya sambhavati | anyathā sphaṭike 'py anānyī- bhavati pūrvapūrvam anyadanyad uttarottarasya kāraṇam anvayavyatirekānuvṛtter iti kiṃ gṛhyate | yady api ca pradīpe kālabhedenānyabuddhir asti tathāpi na tailavartyoḥ, tatkathaṃ pradīpādivyaktīnām utpatti-kāraṇopalabdhir na sphaṭikasyety ucyate | vināśakāraṇaṃ tu cintayiṣyāmaḥ | nāpi pradīpabhaṅguratayā tatkāraṇabhaṅgaḥ saṅgato vaktum, kāraṇābhedāt kāryasyāpi pradīpasyābhedaprasaṅgāt |

[31,7] atha vartisnehayoḥ kṣaya upalabhyate, pradīpasyāpi kṣīyamāṇadeśavyāptiviyogāt, sa eva kṣaya iti cet | tailaṃ prabalam āsīd idānīm alpaṃ vartate | vartir apy evam | pradīpo 'py anyānyatailavarti-bhāgaparihāreṇānyānyatadbhāgavyāpīti, sarvathā nivṛttis tu katham avasātuṃ śakyā, pratyabhijñānasya tadavasthatvāt |
atha varty-ādīnām apacayakāle 'vayave kriyotpadyate | tato vibhāgodayaḥ | tataḥ saṃyoganāśaḥ | tato 'pi tad-ārabdhadravyanāśaḥ | punaḥ kriyā, saṃyogāt itaradravyodayaś ceti naikadravyanirvāhasiddhir iti cet |
anubhavabhuvam avatarann api yady ayaṃ prapañcam ādriyate, bauddho 'py evaṃ svaprakriyām udghoṣayan kathaṃ vāryaḥ | (13b) pūrvakebhyaḥ sabhāgahetubhyaḥ sahakāriṇam aparam arthaman tato vātātapatimirādi [samāsādya] tebhyaḥ parasya samānaparimāṇasya yathā sahakāri-balasaṅketaṃ nyūnasyādhikasya vā sambhava iti na sphaṭikaśatakoṭiprabhṛtīnām ekatā-nirvāhasiddhaḥ | yadā punar anena sādhanam evopanyastaṃ tadā nāsya prakriyayā siddiḥ, tvat prakriyayā bādhā vā |

[31,18] vātādayaḥ kim upacinvanti apacinvanti vā sphaṭikādau, yena sahakāritayā kalpyante, prāg-bhāvitvamātreṇa kāraṇatve 'tiprasaṅgād iti cet | na vai sthūlaḥ kaścid upacayo 'pacayo vā kriyate tais tasya | ata evātyantasadṛśodayaḥ | sūkṣmas tu aśakyopalakṣaṇatayā yathedaṃ tayā nirdeṣṭum ayogyaḥ, tathā niṣedham apy ayogya eva | evam anekavastu-saṃkare kadācit kenacid upayoge na kiñcid vastu prastutopādānasya sahakāri syād iti na sarvathā sahakāryantaravirahād ekasya jananasaṅgatir avagantavyā ity upanyāsasyārthaḥ | sthiratvasiddhau tu yadi tvam api svaprakriyāṃ nirvāhayitum īśiṣe, īṣiṣya | bauddhasādhanavicāras tāvat prastuto 'yam | tatra ca prastute 'nekakāryeṇānekena bhāvyam iti kena karṇe bhavato niveśitam, yataḥ pradīpadṛṣṭāntīkaraṇaṃ bhavataḥ śobheta | tad idam ucyate, anyo vyādhir anyad auṣadham iti |

[32,4] yad apy āha, yad eva ca sahakāri-bhedena kāryabhede pradīpasyābhedasiddhau sādhanaṃ, tad eva kramavat-sahakāru-bhedena kāryabhede 'kramasyāpīti, tad apy atyantam asambaddham | advayākāram indriyapratyakṣam eva hi bhedabhraṃśam āśaṃsati pradīpe | sapratighasya hi pradīpasya naikasthānam | bhinnadeśasya cātyantasadṛśasyāpi bhedopalakṣaṇam anivārya māyāgolakavat | ata ekākāram indriya-jñānam ekatāyām eva pradīpam avasthāpayati | kālabhede hi bhinne 'pi vastuny atyantasadṛśe pratyabhijñānam upajāyamānam upalabdham | na ca pratyabhijñānād anyad ekatā-sādhanam |
tatkathaṃ tad eva sādhanam iti na plavate | na ca sadṛśatayā kālabhedena pratyabhijñānasya saṃśayāṅgatvaṃ vyabhicāradarśanāt,lakṣaṇabhedavirahāt | sakṛdabhedabhāsiny api pratyakṣe 'nāśvaraḥ, tathā kvacid adarśanāt | indriya-jñāne hi kramadarśane 'pi na yogyam arthadvayaṃ pratighāti, ekībhūyopalabhyamānam upalabdham | tatkathaṃ sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ | tasmād anupayogi pradīpadṛṣṭāntena pratyavasthānam | etad eva rūpaṃ dṛṣṭāntīkṛtyābhiprāyāntaram asya dyotayan nyāyabhūṣaṇe 'pi yad āha,
api ca yena svabhāvena rūpaṃ rūpāntaraṃ karoti, na tenaiva rasādikam, rasāder api rūpasvabhāvatā-prasaṅgāt | tataḥ sarvaṃ rūpakāryaṃ cakṣṣā gṛhyate | na caitad iṣṭam | tasmād yathā rūpaṃ rūpāntarotpadanasvabhāvena tad eva karoti, vijñānotpādanasvabhāvena vijñānam eva karoti, na rūpādikam | rasotpādanasvabhāvena ca rasam (14a) evaṃ ga[ndha]-sparśana-jananasvabhāvābyāṃ tāv eva janayati | tad-vat akṣaṇiko 'py ādyakāryotpādanasvabhāvena tad eva karoti | tad uttarakārya-jananasvabhāvena tad uttaram eva janayati | nādyam uttarottaraṃ vā | evam uttarottarakāryeṣv anantakālabhāviṣv api pratiniyatāḥ svabhāvā draṣṭavyāḥ | svabhāvā eva hetavo na svabhāvīty apy ayuktam, rūpasyāhetutvaprasaṅgāt, svabhāvānām eva hetutvāt | atha na rūpasya svabhāvabheda iṣyate, kiṃ tv eka eva tathā-bhūtasvabhāvo, yena bhinnākāraṃ bhinnadeśaṃ kāryam utpādayati | tasya bhinnasvabhāvakāryotpādānurodhena svabhāvabhedaḥ kathati iti |
nanu evaṃ paro 'py abhinnasvabhāvsyaivākṣaṇikasya kramabhāvy- anekasvabhāvakāryotpādanānurodhena bhāvasvabhāvaṃ kalpayan nopālambham arhatīti |

[33,3] etad apīrṣyākāṣāyitadhiyaḥ paradhandhīkaraṇamātram | tathāhi yadi tāvad abhinn-ātmāpi dīpavad anekam artham andhakāranāśādi karoti kalpitasvabhāvabheda itīyan-mātraṃ vivakṣitam, hanta ko niṣeddhā | asty eṣa sambhavo yad anekam eka karotīti | evaṃ pūrvāprakālayor apy ekasvabhāvo yady anekaṃ kuryān na vivādaḥ | kevalaṃ kvacit kāryavilambaḥ kvacid akṣepakarmeti na yuktam, pradīpavat sakṛdanekakaraṇam astv iti vyarthaṃ pradīpanidarśanam | atha karamabhāvyanekam ekātmanaḥ kāryam astv iti vivakṣitam, tadā samartham | na khalv adyāpi dīpo dṛṣṭāntayituṃ śakyaḥ | evaṃ rūpe 'pi nidarśane kriyamāṇe vaktavyam | na caivaṃ nirvahati yad anekaṃ tad anekenaiva kartavyam, dīpakāryavat kālabhedabhāvi cānekaṃ kāryam iti, na hy anekaṃ jāyamānam ekasyaiva kāryam āpadyate, ekakartur apāye vāneka-janmaiva na syād ity upapādayituṃ śakyam | dāhagāhanāder anekasyānekenaiva jala-jvalanādinā karaṇadarśanāt | kālabhedābhinnam ekaṃ vivakṣitam iti cet |

[33,13] anekakālāntaritair ekātmabhir anekaṃ na kriyamāṇam upalakṣayasi | evaṃ tu brūyāḥ, ekam anekaṃ vā bhinnakālam abhinnakālaṃ vā nityād eva jāyata iti tac ca pratijñā-mātrāviṣkaraṇam abhīṣṭātmanaḥ kasyacid arthasya [na] sādhanaṃ, nāpi paraprayuktasādhanabādhanam iti kim anena | tathāpi na dīpa-rūpadṛṣṭāntena kiñcit | yadi ca kāryabhedenāpi bhāvaṃ bhindyād astiravādī, tathāpi rūpam evābhidyamānaṃ bhidyamānau rūpa-rasau kathaṃ janayatītīyan-māteṇānekantam udbhāvya svastho bhava | rūpayāpi punar ekatvasādhanena ka upayogaḥ, siddhatvāt |
tataḥ śaṅkare 'pi, na hi yena svabhāvena vartivikārasya hetuḥ, tenaiva jvālopalambhayor api tat-svabhāvatā-prasaṅgād ity abhidadhāno na kiñcic cetayata iti upalakṣyate, ekasyānekakaraṇāvirodhāt |
atha yathā bauddho 'bhyadhāt kṣaṇāntare 'pi yadi sa eva svabhāvo bhāvasya, tadā sampratīva prāg api jananaprasaṅgaḥ | na ca janayati | tataḥ (14b) svabhāvabhedo bhāvasyeti | tathā hi, yadi jñāna-janakenaiva rūpeṇa vartivikāraṃ karoti dīpaḥ, tadā tasyāpi tattvaprasaṅgaḥ | na ca tattvam asti | tato dīpo 'pi kiṃ bhinnasvabhāvo 'stu | yathā ca kāryāṇāṃ tādātmyavirahe 'pi hetu-bhedābhāvaḥ, tathā kāryāṇāṃ bhinnakālatve 'pi na hetu-bheda iti vivakṣitam | tadāpi bauddhena pramāṇabalam ālambya janakājanakāvasthayoḥ bhāvabheda āropitaḥ | tatra ca yady akṣamā, tadā 'siddhyādidūṣaṇam eva vaktuṃ sāmpratam | tāvataiva tasya nirāśe kim anena prabandhena |
atha duṣṭam eva tat-sādhanam | tathāpi tena yat siddhaṃ tat siddham eva tāvat | pradīpasya svabhāvabhedo bhavatu, mā vā bhūt, tathāpi kim asyopanyāsena | yac ca dīpasya svabhāvabhedasādhanāya sādhanaṃ kāryāṇāṃ tādātmyaviraho nāma, so 'pi yadi siddhasvasādhyapratibandhaḥ, tadā tena yadi yugapad api bhedasiddhiḥ kasyacit, tadā tad-īrṣyayā kim anena bauddhasādhanena | prayāgavaṭaprayātāyātayoḥ dvitīyamūḍhakarṇāṭeneva svasādhyasādhanāya pravṛttinirāśaḥ kartavyaḥ | anyathā 'nena bhede sādhite pradīpabhedasādhanam eva kiṃ pravartate, na vā kiñcid api sādhanaṃ sādhyasādhanāya pravarteta dhūmādisādhanaṃ svasādhyasādhakaṃ dṛṣṭvā ||

[34,14] athedaṃ pradīpasvabhāvabhedasādhanam adhyakṣādhikṣptaṃ, svasādhyapratibandhavidhuraṃ vā, tadā tad eva naśyatu | na tadā bauddhasādhanasya kṣatiḥ | tathāpi kiṃ tasyopanyāsena | yadi bauddhasparddhayā tad-vimarśam-asārī-kartum upamānabhūtaṃ vimarāntaram evedam upanītam, tadāyam asthitaḥ pakṣaḥ svabhāvabhedo dīpasyeti | evaṃ sati eka evāsau śaktiviśeṣo yas teṣām utpādaka iti cet |
etad apetāgamayuktikaṃ paraspardhayābhyupagamyamānam api na nīti-śīlān prīṇāti | pratiniyatasvabhāvopādānābhāve teṣāṃ sarvatrotpatter adṛṣṭapūrvatvād ity-ādinā | tathā svabhāvabhedābhāve ca kāraṇasya kāryabhedabhāve tasyākasmikatvaṃ prasajyeta | tathā cākaraṇaṃ viśvasya vaiśva-rūpyaṃ syād ity anena ca kathaṃ svabhāvabhedam eva svabhāṣayā draḍhayet | na cāyaṃ nyāyyaḥ | tathā hi yat tāvad ucyate, yadi yenaiva svabhāvena dīpo vartivikārahetus tenaiva jvālādeḥ, tadā jvālāder api vartivikāratvaprasaṅgaḥ, na caivam |

[34,24] tasmād bhinnenaiva svabhāvena vartivikāre bhinnena ca jvālādau dīpaḥ pravatate iti viparyayārthaḥ | tatra ca pratyakṣabādhaiva, niraṃśasya dīpādes tatra bhāsanāt | anyathā kadambagolakavadanandasvabhāvaparikaritasyābhāsaprasaṅgāt | na cānuplabhyatvam eṣām abhidhātuṃ śakyam, pradīpasvabhāvatve 'nupalabhyatāyā virodhāt | yadi ca pradīpasvabhāvatve 'py adṛśyatvaṃ viruddham anurudhyase vartivikārakāraṇatve 'pi jvālādi-hetutāṃ kiṃ na sambhāvayasi, yataḥ svarūpa-rāśiparikalpanavyagro 'si | tasmān nānupalabhyamānasya pradīpasvabhāvatā | (15a) upalabhyatve ca nādhyakṣādhikṣepaparihāraḥ | dīpād anyad eva dṛśyam adṛśyaṃ vā vastu dīpasvabhāva iti tu nāga-lokabhāṣā | ananya-rūpe hi svabhāvasvarūpasvalakṣaṇaśabdāḥ prasiddāḥ | kalpanopasthāpite tu dharme binna ivaābhāsamāne 'pi tad adhyavasāyād eva svabhāvaśabdaprayogaḥ, yathā nityatvaṃ śabdasya svabhāva iti | tato yadi sahakāriṇi śakti-śabdavad bhinne 'pi kvacit svabhāvaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, tathāpi svabhāvāntareṇa karotīti vastv-antareṇa sahakāriṇā karotīti yāvat | na ca svabhāvinaḥ karaṇavāraṇam abhimatam | tataḥ svabhāvi-śabdo bāhyo 'rthaḥ | tena svabhāvenābhinnenaiva bhinnāni kāryāṇi karotīty āyātam | kevalam anekasahakāriparivārita iti viśeṣaḥ | sa ca kasya neṣṭaḥ | na ca sahakāriṇo 'pi svamanīṣikayā kalpanīyāḥ, kiṃ tu yāvanto 'nvayavyatirekagrāhakapramāṇavyāpārās tāvanta eva | sa ca vyāpāraḥ tejastailavartyādivyatiriktasya nāstīti kim adhikavidhānena | pratyuta svabhāvaśabdābhidheyānarthān parikalpya ṣad-padārthām antarbhāvayan kiṃ viphalam āyāsyasi |

[35,16] yadā caivaṃ paryante svabhāvaśabdābhidheyaṃ nijaṃ rūpam ekam anekakāryahetur iti upapāditam tadā, yad ekena rūpeṇa janitaṃ, tad ekam eveti na siddhā vyāptiḥ |
tatha sati prasaṅgavat viparyayasyāpi nānekāntaparihāraḥ | pratiniyatasvabhāvopādānatāpi teṣāṃ na pradīpasyaiva tāttvikānekasvabhāvatayā, kiṃ tu tat-sāmagryām apoddhāradvāreṇānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kasyacit tailaṃ kasyacid vartaḥ kasyacid dīpa iti kathaṃ sarvatrotpattir eṣām upalabhyate |
yat tu kāraṇabhedād beda iti, tatra sāmagrī-lakṣaṇakāraṇavaijātyāt kāryavaijātyanimittābhyupagamaḥ, tathaiva pramāṇenārpaṇāt | na tu sāmagryantargatakāraṇanānātvam ekasyānekasvabhāvatayeti śāstra eva vipañncitam | tad alam eṣāṃ pramāṇanirapekṣasvotprekṣā-mātreṇa vikalpeṣu nirbandhena | na ca taiḥ svabhāvabhedair bhāvikaḥ siddhir apy eṣāṃ kācid arthasiddhir ity uktam evety aphala evaiṣa bhāvaḥ |

[36,3] yathā tarhi Trilocanaś caryayati tathānayor api nīyatām abhiprāyaḥ | tathā ca Nyāyamañjarī, asādhāraṇam api sattvaṃ mādhyamikanyāyena śakyam udbhāvayitum | tathā hi, kṣaṇavāde 'pi pūrva-rūpakṣaṇe yena [sva] bhāvenānantarakṣaṇam utpādayati, kiṃ tenaiva rasakṣaṇam apy āhosvit svabhāvāntareṇa | yadi tenaiva, rasasyāpi rūpatvaprasaṅgaḥ | na hy ekasvabhāvāt kāraṇāt kāryabhedaṃ paśyāmaḥ, viśvasyāhetukatvaprasaṅgāt | atha svabhāvāntareṇa karoti | yady evam ekasya viruddhaṃ, svabhāvadvayaṃ prasajyeta | rūpa-jananasvabhāvo hi rasa-jananasvabhāvān nāvyabhicārī | tatra yadi svabhāvāntaraṃ bhavet, bhavet tatraiva tasya bhāvo 'bhāvaś ca | bhāvābhāvau ca sākṣād viruddhau pūrvakaṃ rūpa-lakṣaṇaṃ bhintaḥ | na ca bhinno dṛśyate saḥ |

[36,12] syād etat | pūrvakasya rūpakṣaṇasya rase kartavye svabhāvāntaraṃ pūrvaka (15b) eva rasakṣaṇo, na ca viruddhaṃ svabhāvāntaram astīti | yady evam akṣaṇikasyāpi kramavatīṣu kāryavyaktiṣu svabhāvāntaraṃ kramavat sahakāryantaram eveti sarvaṃ samānam anyatrābhiniveśāt | tasmād asādhāraṇam upādadānasya svabhāvabhedāpatteḥ kṣaṇikebhyo nivartamānaṃ sattvam | yena ca prakāreṇa svabhāvabhedo nirākriyate, tasyākṣaṇikatve 'pi samānatvāt sattvam akṣaṇikān na nivartate | ato vyatirekāsiddheḥ pratibandhāsiddhir iti |

[36,18] tatra tāvad Yogācāraniṣṭhām anālocayann ayaṃ saugatasamaya-jñānābhimānī Mādhyamikanyāyenety āha, ubhayor api hetuphalāpavādasya tattvato 'bhimatatvād ity adharasiddhim uddhūya Sākārasiddhau darśitam eva | sthite ca heuphalabhāve 'smākam iyaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅga-cintety uktam | sā ca sthitir grāhyagrāhakabhāvasya tāttvikatve gṛhīte | tadā ca yad eva yasyānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyi, tad eva kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca bhavatu bījāṅkuravat | yathā ca kasyacid ekam anvayavyatirekānuvidhāyi dṛśyamānaṃ kāryaṃ, tathā yady anekam api kasyacid ekasyānvayavyatirekāv anuvidhīyamānam upalabhyate, tadā kim anekenāpy ekakāryeṇa bhavitavyam | paravedanāpalāpe hi ekam apy ekasya kāryaṃ na syāt | anapalāpe tv anekam api kāryam ekasya vāryate | ataḥ paravedanāpavādivādimatāvatāreṇa na kiñcit | grāhyagrāhakasthitau tv ekavad anekasyāpy ekakāryatā-nyāyaḥ samānaḥ | tatkatham ekātmanā janyamānam ekākāram eva bhaved iti plavate |

[37,6] yat tūktam, na hy ekasvabhāvāt kāraṇāt kāryabhedaṃ paśyāma iti, tad atisāhasam | kiṃ vā na paśyati pradīpam ekam vikārakāriṇan andhakārahāriṇaṃ ca, taraṇiṃ vā vā tamaḥ kamalayor nidhanapravedhavidhāyinam, sarvadāndhakāramagno vā bhavān paśyati vā sahasram-aṃśu-mālinaḥ kāryasahasrakāriṇaḥ | ekasvabhāvāt tu kāraṇān na kāryabheda iti smānasāmagryā na kāryavaijātyam ity arthaḥ | ata eva na viśvasyāhetukatvam | tasmād ekasmād anekotpattir avirodhinī | kāryadvāreṇa tu rūpaṃ rūpakāraṇaṃ rasakāraṇaṃ ceti samuccayena svabhāvadvayavyavahāraḥ | ata eva na virodhavārtā | na hi samuccaye pramāṇasiddhe virodhagandhaḥ | vātātapayor ivaikasminn ākāśadeśe ||

[37,14] yat tūktam, rūpa-jananasvabhāvo hi rasa-jananasvabhāvatā-vyabhicārīti, tāvatāpi bhedamātraṃ sidhyati, na tu virodhaḥ, kṛtakānityavat | yathā hi nīlābhāvāvyabhicāri pītaṃ na nālaṃ bhavatum arhati, na tu tan-mātreṇa virodhaḥ | na hi yad yato bhidyate tadaviśeṣaṃ tena viruddham abhidhātuṃ śakyam | virodhas tu yady apy ekasmin dharmiṇi dvayor asambhavayor niyamaḥ, sa ca kadācid vastunor ekasya bhāve 'nyaparyādānād dahanatuhinavat | kadācid dharmayoḥ svabhāvenaiva ekādhiṣṭhite 'nyāsambhavāt bhāvābhāvavat, nīlatvānīlatvavad vā | tatra yadi nīlapītadravyayor apy ekabhāve 'nyaparyādānam āpādayet, syād eva (16a) sahānavasthānanāmā virodhaḥ | na tu tadabhāvāvyabhicāramātreṇa | bhedamātraṃ tu tāvatā | evaṃ nīlatvapītatvayor apy abhāvavyabhicāramātreṇa bhedamātraṃ tu na tu virodhaḥ | virodhas tu nīlatvasvīkṛte dharmiṇi svayam evānīlatvabhedasya pītatvasyābhāvāt | anyathā kṛtakatvānityatvādīnām api tadabhāvāvyabhicāramātreṇa virodhaprasaṅgāt |

[37,25] atha katham atra tadabhāvāvyabhicāraḥ, na hi kṛtakena satā nānityena bhāvyam ity upapattir asti | yady evaṃ rūpa-janakena satā rasa-janakena na bhāvyam ity atrāpi kopapattiḥ | rūpa-janakatvād eveti cet |

[38,1] na, ayogavyavacchedena viśeṣaṇe kṣīṇatvād upapatteḥ, anyayogavyavacchedasyāsiddhatvāt | tathā hi kiṃ rūpasya janakatvam eva, atha rūpasyaiva janakatvam iti rūpa-janakam | tatra prathamapakṣe rūpaṃ praty ajanakatvasyaiva vyavacchedo na punar anya-janakatvasya vyavacchedo vidhir veti, sādhanāntaram apekṣya tenaiva virodhe vyavacchedasyaiva asiddheḥ | dvitīye tu pakṣe, anya-jananakṣepasiddhir asandigdhā | kevalaṃ na tatra pramāṇavyāpāraḥ | yathā hy ekasya tan-nāntarīyakatvaṃ tathā dvitīyasyāpi yadi syān na doṣaḥ, pradīpavat | na tu rūpa-janakam ity eva rasa-janakapratikṣepo, rūpa-janakatvasyāyogavyavacchedenāpi caritārthatvād iti na kāpy upapattir atrāpi | kevalaṃ kalpanā-buddhau yathārthāntaram iva rūpa-janakatvaṃ pratibhāti, tathā tadabhāvāvyabhicāri ca pṛthag eva rasa-janakatvam avasīyate | yataḥ pṛthak śabdapramāṇavṛttiḥ apekṣyate, tāvataiva virodham adhyavasyati | sāvagatiḥ kṛtakatvānityatvayor api na vyavasīyate kenāpi | nāpi tatra virodhābhidhānena kaścid upayogaḥ | ekatra dharmiṇy aparaparihārārtham eva hi virodhaḥ sādhyate | tad yadi virodhe 'py ekadharmisamparkaḥ, kṛtaṃ virodha-cintayā | nīlatvānīlatvādiṣu tu prayujyate parasparaparihārātmā virodhaḥ |

[38,14] nanu parasparābhāvāvyabhicārāviśeṣe 'pi kathaṃ keṣāñcid dharmāṇām ekadharmiṇy anavasthānātmā virodhaḥ, keṣāñcit punar bhedamātrṃ na virodhaḥ |
uktam atra, yad vyavacchedena yasya vidhānaṃ yad vidhānena vā yasya vyavacchedo niyamena, tat tena pratiyoginā viruddham | yatra neyaṃ gatiḥ, tadaviruddham ity alaṃ punaḥ pariśrameṇa | tad evaṃ rūpa-janana-rasa-jananayoḥ parasparābhāvāvyabhicāre 'pi kṛtakatvānityatvavad bhedamātraṃ śabdapramāṇāntarākarṣi, na tu virodha iti sthitam |

[38,20] yat tūktam, tatra yadi svabhāvāntaraṃ bhaved ity-ādi | sa tarhi nyāyaḥ kiṃ kṛtak[tv] ānityatvābhyāṃ bibheti | prasaṅga eva tatrāpi bhavatv iti cet |
nanu parābhyupagamena prasaṅgaḥ, na ca mayedam aṅgīkṛtaṃ parasparābhāvāvyabhicāramātreṇa virodha ekatrānavasthānahetur iti | kiṃ tavaiṣo 'bhyupagamaḥ pramāṇavṛttir vā | ubhayathā 'pi na mamāparādhaḥ | (16b) sudhyatutarāṃ ca kṛtakatvānity[tv] ādīnāṃ virodho, na caivaṃ tasmāt parasparāvyabhicārasya tādātmyaniṣedhe vyāpārāt na kṛtakatvam evānityatvam | aniṣedhe tv ekasyaiva kṛtakatvasya bhāve 'bhāvaś ca syāt | yathā vastuno nīlād anīlasyāvyavacchede tasyaiva bhāvo 'bhāvaś ca svīkṛtaḥ syād ity ucyate | nīlam iti hi tasya bhāvaḥ | anīlam iti cābhāvaḥ tadabhāvavyāptasyānīlasya bhāvo na vyāpakaṃ tadabhāvam anākṛṣya sthātuṃ śaktaḥ, bhāvābhāvayoś ca virodhaḥ prasādhita evety ekadharmiṇy anavasthānam iti yan nīlaṃ tan nānīlaṃ pītādivastu, tathā dharmo 'pi yad kṛtakatvaṃ tan nākṛtakatvam anityatvādi | yad rūpa-jananaṃ tan nārūpa-jananaṃ rasa-jananādi | anyathaikatra kṛtakatva-rūpa-jananādau śabdapramāṇapravṛttāv anyatrānityatva-rasa-jananādau pramāṇāntarānapekṣāprasaṅgaḥ |

[39,9] tasmāt tādātmye bhāvo 'bhāvaś caikatra syād iti doṣaḥ | na tad-ādhāratve | tau hi parasparaṃ bhinnau dharmau yady ekatra syātāṃ, kīdṛśo doṣaḥ | bhāvābhāvadoṣasya bhedasādhanenaiva caritārthatvāt | śāstre 'pi hi viruddhadharmādhyāso bheda ukto, na virodhaḥ | virodha-lakṣaṇaṃ tv anyat prasiddham eva | tādātmyaniṣedho 'pi viśeṣaṇānapekṣasvabhāvānupalambhād ukto na viruddhopalambhāt | tad evaṃ bhāvābhāva-lakṣaṇaviruddhadharmasaṣargāt tad-dharmitvena bhāsamānau dharmāv eva bhinnau bhavata iti na tayor api dharmivastunor nānā-dharmayogamātreṇa bhedavārtā | yadā punas tathā bhidyamānāv eva dharmau yathoktaparasparapratidvandvinau bhavatas tadā tad-dharmiṇo 'pi bhedaḥ, nīlatvānīlatvabhāvābhāvadharmivat, ekakāryaṃ prati jananājananavac ca | tasmād bhāvābhāvau sākṣād viruddhau rūpa-janakatvadharmāv eva svadharmitvenābhāsamānau bhintaḥ | na tayor apy ādhāraṃ pracīnavirūpa-lakṣaṇam, svayaṃ virodhābhāvāt | ata eva na bhinnau dṛśyate saḥ, ekakārya-janakājanakatve ca svayaṃ pratyanīkatayā svadharmiṇaṃ bhinta eva, abhedadarśanaṃ ca pratyanīkāvasāyena virodhī yata iti anumānavṛttiś ceti sarvam anavadyam ||

[39, 22] ayaṃ tu svayam eva na hy ekasvabhāvāt kāryabheda paśyāma iti na ca bhinno dṛśyate sa iti ca brūvann asvastha eva na nirbandhayogyaḥ | tamān naikasvabhāvāyāḥ sāmāgryāḥ kāryavaijātyam ity avirodhaḥ | na tu svabhāvaparamparā-rahitād iti | tad evaṃ svabhāvasandehāpohād yad uktam, kṣaṇikebhyo nivartāmānaṃ sattvam asādhāraṇam upādānasya svabhāvabhedāpattir iti tan nirastam |

[40,3] kālpanika iva bhedapratibhāso na tāttviko bhedaḥ | kiṃ ca tāttvikasvabhāvabhedāpattāv api sattvam asādhāraṇam iti śraddhāvadheyam eva | na hi vastūnāṃ parimāṇātirekeṇa nityād iva kṣaṇikād api vyāvṛttaṃ bhavati sattvam, yato 'sādhāraṇam avadhāryeta | svabhāvabhūmani kaścin nityo 'pi syād iti cet |
tam anupatat tarhi sattvaṃ (17a) sādhāraṇam anaikāntikam āśaṅkyatām | tac ca cintyam | bādhakānāṃ vyāttavadanānāṃ sambhavāt |
atha svabhāvaparamparā-sambhāve bhāvasyeva kasya kṣaṇikatvam iti kṣaṇikād api vyāvṛttam ucyate, tad api nāsti | svayam eva svabhāvebhyo bhinnasya svabhāvinaḥ kriyā-samarthanena rakṣāvidhānāt | na ca svabhāvabheda-[a] sambhave mūlasya kṣayo 'pi yuktaḥ, aparimititopādhisambhave 'pi tad-vato vyayāniṣṭaḥ | asmad darśane 'pi yadi nāma vastv-antara-rāśer udayaḥ, tathāpi prakṛtabhāvasya kīdṛśī kṣayopapattir iti vyaktam etat | sa tu rāśiḥ pramāṇam anviyān na veti cintyam | bhavatu vā mūlāpalāpaḥ | ye tu svabhāvā bhāvikā dṛṣṭaḥ tad-ātmani magnatvān mūlasyaikaṃ pṛthak sat kṣaṇikaṃ mā bhūt | bhūyāṃsas tu kṣaṇikāḥ santa ity upacaya eva kṣaṇikāyāḥ, kathaṃ kṣaṇikatāyāḥ sattvavyāvṛttiḥ |
tad evam evaṃ vidhāḥ pralāpā grāmya-jana-janitam ahimānas teṣv eva śobhante, na tarkakarkaśakuśāgrīyabuddhiṣu bauddheṣu | yā tu śikṣā svabhāvabhedasādhanāya syād etad ity-ādiḥ saiṣām evāstuḥ, anyo 'nyasya svabhāva iti svasthasya vaktum 'śakteḥ | svabhāvabhedas tu sādhanāsambhavād adhyakṣabādhanāc ca parihṛta eva | na ca bhavann api prakṛtadoṣasaṃsparśī | nāpi sahakāryantaram eva svabhāvāntaram iti dantaniṣkoṣikayā svabhāvabhedasādhanā hetavo viparyāsayituṃ śakyante | kṣaṇikavādī hi sahakāriṇaḥ paśyann eva prasiddhasvabhāvabhedasādhanāya sādhanam upanyasya na katham apy anena vacasā pratārayituṃ śakyaḥ | tad varaṃ tat-sādhanam asādhanam eveti mukham ākhyātāniṣṭasiddhavyāghātād iti | tatra coktam asmābhiḥ | na ca sahakārisādhanāyaiva pratyavasthātur ayaṃ prayatnaḥ | kāryeṇānubhūtānvayavyatirekā hi sahakāriṇaḥ pratyakṣādipramāṇasiddhā eva kim atra sādhyam | tato 'kṣaṇikābhimatasya kramavatīṣu kāryavyaktiṣu svalakṣaṇabhedasādhana upanyaste dūṣaṇam anuktvā sahakāryantaram eva svabhāvabheda iti lapanaṃ yadi svahṛdayasantoṣam ālambeta, ālambatām | na tu parasādhyaṃ bādhitam anena | tasmāt siddham arthakriyākāritvam asthairyeṇa vyāptam iti ||

[41,7] yad apy anenaoktam, kiṃ cedaṃ tāvad ayaṃ kṣaṇikavādī praṣṭavyaḥ | pūrvasya kṣaṇasyottarasminn ekasantānavartini kṣaṇe kartavye nānyat kiñcid apekṣaṇīyam asti | tataś ca parotpatti praty anapekṣatvāt tan-mātrānubaddhenottareṇāpi saty eva tasmin bhavitavyam | abhvan vā tan-mātrānubaddho na syāt, api tu nimittāntarāpekṣo vijñāyeta | asabhāgotpattau tu pūrve samānasantānavartina ekasantānāntarbhūtatvāviśeṣāt samarthā asamarthā vā bhaveyuḥ | na tu sabhāgakṣaṇapratibandhotpattau | tathā ca sati pūrvakṣaṇasattā-mātrānubandhitvāviśeṣād uttarottaraḥ kṣaṇaḥ paurvāparyaṃ tyaktvā yugapadutpadyeta | tataś ca prabandhāpekṣakārya(17b)-kṣaṇakālabhāvināṃ kṣaṇānāṃ prabandha ucchidyeta | tataś ca trai-lokyavartisakalavastu-santānabhāvinām anenaiva paryāyeṇa prabandhocchedād anyonyasampī[ḍi] tā kṛtsnā tri-lokī prasajyeta |

[41,17] athāpi samayasamayabhāvitvāt savyetarago-viṣāṇayor iva kāryakāraṇabhāvo nāstīty ucyate, yady evam atīte kṣaṇe pūrvasmin vastv-antara utpadyeta, sati ca notpadyeta ity apūrvo 'yam anvayavyatirekānugamaprakāraḥ | etayāpi dvārā kṣaṇikānām arthakriyākāritvam evānupapannam iti ||

[41,21] tad api sarvam asambaddham | tathā hi yat tāvat pūrvasyottare kartavye nānyatra kvacid apekṣeti, tatra uttare sarva eva kṣaṇā abhipretā bhavataḥ | anyathā sarveṣāṃ yaugapadyaprasañjanam anupapannaṃ syāt | tatra yadi svābhiprāye dūṣaṇaṃ tadā na kaścid vipakṣaḥ | atha saugata eva praṣṭavyaḥ, tadā pūrvasya uttarasminn-anantara eva kṣaṇe kartavye nirapekṣatvaṃ, nottare kṣaṇe | sa eva tarhi tasya svabhāvo nāsti yas tad utpādakaḥ | tataḥ svabhāvasāpekṣatvāt katham anapekṣaḥ | sa tarhi svabhāvaḥ kadācid asya bhāvī, na bhāvī tarhi tadapekṣa iti vāco yukteḥ ko 'rthaḥ |

[42,3] ayam arthaḥ | yad ucyate devadatto 'tra kārye yajñadattāpekṣaḥ samartha iti | tatra dvayaṃ pratīyate, svayam asamartha iti, yajñadattena saha samartha iti ca | na ca sarvo vyavahāras tattvānurodhī | kiṃ tu kvacit kiñcit satyam | tad atrāpi svayam asamartha ity ayam aṃśa ubhayasaṃmatatvād durapahnavaḥ | sa eva paścād anyena saha samartha ity atra tu vivādaḥ | ata eva sādhane bādhanāvatāraḥ | atas tad aṃśāsiddheḥ tadapekṣaṃ svayaṃ śabdam apy apanīya kvacit sāpekṣa ity asamartha ity evārthaḥ | tata uttarottare kartavye asambhavini tad utpādanasvabhāve sāpekṣa iti ko 'rthaḥ | uttarottarakartavye samarthaḥ | tad atra yad dūṣaṇaṃ tad ucyatām |

[42,11] syād etat | uttarasvarūpāviśiṣṭam uttarottaram, tataḥ pūrvaṃ yathottare śaktaṃ tathottarottare 'pi | uttarottare aśaktaḥ tad uttare 'pi kathaṃ śaktaḥ syāt, ekasvabhāvatvād dvayor iti |

[42,14] tad apy asaṃgatam,ekasvabhāvatvāsiddheḥ | sabhāgakṣaṇaparamparāpekṣayā siddham ekasvabhāvatvam iti cet, na, sarvathā sabhāgatvāsiddheḥ | sajātīyārtho hi sabhāgārthaḥ | sajātīyatvaṃ ca vividham | rūpataḥ śaktitata ubhayataś ceti | tatra yady api rūpamātrakṛtaṃ sajātīyatvam uttarasyottareṇa, tathāpi sāmarthyakṛtaṃ nāsti | tataḥ kṛtaṃ vijātīyatvam eva | ata eva bījādīnāṃ svabhāvapariṇāmaparamparayā kiyatyāpy aṅkurakāryaniṣpattiḥ | tatra hi antimasya bījakṣaṇasyāṅkure śaktiḥ | antime punar upāntyasyopāntye ca tat-pūrvasyety evaṃ yāvat prathamabījasambhavaḥ | evaṃ sahakārisāmagry api tatrāparāparāviśiṣṭaiveti veditavyam |
ata evāparāparapratyayayogena prati-kṣaṇabhinnaśaktayaḥ saṃtanvantaḥ saṃskārā yady api kutaścit sāmyāt sarūpāḥ pratīyante, athāpi bhinna evaiṣāṃ svabhāvas tena kiñcid eva kasyacit kāraṇam kāryaṃ veti nyāyaḥ | (18a) tataḥ sarvathā sabhāgatvavirahāt pūrvasyottarakṣaṇa-jananasāmarthye 'pi nottarottara-jananam asya, tataḥ śaktiviśeṣeṇa viśeṣāt | tathā tasyāpy anyasmāt śakter upacayo 'pacayo vā | ubayor api viśeṣa evocyate | viśiṣyate 'nyasmād iti | tat katham ekakṣaṇa eva sarveṣāṃ sabhāgābhimatakṣaṇānām upanipāta-codyāvakāśaḥ | anvayavyatirekotprāso 'pi paścimo duścaritam eva | kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanasāmarthyākadarthane hi yad ekānantaram anya-janma, sa evānvayaḥ | yac ca tatkāraṇasya prāg-asambhave 'sambhava eva deśakālāntare kāryasya, sa eva vyatireka iti kiṃ atra kriyatām anicchatāpi | nityavādino 'pi hi na sahaiva hetuphalayor janma | kiṃtu hetu-janmānantaraṃ phalasya janma | yat kṣaṇāc ca kāraṇasya kāryam udayavat tataḥ prāk paścād vā sambhave kāraṇasya kārya ka upakāraḥ | tatkṣaṇānantaram asya janmeti tāvataiva kṛtāthatvāt kāryasya tāvataivānvayaḥ, tadabhāve 'bhāvaś ceti vyatirekaś ca | kevalaṃ tatkṣaṇāt pāk paścād api kāraṇābhimatasya bhāvaḥ pramāṇopanītena kāryānupayogamātreṇa arihartuṃ śakya iti tāvan nityavādino viśeṣaḥ | saca vicāritaḥ | anvayavyatirekau tu yathoktamātreṇeti sthitam ||

[43,11] yad api sattvasyāsādhāraṇatāṃ pratijñāya ekasmād anekasmād ekaṃ anekaṃ votpadyata iti vimṛśyānekasmād anekotpattipakṣaṃ sthitam ādāyovāca Vācaspatiḥ, kiṃ pūrve kṣaṇā uttareṣāṃ kṣaṇāṃ parasparaṃ nirapekṣā eva janakā āhosvit sāpekṣā iti |
nanūktam antyakṣaṇaprāptāḥ parasparam anapekṣāḥ kāryāṇi janayantīti | tat kim anabhyupetāropaprapañcena | tat kim idānīṃ samarthabījakṣaṇa-janako 'pi taj-janane bījakṣaṇo 'napekṣa eva | om iti brūmaḥ | hantānena prakāreṇa sarva eva bījakṣaṇā nirapekṣāḥ kārya-janana iti kṛtaṃ sahakāribhiḥ |
nanūktaṃ naite prekṣāvantaḥ kiṃ tu svapratyayādhīnaniyatasannidhayo na kṣaṇam api vyavadher-īśata iti | tat kiṃ ayaṃ kṛṣī-balo 'pi na prekṣāvān, yaḥ kuśūlād apanīya bījam āvapati bhūmau parikarṣitāyāṃ kṣityādisahabhāvena evātiśayotpādaparamparayā aṅkura-jananasāmarthyād bījasya | kuśūlasthād vatsara[śa] tenāpi tad adarśanāt tatrāvapatīti cet | atha kim ayaṃ na svasantāmsA40bnamātraprabhavaḥ samartho bījakṣaṇa | tathā cet, kathaṃ santānāntaraṃ sahakāri nāpekṣeta kāryakaraṇe |

[44,1] nanv apekṣata eva svotpāde, na punaḥ svakārye | tatratasyānapekṣatvam ucyate, na tu svotpattau | nanu svotpattāv apy asya svasantānavartī jāgarti pūrva eva nirapekṣaḥ kṣaṇaḥ | evaṃ tasya tasya pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ kṣaṇaḥ svasantānapatita evānapekṣo jāgarti janana iti kuśūlanihitabīja eva syāt kṛtī kṛṣī-balaḥ | kṛtam asya prekṣāvataḥ kṛṣi-karmaṇā duḥkhākareṇeti |

[44,11] yadi manyeta dvividham iha kāryaṃ, ekaṃ [18b) sahakāribhir āhitātiśayaviśeṣaparamparā-prasavadharmakam, dvitīyaṃ sahakāryatiśayanirapekṣa-janakam | yatrāṅkuro 'tiśayaviśeṣaparamparāpekṣa-janmā | ādyātiśayas tu sahakāri-kṛtātiśayaparamparā-nirapekṣotpādaḥ | na caitad ubhayavidham api kāryaṃ bījasya svasantānamātrād utpattim arhati | kṣity-ādisantānāntarāpekṣam eva bījaṃ svasantānavarti, bhinnasantānavarti vā kādācitkaṃ kāryaṃ karotīti kalpate kṛṣi-karmaṃ, santānāntarāṇi tu kādācitkakāryotpattau ye sahakāripratyayāḥ, ta eva yathāṅkurotpattau sahakāriṇo bījasya sāmarthyaprabodhe hetavaḥ kadācit teṣāṃ kṣity-ādīnāṃ yo 'pi jananahetavaḥ ta eva sāmarthyahetavo bhavanti, yathā bījādinām ādyātiśayotpādane sāmarthyaprabodhahetava upasarpaṇapratyayāḥ | sarvathā santānāntarair anāhitātiśayaṃ na bījaṃ kāryaviśeṣaṃ kādācitkaṃ karoti | sāmarthyaprabodhahetavaś ca sahakāripratyayā upasarpaṇapratyayāś ca |
tad anupapannam | tathā hi bhavatu tathā dvividhaṃ kāryam | astu ca tatkādācitkatvāt santānāntarāpekṣam | apekṣārthaś ca vaktavyaḥ | kāraṇasya svasāmarthyaprabodha iti cet |
nanu sāmarthyatat-prabodhayoḥ samarthabhāvatattvāvyatirekāt samarthapratyayotpāda ity uktaṃ bhavati | tathā ca svotpādāpekṣitakāraṇaṃ sahakāripratyayāt satyam abhyupagama eva doṣatvena codyate | athāyam aṅkura-jananasamartho vā kṣaṇaḥ, ādyātiśayo vā kiṃ nirapekṣeṇa svasantānamātra-janmanā pūrvakṣaṇena janyate, na punaḥ svasantānamātra-janmanā, asyāpi pūrvasmād eva puñjād utpatteḥ |

[45,1] nanu samāna śaktyā kuśūla-janmasu bījasantāneṣu kasmāt kiñcid eva bījaṃ paramparayā 'ṅkuropajananānuguṇam upajanyati bījakṣaṇam, nānye bījakṣaṇā bhinnasantānāntaḥ pātinaḥ | na khalūpasarpaṇapratyayāt prāg eteṣāṃ samānāsamānasantānavartināṃ kaścit paramparātiśayo bījakṣaṇānām | artopasarpaṇapratyayāt prāṅ na tat-santānavartino janayanti paramparayāpy aṅkuropajananānuguṇaṃ bījakṣaṇam, bījamātra-jananāt teṣām | kasyacid bījakṣaṇasyopasarpaṇapratyayasahabhuva ādyātiśayotpādaḥ | hanta tarhi tad abhāve saty utpanno 'pi janayed eva | na cāsyopasarpaṇapratyayena sahabhāvaniyamaḥ, atat-santānāṃ kuśūlavartināṃ bījakṣaṇānāṃ tena saha samānayogakṣemāṇāṃ abhyupasarpaṇapratyayasahabhāvābhāvāt, kṣaṇasya caikasya kṣaṇāntareṇa kāryakāraṇaniścayābhāvāt | sāmanyaviṣayotpādānvayavyatirekayos tatraivopapatteḥ | tathā ca kevalānāṃ vyabhicārasambhāvād ādyātiśayotpādam aṅkuraṃ vā prati kṣaty-ādīnāṃ parasparāpekṣatvam evotpādakatvam akāmenāpy aṅgīkartavyam iti |

[45,13] tad api prācīna-cāryā nirastaprāyam | tathā hi yadi nāma parasparāpekṣāṇām evotpādakatvam etāvatā samarthitaṃ, prastute kim āyātam | atha samāna(41b)-kālabhāvināṃ parasparāpekṣatvam upalabdham | evam akṣaṇikasyāpi sahakāriṣv anupakāriṣu tyakṣyate [iti] kadācit kasyacit kraṇasambhāvanā msA42a_p.15|1 yām āyāsasambhavinī nityād vyāvṛttiḥ satyasyety abhiprāyaḥ | yady evaṃ katham asādhāraṇatā-pratijñā-nirvāhaḥ | sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvam evābhidhātum ucitam ||

[45,19] atha kṣaṇikasya sahakāriṣu nāpekṣā nāpekṣā yukteti vyavasthitam, vakṣyate ca purastād ayam abhiprāyaḥ, tato 'pekṣānapekṣābhyāṃ vyāptam arthakriyākāritvam anityāc ca tadabhāvād vyāvartate | sthirāc ca kramayaugapadyavirahād vyāvartate tvam-mateneti vyaktam asādhāraṇam | tathā ca na kṣaṇikasya sahakāriṣv apekṣā upakārābhāvāt, nāpy anapekṣā, tām antareṇa kāraṇābhāvād iti siddho vyāpakābhāvaḥ |

[45,24] tad api yatkiñcit | tathā hi kādṛśam apekṣārtham ādāyedam ucyate | yadi tāvat sahakāriṇam apekṣata iti shakāriṇopakartavya ity arthaḥ, tadā tad abhāvād anapekṣaiva kṣaṇikasya katham ubhayavyāvṛttiḥ | sahakāri-bhedam antareṇa karaṇānupapattis tu kṣaṇāntare svayam abhāvād eva |
atha tad vā tādṛg vā āsīd iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ, tataḥ tādṛk-svabhāvasambhave 'py akaraṇaṃ sahakāriṇi nirapekṣān na kṣamata iti cet |
asambaddham etat, akartus tādṛk-svabhāvatāyā virahāt | (42b) yad evānantarakāryam aparyāsitaśaktisakalasahakārimadhyam adhyāsīnasya svarūpaṃ tad eva yadi deśakālāntare 'pi, hanta tad-vad eva karaṇakṣamatvam | na ca varṇasaṃsthānamātrasāmye ca sāmyaṃ bījāntarāṇāṃ bhavitum arhati | dṛśyante hy ākārasāmye 'pi phalasadbhāvādi-bhedena bhāvānāṃ bhinnavyavasthitayaḥ, tathā śakti-bhedenāpi syuḥ | pākopacaye harītakī-vat | sa tu svabhāvabhedas teṣāṃ bījatve sādhāraṇe 'pi kuta iti praśne 'pi kāraṇasāmagrī-śakti-bheda eva śaraṇaṃ kathañcit sāmyapratītāv apīti darśitam aparāparapratyayety-ādiprastāve |

[46,12] tato yad uktam, nanu samānakuśūla-janmasvity-ādi, tad apāstam | yasya hi dṛṣṭādṛṭakāraṇasāmagrī-pariṇāme parasparāyātaḥ svabhāvabhedo bījasyopasarpaṇapratyayasahakāri-bhāvabhūmiḥ, tat pariṇāmaparamparayā janayaty-ādyam atiśayam aṅkuraṃ vā | nānya bījakṣaṇās tathā-bhūtahetuparamparā-viraheṇa tat-svabhāvābhāvāt |

[48,1] kiyati vā tvayāpi pratividheyam | tat kiṃ viphalam āyāsyasi | ayogābhyūhavirahe 'pi pratiniyatadeśakālasvabhāveṣu bhāveṣu kāryabhedopalambhaḥ sarvatrāvāntarabhedaṃ durlakṣyakarmādisādhanaśakti-bhedabhāvitam | sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa vā dṛśyādṛśya-cetanācetanārthakarmaṇy upayoginaṃ yogibhir apy avāntarair aśakyaparicchedam idan tayā niyamena sāmānyato vyavasthāpayatīti galepādikayāpi svīkārayitavyo nyāyānveṣī nyāyavidā | tathā ca sati kasyacid eva bījasyopasarpaṇapratyayasamparkakarkaśaḥ svabhāvaḥ, anyeṣāṃ tu tad-viśeṣaviśleṣam asṛṇa ity avāntarāvāntaraviśeṣāt sa eva bījakṣaṇaḥ paramparayāpi prakṛtakāryopayogī, nānye bījakṣaṇaḥ | sa cāvāntaro viśeṣaḥ karasparśād anumīyamāno na karmādisādhanaśaktiviśeṣānabhūhād upayogaviśeṣānabhyūhād vā śakyapratikṣepaḥ | tilakādisambhavād iva dehaṃśaviśeṣaḥ, vṛkṣādyaṃśaviśeṣo vā kutaścid ekadeśikavikāra-leśāt | tatrāpi hi vikārabindu-sthānasyāṃśasyedaṃ dṛṣṭam-adṛṣṭaṃ vā kāraṇam āsādyopādānabhāgaviśeṣaparamparayāyaṃ svabhāvabheda idam anyabhāgāsādhyam arthaṃ kartuṃ samartha iti viśeṣānavadhāraṇe 'py asti kiñcid viśiṣṭaṃ kāraṇam upayogo vā 'nyā sambhavīti sāmānyato vikārakāraṇayogād aṅgasya svabhāvabhedaniścayaḥ | evam atrāpi bīje purṣabuddhiprayuktakarasparśād asti svabhāvabhedaḥ sūkṣmahtuphalabhedabhāgīti sāmānyato durnivāro niścayaḥ | tataḥ svabhāvabhedasambhavāt tad eva bījam upayujyate paramparayāpy aṅkuropajananānuguṇe viśeṣe nānye bījakṣaṇā iti siddham etat |
