[51,20] atha bhinnātmāno 'pi bījādayaḥ kayācit pratyāsattyā ekavyavahāragocarī kriyante, evam aṅkurādayo 'pīti kāraṇābhede 'bhedo 'pi siddhaḥ | tatra kāraṇām ekaikārtha-janakatvam ekavyavahārahetuḥ | kāryāṇāṃ tv ekaika-janyatvam iti samānam | tat kim artham ekībhavitavyam aṅkurādibhiḥ, sāmagryapekṣāyām api tāvataiva hetu-bhedābhedānuvidhānasya paryāptatvāt | etac ca kāraṇaśabdena sāmagrīṃ vyutpadyamānasyāpi (21b) parasya bhedābhedayor avyutpattir eva buddhyanurodhād abhidhīyate | tattvatas tu yathā kāraṇaṃ sāmagrī vivakṣitā, tathā bhedābhedāv api vaijātyāvaijātye vivakṣite iti darśitaprāyam |

[52,3] nanv adyāpi na samagrebhyo 'nyā sāmagrīti teṣām eva samagrāṇāṃ sādṛśye vaisadṛśye vā kāryāṇāṃ sādṛśyaṃ vaisadṛśyaṃ veti prāptam | evam etat | na tu tat-puñjasthānāṃ parasparaṃ sādṛśyādinirūpaṇam | kiṃ tu puñjāntarasthaiḥ saha sva-jātyapekṣayā senāyāḥ senāntareṇa saha sādṛśyetaranirūpaṇavat | tatra yāvanto yādṛśā ekasāmagrī-prajñaptigocarā arthā hetu-saṃmatāḥ, tāvantamsĀ p.15|4s tādṛśā eva yadi deśakālāntaravartinas tadāsau sadṛśī sāmagrī, kāryaṃ ca sadṛśam asyā iti kāryaśabdenāpi puñja eva | yāvanti yādṛśāni kāryāṇi jātāny ekatra tāvanti tādṛśānyevānyatrāpi jāyanta ity arthaḥ | vaisadṛśye tu tāratamyabhedena bhidyamāne kāryam api tāratamyabhedena bhidyata ity api kāryapuñjasyaiva tāratamyabhedena vaisadṛśyam ity arthaḥ | bhedamātravivakṣāyām apy ayam eva nyāyaḥ | satyāṃ vipratipattau bhinnāyāḥ sāmagryā bhinnam eva kāryaṃ bhavatīti etādṛśam eva kāraṇabhedānuvidhānaṃ kāryasya pramāṇānusāri | tadatikrame ca viśvasyāhetukatvaprasaṅgaḥ saṅgatim avatarati | na pramāṇabādhitasya ekakāraṇaikakaraṇaniyamasyātikrame | tad iyaṃ bhedābhedānukaraṇavārtā naiyāyikānāṃ gopamukhāt pāyasam iṣṭatāśrutim anuharati |

[52,16] tasmād ekam eva bījam aṅkurādikam anekaṃ janayati, evaṃ kṣity-ādikam api praty-ekam | ato naikānekayor ubhayor api vyāvṛttir yato vyāpakānupalambhā 'yam aparaḥ kṣaṇikapakṣe 'pi kriyā-bādhanaṃ sattayā asādhāraṇī-karaṇārtham upanyasyate | rūpāntareṇa jananapakṣas tu pratikṣipta evāsmābhir iti na tad-dūṣaṇaparamparāyāḥ parihārābhiyogaḥ | etac ca tattvāpekṣayocyate | kalpanā-vilāse tu yad aṅkura-jananaṃ na tat kṣiti-jananam | tathā na sahakāritvam evopādānatvam ity evaṃ prakāraprapañcasambhave 'pi nāpardho vastunaḥ kaścit kriyā-viraha-lakṣaṇaḥ, tāttvikenaiva rūpeṇa sarvanirvāhāt | ata eva kṣity-ādau janayitavye tad-upādānaṃ pūrvam eva kṣity-ādi-bījasya rūpāntaram iti kim arthaṃ vaktavyam asmābhiḥ, yad uttaraḥ prabandhaḥ sādhuḥ syāt | anapekṣā caikā sahakāriṣv api sādhiteti prakaraṇārthanigamanaṃ sakalam-ākulam-ākuladhiyaḥparasya |

[53,1] kiṃ ca yenaiva rūpeṇa bījam aṅkuram utpādayati kiṃ tenaiva kṣauṇī-kṣaṇam iti paryanuyuñjānāḥ te 'pi paryanuyujyante rūpaśabdena kim atra vivakṣitam iti | kiṃ tāvat kalpanā-talpaśāyino bhinnā iva bhāsamānā dharmāḥ kṛtakatvānityatvādivad aṅkuretara-janakatvādayaḥ svarūpaśabdenāpi labdhavyavahṛtayaḥ | atha rūpaṃ svarūpaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ yad bhedāt (22a) nāparo vastu-bhedaḥ yad adhikāreṇocyate, yad ādau vastunaḥ svarūpaṃ tad eva yadi paścād api prāg iva paścād api na janayed ity-ādi |

[53,7] yad vā naiyāyikaiḥ patyur-nāmāvijānatyā bhrātṛ-śabdena vyavahāravat sahakāriṇa eva svarūpaśabdena vyavahṛtā rūpam ity uktam | tatra prathamapakṣe tāvan na paryanuyogasaṃgatiḥ | kalpanā-nirmitā hi dharmaḥ parasparaṃ dharmiṇaś ca sakāśād vidyamānā iva bhānto 'pi yathā pratibhāsam asattvāt pramāṇasahatayā na kvacit kriyāyāṃ karaṇabhāvabhājo bhavitum arhati | yad eva hi svalakṣaṇam adhyakṣagocarīkṛtam anaṅgaṃ tata evānvayavyatirekābhyām arthakriyā-niṣpattiniścaye 'py anādivāsanā-vaśād upajāyamānaṃ vikalpa-cetasi tatas tato vyāvṛttavastu-vyavasāyabalāvalambisaṃvādeṣu dharmeṣv apoddhāreṇāsyām-asyāṃ kriyāyām ayam ayaṃ dharma upayujyata iti vyavahāramātram ātanyate | na tu teṣākvacit karaṇabhāvaḥ, svayam asattvāt | vivakṣākṛtas tu na vāryate | yathā prakāśe piśaṅgātmani pradīpe 'py ayam akhaṇḍenaiva rūpeṇa tamaso nāśam avakāśapiñjaraṃ ca kurvati tathaiva niścite ca yad ayaṃ dīpaḥ prakāśa-rūpaḥ, tato 'ndhakāraṃ hrati hariṇāṅkavat | piśaṅatvāc ca piñjaraṇahetur haridrādivad iti vyavahāraḥ | na ca tatra prakāśapiśaṅgabhāvau bhinnau | vikalpa-cetasi tu bhinnavat bhāsamānāv ekaikam apoddṛtya bhinnakriyākaraṇatvena vyavasthitau vivakṣitau, [na vyavasthitau vā] na ca vivakṣā-mātreṇa pradīpasyākārakatvaṃ bhedo vā |

[53,20] tathā bījasyāpy aṅkura-jananena rūpeṇa kalpitenāṅkurakaraṇaṃ pṛthvī-janakena ca tatkaraṇam iti vyavahāre 'pi tattvato naikasyāpy anekakarmaṇi niṣedho bhedopapattir vā akriyaiva vā | tato vikalpārūḍha-rūpāpekṣayānekena rūpeṇānekakaraṇam iti vyavahāramātraṃ na vastu | vāstavī ca cinteyam | tat kim anena vikalpitena, kiṃ tena rūpeṇānyena veti | vikalpe 'pi vānekenaiva visarjanaṃ vyavahāramātreṇa | na ca kaścid doṣaḥ |

[53,25] dvitīyapakṣas tv anekasvalakṣaṇadarśane saty upapadyate | na ca bījasvalakṣaṇāni api sakṛd ekasaṃkhyā nirīkṣā-viṣayaḥ | na hy aparidṛṣṭabhūmani manuṣye kim ayam atra karmaṇi niyojyate naraḥ, kim ayaṃ veti praśnāvatāraḥ |

[54,3] tṛtīyavikalpe tv ayam arthaḥ syāt, yenaiva rūpeṇāṅkuraṃ karoti kiṃ tenaiva kṣitim iti | yenaiva sahakāriṇāṅkuraṃ janayati kiṃ tenaiva bhuvam iti | etac ca kadocyate yadi bījasyāṅkurakaraṇe nirjāte niyata-rūpaḥ kaścit sahakārī vyāpāravān pariniṣṭhito 'nyakaraṇe sandigdhavyāpāraḥ | na caivaṃ śakyopadarśanam |
athaivaṃ sati bījasyāṅkurakaraṇe pṛthvī-pāthaḥ-prabhṛtayaḥ sahakāriṇas ta eva kiṃ tasya pṛthvī-janane 'pīti vikalpārthaḥ | tenāpi nopayogaḥ | sarveṣāṃ msĀ p.15|5 sarvatra parasparaṃ sahakāri-bhāvasya suprasiddhatvāt kim atra praśnena | na cottaraḥ prabandho 'trānurūpaḥ | na hi tadāpi kāraṇabhedābhedābhyāṃ (22b) kāryabhedābhedāv iti śliṣṭā kācit | tasmād īrṣyāśalyakadarthitanirarthakaiḥ pralāpaiḥ param ākulayitum icchanti nyāyavin-mānina ity alam atra nirbandhena |

[54,13] api cāpūrvo 'yam asādhāraṇānaikāntikakīrtanaprakāraḥ | vidyamāno hi bhāvaḥ sādhyetarayor aniścitānvayavyatireko gandhavattvādivad asādhāraṇo yuktaḥ | prakṛtavyāpakānupalambhabalāc ca sarvathārthakriyaivāsatīti tat katham asādhāraṇānaikāntikī bhavitum arhati | asiddidūṣaṇaṃ tu vaktum ucitam | tatra coktam eva |
atha kṣaṇikatve vyāpakābhāva ity uktam, tan na sarvthā sattvam iti cet | evaṃ tarhi vidyamānaivārthakriyā kṣaṇikād eva vyāvartate, tato niyamenākṣaṇike viśrāmyatīti tena vyāpyata iti viruddhatāpy astu |
atha sākṣād akṣaṇike tasyā bādakasya sādhakasya vā virahāt sandeha iti cet | vidyamānatve kṣaṇikād vyāvṛttir eva sādhanī tasyāḥ sandeham anavakāśayati | vidyamānatā-sandehe ca sandigdhāsiddhir eva dūṣaṇam |
kiṃ ca, prakṛtavyāpakānupalambhasya kṣaṇikavat akṣaṇike 'pi sāmarthyānapāyāt kathaṃ bādhakasiddhir ity asiddhir eva sarvathāyātā | śakyaṃ hi nitye 'pi vaktuṃ na sahakāriṇi sāpekṣasya karaṇam upakārābhāvāt | na nirapekṣasya, tena vinā karaṇāt | sthiraṃ ca bījam aṅkura-janakenaiva rūpeṇa kṣitim utpādayati bhinnena vety-ādi yadā visadṛśakṣity-ādi-janmopālambhaḥ pradīpo 'pi cākṣaṇika eva bhavatām | tatra vartivikāratailakṣayāv ekena bhinnena vā rūpeṇa kriyetām iti samānam | yas tu samādhiḥ sahakāriṇa eva bhinnāḥ tasya svarūpabheda iti, evaṃ ca bruvatā paro 'py ātmā ātmāpi para iti nivṛttedānīm ātmaparādi-śabdebhyaḥ pratiniyatārthapratyāyanapratyāśā | na ca devadattasya svarūpaṃ yajñadattaḥ śuklasya vā nīlam ity ucitaṃ kvacid ekakarmaṇi vyāpāre 'pi | tad etad apetāgamayuktikaṃ paraspardhayā 'bhidhīyamānaṃ niyatam upahāsabhājanī-karoti |

[55,9] sahakāriṇo 'vadhīrya ca svarūpaśabdavācyam arthaṃ sahakāriṇottaram iti vyaktaṃ na tena nānyena vātmanā janayati sthiro 'pi bhāva iti niyatam anujñātaiva vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ | anyasyāpi hi sa evātmā janako na svayam iti na kaścij janakaḥ | tad ayaṃ sthirāsthirayoḥ sādhārṇo nyāyaḥ kriyā-niṣedhasādhana iti | tasya dṛḍhatve sarvathā kriyaiva nāstīty asiddhir eva, antataḥ kramayaugapadyaviraha-lakṣaṇasyāpi doṣasyāparihārāt | sthire 'pi kriyā-nivṛttir avaśyābhyupeyā | katham anyathā kṣaṇike kriyā-niṣedhābhidhānena kevalenāsādhāraṇatā-pratijñā nivṛttim ālambeta | na hi sādhyād vyāvṛttir ity evāsādhāraṇatā | anyathā vipakṣād vyāvṛttir eva kiṃ nāsādhāraṇatvam ucyate, kim iyatā prayāsena |

[55,17] nanu vipakṣād vyāvṛttyā sādhye niyamād dhetur eva syād iti cet | sādhyād vyāvṛttyā vipakṣe niyamād viruddha eva (23a) syād iti smānam | tasmād arthakriyāyā[ḥ] pratijñā-mātre 'py asiddhir eva | athānyena prakāreṇa ubhayor aniścayamātraṃ sattāyāḥ khyāpyate, tathā ca saty asādhāraṇatā yuktaiva |
tad ayuktam | vyāpakānupalambho hy ekāntato 'bhāvaniścayakara eva katham aniścayaḥ | tatra yadi nāma kramādyanupalambhasya nityāt sattā-nivartakasya dārḍhyamasaṃgatam, tathāpi prakṛtasya kṣaṇe nityatā-bādhanasya dṛḍhatvam abhipretam eva, anyathopanyāsāyogāt | tataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgurāt kriyāyā ekāntikī vyāvṛttir eva vyāvṛttir asādhāraṇatāyāḥ | na hi gandhavattvaṃkutaścid ekāntena vyāvṛttam avasātuṃ śakyam | tad ayaṃ vyāpakānupalambhaḥ

[56,1] sthire 'pi vyāpakānupalambham apekṣamāṇo na sādhur asādhāraṇatāsādhane | sarvathā kriyām evonmūlayatīty asiddhir eva na sādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ | tasmād bāhyavedanaṃ bāhyavedakapramāṇasiddhaṃ cārthakriyāṃ vastu-satīm āśritya vādaprakrame tasyāsādharaṇatā-vādinā na sādhyetarayor ekatra vṛttir ekatā vyāvṛttir vopadarśayitavyā, kiṃ tūbhayatra saṃśayamātraṃ | na ca vyāpakānupalambhe sambhavas tasya | tasmān na sādhur asādhāraṇatopanyāsa iti sthitam |

[56,7] syād etat | yadi bhinnakālakārya-janmani janakasya svabhāvabhedaḥ, tadā bhinnadeśakāryotpāde 'py eṣa prasaṅgaḥ | tad avaśyaṃ sahakāryāpekṣayaiva deśabhedaḥ kāryāṇām | na ca kiñcitkaraḥ sahakārīti kālabhedo 'py eṣām akiñcitkaraḥ sahakāryapekṣayaivāstu | athopādānabhedād deśabhedaḥ kālabhede tu naivaṃ śakyam abhidhātum | kālāntara-janyānām apādānasya sthirapakṣe tadānīm api prāptisambhavāt | tasmāt kāraṇabheda-rūpabhedanibandhana eva kāryasya kālabheda iti cet, tad api nāsti, upādānasahakāri-bhedasya tattvato 'tāttvikatvāt | tāttvikatve 'py upādeyasahakāryabhedena dīpāder upādānasahakāri-bhāvabhedād anekasvabhāvatā prasaṅgaḥ | tad ayam āropitasvabhāva upādānasahakāri-bhāvabhedena bhedaḥ kāraṇasya kathaṃ kāryasya deśabhedāya prabhavet | yadi cāropito 'pi kāraṇasya msĀ p.15|6 bhedaḥ kāryasya deśabhedāya prabhaved evaṃ saty āropita eva kāraṇabhedaḥ kālabhedāya kāraṇāṃ paryāpta ity alaṃ tāttvikabhedapratyāśayā |

[56,18] na caitad vaktavyam, yathā kālabhede yad yadā yaj janakam ity-ādi bādhakam asti na tadā deśabheda iti, etādṛśasya bādhakasya deśabhede 'pi vaktuṃ śakyatvāt | yathā yat yat kāryaṃ tat tad deśe yathopādeyābhimataṃ, tatkāryaṃ ca kāryāntaram apīti || yad apīdam ucyate,

sarvāvasthā-samāne 'pīty-ādi (PVA I 396a)

tatrāpi śakyam evaṃ paṭhitum

sarvadeśasamāne 'pi kāraṇe yady akāryatety-ādi | (PVA II 396ab)

[57,3] atha kāraṇasya vaibhāvaābhyupagame syād eṣa doṣaḥ | tadabhāve [23b) tu kiṃ kṛtam asya sarvadeśasamānatvam | evaṃ tarhi deśāntare 'pi kāryaṃ na kuryāt, tatra svayam apravṛtteḥ | yogyatā-mātreṇa tu tad-deśavṛttim anapekṣya tatra kāryakāriṇaḥ samāno 'sya deśaḥ upakārasyaikato 'py alābhāt | tasmāt tad-deśe karotīti na svāpekṣayā deśasyādhārabhāvaḥ kiṃ tu kāryāpekṣyā | ayogavyavacchedena ca tatkaraṇam | anyathā deśāntaravataḥ kāryasya karaṇaprasaṅgāt | evaṃ tarhi kāle karotīti sa kālaḥ kāryasyaivādhāro niyamena | hetos tu sa cāsac ca syāt | ayogavyavacchedena tv ekakālakāryakaraṇam iti kālāntaravato 'pi kāryasya karaṇam avirodhi | tasmāt kuśūlādisarvāvasthā-samānasvabhāvasyāpi tadatatkālakārya-jananam upapannam, bhinnadeśānekakāryārjanavat iti |

[57,12] tad etan na saṅgatam, bādhakabhāvābhāvābhyāṃ viśeṣāt | yat tu tatkāryatvaṃ tad-deśatā-sādhanāyopanyastaṃ tad-viparyayabādhakapramāṇābhāvād asādhanam eva | anvayavyatirekasamadhigamyaś ca kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ | tau ca yathā tad-deśakārya-janmani dṛṣṭau tathā bhinnadeśakāryasambhave 'pi | na caivaṃ sthitenāpi kāraṇena saha tatkālakāryasyānyakālakāryasya vānvayavyatirekau samānāv iti yuktam | kālāntare 'pi tad eva kāraṇam anuvartata iti na pratyabhijñāto 'nyat pramāṇam, sā ca dūṣiteti kathaṃ sthireṇānvayavyatirekagrahaṇaṃ kāryāṇāṃ kālabhedavatām iti nāyaṃ nyāyaḥ samānaḥ | tato viparyayabādhakavikalatayā deśabhede bhedasādhano hetur yadi svasādhyasādhanasamarthaḥ kim āyātaṃ tadbalavataḥ kālabhede bhedasādhanasya | na hi vṛṣbhasyādohayogyatve dhenor api tatheti yuktam |

[57,21] astu vā deśabhedena bhedasādhanasyāpi viparyayabādhā balam, kālabhede bhedasādhanasya tu kim etāvatā dūṣaṇam anaikāntikatvam upapādyata iti cet?

kim ayaṃ mantrapāṭhaḥ |

kadācij jananasamarthasyājananasyānvayadarśanāt sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvam abhimatam iti cet?

tathāpi kim anena śrameṇa |

samarthaṃ ca syāt, na ca janayatītīyataiva tat-siddheḥ | deśodāharaṇena saṃśayapuṣṭiḥ kriyata iti cet |

[58,1] yadi viparyayabādhā balam asya na puṣṭāpi saṃśayam anullaṅghayantyā kiñcit, viparyayabādhā-vaidhurye tusaṃśayamātreṇāpi hetor viparyāsanāt kim aparam puṣṭyā | yadi ca tan-ātraṃ vivakṣitam, tadā viparyayabādhakena niraste 'smin kiṃ punar upanyāsena |
atha kāladeśayoḥ sarvatra smānanyāyopalabdher ekayogakṣematvād deśabhedavad eva kāryeṇa kālabhedavatāpi na hetur bheda ity ucyate |
tad apy ayuktam | tathā hi na parmāṇoḥ kālavyāptisadṛśī deśavyāptir iṣyate nityavādibhiḥ | nāpi vidyud(24a)-udyotasya deśavyāptisadṛśī kālavyāptir eva ghaṭāder apīti kathaṃ sarvatra samānanyāyatā | na cānyatra samānanyāyatādadarśane 'pi sarvatra tathā-bhāvaḥ, prastute vaiparītyasambhave bādhakābhāvāt ||

[58,11] upādānabhedāc ca deśabhede yad uktam upādānasahakāri-bhāvo 'vāntara iti,
tad apy ayuktam | yady api vikalpe pratibhāsamānau tāv upādānasahakāri-bhāvau bhinnāv iva na vastu, tathāpi vastunas tat-tad-vyāvṛttisambhvān nāvastavavyavasthā, anyānyāpekṣayā ca na virodhaḥ | yathaikasyānyāpekṣayā pitṛ-putratvasya na vāstavatvaṃ, na ca virodhaḥ | na ca rūpadvayena kāryadvayasya karaṇam, yena kalpanābhāsino rūpayor avāstavatvāt dvayākaraṇam | yathā caika-rūpeṇa dvayākaraṇaṃ tathā svopādeyaṃ svadeśe paropādeyaṃ ca paradeśe karotīti upādānabhedād upapanno 'pi deśabhedaḥ yataś ca nāropitasvabhāvabhedād eva deśabhedaḥ kāryasya, kiṃ tu svopādeyaṃ svasvadeśaṃ janayadbhir evārthād bhinnadeśaṃ sahakāryaṃ kāryam iti nyāyaḥ | tato na vikalpitasvabhāvabhedād eva bhinnakālakāryakaraṇam abhinnasya, bādhakasāmarthyena bhedasādhanāt | ata eva na sarvadeśasamānatvaṃ kāraṇasya | svasahakāry-upādeye hi sahakāritā asya, tasya ca kāryasya svopādānadeśa eva sambhavāt tatraiva asya sahakriyā-sāmarthyaṃ na deśāntara iti katham asya sarvaḥ samāno deśaḥ kutaścid upakārābhāve 'pi |

[58,24] yac coktam, kāryasyaiva sa kāla ādhāro niyamena, hetos tu sa cāsac ceti, tad api deśasāmyena pramsĀ p.15|7tihatam | tathā hi yathaikadeśastha eva hetur bhinnadeśāni kāryāṇi karoti, tathā ekakālasya eva binnakālāni kāryāṇi karotīty aprāpyaiva kāryakālaṃ deśavat | tataś ca kadācij jātanaṣṭo 'pi sahakāryapekṣayā sakalakālakalitāni kāryāṇi kuryād iti sthāne sambhūyaikārthakaraṇapratijñā-nirvāhaḥ |

[59,4] atha deśam api kāryasya prāpyaiva jananān na deśadṛṣṭāntasiddhir iti cet | na puruṣāntarbhuvo jñānasya deśaprāpter abhāvād dīpasya jñāādhikaraṇasyātmanaḥ pradīpasaṃyoge 'pi na jñānasukhādisambhavadeśe dehāntaḥprabhā-praveśāvakāśa iti kāśakuśāvalambanam etat | yaś cāyaṃ tad-deśatvasādhanas tatkāryatvahetur upanyastaḥ, sa na svatantraḥ, pratibandhābhāvād | bhāve 'pi nāsmākaṃ kṣitir ity uktam || na ca prasaṅgo bhavatum arhati, tatkāryatāyāḥ pramāṇasiddhitvena paropagamamātrābhāvāt, viparyayaparyavasāyitāvirahāc ca | tadā hi na ca tad-deśatvam atas tatkāryatvam api nāstīti syāt, na caivaṃ śakyam śakyatve 'pi nāsmākaṃ mūlaprasaṅgayoḥ kṣatiḥ | na coktadoṣaḥ, yato jananasāmarthyam anyadā propaganamātreṇaiva, na pramāṇāt | viparyaye ca ajananābhāvaḥ pramāṇasiddhiḥ kṣaṇāntare tatkārya(24b)-sāmarthyaṃ nivartayan jaladharasya anyakriyākriyā-pakṣayor dvayor api kṣaṇabhaṅgaṃ sādhayatīti sapakṣe bhāvān na viruddhaḥ sattvahetur iti ||

anvayādhikāro nāma dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ |

[tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ vyatirekādhikāraḥ]

[60,3] nāpy anaikāntikaśaṅkā, sarvopasaṃhāravatyā vyāpteḥ prasādhanāt | nanu viparyayabādhakapramāṇavaśād vyāptisiddhiḥ, tasya ca nopanyāsavārtā | tat kathaṃ vyāptiḥ prasādhitety ucyate | tad etad uparipariplivamānataralatarabuddhivilasitam | tathā hy uktam etat, kartuḥ sā na kriyā anyadāpi, kiṃ tu parakriyā akriyaiva vā | ata eva4 prakāradvaye 'pi kṣaṇabhaṅgasya saṅgatir avaśyam bhāvas tan-mātrānubandha iti yāvat tac ca prasādhitam ataḥ sādhyena vyāptaiva sā arthakriyāśaktir iti |

[60,9] nanv evam anvayamātram astu, vipakṣāt punar ekāntena vyatireka iti kathaṃ labhyam iti cet | vyāptisiddher eva | vyatireke vyāptisiddhir eva katham iti cet | na, dvividhā hi vyāptiḥ, anvaya-rūpā ca kartṛ-dharmaḥ sādhanavati dharmiṇi sādhyasyāvaśyam bhāvo yaḥ, vyatireka-rūpā ca karmadharmaḥ sādhyābhāve sādhanasyāvaśyam abhāvo yaḥ, vyāptir vyāpakasya tatra bhāva eva vyāpyasya vā tatraiva bhāva iti nyāyāt | enayoś caikasiddhir niyamena dvitīyapratītim ākṣipati | anyathā ekasyāpy asiddheḥ | kevalaṃ sākṣād ekatra pramāṇavyāpāro 'nyatra nāntarīyakatayā pratītir iti tāvataivaikavyapadeśaḥ | tathā ca saty ekatra pramāṇapravṛtteḥ pūrvam anyatra saṃśayaḥ pravartamāno 'pi paścāt anyā tayā nirasyate | yathā viparyayabādhakapramāṇavādinām anvayaḥ sandihyamāno 'pi vipakṣād ekāntena vyāvṛtti-balāt nirastasaṃśayaḥ paryavasyaty akṣaṇike sarvathā 'nupapadyamāneyaṃ sattā kṣaṇabhaṅganiyataiveti, evaṃ sattāvataḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ niyatasvabhāvabhedopasthāpanāt tad abhāve 'pi sattā-saṃśayakṣaṇaḥ pūrvapravṛtto 'pi svayam eva parigalati |

[60,20] kriyāvatā ced avaśyaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgureṇa bhāvyam, kṣaṇikatvavyatireke na bhavaty eva niyataṃ satteti | yadi tu tad abhāve 'pi syāt, tadā tasyāṃ satyāṃ niyamena kṣaṇikatvam ity anvayo 'pi katham | tasmāt sādhyābhāve sādhanasyaikāntiko vyatirekaḥ, sādhane sati sādhyasyāvaśyam anvayo veti na kaścid arthato bhedaḥ | pramāṇavyāpāras tu mukhyato 'rthataś ceti dvidhā vyavahāraḥ | ata eva yatra yatra sādhyaviparyaye bādhakapramāṇaparyeṣaṇā, tatra sādhane sati sādhyānvayaḥ, sādhakapramāṇaparyeṣaṇāpi tayopalakṣitā veditavyā | viparyayabādhakaśabdena punar ubhayasaṃgraha eva | vyatireka-rūpavyāptau hi sādhyaviparyaye bādhakaṃ sādhanasya, anvaya-rūpāyāṃ tu sādhyaviparyayasya bādhakaṃ sādhane satīti | tad ubhayābhāve sādhanasya sādhyapratibandhānupapattir ity ayam arthaḥ | anyathā vyatirekaniścāyakapramāṇasya sākṣād alābhe 'pi yadi sādhanasya sādhyenānvayaniyamaprasādhakaṃ pramāṇam upadarśayet, kas tasya sādhyasiddhau pratibandho vyatirekasyānvayasyāpi sāmarthyākṣepāt | anyathā sādharmyaprayogo 'nupādeya eva syāt, sākṣād vyatirekānupadarśanāt | tad yadi sāmarthyagamyo 'pi na vyatirekātmā, tadā 'pi yatra yatra sādhanaṃ tatra tatra sādhyam itīyataiva sādhane sati 1sādhyapratyāśā-prayuktaḥ kṛtīkṛtārthaḥ | tad abhāve 'bhāviny api hi sādhane sati yadi tadbhāve 'vaśyaṃ bhāvi sādhyaṃ tadā phalitaḥ sādhanasvīkāraḥ | tasmāt sādhanavādinā dvayam api paryeṣaṇīyaṃ vikalpena, vādinā caiko 'pi prakāraḥ pramāṇasiddha upadarśayitavyaḥ, parasādhaneṣu ca vyatirekavad anvayo 'pi niyamavān durlabha eveti veditavyam |
asmābhis tu prakṛtasādhane niyamavān anvayaḥ prasaṅgaviparyayābhāṃ paurastyābhyāṃ darśita eva, tau ca yady api sapakṣīkṛte jalabhṛti pravartitau, tathāpi yo yat karaṇasvabhāvaḥ sa taj janayaty eva, yo yan na janayati na sa tat karaṇasvabhāvaḥ, msĀ p.15|8 ity evaṃ pravartamānau sarvam eva kriyāśakti-yuktaṃ kṣaṇikatve niyataṃ darśayata iti sarvopasaṃhāro vyatirekākṣepabījaṃ dhūmādivat | yathā cādhyakṣaṃ dhūmasya, dhūmadhvajena vyāptiṃ pratiyato na vahner mahānase sattām anupasaṃhārat pratyeti, tathā jalabhṛti kṣaṇikatāṃ pratiyad eva yathoktānumānaṃ sāmānyena kriyāvataḥ sādhāraṇanyāyatayā kṣaṇikatayā vyāptim ātanotīti |

[61,24] yad ukataṃ prāg na sattvād anyad anumānasthirasiddhau yato 'navasthā na syād iti, tad apāstam yathoktaprasaṅgaviparyayor api tat-sādhakatvād iti |
yady evam anarthakaḥ sattvahetūpanyāsa iti cet | brūmaḥ | kiṃ hetv-antarasattā-mātreṇa bandhyaṃ sādhanāntaraṃ, uta pakṣīkṛte tasyāpy upanyāsāt, athopanyasituṃ śakyatvāt, yadi vāvaśyopanyasanīyatvāt, yad vā yad arthakāri tad avaśyaṃ kṣaṇikam iti vyāptisiddhau jaladharavat kṣitidharāder apy arthakāriṇaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhir iti pakṣāḥ |

[62,7] tatra prathas tāvat na yuktaḥ, anekasādhanasambhave 'pi vivakṣopanītasyaiva paropayogāt | ata eva śakyopanyāsatvam api nānarthakyahetuḥ, tādṛśasyāpy upanyāsāt prāg prāg albhyāt | sādhyadharmiṇy upanyāsaś cāsiddhau dṛṣṭāntadharmimātreupanyāsāt | ata eva pakṣe 'vaśyam upanyāsāpekṣāpy asiddhā, tadbalād vyāptisiddhau saṃś cāyaṃ capala-cāmara ity etāvataiva sādhyasiddheḥ | antimas tu doṣaḥ sarvatra sarvopasṃhāravatyāṃ vyāptau asiddhāyāṃ śaṅkām avakāśayati, na ca tatra viraryayabādhakasyāpi viśeṣaḥ, kevalaṃ sāmānyena kriyāvati kṣaṇabhaṅgitayā vyāpteḥ siddhe 'pi viśeṣe pravṛttyarthinaḥ sac cedam ity avaśyopanyāsanīyatvād iti kim atra nirbandhena |
nanu tathāpi dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇi tāvat tadanumānam avaśyāśrayaṇīyaṃ vyāptisādhanāya, (25b) tad eva ca kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanaṃ svadharmiṇaḥ, evaṃ sati sādhyadharmiṇy api tad-upanyasyaiva nirvṛtir ālambyatām, kim iyatā prayāsena vibhāgena tānumānāvatāraṇam | tena ca vyāptaṇ sattvaṃ pratītya sattvāt pakṣe kṣaṇabhaṅga iti |

[62,19] yady evaṃ viparyayabādhakapramāṇavādino 'pi samānaḥ paryanuyoga, tenāpi yad yadā yaj jananasvabhāvam ity-ādiprayogasya vyāptisiddhāv apekṣaṇāt, sādhyadharmiṇi sāmarthyānapāyāc ca tasya | tasmāt pratipattuḥ pravṛtti-bhedam āśrity vibhāgo 'tra kartavyaḥ, yo hi prativastu yo yaj jananasamarthaḥ ity-ādikam avatārayan kṣaṇikatā-parīkṣaṇakṣamaḥ, tasya tata eva kṣaṇabhṅgasiddhiḥ kim anyahetunā | evaṃ parapratipādane 'pi praty-ekavastuṣu tathaiva sādhayataḥ kṛtam anyahetūpanyāsena | yas tu tadapekṣayā pratibuddh-buddhiḥ sa ekatra tat-sādhanavyāpāreṇa nyāyena sarvasya kriyāvata iyam eva gatir iti kṣaṇikatayā tad-vyāptim anavadhārayan praty-ekaṃ tan nyāyāvatāraṇaprayāsam anāviśan neva yathā svayaṃ yaṃ yam arthakriyā-samarthaṃ paśyati, taṃ tam asthiraṃ sthāpayatīti sattvahetor upayogaḥ, tathā parapratipādane 'pi tan nyāyasiddhavyāptikaṃ sattvam eva vyāpārayatīti na doṣaḥ | tad atra prativastu tan nyāyāvatāraṇaprayāsaḥ asahya eva | agatikatayā tv ādyaḥ pratipattā tam evāśrayet | dvitīyas tu saprajñatayā ekatra pravṛttena tan-nyāyena jhaṭity eva kriyā-mātram asthairyaparatantram avadhārayan sattvenaiva param api pratipādayati, na tu tan-nyāyasya kvacit kriyā-vati kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanasāmarthyapratighātaḥ, nāpi sattvādisādhanabandhyataiva, sādhyadharmiṇyapravartitatan-nyāyapratyupanyāsād ity alaṃ bahunā |

[63,10] tad evaṃ vyāptir vyāpakasya vyāpyavati bhāva eveti kartṛ-dharmānvaya-rūpavyāptisampāditasāmarthyād eva sattvahetoḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhir apratihateti kim atra viparyaye bādhakapramāṇopanyāseneti samarthitam | ata eva tad upanyāsāśakyatāpi na pīḍayati, viparyayasyaiva bādhakena sādhyasya siddhatvāt | śāstre 'pi prathamaniyame ca vyāptir anvaya-rūpā bījādivad anekāntaparihāravyājena vistarataḥ prasādhitā | sphuṭataram anuddhedāt tu vyatireka-lakṣaṇāyāḥ parikaramātram etad āropayati loka iti ||

[63,16] atrāpi tīrthikavacanavikrānti-kṛtaṃ kautukam asti vyatireka-rūpāyām eva vyāptau | tadāpi nāpyekaiva vidhā 'nyadāpi kiṃ  tu parakṛd vā  bhavet sthirābhimatasyānyadā pūrvaṃ paścād veti kramanirdeśaḥ | naiva kriyā vā bhavet anyadā naivety avadhāraṇān na pūrvaṃ [: °ṇānuparve] nāpi paścāt kriyety akramanirdeśaḥ, yadi tu prāk paścād vā syāt kadācit kriyā, tadā krama evety asaṅkīrṇam anayor lakṣaṇam ākhyātaṃ bhavati | yady api caikasyā eva samasamayāṃ kriyām apekṣya yaugapadyaṃ bhinnasamayam apekṣya kramaḥ, tathāpy apekṣaṇīyabhedād asaṅkara eva pitāputravat | akriyāgrahaṇena ca vastvabhāva eva vā sarvathās tu, kriyāśūnyaṃ vā svarūpam avaśiṣyatāṃ matabhedena, nātra nirbandhaḥ | tatra nāpy ekaiveti pūrvaparayor ekatvamāmsĀ p.15|9travivakṣayā jātinirdeśaḥ, pūrvā parā vā punar ekānekā vā kriyā syāt | ekadā kriyāpekṣe vobhayam apy akramaśabdavācyatāṃ nātipatati  | tatrāpy anekakriyaiva tāttvikī, puñjātpuñjotpattes tāttvikatvāt | śaṅkāmātreṇānavaklṛptyā  vā ekakriyābhidhānam | ata eva yaugapadyaśabdena tasyāpy upalakṣaṇād akramasaṃgṛhīta evārtho yaugapadyapade 'py avagantavyaḥ  śāstre | etasya ca kāryagatasya prakāradvayasya kartuḥ kṣaṇabhaṅga eva saṅgatir ity atyantībhāvāvadhāraṇayā  vṛttyā nityād vyāvṛttir uktā | pradhānyena kṣaṇabhaṅgasaṅgatir ity akṣaraṃ tu nityād iva kṣaṇikād api sā vyāvṛttiḥ  śaknoti lakṣayitum | atha vā vyāpyasya vā tatraiva bhāva ity anukaraṇārtham | etena nityasya kramayaugapadyābhyām arthakriyāvirodhāt tal-lakṣaṇaṃ sattvam avahīyate, ataḥ kṣaṇikatva eva viśrāmyati tena vyāpyata iti kramayaugapadya-lakṣaṇavyāpakānupalambhād viparyaye bādhakāt sattvasyārthakriyāśakti-lakṣaṇasya kṣaṇikatvena vyāptisiddhir ity uktam bhavati |

[64,15] tatra kartṛ-dharmo yadārthakriyā, tadārthakriyā śaktir iti vā vyavahāra ekārthaḥ | kevalaṃ karmadharmasya kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ vyāptau kathaṃ kartṛ-dharmasya vyāptivyavahāra iti syād āśaṅkā | tatrāpi kramākramikakāryaviṣayatayā vyāpyamānā kāraṇaśaktiḥ kramākramavyāptety ucyate vyavahāra-lāghavārtham iti ||
etena kṛtvā karaṇa-lakṣaṇaṃ kramam āśritya kṣaṇikād ayaṃ kramo nivartayituṃ śakya ity asāraprabandhaṃ Trilocana-codyaṃ nirastam | arthakriyā-virodhād ity atra cārthakriyā kartṛdharma eva veditavyaḥ, tal-lakṣaṇaṃ sattvam iti vacanāt |
atha vā lakṣaṇam upalakṣaṇaṃ na svabhāva iti karmadharmo 'py astu | tad atra pakṣe kramākramābhyām upalakṣitārthakriyā nityasya virudhyata ity arthaḥ | prathamapakṣe tu kramākrameṇopalakṣitārthakāritvaṃ nityasya virodhīty arthaḥ | kramayaugapadyābhyām iti tu viśeṣaṇān na śeṣābhyanujñāśaṅkā, hetutvārtham upādānāt | yasmāt kramākramābhyām evārthakriyā tato nityasya virodhinī, kramākramātikramād ity arthāt ||

[65,3] kaḥ punar atra virodhaḥ | na tāvat sahānavasthānam ubhayo vastutvaprāpter nityaṃ sad eva syāt | nāpi dvitīyaḥ | nityaṃ hi tad-viparītenānityena virudhyeta iti cet |
pramāṇabalena nitye 'tyantaṃ tasyā bādhasādhanād virodha eva pramāṇāntarabādhād veti vacanāt | vastutas tu parasparaparihāra eva niṣṭhāsyati | kiṃ (26b) punaḥ pramāṇaṃ akṣaṇike 'rthakriyā-bādhakam iti cet | yad yat kram-yaugapadyavatyām arthakriyāyāṃ nopayujyate tan nārthakriyāśaktam, yathā haripadāravindam | nopayujyate ca nityābhimato bhāvaḥ kramākramadharmiṇi karmaṇi iti vyāpakānupalambhaḥ |
na hi kramākramābhām anyaḥ prakāro 'sti, yenārthakriyā-sambhāvanāyāṃ tābhyām avyāptir asyā bhavet | tasmād arthakriyā-mātrānubaddhatayā tayor anyatarasya prakārasya ubhayor abhāve cābhāvāt tābhyām asyā vyāptisiddhir iti pakṣī-kṛte tayor abhāve cārthakriyāśaktyabhāvasiddhau nānekāntas tāvat |

[65,15] tatra yat śaṅkaraḥ kramākramabhyām arthakriyā-niṣedhe prakārāntareṇa sambhāvayann āha, na ca tṛtīyasya prakārāntarasyābhāvasiddhiḥ, viśeṣaniṣedhasya śeṣābhyanujñā-viṣayatvād iti, tan nirastam | hetutvārthavacanena yat tūpalabhyasvabhāvatve nātyantābhāvasiddhir upalabhyasvabhāvatvād eva paṭādivat, anupalabhyasvabhāvatve tu nāsatt-niścayo viprakarṣiṇām iti kathaṃ prakārāntarābhāvaniścayas tan nimittāyogād iti viplavate | tatra yady ādaraḥ, hanta hataḥ prakāreyattā-paricchedadvāreṇa tattvavyavasthānanibandhanaḥ svargāpavargamārgānuṣṭhānabhedaḥ | yadā hi prakāradvaye tṛtīyaḥ śaṅkyate, traye caturthaś catuṣṭayādau pañcamādiḥ, tadā sarvatrānantaprakāratve prakāradvayatrayādiniyamakṛtaṃ tattvavyavasthānaṃ kutaḥ, yathā catvāri pramāṇāni, ṣaṭ padārthḥ | yadā ca pramāṇaprakāraśatam anyad api sambhāvyate, tadā caturbhir yan na siddhaṃ tad anyena siddhaṃ, catuḥ-siddhaṃ cānyena bādhitam iti kathaṃ tad-dvāreṇa tattvavyavasthitiḥ |

[66,1] evaṃ yadārthasahasre dravyādivyatirekiṇi sidhyati tattvapariniṣṭhāviplavāt kim abhyudayaniḥśreyasayor vānuṣṭeyam astu | kathaṃ cānityasya jñānakāritvākāritvapakṣau dūṣayitvā nirvṛtam anena svayam evaṃ prakāreṇa prakāraśatasya niṣeddham aśakyatvāt |

[66,4] kiṃ ca paśavo 'pi yad ayuktaṃ paśyanti na tadaiva tad ācarantīti katham anena sāhasam idam anuṣṭhitam | anupalabdher dṛśyaviśeṣaṇāpekṣābhyāṃ prakāradvaitaṃ niyamya kramākramābhyāṃ dvaitanirākaraṇaṃ nāma, prakārāntarasyopadarśayitum aśakyatvād iti tu kramākrame 'pi dvaitavādināṃ nāśakyam | tasmāt kim apy ayaṃ jalpamahodadhinām aparipuṣṭaye viceṣṭām, ekaniṣedhenāparavidhāne tāvad aśamsĀ p.15|10kyābhidhānaḥ prakārāntarasambhavaḥ |

[66,9] kiṃ ca ekakālakriyānantaraṃ kriyāntarasya bhāve kramavyavahāro 'bhāve cākrama iti bhāvābhāvayor api tṛtīyaśaṅketi mahat-tārkikatvam, tad alaṃ nirbandhena | sthitam etat kramākramābhyām arthakriyāśakter vyāptir eveti |
yad api Trilocanaḥ kaścit sahakāripratyayaḥ pratyakṣaḥ | parokṣaś cetaraḥ | (27a) tataḥ pratyakṣaparokṣasahakāripratyayasākalyam asarvavidā pratyakṣato na śakyaṃ pratyetum | tatha ca sati sādṛśasahakāripratyayasākalyavataḥ kramayaugapadyasyātyantaparokṣatvāt tena vyāptaṃ sattvam api parokṣam eveti kathaṃ pratibandhaḥ pratyakṣeṇa sidhyatīty āha, tad api nirupayogam | kāryadharmau hi kramākramau pratipāditau | tataḥ kāraṇasāmagryāḥ sākalyāsākalyaniścayābhāve 'pi kramayaugapadyaniyamaḥ kāryāṇām adhyakṣagocara eva | ekadaiva kāryotpattir anyadāpi neti katham agocaraḥ pratyakṣasya | tadāpi hi kāryam ekam anekaṃ vā syāt | pratyakṣeṇa vā tathā gṛhītam anekasambhave 'pi caikaṃ gṛhītam astu, sarvathā kramākramābhyām eva vyāptā kāryaniṣpatir iti siddham etat |

[66,21] nanu kṣaṇabhaṅgapakṣe nārthakriyā-pratītiḥ, nāpi kramākramapratītir iti kathaṃ vyāptivyavasthā tathā ca śaṅkaraḥ, kṣaṇikatve sati sarvasaṃvittīnāṃ svabhāvaniyamena hetuphalayoḥ svarūpānvayavyatirekāsiddhau sarvatra tadbhāvasyāvagantum aśakyatvāt, na hi kāryasaṃvittyā tasya hetu-bhāve bhāvaḥ pratīyate, tadā tasya hetor atītatvāt | nāpi hetu-saṃvittyā kāryasya tadbhāve 'vasīyate, tadā tasyānupapatter eva, na cātītānāgatayor vartamānena siddhir atiprasaṅgāt |

[67,2] nāpi kāryasaṃvittyaiva hetu-svabhāvasaṃvittiḥ, adṛṣṭānvayavyatirekasyāpi dhūme 'gni-janyatvaviniścayaprasaṅgāt | etena hetu-mātrasaṃvittyā kāryasaṃvittir apāstā | hetu-vyatireke tu kāryavyatirekaḥ svasaṃvittivādino manorathasyāpy aviṣayaḥ, tasya hetv-abhāve kāryābhāvapratipattāv upāyāsambhavāt | na hi tac ca nāsti tena [ca] pratipattir iti nyāyyam | tad ayaṃ kāryasya hetu-sadbhāve bhāvaṃ tadabhāve cābhāvaṃ pratipadyanāno 'vasthitaṃ pratisandhātāraṃ prasādayatīti | evaṃ ca yady avasthi-kartṛ-siddhiḥ, tadā sādhāraṇānaikānta eva maulaḥ sattvahetuḥ, kim atra viparyayabādhakapramāṇopanyāsaḥ kariṣyati |tad aniṣṭau tu vyāptigrahānupapatteḥ sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvam ubhayor api | yathā kramiṇi hetuphale pratyetum aśakye evaṃ phale apīti na kramapratītiḥ, nāpi yaugapadyasya |
yathāha sa eva, nāpi yaugapadyasya, bhinākāreṇa jñānena pratiniyatākāraṇāṃ yaugapadyasyāśakyasādhanatvāt | na tāvadbhir eva jñāne yaugapadyaṃ pratyetavyam, teṣām itaretarāsaṃvedyatve santānāntaravat yugapad bhāvasyāsiddheḥ | na caikam anekākāram, svabhāvabhūtākārabhede bhedasyāvaśyaṃ bhāvitvāt | bhede tu vijñānasyākārebhyo 'rthāntaratvaprasaṅge na viṣayasya tad-ākāratvaṃ samarthitaṃ bhaviṣyatīti |

[67,17] atrocyate, pratisandheyābhimatābhir buddhibhir bhedābhedavikalpākṣamatvāt | abhede (27b) hi sa eva vā syād buddhaya eva vā | atra ca prathamapakṣe karmaṇaḥ, pakṣāntare kartur abhāvāt kaḥ pratisandhānārthaḥ | bhede 'pi buddhibhyo bhidyamānasya jaḍasya kaḥ pratisandhānārthaḥ | buddhi-yogād draṣṭṛ-vat pratisandhātṛtvam iti cet | buddhir eva tarhi draṣṭrī pratisandhātrī ceti niyatasvīkāre tad-yogād anyasya tathātvam iti kim anena yācitakamaṇḍanena | buddhīnāṃ kartṛtvābhāvād iti cet | tad-dvāreṇāpi tarhi tasyātmano draṣṭṛtvādivyavahārānupapattiḥ | yadi hi buddhir hetoḥ phalasya vā draṣṭrī syāt, taānantaryapratiniyamasya cānusandhātrī kalpikā, tad-yogāt tasya draṣṭṛtvaṃ pratisandhātṛtvaṃ cocyata iti syād api | prativiṣayam alabdhaviśeṣāyāṃ ca buddhau sambandho 'pi na viśeṣaṃ vyavahārayitum īśaḥ, adhunā nibandhanādhigantā, adhunā phalasya, idānīṃ pratisandhāteti | tathā-vidhabuddhigataviśeṣasvīkāre tu kim apareṇa kartavyam tāvataiva paryāptavād vyavahārasya | sthirātmānam antareṇa saiva buddhir na syād iti cet |

[68,5] kenaivaṃ pratārito 'si | aho mohamāhātmyaṃ yadīdṛśān api paravaśī-karoti | tathā hi nedam idam antareṇeti yad ucyate tat khalv anyatra pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ sāmarthyāvadhāraṇe sati yujyate, vahner iva dhūme | cakṣur-ādivat vā dṛṣṭakāraṇasāmagrye kāryādarśane paścād darśane ca kiñcid anyad apekṣaṇīyam astīti sāmānyākāreṇa | ādyaḥ pakṣas tāvan nāstīti vyaktam | dvitīyo 'pi na sambhavī | na hi kāraṇabuddhisamanantaraṃ kāryabuddhau satyāṃ niścayapravṛttasya idam asyānantaraṃ drṣṭaṃ mayeti pratisandhānam adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ, kadācid, yato 'nyasya sāmarthyaparikalpanaṃ syāt | evaṃ smaraṇam apy anubhavāt kutaścit paramparayā śaktipariṇāmadvāreṇa, kutaścit tat paripākabalād iti |

anyasyānubhave tarhi katham anyasya na smṛtiḥ |
anyasyeti na sambandhī siddhaś codyaṃ kim īdṛśam ||

anubhavādibhyo bhinnasambandhisiddhyadhikaraṇavivādaprakrame tam eva siddham āsthāya paryanuyoga ity asambaddham etat | tat-siddhau hi vivādaparyavasānāt kā parāpekṣā | tasmād anyasyeti vivādapadatvād apanīyānubhave kathaṃ na smṛtir iti pariśiṣyamāṇaṃ na prakṛtopayogi | evaṃ tu yujyate codyārthaḥ | yad dehasambaddho 'nubhavas tad anyatra dehe kasmān na smṛter udaya iti | evaṃ ca vadatā yat kṣetrasambandhi bījaṃ tad anyatra kṣetre kiṃ nāṅkura-janmety uktaṃ bhavati | sa ca kutastyo nyāyaḥ |

[68,21] nanu kāryakāraṇabhāvamātrād anubhavasmaraṇayor na kācid aparā pratyāsattiḥ, na ca kāryakāraṇabhāve 'yaṃ niyamo, yadādhāram eva kāraṇaṃ tadādhāram eva kāryam iti viṣayād atyantadūre 'pi jñānakāryadarśanāt | evaṃ tarhi nāṅkurasyāpi kāryatā-mātrād aparā pratyāsattir iti jñānam ivāṅkuraṃ dūre 'pi bījaṃ janayet |
nanu bījārambhiṇaḥ (28a) eva paramāṇavaḥ kecid aṅkure samavāyi-kāraṇatā pratipādyāmānāḥ kathaṃ kṣetrāntare 'ṅkuram utpādayitum īśate | bhavatas tu tathā-vidhapratyāsattivirahāt | vijñānādinā sādhāraṇaṃ kāryatvam asyeti dūre 'pi jananaprasaṅgo 'nivārya iti cet |

[69,2] kasmāt punar aṅkura eva kārye bījaparmāṇavaḥ samavāyi-kāraṇatāṃ pratipadyate na jñānādau, kāryatvena sarveṣām eka-rasatvāt | tataḥ sarveṣām aṅkuravat tad-deśa eva jñānaṃ, jñānādivad vāṅkurasyāpi dūre jananaṃ, kāryatvenāviśeṣāt, tad-vad evāṅkure 'pi nimittakāraṇatvād bījasya |

[69,6] nanu yatraiva kārye bījaparamāṇavaḥ samavāyikāraṇatāṃ pratipadyante sa evāṅkuraḥ, tat katham aṅkurād anyatra teṣāṃ samavāyi-kāraṇatā codyate | evaṃ tarhi kāryatvenaika-rasatayā samavāyi-kāraṇatāyā duṣpariharatvād aṅkuraika-rūpatvaṃ sarveṣām ekadeśatā ca prasahyāyāteti sthāne phalitaṃ parihārapratyāśayā | yadi ca kāryatvena sarveṣām aviśeṣaḥ kāryāṇām, kāraṇānām api sarveṣāṃ kāraṇatvenāviśeṣa iti viśvasya vaicitram atrāṇam | tasmāt kāryatve saty api na rītir ekaiva sarveṣām iti |

[69,11] yathā nisargabhedāt kvacit kiñcit samavāyi-kāraṇatvena kvacid asamavāyi-kāraṇatvena kvacin nimittakāraṇatvenopayujyate bhavataḥ, tathāsmākam api kiñcit kāryaṃ samānadeśam eva hetur utpādayati,kiñcid vyavahitadeśam, kāryaṃ kiñcin niyamena hetu-deśa evotpattidharmakaṃ kiñcid anyathā | tathaikatra kārye pratyabhijñāsambhavo nānyatra kāryatvāviśeṣe dīpāntaravat jñānavac ca | tādṛk kāryāpekṣayā ca yatra bhavataḥ samavāyi-kāraṇavyavasthā, tatropādānakāraṇavyavahāro 'smākam ātmāder anyatra | tathā-vidhi-hetuphalaparamparāyāṃ ca ekatra santānavyavasthānam anyatra sahakāritvamātram iti prakriyā-bhede 'pi kāryadvaitaṃ tādṛg nisargasiddham astīti bhavato 'py aśakyam atikramitum iti sthitam etat | tathā-bhūtabhedasambhave ca yat kāryakaraṇādhikaraṇa evotpattidharmakaṃ tatkatham itaratrotpadyate | kāraṇaṃ vā svādhikaraṇa eva śakyotpādanaṃ kāryaṃ katham anyatra janayet | tad ayam anubhave 'pi svādhikaraṇa-janyaṃ smaraṇam aṅkuram iva bījāt katham anyatrotpādayet | smṛtir vānubhavādhikaraṇaniyatotpattir aṅkuravat katham anyatrotpadyeta, yato dehāntare smaraṇaprasaṅgaḥ codyam avakāśam āsādayet | ātmavāde tu duṣpariharam etat, vyāpinas tasya tenaiva smṛti-janana-rūpeṇa dehāntare 'pi sthānāt | adṛṣṭāśrayaṇaṃ ca nityasyaiveti | bījāṅkuravad anubhavasmaraṇayor nyāyo nānyavad iti katham avagantavyam iti cet |

[70,1] bījāṅkurayor api sa nyāyas tathā-darśanād evāvasīyate, tathā niyamadarśanaṃ cānubhavasmaraṇayor apy asti, na hy anyadehe 'nubhavavati (28b) anyamūrtiḥ smṛtimatī nāma |

[70,3] nanu dehaḥ katham anubhavavān | tad-ādhāratayā tat kāraṇatayā tena saha samānakāraṇatayā vā sambandhavivakṣāstīti na kṣati | kiṃ cātmano 'pi katham anubhavavattvam | samavāyabalād iti cet |
nanu samavāyo 'pīheti buddhi-hetur iṣyamāṇa iheit buddhinibandhanakalpana eva | asti ceha śarīre buddhiḥ, ataḥ kiṃ na samavāyakalpanāpi | ayutasiddhatvābhāvāt śarīrabhddhyoḥ pṛthag eva pratīyamānatvād iti cet |
nanu pṛthak-pratīyamānayor ihedam iti pratītiniyamaḥ, uparyadho bhāvena hi bhāvadvaye paridṛśyamāne parasparāsaṅkareṇa saptamī-prathamayor nirdeśa upapadyeta, yadā tu pṛthag-darśanam eva nāsti tadā katham ihedam iti bhedena nirdiśan prekṣā-vattāyā na hīyate | samavāyaviṣaye kvacid api bhedasyādṛṣṭer iti cet |
ata eva svayam iheti buddhiṃ vikalpamātratvena icchayānirvartanayogyām utpādya samavāye nāma kalpyate | iheti buddheḥ samavāyasiddhir iheti dhīś ca dvaya- darśane syāt | na ca kvacit tad-viṣaye dvayekṣā svakalpanā-mātram ato 'bhyupāyaḥ ||
tena cāsaṃvidyamānasyaivātmano buddhimattā-vyavahāra iti bandhyā-putreṇa turgaśṛṅgasya kholighaṭanavṛtāntam anuharati | yat khalu yāvatopayogena kalpitaṃ tāvata upyogasya anyena siddhir eva tasyābhāvaḥ, siddhaś cātmano 'pi smṛtyādy upayogo 'nyateti | tasmāt naikakāyastho 'nubhavaḥ kāyāntare smaraṇakaraṇāya prabhavati |

[70,19] nanu kṣaṇikatve dehāntare eva smṛter udayāt kathaṃ idaṃ śakyaparihāram, janmāntaraparigrahe vā tataḥ santānāntaratvenābhimate 'pi deha kiṃ na prasaṅgo 'nyatvasyāviśeṣād iti cet | īdṛśaṃ dehāntare smṛti-jananam ātmano 'pi duṣpariharam, tato 'nyatrāpi tat-prasaṅgo 'nyatvasyāviśeṣād iti samānam | yady api ca kāyasya kṣaṇikatvaṃ neṣṭam, āśu-nāśitvaṃ punas tair iṣṭam eva, tataḥ samāno doṣo yad bhayād-ātmavādasvīkāraḥ | athātmavāde tasyātmanaḥ karmaṇābhisaṃskṛta eva dehe smṛti-jananam iti na doṣaḥ, nairātmyavāde tu kasya tat karma | śārīrātiriktā hi buddhir eva kṣaṇikā sambhavati | ata eva ca na kartṛ-kṣaṇasya tatkarmasukhaduḥkhādi saṃvartanīyam, tasya tad upabhogābhāvāt | yasya ca kṣaṇasyopabhogaḥ so 'karteti kṛtanāśākṛtābhyāgamadoṣas tv atirikto bhavatu, na tu kasyacit karmasiddhir yataḥ prakṛtadoṣaparihāraḥ syāt | na ca santāno 'pi gīyamāno bhinnaḥ kaścid asti | na ca karmāpi bhinnaṃ bhavatām astīty abhitti citrakarmaṃ ||

[71,5] atrocyate | kartṛ-kṣaṇasya tāvat tatkarma tat-phalopabhogābhāve 'pi nāpahnavasaham | na hi dāhādikam akurvatopāditvena(29a) vahninā tad-vān na bhavati naraḥ | antimakṣaṇasyāpi tatkarmopakārakatayā sambadhyate pramparayā, tata evopabhogabhāgitvāt | ekakālatā tu kāryakāraṇayor api na sambhavati, sambhavati ca meru-mandarayoḥ | tasmād upakāradvārakam eva bhede tasyedam iti ghaṭanam, sa copakāro 'ntimasya tatkṛto mahān asti, tan madhyavartināṃ ca tat-santānavartināṃ kṣaṇāṇāṃ tādṛg-antimakṣaṇaprasūtisāmarthyaṃ sākṣāt paramparayā vā, tata eva karmaṇa ity upakāradvāraka eva teṣām api tat-sambandhaḥ | evaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ karmasambandhavyavasthitau sthitāyāṃ tatkarmādhipatyenopanīyamāna eva śarīre tatkarmābhisambhūtānāṃ buddhidehakṣaṇānām udayaḥ, nānyatra tādṛk pratyāsatter abhāvāt | karma ca kāmaṃ na bhinnam asti vyatirekīva nirdeśo 'pi vyavahārānurodhena | yas tu prāktanaḥ karmasambaddha ity ucyate kṣaṇaḥ, sa tādṛg viśeṣabhūto jātaḥ, yataḥ paryante tat-phalopabhoktṛ-kṣaṇaprasavasamarthasantānasambhavaḥ, tadanurūpaśarīrasantatisambhavaś ca | tatrādyād viśiṣṭād yau buddhidehakṣaṇau alpatamaviśeṣayogināv upajātau sambhūyottarāv alpataraviśeṣau janayataḥ, tau cālpaviśeṣāv uttarau janayata ity anayā diśā tāvac chakti-lakṣaṇaviśeṣaprakarṣastaratamādi-bhāvenopacīyate yāvad antima-jananasamarthodayas tato 'ntima iti | ekasāmagryadhīnatayā parasparānubaddhyor buddhidehayor anyaparamparāṃ prati viśiṣṭayor naikavyatirekeṇa dvaitīyikaśaṅkāvakāśaḥ | janmāntaraparigrahe 'pi tad-āyuḥ-saṃskārakṣīṇe kṣīyamāṇamūrti-kṣaṇāntarasahakāriṇā manaḥ-kṣaṇena janitaṃ tasyānurūpaṃ vapur anyat pūrvavan manasaḥ sāhāyakam ātanotīti na dehāntare smṛti-bhoktṛtva-cintāvakāśaḥ | na cātra santānanāmnā bhinnena kiñcit, kṣaṇānāṃ karmasambandhasiddhidvāreṇaiva santāne 'pi siddher apratibandhāt, tebhyas tasya vyatirekāt | na ca mukhyataḥ santānadvāreṇa siddhāntopakramaḥ, kiṃ tu kṣaṇadvāreṇeti sarvam avadātaṃ mūlapariśodhanād iti || yad uktam,

yasminn eva hi santāne āhitā karmavāsanā |
phalaṃ tatraiva badhnāti karpāse raktā yathā ||

iti, tat svābhimatasantāna-lakṣaṇaprasiddhau ||
yat tu nyāyabhūṣaṇakāra etad dūṣayānn āha | na, sādhanadūṣaṇāsambhavāt, anvayādy abhāvān na sādhanam | na hi kāryakāraṇabhāvāt smṛiḥ karpāse raktādivad ity anvayaḥ sambhavati | nāpi yatra na smṛtiḥ tatra na kāryakāraṇabhāva iti vyatireko 'sti | asiddhatvādyanudbhāvān na dūṣaṇam | na hi ūrvabuddhyanubhūte 'rthe uttarabuddhīnāṃ sambhavati, tato 'nyatvāt santānāntarabuddhivad ity asya hetoḥ karpāse raktā-vad ity anena na kaścid doṣaḥ pratipādyata (29b) iti |

[72,12] tad asamīkṣyābhidhānam, sādhanārthāparijñānāt | na hīha śloke kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ smṛtau hetutvenopanyastah pratīyate | kiṃ tarhi | karmavāsanā | vāsanā hi karmaṇābhisaṃskāraḥ | vasitaṃ hy abhisaṃskṛtam ucyate | karmakṛto viśeṣo yatra santāne utpāditas tatraiva bhogādiphalabandho, nānyatra | yatra nāsau viśeṣa iti pratijñāya karpase raktā yathā iti vadataḥ saṃskārasantānabhedo vā hetur abhipretaḥ, sādhyaṃ cātra bhogādiphalaniṣedhaḥ, tat-santāne tat-phalayogyatā ca pratīyate | tad ayaṃ prayogaḥ,
yo yaḥ saṃskāraḥ kvacit santāne āhitaḥ sa tatraiva phaladānayoggyo nānyatra | yathā karpāsasantane bījāvasthāyāṃ rāgadravyayoga-janitaḥ puṣpāvasthāyāṃ phalāvasthāyāṃ vā rāgaṃ phalam unmīlayituṃ yogyo nānya- santāne |

saṃskāraś cāyaṃ dānādi-karma-janitaś cittasantāna

iti | svabhāvahetur eva samudāyasādhyāpekṣayā | saṃskāramatrānubandhinī hi tat-santāne phaladānayogyatā anyasantāne sarvathā tadayogyatā ceti nimittāntarānapekṣaṇāt | ekaikasādhyatve tu prathame svabhāvahetuḥ | dvitīye tu viruddhavyāptopalabdhiḥ, svādhārād anyasantāne phaladānaviruddhena svādhārasantāna eva phaladānena vyāptasya saṃskāratvasyopalabdheḥ | tatra yadi saṃskāre 'pi sati tatra santāne phaladānayogyatā nimittāntaram apekṣeta, prayatnena saṃskāraghaṭanam anarthakaṃ syāt | anyasantāne 'pi phaladānasāmarthye ca dvitīyaprayatnavaiyarthyam | na caikāmalakyāṃ kṣīraāvaseke sarvāmalakī madhuraphalā | tasmāt svasantāna eva phaladānena vyāptiḥ saṃskārasyeti nānekāntaḥ | saṃskāraś ca karmakṛto viśeṣaś cetasa ity āgamasiddham abhyupagamyaiva codyavat samādhānam apīti nāsiddhiḥ | sapakṣe bhāvān na virodho vyāptyasiddher vā | atha vā, yo yaḥ santānaḥ sa svādikaraṇa eva saṃskāre saṃskāre phaladānayogyo yathā karpāsasantānaḥ, santānaś cāyaṃ cittasantāna iti pūrvavat ||

[73,9] smṛtyādiphalāpekṣayā 'py ayam eva nyāyaḥ | yadi santānadvāreṇāyaṃ vyavasthā, tadā vidyāyonisambandhaprasidde 'pi santāne prasaṃgaḥ | tato guruṇānubhūtādau śiṣyasya smṛty-ādiḥ syāt, evaṃ pitur-anubhavādau putrasya bhavet | naitādṛśaḥ santāno 'tra vivakṣitaḥ upādānopādeyabhūtahetuphalaparamparā-rūpaḥ | kiṃ punar upādānopādeya-lakṣaṇam | ekādhāratāniyamo 'sati vicārakāraṇe, vicāre 'pi tad-yogyatāniyamaḥ | vicitrā hi kāryakāraṇaparamparopapāditā pūrvam, tatraivaṃ lakṣaṇā paramparā santāna ucyata ity api sūcitam eva | na caivaṃ guru-śiṣya-cetasoḥ pitā-putramanasor vā astīti nātiprasaṅgadoṣo Nyāyabhūṣaṇīyaḥ | santānopādānavyavasthyor vānyonyāśrayadoṣaḥ, upādānavyavasthāyās tad nāśrayatvapratipādanāt |

[73,18] atha vā abhrānta-(30a)saṃmataikāvasāyaḥ prakṛtivikriye ubhau hetuphalasyopādānopādeya-lakṣaṇam | hetuphalasantatau idam upādānam idam upādeyam iti pratyabhijñā-pratyayena lakṣitaṃ veditavyam | visabhāgotpattau tu prakṛtir-upādānasya vikṛtir upādeyasya lakṣaṇaṃ svabhāva eva | prakṛtivikṛtitvaṃ vā lakṣaṇam iti bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ, kāṣṭhayūpavat kāṣṭhāṅgāravac ca | anekotpattāv api bhinnā eva bhāgā upādānam | yathā dhūme uṣmādīnām aṅgārāṇām, buddhāv apy ekapuruṣaprajñaptir ekāvasāyaḥ | asti ca viṣayoparāgaṃ vivecya caitanyamātram āmṛśata ekapuruṣābhimatāyāṃ santatau saiveyaṃ buddhir ity avasāyaḥ | te punar atrāśeṣasvarūpānanukārāt, anukārasambhave 'pi stabāntaravad ekāvasāyo bhrānta iti na pitā-putrādāv upādānādivyavasthā | tad evaṃ upādānādi-lakṣaṇam anapekṣya tādṛk-santatau upādānādivyavasthāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ kīdṛśe santāne āhitā karmavāsaneti jijñāsāyāṃ yatropādānādivyavastheti bhaṇitau na doṣaḥ |

[74,4] yat punar ayam evāha | na, sambandhaviśeṣābhāve kāraṇamātraviśeṣād upādānetaravibhāgānupapatteḥ, yathāsmākaṃ janakatvāviśeṣe 'pi samavāyyasamavāyinimittakāraṇavibhāgaḥ sambandhaviśeṣāt, na tathā tava kāraṇānām upādānetaravibhāgaṃ paśyāma iti |
etad api dūṣitam eva, kāraṇatvasāmānye 'pi kāryāpekṣayā vibhāgasya darśitatvāt | kāryakāraṇayor anyonyaviśeṣānapekṣaṇe hi sambandhadvāreṇāpi vyavasthādausthyam āpāditam | na ca samavāyaḥ kṣama ity api leśena sūcitam eva | tasmān na saṃskārasantānayor dūṣaṇaṃ kiñcit |

[74,11] yady api cātra śloke karmavāsanāśabdaḥ prayukto na cāsyārthaḥ karpāsam anveti, tathāpi vāsanārtho 'bhisaṃskāras tāvad anvetīti sa eva hetuḥ sūcito grāhyaḥ | atha vā karmaśabdenāpi kriyā | yatra santāne yayā kayācit kriyayā kṛto 'bhisaṃskāra ity arthaḥ | etena vyāptipradarśanam, pakṣadharmas tu prastāvād boddhavyaḥ | tataḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ sākṣāt tataḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ sākṣāt smṛtau pratipādakam ādāya yad uktaṃ tat-sarvaṃ viplutam, kāryakāraṇabhāvāśrayaviśeṣānvayinī tu smṛtir ity anavadyam |
yat punar asya sādhanaṃ na pūrvabuddhyānubhūte 'rthe uttarabuddhīnāṃ smṛtir bhavaty anyatvāt, santānāntarabuddhivad iti, tatrottarabuddhīnāṃ dharmiṇīnāṃ bhinnasmṛtirūpabuddhisambandho niṣidhyata uta smṛtirūpatvam eva tāsāṃ vāryate, atha smṛtyā phalavaty astā na bhavatīti pratipādyate | prathamapakṣas tāvad ayuktaḥ | na hy smṛtir anyā ca smṛtimatī matir iṣyate asmābhir yan niṣedhaḥ syāt, api tu smṛtirūpaiva sā matir iti |
athāśvasya smarato gavekṣaṇakāle tad-darśanaṃ smṛtimad bhavatīti cet |
tat kiṃ tadavasthāyā eva smṛtter niṣedho (30b) vivakṣitaḥ | kevalā tu yadi smṛtir bhavati tadā bhavatu | naivaṃ cet | kim anena tarhi uttarabuddhīnām iti sahacāranirdeśena |
athānumānārthaṃ dharminirdeśa eva iti cet | na, prakṛtābhimatasākalyasiddheḥ sarvathottarakālaṃ smṛtiniṣedhasyeṣṭatvāt pakṣaikadeśāsiddhiḥ sādhanasya |

[75,1] athāśaktidarśāyāṃ kevalasmṛti-kāle niṣedho neṣṭa eva | tarhi vinātmānam uttarakālaṃ smṛtisambhave buddhyantarasahacārakālena kim aparāddhaṃ yat tatraiva niṣedhaḥ | nāpi vyāptiviṣaye kiñcid asti bādhakam |
dvitīyapakṣe tu uttarabuddhīnāṃ smṛtitvaniṣedhe kim anubhavasyaiva smṛtitvam atha pūrvabuddhīnām | sarvathā niṣedhe tu kiṃ viśeṣanirdeśeneti pūrvavat |

[75,6] tṛtīye tu vikalpe evam eva viśeṣanirdeśavaiyarthyaṃ samarthanīyam | atha viśeṣanirdeśasyopalakṣaṇatvāt sarvaivānubhavād anyā buddhir na smṛtirūpā, nāpi smṛtim utpādayati ity abhimatam | anubhavasya na hi tathātvaṃ niṣiddham, tato 'nubhavaḥ smṛtirūpaḥ smṛtiṃ cotpādayatīty ubhayam apy aniṣṭam āsaktam | anyathā 'nubhavād anyatayā viśeṣaṇam anarthakam | anarthakam evāstu, sarveṣām eva jñānānāṃ tadāpy anubhavād anyatvaṃ hetuḥ pakṣaikadeśāsiddhaḥ, anubhavasyaiva tadanyathābhāvāt |
athottaragrahaṇaṃ vivādapadatvena na tv anyavyavacchedena, anyāsāṃ tu buddhīnāṃ bauddhenāpi smṛti-bhāvāniṣṭeḥ | tathāpi tṛtīyapakṣe nedam uttaram, anubhavasyāpi vivādapadatvāt | nairātmyapakṣe hy anubhavo 'pi sākṣāt smṛtim utpādayatīty aniṣṭam eva bhavataḥ | bauddhasya punar iṣṭam | tad ayam anubhavasya smṛti-janakatvaṃ na svīkartuṃ śakto 'priyatvāt, na parihartum, hetoḥ pakṣaikadeśāsiddher iti |

[75,16] astu caivam ubhayapakṣe 'pi tu vyāptir na śakyā | tathā hi yasyā uttarabuddheḥ smṛtitvaṃ smṛti-janakatvaṃ veṣyate, tasyā yadi tad ubhayaprāptav anubhavād anyatvahānir upapādayituṃ pāryate na paryavasyatu vyāptis tad anyatvasya tad-ubhayaniṣedhena | na caivaṃ śakyam | anubhavād anyatvahānāv anubhavatvam eva, tac ca kathaṃ smṛtitve vaktum śakyam | smṛti-janakatve ca tad ucyamānam anubhavasya smaraṇahetutvam anapīya na viśramyati | pratibandhasiddhau hi prasaṅgasaṅgatiḥ | evam uttarakālabhāvitvādayo 'pi nāśaṅkyāḥ, śakyapratīkaratvāt tad-vad eva | anekāntas tu hetu-doṣo vyāpter abhāvāt | tasmād yadi codya-cuñcutāyāṃ bharas tadaivaṃ brūyāḥ |
anubhavamātrāt karmamātrād vā smaraṇabhogādi janyaṃ cet | bhinnasantāne 'pi janmaprasaṅgaḥ, na cābhimate 'pi | yad yenāviśiṣṭasāmarthyāsāmarthyaṃ tat tenāviśiṣṭaphalāphalatvam, yathā bījorvī-jala-jvalanapavanādisāmagrī-dvayam | aviśiṣṭasāmarthyāsāmarthyṃ ca santānadvayam anubhavād apīti svabhāvahetuḥ | atra ca siddhiḥ yasminn eva hi ity-ādinā darśitaiva, karmavāsanā (31a) ity-ādinā karpāsavat saṃskāraviśeṣasya vyaktam uktatvāt | yathā prathamaṃ prathitam asmābhiḥ | evam anubhavāt smṛtir iti samānanyāyam |

[76,5] atha vā pūrvoktahetāv ayaṃ paryanuyogaḥ, kim anubhavasmaraṇāder eva paramparayā hetuphalasaṃmatasyāyaṃ nyāyo 'nyatvān na jananam iti, athānyasyāpi yadi tāvat prakṛtasyaivāyaṃ yautuka-labdho nyāyaḥ tadā yuktiḥ kācid abhidīyatām, yataḥ sāmānyasiddhaṃ kramam-atikramyāyam atra viśeṣo gamyeta | santānāntarare 'darśanād iti cet | yad viśeṣaparamparayā jananam anyatve tad abhāve tad adarśanaṃ bhavet, yathāraktabījakarpāse raāgādarśanam | na ca tāvatā sarvatrājananam iti śakyam ||
dvitīyapakṣe tv asiddher udbhāvanam etat | rakte bīje 'nyasyāpi tat-santānabhuvaḥ puṣpasya phalasya vā tat-phala-rāgadarśanāt | yat punaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvena smṛtim āśaṅkya nānātvasyāvañcanād ity uktam, atrāpi trapā tapasvinī ekataḥ kṣiptā tad-vacanena, yadi saṃskṛtakarpāse kāryaṃ vāryeta sarvaṃ śobhate | tad ayaṃ sāmānyasiddho nyāyaḥ | pṛthaktve 'pi viśeṣāntarāpekṣaṃ phalam ekatra santāne bhavati nānyatreti prakṛte 'pi vārayitum aśakyaḥ | ślokena cānena sādhanaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ vā sampāditam ity āstāṃ tāvat | tat siddham avasthitaikābhāve 'py anubhavabhāvitasantānasaṃskāreṇa smaraṇam | na ca pratyakṣeṇānubhavasmaraṇayoḥ kvacid ekādharatvaṃ dṛṣṭam |

[76,19] yad apy atroktam, na, dṛṣṭatvāt | tathā hi pūrvaṃ yam artham evānubhūtavān ahaṃ tam etarhi smarāmi, yo 'ham anubhavitā so 'haṃ smarteti anubhavasmaraṇayor abhinnādhāratvaṃ liṅgasambandhasmṛtyanapekṣam āptopadeśānapekṣaṃ ca niścinoti | na ceyaṃ bhrāntir visaṃvādābhāvāt | sukhāder api pratyakṣatvam apahnavāno nākṣa-jena pratibodhayitavyaḥ | tathā cānusandhānecchā-dveṣādīnām apy ekakāraṇatvaṃ pratyakṣato gṛhyate, yam aham adrākṣaṃ tam ahaṃ paśyāmīti | taṃ dṛṣṭvāham icchāmi dveṣmi vā | tam icchan dviṣan vā prayate | yatamāno'haṃ tam arthaṃ prāpya sukhī duḥkhī vā saṃvṛtto 'smīti | tad evam aham ity etasmin jñāne yo 'rthaś ca kāsti tadadhikaraṇaḥ smṛty anusandhānecchādayaḥ pratyakṣataḥ pratibhāntīty ataḥ pratyakṣeṇātmā gṛhyate | na hy aham iti jñānaṃ sandigdhaṃ bhrāntaṃ vā | nāpi lauṅgikaṃ śabdaṃ veti | tad api mithiyā-paritoṣamātram | tathā hi vikalpas tāvad ayam asty aham eva draṣṭā smartā ceti | na ca sarvo vikalpa āśvāsaviṣayaḥ | tathā cāyaṃ caturdhā darśitaḥ Trilocanenāpi |

[77,5] tatra pratyakṣapṛṣṭhabhāvī tāvan na bhavati, pratyakṣāntarasya tad-grāhakasya svayam apy anaṅgī-kārāt, yasyāyaṃ pṛṣṭhavī varṇyeta | lauṅgikatvam api svayam eva nirastam | tad yadi avastukaḥ sandigdhavastuko vā bhavan bhavatā pramāṇī-kriyate, kasya kiyatī kṣitiḥ |
athaibhyo bhinnaḥ pañcamo 'yaṃ pratyakṣa iṣyate | sarvasya tarhi svābhimate pramāṇavirahiṇi viṣaye sulabha eva nyāyaḥ (31b) iti na kvacit siddhipratibandhaḥ |
saṃvedena viśeṣaiti cet |
sa punaḥ saṃvādo 'rthakriyā-prāptiḥ pramāṇāntaravṛttir vā syād iti nirūpitaprāyam | pramāṇāntarabhāve ca tad evāstu kim anena | arthakriyā ca nāvasthitasādhyā kācin niścitā, sarvasyā buddhi-śarīrābhyāṃ siddheḥ | nāpi tadatiriktagocaro 'haṃ pratyayaḥ | yathā hi so 'yaṃ caitra ity atra caitraśarīre eva upādhyavasthākṛtaṃ bhedam avigaṇayya pūrvāparakālayor ekatvena pratyabhijñāyete, tathā aham eva draṣṭā smartā cety anenāpi pratyayena | kevalam ayaṃ buddhidvārakaḥ samydāyavyapadeśaḥ, yathā yo 'haṃ mūrkha āsaṃ sa piṇḍato 'smīti | kaścit punar dehadvāreṇa vyapadeśo yathā gauraḥ pīno vā 'ham iti ekadeśena samudāyavyapadeśasya prasiddhatvāt | kaścit punar ubhayadvārako yathā mayā rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ mama durgatir ity-ādi yathāyatham ūhyam | sukhaduḥkakecchā-dveṣaprayatnadharmādharmadvārakā api buddhi-kārakā eva vyapadeśāḥ, ahaṃ sukhī yāvad ahaṃ dhārmika iti buddhivyatirekābhāvāt teṣām | mukhaṃ śarīraṃ vā 'syāstīti bhedanirdeśo 'pi samudāyaikadeśabhedavivakṣayā, yathā vṛkṣasya śākhā | ata eva mukham aham iti iti na bhavati |

[77,22] kathaṃ tarhi mama matimūrtī iti yathā śilā-putrakasya śarīram | tarhi buddhi-śarīre ity api syāt, śilā-putrakaḥ śarīraṃ rāhoḥ śira ity apy kiṃ dṛṣṭam | yathā ca tatraiva dvitīyātmābhāve 'pi mamātmeti vyavahāras tathā samānaṃ prathamātmābhāve 'pi mama buddhidehav iti | yathā ca nāham ātmeti tathā nāhaṃ buddhi-śarīre iti | aham ātmety ukatārthatvān na prayogārham iti cet | evam evāhaṃ buddhi-śarīre ity uktārtham | na ceṣṭā-mātraparādhīneṣu dhvniṣu nirbandho budhānām ity āstāṃ tāvat |
tad ayam asmac chabdo vaktuḥ paraniṣedhaparaḥ, na tu mativigrahau vihāya vastv-nantaraparaḥ | tayoś ca buddhivigrahayor bhūtabhāviṣyator api vartamānena ekādhyavasāyān mayaiva dṛṣṭaṃ mayaiva spṛṣṭaṃ smṛtaṃ ceti prayujyate | tasmāt so 'yaṃ caitra itivad ubhayapuñjasya pūrvāparakālayor ekatāropamātram etat, nārthāntarollekhaḥ |
caitro 'py ātmaiva pratyabhijñāyata iti cet |
na, adṛṣṭe pratyabhijñānābhāvāt, buddhivigrahāv eva hi dṛṣṭau | yady api ca parabuddhir anumeyā tathāpi atyantābhyāsād asyām adhyakṣavad vyavahāradarśanān na doṣaḥ | mitrāmitrayor darśanamātrād eva hi tadanurūpānuṣṭhānam upalabdham | na ca tatra liṅga-rūpānusaraṇādiparilambho 'sti | nāpi kalevaramātrapratipattau tādṛg-anuṣṭhānam, mṛtamūrtāv api prasaṅgāt | sarvaśarīravyāpāraprayojakatayā ca janmanaḥ prabhṛti buddher ātmani darśanam eva paratrāpi tat-sahacārābyāsabījaṃ satataṃ sannihitam asti | na caivam ātmano darśanam abyāsabījam asti, (32a) sarvavyāpārasya śarīra-caitanyābhyām eva paryavasānāt | tasmāc caitraśabdagocarau cittakāyāv eva so 'yam iti pratyabhijñāyete | tathāsmāc chabdaviṣayayos tayor eva pratyabhijñānamātram etan mayā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā smṛtam iti | mayā kṛtaṃ mayā mokṣyata ity api ekatvādhyavasāyamātraṃ tayor eva | tad atra pakṣe pratyakṣaapṛṣṭhabhāvī vikalpo 'yam āśvāsaviṣayaḥ, sattā-mātre ekatve pūrvaparakṣaṇānām avastukaḥ, atiriktaviṣayatve tu sphuraty apy arthe alīkānalīkaśaṅkā-saṃkarāt sandigdhavastukaḥ kathaṃ pratyakṣasiddhatām ātmanaḥ prayojayet |

[78,19] yac cānenāpy udghuṣyate, abhinnasambandhina icchādi-bheda mametyakapratisandhānaviṣayatvād ekanartakī-pratisandhānaviṣayā iva prekṣakā ity anumānam | tad apy atitalahṛdayatāmeva dyotayati | na hi nartakī tattvata eka-rūpā kācit, caitanyādhiṣṭhitaparamāṇusamūhamātratvāt | vyavahārasiddham ekatvam upādāya dṛṣṭāntasiddhau dārṣṭāntike 'pi vyavahārasiddhaṃ kena vāryata iti | na ca sarvātmanā dṛṣṭānta iti cet |
satyam etat | tāttvikaṃ punar ekatvaṃ kasya sāmarthyena sāmarthyatām, dṛṣṭānte tad anvayadarśanāt tena vyāpty asiddheḥ | dṛṣṭāntadṛṣṭenāpi hi pramāṇabalāvalambinī vyāptiḥ siddhyati | adṛṣṭena tu tat-siddhi-śaṅkāpi nāsti | tasmān na sarvātmanā sādhāraṇo dṛṣṭānta iti vārtāyām api sādhyasādhanābhyāṃ sādhāraṇas tāvad avaśyakartavyaḥ | na hi vyāptipradarśanād anyo dṛṣṭāntasya arthaḥ, na cānupadarśitena dṛṣṭānte sādhyena vyāptisādhanam ādarśitaṃ bhavati | na caikāvayavisiddhyā sādhyaśūnyatā-parihāro hāri | śarīrabuddhyādirāśitayā nartakyā 'vayavitvābhāvāt | śarīrāpekṣayā tv avayavidūṣaṇam eva jāgarti | ātmāpekṣāyāṃ tu so 'dyāpi na sidhyati, viparyayabādhakābhāvāc ca nānekāntaśāntiḥ | mameti pratisandhānaṃ hi vikalpatayā anādyavidyā-vaśād api pratyabhijñānavat sambhavat katham ekasambandhādhīnatāṃ svīkuryād iti |

[79,9] tad evaṃ yathā smṛti karmaphalasambandhādikam aśeṣam avasthā-tāram antareṇāpi na vipattim āsādayati kṣaṇikavādinaḥ, tathā kāryakāraṇabhāvabuddhir apīti na sādhāraṇānekāntaśaṅkākalaṅkaḥ |
Śaṅkaras tu vācāṭatayā kim api nāṭayati | tathā hi, kadācid upalambhapūrvakā dhūmabuddhiḥ tejaḥ-kāryam idaṃ kapotakaṇṭhadhūsaraṃ vastv iti niścayam utpādayati, kadācit tad ubhayopalambhapūrvakas anupalambhaḥ | anupalambho 'pi pratiyogivastūpalambhasvabhāvatayā adhyakṣa-rūpa eva anvayaḥ punar anupalabdhiniṣṭhāyāṃ vihita iti tatraivāvadhāryaḥ | anvayavyatirekagrāhakapratyakṣānupalambhanītir api trikapañcaka-cintāyāṃ darśitety āstāṃ tāvat |

[79,17] prakṛtaṃ tu brūmaḥ | ubhayathāpi kramabhāvinīṣu buddhiṣu (32b) pūrvapūrvayā saṃskāraviśeṣādhānād antimā buddhir etasyedaṃ kāryam iti matim utpādayituṃ pūrvavan nirvahatīti nāvasthitasyānurodhaḥ pratisandhātuḥ |
yat punar uktam, vyatireko manorathasyāpy aviṣaya iti, tad atisahāsam | na hi yad eva pratyakṣaṃ vastu-grāhi vastu-dvayanivṛttau tad eva tayor vyatirekam api gṛhṇātīti ucyate, kiṃ tu tad viviktapratiyogivastūpalambhasvabhāvaṃ pratyakṣāntaram eva | tato yad uktaṃ tac ca nāsti tena ca pratipattir iti na nyāyyam iti kvopayujyate | na caivaṃ svasaṃvittivādopalambhasaṃgatiḥ | yad apy uktaṃ pūrvottarayoḥ kṣaṇayoḥ saṃvittī, tābhyāṃ vāsanā, tayā hetuphalādhyavasāyī vikalpa iti cet |

[80,1] tat kim idānīṃ yat kiñcid āśaṅkitena vaktavyam ity evaṃ vidhir anuṣṭhīyate bhavatā | vikalpo hi gṛhītānusandhānam atadrūpasamaropo vā syāt | na tāvat pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ, adṛṣṭānvayavyatirekasya purṣasya hetuphalabhāvāgrahe 'nusandhānapratyayahetor vāsanā-viśeṣasyaivānupapateḥ | agṛhītasya cānusandhāne 'tiprasaṅgād iti |
tad etan na samīcīnam ālocitam | yato hetuphalabhūtapūrvottarakṣaṇayor anubhavena kramiṇāpi svarūpasākṣātkaraṇāt hetuphalatve gṛhīte eva, kevalaṃ hetu-kāle phalābhāvāt tad-viṣayasāmarthyagrahaṇe 'pi phalādarśanāt tadavasāya evāpravṛttaḥ kāryadarśane pravartate | tathā phalāvalokane 'pi tatkāryatā gṛhītaiva vikalpenānusandhīyata iti gṛhītānusandhāna-rūpa evāyaṃ vikalpaḥ anvayavyatirekagrahaṇaṃ ca pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ pratipāditam iti yatkiñcid etat |
etena tad api pratyuktam, yad uktaṃ na cādṛṣṭānvayavyatirekasya hetuphalabhāvo vāsanāyāṃ vāsanāhetau ca sidhyati | tatrāpi paryanuyogasyāviśeṣād anavastheti |

[80,13] anvayavyatirekadarśanaṃ hi prastutaviṣayaṃ tāvad upapāditam eva | vāsanā-vikalpayor anvayavyatirekasiddhir adhyakṣānupalambheṣv antimād evānusandhānavikalpapravṛtteḥ, ekākinaḥ pratyakṣād anupalambhād vā pravṛttyabhāvāt, śaktisvabhāvatvād vāsanāyāḥ kāryam antareṇa vyavasthānupapatteḥ | tathā vyavasthitāyāś ca tasyāḥ svahetunānubhavenāpi sahānvayavyatirekasiddhiḥ kāryānvayavyatirekadvāreṇaiva | na cādyaṃ codyam, yāvan nānusandhānavikalpaḥ tāvan na vāsanāyāṃ vāsanāhetau vānvayavyatirekasiddhiḥ, yāvac ca na vāsanāyāṃ vāsanāhetau vānvayavyatirekasiddhis tāvan nānusandhānavikalpa iti | na hy anusandhānavikalpo vāsanāyāṃ vāsanāhetau vānvayavyatirekaniścayam apekṣate, api tv anubhayavāsanayor anvayavyatirekavatyoḥ svasantāne sattā-mātram, tadanvayavyatirekaniścayas tv anusandhānavikalpam apekṣata eva | tatra yathā dahanendhana(33a)vimsA5A_01kārānvayavyatirekaniścayānapekṣas tadapekṣaṇīyo dhūma iti netaretarāśrayas tathā prastute 'pīty alaṃ bahu-bhāṣitayā |
atadrūpasamāropapakṣe tu dūṣaṇaprasaṅgāgatam aprastutatayā tadanaṅgī-kāreṇāvadhīritaṃ tāvat | tasmād avyākulā kāryakāraṇabhāvapratītir asthiratva iti sthitam ||

[81,1] tat-sthitau ca kramapratītir anivāritā, asmin satīdam asmād upajātam iti pratīteḥ kramāvasāyanāntarīyakatvāt | anyathā siddhasādhyavibhaktiprayogasya viṣayaniyamānupapatteḥ | yasmād dhetuphalayor vā kramapratītiḥ phalayor veti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ kramāpekṣayā | yaugapadye śaṅkāpi nāsti, ekakālikānekāvalokanānantaram eva sakṛd imāni jātānīti vikalpasya baujād ivāṅkurasyotpatteḥ | na hi tadanekakāryodayagrahaṇakṛtaḥ kaścid aparādho virodho kṣaṇikatāyāḥ | kramikadarśane hi sthirāpekṣayā syād apy anusandhānāyāpātataḥ, sakṛd-darśane tu kiṃ sthireṇa |

[81,7] evaṃ tu syāt, sakṛd-darśane 'nantaram api smartānyaḥ prāpnotīti, tac ca parihṛtaṃ prāk | tad eva vā vācyam astu, kim avraṇ-kaṇḍūyāsthānīyena sākāravedanadūṣaṇodgīraṇena aprastutatvāt | grahaṇaṃ cet | asti sakṛd anekasya sākāreṇa nirākāreṇa vā jñānena bhaviṣyati, kim idānīm eva sakalatattvaniṣṭhāyā anuṣṭhānam | yadi tu sakṛj jāyamānānekagrahaṇam eva nāstīty abhimatam, tadā yathā sākāranirākaraṇaṃ tathā nirākārasyāpy astu | anyathā tenaiva grahaṇam āśaṅkyeta | kiṃ cānekagrahaṇābhāvo 'pi sakṛt katham abhimataḥ | kiṃ sakṛd anekasambhavābhāvāt grahaṇaprakārāsambhavād vā |

[81,15] prathamakalpe tāvat kathaṃ pradīpasya vartivikārāndhakārakṣayādaya[ḥ] tadā kriyante svayam api | asmākaṃ punar evaṃ sati prayāsa-lāghavam eva na kṣatiḥ, nitye kramadūṣaṇenaiva sādhyasiddheḥ |
dvitīye tu anekasambhavavyavahāraḥ kiṃ kṛto 'stu | anumānakṛto 'stu | kiṃ tadanumānam iti pṛṣṭo yadi vyākaroṣi tadānumānasiddham eva yaugapadyaṃ kramasahāyam arthakriyā-vyāpakam astu, kathaṃ prakṛtivirahadoṣaḥ | atha na vyākaroṣi, tāvataiva heto 'si | yugapad anekagrahanigrahe ca varam antaḥkaraṇasya manaso yugapad anekatra pravṛttyasambhava eva pratipadyatām, kim anena

[81,23] athānekākārānekasaṃvedanasaṃkalayitā eka eṣitavya iti matiḥ | tataḥ kim sthirasvīkāro hi kramavān naḥ samprati pīḍayati, anyathā tu vādāntarāvatāra eṣaḥ | tad-vat krame 'pi saṃkalayitā sidhyatīti cet
tad api yadi sākāranāntarīyakaṃ grahaṇam iti pramāṇasiddhaṃ syāt tadā sidhyet, anyathopagamamātrasya sukaratyāgatvād anākārasvīkāreṇa nirvahet paraḥ | na (33b) cākāramsA33b 5B_01sādhanayatno 'sti, viṣayasyaiva tad-ākāratvaṃ samarthitaṃ syād iti tan nirapekṣam akṣaraṃ vā katham āvakṣīta | na cātra pratisandhātur asthiratvāvirodhinaḥ svīkāre 'pi krame 'vaśyaṃ svīkāraḥ, yathā bhinnadeśam abhinnasvabhāvasya kāryakaraṇam icchann api na bhinnakālam icchati | tasmāt krame pratisandhātṛ-svīkārārtham anya eva prakāra āśrayaṇīyaḥ | tataḥ kim anena | tasmāt kathañcit gaṇḍollāsaḥ kartavya ity evaṃ vidhim anuṣṭhito 'nena | na cedānīm ākāradūṣaṇapratividher avasara itinedaṃ pratiṣidhyata iti ||
nanu tathāpi,

matiḥ sākārā cen na ca bhidi mitho vedanamataḥ
sphurty ekaivāsau tad iha na virodhaḥ prabhavati |
ataḥ śaktāśakto 'py abhid iti nirastā kṣaṇikatāna
vācyo doṣaś cāvayavini na vā sākṛti-ayaḥ ||

nanv ata evoktaṃ nāyaṃ tat-pratividher avasara iti | na hi tadasiddhir avayavisiddhir vā bādhikāsmākam |

nityatrayānugamanādiguṇe kāntaḥ
  sautrāntikasya samayo 'pi na bādhito 'ṃśe |
no cen na pudgalanirākaraṇena bauddha-
siddhāntabādhakṛta eva kṛtāparādhaḥ ||

tasmāt,

dhiyaḥ sākāratvaṃ yadi mama ya evaiṣa samayo
bhaved duṣṭo mānābhyupanatahatiḥ syāt katham iva |
pramā-siddhaṃ tac ced bha[va] tu dhiya evaiṣa samayo
bahiś citre 'py ekasthitir iti viluptaṃ khalu bahiḥ ||

[83,1] arthakriyā-bhedanāntarīyako hy ākārabhedaḥ padārtheṣu | tatra yady ākārabhede 'pi nārthakriyā-bhedaḥ, hanta pratibhāsamātrabhedān nātiriktaṃ kiñcid iti bāhyapadārthāpalāpa eva prasaktaḥ | tad avaśyam anena bāhyavastuna ākārabhedād bheda eva svīkartavyo, buddhir bhidyatāṃ mā vā | na hi samakakṣṭāpi dhiyo 'dhigantum alam | anyathā svasaṃvedanam anyaprakāśanaṃ ca bāhyasyāpi prasajyamānaṃ grāhyagrāhakabhāvam eva viplāvayet | tad yadi pramāṇasiddhaṃ buddher ekatvaṃ citrākārāyās tasyā evāstu, bāhyaṃ tu bhinnākāraṃ bhinnam eva |
bāhyam api bhinnākāraṃ kathaṃ bhinnam iti cet | bhavatu tri-bhuvanam ekam eva vastu kim asmākaṃ kṣīṇam | pṛthag-arthakarmaniyogādyabhāve tu na gandharvanagarādivat pratibhāsamātratāṃ atiśayītety uktam | kvacid ekatā kvacid bheda iti vibhāgasyāpi naiṣa prastāvaḥ |

[83,10] atha buddher apy ekatvaṃ samayamātraṃ na pramāṇasiddham | tadā[nīṃ] bādhavirodhī samaya iti sa eva duṣyatu, pramāṇopanītas tu prastuto vastu-bhedaḥ parasparavirodhāt kathaṃ tyājyaḥ |

[83,13] kiṃ ca,

hato hetur vaktur yadi samayam āśritya samaye
tavāstu eṣa śreyān-atha samaya-cintā pravadituḥ |
na vai śāstre sthitvā vacanam iti vaktuś ca samayaḥ
pramā-siddhau rūpair anumitividhau nāgamaguṇaḥ ||

api ca na virodhamātraṃ bhedam asmākaṃ, kiṃ tu śaktāśaktatvena | tac cāvamsA34a 5A_02śyaṃ (34a) svīkāryam, anyathā sādhanadūṣaṇasamarthānusaraṇavisaraṇāt paryavasito vāda iti kim apareṇa | tasmāc chaktyaśaktidvāreṇa bheda duṣpariharaḥ | tato virodhamātrasya bhedavyabhicāre 'pi prakṛtaviśeṣasya na vyabhicāraḥ, vastu-mātrasya vahnivyabhicāre 'pi dhūma-lakṣaṇavastv-avyabhicāravat |
nanu śaktāśaktatvenāpi bhedo virodhād eva sa ca vyabhicārīti cet | dhūmo 'pi vastutvād eva hetur gamako, vastutvaṃ ca vyabhicārīti samānam | tasmād vastutvād eva dahanasya gamako dhūma iti na vastutvaṃ parihṛtyety arthaḥ | na tu yāvad vastu tāvad gamakam | evaṃ śaktāśaktatvaṃ virodhād eva bhedasādhanam iti na virodhaṃ vidhūyety arthaḥ | na tu yāvad virodhas tāvad bhedasādhakaḥ | āha ca: virodaś ced bhedaṃ vyabhicarati bhedapratipade viśiṣṭo 'sāv iṣṭaḥ prabhavati ca śaktetaratayā |

aśakte sāmānye yadi ca viśeṣe 'pi balavān
na dhūmād agny-āśā vyabicarati yad vastu śikhinam ||
virodhād evālaṃ balavad abalatvaṃ yadi
bhide na vastutvaṃ hitvā hutabhuji sa dhūmo 'pi balavān |
atho vahniṃ vastu vyabhicaratu bhedo 'sya tu balī
pramā-siddhāpattiḥ prakṛtaviṣaye 'py eṣa samayaḥ ||

[84,13] abhede hi śaktāśaktayoḥ sakalam ākūlam trai-lokyam apravṛttinivṛttikam āsaktam iti śaktetarayor virodho 'vaśyaṃ bhedasādhaka eṣitavyaḥ, ākāradvāreṇa bhavatu mā vā | nanv ākārabhedo 'pi śakti-bhedanānantarīka eveti kiṃ-kṛto vibhāgaḥ | satyam, bāhyeṣu tāvad evam eva, jalānalādiṣu tathaivopalabdheḥ | anyathā ca na bāhyaṃ nāma kiñcit pratibhāsamātrāvaśeṣāt | buddhes tv ākārā na tāvad dāhagāhanādiṣv evopayogino, bāhyakāryatvāt teṣām | yat punar avasāyādi-kāryaṃ tad apy ākārāntareṇa saha bhedābhedavivādārūḍham eveti katham ekatraikavyāpāro darśitaḥ | bhavatu vā kiñcid ekam api kāryam, tatrāpi kim apoddhāradvāreṇa ekākāravyāpārakalpanam atha bhedād eveti cintyam | na cāsmākaṃ citrabuddher ekānekatvasādhane mirbandhaḥ, icchāpi sākāratā-mātre, kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhane tu tasyāpi na kaścid anurodhaḥ |

anāntarīyake cārthe bādhite 'nyasya kā kṣatiḥ | (PV 4.47cd)

[85,1] iti nyāyāt | tasmān nāpratīti-kṛto 'rthasāmarthyasya kramākramasya ca vyāpyavyāpakabhāvaniścayaḥ |
yat punar ucyate, yadi krameṇa vyāptam, tadā katham akrameṇa | athākrameṇa, na tarhi krameṇa | kramākramābhyāṃ vyāptam iti bruvatā vyāpter evābhāvaḥ pradarśito bhavati | sā hi vyāpyasya tatraiva bhāvo vyāpakasya tatra bhāva evety evaṃ rūpā, ubhayor vyāpakatvena svarūpaṃ jahāti | na hi bhavaty agnir dhūmādhūmābhāvābhyāṃ vyāpta iti |
kim evaṃ vaktari vaktavyam | datto hi jalāñjaliramunā krameṇa sakalatārkikavartmani vartamānair ātmanā cāmsA34b 5B_02nena bahudhā dattasya vikalpya dūṣaṇa-rāśeḥ | api nāmaitat-prakārāṇāṃ dūṣaṇenāsattā-praipādanāt tat-prameyam asat syād iti vikalpya dūṣaṇāni pratīyante, tat-prakārair avyāptau ca dūṣyaprameyasya teṣām abhāve 'pi nāsyābhāvaniyama iti dūṣaṇābhidhāne 'pi prāg iva saṃśayaḥ, tad alam upanyāsena | tat-prakārāṇām abhāve 'bhāvaniyame vā sa eva vyāpty artha iti kasya niṣedhaḥ | tathā ca santānasya vastutvam anicchan bhinno 'bhinno veti vikalpya dūṣaṇam ārabhate, tad ubhayābhāvavibhāvane ca nirvṛṇvīteti na bhedābhedābhyāṃ vastu-vyāptim anaṅgī-kurvan nirvahati | evaṃ trayādivikalpeṣv apīti sthitam | tasmād ekaikenāvyāptiḥ, samudāyena tu vyāptir eveti nyāyaḥ | yathā yudhiṣṭhirādiṣv anyatamo 'bhavan pāṇḍava eva na bhavati | ekanivṛttau hi tadanyaprakāram āśrityāsīt tattvam | sarvaprakārābhāve tu kvāstām | ato niyamavatī nivṛttir vyāptir eva |

[85,18] yad apy uktam – na hi bhavaty agnir dhūmādhūmābhāvābhyāṃ vyāpta iti, tad api pāpīyaḥ | kramākramābhyāṃ hi kāryodayavyāptivādino rāśyantaravirahavatā tad-dharmadvayena vyāptiḥ prastutā, tat kvedam upayujyate | na hi kramākramāv iva kāryāṇāṃ vahner api dhūmadhūmābhāvo dharmaḥ | svabhāva eva dharmiṇo dharmaśabdavācyaḥ prakṛtaḥ | tad yadi dhūmadhūmābhāvābhyām iti dhūmavattvādhūmavattvābhyām iti vivakṣitam, tadā kaḥ pratibandhaḥ pratibandhabodhasya | na hi dahanas tadavasthā-dvayavirahitaḥ kvacid upapannaḥ |
atha yathā yathoktadharmo nāntarīyakatvam agnes tathā parabhūte dhūme dhūmābhāvaśabdavācye ca nścitam iti tābhyām api kathaṃ na vyāptir asya, sāmānya-lakṣaṇasyākṣīṇatvāt asti hi dhūmadhūmābhāvayor yatrābhāvas tatra vahner api, yatra ca vahnis tatra tayor anyatarasya sambhavaḥ dhūme sati hutāśanaprakārāṇām ivānyatamasyeti cet |

[93,1] tathā ca Trilocanaḥ svākṣareṇa sphuṭayati, kramayaugapadyarahitatvam abhāvadharmo na sidhyati, āśrayānupalabdher iti | atra hi vyaktam abhāvo dharmī, kramādirahitatvam asya dharmo niṣidhyate, āśrayānupalabdher iti hetor iti | evam asato dharmitvaṃ pratijānāna evānantaraṃ kramayaugapadya-rahitaśaśaviṣāṇadharmatvaṃ prekṣāvantaḥ pratipadyanta iti evaṃ bruvan mahān sāhasiko yad ayam-ātmānam-ātmanaiva nopahasati | abhāvād eva hi śaśaviṣāṇasya dharmitvaṃ niṣeddhavyam, svīkṛtaṃ cābhāvasyāpi dharmitvam iti kaḥ pratirodhasturaṅgaśṛṅgādeḥ | athābhāvasya dharmitā kramādirahitatvaniṣedhena svīkṛtā, kathaṃ kramādirahitatvenaivāstu | aho buddhivaibhavam | abhāvasya śaśaviṣāṇasya kramādirahitatvaniṣedhena dharmitvaṃ manyate, na kramādirahitatvena | ubhayathāpy avastuni vidhiniṣedhavyavahārasvīkārād durnivāraḥ saugatakṛtānta iti varaṃ kramādirahitvenaiva dharmitvam ubhayatrāstu, kim uttarā-pathaṃ praviśya tāvataiva mūlyena turagatyāgino garbhakriyaṇavṛttānta āśriyate |

[93,12] atha vātisūkṣmā buddhiḥ sthavīyāṃsam asamañjasaviśeṣam iyantaṃ na paśyatīti kim atra kriyatām | tathāpy akṣiṇo nimīrya cintaya tāvat kiṃ śaśaviṣāṇaṃ kramādi-yogi bhavati na vā | yadi bhavatīti bhaṇasi, kim atra vaktavyam asmābhiḥ | sabhyādayaḥ pramāṇam | atha neti pakṣaḥ, tadā kramādirahitaṃ tat-tatkathaṃ kramādirahitatvaniṣedhena dharmī-karoṣi | ubhayathā ca hetuṃ paryanuyujyāvaśyam avastutvād iti vakṣyāmīty alaṃ vistareṇa |

[93,17] evaṃ bandhyā-sutto vaktā navety evaṃ vidhe 'pi prastāve niṣedham apratijñāya na sthātuṃ śakyam acetanatvād avastutvād ity-ādi sādhanam anupanyasya vā na kaścid evam āśaṅkate | yad īdṛśam uttarayitavyam iti cet | kutaḥ | tad avastu tāyāḥ prasiddhatvād iti cet |
punas tad evāyātam bandhā-sutasya dharmiṇo vaktṛtvenāśaṅkanīyatā-niṣedhaḥ, suprasiddhāv astutvād iti hetur iti | na ca suprasiddhatve 'pi sarvathā śaṅkā-virahaḥ | niḥsīmo hi mohamahimā | dṛṣṭo hi śāstrakārāṇām api (38a) kramādiramsA38a 5A_06hitatvaniṣedhaḥ śaśaviṣāṇe ity evaṃ pramsĀ p.17|3kāro bhramaḥ | tato yathā śabde cākṣuṣatvād anityatvaṃ sambhāvayan na siddhatvena [-nn asiddha-] niṣidhyate tathehāpi syātāṃ śaṅkā-niṣedhau, na virodhaḥ | tasmād vastunīvāvastuny api kasyacid dharmasya vidhiniṣedhavyavahāro durvāraḥ, āhatya vipratipannānām api śāstrakārāṇāṃ niṣedhavākyenaiva svīkārāt |

[94,1] tatredānīm avastuṣu bandhyā-sutaparyanteṣu kathaṃ dharmitvam | pratītyabhāve kathaṃ vyavahāraḥ | pratīti-janakatve kathaṃ na vastutvam | na ca vacanamātrapramāṇam upadeyam iti yaḥ kaścid dhetur upādīyate, sa sarvaḥ kathaṃ nāśrayāsiddhaḥ | tad etad āyātam, yaś cobhayoḥ samo doṣa ity-ādi |
yadi ca niścitāvastu-bhāveṣv api naite doṣāḥ, tat kiṃ sādhanāt prāg asandigdhasattāke nitye bhaviṣyati | kaḥ punar atra paramārthaḥ | na hy avastuni kasyacid dharmasya vidhiniṣedhavyavahāraḥ śakyaparihāraḥ prāmāṇikasya |
na caite doṣāḥ sānuṣaṅgiṇa iti cet | ucyate, na tāvad avastuno dharmitvābhāvaḥ | yatraiva hi idam evam iti prāmarśaḥ tad evedam ity anenākāreṇa dharmi | evam iti dharmaviśeṣayogaḥ | yathā ghaṭo nīla evaṃ bandhyā-suto na vakteti ghaṭasya nīlatvam iva bandhyā-suttasya vakṛtvaṃ dharmaḥ pratīyata iti na dharmitvābhāvo 'bhāve | kevalaṃ kaścid dharmo vastuni yato nīlatvādiḥ, kaścid avastuni yataḥ sarvopākhyā-virahādiḥ, kaścid ubhayasādhāraṇo 'nupalambhamātram | tatra vastu-dharmiṇāvastu-dharmatvaniṣedha iti yuktam | na tu dharmamātrāṇām, svavacanavirodhasya bādhakatvāt | pratītyabhāvena vyavahāraity apy ayuktam | na punar ubhayor ekaprakāraiva pratītir aṅgaṃ vyavahārasya | vastuno hi svasāmarthyabhāvinī pratītiḥ | vikalpaś cādhyakṣa-liṅgaābhyāṃ pāramparyakāryaḥ | avastunas tu sandigdhavastu-bhāvasya vā vikalpamātram | sāmarthyābhāve hi tayor abhāve vikalpamātram api yadi na tat-pratītir avasthāpyate sarvathā vyavahārya eva syāt | iṣṭaś ca vyavahāraḥ, ato vikalpanamātraṃ tatra pratītiḥ, tad-upasthāpitam eva ca tayoḥ svarūpaṃ nānyat | yathā vastunaḥ pratyakṣānumānopanītam eva svarūpam, evam avastunaḥ sandigdhavastu-bhāvasya vā vikalpopasthāpita evātmā nānya iti | nātaḥ samayād aṅgam ākarṣantaḥ santā bhavitum arhanti | yat tu

grāhyatāṃ viduḥ hetutvam eva yukti-jñāḥ (PV III 247)

[96,1] atha bandhyā-sutādīnāṃ vikalpanīyād rūpād rūpāntaravirahāt tan-mātrasya ca vikalpena viṣayīkaraṇe tadanurūpavyavahārasya na kṣatiḥ | evaṃ sati virodhavyavahārasyāpi tadanurūpasya kā kṣatiḥ | yathā ca vastutayā bandhyā-sutasya virodhaḥ, emsĀ p.17|4vaṃ nityasyāpi yo dharmaḥ pratyanīka upapādayituṃ śakyas tena kathaṃ na virodhaḥ | tat katham anubhavābhāvamātraṃ virodhabādhane sādhanam anabhidhīyamānaṃ sādhu syāt | yadi tu vikalpe 'pi tad-viṣayo na syāt, tat-pratyanīkākāraparāmarśo vā na syāmsA39a 5A_04t, (39a) sahānavasthānābhidhāno vā virodhaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭo bhavet, bhavet virodhasiddhiḥ, ekasya hi bhavato 'nyabhāve abhāvāt sahānavasthānavyavasthā | bhāvaś ca pratyakṣagocara iti katham ekasyānyavastututve ghaṭeta | parasparaparihārasthiti-lakṣaṇatvaṃ tu pratyanīkākāraparāmarśamātrasādhyam vikalpamātreṇa viṣayī-karaṇe 'pi sannnidhīyamānavyavasthā-nimittaṃ nāvaśyaṃ vastv-anurodhi, katham anyathā bhāvābhāvayor eva virodhaḥ parasparaparihāra-lakṣaṇaḥ | tatra ca virodhe pradhānam udāharaṇaṃ tāv eva | abhāvasya vastutvasvīkāre 'pi na bhāvasya bhāvo 'bhāvābhidhāne vastuni, nāpy abhāvasya bhāvo 'bhāva iti nābhāvavastuparamparām upagantuṃ śakyam iti svapracyutimātram avastu-vyavahartavyaikasvabhāvam iṣyamāṇaṃ kathaṃ tad-virodhi vyavasthāpyatām | virodhāvyavasthāne ca tatra svātmā ca svapracyutiś cety ekam eva vastu svātmanaivāsti ca nāsti ceti syāt, na caivaṃ niyamenety ayam eva virodhārthaḥ | kṣaṇikākṣaṇikavad vā | yathā hy ekasya nākṣaṇikaṃ tathā nānyasya kṣaṇikam iti | tasmād vastv-avastunor na parasparaparihāra-lakṣaṇavirodhabādheti sthitam ||

[96,19] nanu virodhasyāpāramārthikatve tad-dvāreṇa kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhir apy avāstavī syāt, na hy apāramārthikādharaḥ pāramārthiko bhavitum arhati virodhaḥ |
yad āha śaṅkaraḥ, evaṃ tarhi virodhakalpanayā bādhakam api kalpitavirodhatvān na vāstavavyatirekasādhanam ity avāstavavyatirekatvāt msĀ p.19|4 sattāyāḥ, tadāyattaṃ kṣaṇikatvam apy avāstavam eveti |

[96,23] nyāyabhūṣaṇo 'pi tad evam upaskurvann āha, saṃvṛtisiddhenākṣaṇikena virodhasiddhir iti cet | saṃvṛtisiddham api vāstavaṃ kālpanikaṃ vā syāt | yadi vāstavam, tataḥ kathaṃ tasyāsattvam | kathaṃ vārthakriyā-virodhaḥ | arthakriyāṃ kurvad dhi vāstavam ucyate | atha kālpanikam, tad-virodhaḥ kiṃ vāstavaḥ kālpaniko vā | na tāvad vāstavaḥ, kalpitavirodhivirodhatvād bandhyā-putravirodhavat | atha virodho 'pi kālpanika eva, na tarhi paramārthato 'kṣaṇikasyārthakriyāyāṃ kramākramābhyāṃ virodha ity ato 'kṣaṇikāt sattvasya vyatirekasiddhir apy apāramārthikīty avāstavavyatirekatvāt sattāyāḥ, tad-āyattaṃ kṣaṇikatvam apy avāstavam eveti |

[97,6] abaddhapralapitam etat | na hi virodho nāma vastv-antaraṃ kiñcid ubhayakoṭidattapādaṃ sambandhābhidhānam iṣyate 'smābhiḥ, upapadyate vā, yenaikasambandhino vastutvābhāve apāramārthikaḥ syāt | yathā tv iṣyate tathā pāramārthika eva | viruddhābhimatayor anyonyasvarūpaparihāramātraṃ virodhārthaḥ | tac ca bhāvābhāvayoḥ (39b) pāramāmsA39b 5B_04rthikam eva | na hi bhāvo 'bhāva-rūpam āviśati, nāpy abhāvo bhāva-rūpam iti yo 'yam anayor asaṅkaraniyamaḥ sa eva virodhaḥ | sa ca niyamaḥ svātmanaṃ virodham api pāramārthikapade niveśayati | evaṃ na nityaṃ kramayaugapadya-rūpam āviśati, nāpi kramayaugapadyaṃ nitya-rūpam āviśatīti yo 'yaṃniyamaḥ sa eva virodhas tayoḥ | na ca kadācid anyateti pramāṇasiddhir eva pāramārthikateti katham ucyate, virodhasyāpāramārthikatayā sattvahetor vyatireko 'py atāttvika iti?

[98,6] api ca | virodho nāmaikatra dvayaḥ saṃvāsaniṣedhārtham arthyate | na tu dvayor vastutvasiddhir nāma virodhaphalam | yatra tu dvayor vastutvasiddhis tatra sāmarthyād ekena vastunā vastv-antaratiraskārāt kvacid deśe, yathā sahānavasthāne yathoktaṃ prāk | prakṛtas tu virodho dhamayor ekatra dharmiṇi sadbhāvaniṣedhaphalaḥ | tatra yathā dvāv api dharmau santau niṣedhyete,yatra nīlatvaṃ na tatrānīlatvam | ato na nīlānīlam ekam iti | tathā sadasattva-rūpāv api vipratiṣiddhau dharmāv ekatra dharmiṇi samāropitau pratiṣiddhāv eva | na hi jananyāḥ (40a)msA40a 5A_08 tanaye bandhyā-tanayatvam āropitaṃ tattvato 'saditi na niṣedhyam | bandhyā-tanaye vā vikalpaikagocare jananī-tanayatvam āropitaṃ na niṣedhyam | na hi jananī-tanayo babdhyā-tanayo vaikātmā, tāvataiva virodhakāryaparyavasanāt, kim apareṇa virodhanāmnā yo vastu-dharmāv anapekṣya nātma-lābham āsādayati? evaṃ yatra nityatvaṃna tatra kramayaugapadyavattvam, yatra kramayaugapadyavattvaṃ tatra na nityatvam ato na nityaṃ kramayaugapadyayogi paramārthataḥ | tataś ca sattāyuktam api naiva niyamena paramārtataḥ | tataḥ kṣaṇika eva viśrāmyat tad-āyattasattākameva sattvam iti sattvāt kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddher avirodhaḥ |
