[100,9] syād etat, yadi vikalpa-rūpāṃ pratītim āśrityāśrayāsiddhiparihāraḥ sattā-sādhane 'pi samānam, tataḥ katham ucyate nāsiddhe bhāvadharmo 'stīty-ādi | kathaṃ ātmano vibhumsĀ p.17|6tvasādhanaṃ sarvatropalabhyamānaguṇatvam āśrayāsiddhāv udāhriyata iti cet | sādhanānurodhād ubhayatrāpi hi bhāvadharma eva hetur upātta āśaṅkitaś ca | na ca bhāvadharmasyāvastu dharmī bhavatum arhati | na hi dhūmaśiṃśapātvādayo 'vastuni vasanti | tasnād yatra bhāvadharmaḥ sādhanaṃ tatra niyamena vastv eva dharmī | na ca vikalpamātraviṣayasya vastutāśvāsaḥ, avastuny api vikalpamātrānapāyāt | tato vastu dharmī-kurvatā pratyakṣānumāna-rūpe ca siddhir abhidhātavyā | tad anabhidhāne tu vikalpamātragocarrito 'rthaḥ sandigdhasattāko nirastasattāko vā dharmī-kriyamāṇaḥ kathaṃ vatutayā niścitaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt | tathā ca sati yāvān vastu-dharmo hetuḥ sarvo 'sau nāśrayāsiddhim atikrāmati, ekatra sandehād anyatra viparyayāt | tataḥ pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ vastu-viṣayābhyām asiddhe bhāvadharmo na hetur asty āśrayāsiddhatvād iti yuktam etat sattā-sādhane | asattā-sādhane tv avastu-dharmo hetur avastuni viklpamātrasiddha nāśrayāsiddhidoṣeṇa dūṣayituṃ śakyaḥ | na hi tasya vastv-āśrayāpekṣā, avastu-dharmād eva | na ca tad-ādhārasya pratyakṣānumānāpekṣā, avastutvād eva | bhāvadharme tu sādhane vastv evāśrayo (41a) vamsA41a 6A_01studharmatvāt | vastunaś ca niścayaḥ pratyakṣānumānābhyām eva, tatas tayor abhāve niyamenāśrayāsiddhir iti sadasattā-sādhanayoḥ kathaṃ samāno doṣaḥ |

[100,24] yat tu Trilocanena pramāṇāntaraṃ nityānām asattā-siddhau kramādivirahasyābhāva dharmatā na sidhyatīty uktam, tad bālasyāpi durabhidhānam | nityā hi dharmiṇa | asattvaṃ sādhyam | kramādiviraho hetuḥ | asya cābhāvadharmatvaṃ nāma svasādhyāvinābhāvitvam ucyate, abhāvānāṃ śaśaśṛṅgādīnāṃ dharmo na bhāvānām iti kṛtvā | tad anena vacasā yāvat pramāṇāntareṇa pakṣe sādhyaṃ na sidhyati, na tāvad dhetor vyāptir ity uktaṃ bhavati | tac ca kutra hetāv upalabdham aneneti na vidmaḥ | yathā cānyatra sādhyanāntarīyakatā anyadā pravṛttapramāṇāntarasiddhā dṛṣṭāntena smāritā pakṣīkṛte sādhyasiddhyartham upayujyate, nānyataḥ sādhyasiddhim apekṣate, tadā kramādyabhāve 'bhāvadharmatā vyāptisvabhāvānyadaiva kramākrameṇa siddhatvasya [sattvasya] | vyāptigrahaṇakāle pravṛttapramāṇasiddhākāśakamaladṛṣṭāntena smāritā sādhyasiddhāv upayujyate, nānyataḥ sādhyasiddhim apekṣate | anyathā sarvānumānavaiyarthyāt | kramayaugapadyena hi sattvasya vyāptisiddhau sattvasya vyāpyasyābhāvena kramayaugapadyasya vyāpakasya viraho vyāptaḥ sidhyatīty abhāvadharmatvaṃ msĀ p.19|6 kramayaugapadyaviṣayaḥ | yathā ca vyāptirūpaṃ tathā pūrvam eva niścitaṃ, sadabhāvadharmatvaṃ na pakṣe pramāṇāntareṇa sādhyasiddhyā vyavasthāpyate, tathā kramākramābhāvābhāvenāpi sādhyaṃ prasādhya vyavasthāpyata iti naḥ pakṣaḥ, pūrvam eva vyavasthāpitatvāt | tat kuta itaretarāśrayatvam |

[101,14] kiṃ ca, itaretarāśrayatvam apy evaṃ yujyate | kramādivirahasyābhāvadharmatvasiddhau teṣām asattvasiddhiḥ asattvasiddhau cābhāvadharmatvasiddhir iti | viṣamadṛṣṭinā punar abhāvadharmasiddher asattvāsiddhau na prayojakatvam uktaṃ, kiṃ tu pakṣadharmatāsiddheḥ | tat kīdṛśam itaretarāśrayatvam | na ca pakṣadharmataivābhāvadharmatā, sādhyāvinā-bhāva-rūpatvād abhāvadharmatāyāḥ | atha yady abhāvadharmatvaṃ kramādyabhāvasya syāt, tadā pakṣīkṛtānām asatāṃ nityānāṃ dharmaḥ syād ity abhiprāyāt pakṣadharmatāvyāpāradvāreṇa tadavyāpāro darśitaḥ, tathāpi cakrakaṃ vakutum ucitam | tad api pracīna-carcayā carcitam eva |

[101,21] kiṃ ca, abhāvadharmatve vyāptirūpe sati pakṣadharmatvam iti nāyaṃ hetv-antarasādhāraṇo nyāyaḥ | na cāsyāpi hetor evam, abhāvadharmatvaṃ hi vyāptir bhavatu mā vā, kramādivirahas tu kena nityāāṃ niṣidhyate | na caite 'py asattā-rūpeṇa dharmiṇaḥ, kiṃ tu sadasattvasandehavattveneti yat kiñcid etat bhāvadharmatvam ubhayadharmatvaṃ ca neṣṭam asya kramādivirahasya hetor iti na prathamavikalpe doṣaḥ |
zu 88,15 nāpi dvitīye, vyatirekasyābhāvarūpatve 'pi vikalpena pratīteḥ samarthitatvāt. [102,1] na hy abhāvarūpāṇāṃ vikalpād anyā pratītir apratītir vā, ubhayathāpy abhāvavyavahārahāniprasaṅgāt. tato 'nubhavāpekṣāvirahān na tajjananaprasaṅge doṣāvakāśaḥ. anāśvāsas tu śāsitum ucitaḥ. so 'pi kramayaugapadyavirahalakṣaṇavyāpakānupalambhasambhavāl liṅgajatvena dūrīkṛtaḥ. tathā hi tathaiva trairūpyapariśodhanam etad ārabdham, siddhaṃ ca kim iti vismaryate, yato liṅgābhāvād ity ucyate. tasmāt kramādivyāpyasattāvyatirekavikalpe katham anāśvāsaḥ. avyatirekaśaṅkā hy anāśvāsyārthaḥ. vyāpyavyāpakabhāvaniścaye cāsthānam etad iti nityān niyamena vyatiricyamānaṃ sattvaṃ kṣaṇikatvena vyāptaṃ siddham iti na doṣaḥ.
zu 89,12 tṛtīye 'pi vikalpe vyatirekaniścayasya dṛḍhīkṛtatvāt, so 'yaṃ vyāpakānupalambho nitye svāśraye kramādyabhāvaṃ sādhayann eva sattāyās tato niyamena vyatirekaṃ, kṣaṇikatāyāṃ ca pratibandham asyāḥ sādhayatīti trayo 'sya vyāpārāḥ ekavyāpārasaṃgṛhītāś ca, na ca doṣaleśena lipyante | tritvaṃ cārthaśakteḥ sattā-lakṣaṇatve, hetu-mātratve tu vyatirekamātrasādhanam asattāsādhanārtha iti vyāpāradvaitam eveti sthitam ||
[102,14] nanu vyāpakābhāvasyābhāva-rūpatvena vastu-dharmatayā āśrayāsiddhiparihāre 'pi sa katham abhāvaḥ kasyacit pratipattiḥ, pratipatti-hetur vā tasyāpi vā kathaṃ pratipattir iti kiṃ na dṛśyate? tal-liṅga-janmā ca sampraty eva vyatirekavikalpo na visaṃvādaśaṅkām aṅke nidhatta ity uktam | avaśyaṃ ca sādhyabuddhiṃ sādhayatā sādhanena bhāvavyavahāraḥ svīkartavyo nānyathā | tac cābhāva-rūpatve sarvaṃ virudhyate | vyāpakānupalabdhir ity api yady apy anupalabdhimātraṃ sa eva doṣaḥ, na cānyopalabdhir vyāpakānupalabdhir abhidhātuṃ śkyā,anyasyāpi kasyacid anupalabdhir iti |

[102,20] tad api yatkiñcit, dharmy-upalabdher evaānyatrāpy anupalabdhitayā vyavasthāpanāt | yathā hi nehi śiṃśapā vṛkṣābhāvād ity atra vṛkṣāpekṣayā kevalapadeśasya dharmiṇa upalabdhiḥ vṛkṣānupalabdhiḥ, śiṃśapāpekṣayā ca kevalapratītir eva śiṃśapābhāvapratītir iti svabhāvahetuparyavasāyivyāpāro vyāpakānupalambhaḥ | tathā nityasya dharmiṇo vikalpabuddhau parisphurataḥ kramādyapekṣayā kevalasphuraṇam eva kramādyanupalambhaḥ, arthakriyāpekṣayā ca kevalapratītir evārthakriyā-viyogapratītir iti viśeṣaḥ |

[102,25] adhyavasāyāpekṣayā ca yathā neha śiṃśapā vṛkṣābhāvād ity abhāvasya hetupañcamyā nirdeśaḥ, tathā bhāvaḥ sādhanam ity api vyavahāraḥ, na tv abhāvaḥ sādhanameva msA42a 6A_02 kvacit | sa ca vyavahāraḥ avasitārthāvisaṃvādān na parihartuṃ śakyaḥ | yat khalu vyāpakena virahitaṃ tad avaśyaṃ vyāpyenāpīty etāvata evārthasya saṃvādinaḥ tenāpi prakāreṇa pratipādanāt | ayaṃ ca nyāyo yathā satye dharmiṇi tathāsaty 'pīti ko viśeṣaḥ?

[103,6] nanu ayam eva mahān viśeṣaḥ | satye hi dharmiṇi vyāpakasyaika-jñānasaṃsargī sa eva dharmīti tasyopalabdhir anupalabdhir vyāpakasyāstu, asatyas tu dharmīnaika-jñānasaṃsargī kenacid iti ced,

[103,8] tenaiva svasambandhinā dharmeṇa vyāpakasaṃmatena | tathā hy eka-jñānam atra vikalpa eva | sa hi nityagrāhī vikalpaḥ tad-ākārāntaram iva kramayaugapadyadharmasambandhe nityasya kramādy-ākāram apy ullikhed iti sambhāvanayā eka-jñānasaṣargitvam ubhayor anivāryam | yadi na nityam anādheyāti] sayatvādinā dharmāntareṇa saha pratītigocarībhāvet, yaugapadyāyaugapadyaṃ vāstavadharmi |ṇā saha na pratītiviṣayaḥ syād apy evam | na caivam, na ca niṣedhyamsĀ p.19|7sya sambhāvanāṃ vinā kvacid eka-jñānasaṃsargaḥ tadaiva syāl labhyaḥ | tatra yathā hariṇaśirasi tenaika-jñānasaṃsargi śṛṅgam upalabdham, harivarāṅge 'pi tat-sambhāvanayaiva tt-saṃsargān niṣidhyate, tathā nīlādāv apariniṣṭhitanityānityabhāve tāvat kramākramau svadharmiṇā sārdham eka-jñānasaṃsargiṇau dṛṣṭau nitye 'pi yad bhavato nityagrāhiṇā jñānena svadharmiṇānityena sahaiva gṛhyeyātām iti sambhavanayaika-jñānasaṃsargadvāraka eva pratiṣedham āviśataḥ |

[103,18] kathaṃ punar etannitya-jñāne kramāder asphuraṇam iti, yāvatā kramākramakroḍīkṛtam eva nityaṃ vikalpayāma iti cetata eva bādhakāvatāraḥ, viparīta-rūpāvatāraṇaṃ vinā tasya vaiyarthyāt | so 'yaṃ nityātmani kramākramāropau bhavatas tadbādhakopanyāsaṃ prayojayen nāma, na tu nitye kramākramāv antarbhāvayituṃ prabhavati, virodhāt | kālāntaraika-rūpatayā hi nityatvaṃ, kramākramau ca kṣaṇadvaye 'pi bhinna-rūpatayā, tato nityasya kramākramikārthakriyāśakteś ca parasparapratyanīka-rūpatayā durnivāro virodha iti kathaṃ nitye 'ntarbhavaḥ kramādeḥ? anantarbhāvāc ca śuddhanityavikalpena dūrīkṛtasamāropeṇa katham ullekhaḥ kraṃākramasya? sarvasya ca vikalpamātragocararasya vikalpārūḍha-rūpāpekṣayā viruddhaniyatāniyatadharmavyavasthānaṃ, yathā triguṇyasyaikatvaṃ viruddhaṃ dharmaḥ prasādatāpadainyakriyā niyatā, nairātmyetarayogo 'niyataḥ, tathehāpi pūrvāparakālayor ekātmatayā yady akārakam akārakameva, sarvadā kārakatve ca kārakatvam eva nityaṃ, kramākramau tu kadācit kriyāśaktisvabhāvau, yaugapadye hi vyaktam ekadaiva karaṇam iti kādācitkakriyatvam, krame 'pi kṛtāyāḥ kariṣyamāṇāyāś ca karaṇāt kādācitky eva kriyā, sahakāryapekṣāyāḥ kṣiptatvāt | tataḥ kādācitkākādācitkakriyatvayoḥ parasparaparihārasthita-lakṣaṇatayā virodhaḥ siddhaḥ | evaṃ sati pratiyogini nitye vikalpyamāne eka-jñānasaṃsargi-lakṣaṇaprāpte viruddhasyānupalabhyamānasya kramākramasyatad-upalabdhir evānupalabdhiḥ | saiva vārthakriyāśakter vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ | tasmād vyāpakadharmy-upalabdhitayā na vyāpakānupalambhāntarād asya viśeṣaḥ | yadica dharmitve 'pi vastv-avastutayā vibhāgo bhāgyahīnasaya bhavato matimadyāpi duḥsthayati, vastuny api dharmiṇi ekatra pradeśaḥ kaṭhino dharī drava-rūpam anyatra msĀ p.17|8 jalam ityādayo vibhāgā bhaṅgavantas tadanviṣyantaḥ kena vāraṇīyāḥ? tasmād vastv-avastutayāpi bheda-cintā kopayoginī?

[104,14] nanu mahānasyā upayogaḥ | tathā hi vastuni dharmiṇi paramparā tat-pratibaddhaṃ vyāpakānupalambha-lakṣaṇam anumānaṃ pramāṇam pramāṇabhājanībhavati, vastv-adhiṣṭhānatvāt pramāṇavyavasthāyāḥ | na caivam avastuni śakyam iti cet,

[104,16] kiṃ tāvat paramparayāpi vastunaḥ sakāśād āgatatvam eva vastv-adhiṣṭhānatvam tadā kramākramasyārthakriyāyāś ca vyāptigrahaṇagocaravastupratibaddhatvam asyāpi na kṣīṇam, dharmivikalpavastupratibaddhatvaṃ vā | atha vastuni kenacid rūpeṇa vyavahārakāraṇatvaṃ vastv-adhiṣṭhānatvam? tad api kṣaṇabhaṅgivastu-sādhanopāyatvena pratiṣṭhitam asya, tasyaiva vā dharmivikalpasya vastuno 'vastūpādānatvavyavahārakāraṇatvena dharmivastunaiva tu vastv-adhiṣṭhānatvam iti kim anena? yadi caiṣa grhaṇa eva tat kim anumāna eva vastv-adhiṣṭhānatvaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ vā? na pratyakṣe, loṅgāśrayaṇam eva hi dharmi-cintām avakāśayati | tadanāśrayaṃ tu pratyakṣaṃ vastuna āgataṃ vastu-nimittavyavahārakam ity eva vastu-adhiṣṭhānam, evam anumānam api tathaiva vastv-adhiṣṭhānam iti gṛhyatām | kevalaṃ pramparayā pratyakṣasyāpi hi janmaiva sākṣāt, vyavaharaṇaṃ tu vialpādivyavadhānenaiva | anumānasya punar ubhayam api parmparayā | vyavahāraṇam api smṛtyabhilāṣādinā vyavadhānāt | evaṃ vastv-adhiṣṭhānatvam anumāne vyavadhānena dūṣaṇam eva | kevalam anumāne 'py anyatra sādhyadharmāpekṣayā yad vyavadhānaṃ tato 'tiriktam idaṃ vyāptigrahaṇāpekṣaṃ varata iti dhāndhyaṃ dhiyaḥ | tatrāpi na sarvo 'numānāntarasādhāraṇo 'yaṃ dharmaḥ | svasādhye hi sākṣāt pratibandham avadhūya viparyayavyāptyā gamakatvaṃ kāryakāraṇavyapakānupalabdhiṣu |

[105,7] tadvad vastv-adhiṣṭhānatvam api yadi yathoktavyavadhānena viṣayaviśeṣe bhavet kīdṛśo doṣaḥ, kasyacid bādhakasyābhāvāt? dharmivikalpāpekṣayā tu na tāvato 'pi vyavadhānasya sambhavaḥ, msA43a 6A_03 asādhāraṇī ca pratyāsattidharmiṇo vikalpākāreṇa sahaikīkaraṇāt | nirākārapakṣe 'pi hi vikalpāyattaprakāśatvād alīkanityākārasya dharmiṇaḥ | tasmād dharmiṇo vastv-adhiṣṭhānaparyeṣaṇaṃ pratyāsattiviśeṣāśrayatayā vikalpavapuṣāpi kṛtārthī-bhaved iti na doṣaḥ kaścit | ayam eva nyāyo na vaktā bandhyā-suttaś caitanyābhāvāt, na kharaṃ kharaśṛṅgaṃ dravyatā-viyogād ityādau yojyaḥ, nāvastuni virodhaḥ pratītyaviṣayamsĀ p.19|8tvād ityādau ca śaraṇam |

[105,15] yadi pratītimātrāpekṣayā pratītyaviṣayatvaṃ tadā asiddhiḥ anubhavāpekṣayānekāntaḥ | ity evaṃ prakāradūṣaṇaparihāraśaktiḥ, na punar āśrayāsiddyādidūṣaṇagaṇagaṇanā kācit | etena vyāpakānupalabdhau hi vyāpyābhāvo 'nyaḥ pratipattavya iti helayāpahastitam, dharmirūpasya bhinnasya pratipattiviṣayasya pratipādāt, gaṇḍśale vṛkṣatvābhāvena śiṃśapātvābhāvavat | tad evaṃ na prakṛtavyāpakānupalambhasya svarūpāsiddhiḥ, nityakramayaugapadyayoḥ virodhapratipādanāt | yad āha, kramākramavirodha iti, tad vyāpakadvāreṇa punar arthakriyā-virodhād ity āha | nāpy āśrayāsiddhir avastuno 'pi dharmitvapratipādanāt, vikalpena pratipattipratipādanāc ca | ata eva śāstre,

tasya dharmiṇi pratyakṣato 'numānato vā prasiddhiniścayaḥ

ity utsargasya parair anutpādyāpūrva-rūpaṃ nakhādikaṃ sakṛt śbdādyahetutvādikam avastuni sādhyasādhanapratijñānam apavādo veditavya iti vyaktam etat |

na hīdan tayā nāśasya svarūpam upalabdhigocaraṃ yenānvayavyatirekaniścayāt kāraṇābhimatamudgarādi sannidheḥ prāk nāśākhyaṃ kāryam abhavat tāvan taṃ kālaṃ bhāvasya sthairyam āpādayet yāvatā nāśyasya svabhāvānupalabdher mṛṣaiva kalpaneyam iti kutaḥ kāraṇānupalabdhyā sthairyasiddhiḥ?

dṛṣṭas yāvad ayaṃ ghaṭo 'tra ca patan dṛṣṭas tathā mudgaro dṛṣṭā karparasaṃhatiḥ paramato 'bhāvo na dṛṣṭo 'paraḥ | tenābhāva iti (43b) śrutiḥ kva nihitā kiṃ vātra tatkāraṇaṃ svādhīnā palighasya [: prari°] kevalam iyaṃ dṛṣṭā kapālāvaliḥ || dṛṣṭas tāvad ayaṃ ghaṭo 'tra ca patan dṛṣṭas tathā mudgaraḥ dṛṣṭā kharparasaṃhatiḥ paramato 'bhāvo na dṛṣṭo 'paraḥ | tenābhāva iti (43b) śrutiḥ kva nihitā kiñcātra tatkāraṇaṃ svādhīnā kalaśasya kevalam iyaṃ dṛṣṭā kapālāvalī || [= 118,24-27 ] palighasya,
sunipuṇaṃ nirūpayanto 'pi māṃsa-cakṣuṣā vayaṃ tāvan nāparam atra vastu-jātam īkṣāmahe, msĀ p.17|9 yad abhāvaśrutyā viṣayī-kriyate | tad-darśanābhāvāc ca tatkāraṇam api kim avadhārayāmo, yad abhāvena pūrvapūrvam asan nāśa iti syāt? yaś ca tatkāraṇaṃ kalpito daṇḍas tasyāpy anvayavyatirekānuvidhāyinī kapālapaṃktir eva dṛṣṭā, nānyā kācit | vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntatayeyam upanyastā punaḥ, yatheyam adhyakṣānupalambhābyām anvayavyatirekāv anubidadhatī dṛśyatayā

ayam arthaḥ | yathā vegavan mudgaraprahārāt pūrvaṃ ghaṭasya nāśo nāstīti pratipādayituṃ śakyaṃ bhavatas tat-svabhāvabhūtāyāḥ kapālapaṃkter adarśanāt, tathā nābhāvaparamparāparicayo 'pi nāstīti śakyam | na hy abhāve 'pi kapālapaṃktir evocyate, yena svabhāvānupalabdhir avalambanaṃ tad-vad eva syāt | atha nāśavad abhāvo 'pi kapālapaṃktir evocyate, tadā kvacid deśe kumbham ekam apanīya kumbhāntaranyāse katham abhāvavyavahāraḥ, kapālāvaler abhāvāt? asti ca kathañcid bhedam ākalayataḥ tatrāpy abhāvavyavahāraḥ ekasyānyasya sādṛśyavipralabdhasya prācīnāvasthānavyavasāye 'pi, tat kathaṃ kapālapālir evābhāvaḥ? tad asyāṃ dhvaṃsaśabdaṃ saṅketayato yadi pūrvaṃ dhvaṃso nāstīti śakyam apy abhidhātuṃ, kapāladaśā-virahāt, abhāvas tu nāstīti na śakyam, sadṛśāparasambhavena dur-upalakṣaṇāt | tasmāt prahārāt prāg-abhāve 'pi kumbhasya sambhāvyamāne siddham abhimatam asmākam | dṛśyānupalambhānavatāraṇaṃ nāma, ato na karparāṇāṃ dhvaṃsasaṃjñayopayogaḥ | na cānyan mudgarānvayavyatirekānukāri dṛṣṭam iti vyavahāramātraparāyaṇa eva nāśo na vastuto 'sti |

pūrvārdhena naṣṭaghaṭabuddher janmasāmagrīm ādarśya paścārdhenādhikasya nāśanāmno nānvayo na vyatirekas tad-vivekasāmagryās tūbhayam anukṛtaṃ bhaved iti darśitam | tatra nāśākhyaṃ na kiñcid iha sāmagryāṃ nimittam astīty anvayo nirastaḥ, na cāsyāṃ satyām api sāmagryāṃ kadācin na syād buddhir iti vyatirekāvalambanam apāstam | pūrvaṃ tarhi kasmān neyaṃ buddhir iti vyatirekapratyayāśātanaṃ śeṣena | yadi purāpy eṣā sāmagrī syāt, niyatam iyaṃ bhavantī buddhir arthāntarasāpekṣatāṃ sūcayet | na ceyaṃ sāmagrī purāpy asti, vikalakapālapaṃkteḥ parighapātādi-kāraṇābhāvenābhāvāt | tat kuto vyatirekamāram api | uktasāmagryās tu na vāsyām api syād eṣā na kadācid iti niṣedhadvayenānvayaḥ | śeṣeṇa vyatirekaś ca vyaktaḥ | tad buddhy abhāva kāle sāmagryā evābhāvapratipādanād asau sāmagryabhāvo buddhyabhāvavyāpta ity arthaḥ | yas tu pratyakṣetarasahakārisākalya-rūpatayā sarvaiva sāmagrī parokṣeti samarthyate viṣamadṛṣṭiḥ tataś ca parokṣatayā tasyā nānvayavyatirekaniścaya ity ucyate, hanta hutavahendhanādisāmagrī-pratibandho 'pi dhūmāder astamita iti apravṛttinivṛttikaṃ jagat prasajyeta | tasmān nādṛṣṭābhupagame dṛṣṭasādhanasāmarthyapratirodhenety alaṃ vistareṇa | tad ayaṃ ghaṭāmarśavataḥ kapālānubhava eva naṣṭaghaṭāvasāyasādhana iti siddham |

arthāpattir ato gatā kṣayam iyaṃ na dhvaṃsasiddhau prabhuḥ

[110,1] svabuddhyā rajyate yena viśeṣyaṃ tad-viśeṣaṇam |

kālabhedena pūrvāparakālayor nāśabhāvayor abhāvāt kena kaḥ syāt | kvacit pratītiviṣayīkriyate | na ca bhāve sthitidharmo dhvaṃsaḥ, kiṃ tu pradeśe | na cānyatra sthitaḥ anyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ, daṇḍavat | bhedād evam api syād iti cet | bhedetarhi sarvānya-rūpavivekena pratibhāsamānam eva viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyaṃ svānuraktapratītiviṣayīkuryāt, na svarūpeṇāpratibhāsamānaṃ, daṇḍavad eva | anumānasiddhenāpi daṇḍena daṇḍipratītir utpādād anekānta iti cet | na, sarvamsĀ p.17|10thā yasya na svarūpāvabhāsa ity abhiprāyāt | daṇḍasya punar anumānakāke 'pratibhāsane 'pi niścāyakābhimata-liṅgena saha sambandhagrahaṇakāle 'sty eva svarūpanirbhāsaḥ | tatas tadanusmaraṇād anumānakāle 'pi tadrūpānuraktāṃ buddhim ādadhīta daṇḍaḥ | na ca sarvathā adṛṣṭadaṇḍasya daṇḍo 'py anumānabhājanaṃ svarūpānuraktapratīti-hetur vā dṛṣṭapūravaḥ | evaṃ nāśanām apy arthaḥ kathaṃ tathā syāt, sarvathā adarśanād iti | na ca daṇḍānumānād bhinnā daṇḍipratītiḥ, daṇḍo 'tra daṇḍo 'sya daṇḍavān ayam iti cānarthāntaratvāt | na ceyaṃ liṅgatyāge (44b) na bhavantī pratijñā-mātratayānumānaṃ bhavatum arhati, yan naṣṭapratītir api nāśanāmārthasādhakaṃ niścayam apekṣamāṇā kathaṃ svayam eva sādhanatvenābhidhīyeta | na cānya-liṅgam asti sarvathā adṛśyatayā tasmin kasyacit pratibandhāsiddheḥ | ata eva hi sarva buddhis tat-siddhaye śaraṇam āśrīyate | ato 'numānasiddhenānekāntaḥ | anumānasyāpi viśeṣaṇasvarūpanirbhāsanānantarīyakatvād apṛthak-siddheś cānumānaviśeṣaṇapratītiyor iti,

[110,17] yasya na svarūpanirbhāsas tan na kasyacit svānuraktapratītinimittam, yathā karikeśaraḥ | nāsti ca sva-rūpapratibhāso dhvaṃsasyeti vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ |

[111,9] atha viśeṣabuddhyaiva pratibhāso 'pi sādhyaḥ, yathā hi na daṇḍi-buddhir daṇḍabuddhim antareṇa tathā daṇḍapratibhāsam antareṇāpi, evaṃ naṣṭabuddhir api viśeṣabuddhitvān na nāśaṃ nāśapratibhāsam antareṇeti katham apratibhāsaghoṣam iti cet | bhavaty eva vikāro na punar etādṛśaḥ | svasantānavartipratibhāso 'smābhir apy anumānena pratipattavya iti ghaṭādipratibhāse 'py evam idānīm āyātam | tat kim ahaṃ paśyāmi kiñcid ity anumānam anāptavatā āptavacanenāpi pratyetavyam ity artham apratikurvāṇo 'pi vaidya kṛtārthaḥ syāt | antataḥ śapathenāpi nivṛttir ālambyeta | parokṣe hi viṣaye 'mīṣāṃ prakārāṇam avakāśaḥ, msA45a 6A_05 na jñāne | yat punar apaśyantam ātmanaṃ vedayamāna eva paśyasīti grāhyate vyaktam iyaṃ bhaṇḍavidyā paśyantam api vāhayati | yo 'py apaśyann api tad-vacanena paśyāmīti gṛhṇīta sa khalu paśor api paśuḥ | jñānaparokṣatā-vāde 'pi hi,

abyupagamyāpi brūmaḥ | astu vā nāśo nāma, na punar asyāvaśyaṃ pratītam eva janakaṃ mudgarādīti śakyam, yathā naṣṭaghaṭabuddher eva na pratītiḥ kapālānubhavo hetur iṣṭaḥ, tathā nāśasyāpi mudgarādiparihāreṇa kāraṇam anyad evādṛṣṭaṃ kiñcit syāt, yato na purā kāraṇānupalabdhisiddhiḥ | yathā adṛṣṭam eva nāśākhyaṃ vastu svīkārasiddhaṃ naṣṭabuddher nibandhabam, tathā nāśasyāpy adṛṣṭam eva kiñcit kāraṇaṃ na mudgarādīti kathaṃ tad abhāve niyamena nāśanivṛttiḥ | ayaṃ tu viśeṣo yathā mudgarasya kapāle kapālānubhavasya ca naṣṭabuddhāv anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ sāmarthyasiddhas tathā na mudgarasya nāśe na nāśyasya naṣṭabuddhāv iti, yadi paraṃ bhavad uparodhād ayam arthaḥ pratipattavyaḥ |

bhavato bhāṣaiva bhāvānyatā |

nātra bhāvānāṃ sāmarthyaṃ, kiṃ tu bhavata eva bhāratyā bhāvatā abhāvatā vā | tathā hi bhavatīti bhāvaḥ, bhavanaṃ cotpattis tāvad asya svīkṛtā | yadāpi astīti bhāvaḥ, tadāpi vidyamānatā bhāvārthaḥ | sāpi svarūpasattva-lakṣaṇā svīkṛtaiva nityatālaṃkṛtā yāvat | yac cāstīti na bhavati tat kim utpadyatinā sambadhyate bandhyā-sutavad aṅkuravac ca |

[115,1] atha sarvasāmarthyopākhyā-viraheṇābhāvavyavahārāt śaktir api sattvam anumanyate, sāpi sva-jñāna-janane 'bhyupagataiva, niḥ śaṅkagamanādikaṃ ca tatkāryam eva | svābhyupagataḥ sattvasamavāyaḥ svakāraṇasamavāyo vā paraṃ nāsti | na ca sarveṇa bhāvadharmeṇa sarvatra bhāve bhāvitavyam, nāpi sarvabhāvadharmābhāvena bhāvāntarasyāpi na bhāvatavyam | evaṃ sati sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyānām apy abhāvaprasaṅgaḥ | tebhyo 'py adhiko dhvaṃsasyotpattir evāparādhaḥ | vastu cāvaśyaṃ nāśo vasatyarthakriyā asminn iti na bhāva iti kaṣṭo vatāyaṃ siddhāntaviṣamagrahaḥ | tasmād bhavato 'tra svātantryam | yadi bhaṇasi dhvaṃso 'pi bhāvaḥ syāt, mudgarādir api kumbhasyābhāvaḥ syāt |

[115,9] na khalu mudgarādikaṃ bhāvam abhāvaṃ vā kaścid vyavaharatīti cet | nanu dhvaṃsam api yadi kenacid rūpeṇa jāyamānam upalabheta kaścid viśeṣato nityasthitaṃ kim abhāvaṃ vyavaharet | dṛśyante hi tanu-dhūmaādayo vyavadhānānavadhānādinā anupalabdhamūrtayaḥ punar upalabhyamānā bhāvavyavahārabhājaḥ | tasmād bhāvavyavahārahānir asādarśanād eva praty-ātmaṃ vedyate pratiyogidarśanasvabhāvāt | tac cādarśanam anubhavābhyupagame bhāva eva, anupalabhyatve tu janmādi-kīrtanam ākāśa-citraṇam | svarūpa-janmanor upalambhe tu bhāvavyavahāraḥ prasahyāyāta iti katham asyāpi virodhitvam | na ca mudgarādāv apy abhāvaśabdāpravṛttir eva, bhāvāntaraparyudāsena tat-siddheḥ | na cātiprasaṅgo, dhvaṃsavat | yayā hi pratyāsattyā dhavaṃsākhyam eva vastu ghaṭasya nivṛttir ucyate, tasyā na karparaparighayor vighātaḥ | virodhitvam api tayor eva ramaṇīyam, aṇīyasāpy aṃśena darśanākhyena tayor utkarṣāt | yayoḥ satoḥ kumbhābhāvavyavahāra itiy asyātiprasaṅgasaṅgamād bhṅganimittasya puṣṭatvāt | na ca bhāvo bhāvāntaravirodhī na bhavaty eva, katham anyathā gotvam agotvasya, dahanas tukinasya vā |
kiṃ ca virodho 'pi dvividhaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tatra, rodhaḥ so 'pi sahāsthitir yadi tadā bhāvadvayasyaiva sā dahanatuhinavat | avikalakāraṇasya bhavato 'nyabhāvo 'bhāvād dhi sahānasthānavyavasthānam | na ceyaṃ gatir bhāvābhāvayoḥ sambhavatīti vyaktam |

[116,1] naikenānyahatiḥ parasparaparīhārasthite lakṣaṇe ||

na khalu alākṣaṇikavirodhasya sad vastu-bādhanavyāpāraḥ, kiṃ tu sahānavasthānasyaiva, lākṣaṇikasya tu dharmayor eva vyavasthānāt | vyavasthita eva vastuni vastunā avastunā vā svarūpasaṃkaravyatikara- niṣedhaḥ | tato yathā nīlam-anīlaṃ na bhavati ubhayor anyonyasvabhāvatvāt, tathā kalasanāśayor api syāt | na ca tāvateṣṭasiddhiḥ mudgarasannidhimātra iva tasya tādavasthānapāyāt |

[116,7] nanu kalasakuliśādau dharmayor eva virodhāt tadadhyāsitasya bhedamātram, kalasanāśau tu bhāvābhāva-rūpatayā svayaṃ viruddāv iti kathaṃ saha syātām |
na, bhāvābhāvayor hi bhavanābhavana-rūpatayā dharmayor eva parasparaparihāraḥ, yato na bhāvādhyasitasyābhāvo 'bhāvādhiṣṭhitasya vā bhāvaḥ, yato vā kumbhanabho 'mbhor uhāder naikatvam | virodhamātraṃ tu na vāryate, kevalam ekena bhavatā bhavataḥ paribhave sati | tāvatā ca sahānavasthānavyāpāraḥ | tasmād dharmayor eva parasparaparihāraḥ | nīlānīlayoḥ katham iti cet | nīlānīlayoḥ parasparaparihāra iti naikatvam anayor ity evārthaḥ | tato dharmavirodha evānenāpi prakāreṇa prakāśyate | anyathā tuhinahutabhujor iva nīlānīlavāsasor api militayor anavasthitiprasaṅgaḥ | tādātmyaṃ tu tadāpi nāsty eva |

[116,17] deśo 'pi nīlānīlayor bhinna eveti cet | kāmaṃ bhinnaḥ, na tu vastunor virodhaḥ tāvatā deśabhedena kṛtārthaḥ | anyathā jala-jvalayor api tad-vad eva militayoḥ prabandhasthitiḥ prasajyeta, sūkṣmadeśaparihāreṇa virodhasya phalavattvāt | ata eva viruddhopalabdhau kalpitaikabhāvaḥ sthūla eva deśo dharmī | evaṃ nīlam anīlatvena virudhyata ity api nīlam-anīlaṃ na bhavaīty evārthaḥ |

[116,22] yadi tu dharmidharmayor api sākṣād virodhaḥ syāt, tadā yatra dharmiṇyanīlatvaṃ tatra nīlatvaṃ na syāt | asti ca yathā ratnāntaraṃ tapanīyamātre, tathā nāśasyābhāva-rūpadharmamātratve 'pi bhāvadharmā ghaṭo nāsann abhāvadharmā ca na sann ity evārthaḥ, tataḥ

[117,1] siddhenābhāvena dharmeṇāsann eva ghaṭo 'sann iti vyavahriyate, na tu sann eva nivartyate | sattā-nivartate tu sarvatra sahānavasthānavyāparaḥ | kathaṃ punar ghaṭasyābhāvo dharmaḥ | kasya punar asau dharmo 'stu | dharmatvena svī-kārāt dharmiṇo 'vaśyam ākṣepātkṣmātalasyaivāstu iti cet | tataḥ kiṃ bhūtalasyaivābhāvo(47a) vivakṣitaḥ |

[117,5] nanu ghaṭasya nivartyanivartakabhāvasambaddho 'bhāvo bhūtalasya dharmamātram ucyate, na tu bhūtalasya nivartaka iti cet |
bhavatu bhūtalasyānivartakas tad-dharmo vā kevalam, yathā nīlaviruddhānīlatvayukte bhūtale nīlavastu-sthitir aviruddhā, tathā gaṭaviruddhābhimatenābhāvena yukte 'pi ghaṭasthiter avirodhaḥ syāt, tato 'bhimānamātravyavasthita evaiṣāṃ nivartyanivartakabhāvaḥ | tasmād bhūtale kalasasyābhāva iti bhūtalādhārasya ghaṭasya sambandhitvenābhāsayantī vikalpabuddhir abhāvaṃ tad-dharmatvena vyavahārayatīti nyāyyam | adhyavasitāpekṣayā tu saṃvādetarau tad evaṃ parasparaparihāraviruddho dharmaḥ svaviruddhasyāsata evāsattām-ātmadharmiṇi vyavahārayati | na tu nivartayatīti dharmiṇo bhedavyavahārahetur eva | tathā ca jalānalādiṣu sparśasyoṣṇetaratvaṃ dūre 'pi pratyanīkākāravattayā anyonyāpanayanam anapekṣya svarūpavimarśamātreṇa virodhavyavahāragocarībhavati | sahānavasthānaṃ punar ekenānyasya, sattā-nivartanadarśanād eva vyavasthāpyate | tad yadi sahānavasthānam abhimato virodhaḥ, tadā sidhyatu bhāvasya sattopalambhayor nivṛttiḥ | kevalaṃ bhāvayor evāsau na bhāvābhāvayoḥ |

[117,17] nanu tasmin sati tan-nivṛttir itīyatā sahānavasthānam abhimato virodhaḥ, tac cābhāvenāpi bhāvasya labhyata iti na bhāvayor eveti yukto niyama iti cet |
uktam atrāsmin satīty eva durlabham abhāve iti | kiṃ caivam abhāvatvasamarthanam upayogi, bhāvayor api tad-virodhasyāvirodhāt | mudgarādinaiva virodhasiddheś ca dhvaṃsasyānupayogāt | atha lākṣaṇiko virodha iṣṭaḥ, tadā svarūpāsaṃkareṇaaiva tasya kṛtārthatvāt bhāvasyāvasthānam anivāryam |

[117,23] kiṃ ca, sahānavasthāna-lakṣaṇapakṣe nānupapannena virodhinā paro viroddhvyaḥ, śītahutāśavat | prathamam utpattiḥ, tato vyāparaḥ, vyāpārapāṭavatāratamyāpekṣayā kiyatāpi kṣaṇena paroparodha itīyan taṃ kālamuparodhāt prāg-abhāvena saha saṃvaset |

[118,1] athotpatti-kṣaṇa eva vyāpāras thāpy utpadyamānena dhvaṃsena sahakāriṇā bhāvaḥ svopādeyaṃ bandham ādadhīta, tato nivṛttir iti durnivāraḥ sahabhāvaḥ | bandhakṣaṇādhānānapekṣāyām api svasantānakṣaṇānantaraṃ nāśanāt kṣaṇam api sahabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | etac ca kathaṃ cetanā-vataḥ soḍhuṃ śakyam ekasminn eva kṣaṇe bhāvasya bhāvābhāvāv iti |
api ca sahānavasthānasvīkārāt kṛśānunā śītam iva dhvaṃsam aparam utpādayatā dhvaṃsenāpi nipādi nivartanīyam iti tenāpi dhvaṃsam aparam utpādayatā pratiyogī pratihantavya ity anavasthānāt puruṣāyuṣaśatenāpi na kasyacid abhāvavyavahāraḥ syāt |

[118,8] atha dvitīyo (47b) virodhaḥ, tadā yatra bhāvas tatrābhāvasyāvakāśa eva nāsti | ayam eva hi lākṣaṇikavirodhasya svabhāvo yad viruddhayor dharmayor anyatrādhiṣṭhite dharmiṇi netarasyāvakāśa iti anutpattir eva dhvaṃsasya |
atha hetu-sāmarthyāt katham abhūtvā āsituṃ śaknotīty avaśyaṃ bhāvyaṃ dhvaṃseneti cet | na, pramāṇabādhite 'rthe hetu-sāmarthyakalpanānupapatter atiprasaṅgāt | yāvat khalu bhāvasya śvāsaḥ calati na tāvad abhāvagandhaḥ | anyathā viruddhābhimatayoḥ dharmayor ekatra dharmiṇi kṣaṇam api sambhave kva parasparaparihāravirodhaḥ | tathā hi hetu-balād bhavatu nāma, sahabhāvas tu vastyny ekatra bhāvābhāvayor duṣ-pariharaḥ | sa hi bhāvaḥ pūrvavyavasthito, na bhavanaprayāsakhinno yan nivarteta | mudgarādeś ca dhvaṃsa eva vyāpāraḥ | ubhayatra vyāpāre 'pi kim aṅga dhvaṃsena | nāpi dhvaṃsenaiva nivartanīyaḥ, tasyodayāt pūrvam avyāpārāt | tato bhāvasya sthitir abhāvasyotpattir iti siddhaḥ sahabhāvaḥ, girer iva kāśariṇotpadyamānena |

[118,20] paścāt tarhi barhi-ṣevendhanadhvaṃsena nirākariṣyate tāvad iti cet | bhāvābhāvayoḥ bhāvābhāvayoḥ sahabhāvaprasaṅgadūṣaṇād avibhyadabhyastadurnītir uttaraṃ kila vilapati | paścād vidhvaṃsena bhāvo nirākariṣyate na vā, bhāvābhāvayos tu sahabhāvaḥ prasakta ity eva pakṣakṣatir āyātā | kim aparagaveṣaṇena | yadi ca vyavasthito bhāvas tena dhvaṃsena dhvaṃsanīyaḥ, tadā vyaktam ayaṃ sahānavasthānavirodhavyāpāra iti prakṛtakṣatiḥ | parasparaparihāravirodho hi vicārayitum upakrāntaḥ | tataḥ prakaraṇavismaraṇād vyutthāpayaty adyāpi parasparaparihāravirodhābhimataḥ, tadā na vyavasthitāpanayanavyāpāraḥ spraṣṭavya iti drāghīyānasahabhāvaḥ |

[119,2] samprati svahetu-balāvalambinoḥ kalasanāśayor upanatau bhāvābhāvau caikatra dharmiṇi dhīyete ciram iti paryavasitaṃ virodhakathayā |
atha dhvaṃsena svodayāt prāg eva bhāvo nirbadhyamāno nivartate pravartate cānantaraṃ dhvaṃsa iti noktadoṣaḥ | na caiṣa vyāpāraḥ sahānavasthānasyeti cet |
na śakyam evam | vyavasthite hi vatuni,

paścāt pravartamāno 'pi dhvaṃsātmā tasya kiṅ-karaḥ |
apravṛtte yat astv asmin vastv eva balavat-taram ||

vyāpāras tu yathā naiṣa sahānavasthānasya tathā parasparaparihārasyaāpīti niveditam etat | nāpi bhaviṣyataḥ kācic chaktiḥ | svayam eva tarhi nivartatām | evaṃ sati kim atrānyena dhvaṃsena mudgareṇa | tat-sannidhānāpekṣāyāṃ ca svayaṃ śabdārtho riktaḥ | yathā bījam apekṣya svayam eva jāyate 'ṅkura iti na tāvatā tat-prayuktatvaparihāraḥ | atha parihāra eva, tadā tadapekṣyeti na vaktavyam | tāvatā ca siddhaṃ sādhyam ity anena kim iha (48a) kartavyam | dhvaṃsa mudgarādikam anapekṣya svayam eva bhāvo nivartata iti prāg api nivṛttisiddhiḥ | vastu-mātrānubandhī ca dhvaṃso nibandhanāntaranirapekṣa iti,

[119,16]sahasthānābhāvo yadi tava virodho 'rthavipadoḥ
sahasthānāsaṅgaṃ kṣaṇam api yathā śītaśikhinoḥ |
sahadhvaṃso dhvaṃsāntaram upanayan samprati bhaved
virodhī so 'py anyaṃ kṣayam iti na nāśaḥ katham api ||

[119,20] athānyonyābhāvaprakṛtikatayā 'rthe sati tadā
kṣayasyaivābhāvaḥ saha bhavatu vā hetu-balataḥ |
anena dhvaṃsena prakṛti-hatir asya tv anudaye
balīyān evārthaḥ svayam apacaye 'nyena kim iha ||

iti saṃgrahaślokau ||

[120,1] etena yat śaṅkarasyābhavanotpattividhānena kathaṃ bhāvasya niṣedha iti cet?
abhavanotpatter eva saha sthitivirodhena bhāvapratiṣedha-rūpatvād ity evaṃ prakāram abhidhānam, tad-virodhabodhavaidhuryādi-yuktam iti darśitam | ata evābhāvotpattividhānena ca bhāvasya tādavasthyaprasaṅga iti pramattabhāṣitam ity abhidadhānaḥ sphuṭam ayaṃ tapasvī prativātakṣiptabhāsmānātmanam eva cchurayatīti mahā-mohamagnatayā kṛpāpātraṃ mahātām avagantavyaḥ | yadi evaṃ bhavatām apy abhāvo vyavahriyate sa kiṃ svabhāvo yadi na vastu bhāvena vā satyaṃ na virudhyata evāyam | kathaṃ vā virodhadvayavyavasthā | ko vāsya hetuḥ | kādācitkatve akādācitkatve ca bhāvasya saṃkālaṃ kathaṃ na vyavahriyate | kathaṃ vā prāg iva paścād api na kṣaṇapramparāprasavaḥ | prasave ca na shaḥ sahānavasthānavirodhaḥ |

[120,10] parasparaparihāro 'pi bhāvābhāvayor abhāvasyāvastutvenāvāstavaḥ prāpta iti cet |

yat evaṃ paramataṃ vicārakṣamam,

tasmāt pracyutimātrakaṃ vyavahṛteḥ pātraṃ prasajyāhvayaṃ bhūyo 'rthasya viruddhyate na tu janis tasyeti kiṃ hetunā |

rodhād eva sakṛn na tad-vyavahṛtir hetu-kṣayām nodayo
rodhas tāttvika eva tāttvikamithaḥ svābhāvyabhaṅga- sthiteḥ ||

[120,16] bhāvapracyutimātraṃ prasajyapratiṣedhasaṃjñākam iti svarūpanirdeśaḥ | tatra 1pratiṣedhe pratiṣedham eva vastv-icchantīti pracyutimātram uktam | pracyutir nāma kiṃsvit tṛtīyo bhāvaniṣedha iti śaṅkāyāṃ prasajyāhvayam ity uktam, tac ca tathā vyavahāramātraviṣayo na punar anubhavaviṣayaḥ anyathā vastv eva syāt |

[120,20] na ca yat kiñcid vyavahriyate vikalpabuddhyā tāvad vastu, kharaśṛṅgāder api vastuprasaṅgāt, nirvastukavikalpavyavasthānupapatteś ca | tac cābhāvasya bhūtyā dharmeṇa virudhyata eveti dvitīyapraśnavisarjanam | bhūtiś ca sattārthasāmarthyaṃ, svarūpeṇāvasthānaṃ vā | ubhayathāpy anyonyapratyanīka-rūpatayā pracyutimātreṇa virudhyata iti parasparaparihārasthiti-lakṣaṇavirodhavyavasthoktā |

[121,1] nanu pracyutimātraṃ na kiñcit, tac ca kathaṃ (48b) kenacid virudhyate |
yata eva pracyutimātraṃ na kiñcit, bhāvas tu nañ-arthapratyanīkas tata eva virudhyate | virodho 'py eṣa nānyonyapratighātaḥ, sattānavasthānavat, kim tv anyonya-rūpānanupraveśamātram | tac ca vikalpitānubhūtayor apy astīti na doṣaḥ | pracyutimātrasya ca kadācid bhāvatvābhāvāt kiṃ hetuneti caturthe visarjanam | kenacid rūpeṇonmajjato hi janakaḥ kalpyeta, akādācitkaṃ ca sarvadāsti vā nāsti vā | tatrāstipakṣakṣepāt sarvadā nāsty eva tat | vyavahāras tu kādācitkaḥ, bhāvakāle tad apravṛtteḥ | kathaṃ virodhād eva | bhāvavirodho hy abhāvaḥ pracyutisvabhāvaḥ kalpanā-viparivartī kathaṃ bhāvakāle vyavahriyate | bhāvadharmā hi nirhetuko vā, bhavanahetu-janito vā, hetv-antarakṛto vā bhāvakāle 'pi bhaven nāma, bhāvānvayaṃ ca vyavahāram asyāsādayet | yadā tu nāsya bhāvo na tadā bhāvānuyāyī vyavahāraḥ | vāsanānugas tu virodho niścayavato vastu-darśane vāsanā-prabodhavaidhuryāt kathaṃ pravarteta |

[121,13] ata eva yāvat sa eva vastv-ātmāstīti vyavasāya, tāvad anavakāśa evābhāvavyavahāraḥ, kṣaṇabhaṅgabhāve 'pi tattvataḥ | yadā tu pramāṇabalād ekakṣaṇasthitadharmaiva bhāvasvabhāva ity avadhārayati tadā dvitīye kṣaṇe tad-vastūpādeyakṣaṇasamakālaṃ tadabhāvaṃ vyavaharati | tat-pramāṇālābhe tu karparādivikāradarśanam apekṣyaivābhāvavyavahārā iti pañcame visarjanam | ṣaṣṭhe 'pi hetu-kṣayān nodayaḥ sajātīyakṣaṇadhārayā iti |

[121,18] etad uktaṃ sva-rasanirdheṣu pūrvapūrvakṣaṇeṣu mudgarasahakāriṇā kṣaṇe sāmāgrī-vaisadṛśyād bandhyakṣaṇasyotpādanād upādānaṃ kṣīṇam iti nāparasyotpattiḥ | yat kṛte ca kasyacid bandhyakṣaṇādhāne sajātīyakṣaṇāntarāpratisandhānam, so 'pi bhāvas tasya bhāvasya virodhī siddha iti sahānavasthānavirodhavyavasthā | tenaiva saptame 'pi caturthapādena yadi nāma vastv-avastunoḥ parasparaparihāro virodhaḥ tathāpi na tāttvikatvahāniḥ | na hi tayoḥ kadācit svabhāvasāṅkaryam asti | etāvān eva dharmavirodhasyārthaḥ | ata eva sthitigrahaṇaṃ niyamasūcanaparam | etena tṛtīyo 'pi vikalpo nirastaḥ | tasmān nāśo nāma na prasajyātmā kartavya-rūpo yato hetu-sāpekṣaḥ syāt, nāpy etāvanti dūṣaṇānīti sthitam ||

[122,1] kiṃ cārthasya vinaśvaretaratayoḥ kiṃ nāśane kāraṇaiḥ svayaṃ vinaśvarasvabhāvasyotpattau vaiyarthyam anarthahetūnām, avinaśvarasvabhāvatve tv asāmarthyam |

evaṃ tarhi bhaviṣṇutetaratayoḥ kiṃ kāraṇair janmani |

śakyaṃ hi vaktum arthasya bhaviṣṇutāyāṃ vyarthā janmahetavaḥ, abhaviṣṇutāyām asamarthā iti |

[122,7] tathā ca nyāyabhūṣaṇakāraḥ | tan na, hetu-vādocchedaprasaṅgāt, vikalpasya sarvatra sambhavāt | tathā hi hetutaḥ kiṃ bhavanasvabhāvo bhavatvāhosvid (49a) abhāvasvabhāva iti | yady ādyaḥ pakṣas tadā svayam eva bhavati, tat-svabhāvatvād iti vyartho hetuḥ | dvitīyapakṣe tv asamartho na hy abhāvasvabhāvaṃ śaśaviṣāṇādi kenacid utpādayituṃ śakyam | tathā cchedadāhādi-hetavo 'pi tat-svabhāvatva-'tat-svabhāvatvapakṣayoḥ vaiyarthyāsāmarthyābhyām anupapannā draṣṭavyāḥ | tathā caivaṃ sarvahetupratikṣepasambhavān mokṣādau prayāsaḥ śāstraśravaṇādau vyartha iti,

[122,13] atrāyaṃ paryanuyujyate | kim anena mūle paraśu-nipātaprakāreṇa | sarvathā kvacid api hetutayopanīte 'sāmarthyavaiyarthya-lakṣaṇaṃ dūṣaṇam eva na vācyam ity ucyate | tat-tāvad ayuktam, dṛśyate hi nakha-cchedye kuṭhāravaiyarthyam, kutṭhāra-cchedye ca nakhasyāsāmarthyam | tathā devadattenaiva yat sādhyaṃ tatra devadattasahāyasya yajñadattasya vyāpāravaiyarthyam | tad-vinākṛtasya punar asāmarthyam | dahanendhanasāmāgryāṃ satyāṃ rāsabhasya dhūme vaiarthyam asatyām asāmarthyam | yatra vā sidhasādhanapoṣaṇaṃ tatra vaiyarthyam | asiddhaviruddhānaikāntikeṣv anyatamasattve asāmarthyam iti | ye tu siddhasādhanasyāpy eteṣv antarbhāvam icchanti, tat-prayāsaphalaṃ na kiñcit, vaiyarthyasya hetu-dūṣaṇasya sarvathāśakyāpahnavatvāt, jñāpakahetor api pratītiṃ prati kārakatvāc ca | yadi cāsāmarthyavaiyarthyam adūṣaṇaṃ hetor anyadūṣaṇābhāvāt sarvasya sarvasiddhir yataḥ kutaścit |

[123,1] atha tat-svabhāvātat-svabhāvavikalpadvārakaṃ dūṣaṇam asad ity ucyate, tad apy asat | pradīpe hi yo hetuḥ prakāśakaraṇe 'ndhakārakāraṇe vā upanīyate, sa kiṃ vaiyarthyāsāmarthyābhyāṃ na nigṛhyate |
yat punar ayam evāha, prakāśādidṛṣṭānto 'py ayuktaḥ | tathā hi na tāvad asman-mate pradīpaprakāśādīnām ekatvaṃ siddham, nāpy ekahetutvam | dravyotpattyanantaraṃ hi sāmagryantarataḥ prakāśādayo guṇā utpadyanta iti naḥ siddhānta iti |
tad apy asambaddham | yataḥ yady api dravyotpattyanantaraṃ prakāśo guṇā utpannaḥ, tathāpi tad eva dravyam utpannaṃna tadrūpaniṣpattau hetv-antaram apekṣate, paścād vā prakāśo guṇo na prakāśaguṇa-rūpatve iti na dṛṣṭāntakṣatiḥ |

[123,10] atha dravya-rūpam api dravyatvasāmānyāt tat-samavāyāt pūrvaṃ na dravyaṃ nādravyam iti cet |
tat tarhi dravya-rūpaṃ dravyatvasāmānyāt jñāyate, atha dravyam iti vikalpavacasor vā gocarībhavatīti pakṣaḥ | prathamapakṣe tāvan na doṣaḥ | sāmānyād eva dravyaṃ jāyatāṃ yataḥ kutaścid yenātmanā jātaṃ na punas tadbhāve hetv-antaram apekṣata iti hi prakṛtam | dvitīyapakṣe 'pi sutarāṃ na doṣaḥ, dravya-rūpaṃ hi jātam eva prāg api dravyadhī-dhvaniprasava eva sāmānyāt, na caitāvatā tadbhāve hetv-antaram apekṣitaṃ bhavati | na hi kāryeṇa kāraṇasya svaviṣayasāmarthyavyavahāre prāg aniṣpannam(49b) eva tat-sāmarthyaṃ tadbhāve vā kāraṇam, tad eva kāryaṃ hetv-antaram apekṣitavat |

[123,18] kiṃ ca, bhinnena paścāt jāyamānenāpi prakāśaguṇena yadā tāvat prakāśaguṇayuktaḥ sampanno dīpaḥ, tadā kiṃ punas tadbhāve hetv-antaram apekṣate yato dṛṣṭāntakṣatiḥ syāt | tan na prakriyā-poṣaṇatrāṇam apramāṇaparāyaṇena | anubhavānurodhena tu yathābhimatam eva dṛṣṭāntaḥ | na hi prathamadvitīyakṣaṇayoḥ sāmanyayogāyogābhyāṃ viśeṣapratītir asti | nāpi dravyasāmānyayor bhedānubhava iti prakṛtasya tv anyathāpi siddher nātra nirbandhaḥ | tasmān na prakāśaḥ svahetoḥ prakāśa-rūpaniṣpannas tadbhāve hetv-antaram apekṣate, vaiyarthyāt | andhakārī-karaṇe 'py asāmarthyād iti siddham |

[124,1] nanu śulkam[=śuklam or śukram] ambaraṃ rāgadravyayogena raktī-kriyāmāṇam upalabdham, tatra raktasvabhāvāsvabhāvatve vastrasya vaiyarthyāsāmarthye codyaṃ rāgadravyasya kiṃ nopakramyata iti cet |
na khalv asya vikalpasya sarvatrāvatāro vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tu tat-svabhāvātat-svabhāvavikalpadvārakam api dūṣaṇaṃ hetor asti tāvad ity atyantāyoganiṣedha upakrāntaḥ | tato yatraitad dūṣaṇam upapādayituṃ śakyate, tatra dūṣaṇabhāvam āviśati | kim anya-cintayā yadi yukti-bhedaḥ | tathā ca vinaśvaratvaṃ nāma kṣaṇikatvaṃ kanīyaḥ kālatvaṃ vā | avinaśvaratvam api drāghīyasā kālena sadāshāyitayā vā | sarvathā yāvatkālāvasthitiko bhāvaḥ svahetor udapādi [=udayādi] tadabhyantare yadi kenacin nāśyeta, tadā yāvat- kālāvasthitir eva notpannaḥ | na hi saṃvatsrasthāyī cāsau divasanāśī ceti svabhāvadvayaṃ parasparaviruddham asya sādhu |

[124,10] nanu vināśakāraṇam antareṇa saṃvatsarasthāyī, avāntaraṃ tu vināśakāraṇasamavadhāne 'vāntaranāśīti ko virodhaḥ |
virodhe eva niścaye hi yady arthānupraveśo na svabhāve, yathā yady atra patrapāte dhūmaḥ sambhaven niyatam iyam aṅgārā, anyathā tu guñjāpuñja iti na svabhāvabhedaḥ | tathā yadi divase vinaśyati tadavadhikam eva hetunā janitam, saṃvatsaranāśe tu tadavadhikam iti bhavatu | na tu parasparavirodhisvarūpe dvitīyasyaikatra samuccayaḥ | na hi tatrāhani vinaśyann eva saṃvatsarasthāyī, ardhārdhena vā tad ubhayaṃ bhavitum arhati | vikalpas tu saṃśayātmā jñānasyaiva, na vastuno dharmaḥ | tasmād vastv-ekasvabhāvam eva na viruddhasvabhāvāntarayogi | etac ca divasādisthāyitvaṃ pramāṇena nirūpaṇam arhati satyaṃ naveti | abhypagamya tu cintitam etat, pramāṇavyāhate hetu-sāmarthyāśrayaṇasya durlabhatvāt | tato yady akṣaṇikatāpu tathāpi yāvān asya kālaḥ sthiter avadhis tadabhyantare hetv-antarasyāsāmarthyaṃ tasya purastād vaiyarthyam iti sthitam | kṣaṇikatve 'pi na tatkṣaṇe nāśakāraṇena kiñcit śakyam iti vyaktam, kṣaṇāntare tu svayam eva nāstīti nārtho 'narthahetunā | sadātane tv asamartha evāyam |

[124,23] tasmād vināśe kartavye na kaścit hetur asāmarthyavaiyarthyadūṣaṇam atikrāmati | yadārthāntare tu karparādau sa eva mudgaras tābhyāṃ dūṣaṇābhyāṃ na lipyate, tad-vyāpārānantaram eva janma-lābhāt karparasya, evaṃ rāgadravyasyāpi tad-vyāpārāntaram udayabhājiraktavāsasi nāsāmarthyavaiyarthyam |

[125,1] pāṇḍu-caṇḍātakanivartane punaḥ kas tan nivartayati | yadāpi daśādvaye ekam eva vastravastu tadāpi tad doṣānativṛttir eva | na hi raktāvastāyām api śubhram eva tad iti nirvahati | tato yadi tadāpi śubhram eva tad vastu na raktāyā avakāśa ity asamarthyaṃ rāgadravyaṃ, pūrva-rakte tu tan-mātra-rāgāpekṣāyāṃ vyartham | tasmāt sthairyāpekṣayā doṣāvatārāt samayāparādha evaṃ-vidho na vastunaḥ | pūrvasya sva-rasanirodhe tad-upādānāpekṣayā rāgadravyeṇāpūrva-raktavastrotpādane tad-doṣasya parihārasiddheḥ |

[125,6] naivaṃ vastu-sthitir iti cet? nanu tad eva cintyate kīdṛśī vastu-sthitir iti | kim atra kośapānena paraḥ pratyāyanīyaḥ | tat kim akāṇḍenaivaṃ vastu-sthitir iti ucyate, pratyabhijñā-prāmāṇyāvalambanasya nirastatvāt |
nanu samayāparādho 'pi katham abhidhīyate, vyavasthite dharmiṇi guṇadvayasya tiro-bhāvāvir-bhāvasvīkārāt |
yady evaṃ tadā prācīnaguṇanirākaraṇo 'sāmarthyavaiyarthyaprāptāv apy apūrva-raktā-guṇotpādanenaiva caritārtho rāgadravyavyāpāra iti katham uktadūṣaṇasparśaḥ | pūrvaniṣpanna-rūpāpekṣayā hi vaiyarthāsāmarthya-cintā prakrāntā nāpūrvāpekṣayā | na hy apūrve 'pi kartavye yady evaṃ rūpaṃ svahetor jātaṃ tadā vaiyarthyam, evaṃ jāte tv asāmarthyam iti nirṇayāvakāśaḥ | nāśanīyaś ca sarvaḥ pūrvasiddha eva bhāvaḥ | sa ca vinaśvaretarayoḥ, prakārāntaratiraskārad anyatarasvarūpam anativartamāno na vināśahetoḥ kalpitasyāsāmarthyam ānarthakyaṃ vā sthātuṃ prabhavati | na caivaṃ hetu-vādocchedaprasaṅgaḥ saṅgataḥ | asiddhe hi kārye hetor āśrayaṇam, siddhe ceyaṃ cintā | tadaiva ca yadi hetor evaṃ rūpo niṣpanna iti hetupuras-kāreṇaiva vādapravṛtteḥ | na caivam asiddhe śakyam ity uktam | tatkathaṃ prakṛtāsmad vikalpasya sarvatra sambhavaḥ | vikalpamātrasya sarvatra hetuphalasaṃmate sambhave 'pi nāsmadīyayukter aparādhabodhaḥ kṛto bhavati |
yadi tu siddhe 'pi vastuni vyāpakasvabhāvadvaye 'sāmarthyavaiyarthyāvatāre 'pi hetv-antaram apekṣamāṇam upadarśayituṃ śakyate syād aparadhaḥ |
na caivam | tasmād vikalpamātrasyāparādhe nāparādaḥ saviśeṣaṇasya, anupalambhavad iti vyarthaḥ tan-mātropanyāsaḥ |

(50b) athānupalambhamātrasya svasādhyasādhanasāmarthyaśūnyataivāparādhaḥ, vikalpamātrasya punar asāmarthyavaiyarthyollekhaśekharasya na hetu-vādāpavādaśakti-śūnyateti viṣama upanyāsaḥ | aho puruṣakāro bhasmabhūṣaṇasya! evaṃ hi sarvathā hetuphalāpalāpe sādhu sādhitaṃ dhvaṃsasya hetu-mattvam iti vyaktam ayam ātmānam-ātmanaiva viḍambayati | tad ayaṃ bhāvasvabhāvādivikalpaḥ saṃkalpaniveśitaśaktir api viṣaye ca parihāryaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvavyavasthitena, anyathā mūlocchedāt prakaraṇapravṛtteḥ | siddhopādhis tu vikalpo vināśakaraṇam eva kavalayati, na kāraṇamātram | atiprasaṅgabhaṅgabhīruṇā tu bhavatā nādriyate iti yuktam evaitat | tasmāt

hantuṃ hetuphale śramo 'yam aphalaḥ saṃsthāpya sāmānyata-
tattvaṃ kvāpi vimarśa eva viṣaye prārambhasambhāvitaḥ ||

prārambha upakramaḥ prastāvaḥ tena sambhāvita ādṛtaḥ | sāmānyena kāryakāraṇabhāvasattāṃ vyavasthāpya vināśādau viṣayaviśeṣe kvacid dhetu-sattā kim astu na vety atra vimarśa eṣo 'smadīyaḥ prastāvānurūpaḥ | hetuphalonmūlanāya tu viphalaḥ prayāsaḥ, sāmānyena vyavasthāpyaiva prakaraṇapravṛtteḥ | na cāyaṃ vikalpaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvakṣepāya kṣamaḥ bhavanasvabhāvo 'bhavanasvabhāvo vā hetuto bhavatīti | tathā hi abhavanadharmā tāvad bandhyā prasūtīti bhavanasvabhāvaś ca, tvan-matena gaganāder abhavanasya kadācid apy abhāvāt, tayos tāvad asāmārthyavaiyarthyagrasto bhavati hetu-vyāpāraḥ | kādācitkaṃ bhāvaṃ bhavanadharmāṇam abhavanadharmakaṃ vā brūhi, na punar ayaṃ kiñcid anapekṣamāṇaḥ kādācitka eva bhavitum arhati, yaś cāpekṣo 'rthaḥ kāladeśasvabhāvaniyamāya sa eva hetuḥ | atha bavanasvabhāva iti na sattā-dharmā kiṃ tu utpattidhrmeti vivakṣitam, tadāpy utpattir ity asata ātma-lābho na kādācitkatvād anya iti tad-vad evottaram | vināśasya tu kādācitkatvaniṣedha uktaḥ |

[126,21] atha hetuto bhavanadharmā yaḥ sa kiṃ bhavatītaro veti vikalpārtho | tadā ādyavikalpa eva viśrānto vādaḥ | tathā hi hetuto bhavati, na pūrvam iti na vaiyarthyam, bhavati hetuto nānyato bhavati kuto 'sāmarthyam | atra ca nirbandho bandhya iti diṅ-mātram abhidhīyate, ubhayoḥ siddhatvāt hetuphalabhāvasya aprasutatvāc ca | yataś cāyaṃ siddhopādhiko vikalpaḥ san-nāśasyaiva hetor bādhako nāsad-utpādakasya, asamānatvāt nyāyasya yathoktaṃ prāk | tataś chedadāhādi-hetavo raktadukūlakāraṇavad upapannā eva, mokṣākhyadaśāviśeṣahetuś ceti saphala eva tatra prayāsaḥ | tasmān na sato nāśahetuḥ kaścit | svahetuta eva tāvad deśākāravat kālatayāpi niṣpattiḥ ||

[127,7] (51a) kiṃ ca,

dhvaṃso vāstu vidher balāt parighavat yat vā yathā
śarkarā bhāvo 'sau tadavastha eva tu na yatkiñcitkarās tasya te |
vyāpārāviratis tataḥ kṣaṇinaye dattvād abandhyaṃ kathaṃ
deśākāravad asya hetu-niyataḥ kālo 'pi yasmān mataḥ ||

yathā hi mudgaraḥ śarkarā-nikāro vā yas tasmāt syān mataḥ, nāśahetor anupapatteḥ notpattir nāśasyety uktam | astu vā nāśābhidhānam arthāntaraṃ kāraṇabalāt | daṇḍavat śarkarā-raktā-nāśe 'pi koṣāntarakam adhiṣṭhāya tiṣṭhatu, santu bhāvās tadavasthā eva, na hi tasya kiñcitkarāḥ | yathā hi mudgaraḥ śarkrā-nikaro vā tasyākiñcitkaraḥ, anyathā nāśābhyupagamavairyarthyaprasaṅgāt, tathā nāśo 'pi sthitam iti bhāve svakāraṇād utpadyamānas tasya kim aṅga kartum asamarthaḥ | yathā hi tasya hetu-balabhāvino na sarvathā nāśaḥ śakyo vāsāmarthyavaiyarthyābhyām, tathānurūpāṃśe nāśo 'py aśakya eva | tatrāpi svabhāvabhede pūrvavan naśvaretaravikalpasyāvatāravāraṇābhāvāt, niraṃśe 'pi ca vastuni kalpanānurodhād etad ucyate | tattvatas tv aṃśanāśane 'pi sarvathā nāśa eva, sa cāśkya iti sādhitam apūrvanirvartanam | vastutas tu vāryate | tataḥ yo 'py apūrvaḥ pūrvavat koṣāntaratirohitaḥ kalpam āstāṃ tatkṛto vā punar aparo nāśābhidhāno 'rthas tad-vad astu | na tu bhāvasya kiñcid iti sva-jñāna-janana-jaladhāraṇādivyāparānuparamaprasaṅgo durnivāraḥ |

[128,1] etena yad avocad Vācaspatiḥ, nanv asminn utpanne 'pi bhinnamūrtau kim āyātaṃ bhāvasya | na kiñcid āyātam, astv ayam āyuṣmān bhāvaḥ | svakāraṇādhīna-janmanā tadabhāvena tat-svarūpaviraha-lakṣaṇena svalakṣaṇaśālinārthānurūpavyavahāraṃ pravartayatā nirastasamastārthakriyā kiṃ naśchinnam iti,
tad apahastitam, samastārthakriyā nirasanasyaiva tadavasthe tasminn aśakyasādhanatvāt | tadabhāvenaiva tādavasthyakhaṇḍanam iti cet |
nanu bhāve tāvat tadāvastha eva svakāraṇaprabhāvād abhāvo jātas tato vyāvṛttya tatkhaṇḍanam anena kartavyam iti samasamayatā-prasaṅgaḥ prācīno duṣpariharaḥ | tathā ca sati tat-svarūpaviraha-lakṣaṇenety anupapannam, na hi tad-viraha-rūpatve tatkālasambhavo nāma | tato mudgarādipadārthāntarasādhāraṇasya abhāvasaṃjñākaraṇe nābhimatasvalakṣaṇaśālitābhivyaktisiddhiḥ, yataḥ tadanurūpavyavahārapravartanam abhidhīyamānaṃ śobheta | tena ca svarūpasyārthakriyāyāṃ tādavasthyasya cākhaṇḍanam iti parasparākarṣī nāśāntarakaraṇaprasaṅgaḥ |

[128,13] svayaṃ nivṛttirūpatayā na nāśāntarāvakāśa iti cet | na, samānakālasambhavat nivṛttirūpatāyāḥ pratikṣiptatvāt, padārthāntaravat paryudastam eva rūpam avaśiṣyate | tena ca vināśena niyataṃ parabhūtavināśākhyavastu-karaṇaṃ mudgareṇeva, ko hi viśeṣo 'sya tat-paryudasta-rūpatvena mudgarāt, tad ayaṃ param-anapekṣamāṇa eva nāśayati | mudgaras tv enam anapekṣamāṇo nāśa iti syāt | vināśasaṃjñākaraṇapratilambhas tu bhavet | tām antareṇa tasyāpi mudgarād aviśeṣāt, ākārabhedamātrasya maṇimātrādiṣv api bhāvāt |

[128,19] yadi tu pratyakṣānupalambhaṃ śaktisādhanam ekaniyataṃ bhaved, bhaved viśeṣaḥ | tac ca nāstīti pratipāditam || tasmāt,

prasajyapakṣe 'sti na tulyakālatā na paryudāse paranāśavarjanam |
athite 'nyad anyatrabhavad bhavet sakṛtan niyogato 'nyakṣaṇatānurodhini ||

iti saṃgrahaḥ |

[129,9] sthite 'pi hetau bhavad ekadā na cet? prayojanaṃ tatkṣaṇabhaṅgasambhavāt |
sthitena kiṃ vyomni samakṣaṇaṃ phalaṃ phalena nāśo 'pi yathaiva lakṣyeta ||

ity antaraślokaḥ |
yadi tu nāśākhyaṃ kāryaṃ na tasya nivartakaṃ kiṃ tv anyad eva daṇḍādi, tadā bhavaś ca nivartate, abhāvaś ca pravartata iti bhavati kālabhedaḥ, kiṃ tu nopayogo nāsasya | nāpi tadabhāvena nirstasamastārthakriyā iti vācyam | asāmarthyavaiyarthyaṃ ca prastutam | tato 'pi rikteyaṃ vāco yuktiḥ |

[129,13] yat punar atra tenotprekṣitam | yathoktaṃ svahetuto bhāvo naśvaro 'naśvaro vā jāyate iti, tatrocyate | na vayaṃ vinaśvaram aniśvaraṃ vā jānīmaḥ, santaḥ svahetubhyo jāyante, dhvaṃsante ca hetv-antarebhyaḥ svapratyayādhīnasannidhānebhyaḥ, dhvaṃsaś ca dhvaṃsamānād bhinno hetu-bhedataḥ svabhāvabhedāc ceti, tatrāpy ucyate | yadi naśvarānaśvarasvarūpam avidvān eva bhavān evam āha, tadā kva nāśo nāma padārthaḥ | kuto vā vyāvṛttyā bhavati vyavasthāpyo yo dhvaṃsamānād bhinnnaḥ sampraty eva pratijñātaḥ, sa idānīṃ vinaśvarāvinaśvarasvarūpāparijñānena vyavasthāpyamāna ākāśādiṣv api kiṃ na vyavasthāpyate |
teṣu nāśādarśanād iti cet | nanv anyatrāpi nāśo nāma dṛśyata iti śapathagamyam etat | tato vinaśvaretarasvabhāvāviṣkaraṇaṃ bhavataḥ prasahyāyātaṃ kim atra śa[pa] thena | tathā ca sati svahetor eva tad-tadrūpa-janmani niyatāvatāram asāmarthyavaiyarthyadūṣaṇaṃ paśyato 'pi tatra hetv-antarapratijñānaṃ katham iti vayam api na jānīmaḥ | athedamākūtaṃ vaidarbhyagarbhayā girā pratyakṣata eva kutaścid utpādaḥ kutaścin nāśa upalabhyamāno vinaśvaretaravikalpena katham apohituṃ śakyaḥ | na hi pratyakṣasiddhaṃ vikalpaśatenāpi śātayiyuṃ śakyam, sarvapramāṇavyāpārasya pratyakṣ eva viśrāmād iti ||

[130,3] tatrāpi nāśa iti yadi padārthāntaraṃ svasamayaprasiddham ucyate, yo mudgarādi-janmā ghaṭādipadārtham arthaḥ kadarthayati, tasya janmavyāpārau pratyakṣagocarav iti mahas-sāhasam ity upapāditaṃ prāk | tat kathaṃ na vikalpāvakāśaḥ |
atha naśyataḥ svayam eva rūpaṃ bhedāntarapratikṣepeṇa tan-mātra-jijñāsāyāṃ pṛthag ivādarśyamāno nāśo 'bhipretaḥ, tathā ca dhvaṃsante hetv-antarebhyaḥ ity abhītvaivoktam | evaṃ tarhi daṇḍādibhyaḥ kuṇḍādayo vinaśyanti, na svayam iti siddhāntaniṣṭhāyāṃ dhvaṃsaś ca nirastasamastārthakriyā ity api suptavikalpitam eva | tat kim anayā Vācaspatiḥ (52a) abhipraitīti na vidmaḥ | evaṃ tarhi yāvati pratyakṣavyāpāraḥ tāvato 'pi katham apahnavaḥ | kiyati cāsau pratyakṣavyāpāraḥ | utpadyamāne ca hetv-antarād dhetv-antarān nirudhyamāne ca bhāve tad-utpatti-hetor vināśahetur anya iti siddham |
na ca nāśo nāmānyo yataḥ pratyakṣagocara-codyāvakāśa iti | dhig etat!vināśasya bhāvād ananyatve tad-dhetur bhāvahetur eva, bhāvahetur eva na bhāvotpatti-hetuḥ | tatkatham utpatti-hetor anyo vināśahetuḥ | kathaṃ ca pūrvaniṣpannasya paścāt tano hetuḥ | pūrvaparabhāvaś cāyam adhyakṣasiddha eva

[130,17] kiṃ cotpadyamānaṃ nirudhyamānaṃ ca vastv-ekam anekaṃ vā, ekatvaṃ tāvad viruddhadharmādhyāsād ayuktam | atha pratyakṣeṇa tathā vyavasthānāt kiṃ kurma iti cet, ekapratyakṣeṇa ekadaikādhārayor upalabdhau sādhur avirodhaḥ, nīla-catur-asratāvat | yadā tu bhinnakālam adhyakṣadvayam ekaika-rūpagrāhi, tadā pratyabhijñānamātram eva 10 miśrayati | tac cāpramāṇam ity uktam | tato viddhadharmādhyāsād bheda eva | ekatra tu kṣaṇe vibhāgābhāvān na virodho vyāvṛtti-bhedamātreṇaikatra bhāvāt | tathā hi sa eva bhāvakṣaṇaḥ prāg-abhāvād utpadyamāna ucyate, paścādbhāvān nirudhyamāna ucyate |

[131,1] na, vyāpakadvāreṇa virodhasyaiva siddheḥ | prathamakṣaṇe 'py utpadyamāno bhāvo vā bhāvavikṣaṇāntarāvathānena vyāpto na prācīnāvasthitiṃ kṣaṇam api spṛśati, nirudhyamānaś cāsau caramakṣaṇe prācyakṣaṇāntarāvasthānena vyāpto, na ca bhāvinīm avasthitiṃ kṣaṇam api spṛśatīti virodha eva | kṣaṇe punar ekasminn eṣa vibhāga iti vyāvṛttimātrabhedo na virodhaḥ | tasmāt kṣaṇadvayam api sthitivivakṣāyām udayanidhanadharmayor virodhān naikatvam | anekatvapakṣe ca prācīnaṃ vastu mudgarādiparigaṇitavināśahetu-vyatirekeṇāpi nirudhyamānaṃ svahetor eva niyatakālasthitidānasāmarthyam uddīpayatīti na vināśahetuḥ kaścit | athāparigaṇitā eva vināśahetavaḥ, tatra durupalakṣaḥ kaścid dhetur anirjñāyamānaḥ svanibandhanaṃ nidhanam ādadhītīti kim ayuktam, evaṃ tarhi pratikṣaṇam api vināśasambhāvanāyā na pracyutir iti vyarthaṃ vināśahetu-vyavasthāpanam | parigaṇitasya hi bhūyo lakṣaṇasya hetoḥ prasiddhapradhvaṃsa-lakṣaṇāt prāg-abhāvaniścayena vināśavyavasthā mā bhūd iti sahetukatvaṃ vināśasya sādhayitum ārabdham | sūkṣmatayā tu durupalakṣaṇasyāpi hetoḥ svīkāre prayatnavaiyarthyam āyātam ity alaṃ mithyā-vikalpena | tasmāt sthitimati vastuni sarvasyākiñcitkaratvapratipādanāt santaḥ svahetubhyo jāyante dhvaṃsante ca hetv-antarebhya ity arthapadam etat | tat kutaḥ idaṃ maṇimantrāuṣadham indra-jālaṃ bhāvena śikṣitaṃ yad ayam avikalānyadarśanapratyayas tadavastha eva kadācid adhyakṣaḥ (52b) atyakṣaś ceti |

[131,17] nanu kṣaṇikanītāv evāyaṃ doṣa ukto yuktaś ca | yad āha śaṅkaraḥ – na hi bhāvasya nivṛtter utpattim antareṇa prāg iva paścād api svarūpahāniḥ, yenāyaṃ tadaivānupalambhaviṣayo na pūrvaṃ hānau vā paścāt saivāsya nivṛtter utpattir iti |
tad ayuktam, kṣaṇikapakṣe hi prāg iva paścād api na svarūpahānir iti sāhasam etat |
nivṛtter utpattim antareṇa svīkriyamāṇāpi svarūpahānir asaṅgataiveti cet |

[131,21] nivṛttyādināmnaḥ padārthāntarasyotpattiḥ bhavatu mā vā bhūt, yata evāsau kṣaṇasthitiniyato 'rthaḥ, tata eva kṣaṇāntaram avyāpnuvan kṣaṇāntare nāstīty ucyate, sa evārtho bhāvasya kṣaṇāntare nāśo jāta ity anena vacasocyate | nāpūrvavastūtpādo vidhīyate | chandato hi vacasāṃ pravṛttiḥ | arthas tu nirūpaṇīyaḥ | tatra yady ekakṣaṇādhīnatayā kṣaṇāntare niyatasattāvasāyasiddhiḥ, tāvataiva caritārto vināśavādaḥ, kim atra kasyacid utpattiparyeṣaṇayā | na hi gṛhe eva devadatto 'stīti sarvatrānyatra vastv-antaram abhidhānanirodhabodhanam iti nyāyaḥ |

[132,3] tatrāpi pradeśāntare 'bhāvavidhir astīti cet |
astu, tad artham eva niyamanibandhananipātaprayogāt | kevalaṃ kiñcid vastu vidyamānam utpadyamānaṃ vā na pratītipathaprasthāyi, niṣedhamātrasyaiva pratīteḥ | tāvataiva ca devadattam anusarataḥ pravṛttinivṛttipāṭavam āpanīpadyate | vastv-antarapratītāv api hi vihitāyāṃ gṛhād anyatra yāvan na niyamānusāreṇadevadattasya prasajyātmānaṃ niṣedham avasthāpayati tāvan na susthaḥ | tasmād aspṛṣṭavastu-rūpam abhāvamātram avaśyapratipādyam |

[132,9] na cānyatra nāstīty anena vastu-rūpaṃ kiñcid vidhāya tad eva param asti na devadatta iti kramavatī pratītir anubhavaviṣayaḥ, yathā gṛha evāstīty anena nānyatreti | bhavatu caivam, tathāpi paścād abhāvamātrapratītyaiva viśrāmaḥ | anyathā parāpravastu-rūpapratipattāv eva puruṣāyuṣam upayujyet, na prakṛtaniṣedhabodhasiddhiḥ | tasmād yathātra niṣedhamātraṃ mandirād anyatra devadattasya vyavahriyate, tan-mātram eva ca devadattasyānyatrābhāvaḥ pratītigocara ity-ādi vyavahārasyāpy arthaḥ, tathā ekatraiva kṣaṇe 'sti bhāvaḥ, kṣaṇāntare nāsti | kṣaṇāntare tasyābhāvaḥ pratīyata iti niṣedhamātram anyatra kṣaṇe khyāpyate, na vastu-rūpasaṃsparśaḥ | nāpi tadapekṣā-niṣedhasiddhaye 'pi | evaṃ svarūpahānir ity api niṣedhamātravyavahāra eva | tatra ca na kasyacid utpattyā sattayā vopayoga iti katham ucyate nivṛtteḥ utpattim antareṇa svarūpahānir iti | ata eva hānau vā paścāt saivāsya nivṛtter utpattiḥ ity api pravāhāpātaḥ pātakavat parihāryaḥ | paścāt svarūpahānir ity api hi paścān niṣedhavyavahāramātram, na tu (53a) kasyacid vastu-rūpasyotpattir iti | sa ca niṣedhavyavahāro devadattasyaivānyatra kvacit sattā-niyamapratibandhād avyavasthitasaṃvādī |

[132,22] etena yat nyāyabhūṣaṇo 'py āha, ko hy evaṃ śraddadhīta pratyutpannāvasthāyām eva san bhāvaḥ paścāt tv asan, na ca paścān naśyatīti | tatrāpi kaḥ punar evam āha, na paścāt naśyatīti | yadi paścān naśyati tadā paścān nāśotpattiḥ svīkṛteti cet | yadi tvam eva vacasām artheṣu svāmī |

[133,1] syād etat | dvidhā tv arthasthitiḥ, pramāṇānusāriṇī samayānusāriṇī ca | prathamāyāṃ paścān naśyatīti paścād asann iti vyavahriyata ity evārthaḥ samarthitaḥ | ataḥ pramāṇaparāyaṇena katham abhidhātuṃ śakyaṃ paścād asan na ca paścān naśyatīti | dvitīyāyāṃ tu na virodhaḥ | yasya hi paścān naśyatīti paścān nāśotpattir iṣṭā taṃ prati paścād asan | na san vyavahartavyo na ca paścān naśyati | na cāsya paścān nāśavastūtpattir iti katham aśraddhā-viṣayaḥ |

[133,6] tad apariniṣṭhārthatattvavacanavibhramamātreṇa grāmya-janamanohareṇa samayanirvāhamanoratha iti kaṣṭam | tasmāt svahetor ekakṣaṇaniyatasthitir udbhūd bhāva ity eva nānyadā san, na tu kasyacid utpattyā hetos tu tādṛk sāmarthyaṃ kiṃ sambhāvanā-viṣaya iti yadi cintayasi, tadāpi yadi janane sāmarthyaṃ tadāvaśyaṃ kenacid rūpeṇa kāryam utpādayan kṣaṇamātrashāyināpi rūpeṇa kiṃ notpādayet | sarvaṃ tu rūpam aspṛśan kāryaṃ kuryād dhetur iti kasya śraddhā-viṣayaḥ | tato yathāyaṃ bhāvo niyatadeśo niyatavastu-saṃsthānādy-ākāraḥ svahetor eva samutpadyate, tathā niyatakālo 'pīti kim asambhāvyam atra | na ca deśādiniyamena svarūpasaṃkocam abhāva eva bhāvasya bhāvayatīti vācyam | na hy abhāvo bhāvam utpannaṃ vā saṅkocayet | kāraṇena saha sambhūya saṅkucitam eva cotpādayet | atra pakṣe pṛthak pauruṣa-rahitaḥ kāraṇasāmagryantarbhūto 'bhāvo 'pi nāma yadi bhāvasādhakaḥ kaścid upapādayituṃ śakyaḥ, kiṃ naśchinnam | yādṛśī tādṛśī vā kāraṇasāmagrī kāryaṃ kuryāt | yathā tu niyatadeśākāraṃ kurute tathā niyatakālam api kurtuṃ kas tasyāḥ śaktividhāta iti brūmaḥ, yatas tadartham arthyate parotpattiḥ paścāt | prathamapakṣe 'pi kiṃ tāvat sa bhāvaḥ svahetor viśva-rūpa utpanno niyataḥ kriyate 'bhāvena | na vā kenāpi rūpeṇa niṣpannaḥ kenacid vā niṣpanna eva na tu deśākārakālair iti vikalpāḥ |

[133,22] antyas tāvad ayuktaḥ | yena hi rūpeṇa niṣpannaḥ sa eva tasyākāraḥ, sa ca na kvacid bhāvam antareṇa, kvacid bhāvo 'pi na kadācid abhavata iti katham ākārādiparihāraḥ | mā bhūt tathaivaṃ kevalaṃ kenacid rūpeṇotpādayituṃ śaknuvataḥ svahetor anyatra kim ālasyam īrṣyā vā, pramāṇenaikatra śaktiniyamānirvāhāt | madhyamīye tu kiṃ-kṛtaḥ kāraṇabhāvaḥ, rāja(53b) prasādo vā |

[134,1] ādye 'pi kalpe sakala tri-bhuvanākāra-cchedanasahābhāvakarṣiṇaḥ kṣaṇāntarāvasthiti-cchedanamātre aṇīyasi kārye paryāloca eva nāsti | tato deśādisaṅkocakāriṇaivābhāvanāmnā pūrvasiddhena siddhe kālasaṅkoce 'pi kim akāraṇam anyaḥ kālāntarabhāvī kāraṇāntarāpekṣaḥ siddho yaḥ sthāyī gaveṣyate ity uktaprāyam |

[134,6] praty arthaṃ bhedo 'bhāvasyeti cet | sarvathā 'nupalabhyasvabhāvatve sāhasam etat | ato vyomādeḥ sarvadharmanirmāṇavat sarvato vyāvartanam api kiṃ neṣyate | na ca prācīnam evaṃ vyāpārabhāvam anubhavaḥ kṣamate | tasmāt svakāraṇād eva deśādiniyata iva kālaniyato 'pi jāta iti na sthirapakṣavat kṣaṇikapakṣe 'pi vīkṣaṇādiprasaṅgaḥ, bhāvasyaivābhāvāt | sthirapakṣe tu cāsti tadavasthś ceti na nivarate prasaṅgaḥ padārthāntarotpattāv api tasya tatrākiñcitkaratvāt | aprastutābhidhānaṃ ca bhāvanivṛttau prastutāyāṃ vastv-antarodayavarjanāt |

[134,12] nanu bhāvanivṛttau prastutāyāṃ nivṛtter udayo 'padiśyate iti kim aprastutam atra | nanu tāvad eva nivṛttiḥ prasajyātmā yāvan nodayopadeśaḥ | udaye tu tat-paryudastavastv-antaravidhānāt punar arthāpattyā nivṛtty-ākṛṣṭiḥ, na tu saiva nivṛtir-vastutvād eva, anyathātiprasaṅgāt | yat tu śaṅkaraḥ, bhāvād bhāvāntaravad arthāntaratvāviśeṣe kathaṃ sa eva tasyaiva nivṛttir iti cet | atra vastu-svabhāvair uttaraṃ vācyaṃ yeṣāṃ svahetubhyaḥ sahasthitivirodhenaivotpattiḥ, na hy arthāntaratvād anyatra sahasthitivirodhābhāve bhāvatan-nivṭtypr api tasyābhāva iti nyāyam, tayor eva sahashitivirodhasya pramāṇena siddhatvāt | na hi yathā kaścid arthāntaratayā anyeṣām ahetur evaṃ svakāryasyāpi mā bhūt tādṛg etad apīti |
etad eva nyāyabhūṣaṇo 'pi, tad api dvividhasyāpi virodhasya ghaṭanād apāstam | yadi ca virodhād arthāntarasyāpi nivṛtti-bhāvo varaṃ mudgarasyaivāstv ity api darśitam | na ca pratyakṣam anumānaṃ vā nivṛttau pravṛttam | tad-virodhaś ca pramāṇasiddho 'vaśyavaktavya iti sundaram |

[135,1] vahnidhūmādau tu hetuphalabhāvaḥ pramāṇasiddha eveti nārthāntarodayavarṇane 'pi tan-nivṛtti-khyātiḥ | tasmāt,

agner arthāntarotpattau bhavet kāṣṭhasya darśanam |
na tasya kiñcid bhavati na bhavaty eva kevalam |

iti duratikramo nyāyaḥ |

[135,8] yat tu nyāyabhūṣaṇaḥ, yadi tasya na kiñcid bhavati tataḥ pratiṣedho 'pi na tasya bhavatīty apratiṣiddhasvarūpas tadavasthatvāt prāg ivopalabhyeteti, prāg eva parihṛtam etat | tathā hi pratiṣedho 'pi na tasya bhavatīti yadi pratiṣedhākhya 'pi padārtho notpadyata ity arthaḥ, tadā satyam etat, na tu tāvataivāpratiṣiddhasvarūpatvam arthasya, svahetutaiva kṣaṇāntare pratiṣiddhatāpratipādanāt | (54a) atha vācanikapratiṣedho vivakṣitas tadā kas tam apahastayati | kevalam atra pakṣe prāg ivopalabhyetety asambaddham, na hi yo yadā nāsti sa tadopalabhyaḥ | anyathā kānyakubjasthito 'pi pāṭaliputre dṛśyeta | māndhātā 'pi vādyopalabhyeta |

[135,15] nanv adya māndhātur abhāvas tena nopalambhaḥ | ko vai anyathā prāha | kevala-ṣaṣṭhī-nirdeśād bhedāvasāye 'pi na tato bhinnaḥ padārtho vidhīyate, yāvān evārtho māndhātādya nāsti tatkālaniyatasattākatvāt, tāvān eva māndhātur adyābhāva iti | nanu samānam etad api yāvān evārtho māndhātur adyābhāva iti tāvān eva māndhātādya nāstīti |
yad apy ucyate | tatkālaniyatasattākatvād iti, tatrāpi tatkāla evāstīti kālāntare abhāva eva pratipādyata iti kim atrādhikam abhihitam | uktam evaitat | tathāpy ucyate, bhedābhedanideśayor eka evaārthas tattvataḥ kevalaṃ yadi yadi bhinnavastu-siddhiḥ pramāṇabalāvalambinī, tadādya nāstīty asyāpi vākyasyādyābhāvo 'stīty ayam evārthaḥ |
atha bhinnavastu-bādhaiva pramāṇānvayinā, taābhāvo 'stīti tāvad astu | adyābhāvo jāta ity asyāpi vākyasyādya nāstīty evārtho veditavyaḥ | pramāṇānveṣaṇe ca dṛśyatayā svīkṛtasyādarśanam eva bādhakam uktaṃ ca sādhakaṃ ca kiñcin nety api | adyānupalambhe 'pi tatkālavartinaḥ kālāntare vastv-antara-rūpam aspṛśatā virahamātreṇa siddha[tvam] ity upapāditam na ca virahamātreṇeti karaṇaśaktinirdeśād vastutvapratyāśā, vivakṣā-paratantratvāt kriyākārakavyavahārasya,

yāti gandarvanagarād eṣa bandhyā-sutaḥ padā |
mṛgatṛṣṇāmbhasi snātvā pitre dātuṃ jalāñjalim ||

iti |

[136,6] sakalakārakaśakti-yoge 'pi vastutvābhāvāt sarvathā mithyedam iti cet |

vivakṣāparatantratā-mātreṇa dṛṣṭāntī-kṛtatvāt |

ka evaṃ sādhur abhidadhīteti cet | na ko 'py abhidhattāṃ prakṛtasiddher avirodhāt | na ca sādhor apy etat pāṭho 'sambhavī sarvathā kiṃ tat sādhur nābhidadhīteti tad-śurtavataḥ praśne tat-pāṭhamātreṇa sādhutā kṣater abhāvāt | kūrma-romṇāṃ tu mithyātvaṃ svīkṛtam ity api kim asādhunaiva vaktavyam | nāpi sarvathā mithyaivedam | tathā māndhātā nāstīti nādya sthīyate māndhātreti vā vyaktā kartṛ-śaktir na vastutāṃ pratyujjīvayati |

[136,13] niṣedha eva tasyā vartata iti cet | ata eva vivakṣā paratantryam apetasandeham | tasmāt kārakaśaktinirdeśena vastutā-siddhipratyāśā phenasaṃghātena toyataraṇamanoratham anuharati | tad evaṃ nābhidhānādhīnam arthatattvavaśenedaṃ tv abhidhānam iti bhedanirdeśa evādya abhāvo 'sya jāta iti bhinnavastūtpattim ivāsaṃśan adyedaṃ nāstīty asya prasajyapratiṣedhamātrasūcakasyārthe sthāpyo, na viparyaye, pramāṇāśaraṇatvād asya vibhāgasya | tatkālaniyamena kālāntare 'bhāvābhidhānaṃ ca siddhasādhanam, vastv-antarotpattir eva hi niṣidhyate kālāntare, (54b) na ca prasajyapratiṣedhavyavahāramātraṃ pratiṣidhyate | tad asya bādhavidhānapratipādane 'pi na paramārthasat padārthāntarasiddhiḥ |

[136,22] tena yad udvartya vārtikaślokasya nyāyabhūṣaṇaś ca kāra kāvyam,

abhāvo yadi paścān na bhāvas tasya kim iṣyate |
so 'pi na pratiṣedho 'yam abhāvasya kim iṣyate ||

iti, tat siddhasādhanaṃ bādhā-niścayena vā paścād abhāvavyavahārapravartanamātrasyeṣṭatvād vastūtpatter eva pratisiddhitvāt |

[137,3] nanu keyaṃ vāco-yuktiḥ, abhāvavyavahāramātram iṣyate paścān nābhāva iti, evaṃ hi sati visaṃvāditā-prasaṅgo 'bhāvavyavahārasya, abhāvaś ca mithyeti bhāva eva pratiṣedhyasya syāt |

[137,6]  pratiṣedhaniṣedhaś ca vidhānāt kīdṛśo 'paraḥ | (PV IV 221cd)

iti nyāyasya svayaṃ pratijñānāt | sa cābhāvo bhavan paścād eveti sphuṭataram asya kādācitkatvāt sahetutvaṃ vastutvaṃ ceti | tathā ca saha evāha, yasya bhāvasya paścād abhāvaḥ sa eva nāśa ity ucyate | kathaṃ bhāvasya vināśo 'nyo vā kaścin nopalabhyate | atha bhāvasya vināśa ucyate, kiṃ tu sa bhavatīti nocyate, bhavatīty abhidhāne ko doṣaḥ | bhāva eva syād iti cet | tatkim idānīm abhidhānād evārthasya rūpaparivarto bhavati | yadi ca bhavet tato jāyata ity ucyatām | janmāpy abhāvasya kuta iti cet | kādācitkatvāt | akādācitkatve tu pratyutpannāvasthāyām apy abhāvaḥ syād iti |

[137,15] atrocyate, vyavahāraśabdena tāvad asmākaṃ niścayavacasī abhimate, vacanaṃ ca vikalpena 8sahaikaviṣayam eva | vikalpasya ca grāhyādhyavasāyabhedena dvividho viṣayaḥ | tatra yat pratibhāsaṃ vikalpa-jñānam ājāyate tad grāhyam ucyate | yad āśraye tu pravṛttinivṛttī tad adhyavaseyam, yathā paścād abhāvo bhāvasyaiva jāta9 ity asyaiva vikalpasyārthāntarotpattiḥ ( || )
sākṣān nirbhāsamānā grāhyā tadbhāvārthakriyārthino nivṛtter āśrayabhūtā ca tad-viviktatatkāladeśasvabhāvavastv-avasthādhyavaseyā, yatas tad-vikalpodaye vināśākhyavastūtpattiparāmarśavimukhaḥ pratiṣedhyabhāvārthkriyārthī tad-deśakālātmani vastuni na pravartate, api tu nivartate | tatas tad-deśakālavastv-avasthādhyavaseya ucyate | tatra pratibhāsamānavastv-antarāpekṣayā vyavahāramātram ucyate, yatnena nirūpatayā nayanasahasreṇāpy udīyamānapadārthāntarasyānupalabdheḥ | tatas tad-visaṃvāde 'pi yatra pravṛttinivṛttibhyāṃ pariniṣṭhitavyāpāro vikalpaḥ sampadyate, tam adyavaseyaṃ viṣayam apekṣya na visaṃvādasaṃvādaḥ |

adhyavaseye casaṃvādetara-cintā, na pratibhāsini |

tad ayam vyāpako 'pi yadi nyāyaḥ prakṛte tāvad avaseyasaṃvādenaiva saṃvādam anuśiṣmaḥ | pratibhāsinī tu visaṃvādaḥ sādhya eva yadi sidhyati prasannāḥ devatāḥ, kim atra bhava[ta] ḥ (55a) kopena |
tasmād abhāvavikalpapratibhāsinaḥ kārya-rūpasya mithyātve 'pi nābhāvavyavahārasya visaṃvāditā, adhyavasitārthayathātmyasya sattvāt | tasya ca kalpita-rūpasya mithyātve 'pi bhāvavirodhinaḥ pracyutimātrasya vyavahartavyaika-rūpasya mithyātvam iti na vastu-niṣedhe bhāvaprasaṅgaḥ | na ca sā tena rūpeṇa pracyutimātrātmanā pratiṣidhyate | kiṃ tu vastu-rūpatayā kalpitayā |
　
[138,9] nanu vastu na bhavatīty ayam eva pratiṣedhaḥ tathā ca sā pracyutir asti naveti praśne yady asti kathaṃ na vastu, nāsti cet? katham apratiṣedhaḥ, ucyate, vastu-virahamātrasya7 vastutvāropa eva niṣedhaḥ | na vastutvaniṣedhas tan-niṣedhaḥ |

[138,11] tataḥ pracyutir astīti na pracyutirūpāt pracyavata ity ayam evārthaḥ | na tv asti prayogamātreṇa kalpitasyāpi traiguṇyamayatvāder vidhiḥ | yathā ca pratiṣiddhaghaṭa-rūpād atirikta-rūpāpekṣaiva nāsti ghṭo nityatayā kṣaṇikatayā veti sādhu, tathā nāsti pracyutir ity api vastutvenety apekṣaiva sādhu | nirupādhis tv asti pracyutir iti tat svarūpāpracyutau na duṣyati | yāvac ca na pratiṣedhyabhāvas tāvat pracyutiḥ, svarūpāpracyutiḥ, parasparābhāva-rūpatvād anayoḥ |

[138,17] ata eva,

nivṛttir yadi tasmin na hetor vṛttiḥ kim iṣyate |
sāpi na pratiṣedho 'yaṃ nivṛttiḥ kiṃ niṣidhyate || (PV IV 224=PVin III 15)

iti durlaṅgho 'yaṃ nyāyaḥ | evam, abhāvo yadi paścān na ity anena paścād abhāvākhyaviraham āśaṅkya, bhāvas tasya kim iṣyate

[139,1] ity ucyate yadi tadā na doṣaḥ | yasya hi yadāstīty asya pratyanīkaṃ nāstīti virahamātram avastu-rūpaṃ kalpanā-viparivati pratiṣidhyate, tasya tadā niyamenāstīty evaṃ rūpam antar-mātrāyām upasthānam āsādayati | yadā tu paścād virahamātram apratikṣipya paścād bhavati jāyate ceti vikalpavivartavaśād vāsanāgād vastu-rūpasya kalpitasya niṣedhaḥ, tadā kathaṃ virahamātrapratikṣepaprabhavo bhāvaprasaṅgaḥ, yato

bhāvas tasya kim iṣyate

ity ucyate | na hi ghaṭaḥ kalpita-rūpaniṣedhe svarūpāt pracyavamāsādayati, udakadhāraṇādy arthakriyā virahaprasaṅgāt | na ca pracyuteḥ svarūpollekho vastutvapratyāśāyāḥ pūrakaḥ, asat-svabhāvo bandhyā-suta ity-ādivat, svabhāvāvasthānaniveśane 'pi tad ayogāt | asiddho hetur ity-ādivad vā |
tasmāt nāśaḥ paścād bhavati jāyate mudgarādibhya iti bālavyavahāramātram apalapyate | tat pratibhāṣitaṃ tu kādācitkatvādi vastu-rūpaṃ nāstīti brūmaḥ |

[139,13] na ca vastu yāvad vyavahāropasthāpitaṃ tat-sarvaṃ vastu-tattvam iti śakyam, śāstrapraṇayanārthakyaprasaṅgāt | vyavahāraṃ tu vitatham upadarśayan nāpi mūlabalābalābhyāṃ kaścid upādeyo heyaś ca kaścid iti vibhāgaḥ subhagaḥ | mūlaṃ cādhyavaseyam iti (55b) darśitam | tasmāt tattva-cintāyām,

na bhāvo bhavatīty uktam abhāvo bhavatīty api | (PV I 278cd)
paścād abhāvo bhavati bhāvasyaivānāpāyi vā ||

[ta]thā ca paścān na bhavati bhāvaḥ svakālamātraniyata ity eva kathayate | ato nārthāntarotpattir iti na kṣaṇabhaṅgapakṣe tādavastthyād upalambhādisambhavaḥ | kiṃ tu sthirapakṣa eveti sthitam ||

nārthas tāvat svayam uparato nāśahetor mudhā tv aprāpter
 daṇḍād api na nidhane vyāpṛtes tasya gīteḥ |

[140,1] nāpi dhvaṃsāt parighavad ato bhinnanāśaprasakteḥ
kasmān naiṣa sphurati caṭakālopavṛttaṃ kim etat ||

ity antaraślokaḥ | kṣaṇikatve tu,

svakārāraṇād eva yathānya-rūpa vicchinna-rūpaḥ samudeti bhāvaḥ |
vicchinnabhinnakṣaṇavṛttir evaṃ svakāraṇād eva na jāyate kim ||

ity uktam |

abhāvatao 'rthāntara-rūpabādho tatrāpy abhāvāntaram īkṣaṇīyam |

tatra yad ayam āha, pradepaprakāśavan nāvasthety eke iti | tatrocyate;

pradīpadṛṣṭāntamataṃ na kāntaṃ svarūpasan-darśanaviprayogāt ||

dṛṣṭo hi pradīpaḥ paraprakāśanaśakti-yuktaḥ katham apahnotuṃ śkyaḥ | abhāvasya punaḥ svarūpavedanaṃ svapne 'pi durlabham | tatra ka evaṃ dhṛṣṭa ākāśa-citram ācaratu etad bhāve 'yam asya bhedaḥ, tad abhāve cātra nāsti, svayaṃ cānena rūpeṇa bhidyamāno nānyam apekṣata iti | tat kathaṃ pradīpena sāmyam | kiṃ ca,

[140,17]pradīpavac ced ayam apy abhāvo bhinatti bhāvaṃ ca vibhidyate ca |
sa eva bhāvo 'py uditaḥ svahetor bhinat tu bhāvaṃ ca vibhidyatāṃ ca ||

na hy evam abhidhīyamānaṃ vadanaṃ vakrayati | adarśanād anyapauruṣābhāvasya | na ca dṛṣṭāntamātrāt sādhyasiddhiḥ, hetus tadbhāvasādhanāyābhāve upādīyamānaḥ ko 'sāv asti yo nāśrayāsiddha iti |

[141,1] yat punar āha, vayaṃ tu paśyāmaḥ | tatrānavasthā nābhyupagamyate yatrānavasthāyāṃ kiñcid dṛṣṭaṃ virudhyeta, na cātra dṛṣṭaṃ kiñcid virudhyate | yā tāvad ghaṭasya paṭādibhyo vyāvṛttiḥ, tayaiva ghaṭādibhyo vyāvṛttaḥ siddhaḥ | tatra vyāvṛttyantarānavasthāyāṃ na kiñcid vighaṭam | vyāvṛttivyāvṛttiparamparā-grahaṇopakṣīṇaśaktitvād vastu vyāvṛttaṃ na sidhyatīti cet | na, viśeṣaṇaviparyastānām api grahaṇābhyupagamād iti | tatrāpy ucyate,

sa hy astu nābhyupagamo 'tra paramparayā bhāvasya tadgrahaparamparayās tam āpteḥ |
neṣṭaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣaṇavedanaṃ cet nyāyaḥ samāna iti naiṣa tato vibhāgaḥ ||

agṛhītam api kila vilocanaṃ grāhayati rūpam iti tad-viśeṣaṇaviśeṣaṇam agṛhītam api viśeṣaṇaṃ grāhayatīti manyamānasya prathamam api viśeṣaṇam agṛhītam eva grāhayiṣyati viśeṣyam iti kṛtaṃ tad-grahaṇenāpi | na cāyaṃ viśeṣaṇakramaḥ | tato yathā prathamam eva viśeṣaṇagrahaṇam anapekṣya lakṣayituṃ viśeṣyam aśaktaṃ tathā dvitīyādy apīti katham ayaṃ vibhāgaḥ (56a) śobhām abhyeti | yathā hy abhāvopādhigrahaṇam antareṇa saṅkīrṇagrahaṇabhītiḥ, tathā so 'py upādhir asaṅkīrṇo 'gṛhyamāṇaḥ kathaṃ parabhedako nāma, svayaṃ viṣṭambhidravyavat | evaṃ paramparāpekṣāyāṃ vyāvṛttavastunaḥ kalpair api grahaṇābhāvād astamayo durvāraḥ |

[141,17] yadi ca viśeṣaṇam abhāvaḥ tadā svahetor eva bhinnabhāvasambhave bhinnadarśanavikalpanayor arthāpattyā siddheḥ kim abhāvena | na hi bhinnam abhinnam anubhavitavyam abhrāntapratyayena | nāpi bhinnam anubhūtaṃ bhinnasaṅkalpavirodhi | athābhāvam antareṇa na bhinnaṃ nābhinnaṃ, kva tarhi kārakavyāpāra ity abhāvaḥ kāraka eva svīkṛto bhavati | tathāpi svahetor eva bhinnotpattau sarvam aviruddham iti nopādhivādaḥ saṃvādaviṣayaḥ |
yac cāha | atha vā nirvikalpaka-jñānena vyāvṛttivyāvṛttyānantyam api gṛhītam iti, tatrāpi,

[142,1] nirbhāsam āha yad ayaṃ hṛdi nirvikalpe tat kauṣikāvaraṇam apy ajahād alajjaḥ |
yatraikam apy anupalabhyam abhāvanāmnā sarvavyāpinī sphurati tatra parampareti ||

mṛṣā-vādaś ced ārabdhaḥ kim atra naibhṛtyenety anurūpam eva nyāyabhūṣaṇasya, yad apy ayaṃ likhati,
nanu svarūpeṇa buddhaṃ vyāvṛttam avyāvṛttaṃ vā | yadi vyāvṛttaṃ, tadā 'narthikā vyāvṛttiḥ | na ced vyāvṛttaṃ, vastu-saṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ | svarūpeṇeti ko 'rthaḥ | kiṃ vyāvṛttiṃ vinā, kiṃ vā vyāvṛttivyatiriktena rūpeṇa | vyāvṛttiṃ vināti na yuktam, vyāvṭter nityadharmatvāt | yo hi dharmaḥ kadācid bhavati tena dharmeṇe vinā 'pi dharmī vyapadiśyate, yathā kuṇḍalena vinā kuṇḍalena vinā puruṣo 'kuṇḍalī, nāśāt prāg aniṣṭa iti | na ca vastv-antarād vyāvṛttivihīnaṃ vasu kadācit, yathā na gotvavihīno 'sti gauḥ, nāuṣyavihīno 'gniḥ |
atha vyāvṛttivyatirekena rūpeṇa vyāvṛttam ity abhipretam | tad-iṣṭam evāsmākam, bhedābhyupagamāt | na caivaṃ vyāvṛttir anarthikā | yadi vyatiriktena dhānena dhanī ['dhanī ? ] puruṣaḥ, kim etāvatā dhanaṃ vyarthaṃ bhavet | tasmād itaretarābhāvo 'pi bhāvād arthāntaram eveti,

[142,15] tad api vidhūtam | yasmāt na khalu vastu-satīṃ vyāvṛttam anumatyānyad artha codyam etat | kiṃ tu vyāvṛttapratyaye 'sāmarthyavaiyarthābhyām anupayogān na tad-dhanena vyāvṛttisiddhir iti codyārtha | tatra prathamapakṣe vaiyarthyam uktam | dvitīye tv asāmarthyam abhipretam |

[142,19] atha [|ayaṃ? ] cārthḥ, yadi vyāvṛttasvabhāvo bhāvaḥ svahetor udayavān, tadā tad upajaniyatayā pratīttyā vyāvṛtta eva pratyetavyaḥ | vyāvṭti-lakṣaṇam arthāntaraṃ vināpi na hi vyasanam evaitad arthasya pramāṇena vā kenacid avadhāritam, yat mayā pratyayāntarasākalye 'pi tām antareṇa na sva-jñānam utpādanīyam iti | nāpi jñānasya tad-utpāditasya tayā vinā tad agrahaṇagraho nāma tad iyam anarthikā vyāvṛttiḥ vyāvṛttapratyayasyānyathāpi sambhavān na kalpanīyā |

[143,1] atha na (56b) svahetor vyāvṛtta utpanno bhāva utpannaś ca tataḥ saṅkīrṇasvabhāvasyotpannasya vyāvṛttir evāsatī kathaṃ vyāvṛttapratyayam utpādayed ity asamarthā | evaṃ ca codyaprakrame siddhām eva vyāvṛttim avasthāpya vyāvṛtter nityadharmatvādi kutropayogi | na hy anena prathamapakṣoktavaiyarthyaparihāravārtā | tathā hi vyāvṛttapratyayasāmarthyād vyāvṛttir nāma kalpyate, sa ca vyāvṛttapratyayo 'nyathāsiddha iti kim asyāḥ kalpanayeti codye vyāvṛttiḥ nityo dharmaḥ, atas tena vineti na śakyam ity uttaravādinaḥ kiṃ kena saṅgatam | yāvatā vyāvṛttivyatireke sthityaiva vyāvṛttapratyayasyānyathānupapattivādasyāyaṃ nāvasaraḥ, tadvidhūya siddhāntamātrakathayā kim atra |

[143,9] na ca vināśāt prāg anaṣṭa ity udāhartuṃ yuktam, vināśasya bhedāsiddheḥ | na vyāvṛttivihīnaṃ vastv ity api vyāvṛttes tāttvikābhede siddhasādhanam, bhedāsiddhiḥ dṛṣṭānte 'pi atad-vyāvṛttirūpayor gotvāuṣṇatvayor gavāgni-bhedena darśayitum aśakyatvāt |
yac cātraiva pakṣe pakṣe dvitīyaṃ vikalpatam anena, kiṃ vā vyāvṛttir iti vyatiriktena vyāpāreṇeti, tadanabhyupagamenaiva gatam, svarūpeṇa vyāvṛttaṃ buddham iti viśvasmād vyāvṛtta-rūpaṃ buddham ity etasyārthasya vivakṣitatvāt | na cādyavaiphalyaparihāra ity uktam | nāpi dhanidṛṣṭāntena bhinnavyāvṛttisiddhir-niyamahetor abhāvāt dhanavad vā saṃyogasamavāyānapekṣo, viśeṣaṇāntarasya daṇḍapāṇḍaratvāder api sambandhavyavahāraḥ syāt | tasmān netaretarābhāvo nāma kaścit, svahetor eva parasparavyavacchinnasyotpatteḥ |

[143,18] evaṃ kālāntaravyavacchinnasyāpīti | na vināśahetunā kiñcit | tad ayam,

apekṣeta paraḥ kāryaṃ yadi vidyeta kiñcana | (PV I 279ab)

iti siddho nyāyaḥ | kim atra piṣṭapaṣeṇa

nāśo 'dya, jāta iti nānyapadārthabhāvo bhāvaḥ svakālaniyatas tu sa nānyadā 'sti |
 [144,1] nāsty anyadety api parodaya eva yasya tasya prasajyaviṣayāstamaye prasaṅgaḥ ||

yat punar ayaṃ prasajyaparyudāsayor bhedasādhanārtham abhāvabhāvavyavahāraviṣayatvena vibhāgaṃ pratyapīpadat, tad bhavato bhāṣaiva bhāvānyatety atrāntare tiraskṛtam | na hi nyāyasiddhasya samayamātreṇa bādhanaṃ sādhu | tathā hi,

yaj jāyamānam upalakṣitam arthakāri bhāvātmanā vyavaharanti tad eva santaḥ |
so 'yaṃ na yaḥ samayato yadi bhaṅgabhāgī bhāvānavasthitir iyaṃ na ca paryudāsaḥ ||

[144,10] yadā hi mūrtāmūrtasapratighāpratighasanirdarśanānirdarśanadūrāsann-sthūlasūkṣmādiprakāreṣu kaścid bhāvābhāvaṃ vā kaścit svecchā-vaśād abhidadhīta | vindhyabandhyā-sutādikam abhāvabhāvaṃ vā, tadāyātam avyavasthānaṃ bhāvasya | na caivaṃ kṣatiḥ | svasamayānurodhāt abhidhānabhedasambhavāt | [57b) kevalaṃ kim idānīṃ paryudastaṃ vastu vyavahriyatām | tasmāt samayānurodhād abhāvaśabdāpravṛttāv api ekasya kāraṇāpekṣasambhavasyopalambhabhājo vā, anyas tādṛg eva padārthaḥ paryudasto vaktavyaḥ |
tatkatham abhāvaśabdasaṅketamātreṇa paryudāsavyudāsaḥ | yadi punar upalambhasambhāvāv apy abhāvābhimatasya samayamātratantrāv ity ucyate, tadā vāstavaḥ prasajyapratiṣedha evāyaṃ na paryudāsa iti na doṣaḥ | anena tu nyāyavin-māninā nyāyāgataṃ tam eva prakāram ullaṅghya sambhavopalambhārthakriyāśaktayaś cābhāvasya bhāvikyaḥ abhyupagantavyāḥ | paryudāsapratyanīkaprasajyapratiṣedhatā ceti kim ato 'pi vyasanam-anavasānam anyat |
yac cāyam āha, na hy utpattir bhāvasya lakṣaṇaṃ yena nivṛttir bhavantī bhāvaḥ syād anutpattimatām apy ākāśādīnāṃ bhavatvād iti | tatrāpi,

pāṇiner na nadī gaṅgā yamunā ca sthalī nadī |
abhavann api bhāvo 'sya na bhāvo 'sya bhavann api ||

[145,1]  naraḥ svātantryam āpanno yad icchati karoti tat |
ubhayatra samāno 'yaṃ nyāyo nyāyavidāṃ mataḥ ||
nadī-saṃjñā-niṣedhe 'pi nāvagāhasya bādhanam |
bhāvasaṃjñā-niṣedhe 'pi paryudāso na bādhyate ||
upalambhārthaśaktasya kāraṇāpekṣa-janmanaḥ |
sarvasya paryudastatvaṃ vastv-antaram apekṣya hi ||
abhāvasaṃjñā-virahe paryudāsavyavasthitiḥ |
na kvāpi sidhyet sarvatra saṃjñāyāḥ sulabhatvataḥ ||

[145,9] yac cedaṃ svarūpanivṛtti-lakṣaṇā cotpattiḥ pradhvaṃsasyeṣyate, na tu prāg asataḥ sattā-sambandha-lakṣaṇā kāraṇasamavāya-lakṣaṇā veti, tatrāpi,

svarūpasyaiva nivṛttiḥ sarvatrotpattir ucyate |
prakṣipya samavāyaṃ tu vimūḍhaiḥ sāpi hāritā ||

samavāyasyaivābhāvāt kva sattā-sambandhādiḥ | astu vā so 'pi, tathāpy apūrvātma-lābha evotpattiḥ dharmaādharmāntarāṇāṃ tu bhāvābhāvau na sādhakabādhakau | kiṃ ca kāryasyāpy abhāvasya na prāg-asataḥ sattā-sambandha iti kp 'rthaḥ | kiṃ prāg-asann eva na bhavati | atha paścād api na sattvam asya | ubhayathāpi kutaḥ kāryatvam ākāśākāśakuśeśayavat | prāg-asataḥ sattvam astu paścān na tu sattāyogaḥ |
nanu sattvaṃ sattety anarthāntaram etat | yogaś ca sambandhaḥ | tatra sattvayogo 'sti na sattā-yoga iti ko 'py ayaṃ nyāyaḥ | ata sattā mahā-sāmānyam ucyate, tad abhāve 'pi svarūpasattvamātreṇa paścāt sann ity ucyate iti cet |
tat tarhi svarūpasattvaṃ yadi tāttvikam, tāvataiva kāryatvaṃ kim apareṇa kartavyam anyasyāpi kāryasya | athāupacārikam, tadā nāśasyāpi kutaḥ kāryatā | na hi bandhyā-tanayasya paścād bhāvopacāre kāryatā vāstavī nāma |

[146,1] yac cedaṃ nivṛtter apy ādimattvam ity ucyata iti, tadāpi nādhikaṃ kiñcit | sā ca nivṛttir abhāva-rūpeṇaiva (57b) ādimatīti punar na sahāmahe, kāryāntarasādāraṇatāyāḥ pratipādanāt | ādeśamātram etat bhūbhujām eva śobhate | bhāvopalambhakāle tadrūpānupalambhād ity api paścād rūpopalambhe śobhām ābhajati | sa ca nāsti, kumbhā-sambhavavikalpamātraṃ tu saṅketānurodheneti darśitam |

arthī paṭārthakriyayā ghaṭasyānupalambhane |
na prāvartata ity asti nānyadṛk pratiyoginaḥ ||

tad alam asya prakriyā-mātram avakaraṃ nirūpya, svayam ūhyadoṣatvāt |
yac cāha nāpy arthakriyāhetutvamātreṇa bhāvatvaprasaktiḥ, tvad uktabhāva-lakṣaṇānabhyupagamād iti, tatrāpi paryudāsatvānatikramād ity uktam | tasmān na bhāvād arthāntaram abhāvaḥ |

[146,12] yat punar āha, tvayāpi bhāvābhāvayor lakṣaṇabhedo 'bhihitaḥ | tat katham ekatvam | sarvārthānāṃ lakṣaṇabhedād eva bhedavyavasthā, tato 'pi cen na bhedavyavasthitir na kasyacit kutaścid bhedasiddhir ity advaitaprasaṅga iti |
tad apy apryālocanaphalam | yo hi naśvarasvabhāva eva nāśo nāśo nāśyatīti bahulādhikārāt kartari ghañ, tad-dharmatākalpanayā vā tad-vācakenābhidhānāt | tan nāśaṃ bhāvasvabhāvam icchāmaḥ, tam evāśritya,

sattā-mātrānubandhitvān nāśasyānityatā dhvaneḥ (PV I 269ab)

ity uktam | tathā cānenaivotthāpitam bhāva eva kṣaṇasthitidharmā nāśā iti tasyābhedam eva brūmaḥ | naśanaṃ nāśa iti prasajyaātmā dvidhā vyākartavyaḥ, tattvatas tāvad vastutvavirahāt tattvānyatvaśūnya evāsau bhāvo na bhavatīti tad bhāvaniṣedhamātrapātraṃ tu kharaśṛṅgādivat | saṃvṛttau tu yathā kālabhedena vikalpyamānaḥ kādācitka iti pratibhāti, tathā sarvopākhyā-viraha-rūpatayā bhāvād bhinna iva pratibhātīti nāvastutve 'pi lakṣaṇabhedākhyānavirodhaḥ | evaṃ ca sati saṃvṛttyā lakṣaṇabhede bhāvābhāvayor bhedasyeṣṭatvāt | tattvena ca lakṣaṇaikatā-virahe bhāvasya tenaikyaniṣedhāt katham advaitaprasaṅgopālambhaḥ |
naśyatīti tu nāśo naśvarasvabhāvaḥ kathaṃ bhāvātmatāṃ pariharet | sa ca sahetuko bhāvahetunaiva, na tu paras tasya hetur bhāvasvabhāvatvāt | tad ayaṃ yat,

bhāve hy eṣa vikalpaḥ syād vidher vastv-anurodhataḥ | (PV I 278ab)

ity ata āha, tad api svavacanavirodhād ayuktam | tvayā hi bhāvābhāvayos tādātmyam uktam, tac ca tattvānabhyupagame virudhyate | tattvābhyupagame 'pi lakṣaṇabhedo virudhyate | yasya hi lakṣaṇabhedena bheda ucyate tasya kathaṃ tattvātattvanirvacanīyatvam iti |
tat-sukhaidhitaḥ krīḍanaśīlatayā kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ punaḥ kārayati | na khalu bhāvapracyutisvabhāvenābhāvena bhāvasya tādātmyaṃ brūmaḥ | yas tu na bhavatīty abhāva uttarakṣaṇāpekṣayā tena kas tādātmyavirodha iti nāśavimarśena gatam etat | (58a) evam anyad apy anadhikam avadhīritam asya veditavyam |

[146,12] yad apy āha, nanv abhāvasya sarvadharmaviveka-lakṣaṇatvād utpattir na yuktā | sā hi bhāvadharma eveti | na, jñeyatvāder bhāvadharmasyābhāve 'pi sadbhāvād ity-ādi, tad apy asāram | na hi sādhāraṇadharmayogamātreṇa virodhapratiniyatānām api dharmāṇām avakāśaḥ, hutāśanasyāpi śaittyaprasaṅgāt, abhāvasyaiva vā sarvatra sadbhāvaprasaṅgāt jñeyatvādīnām api niṣedhāt | utpattiś cābhūtvā bhavana-rūpatayā bhāvadharma evety āpāditam eva |

[147,19] yat tu svayaṃ na bhavatīti, ko 'rthaḥ | kiṃ svayam evāyam abhāvaḥ | kiṃ vā svayam abhavanaṃ karoti | uta bhavanaṃ na karoti | atha kiñcin na karoti | svayaṃ vā na kiñcit | kiṃ vā svayam abhāvī-bhavatīti vikalpya dūṣaṇam ārabdham, tad api marmac chedikā-janitārtaravaprāyam |
