tatra hi svayam iti hetv-antaram anapekṣya svahetunā kṣaṇaniyatasthitir janita iti kṣaṇāntareṇa na kiñcid iti prakaṭita evārthaḥ | tato 'tat-svabhāvaḥ paścād asau kuto jātaḥ |

[148,1] svahetor hi tat-svabhāvo 'tat-svabhāvād vyāvṛtta utpannaḥ | sa kathaṃ paścād apy atat-svabhāvaḥ syāt | na hi laghu-svabhāvād vyāvṛttaḥ pāṣāṇaḥ kadācil laghu syād iti | tad api plavata eva | yathā hi deśāntarasthitivyāvṛtta utpannaḥ, tathā kṣaṇāntarasthitivyāvṛtto 'pi kathaṃ kṣaṇāntarasthiter avakāśa ity uktaprāyam |
nanv asad iti na tad eva vastv-abhidhīyate, vidhiviṣayatvāt | anyac cābhāvaśabdābhidheyaṃ pratītigocarāpannaṃ tvayā neṣṭam, tato nirviṣayaḥ pratiṣedho visaṃvādīty apratiṣIddhaṃ vastu syāt |
naivam, pracyuter api pratipādyatvāt kuto nirviṣayatvam | nāpi visaṃvādaḥ, bhāvasthitau hi pratiṣedhasya visaṃvādaḥ syāt | sa ca nāsti, pracyuteḥ pratipāditatvāt | na cāvastunaḥ saṅkalpaviṣayatāyā apy anupapattir ity uktam eva |
yat punar arthāntaraviṣayo 'pi pratiṣedhaḥ kathaṃ vastupratiṣedhaka iti cet |
tadabhāvābhidhāyī kathaṃ na pratiṣedhaka ity uktam, tad api pratyuktaprāyam | tad abhāvo hi na prasajyātmako 'rthāntarasvīkārāt, paryudāsamātratve tu nārthāntaranivṛttir avaśyam arthāntarabhāvena vibhāvitā bhavati | virodhas tu nāstīti pratipāditam | saty api vā virodhe kiṃ viruddhadvārāśrayaṇena | sākṣād evābhāvapratipādanam astu |

[148,15] syād etat, vacasābhāvapratipāde kṛte saṃśayāvakāśaḥ, viruddh-dvāreṇa tu niścaya ity asat | viruddhapratipādanam api hi vacasaiva vartate | tad yathā vacanamātrapratipādye hutabhuji neha śītam ity eva sādhu, na tu nātra śītaṃ vahner iti tad-vad etad api ||
athānyac cintyate,

nālaṃ niṣedhavidhaye (58b) yadi paryudas tam
anyopalabdhir itarasya kathaṃ niṣeddhrī |
naṣṭo ghaṭaḥ sa iti vā bhavato vikalpākāraḥ
kathaṃ ghaṭaniṣedhanam ādadhāti ||

atrottaraṃ,

nehāsty asāv iti vikalpam abhiprasuter
anyo niṣedhavidhir anyadhiyo na tāvat |

[149,1] nābhāvakalpanā-dhiyo 'py aviśaṅkatāyām
ānāṅgabhāvam avadhūya niṣedhakatvam ||
sato vināśanaṃ nāma nopapannam itīritam |
nāsataḥ karaṇe śaktir aniṣṭā vastunaḥ sataḥ ||

tataḥ pratiyogyanubhavaḥ pratiyogyantaravirahavikalpam utpādayed iti nehānupapattiḥ | na ca tan-mātrād anyo 'py anubhavasya pariniṣedhanavyāpāraḥ | yasyāpi vikalpasya naṣṭo ghaṭa ity evam ākārasya vā niḥśaṅkagamanādau tad arthakriyānvitatayā pravṛttivyāvṛttyavasthāyāṃ vā nimittabhāvān nānyaniṣedhakāritvam | evaṃ vacanasyāpi tad-vikalpotpādanadvārakam eva niṣedhasādhanatvaṃ draṣṭavyam |
etena atha nāstīti jñānam evānupalambhaḥ, tad api vastu-sat kathaṃ vastv-antarapratiṣedhasya viṣayaḥ syād ity-ādy avakaraparihāraḥ siddhaḥ |
na ca nāstīti jñānam anupalambho 'smākaṃ, kiṃ tu pratiyogy-upalambho nirvikalpa eva, nāsti jñānaṃ tu mano-vyavahāra-rūpaṃ tat phalam eva | kiṃ caivaṃ vidhanirbandhena vastu-cintāyām anupayogāt | yad apy asya nāstīti jñānaviṣayanirūpaṇam, tad apy asad iti nirūpaṇena gatārtham |
yat tu tad-viviktabhūtalāder viṣayatvam āśaṅkyoktam, na bhūtalāder vastv-antaratvāt, na ca vastv-antare pratipādite pratīte vādyaghaṭādivastv-antaram abhūtam iti pratipāditaṃ pratītaṃ vā bhavati |
evaṃ hi vastv-antaraṃ hi nāśa ityetasmin mate yad dūṣaṇam uktaṃ tat tu svayam eva parihṛtaṃ syād iti |
tad apy asambaddham, kevalaṃ hi bhūtalam asya viṣaya iti kathaṃ na ghaṭāder abhūtatvabodhaḥ, yaiva hi ghaṭādyapekṣayā kaivalyāvasthā pradeśasya sa eva ghaṭavirahaḥ | vacanādināpy evaṃ kevalaṃ pradeśapratipādane katham iva na prakṛtaghaṭādy apekṣya abhāvapratipādanam |
evaṃ yadi karparādivat kevalasya nāśasyāpy upalambhaḥ syāt, bhavatu ghaṭo niṣedhapratītiḥ ghaṭaniṣedhas tu kena kṛtaḥ | pūrvaṃ sann eva hi ghaṭābhāvaḥ tad-dvāreṇa pratipattavyaḥ, na hi pradeśena ghaṭābhāvo janyante, kiṃ tu sann eva ghaṭābhāvaḥ tad-dvāreṇa niścetavyaḥ, yadi hi ghaṭo 'pi na syān na pradeśaika-rūpaniyatā pratītir iti |

[150,1] evaṃ yathā yadi ghaṭo 'dyāpi syān na karparaika-rūpaniyatā pratipattis tathā na nāśaika-rūpaniyatā pratipattir iti balād ghaṭābhāvaniścayo bhavatu, yadi pūrvaṃ ghaṭābhāvaḥ syāt, sa ca nāsti | tadbhāve 'pi kiṃ nāśena, kapālenaiva pratiyoginā gatārthatvāt | na ca nāśapratītirapy astīty uktam, tasmāt sataḥ (59a) pradhvaṃsane sadrūpeṇāsadrūpeṇa vā dūṣaṇam uktaṃ kathaṃ sadrūpeṇa sato 'sato vā niścaye kartavye syād iti na samānaḥ parihāraḥ |

[150,6] yat tu āha, na ca tad vivekāpratītau tad viviktagahaṇaṃ bhavati | tad-vivekaś ca na bhūtalādisvarūpam eva, viśeṣaṇatvād iti, tat nyāyabahiṣ-kṛtam | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo 'pi saṅkalpārūḍhe rūpe | sa ca,

bhinnaṃ bhāvam abhinnam ākalayati vyaktaṃ tad anyātmanā
jiṣṇu sphārakadamba-ḍambaram iva svāṃśair anaṃśaṃ jagat |
kiṃ ca svākṛtimātra eva viṣayavyāmohadohakṣamaḥ
saṅkalpaḥ paramaindra-jālika iva vyādhūtabhūtasthitiḥ ||

yathā hi bhinnaṃ bhāvam ekīkurvann utpadyate, tathābhinnaṃ bhāvaṃ bhinnam-ākalayatīty apy arthaḥ, yathā śilā-putrakasya śarīram, śarīre karacaraṇādayaḥ lambakarṇo devadatta ity-ādi | tasmāt kalpanādhīno viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo 'bhinno 'pi bhāve bhedavivakṣāpekṣavyavahāraḥ kathaṃ bhedaniyamātmānam-ātanoti |
skhalad-gatir ayaṃ rāhoḥ śira ity-ādinirdeśa iti cet | yadi satyam etat tadā bhinnasya sākṣād anupalambhād eva | iyaṃ ca gatir ghaṭavivekākhyapadārthāntarāpekṣayāpy asti, tathāpi neti koṣapānaṃ pramāṇam | tasmāt sa ghaṭābhāvapradeśa eva ayam anyo ghaṭavivikto na tu ghaṭavivekena bhinnena viśeṣita iti |
tasmād yady api kiñcid viśeṣaṇaṃ bhinnam eva dṛṣṭaṃ vāhādi, tathāpi nāyaṃ niyamaḥ, viparyayasyāpi darśanāt, sambhāvanāc ca bādhakādarśanāt | vivakṣā-paratantratā tu dṛṣṭāntasambhāvanā-bījam | tad evaṃ na vācyaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyaād arthāntaratvād vāhādivad iti | kiṃ ca,

vyāptaṃ bhidā yadi viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ bhedātyayān nanu tadā tad abhāva eva |

[151,1] deśo viśiṣṭa iti nāsti yathā tathedam apy asti dṛśyamatabhedadṛg asti neti ||

na ca dṛśyānupalabdheḥ pramāṇātmano viśiṣṭavyavahāramātreṇa sa ghaṭād anya ity arthaniṣṭhena bādhaḥ, kiṃ tu tathaivāsyeti |
yac cāha, abhede 'pi na pramāṇaṃ kiñcid astīti, tad anunmīlitākṣasyaiva sāmpratam, anyathā pratyakṣodayasya nivārayitum aśakyatvāt |
yac cedam yadi ca ghaṭo nāstīty asya saṃjñānasyābhidhānasya ca bhūtalam eva viṣayo na ca tato 'nyo ghaṭābhāvaḥ, tadātra ghaṭo 'stīty asyāpi bhūtalam eva viṣayaḥ syāt | ghaṭo 'pi na tato 'nyaḥ kalpanīyaḥ, tathotpādena viśiṣṭaṃ bhūtalam evobhayatrāpy astu |
na caitad yuktam | yasmād gaṭasadbhāvavad ghaṭāsadbhāve 'pi bhūtarato 'nyaḥ pratibhāti, evaṃ hi vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ prayogo 'py arthavān eva bhaved iti tad varaṃ januṣāndho, na punar ayaṃ durnītidagdhabuddhiḥ | abhāvavat kila kalaso 'pi kalpanā-mātraviṣayo na locanagocara iti kim atra brūmaḥ | sakumbham udbhūtaṃ bhūtalam (59b) ity api sahitotpattir āpadyate, na rūpasaṅkaraḥ, bhedopalambhasya bhinnārthakriyā-niyogasya ca durapahnavatvāt | tad-van nābhāvo 'pi bhūtalakapālādibhyo bhinnaḥ pratibhātīti cintitam eva | kiṃ ca,

kim iha kalasadhvaṃso dṛśyo na vety udito jano
vadatu samayasmṛtyā dṛṣṭiṃ vimarśaparāṅ-mukhaḥ |
kalayasi punaḥ kāṃskān arthān iheti paraṃ yadi
pradiśati dharādibhyḥ sabhyas tvam eva vayaṃ na tu ||

tato vidhipratiṣedhaprayogayor api kānupapattiḥ, avasth-dvayapratipādanāt | tathā ca jālāntareṇa praviṣṭālokasyābhāvo bhāsamānaḥ kim apahnotuṃ śakyaḥ | kevalaṃ, vicchinnaḥ sphuṭanīlakānti-kalitaḥ tāvat pradeśasthitir bhinārthatvaviniścayāt tu sa iti prakhyātināmāntaraḥ | ālokasya yathā tathānyaviraho 'py ātmasvarūpasphuṭī kāre kiṃ kalasaḥ kim ātapabhidādhyakṣeti citraṃ mahat ||
na hi sūkṣmam īkṣamāṇe 'py atyantavicitrasya bhāva-rāśer abhāvānāṃ sambandhi-bhedād bhedopacāram antareṇa sūkṣmo 'pi svabhāvabhedas tama ivopalambhagocaraḥ | tad varam ālokaviveko 'pi sakalānyavivekavad anālokya evāstu, tamas tu vastv eveti gṛhāṇa | kim aṅga kaṣṭasaṃkaṭe sukhinam-ātmānam āveśayasi |
nanu nimīlitākṣasyāpi tādṛṅ-nīlapratibhāsaḥ sambhavī, na ca nīlam artham upasthāpayatīti | tad ayuktam, kṛṣṇavarṇāntarasya sarvasyāpy abhāvaprasaṅgāt |
anyādṛśam etat kṛṣṇāntaraṃ kalayāpi nimīlitākṣapratibhāsād iti cet |
andakāro 'pi tarhi punaḥ parimitadeśo vicitrasaṃsthānaḥ pratibhāsamānaḥ sphuṭataraṃ nimīlitākṣapratibhāsād bhinna-rūpa evānubhūyate, eka-rasaś ca nimīlitākṣapratibhāsaḥ, andhakāras tu kadācit kiraṇaparamāṇu-nikarasaṅkarakāle virala-rūpaḥ, anyadā ghano ghanataro veti kathaṃ sāmyam | kṛṣṇatā-mātraṃ punar anyatrāpi sādhāraṇam |

[152,14] anyatra nīlavarṇe vastuni sparśāntarasahacāraḥ avaśyam bhavati cet |
na, indranīlādimaṇi-kariṇa-jālake tad abhāvāt | anupalakṣyas tatra sparśa iti kalpanaṃ nāndhakārād bibheti | tasmād rūpamātram ubhayam astu | na hi dṛṣṭe 'nupapannaṃ nāma | yadi cāśrayo 'vaśyamṛgyaḥ maṇi-kuḍyādikam asty eva | na ca vastu-vyavasthāyāṃ pratyakṣapratibhāsam āśrayataḥ pratibhāsaviplavena vyabhicārābhidhānaṃ dhīmato dhinoti | anyathā vātapittakṣobhādinā jvalitastambhādisaṃdarśanāt satyam api jvalitastambhādikam asatyaṃ syāt | prakṛtipratyāpattau tu yathā tat-pratibhāsābhāvaḥ, tathā nayanonmīlanakāle nīlābhāvaviplavasyāpi | andhakārādarśanaṃ tu svasthāvastāpekṣam eva yathopavarṇitaviśeṣam | tatpratibhāsasya ca pratyakṣasambhavasāmagrī-vigha[ṭ] ne vighaṭanaṃ guṃa eva nāparādhaḥ pratyakṣasvabhāvatāyā iṣṭatvāt |

[153,1] (60a) yat punar uktam – kṛṣṇarūpasyālokena vinā grahīttum aśakyatvād iti | nanu pītāvadātādayo 'pi nālokanirapekṣavīkṣaṇā iti pradīpacandrātāpādayo 'pi prakāśāntaram apekṣeran | vicitrāstu bhāvaprakṛtayaḥ pramāṇasamadhigatā na paryanuyogam arhanti |
yac cālokavat, tadabhāvasyāpi grahaṇe cakṣur ālokāntaranirapekṣam ācakṣāte śaṅkaranyāyabhūṣaṇau,
tad api na kiñcit | niścāyakaṃ hi cakṣur vijñānam abhāvasya na grāhakam avastutvāt, ālokāntarānapekṣam iti tu siddham eva |
na caitat vācyam | yo hi bhāvo yāvatyā sāmagryā gṛhyate tad abhāvo 'pi tāvatyaivety ālokagrahaṇasāmagryā gṛhyamāṇaṃ tamas tad abhāva eveti, tamo grahaṇasāmagryā gṛhyamāṇasyālokasyaiva tad abhāvatvaprasaṅgenānaikāntakatvāt | ghaṭapaṭayor vā samānagrahaṇasāmagrīkatayā pramparābhāvatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
tasmāt padārthāntare rūpavivekena pratibhāsamānam adhyakṣe andhakāram ālokavirodhi vastv eva | virodhitve tarhi kadācid ālokam apy andhakāraḥ paribhaved iti na codyam, adyāpi prakṛtivādasyopasthāpanāt, tūlānalādivat |
etena tamasa eva pratiyogivastuna upalabdhir abhāvaṃ sahasā vyavahārayituṃ prabhavati | tamasyālokanivṛttāv apīti siddhe yathehālokasyābhāvopalabdhis tathā sarvatreti śaṅkarādīnāṃ pratyāśā-pratyādeśo veditavyaḥ |
anupalabdhiniṣṭhāyāṃ tu jñānākāre 'pi pratiyoginy abhāvasiddhir darśitā | na ca kaścid doṣa ity āstāṃ tāvat | tasmān nābhāvo nāma kiñcid yatra kāraṇavyāpāra iti sthitam |
etena Trilocano 'pi nirastaḥ,
yad āha | bhāvasya vyatiriktāṃ nivṛttim anicchadbhir aśakyā svarūpanivṛttir avasthāpayitum, yā hi tasya prāktanī kācid avasthā bhavadbhir arthakriyā-nirvartanayogyā dṛṣṭā saiva yady uttarakālam apy anuvarteta tarhi svarūpeṇaiva nivṛttau bhāvaḥ katham avasthāpyeta | tadānīm ayaṃ naṣṭo bhāvo, na sapadi svahetupratilabdhasvarūpātirekiṇī tasya kācid avasthotpadyeta ||

[154,1] utpattau saiva tasyātmāntaraṃ jātām ity atādavasthyas | atādavasthyam evāsya vināśaṃ brūmaḥ | tādavasthye tādātmyam eva svarūpeṇa nivṛtto bhāva ity asya śabdasya satyam arthaṃ na vidmaḥ | svarūpanivṛttiḥ khalv iyaṃ bhavantī bhāva eva syāt, bhāvād anyā vā | tattve svakāraṇebhyo niṣpannasyānyathānutpattāv utpatter ārabhya sattvān nityatvaṃ prasajyate, anyathātve ca tad eva nivṛtter anyatvam iti priyam anuṣṭhitaṃ priyeṇa | tasmād utsṛjya vibhramaṃ nāśotpattir eva naṣṭatvam abhyupagantavyam | tat kim ucyate naṣṭasyādarśanam, na ca tasya kiñcid bhavatīti | adarśanaṃ naṣṭasya punar abhāvadarśanam eva | ātmahānam abhāvotpattim eva vayam aṅgī-kurma iti sarvam anavadyam | akṣaṇikāḥ santaḥ, kāraṇavattvāt | yat kāraṇavat tad akṣaṇikam, yathā bhāvavināśaḥ | kāraṇavantaś ceme santaḥ | tasmād akṣaṇikā iti |

[154,10] kāraṇavat tv asya (60b) sādhyaviparyaye vṛtti-śaṅkā vināśahetu-mattvam eva nivartayatīti prasiddhavyāptikākāraṇavattvād akṣaṇikatvasiddhir iti, vyatiriktanivṛttim antareṇāpi svarūpanivṛtter upapāditattvāt | tataś ca kṣaṇād ūrdhvaṃ kutaḥ prāktanaśaktāvasthā-sthitiḥ | vyatiriktotpāde 'pi kathaṃ naṣṭo nāma | atādavasthyam atādātmyaṃ ca jātam ity asyātyakṣarasya svahetor evāvasthā-svabhāvāntaravirahito 'yaṃ jāta ity evārtha uktaḥ | tan-mūlakaḥ ātādavasthyādivyavahāra eva paścād bhāvī na tad-vikalpapratibhāsi bhāvāntaram iti na tattvānyatvavikalpāvakāśaḥ | tasmād utsṛjya vibhramaṃ naṣṭavyavahāro 'stu, na tu tasyānyat kiñcit jāyata iti | adarśanaṃ cābhāvadarśanam eveti sampraty eva pratyākhyātam iti sarvam anavadyam |
tasmāt prasajyātmano 'bhāvasya nāśākhyasya hetur eva na kaścit | vinaśvarasvabhāve tu hetv-antaraśaktim-apākṛtya svahetor eva sāmarthyasamarthanād jātamātram eva vinaśyantīti na kṣaṇāntaram anvetīti siddheḥ | kāraṇavattvasyākṣaṇikatvena vyāpty asiddher anekāntaḥ | kṛtakānām avaśyam ante 'pi nāśābhyupagame ca virodhaḥ | pramāṇagocarasya pakṣīkaraṇe pratijñāyā anumānabādhā | agocare c`aśrayasvarūpayor asiddhir iti sthitam |

[154,24] pratyakṣasiddham kṣaṇikatvam yat punar ayaṃ bhagavato bhāṣyakārasya pratyakṣataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddham anavagāhamānaḥ anurūpavikalpābhāvodbhāvanamātrasāreṇa vistareṇa dūṣaṇam abhilaṣann-apabhāṣaṇapramādam ācarati,

[155,1] tad asya caṭulavaṭubhāvasulabham-anātma-jñātāviṣkaraṇamātram iti mantavyam | tathā hi pratyakṣasiddhaṃ kṣaṇikatvam iti na pratyakṣavyavahṛtam, anurūpavikalpānudayāt | kiṃ tu pratyakṣagṛhītam, vyavahāratvānumānāt | tac cānumānaṃ yadi svayaṃ kutaścil liṅgāt prasādhya pratyakṣeṇa kṣaṇabhaṅgagrahaṇavyavahāram ādadhīta sāmarthyāt, tadā na viśeṣaḥ sattvādyanumānavat | arthato hi tadā pratyakṣeṇa kṣaṇabhṅgagrahaṇam avasthāpyamānaṃ svapauruṣasparśābhāvāt na pratyakṣataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiprasiddhiṃ puṣṇāti | yadā tu pramāṇāntarasiddham adhyakṣasya kṣaṇamātrasthitigrahaṇam āśritya vyavahāramātrasādhanam anumānaṃ pṛṣṭha-javikalpanirviśeṣaṃ tat-pauruṣam eva dīpayad utpadyate, tadā pratyakṣataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhir iti mukhyam ākhyāyate | tad ayam arthaḥ,

kṣaṇikatvam adhyakṣadhiyādhipātaṃ pātaṃ punar na vyavahāram etat |
ataḥ samakṣagrahasādhanena prasādhyate tad-vyavahāra eva ||
kṣaṇabhaṅge 'nyadāsiddhe pratyakṣena grahasthitiḥ |
pratyakṣena grahād asya kṣaṇabhaṅgavyavasthitiḥ ||

tathā hi,

yan nirbhāti yathā tathā tad akhilaṃ gaṅgāmbu gauraṃ yathā
no cen na prativastu śaktiniyamaḥ saṅkīrṇabhāve bhavet |
saṃskārāḥ pratibhānti cendriyamatiṣv ekakṣaṇasthāyinaḥ
syād ekakṣaṇavīkṣaṇād itarathā (61a) dṛṣṭas tri-kālī kalaḥ ||

liṅga-rūpopapattivyavakīrṇo 'yaṃ svabhāvahetuprayogaḥ | atra ca sapakṣe sadbhāvān na virodhadoṣaḥ | dvitīyapādena cānekāntaparihāraḥ | tathā hi, nirbhānaṃ pratyakṣe pratibhānam uktam, tato yāvatā viśeṣeṇa padārthaḥ pratyakṣe pratibhāsam āsādayati tan-niyamaparihāreṇa yadi svarūpasthititam ābhajeta tadā sarvasaṅkīrṇam asya rūpam iti sarvatra sarvopayogādiprasaṅgaḥ | ataḥ svarūpaniyame pramāṇāpekṣāyāṃ pravṛttinivṛttikām asya yad yathā pratyakṣe pratibhātaṃ tat-tathaiva san, nānyatheti |

[156,1] tad anena avaitathyavyāpto hi pratyakṣapratibhāso 'rthasyānyathāvasthāne vipakṣe vyāpakābhāvād abhavaṃs tathāvasthānena vyāpyata iti darśitam | tṛtīyapādena pakṣadharmopasaṃhāraḥ tadasiddhiparihāraś caturthena pūrvāparakālayor ekatve hi padārthasya dṛṣṭād rūpād rūpāntaravirahāt sakalakālakalākalitasya deśāntarayuṣo 'pi rūpasyāvaśyaṃ pratibhāsa iti na deśakālāntarāvasthā-pratipattaye pramāṇāntaraparyeṣaṇāvakāśaḥ | asti ca paryeṣaṇā idānīm anyadeśe kāle vā tad-vastu kathaṃ asti kiṃ-svin-nopanipātinā rāga-rasena siktam iti tad upanipātasambhaviny avasre vimarśadarśanāt | na ca darśanaviṣayīkṛte tathā sambhavaḥ | na ca dṛṣṭe 'py anavaāyaḥ śakyo 'bhidhātum, tādṛśi jijñāsite raktādau rūpe kṣaṇikatāvadanabhyāsābhāvāt | anyathā paścād darśane 'pi nāvasāyodayaḥ syāt | tasmāt tadanavasāyas tu tadapratibhāsād eva |

[156,11] nanu vastunas traikālyavyāptipratibhāse 'pi svasambandhiviśeṣāṇāṃ kāladeśadaśāntarāṇām apratibhāso na bādhakaḥ, kṣaṇikagrahaṇe 'pi tat-sambandhi-hetuphalasaṃyogyādivastyantarāṇām apratibhāsasya smānatvāt, ataḥ sambandhyantarāpekṣayā pramāṇāntaraparyeṣaṇam api yuktam eveti cet?
naivam, deś-kālakriyā-guṇādīnāṃ bhāvād bhedāsiddheḥ | bhinnasya tu sambandhino 'pi pratibhāsas tat-pratibhāse mā-bhūt | tasmāt kṣaṇāntaradaśāḥ sarvā nirvāsya kṣaṇaparigatenaiva rūpeṇa pratibhāsanaṃ samastavastunaḥ siddham | yāvat tarhi raktādirūpā visadṛśī daśā na san-nidhīyate, tāvat kālam ekīkṛtau ca grahaṇam astu | tad api nāsti, daśana-lakṣaṇānantaraṃ jhaṭiti vicalane vilocanasya sadṛśeṣv api tattvataḥ kṣaṇāntareṣu viparyayaśaṅkāvatārāt, sākṣātkṛteṣu ca tad ayogāt | yad anantaraṃ tarhi locana-calanaṃ tad-darśanaṃ naikakṣaṇikam avasāyaviparyayaśaṅke pṛthag-janasya sambandham utthāpayitum, avaśyaṃ hi dvi-trān api kṣaṇān udīyamānam eva dad-darśanaṃ tad upayogi | tato dvi-tri-kṣaṇasthāyino rūpasya kathaṃ prathamakṣaṇe pratibhāsabhraṃśaḥ, yena dvitīyādi-kṣaṇasya bhedasiddir iti cet?
yasya tāvat prathamakṣaṇa(61b)vīkṣaṇakṣaṇāntaram eva calati cakṣuṣi viṣayavikalpodayaḥ, tasya durvāraḥ sarvāprakṣaṇaviparyayavimarśāvakāśaḥ |

[157,1] naiva kasyacit sambhavatīti cet? kim atra bādhakam? sādhakam api kim atreti cait?
ucyate, yadi tāvad īkṣaṇakṣaṇamātrānantaram avasāyodaye sādhakānveṣaṇam, tadā dvividhaḥ pratyakṣapṛṣṭha-jo vikalpaḥ, dṛṣṭamātravikalpaś ca | dṛṣṭam idaṃ vastraṃ vety eva svarūpaviśeṣavikalpaś ca kṛtrimetaramaṇim uktādau | tatrāsya viṣaye sādṛśyāpahāryamandadhiyaḥ pṛthag-janasya bhrāntir utsargasiddhābhyāsaprakarṣasambhavināpohyate | ataḥ prakarṣatāratamyenodayasya kālasya lāghavatāratamyaniṣṭhāyāṃ darśanakṣaṇānantaram apy ayam udayam āsādayann-aśkyasambhāvananiṣedhaḥ | dṛṣṭamātrasya vikapasya tu darśanānantaram eva janmotsavasiddhaṃ sāmagrī-bhedenāpohyate | tathā hi, prakṛtyā anādisaṃsārasantatisātmībhūtavikalpās tv anubhūtapratyakṣe 'pi ca vastuni vikalpāpekṣapravṛttinivṛttayo viśeṣataḥ sukhaduḥkhaprāptiparihārārthinaḥ sarve sarvadā tat-sādhanavimarśābhyāsavāsitasantatayaḥ kathaṃ tad-viṣayānubhave 'i samarthahetau samupasthite vilambitavikalpabhāvān anubhavitum arhanti? kevalaṃ kadācit saṃhatāḥ, yato na vikalpasaṃhārābhyāsaḥ, kadācid anyāsaktiḥ, kadācid ātyantakamohād āmukhībhāva ity evaṃ prakārasāmagryā vilambasaṃvāhitavikalpa-janmāno bhavetuḥ | tad abhāve tu siddha eva pratyakṣ-kṣaṇānantaram udayo vikalpasya | tatas tad-darśanavinākṛteṣu sarveṣv eva viṣayakṣaṇeṣu raktatādisandehadolāndolanaṃ manaso viprakṛṣṭakṣaṇapamparāsv iva dvitīyakṣaṇe 'pi vimarśaviṣayīkṛte katham anavakāśa? na ca pratyakṣapratibhāse 'py evam tasmāt kṣaṇaparigateneva padārtha-rāśir adhyakṣapratibhāsam āviśati |
syād etat | pratyakṣasya kṣaṇikatve saty upapannam etat yāvatā pratyakṣam anekakṣaṇavyāpi | tato 'nekakṣaṇavyāpini pratibhāsite vikalpāvakāśaḥ (? -sāyaḥ) | tat katham ekakṣaṇagrahaṇasiddhiḥ?
ucyate, kiṃ tāvat svarūpaniṣpattāv upayogād anekakṣaṇasya vyāpakam adhyakṣam, atha kṣaṇaniṣpannasyaiva sthairyāt? tatrādyakalpas tāvad asambhavī, jñānasyāvayavirūpatā-viyogena khaṇḍaśa utpatter ayogāt | kṣaṇabhedinaś ca te 'vayavā(ḥ) pratyakṣasya yadi paricchittisvabhāvāḥ, tadā tāvanty eva pratyakṣāṇīti prathamapratyakṣāpekṣayā saiva cintā | aparicchittisvabhāve tu samuditam api na pratyakṣam | akhaṇḍaśaḥ paricchittiḥ samudāyena samudāyena sakalātmavastuparicchedaḥ | tadāpy ādyakṣaṇaparicchinnaḥ khaṇḍa eva sakalātmavastu, tadapraviṣṭasya tato bhinnatvāt | anyathā krameṇa pratīyamānaṃ viśvam ekam eva vastu syāt, sakalaṃ ca pratyakṣam ekam eva pratyakṣam iti |

[158,1] dvitīye pakṣe 'pi niṣpannavyāpārasya vā? (62a) kṣaṇāntaravyāptiniṣpannavyāpārasyaiva vā? prathamapakṣe viṣayagrahaṇam evāsya vyāpāra iti tāvataiva vikalpa-janmāvakāśaḥ, svayaṃ kṣaṇāntaram astu mā vā? tathā ca sati calati cakṣuṣi viṣaye vā tad-viṣayagrahaṇapravaṇam adhyakṣam avatiṣṭhata iti apūrvo 'yaṃ nayaḥ | agrahaṇāvakṣaṇāvasthāne tu na tāvataiva vikalpa-janmāvakāśānmuktiḥ | na ca pūrvagrāhiṇaḥ paścād agrahaṇe sthairyapakṣasthitiri[ti] indriyaviṣayavidhāne vāgṛhṇato 'pi tasya sthitir iti śraddhāvadheyam eva | evam aniṣpannavyāpārasthitir ity api duḥśraddhānam | na hi kāryāntaravaj janmātirekeṇa jñānasyāpi vyāpāraḥ | astu caivam, tathāpīndriyaviṣayopanidhau labdhodayam adhyakṣam anadhigatagocaram ubhayavicālakāle kalayat kilāstīti subhāṣitaṃ pūrvavat |
tad alam atipratiṣṭhair mithyā-vikalpair iti caturthapādena prāk paścād vā citra-raktādirūpasya tadaiva nirbhāse sūcitapramāṇāntarāvṛttiviparyayeṇa |

yad yad rūpaṃ vyavasitisahaṃ kvāpi nirbhāsamāne
mānaṃ bhinnaṃspṛhayati na tat tatra nirbhāsayogi |
rūpābhāse rasa iva tathā tatkṣaṇe bhāsamāne
pūrvāvasthā vyavasitisahāpekṣyate mānam anyat ||

iti viruddhavyāptopalabdheḥ sthitam etat ekakṣaṇasthāyinam eva bhāvasvabhāvam āmukhayati pratyakṣapratibhāsa iti | na ca tat-pratibhāsabahirbhūto 'pi svabhāvas tasyeti niveditaprāyaṃ vyāptisamarthanaprastāve |

[158,19] tasmāt siddham adhyakṣeṇa bhaṅguratvam, vyavahṛtaṃ cānumānena mānāntaropapāditaṃ tat-siddhisiddheneti |

pratyakṣeṇa kṣaṇikakalane nyāyadik-sūcanātaḥ
sāmarthyāptavyavahṛtividhau dhīmato na prabandhaḥ |
so 'py ācāryapravara-raviṇākāri kiṃ tv alpamedhās
tattvābodhāt prakṛtimukharo 'satyam abhyuj-jagāra ||
[159]no mārgam ācārya-raver apekṣya ca kṣaṇikagrahe 'smākam atha kramoyataḥ |
yathā ca bhāṣyoktisamanvayas tathā na gītam aprasutavistarād bhiyā ||

tad alam ānuṣaṅgikakathā-nirbandhena | sthitam etan na vināśo nāma parighādibhyo bhinnaḥ kaścin mudgarādisādhyo yas tad anupanipātadaśāyām abhavan bhāvasya sthairyasiddhimanorathaṃ paripūrayed iti |

durnītāśramavedikā-dṛḍhatarastambhān anūm Śaṅkara-
Nyāyālaṅkāraṇatrilocanavacaspaty-āhvayān helayā |
unmūlya kṣaṇabhaṅga eṣa vihito yat puṇyam āptaṃ mayā
tena syāt parapāragastribhuvane jñānaśriyo 'yaṃ janaḥ ||

|| ahetukavināśādhikāro nāma caturthaḥ pādaḥ samāptaḥ ||
|| samāptaś cāyaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgādhyayaḥ ||
VYĀPTICARCĀ

[161,3] namo bhagavate vītarāgāya |
[161,4] iha dahanādinā dhūmāder vyāptir adhyakṣānupalabdhisādhanatadutpatti-lakṣaṇeti vyutpādyate |
[161,5] pare hi purastanās tāvad agnimati dhūmasya darśanam adarśanaṃ ca tadvirahiṇīty evānvayavyatirekitvaṃ
[161,6] kalpayāṃ babhūvuḥ | tatra darśanādarśanaṃ yādṛcchikam api sakṛd bhaved iti ca bhūyaḥ pravṛttim
[161,7] apekṣate | nanu bhūyasāpi pravṛtte darśanādarśane ghaṭakulaṭādāv upalabdho vyabhicāra iti
[161,8] cet | kim etāvatā tatrāpy anumānam astv ity ucyate | atha tadvad dhūmādāv api mā bhūd iti |
[161,9] prathamapakṣas tāvad vyabhicārād eva nirastaḥ | dvitīyo 'py avyabhicārād eva | na hy anyasya
[161,10] vyabhicāre dhūmasya kiṃcit | na khalu viṣānnam aniṣṭam iti bhakṣyāntaram api heyam astu |
[161,11] tāvatā ca sarvā nivṛttir labdheti | kim utpattiprārthanayā | tanniścayopayoginā vā pratyakṣānupalambhena |
[161,12] tadutpattir api yadi darśanādarśanād eva gṛhyeta kīdṛśo doṣaḥ | anumānam eva
[161,13] ca vibhāgena bhavatv iti tadanveṣaṇam | sa ca vibhāgo vyabhicārāvyabhicāradvāreṇa
[161,14] siddhaḥ | asati ca vyabhicāre tāvataiva gamakatvam anarthikā tadutpattiḥ | vyabhicāre
[161,15] ca śatam api tadutpattayo na samarthāḥ | tasmāt sa(1b4)nnikarṣeṇa paryeṣaṇaṃ saṃyogenaiva kṛtārtham |
[161,16] ata eva saṃyogī hetur ucyate vahner dhūmo na kāryam iti ||
[161,17] Trilocanas tv āha | pratyakṣānupalambhayor viśeṣaviṣayatvāt kathaṃ tābhyāṃ sāmānyayoḥ
[161,18] sambandhapratītiḥ | athānagnivyāvṛttenādhūmavyāvṛttasya sambandhaḥ pratīyata eveti | nanu
[161,19] so 'pi kasya pramāṇasya viṣayaḥ | na tāva(1b5)t pratyakṣasya svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvāt
[161,20] tasya | nāpy anumānasya tasyāpi tatpūrvakatvāt | na ca vyāvṛttyoḥ kaścit sambandhaḥ | atha pratyakṣa-
[161,21] pṛṣṭabhāvī vikalpo dṛṣṭe bhede 'bhedam avasyati | tad eva sāmānyam | evam api vikalpānāṃ
[161,22] na vastv eva viṣayaḥ | api tu grāhyākāraḥ | sa ca na vastu | vastu tu teṣāṃ parokṣam eveti

[179,6] mātram, paryudāsavṛttyā vā bhāvāntaram? tad api prakṛtapratyanīkaṃ tṛtīyaṃ rūpam, uta-
[179,7] aprakṛtam eva kiñcit?
[179,8] tatra prathamapakṣe yāv eva bhedābhedau pṛthaṅdoṣajālakavalitau tāv evāmū ekavastu-
[179,9] vartināv iṣyete, tadānyāv eva vā? tattve taddūṣaṇasyāvaśyam anuvṛtter viphalo 'bhyupagamaḥ |
[179,10] anyatve 'pi taddūṣaṇavad guṇasyāpy ananuvṛtteḥ | api nāma bhedapakṣabhāvi pṛthakpratītiprasaṅga-
[179,11] dūṣaṇam abhedam upagacchan parihariṣyāmīti bhede 'py abhedasvīkāras tatra bhavataḥ | yadi ca sa
[179,12] evābhedaḥ pṛtagupalabdhibādhano 'dhunāpy upanītaḥ, syād evaṃ tatparihāraḥ, kevalam ekayogakṣema-
[179,13] samāveśāt pramāṇāntarāvṛttim apy ākarṣet | tato yady anyatayaināṃ nākarṣet, tata eva
[179,14] pṛthagupalabdhiniṣedhanam api na sādhayet | athābhedasya pṛthagupalabdhibādhaiva phalaṃ na
[179,15] śabdāntarāvṛttisvābhāvyāt, tathāpi dvaitābhyupagamo viphalaḥ | evaṃ bhedapakṣe 'pi vācyam |
[179,16] atha pṛthagupalabdhibādhaiva phalam abhedasya, śabdāntarāvṛttinivṛttis tu bhedasyaiva, tenāpi hi
[179,17] sambhavinā svakāryam arjanīyam eva | evaṃ bhedasyāpi pramāṇāntarāpekṣaiva phalaṃ, pṛthagupa-
[179,18] labdhibādhā tv abhedasyeti |
[179,19] ucyate | ubhayam ubhayasya kāryaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, bhedasyāpi pṛthakprakāśaprasaṅgadoṣaḥ,
[179,20] śabdāntarāpekṣā ca guṇaḥ | abhedasyāpi śabdāntarāpekṣāprasaṅgadoṣaḥ, apṛthakpratibhāsaś ca
[179,21] guṇaḥ | tatredānīṃ bhedena śabdāntaravṛttimātram ātanvatā sthātavyam | dvitīye tu kārye
[179,22] paraprahāro 'pekṣitavyaḥ | abhedenāpi saha pratibhāsaṃ sṛjatā kāryāntare pratyanīkaprahāra
[179,23] iti kiṃkṛto vibhāgaḥ? bhavadabhiprāyānuvidhāyitayā bhāvānām, svayam eva vā
[179,24] guṇadoṣayor anunayapratighasambhavāt, kālabhedasambhavād vā svabhāvayoḥ, kāryāṇāṃ ca |
[179,25] tatrāpi niyatoguṇadoṣakramo 'niyato vā? tatra prathamavikalpe bhedābhedayor anyatara eva
[180,1] pakṣaḥ svakīyaṃ guṇamātram arpayan dūṣaṇasparśarahito bhaviṣyati | na cainaṃ dūṣaṇam upaneṣyata iti
[180,2] kim ātmapramāṇānabhijñena dvaitaparigrahaā kṛtaḥ? caitanyaśūnyatvāc ca bhāvānāṃ nābhiprāya-
[180,3] anuvidhānam |
[180,4] ata eva na dvitīyo 'pi vikalpaḥ | astu vaiṣamye 'nunayādiḥ sa punar ātmopakārāpakāriṇi
[180,5] syāt, na vai vācakavācyatayā kiñcid eṣām apakṛtaṃ pratibhāsabhedena vopakṛtaṃ vā
[180,5] taditareṇa | bhavadanurodhāt tu guṇadoṣaśabdaprayogaḥ | tatas tadanuvṛttividhurasya tathātve 'pi
[180,6] na kiñcit | ananuvṛttau vā caitanyam uktam eva |
[180,7] syād etat | śabdodayakāraṇakaraṇakalāpavyāpāravad abhiprāyānuvṛttiḥ svabhāvād eveti |
[180,8] tathāpi dvaitaparigraho 'graha eva | ekasyaiva svabhāvasya tathā vyāpārakalpanaṃ kiṃ
[180,9] nāsthīyata ity uktaprāyam |
[180,10] nāpi tṛtīyapakṣopakṣepaḥ kṣamaḥ | svabhāvayos tāvat kālabhede yadā bhedo na
[180,11] tadā abhedaḥ | abhedakāle ca na bheda iti na kadācid paradoṣaparihāraḥ | tatra yathā
[180,12] bhinne 'bhinne vā vastuny ekāntabhedābhedabhāvīni paryāyatvādīni kāryāṇi na vihanyante,
[180,13] tathaiva svabhāvayoḥ kālabhede na prāpnuvanti, pratidvandvano 'bhāvāt | na ca bhāvinaiva
[180,14] niṣedho 'vastutvāt | atas tatkālakāryakālabhedaḥ | śaraṇīkaraṇīyaḥ | tatra bhedaḥ śabdāntara-
[180,15] vṛttim ādhāya yāvat pratibhāsabhedam ādhātum upakramate, tāvad evābhedenopaniyatatā pratibadhyata
[180,16] iti ka evaṃ nyāyavihasto hastasamāracitaṃ vastu prastotum arhati sāhasaikabhuvaṃ bhavantam
[180,17] antareṇa? svabhāvayor eva hi kālabhedaḥ
[sa ca] kasya vastunas tāvad durlabhaḥ? na hi sa
[180,18] paścād bhavan tasyaiva yuktaḥ, kāraṇacintāvidhuratvāc ca tatrāpi pratyekaṃ kālabhedaḥ | na
[180,19] hy ekasvabhāvapratibaddhatve yuktam evam | tatrāpi niyato guṇadoṣābhimatakāryakaraṇakramaḥ |
[180,20] aniyamena punaḥ prapātapatanaprasaṅgād iti vyaktam iṣṭakāmatāmātrāpahṛtahṛdayo na kiñcit
[180,21] cetayata ity upekṣām arhati | na hi tad icchātiriktam atra kāraṇam ākalayāmaḥ | api ca, yadā
[180,22] bhedasya paścād bhedābhyupagamaḥ, tadā pṛthagupalabdhiṃ bādhamānasyābhedasya dvitīyaṃ kāryaṃ
[180,23] kena nivāryatām? bhedeneti cet, na, yady anyenottarakālabhāvinā, tadāsyāpi doṣāṅga-
[180,24] nirākaraṇāyāparo mṛgyata ity anavasthā | atha prāktanena, tasya yady etāvatī śaktiḥ
[180,25] paścād abhedenopanīyamānam apṛthakpratibhāsam eva kathaṃ na badhnīyāt? tad yadi pūrvāpekṣayā
[180,26] uttarasyāpavādakatvaṃ, pūrvatarāpekṣayā kathaṃ neti cintyam | tasmāt pratyekam ubhayakārya-
[181,1] tvāt bhedābhedayor ekapratiniyataḥ parihāraḥ svīkāro vety anibandhanam etat | tataḥ pṛthak
[181,2] pratibhāsāpratibhāsau sahotpattyanutpattī śabdāntaravṛttyavṛttyādayaś caikasyaikadā prasajyeran |
[181,3] na copādher upādhimato bhedenānubhavagandho 'pi samasti | vyaktivināśe va vyaktileśo 'pi
[181,4] na sāmānyasyābhyupeyate paraiḥ |
[181,5] vyaktirūpeṇeṣyata eveti cet nanu vyaktirūpeṇeti na nijena rūpeṇeti
[181,6] vivakṣitam, anyathā viśeṣaṇānarthakyāt | nijasyaiva rūpasya bhedābhedacintāyām ayaṃ
[181,7] prasaṅga iti kim anena parihṛtam? atha nijam asya na rūpāntaraṃ sambhavaty eva, kasya tarhi
[181,8] bhedābhedacinteti siddhā nirupādhayo dharmāḥ | nanu bhinnasyābhedasambhave 'pi śabdāntara-
[181,9] vaiyarthyaṃ vidma iti kim atra kurmaḥ? evaṃ tarhi bhinnasyāpy upādher na bhinnaḥ prakāśa iti
[181,10] kim atra kurma iti bruvato naikāntavāde 'pi doṣa iti tathāpi vyartho dvaitamartāśrayaḥ, paryante
[181,11] pādaprasārikāyā aparihārāt | pariśramātiśayas tv atiricyate, āho puruṣikā
[181,12] vā? athāpi syāt tādātmyam abhyupagacchato yadā śabdāntarāvṛttyādidoṣaḥ, paraiḥ
[181,13] prasajyate, tadā bhedasyāpi sambhavaḥ parihāraḥ | bhede ca pratibhāsabhedāpādane 'bhedopanaya
[181,14] iti na śakyam ekāntavāde | na ca pādaprasāriketi nāpy ubhayadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ | yadā hi pūrvaṃ
[181,15] bheda upanītaḥ, tadā tadāsaṅgidoṣotkhāte cābhedasyopanayāt |
[181,16] evaṃ punaḥ punas tadāvartanaparamparayā paryavasānābhāve 'pi na kṣatir iti cet?
[181,16] bhavatopanīyamānas tarhi bādhako dharmaḥ sādhako vā na svasāmarthyenaivety āpannam | upanayaś ca
[181,17] vacanātmany anabhidhīyamāno bhavata uṣarbudho 'pi na bādhakaḥ syāt | etena mayā prasaṅgārtham
[181,18] anaṅgīkārād ity api nirastam | na hi jīvanāya bhakṣyamāṇaṃ viṣaṃ na hinastīti śakyam |
[181,19] tasmād bautārgalayugalasamānam etad ubhayaparijihīrṣayobhayapakṣālambhanaṃ mandamedhasām
[181,20] iti |
[181,21] prayogaḥ, yad yanmātranimittaṃ tat tasmin sati bhavaty eva, yathā cakṣurādi-
[181,22] sāmagrīmātranimittaṃ jñānajanma, bhedābhedamātrāpekṣaṃ ca yathoktadoṣajātam iti svabhāvahetuḥ |
[181,23] tanmātranimittatvam anyānapekṣatvena vyāptam, tatsambhave 'pi ca tadbhāve tadviruddham anyāpekṣatvaṃ
[181,24] syād iti vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhyā viparyayān nivartamānaṃ tanmātranimittatvaṃ tasmin
[181,25] sati bhāve niyamyata iti vyāptisiddhiḥ | nāpy asiddhis tanmātrāpekṣāyāḥ | na hy abheda-
[181,26] mātrātiriktaṃ sahotpādanimittam upapadyate | bhedamātrātirikitaṃ vā pṛthakprakāśasya dṛśyatve |
[182,1] ayoguḍadahanayoḥ kṣīrodakayor vā bhede 'pi abhavan prakāśabheda itarasāpekṣaḥ siddha iti
[182,2] cet? na, abhrāntendriyajñānasyaprakṛtatvāt | tatra bhinne eva vastunī ekīkṛtya pratipādyamānaṃ
[182,3] jñānaṃ katham abhrāntaṃ nāma?
[182,4] etena candradvayapratibhāso vyākhyārtaḥ | athobhayakāraṇārabdham ekam eva tad vastu
[182,4] saṃjātam iti matiḥ, tadā vyabhicāra eva nāstīti siddhaṃ tanmātrāpekṣatvam | syād etat |
[182,5] tanmātrāpekṣasyāpi tadbhāvenāvaśyambhāvaḥ, yathā kaṭukamadhuradravyabhāvinor api pitta-
[182,6] śleṣmaṇoḥ | tad ayuktam, vīryavipākāpekṣayāpi tad atatkāryakaraṇasambhavād dravyāṇām,
[182,7] rasamātrāpekṣātipātāt pittāder iti ||
[182,8] || bhedābhedaparīkṣā samāptā ||
ANUPALABDHIRAHASYAM

siddhānte viprakīrṇasyānupalambhasya yādṛśī |
rūpaniṣṭheha tādṛśyāḥ saṅgrahaḥ kriyate sphuṭaḥ ||

pratiṣedhe sādhye 'nupalabdhis tṛtīyaṃ liṅgaṃ | (2b7) tac ca yady upalabdhivirahamātraṃ tat kathaṃ kasyacit pratipattiḥ pratipattihetur vā tasyāpi vā kathaṃ pratipattiḥ | tasmād abhakṣyādivat paryudāsavṛttyā 'nyopalabdhir evānupalabdhiḥ |
tatrāpi yady anyamātrasya | tadaikasya kasyacid upalabdhau sarvasya niṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ | iṣyata eva tādātmyaniṣedhaḥ sarvasyeti cet | taddeśaniṣedho 'py anivāryaḥ | tad ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ ||

vedye yatra hi yanmatir niyamataḥ (3a1) syād vā na vā |
tasya dhīr iṣṭā no 'nupalabdhir anyavirahajñānasthiter āśrayaḥ ||

yatra vedyamāne yasya matiḥ syād iti deśakālasvabhāvaviprakarṣiṇāṃ niṣedhaḥ | niyameneti | upalambhakāraṇāntaravaikalyasya | etena dṛśyaviśeṣaṇaprāptasyābhāvajñānasthitir iti darśitaṃ | ato na sarvasya niṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ |
yatra ca vedyamāne yanmatir niyamena syāt | tasyaiva dhīr iṣṭā 'nyasya dvitīyasyābhāvaniścayaprabandhākṣepāya kṣameti | etena na virahamātraṃ | (3a2) paryudāsavṛttyā tv anyaviśeṣabuddhir ity uktaṃ | atra ca tasyaivaikākina iti sāmarthyāt | anyathetarasyāniṣiddhopalabdher abhāvāsiddheḥ |
tad yathā neha ghaṭa upalabhyasyānupalabdheḥ | yathā kvacit kiñcid iti | tatra dṛśyasyeti svabhāvaviśeṣa upalambhapratyayāntarasākalyaṃ coktaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | anupalabdher iti pratiyogina upalabdher ity arthaḥ |
tac ca pratiyogīhety ādhāratāprāptaṃ bhūtalam anyad vaikendriyajñānasaṃsargi | (3a3) tadanyo vā | yasmin vedyamāne niṣedhyam upalabhyam eveti sāmānyokteḥ | tatra yadi bhūbhāga upalabhya eva kumbhasambhavaḥ sādhyaḥ | tadā sa eva pratiyogī kim anyāpekṣayā | yadā tu nabhasi tadā 'pi tad evālokasañjñitaṃ | anyo vā ghaṭādir aniyatasthitiḥ spṛśyaniṣedhe tv ayam eva |

[184] etenaikajñānasaṃsargī pratiyogī vyākhyātaḥ | kvacit punar anyathā 'pi |
athā pradīpaṃ kavalayatur neha (3a4) raso dṛśyānupalabdher iti sparśa eva pratiyogī | tayor hi sator naikarūpaniyatā pratipattiḥ pānakavat | dūrād rūpadarśane 'pi tarhi kathaṃ rasaniṣedho na bhavati | deśaviprakarṣiṇa upalambhayogyatāyā abhāvāt | prāpyakāritvād ghrāṇarasanasparśanānāṃ | uktaṃ ca | yasmin vedyamāne yad avaśyaṃ vedyata eveti | nāpi rasānubhave rūpaniṣedhaḥ | tadā 'pi tallakṣaṇāyogāt | evaṃ (3a5) śabdopalabdhyā 'pi na rūpaniṣedhaḥ | samandhakāre hi sato 'pi rūpasya jñānāvyabhicāriṇī na śabdavittiḥ | āloke tu na tāvad dṛśyamānasyaiva niṣedhaḥ | adṛṣṭasya tu yogyasya niṣedhe 'pi na doṣaḥ | tallakṣaṇātyāgāt |
etena devakulādau paridṛśyamāne taddeśabheryāder evābhāvasiddhir nāvaśyaṃ śabdāntarasahapratītisāpekṣeti darśitaṃ | na tayoḥ sahapratītiniyama iti ceti | (3a6) bhūbhāgakumbhayor api naivaṃ | ubhayos tu sator ekarūpapratītiniyamavirahaḥ pratyakṣasya tatrāpi samānaḥ | ekajñānam anyagrahāvinābhūtam vā 'nyagrāhijñānāntarāvinābhūtam veti na viśeṣaḥ | evam ekendriyajam anyad vā |
santamase 'vavarake 'pi dīpābhāvas tadākāravirahiṇo jñānāntarād antato vikalpād api yadi parasamayasyānuvartanaṃ| vastutas tu vastusann evāndhakāra ekajñānasaṃsargī pradīpasya (3a7) sambhavatīti kim anyena |
nanu svabhāvaviśeṣe 'pi pratyayāntarasannidhir upalabdhiyogyatā | sa ca bhinnendriyajñānanimittam bhavann api bhinnendriyajñānapratyayaniścaye 'nupayuktaḥ | tataś cānyasya pratyayāntarasannidhisaṃśaye niṣedhaḥ kriyamāṇo 'ntato vikalpād api niyatākārāt kathaṃ dṛśyasya kṛtaḥ syāt |
ucyate | na khalu pratyayāntarasannidhisiddhinibandhanaṃ samānendriyajñānam eva | kiṃ tu (3b1) pañcaskandhalakṣaṇasyātmabhāvasyāvasthāviśeṣasamvedanam api | yadā nendriyasvabhāvaviśeṣābhyām aparaḥ prakāśako 'pekṣyate | yathā śabdapradīpādau | tatra hi kiñcit śrutadṛṣṭapūrviṇas tadavasthendriyapraṇidhividuṣo yataḥ kutaścit tattadākāravirahiṇo jñānāt tadabhāvasiddhiḥ kena vāryate |
kas tarhi jñānāntaraparigrahasyopayogaḥ | taddaśāsamvido jñānānutpādād eva tadabhāvasiddheḥ | katham vā bhinnaviṣayendriyajñānād (3b2) anyaniṣedha iti |
uktam atra

nābhāvasya kvacit sāmarthyam

ityādi | tato na jñānāntaram indriyasādguṇyaniścayāya samāśrīyate | kiṃ tu [185] pratiyogivirahavikalpajananāya | tatra yathā samānendriyasaṃsargijñānam anyābhāvaniścayasamarthaṃ | tathā 'nyad api | sati sattve 'vyabhicaritavyārthāntarajñānākāravirahīti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ |
katham iti cet |
nātrecchānicchayoḥ sāmarthyaṃ | yasya tu (3b3) yadanvayavyatirekānukāras tayor hetuphalabhāvābhyupagamaḥ | yathā bhūtalaikākāraniyamāt tajjñānam anyaniṣedhavikalpenānukṛtānvayavyatirekaṃ tathā pradīpam ānane kṣipataḥ sparśākāramātraniyamād rasābhāvajñānena tajjñānaṃ | na hy anayor utpattau vyavadhānāvyavadhānavibhāgaḥ | tathā 'nupādhike payasi praṇihitaghrāṇasyāsparśanadarśanasyāpi (3b4) vikalpa eva gandhāntaram ananubhavato 'pi gandhābhāvajñānena tadākāraśūnyaḥ |
laiṅgikaṃ tad iti cet |
na | vyavadhānābhāvād abhyāsadaśāvataḥ | yatpratipattāv eva hi yanniścayo na sa laiṅgikaḥ pratyakṣasiddho vā | yathā nīlaṃ na pītam iti | asti ca sannihite payasi ghrāṇapraṇidhānamātrākāravikalpavato nāsti gandha iti niścayaḥ | tatra (3b5) gandhajñānābhāvamātrasyāsādhanatve yadi niyatākāravikalpānubhavo na hetuḥ | pītābhāvajñānasyāpi mā bhūn nīlānubhavaḥ |
atra vā pratyakṣapauruṣam āmanato duṣpariharaṃ paratrāpi | tad eva ca pratyakṣam ekasya niṣedhyāpekṣayānupalabdhir ucyate yathā tathoktaṃ |
tac ca mūḍhaṃ pratipattāram adhikṛtya pūrvasamayānusāreṇa dharmiviśeṣe 'bhāvaṃ (3b6) niścāyayal liṅgaṃ | amūḍhasya punar abhāvavato 'nantarasaṃśayavinākṛtaḥ sthira evāsau niścaya iti pratyakṣapravartita ucyate |
nanu na pratyakṣakṛtaḥ kaścid abhāvavyavahāraḥ | nāpi pratyakṣam arthābhāvaniścayena phalavad uktaṃ | kiṃ tu jñānābhāvaniścayenaiva | taddvāreṇaiva tv arthābhāvaniścayam antarbhāvayatīti pratyakṣakṛtaḥ sa ucyate |
sa ca tatsāmarthyajanmā 'py anantaraṃ saṃśayena bhavatā (3b7) paribhūyamāno mūḍhaṃ prati laiṅgikaḥ | na hi jñānasyeva prakāśarūpaniyamo 'rthasyety adṛṣṭasyāpi sthiter avirodhāt | dṛśyānupalabdhiḥ śaraṇaṃ | amūḍhasya tu vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ | dṛśyasattāyā darśanaviṣayatvena vyāpteḥ | etadvivecanāsāmarthyāt tu prācyo mūḍha ity eke |
tad ayuktaṃ | yathā hi jñānam aprakāśam anavasthāyi tathā 'dṛśyam bahir apīti tadvad eva (4a1) pratyakṣeṇānivāryavirahavyavahāraṃ | kevalaṃ jātyaiva jñānaṃ dṛśyaṃ | bahis tu kiñcit kathañcit kadācit | tatrābhyāsaviśeṣavataḥ pratipattur jñānāntarasāmānya iva bāhyaviśeṣe 'pi pratyakṣamātrād eva jhagiti niṣedhasiddhir asakṛd anubhūyamānā katham apahnotuṃ śakyā |

[186] tattvato 'numānasambhavād iti cet |
abhimatayogyatāniścayo 'pi na pratyakṣakṛtaḥ syād iti yat kiñcid etat | na ca yathoktaḥ saṃśayo bahiradhikāreṇaiva | tad ayam (4a2) asaṃsṛṣṭavikalpo vā darśanātmā dṛśyātmano vā vikalpasya darśane 'dṛṣṭir vikalpakalpanām indriyajñāne pratihanti ityāder avācyatāprasaṅgāt | tasmāt jñāne 'pi kadācid anyajñānasya vimarśaḥ | arthe 'py anullikhitāntarāsaṃśayo niścaya iti daśāvibhāgena pratyakṣasyetarasya vā sāmarthyasthitir na tu jātivibhāgena |
nanv

ekopalambhānubhavād

ityādinā jñānāntaraniṣedha eva sāmarthyam uktam anubhavaś caivam (4a3) eveti cet |
na yathā hīdaṃ nopalabha iti pratyakṣād anubhūyate | tathedaṃ nāstīty api jhagity evābhyāsavataḥ | anabhyāsavatas tu jñānābhāva eva niścayaḥ | taddvāreṇa tv arthābhāva iti tadapekṣayā śāstre tathābhidhānaṃ | evam ekajñānasaṃsargiyatnādayo 'pi vācyāḥ | ata eva

vyavasyantīkṣaṇād eva sarvākārān mahādhiya

ity uktaṃ | mṛduprajñādhikāreṇa (4a4) ca sthānasthāneṣu yatnaḥ | tasmāt paṭudhiyaḥ pratyakṣād eva maṇirūpyādivivekavat tanniṣedhavyavahāro 'pi durnivāraḥ | na cābhāvo nāma vigrahavān yenānyavyatirekiṇā rūpeṇa sākṣātkartavyaḥ kiṃ tu vyavahartavyaḥ | sa caikākāraniyamāt paṭunā vyavahartum adhyakṣeṇa śakya eva | yaḥ punar apaṭur āpātataḥ pravṛtte 'py abhāvaniścaye saṃśete (4a5) sa dṛśyasyānupalambhamātram anusṛtya tadvyavahāraṃ pravartayati yas tu tato 'py apaṭuḥ sa dṛśyasyānupalambhe 'pi sandihāno vyāpakānupalambhena pravartate | na punar avyāmūḍhasyānena pravṛttiḥ | pratyakṣāpāṭava eva hy anumānaṃ prārthyate | tatpāṭavaṃ ca vikalpajananenāvasthāpyate | paṭutaratvaṃ ca tatra vimarśābhāvāt |
cārvākaṃ tu pṛthag abhāvam (4a6) anumanyamānam eva prati pratyakṣasya niṣedhe 'vyāpāro darśitaḥ |

arthasāmarthyāpekṣādy

ukteḥ | na cānumānasyeva pratyakṣasyāpi niścayavaśād grahaṇavyavasthā | kiṃ tu pratibhāsavaśāt | niyatākārataiva ca tasya tadanyābhāvabhāsanaṃ |

[187] tasmād duṣpariharaḥ pratyakṣasyābhāvavyavahāraśaktisambhavaḥ | pratiṣedhas tu sarvatrānupalambhād iti tu na pratyakṣapratikṣepaḥ kiṃ tu (4a7) liṅgāntarasya | dvāv eva vidhisādhanāv iti yathā | tad ayam ambhasi gandhaniṣedhaḥ pratyakṣakṛta evāvyavadher na laiṅgikaḥ |
kiṃ cātra liṅgaṃ gandhābhāvāvyabhicāri | jñānakāryānupalabdhir iti cet | yadā svagrāhijñānaṃ kāryahetus tadedaṃ yuktam api | yadā tu pratyakṣam eva tat tadā pratyakṣayogyasya tannivṛttir yadi na dṛśyānupalabdhir ghaṭasyāpi[Birgit1] mā bhūt | tad idaṃ pratiyogijñānarūpatālocanavañcanāphalam (4b1) eva | ayaṃ ca vādī yadīndriyasādguṇyam aniścinvann etad āha tadā sann api gandhādir nopalabhyata ity āyātaṃ | atha niścinvann alaṃ kāryānupalabdhyeti draṣṭavyaṃ |
parokṣasambhāvite ca kāraṇādau kāryādyanupalabdhiṃ yatnena yojayati | samprati ca doṣaleśabhayāt pratyakṣasambhāvite 'pi saṃśayatīty asambaddhaṃ |
tasmāt sthitam etat | yasmin vedyamāne yad avaśyaṃ vedyata eva tasyābhinnendriyagrāhyasyānyasya vā (4b2) 'nindriyagrāhyasya vā buddhir anupalabdhiḥ | sā ca vyavahāram eva sādhayati | anyathā pratyakṣasiddheḥ | tadarthaṃ ca virahajñānasya sthiteḥ sthairyasyāśraya ity uktaṃ | na tu virahaniścayasyeti |
yathā ca niyatasahopalambhayor ekajñānam anyaniṣedhāya | tathā niyatāsahopalambhayor apīty āha | na veti | vedye yatra hi yanmatir niyamato na syād ity arthaḥ | yathā nīlam idam anīlaṃ na bhavatīti | atrāpi vyavahāra (4b3) eva sādhyaḥ | etena parasparaparihārasthitilakṣaṇo virodho vyākhyātaḥ |
nanu yasmin vedyamāne yanmatir niyamena bhavituṃ sambhāvyata ity anenaiva gatam etat | aḍṛśyo 'pi hi tādātmyena niṣedhyamāno dṛśyatayā sambhāvita eva niṣidhyate | anyathā dṛśyādṛśyatayā svayam eva bhedābhyupagamād iti kim anena pṛthagvacaneneti cet | evaṃ tarhi na vā (4b4) syād ity ayam abhāvaḥ pradhvaṃsalakṣaṇo vyākhyāyate | pravṛttā 'pi yanmatir yatra vedye sati niyamena nivartata ity arthaḥ | niyamaś ca sattābādhane 'bhāva eva yuktaḥ | yathā neha śītam agner iti | etena sahānavasthānalakṣaṇo virodho vyākhyātaḥ | nanv andhakāre niyamenānupalambha iti nāvaśyaṃ viruddhaparigraha iti cet | naikapratipattrapekṣaṃ lakṣaṇam (4b5) etat kiṃ tu sāmānyena | asti ca nirālokasyāpi rūpasya darśanaṃ kaiścit | tenāpi vā sambhāvyam añjanaviśeṣādineti sattocchede tu niyama evety adoṣaḥ | nanv atrāpi śītaṃ yadi syān nāgner ekarūpaniyatā pratipattir iti kathaṃ pūrvato viśeṣaḥ | naivaṃ sparśanāgamye niṣedhasyābhimatatvāt | tarhi pravṛttā 'pi śītasya buddhir agnau vedye sati niyamān nivṛtteti (4b6) pratyetum aśakyaṃ | anyadaitatpratīter

[188] vivakṣitatvāt | tarhi prāggṛhītavirodhasmaraṇavyavahitavyāpāratvān na pratyakṣasya pravṛttito 'bhāvaniścayaḥ syāt |
mā bhūt kevalaṃ vyavadhāne 'pi tathāviruddhabuddhir evābhāvaniścayāṅgaṃ nānyamātrasyety anupalabdhivyavasthānibandhanasya na kṣatiḥ |
na ca vyavahāramātrasādhanam atrāpi sammatam ity āha | sāpekṣā tu parā smṛtāv ata ihābhāvo 'pi (4b7) sādhyaḥ | tatsiddhau ca tanniścayasthitilakṣaṇo vyavahāro 'pi na punas tanmātram ity arthaḥ |
tathā hetuvyāpakanihnave | abhāvo 'pi sādhya (48) iti vartate | yathā neha dhūmo 'gner abhāvāt | neha śiṃśapā vṛkṣābhāvāt | na hy atrāgnivṛkṣayoḥ pratiyogipratyakṣamātraṃ pūrvapravṛttatādātmyatadutpattisambandhabodhasmaraṇanirapekṣaṃ dhūmaśiṃśapayor abhāvaniścayaṃ prasavati | tato 'trāpy abhāvasādhanavyavahārasiddhiḥ |
(5a1) ta etarhi niṣedhahetavaḥ | svabhāvānupalabdhiḥ | kāraṇānupalabdhiḥ | vyāpakānupalabdhiś ceti | tathā vidhisādhanau dvāv iti (35)pañcahetavaḥ prasaktāḥ |
na | anupalabdhisāmānyāśrayād ekatvāt |
api ca | anupalabdhiḥ svasyāparasyāparā | kāraṇavyāpakayoḥ svabhāvānupalabdhir eva | aparasya kāryasya vyāpyasya vā 'parā kāraṇānupalabdhir vyāpakānupalabdhiś cocyate | yathā hy (5a2) anyapratyakṣam evānyasyānupalabdhiḥ | tathā kasyacit svabhāvānupalabdhir eva kāryavyāpyāpekṣayā kāraṇavyāpakānupalabdhir ucyata iti na vyapadeśabhedād vastubhedaḥ | tasmāt svabhāvānupalabdher eva niṣedhaḥ sarvasyeti trayam eva liṅgaṃ |
etena kāryasya svabhāvānupalabdhir eva samarthakāraṇasya kāryānupalabdhir upalakṣitā draṣṭavyā | hetuśabdasya vā liṅgārthasya vyākhyānāt | yathā (5a3) nehāpratibaddhasāmarthyāni dhūmakāraṇāni santi dhūmābhāvād iti |
kathaṃ tarhi nātra tuṣārasparśo 'gner iti vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhisaṅgrahaḥ | atrāpi vyāpakasya hi śītasya viruddhadahanopalabdhirūpā yā svabhāvānupalabdhiḥ sā vyāpyasya tuṣārasparśasya vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhir ucyata iti na doṣaḥ | yady api ca vyāpakānupalabdhir api (5a4) sā vaktuṃ śakyā tathā 'pi viruddhapratiyogipratītirūpatāpratipādanārthaṃ tathāvyapadeśaḥ | evaṃ kāraṇaviruddhopalabdhyādayo vyākhyeyāḥ | sarvatrābhāva eva sādhyo 'dhyakṣeṇāsiddheḥ | taddvārakas tu vyavahāra iti |
nanu viruddhopalabdhyādau katham anupalabdhivyavahāraḥ |
uktam atra pratiyogyupalabdhir evānupalabdhiḥ pratiyogī ca dvividha eva | tatra yadā viruddaḥ (5a5) pratiyogī tadā viruddhaśabdaprayoga upalabdhiśabdam eva prayojyam upapādayati | śeṣe tu pratiyogini

[189] gamyamāne svabhāvaśabdo dṛśyaśabdo vā prayujyamānaḥ pratiṣedhyāpekṣayā 'nupalabdhiśabdena vyapadeśayati | tad ekatropalabdhitvaṃ gamyam anyatrānupalabdhitvaṃ | tattvaṃ tv ekam eveti na doṣaḥ |
yadā ca viruddhaḥ pratiyogī dvitīyasya ca (5a6) parokṣasyaiva niṣedhas tadā tasyāpi nāvaśyaṃ pratyakṣam evānupalabdhiḥ kiṃ tv anumānam api | viruddho hi svasattayā parasattām apanayan pratiyogī mataḥ | na ca parokṣo 'pi tathābhavan kena vāryate | niyatasahopalambhe tu pratiyogini pratyakṣayogyasyaiva niṣedha iti tasyāvaśyaṃ pratyakṣāpekṣā | na hy anumīyamāne pradeśe ghaṭo yadi bhaved upalabhyetaiveti sāmarthyaṃ pratyakṣāyogād (5a7) anumānasya cārambhaniyamābhāvād iti kathaṃ niṣedhaḥ |
yady evaṃ vikalpamātrād apratiṣedha iti cet |
na tatrāpi vikalpākāre vedyamāne bahir apy abhimatadeśam indriyasāmarthyānapāye 'nubhūyetety ucyate | na tu vikalpanīye bāhye vikalpyamāne dvitīyam api vedyeteti śakyaṃ | vikalpanīye 'pi bāhye vikalpyamāne taddeśam aparam upalabhyetaiveti kiṃ na syāt | na hi (5b1) pratiyogijñānam anyasya dṛśyatāropanibandhanaṃ | api tv abhāvaniścayotpādanimittaṃ sattvavastutvāt | tac ca vikalpasyāpīti ko viśeṣaḥ |
atha pratipattranurodhaḥ | ekajñānasaṃsargiṇo 'py anurodhaḥ sādhur iti |
naivaṃ jale gandhasyānale rasasyāpi vāyau rūpasyāpi śeṣamātropalabdhau vā abhāvavyavahāramātradarśanāt | tatra vā jñānakāryānupalambhavāde 'nyatrāpi sa eveti kim ekajñānasaṃsargiṇā |
kāryānupalabdhyā samarthasyaiva (5b2) niṣedha iti cet |
gandhādis tarhi sann api nīrādāv indriyavaiguṇyān nopalambhya iti mahad eva śāstrapariśramaphalaṃ | sa hi vaiguṇyasya kāraṇānupalambhe 'pi yogyādibhir abhibhavaṃ sambhāvayan saṃśete | bhūtale tu tatkṛtābhūtadarśanam indriyapāṭave 'pi sambhāvayan kiṃ na saṃśete | tasmād abhyāsadaśāyāṃ tādavasthyasthityaiva vyavahāraḥ |
nyāyanāthasya tu na vyavahāram anuvṛttya (5b3) paryanuyogo visargo vā kiṃ tv etāvatyām api gatau nāsmallakṣaṇakṣatir iti darśayituṃ prauḍhivaśāt | yathā sarvacittāsarvabodhaniścaye 'pi sa eva sarvajña iti |
vyavahāre ca yathaikajñānasaṃsargiṇaṃ paśyatas tathā 'nyam api pratiyoginam abhāvaniścayo dṛṣṭaḥ sādhāraṇo 'visamvadī ceti naikajñānasaṃsargigrahaḥ | vikalpaśaraṇāvasthāyāṃ ca (5b4) tadākārasamvedanam evānyaniṣedhasādhanaṃ yuktaṃ | tathaivābhyāsena

[190] pratyakṣasāmarthyadarśanāt | tad evam viruddhasya parokṣasyāpy upalabdhir anumānātmikā 'bhāvam itarasya sādhayati | yathā neha śītaṃ dhūmād ity evaṃ vyāpakaviruddhakāryopalabdhir draṣṭavyā | yathā neha tuṣāraṃ dhumāt | etac ca saṅkalayya prayogakāle vyākhyānaṃ | vastutas tu (5b5) na śītam agner ity ekaḥ prayogaḥ | tadasiddhiparihārāya tu | asti cāgnir atra dhūmād ity aparaḥ | tathā na tuṣāram agneḥ | vyāpakasya hi viruddho viruddha eva | agniś ca dhūmād iti | śeṣam apy evam ūhyaṃ |
yadi kāraṇādeḥ svabhāvānupalabdhir anyasya kāraṇādyanupalabdhiḥ paryudāsarūpā | kathaṃ tarhi nirupākhyeṣu | yathā na vaktā bandhyāsutaś (5b6) caitanyābhāvād iti |
tatrāpi buddhipratibhāsasyaiva caitanyaviyuktatvena samvedanaṃ vyāpakānupalabdhiparyudāsaḥ | vaktṛtvavyavacchedena ca samvedanaṃ | vyāpyābhāvaḥ |
svabhāvahetuparyavasitāś ca sarvānupalabdhayo niṣedhasādhanādhyavasāyāc ca bhedena nirdeśa iti na doṣaḥ |
tathā 'py uktena krameṇa sākṣād eva svabhāvānupalabdhir niṣedha iti katham ācāryapādaiḥ (5b7) paramparayā 'bhidhānād aupacārikaḥ kṛta iti cet |
niṣedhyasyaiva yadi dṛśyānupalabdhir niṣeddhrā vivakṣitā tadaupacārikaḥ | yadi tu parasyāpi tadā mukhya iti ko virodha iti
kevalam aupacārikakathane kiṃ prayojanam iti syāt |
tatrāpi dṛśyasyaiva niṣedho yathā śakyaḥ syān nānyasya sarvajñavītarāgādeḥ pradhānapuruṣasyeti kāryatas tatrāntarbhāvaḥ | tattvatas tu tasya (6a1) tadanyasya vā yathoktasyānupalabdhiḥ sādhiketi ||

|| anupalabdhirahasyaṃ samāptam||
ĪSARVAŚABDĀBHĀVACARCĀ

[191,3] iha sarvaśabdābhāvasādhane jñānakāryānupalabdhim eke pramāṇayanti | ekajñānasaṃsargivirahāt kila neha svabhāvānupalabdher avasaraḥ |
[191,4] tathā hi trayam avaśyam asyām abhidheyaṃ ghaṭādimatpratikṣepeṇa viśeṣaṇaṃ svabhāvaḥ phalañ ceti | tatra dṛśyaviṣayaviśeṣaṇavaśāt piśācāder (6a2) apratiṣedhaḥ | ekajñānasaṃsargivedanasvabhāvatvena rūpajñānād rasasya | nāpy abhāvapakṣadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ | vyavahāraphalatayā ca pratyakṣasiddhir upasaṃhitā |
[191,7] sā ca pratiyogijñānāśraye saty upapadyate | tad eva pratiyogyantarābhāvanāntarīyakatayā tadabhāvavikalpajananasāmarthyāt sādhanaṃ bhavet | tato mūḍhaṃ prati tadātmikānupalabdhir abhāvavyavahārasādhanīti (6'a1) yuktam |
na ca sarvaśabdābhāve sādhye kaścid ekajñānasaṃsargī labhyata iti nātrāvakāśas tasyāḥ | sa tu śabdarāśir abhimatapradeśe vidyamānas tadā jñānakāryam anārabhyāsituṃ na samartha iti kāryapratiṣedhe 'pi nirviśeṣeṇaiva sattā pratiṣiddhā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
[191,13] atra cintyate | na tāvat dhvanir ity eva śravaṇam vadhirasyāpi prasaṅgāt | tasmād indriyapāṭavasahakṛtasyaiva śabdasya (6'a2) śravaṇajñānajanakatvam | tac ca śravaṇapāṭavam ekajñānasaṃsargivirahe duravadhāram | ata eva pradeśapratyakṣāpekṣayā ghaṭaniṣedhaḥ | tato hīndriyaguṇaṃ gaṇayan ghaṭāparādham evānupalabdher avadhārayati |
[191,16] na ca manaskāravat svasaṃvedanasiddhir indriyasya jaḍatvāt | nāpīndriyāntaragamyatvam | atīndriyatvāt | kāryaṃ punar upalabdhir evāsya | tatsiddhau ca kāryānupalabdher (6'a3) evāsiddhiḥ | asiddhau siddham anaikāntikatvam | na hi viṣaye saty apīndriyadoṣāt sambhāvyamāno 'nupalambhas tadabhāvaniyato nāma |
[191,21] nābhāva eva śabdasya tajjñānajananayogyas tu nāstīti brūma iti cet |
seyaṃ kuvaidyavṛttir āyātā | prathamaṃ prāgalbhyagarbham abhimatapratikaraṇam abhyupagamyopāyabuddhyopanyastasyānupāyasya pareṇa (6'a4] tattvapratipādane kṛte paścād asādhyatvaghoṣaṇāt | sarvathā 'bhāva eva hi jijñāsite kāryānupalabdhir iyaṃ sādhanam uktā | na tu jñānajananayogyatāvirahajijñāsāyām | tad yadi pramāṇabhraṃśa eva kathañcij jñātaḥ | prameyabhraṃśas tu kimaṅgāṅgīkriyate |
[192,1] varaṃ ca pramāṇāntaram eva mṛgyatām asādhyataiva tu kasmād avaghuṣyate | na hi śakyam avadhirasyāśṛṇvataḥ (6'a5) sannihitabherīravādyabhāvaḥ pratikṣeptum | vadhirāvadhirayor aviśeṣaprasaṅgāt |
 sati śrutikṛto 'sti viśeṣaḥ prāk paścād iti cet | naivam | yadi hi prāgavasthātaḥ śravaṇaśaktyānirviśeṣaḥ eṣaḥ | katham aśrutiḥ sati śabde | anyathā prāg api na syāt | atha visadṛśāvastho 'pi sambhāvyate | śrutāv api na śraddhātavyam asya viplavasya (6'a6] sambhāvyamānatvāt | tatrāśravaṇam abhūtaśravaṇaṃ veti na viśeṣaḥ |
 ante kutaḥ śaktiviparyaya iti cet | madhye kutas tadabhāva iti samānam | tasmād apakṣa evāyaṃ sann api śabdas tadā na śruta iti | kevalaṃ kim atra pramāṇam astv iti cintāyāṃ kāryānupalabdhir anaikāntikīty uktam eva | śravaṇapāṭavasya duravadhāratvād iti |
[192,11] nanu katham etad duravadhāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭaśravaṇapāṭavasmaraṇabalavataḥ (6'a7) śrotuṃ pravṛttasya | kṣaṇikatve 'pi hi visadṛśasahakāripratyayāntaravirahe visadṛśadaśāsambhavābhāvāt | indriyavikārakāriṇo hi pratyayā dhātukṣobhaprahārādayo nirṇītaśaktayaḥ svasantāne santānavyākulībhāvahetavaḥ sūpalakṣā eva | anupalakṣItās tu svaprabhavabhedaśaṅkā katham iva kṣamante | sūkṣmaṃ tu prabhāvavato 'dhiṣṭhānādivikārakāraṇaṃ (6'b1) śaṅkamānasya śravaṇe 'pi ka āśvāsaḥ | tasmād anupalakṣyakāraṇārabdhadiṅmohalakṣaṇendriyabhrāntidarśane 'pi prasiddhakāraṇānupalakṣaṇān nendriyāṇām atādavasthyavyavasthā yathā anyathā tatpratyayānāṃ bhramatvaprasaṅgāt tathādyāpi kiṃ na gaṇyate mābhūt sarvasaṃvṛttivilopaḥ |
[192,19] abhyāsadaśāsattisamāśrayas tu samānaḥ | na hi vadhiravarasyābhiropārūḍhaśravaṇabalasyāpy aśravaṇe (6'b2) 'bhāvaniścayaṃ brūmaḥ balaniścayasyaivābhāvāt | tadvad anyasyāpy akalitabalasya | atyantābhyāse hi sakalarajanīsuptaprabuddhānām adarśane 'pi tadavasthāsaṃvedinām aviparītavyavahāravṛttidarśanāt kaḥ prastāvo jāgrataḥ svātmany anyathātvaśaṅkāyāḥ |
 tasmād atādavasthasya tadvyavasthāyā vā niṣedhaḥ prasiddhakāraṇābhāvāt tadupalakṣaṇābhāvād vā |
 yadi (6'b3) darśanaśravaṇādāv abhyāsadaśāpekṣayādhyakṣatvanibandhanaṃ tādavasthyam icchatā saṃvṛtivyavasthite nendriyatādavasthyaṃ sāmagrīpratibuddhabuddhitādavasthyaṃ vā sādhāraṇaśaktyapekṣayā svasaṃvedanam eva vā śaraṇam āsthīyate | tad evāśravaṇadaśāyām apīti katham anekāntaḥ śabdābhāve |
 nanu jñānātmany eva svasaṃvedanam (6'b4) iti cet | na |

[193]  ekādhimokṣaviṣayeṣv ekakāryopayogiṣu |
 ekadhīḥ sarvaviṣayā sthitā nirbhāgavartiṣu ||

 pañcaskandheṣv apy aham ity eko 'dhimokṣaḥ | bhāṣaṇādāv ekasminn arthe parasparopādeye copayogaḥ | ghaṭādisaṃjñake tu rūparasādau prasiddho 'yaṃ nyāyaḥ | anyathā vyavahārāyogāt |
[193,5] nanu na (6'b5) śarīrapratyakṣaṃ buddhim anveti | evam etat prātisvikarūpāpekṣayā rūparasādivad eva | sāmānyena tu gṛhītvaikadhīviṣayatvam ucyate yāvan na nirbandho vivecane | vivecane tu pṛthakpramāṇam uktam | tena pratyakṣaś caitro na ca buddhir adhyakṣeti dvitayam aviruddham | ata eva tadavastho 'ham iti vikalpo 'pi (6'b6) saṃvedanānusārī sarvaviṣaya eva |
[193,9] bhrāntir iyam iti cet | na | bādhakābhāvād bhrāntyasiddheḥ | tasmāt pūrvapratītaśrotraśaktes tadavasthāniścayasambhavād aśrutiḥ śabdasyaivāparādhād iti jñānābhāvenāpi tadabhāvasiddhir aikāntikīti na prakṛtavyāghātaḥ | iyaty eva tarhi svabhāvānupalabdher (6'b7) lakṣaṇasāmagrīti kāryānupalabdhisaṃjñākaraṇe ko 'rthaḥ | pratyayāntarasākalyaṃ svabhāvaviśeṣaṃ cāpannasyaiva śabdasyānupalabdhyā niṣedhāt | tathāpy anyasaṃjñāyāṃ ghaṭaniṣedhe 'pi ko niṣeddhā kevalaṃ ghaṭavat śabdasyāpi dṛśyānupalabdhyāpi niṣedhaḥ sādhyo jāta ity ucyate | tatraikajñānasaṃsargisambhavād yuktaḥ tayā niṣedha iti cet |
 tatraiva (6a3) tāvad ekajñānasaṃsargiṇaḥ kim apekṣayā | rūpadarśane hi rasasya viprakṛṣṭadeśatayā 'nupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvād evāpratiṣedhaḥ prāpyakāritvād ghrāṇarasanasparśanānām | uktena ca krameṇendriyatādavasthyaṃ siddham iti kim ekajñānasaṃsargyapekṣayā | naivam indriyātiriktasyālokasya tatrāpekṣyatvāt | sa hi bahiḥsulabhakāraṇādhīnopajanāpajanadharmako na svātmatādavasthyasādhya (6a4) iti tadartham ekajñānasaṃsargo 'pekṣyamāṇa indriyasādguṇyajñāne 'pi sahāyībhaviṣyati |
 evaṃ yatrālokanirapekṣaiva grahaṇaśaktis tatra na kiñcid ekajñānasaṃsargyapekṣayeti siddham | tac ca nāma kvacit sādhane 'pekṣyate yadantareṇa virodhāsiddhisandeheṣv anyatamadoṣāsattiḥ | na ca dvividhopalabdhiyogyatāpannasya kvacid (6a5) anupalabdhyā niṣedhe sā 'sti yena saṃsargī niyatam apekṣyeta | yatrāpy ayam apekṣyate | tatrāpi ālokāpekṣapratipattino vastunaḥ pratiṣedhe viśeṣaṇāsiddhiparihārārtham eva | na caitāvatā sarvatra tadapekṣā | na hi vināśaṃ praty anapekṣā vyāptisādhanī sarvatra kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhane 'pi svabhāvahetāv apekṣyate |
 [194,3] yadi cāyam apekṣya eva kimaṅga dṛśyaviśeṣaṇena (6a6) kenacid ekajñānasaṃsargino dṛśyatvāvyabhicārāt | na hi piśācasya kenacid ekajñānasaṃsargaḥ
 eka evārtha ubhayathāpīti naikaprayoge 'nyaprayojanacarceti cet |
 na sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena bhedasyāvyaktatvāt | saṃsargo hi na viśeṣaṇaṃ vyabhicarati | viśeṣaṇamātraṃ tu taṃ vyabhicaraty eva | ata eva viśeṣaṇasiddhaye saṃsarga upanīyate na tu viśeṣaṇaṃ saṃsargākṛṣṭaye (6a7) prabhavati śabde 'pi prasaṅgāt | tathā ca pakṣakṣaya iti kaḥ śramasyārthaḥ | tasmād ekajñānasaṃsargo nāma prakṛtodāharaṇāpekṣayaivodghuṣyate | na svabhāvānupalabdhau sarvatrāpekṣyatvena ||
 [194,10] prastute hi kalasapratiṣedhe sā dig astu saviśeṣaṇasiddhyai | nopalabdham upalabhyam itīyallakṣaṇaṃ khalu nijānupalabdheḥ | tathā ca lakṣaṇe prayoge copalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalabdhimātropanyāsaḥ | śāstre viparyayabādhopadarśane ca pratyayāntarasannidhau svabhāvaviśeṣavataḥ sattve 'nupalabdher asambhavaḥ khyāpyate | anyathā prayojakam aṃśaṃ saṃsargam eva sarvatra darśayet viśeṣaṇavat | tādātmyaṃ tu dṛśyatvam abhyupagamyaiva niṣidhyata iti viśeṣaṇasyānuktimātram na punar aprayojakatvaṃ vyāpter iva viduṣi | anvayoktiviśeṣe vā vyatirekasya | tasmāt nyāyanāthasyāpi nāvaśyam ekajñānasaṃsargivyapekṣābhiprāyaḥ svabhāvānupalabdhau |
 [194,17] api caivaṃ kāryānupalabdhāv eva sarvasaṅgraham ācakṣīta svabhāvānupalabdher api tadekadeśatvāt | sarvapramāṇasaṅgrahavyavasthāṃ ca kāryānumāne kuryāt svasaṃvedanād anyatra |
 [194,19] tasmād indriyajñānaviṣaye na kāryānumānavyavasthā yathā tathā tadagṛhīta ity eva kutaḥ kāryānupalabdhivyavasthāpi śāstrakārasya | yathā hi pratyakṣavyavasthāvilopabhayam ekatra tathānyatra svabhāvānupalambhasya | yathā vā 'pratyakṣe kāryaṃ liṅgam tathā 'pratyakṣayogya eva tadanupalabdhir iti samānam |
 yathā vāyam eva bhagavān jñāne jñānāntarābhāvam api dṛśyānupalabdhyā vyavahārayati | yad āha;

 dṛśyātmano vā vikalpasya darśane 'dṛṣṭir
vikalpakalpanām indriyajñāne pratihantīti

 tadā ka ekajñānasaṃsargī | kiṃ caivamabhyupagame kāryānupalabdher apy asiddhir iti prakṛtamatahānir eva | na hi jñānakāryasyābhāvaḥ kāryānupalabdher eva boddhavyo 'navasthāprasaṅgāt |  svasaṃvedanaṃ caikākāraniyatam anyābhāvaniścayam ākṣipty eva kevalaṃ vimataṃ prati yadi syāj jñānāntaram anubhūyeteti dṛśyānupalabdhir eva śaraṇaṃ vyavahāre bāhyavat | viśeṣaṇānuccāraṇaṃ tu syāt | na tv anyā gatiḥ | saṃsargāpekṣāyāṃ ca sāpi nāstīti sandigdhāsiddho hetuḥ | tasmād anupalabdher ekajñānasaṃsargāpekṣāniyamam anullaṅghya vartitum aśakyam |
 [195,4] bahir apekṣayā niyamo veti cet? na tatrāpi nibandhanābhāvāt | yad dhi sāmarthyam antas tadatikrame tasya bahir api lābhasambhave kiṃ na sadṛśī sthitiḥ | vicitro hi viṣayasvabhāvaḥ | tatra svātmā tāvat pratyakṣībhāve yogyatāmātram apekṣate | śabdagandharasasparśatamisrālokās tu manaskārātiriktam indriyaṃ ghaṭādisanniveśinas tu rūpaviśeṣāḥ prakāśam api prāyaśaḥ | tathaiṣāṃ vidhāv upalabdhir iva svabhāvasyānupalabdhir api niṣedhe kiṃ na bhinnām eva sāmagrīm apekṣeta |
 [195,10] tatrādye yathā nendriyatādavasthyenopayogaḥ tathā madhyamīyeṣv api naikajñānasaṃsargiṇā | anyātiriktāpekṣiṇas tadapekṣā yujyate 'pi | tato yathā yadi buddhiḥ syād upalabhyetaiva kim indriyatādavasthyāpekṣayeti sāmarthyam tathā yadi syād rasādis tadavasthendriyeṇa mayopalabhyetaiva kim ekajñānasaṃsargiṇeti śakyam eva | tasmād bahir api niyamasambhāvanā 'tidūraivābhyupagame vā jñāne 'py apekṣeta |
 [195,15] tatrāpi saṃvedanaikapratyakṣāpekṣaikajñānasaṃsargo 'stīti cet |  nanu na saṃvedanaṃ nāmaikaṃ pratyakṣam asti dharmamātrasya tasya pratisvaṃ bhedāt | sāmānyam āśrityaikajñānasaṃjñayā tu parituṣṭau bhinnendriyagrāhyayor api svasaṃvedanendriyajñānaviṣayayor api vā prasaṅgaḥ | yayoḥ sator anyonyapratyakṣāvyabhicāras tatreyaṃ vyavastheti cet | rūpayor api nāyaṃ niyamaḥ | pradeśapiśācayor adarśanāt | viśiṣṭayor asty eva | na ca sāmānyāparādho viśeṣam āskandatīti cet | evam api śabdākāśayoḥ śabdamanaskārayor vā prasaṅgaḥ | na hy ākāśapratyakṣaṃ manaskārasaṃvedanapratyakṣaṃ vā sattve śabdasya pratyakṣaṃ vyabhicarati | vyabhicāre punaḥ kāryānupalabdher anekāntaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmād avyāpakam ekajñānāpekṣaṇam anyasyāpi ca sulabham ity alaṃ vimatyā |
 [195,24] api cāyaṃ cittayor ekajñānasaṃsargo 'pūrva eva mukhyasyābhāvād gauṇasya caikāyatanasaṅgrahābhāvāt | upalakṣaṇam ekāyatanasaṅgraha iti cet | ekajñānasaṃsarga eva kiṃ nopalakṣaṇam ākhyāyate | prakṛtaghaṭodāharaṇāpekṣayā tu dvayam apy etad uktam ity anabhiniveśaḥ |
[196] yathā hy ekāyatanasaṅgraheṇānyonyapratyakṣāvyabhicāra upalakṣyate tathaikajñānasaṃsargeṇāpi pratiyogimātrāpekṣaiveti yujyate |
 kaś ca kasya pratiyogī | yayor ekākāraniyataṃ pratyakṣam itarābhāvaniścayam upapādayituṃ śaknotīti | kayoś caivam anupalabdhiḥ | yayor ekapratyakṣam aparapratyakṣāvyabhicāri | tayor hi sator naikarūpaniyatā pratipattir asambhavāt | tatas tāvat yo viśiṣṭakāladeśadaśāsantānāpekṣayānyo 'nyasya pratiyoginau vyavasthāpyete | sa dṛśyaḥ saṃvittilābhalakṣaṇe 'yogas tayor iti kṛtvā | ata eva tayor ekākāraniyataṃ vedanam anyasya pratiṣedhavikalpam upapādayituṃ śaknotīti tādṛśām abhāvaḥ pratyakṣasiddho 'bhidhīyate | tam eva niścayaṃ mūḍhaṃ prati pratiyogyupalambhasvabhāvānupalabdhir upalabdhiyogyatā yugayoginaḥ sambhavantī vyāhāravyāhārāv api sādhayatīti tāvataivetaramatapratikṣepeṇa svabhāvaphalayor api pariniṣṭhāsiddhau kim ekendriyagrāhyatāpekṣopagraheṇa |
 [196,12] ayaṃ hi pratiyoga ekenānekena vendriyeṇa grāhyayor arthayor jñānayor jñānārthayor vā sādhāraṇo 'bhāvasādhane ca nirapavāda iti kas tadanurodhaḥ | yathā hi bhūtalakalasayoḥ jñānayor vaikarūpavedanam anyapratyakṣāvyabhicāritayā tadabhāvaniścayotpādane paryāptam tathā pānakapānakarmaṇi dvayam upalabdhavatas tādavasthyasaṃvedinaḥ pradīpakavalane sparśamātropalabdhī rasābhāvaniścayajanane |
 svavikalpākāramātrasaṃvedanaṃ vā sannihitasparśābhāvāvasāyasādhane śaknoty eva | na hi tadvikalpavedanaṃ tadā sataḥ sparśasya pratyakṣaṃ vyabhicarati | na cānyonyapratyakṣāvyabhicārād anyad anyatrāpi dvitīyābhāvaniścayotpādanasāmarthyaṃ nāma | nāpy abhāvaniścayotpādanasāmarthyād arthāntaram abhāvapratyakṣīkaraṇaṃ nāma | na hy asau vigrahavān yataḥ sākṣātkartavyaḥ |
 yadā ca paryudāsena pratiyogy evābhāvas tadā tv asya mukhyaiva pratyakṣasiddhir iti yuktaṃ sarvatra vyavahāraphalatvam | na cāyaṃ pratiyogaḥ svabhāvādiviprakarṣiṇāṃ kenacid asti yena kasyacit pratyakṣaṃ tadabhāvavibhāvanāya prabhavet | na caivaṃ nivṛttimātram anupalabdhir ukta bhavati |
 bhaṭṭas tu paryudāsapakṣe 'pi yathoktaṃ pratiyoginam anapekṣyānyamātrasyopalabdhim anupalabdhiṃ pramāṇayatīti tanmate yuktaḥ piśācādipratikṣepaḥ | rūpadarśinas tu rasas taddeśaviprakṛṣṭa eva | na tena pratiyogaṃ yathoktam āvahati | rasanāgrasaṅgī tu nābhāvam anupalabdhau vyabhicarati
[197] iti na dośaḥ kaścit | ata eva kāryānupalabdhyādīnām sākṣād akṣamaḥ svabhāvānupalabdhau antarbhāvaḥ paramparyeṇocyate | tādṛśasya pratiyogasyābhāvat |
 tasmād upalambhayogyatāprāptasyānupalambha ity eva dṛśyānupalabdher lakṣaṇam | sā ca yathoktapratiyogyupalambharūpatayā siddhasyābhāvasya vyavahārikasyaivāvatiṣṭhata iti na nyāyaśāstrayor uparodhaḥ | ekendriyagrāhyopanyāsas tu ghaṭādyudāharaṇāpekṣa eva mantavya iti sthitam | tatra yadā tāvat timirālokasaṃjñite ākāśapradeśe dṛśyamāne devakulādau vā bheryāder evābhāvaṃ pratipadyate tadā tad eva tadekākāroparaktajñānaviṣayībhavatjñānaṃ vā tādṛśaṃ niyataprāptikapratyakṣodayasya niṣedhyasya tajjñānasya vā paryudāso 'nupalabdhiḥ | avyāpṛtacakṣus tu rasādis tajjñānaṃ vāntato manaskārākāro jñeyaparyudāsaḥ | tatsaṃvedanaṃ ca paryudāsaḥ |
 na hi tad api śabdapratyakṣodayavinākṛtam upapadyate paṭuśravaṇasya | nirvikalpakasya tu na niṣedhe 'dhikāraḥ | kevalaṃ yāvaddeśasambaddhasya dhvaner adhyakṣaṃ na vyabhicarati rasādipratyakṣaṃ vikalpākārasaṃvedanaṃ vā tāvaddeśaśabdāpekṣaiva paryudāso vaktavyaḥ anyaṃ prati pratiyogasyānyonyapratyakṣāvyabhicāralakṣaṇasya vaktum aśakyatvāt | tataś ca pūrvavat pratyakṣasiddhir abhāvasya | vyavahāraś ca phalaṃ dṛśyānupalabdher eva śabde 'pīti siddham |

ekadhīvirahe 'py asyā vyāpārānuparodhataḥ |
anākṛṣṭer aniṣṭasya pratiyogisamāśrayāt ||

iti || ālokādisamagrādhigataye janmādhikavyañjakāpekṣe sūcita ekadhīparicayo śabdapradīpādiṣu | kiñcit tu śrutadṛṣṭapūrvimanasas tādṛgdṛśaḥ saṃvedo 'nyeṣu svānupalabdhir eva hi svādyākāraśūnyānyadhīḥ ||
nākṣasya siddhaṃ yadi tādavasthyaṃ śaktinaṃ kāryānupalambhanasya | akṣasya siddhaṃ yadi tādavasthyaṃ phalaṃ na kāryānupalambhanasya ||

[198]avaśyāpekṣaṇīyatve svabhāvānupalabdhiṣu |
saṃsargasya kathaṃ siddhir jñānakāryadṛśo 'pi vaḥ ||
bāhya evaiṣa niyamo yadi tatrāpi kiṃkṛtaḥ |
pradeśamātrayogyatvāc citrā hi viṣayasthitiḥ ||
anālokasya dhīr yadvad bādhā nānuktabhedikā |
saṃsargiṇam anādṛtya tathā bādhāt tu kutracit ||

tasyāstu rūpaṃ pratiyogi vastuvijñānam eveti na bhaṭṭabhītiḥ | tathā hi so 'pi pratiyogibhāvo mithaḥ samakṣāvyabhicāra eva ||

tata evaikavijñānam anyābhāvavikalpakṛt |
nābhāvabodhyo 'dhyakṣeṇa tatkṛtān niścayāt paraḥ ||
yathoktapratiyogitve saty eva kṣamam akṣajam |
tadabhāvāvasāyāyetīdṛśī vastunaḥ sthitiḥ ||

nanu pratiyogyevaikajñānasaṃsargī sākṣād ekajñānasaṃsargasyābhimatatvān mukhyatayā sākārasvīkārāt | tataḥ sāmarthyād ekaśabdo 'vyabhicāramātropalakṣaṇatayā 'vatiṣṭhate | pratyakṣaikajātyapekṣayā caikavṛttir eva | na caivaṃ saṃjñāmātram tathā rūḍhadarśanāt yathaiko brīhiḥ sampannaḥ subhikṣaṃ karotīti | tena yatrāpy ekajñānasaṃsargiṇi dṛśyamāna iti ucyate tatrāpy anyonyapratyakṣāvyabhicāriṇīty ayam evārthaḥ | ekāyatanabhāva eva tūpalakṣaṇatayā prakṛtāpekṣatayā vyākhyeyaḥ yathā pradeśas tajjñānaṃ cānupalabdhir iti |
tataś ca svabhāvānupalabdhau pratiyogisamāśraya ity ekajñānasaṃsargasamāśraya evokto bhavatīti katham avyāpakam ekajñānasaṃsargitvaṃ nāma | satyam evam | pratiyugasitaikadhīsthitir yadi bhavate pratibhāti kā kṣatiḥ | nanu sakalakalāpasaṃhṛtaṃ svayam adṛśo 'stu niṣedhanaṃ dhvaneḥ ||
[199] anyonyapratyakṣāvyabhicārasya kenāpi dhvanāv api sambhavāt itarasya tu pratiyoginaḥ ayogāt | pratiyogaparyavasitam ekajñānasaṃsargaṃ manyamānasya svānupalabdhiḥ prakṛtaniṣedhe kā parāpekṣā | tasmān na yogyadeśāviśeṣaśabdābhāvasādhane jñānakāryānupalambhaḥ śaraṇīkaraṇīyaḥ svabhāvānupalabdhyaiva siddher iti | timirālokayos tu parasparadeśaparihāreṇa sthitayor abhinnendriyakṛta evaikajñānasaṃsargaḥ sulabha iti tadabhāvasādhanādhikāre dūrasthitaiva svabhāvānupalambhād anyasādhanacinteti ||

|| sarvaśabdābhāvacarcā samāptā ||
APOHAPRAKARAṆAM

[201,3] apohaḥ śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ prakāśyata iti sthitiḥ |
[201,4] sādhyate sarvadharmāṇām avācyatvaprasiddhaye ||
[201,5] sthitir vyavasthā | prasādhya? kāśyata ity antenāpoho 'trābhideya uktaḥ | śeṣeṇa
[201,6] tatprasādhanaphalam | athavā yad ācāryair apohaḥ śabdādinā prakāśyata iti vyavasthā kriyate
[201,7] tad etad artham ity arthaḥ | ubhayathāpi sarvadharmānabhilāpyatvapratipādanaparam apohavyavasthāpanam
[201,8] ity uktaṃ bhavati |
[201,9] nanv apohaḥ śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ prakāśyata ity anubhavabādhitam etat | tathā hīha
[201,10] mahīdharoddeśe vahnir astīti śabdāl liṅgād vā pratītir vidhirūpam evollikhantī lakṣyate |
[201,11] nānagnir na bhavatīti nivṛttimātram āmukhayantī | yac cānubhavabādhitaṃ na tatra sādhanāntara-
[201,12] cintā, sarvapramāṇapauruṣasya tatraiva viśrāmāt (8b) tatprasūtes tatphalatvāc ca | na hi
[201,13] pratyakṣopakāranirapekṣaḥ pramāṇāntarodayaḥ | nāpi pramāṇāntarodayamātreṇa kṛtārthaḥ
[201,14] pramāṇānusārī yāvan na tadupanītasādhanārthakriyānubhavaḥ | tasmāt tadanapekṣāyām asāmarthya-
[201,15] vaiyarthyagrastaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ svayam eva na kiñcid iti na tena sādhite bādhite vāvakāśam
[201,16] āsādayati | tat katham apohaḥ śabdādigocara ucyate?
[201,17] atha yady api nivṛttim ahaṃ pratyemīti na vikalpaḥ, tathāpi nivṛttipadārthollekha eva
[201,18] nivṛttyullekhaḥ | na hy anantarbhāvitaviśeṣaṇapratītir viśiṣṭāpratītiḥ | tato yathā sāmānyam
[201,19] ahaṃ pratyemīti vikalpābhāve 'pi sādhāraṇākāraparisphuraṇād vikalpabuddhiḥ sāmānya-
[201,20] buddhiḥ pareṣām, tathā nivṛttipratyayākṣiptā nivṛttibuddhir apohapratītivyavahāram ātanotīti
[201,21] cet? nanu sādhāraṇakāraparisphuraṇe vidhirūpatayā yadi sāmānyabodhavyavasthā, tat
[201,22] kim āyātam asphuradabhāvākāre cetasi nivṛttipratītivyavasthāyāḥ? tato nivṛttim ahaṃ
[201,23] pratyemīty evam ākārābhāve 'pi nivṛttyākāraṇnasphuraṇaṃ yadi syāt, ko nāma nivṛttipratīti-

[226,14] deśabhrāntiś ca na jñāne tulyam utpattito dhiyaḥ |
[226,15] tathāvidhāyā anyatra tatrānupagamād dhiyaḥ || (PV III 13)
[226,18] iti | tasmān na rūpyādivad āropadvāreṇa pravṛttir api tu tathāvidhākārotpattipratibaddhaśakti-
[226,19] niyamāt, yathā śālitvena śālibījam upādānaṃ niranvayodaye 'pi śālyaṅkura upādeye,
[226,20] śālitvādisthiteḥ sthairyadūṣaṇena nirastatvāt | na ca vicārakasya vastvadarśanaṃ niścinvataḥ
[226,21] apravṛttiprasaṅgaḥ saṅgacchate, darśane 'pi hi pravṛttir arthakriyayānvitayā, arthakriyāprāptiś ca
[226,22] vastusattāniyame | sa ca niyamo yathā darśanād vastupratibandhakṛtas tathā vikalpaviśeṣād
[226,23] api pāramparyeṇeti nānumānam anavasthitam | śabdāt tu kvacid arthasaṃśayeneti prāpter api
[226,24] tatrāniyamaḥ | tasmād adhyavasitam ity apratibhāse 'pi pravṛttiviṣayīkṛtam ity arthaḥ |
[226,25] tato vikalpabuddhāv apratibhāse 'py adhyavasitaṃ na bāhyasya bādhyate | ayam eva
[226,26] cārtho dṛśyavikalpayor ekīkaraṇasyābhedapratipattyādeś ca | tataś ca tac ca na pratīyate tena
[226,27] cābhedabhāsanam ity upālambho 'sambhavīti darśitam, tadarthaniṣṭhāyāḥ kṛtatvāt | sa cāgnir atra
[226,28] iti vyavasāyo yathā kāyikīṃ pravṛttiṃ prasūte, tathāgnir mayā pratīta iti vācikīm api
[227,1] prasūte | etadākārānuvyavasāyarūpāṃ mānasīm api prasavati | evaṃ sati yathā vikalpena
[227,2] ayam artho gṛhīta iti niścayas tathā śabdena saṃyojyety api, arthākāraleśavac chabdākārasyāpi
[227,3] sphuraṇāt | tasmād yāvad arthagrahaṇābhimānavān mānavaḥ (19a) tāvad abhidhānasaṃyuktagrahaṇābhimānavān
[227,4] apīty avasāyānurodhād eva vikalpavyavasthā na tattvataḥ |
[227,5] āha ca,
[227,6] na śabdaiḥ saṃsargaḥ kvacid api bahir vā manasi vākṣara-
[227,7] ākārākīrṇaḥ sphurati punar arthākṛtilavaḥ |
[227,8] ubhāv apy ātmānau yad api dhiya evādhyavasitir
[227,9] nidhatte tau bāhye vacasi ca vikalpasthitir ataḥ ||
[227,10] ata eva ca tadabhimānamlānamānasaṃ vyāvahārikaṃ prati pratyakṣalakṣaṇe kalpanāpoḍha-
[227,11] viśeṣaṇam upādīyate, sūtrato 'pi vikalpād adhyavasāyeneti bhedanirdeśaḥ | tatrāpi nāyam
[227,12] adhyavasāyadhvanir dharmiṇa eva vikalpasyābhidhāyakaḥ prayuktaḥ, kiṃ tu tadgatasyādhyavasāna-
[227,13] lakṣaṇasya dharmasya | tad ayam arthaḥ, adṛṣṭe 'pi pravartanayogyatā nāma yo dharmas tayā vikalpāt
[227,14] pravṛttir iti | jñātaś ced artho vyavasthāpito 'dhyavasāyāt saṃvṛttyā, tato viṣayavyavahāro 'pi
[227,15] labdha ity avasāyamātreṇa viṣayatvam iti yuktam |
[227,16] ata uktam,
[227,17] arthaś caiko 'dhyāsato vācya iti |
[227,18] yad āha bhāṣyakāraḥ,
[227,19] kathaṃ tadviṣayatvaṃ tatra pravartanād iti | (PVA***)
[227,21] yas tu katham adṛṣṭe pravartanam ity āśaṅkyādṛṣṭa eva sarvatra pravartanam ityādisiṃhanādaḥ, sa
[227,22] na vipañcito 'smābhir grandhagauravabhayāt |
[227,23] evaṃ svapratibhāse 'narthādhyavasāyena pravṛtter ity atrāpy anarthe svapratibhāse sati
[227,24] adhyavasāyaḥ pūrvavat, arthas tv arthakriyāsamartho bāhya uktaḥ | tatparyudāsenānartho buddhyākāraḥ |
[227,25]  evaṃ sa vastv iti asann iti ca draṣṭavyam | etac ca vārttikavācaiva sphuṭīkṛtaṃ
[228,1] Sākārasiddhau | arthādhyavasāyena pravṛttir anumānasyety api hi arthādhyavasāyānumānam ity arthaḥ |
[228,2] Ṭīkākārasya tu yathā 'tra vyākhyānaṃ svāpohasiddhau tad dheyam eva, vistaraprasaṅgabhītyāna-
[228,3] udbhāvitam asmābhiḥ |
[228,4] yadi tarhi bāhyasyādhyavasāyena vācyatā, kathaṃ buddhyākārasya? yac chāstram,
[228,5] anādivāsanodbhūtavikalpapariniṣṭhitaḥ |
[228,6] śabdārthaḥ trividho dharmī bhāvābhāvobhayāśrayaḥ || (PV III 204-5)
[228,8] ityādi |
[228,9] vikalpapratibimbeṣu tanniṣṭheṣu nibadhyate |
[228,10] tato 'nyāpohaniṣṭhatvād uktānyāpohakṛc chrutiḥ ||
[228,11] vyatirekīva yajjñāne bhāty arthapratibimbakam |
[228,12] śabdāt tad api nārthātmā bhrāntiḥ sā vāsanodbhavā || (PV II 164-5)
[228,14] iti | na hi buddhyākāre 'py adhyavasāyaḥ śakyo 'bhidhātum, pravṛttiviṣaye tasya vyavasthāpanāt |
[228,15] sa cārthakriyārthino bāhya evety āha,
[228,15] bhāsate 'nyo 'rtho vācya iti |
[228,16] bāhyād anyo buddhyākāra ity arthaḥ | śabdādijanyāyāṃ buddhāv ākāramātrasya pratibhāsanāt sa
[228,17] eva viṣaya ucyate, cakṣuṣa iva rūpaṃ viṣayaḥ, na punar adhyavasāyād iti bhāvaḥ | uktaṃ ca,
[228,18] yathāpratīti kathitaḥ śabdārtho 'sāv asann api (PV III 83)
[228,20] iti | asann iti tu yathāpratibhāsaṃ bahirabhāvāt, bahirmukhāpekṣayā ca cintāyāḥ
[228,21] prakramāt | ayam evārtho yathādhyavasāyam atattvāt, yathātattvaṃ cānadhyavasāyād iti |
[228,22] adhyavasāyasya vikalpaparyāyatvād yathāvikalpasphuraṇam ity arthaniṣṭhānāt | asadartha-
[228,23] prakāśanāder api yathāpratīti bahirasattvam evārthaḥ | bhrāntitvam api bahirapekṣayaiveti sarvam
[229,1] anākulam | na tu svasaṃvedanagocarasya jñānarūpatayārthatvāt keśādyākārasyevāsattābhidhānaṃ
[229,2] (19b) sādhu | ata eva vācyatve 'pi,
[229,3] nākārasya na bāhyasya tattvato vidhisādhanam |
[229,4] bahir eva saṃvṛttyā saṃvṛtyāpi tu nākṛteḥ || (***)
[229,6] na hy asandehasya viṣayasya svasaṃvedyasyākārasya śabdādināvidhiniṣedhayogaḥ
[229,7] vaiyarthyād asāmarthyāc ca | nāpi vikalpāpratibhāsino bāhyasya | viṣayāpratipatter hi kasya
[229,8] vidhir niṣedho vā syāt? tasmād yathā vṛkṣaśabdena bāhyo vṛkṣo 'dhyavasāyād abhidheyo
[229,9] vyavasthāpitaḥ, tathādhyavasāyād eva bāhyasya vidhir niṣedho vā vyavahriyate | yadāpi
[229,10] kutaścit prakaraṇād buddhyākāraṃ kañcid vikalpāntareṇādāyaḥ parīkṣā, tadāpi tadvikalpād
[229,11] bāhya eva vidhiniṣedhau |
[229,12] taṃ hi pataty arthe vivecayan | (PV II 220)
[229,14] iti hi śāstram | tasmāt tattvato nobhayor api vidhiniṣedhau, saṃvṛttyā hi bāhyasyaiva
[229,15] duṣpariharau ca | anyathā saṃvyavahārahāniprasaṅgāt |
[229,16] etena yaṭ ṭīkākāraḥ āropitasya bāhyatvaviṣayau vidhiniṣedhāv ity alaukikam anāgamam
[229,17] atārkikīyaṃ kathayati, tad apahastitam | na hi saṃvṛtiparamārthasatyadvayam anāśritya
[229,18] kācid vyavasthā | tatra na tāvad iyaṃ saṃvṛtiḥ, lokābhimānarūpatvāt tasyāḥ, lokasya
[229,19] ca bāhya eva padasyārtho vihitaḥ pratiṣiddho vety avibhāgena vyāpī pravṛttinivṛttyāśrayaḥ
[229,20] abhimānaḥ, nāropitasya bāhyatvādikaṃ spṛśati lokaḥ | nāpy eṣa paramārthaḥ | na hy avācyasya
[229,21] vidhiniṣedhau | na ca vācyaṃ kiñcit tattvata ity āgamaḥ | tarkasyāpi nānyā dik |
[229,22] kiṃ ca nānadhyavaseyasya vidhiniṣedhau, na ca śabdād adhyavasāyaḥ svalakṣaṇād anyatreti
[229,23] svayam apy udghuṣyate | ataḥ kim āyātam āropitabāhyatvavidhiniṣedhayoḥ? pratibhāsādhyavasāya-
[229,24] dvārā ca sarvā vyavasthitis tattvam aspṛśatī | tatrāropitam āropitabāhyatvaṃ vā na
[229,25] pratibhāsasya viṣayo, nāpy adhyavasāyasya | tatrāropitaṃ tāvan na pratibhāsasparśi, yat svayam
[230,1] evāha; ullekhānubhavasamānakālaṃ samāropaṇam apratibhāsarūpam evāvastu vikalpaviṣaya
[230,2] iti | ata eva tadbāhyatvam api na pratibhāsi, taddharmatvāt | adhyavasāyavastu bāhyasvalakṣaṇa-
[230,3] niyamād eva nainayor ity alam enām utthāpya |
[230,4] āropitam ity api kalpitam evocyate, kaplanākarma ca pratibhāsam avasitaṃ ceti
[230,5] dvayam | tat kutastyo 'yam āropitākhyo rāśir aparaḥ? tasmād buddhyākārabāhyāśrayaiva
[230,6] saṃvṛtiparamārthābyāṃ cintociteti | tathāvidhārthakriyāvivakṣāyāṃ ca kiṃ vakradurgamārgāśrayeṇa
[230,7] ity alam atinirbandhena | sthitam etad adhyavasāyena bāhyasya buddhyākārasya tu pratibhāsena
[230,8] śabdavācyatvam ucyate iti | nanv evaṃ vyācakṣāṇena bhavatobhayārtharāśer aśeṣasya vācyatā
[230,9] svīkṛteti kathaṃ sarvadharmānabhilāpyatāsamarthanārtham idam avatāritam ity āha,
[230,10] sthāpyata iti
[230,11] prayojanāntaram uddiśya vyavasthāmātram etat kriyate, adhyavasāyamātreṇa pratibhāsamātreṇa
[230,12] (20a) vā vācyatvam iti | tathā ca bahirviṣayīkaraṇaṃ tattvavyavasthānamātraṃ gṛhṇataḥ
[230,13] tāvad anyāpoḍhaṃ viṣaya ity ucyate upādhirāśiniraśanaparaṃ, evam anyāpoḍhākāro
[230,14] vikalpasyātmā viṣaya iti samastabāhyanirasanaparam, na tu svasmin viṣayatvasya
[230,15] viśrāmāyeti na virodhaḥ |
[230,16] kutaḥ punar etat? tatra tatra viṣayatāpratipādane 'pi na viśrāmo vivakṣitaḥ,
[230,17] kiṃ tv anyanirasane tātparyam ity āha,
[230,18] vācyas tattvato naiva kaścid arthaḥ |
[230,19] iti | adhyavasāyasahāpohipratibhāsaḥ sāṃvyavahārikāpekṣayā tattvato jñeyasya jñāna-
[230,20] viṣayatām upanayati pratyakṣavat | na hi pratibhāsamātram avasāyaśūnyam anyāvasāyākrānta-
[230,21] vyāpāraṃ vā pravṛttikāmasya viṣayavyavasthām arthe kṣamate, gacchattṛṇasparśavat, marīcāv udaka-
[230,22] āropavat | nāpy avasāyamātram apetapratibhāsam, udakāropavad eva | tasmāt pravṛtti-
[230,23] yogyatayā vyāptaṃ viṣayavyavasthānam ubhayābhāvo vyāpakābhāvena paribhūyamānam ubhayasambhava-
[230,24] pratibaddham ekaviveke svīkriyamāṇaṃ sāṃvṛtam eva | yatra jñāne yan na pratibhāsate yena vā
[230,25] yan nāvasīyate sa na tasya viṣayo yathā gojñānasyāśvaḥ | na pratibhāsate ca śābdajñāne
[230,26] svalakṣaṇaṃ, nāvasīyate cānena buddhyākāra iti vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ | pratibandhasādhanāt
[230,27] nānekāntaḥ | yady api cātyantābhyāse pratibhāsamātreṇāpi pravṛttir viṣayatvaṃ ca dṛṣṭam,
[231,1] tathāpi sa evābhyāso nāvasāyād vinety avasāyasyaiva tat pauruṣam, tato yena yan nāvasīyate
[231,2] 'saty abhyāsa iti viśeṣaṇam apekṣyam |
[231,3] nanu pratyakṣe 'pi na gṛhītakṣaṇasyāvasāyaḥ, kiṃ tu santateḥ, na cāsyāḥ pratibhāsa
[231,4] iti kenāsyāpi saviṣayatvaṃ, kṣaṇe santatau cobhayābhāvāt | anumāne tu parīkṣaiva
[231,5] vartate | na cānyat pramāṇam asti, yasyobhayasambhavena viṣayaḥ kaścid ity asambhavam etat |
[231,6] tad ekaikena vidheyatve sthitaviṣayakasthitir akhilasya bāhyasyāntarasya vā vācyatvam iti |
[231,7] atrocyate | tattvavyavasthām āha, ubhayasambhavenaiva viṣayatvaṃ, kevalaṃ sāṃvyavahārika-
[231,8] apekṣayā saṃvṛter evādharasaṃvṛtim apekṣya tattvam iti vyavahriyate, kṣaṇabhedāvatāre saṃvyavahāra-
[231,9] vilopāt vyāvahārikaṃ prati pratikṣaṇakṣīṇatāyā abhāvāt, tattvataḥ pratyakṣeṇobhaya-
[231,10] sambhavābhāvaḥ, iti na doṣaḥ | atha pṛthagjanasya dṛśyavikalpyayor apy abhedagraho niyata
[231,11] evety avasito vahniḥ pratibhāsita eveti cet, na, pratibhāsāntarasmaraṇena tatpratibhāsa-
[231,12] bhramabhraṃśasyakṛtatvāt | yathā ca vikalpaoratibhāsād anya eva vastupratibhāso darśayitum
[231,13] adhekṣe śakyaḥ, tathā nādhyakṣapratibhāsād anyo 'stīti tatraiva vastupratibhāsaviśrāmāt
[231,14] tadvijātīyasya vastupratibhāsatāvyudāsaḥ śreyāt | tasmād yuktam uktam,
[231,15] sthāpyo vācyas tattvato naiva kaścit |
[231,16] iti | (20b) athavā vastvantarāvācyatve 'pi tatrāpohas tadviśeṣaṇatvena gamya iti
[231,17] apohasya vācyatā svīkṛtaiva | tathāpi kathaṃ sarvadharmānabhilāpyatvam ity āha,
[231,18] vācyas tattvato naiva kaścid artha iti |
[231,19] ayam abhiprāyaḥ | paryudāsapakṣe tāvad vasturūpavat tasyāpy adhyavasāyamātrakṛtaṃ vācyatvam,
[231,20] na pratibhāsād adhyakṣavat | prasajyapakṣe punar anyanivṛttimātrasyānyadāpi na viśeṣaḥ,
[231,21] tathāpy asau nārtha iti noktadoṣaḥ |  (yad) vā yaḥ śāstre, tasmāt siddham etat sarvaśabdāviveka-
[231,22] viṣayā vikalpāś cety upasaṃhāraḥ, tasyārthaniṣṭhām upasaṃhāreṇaiva darśayati,
[231,23] vācyas tattvato naiva kaścid artha iti |
[231,24] saṃvṛtau pratibhāsādhyavasāyamātrena vācyatāyā darśitatvāt,
[231,25] tattvata ity āha |

[232,3] evāpoha ity arthaḥ | etac ca hetutrayavibhāgakaraṇādinā svayam eva śāstreṇa sphuṭīkṛtam ity upapāditam |
[232,5] tad evaṃ katham apohaḥ śabdavācya iti praśne tadguṇatvena yathoktārthenety uttaram | atha

[232,7] ubhayasya vābhāvād iti krameṇa visarjanāni | yadā tu śabdaiḥ kiṃ vācyam ity anuyogaḥ,
[232,8] tadā pratibhāsād arthādhyavasāyāt, yad vā tattvata iti vikalpya vikalpasthe 'nyāpoḍha-
[232,9] ākāraḥ, anyāpoḍhasvalakṣanaṃ na kiñcid iti prativacanāni krameṇaivety uktaṃ bhavati |

  karmanirmitavaicitriyam anīśaṃ yo jagaj jagau |
  praṇamāmi pramāṇena tam avyāhataśāsanam ||
iha pratyavasthānam anyeṣām, vivādāspadībhūtaṃ bhūdharādi buddhimatkartṛkam, kāryatvāt | yad yat kāryaṃ buddhimatkartṛkaṃ, yathā ghaṭaḥ | kāryaṃ cedaṃ bhūdharādi | tasmād buddhimatpūrvakam iti | na cedam asiddham, bauddhasyāpi vindhyagandhamādanādīnāṃ kāryatve vivādābhāvāt | nāpi viruddham, sapakṣe bhāvāt | na cānaikāntikam, kvacid api kārye buddhimadadhiṣṭhitānavyabhicārasya darśasyitum aśakyatvāt | pratyakṣāgamābhyām abādhanāc ca na kālātyayāpadiṣṭam | pratihetor abhāvāc ca na prakaraṇasamam | tad anena yat siddham, tadupādeyaṃ vidūṣām, sādhanāntarasiddhatvāt | na ca sarvatrānvayavyatireke hetuval labhatayā buddhimati kāryasya tadubhayāsiddher asādhanatvam abhidheyam, sapakṣe sato 'sya vipakṣarāśer ākāśāder atyantaṃ vyāvṛtteḥ |
 trayo hi bhāvarāśayaḥ | buddhimatkartṛkāś ca ghaṭādayaḥ – akartṛkāś cākāśādayaḥ, sandhigdhakartṛkāś ca bhūdharādayaḥ | tatra ghaṭādiṣu sapakṣeṣu vidyamānam, avidyamānam ambarādiṣu vipakṣeṣu ity anvayavyatireki kāryatvaṃ śeṣeṣu vartamānam avaśyaṃ sādhyam upasthāpayati | yady api ca digambarādayo 'santas tanmate paramāṇavas tu kāryam eva, tathāpy asato 'pi vyāvṛttiḥ svīkṛtaiva | tathā ca –
  nivṛttir yadi tasminn hetor vṛttiḥ kim iṣyate | (PV 4.224)
iti hi śāstram. na ca vipakṣatākṣatiḥ sādhyānadhikaraṇalakṣaṇatvād vipkṣasyeti kim eṣāṃ sattāsādhanaprayāsena. tasmān nānvayavyatirekaḥ kartari yathokte kāryatvasya | evam utpattimattvācetanopādānatvasthitvā [verb. : °sthityā] pravṛttyādiṣu yojyam ||
