 atrocyate | bhaved anekānto yadi kulālo dvyaṇukasya kartā bhavet | na hi yāvad antyāvayavaniṣpatter aṅgaṃ tat sarvaṃ kulālaḥ karoti, dṛṣṭasāmarthyakāraṇaprayoktṛlakṣaṇatvāt kartṛkasya | tasmād dvyaṇukam api mahābhūtavat sandigdhakartṛtkatvāt sādhyam eva | < NOTEREF _Ref345984474   MERGEFORMAT vvvtad evaṃ yat sadhyavādinā sādhayitum iṣṭam anumeyasāmānyaṃ tad dūṣaṇavādinā pratibandhuṃ na śakyate | yas tu dūṣaṇavādinā pratibandhum iṣṭo viśeṣaḥ, nāsau sādhyasāmānyavādinā sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ | kiṃ tarhi | sādhyasāmānye niścetavye tena vāstavapratibandhasya viśeṣasya siddhir balāt bhavantī nopekṣate | evaṃ sādhanāyattāṃ viśeṣasiddhim ācāryo manyamāno yad dūṣaṇam avādīt, – yāvatīṃ arthagatiṃ sādhanaṃ vyāpnoti tāvatīṃ dūṣaṇam api | yady asau viśeṣo na sādhanena viṣayīkṛtaḥ, kathaṃ atas tatsiddhiḥ | sidhyan vā katham aviṣayaḥ | viṣayaś cet, kathaṃ svāśrayāṃ doṣagatīṃ na spṛśed iti, tan nirastam | yataḥ sādhanavādī sādhanādhīnāṃ yadi viśeṣasiddhim upagacchet, tadaitat syāt | na ca naiyāyikaḥ sādhanāyattām viśeṣasiddhim upajīvati | kiṃ tarhi | sādhyasāmānyapratibandhākṛṣṭasya viśeṣasiddhim>, yathā bauddhaḥ kṣaṇikatvasiddhau tena vāstavapratibandhān nairātmyasiddhim upajīvati | na hy ātmani nitye vibhau ca sati sarvavastuviṣayaṃ kṣaṇikatvam anumātum īśaḥ ||
 mīmāṃsako 'pi darśanasparśanābhyām avayavinaṃ niścinvan niścetavyānuṣaṅgiṇa indriyasya nānātvaṃ niyataviṣayatvam indriyāṇāṃ svaviṣayagrahaṇaliṅgatvaṃ jñātur jñānasādhanatvaṃ gandhādiguṇavyatiriktaṃ ca guṇādhikaraṇam aniyataviṣayaś cetana ity etāvato 'rthān upajīvati  | tathā sādhayaviśeṣo 'pi naiyāyikair upajīvyata iti sarvaṃ samānam anyatrābhiniveśāt | tasmāt siddhaṃ sarvajñatvam iti ||
 Vācaspatis tu –  tad evaṃ kāryatvād eva pakṣadharmatāsahāyād evambhūtaiśvarasiddhir iti sthitam ||
 bhavatu vāsmād upādānādyabhijñakartṛmātrasiddhiḥ | pāriśeṣyānumānāt tu vyatirekadvitīyanāmno viśeṣasiddhiḥ | tathā hi tanubhuvanādyabhijñaḥ kartā nānityāsarvaviṣayabuddhimān, tatkartus tadupādānādyabhijñaś cāyam | tasmāt tatheti | no khalu paramaṇubhedān pratikṣetrajñasamavāyinaś ca karmāśayabhedān aparimeyān anyaḥ śakto jñātum ṛte tādṛśād īśvarād iti ||
(p. 242)  Vittokas tu, yathā dhūmadarśanena pakṣadharmatābalāt nikuñjavartitvaṃ vahner viśeṣo 'vyāpako 'pi pratīyate tathā kartur apīty adoṣa iti tādṛg eva puruṣaviśeṣa īśvaraḥ pramāṇasiddha iti katham anīśajagadvādino bhagavataḥ pramāṇenāvyāhataśāsanatvam iti ||

              īśvaravādādhikāre pūrvapakṣasaṃkṣepaḥ samāptaḥ ||

ĪŚVARAVĀDĀDHIKĀRE SAŅKṢEPADŪṢAṆAM

vārtikasaptaślokīvyākhyāpekṣaprabandhabhīrūpaṇām |
īśvaravāde dūṣaṇamātrakatheyaṃ samāsena ||

iha yadyapi bahulaṃ sahacāramātraṃ kāryasya prayatnavatā darśitam, darśitaś ca tadabhāve kvacid abhāvaḥ, tathāpi pratibandhāsiddheḥ kāryam api syāt, na ca buddhimatkartṛpūrvakam ityāśaṅkā bādhavaidhuryāt kāryaṃ buddhim iti sādhye sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttiko hetvābhāsaḥ | na ca sapakṣavipakṣayor darśanādarśanamātreṇa sādhanasya bhāve sādhyasyāvaśyam bhāvaḥ, sādhyābhāve vā tadabhāva ity evaṃ rūpāyā vyāpteḥ pratibandhaśabdavācyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ bhavitum arhati, bhāvivyabhicāradarśaṇeṣv api tathopalabdheḥ | kim idam idānīm adarśanam abhāvād eva vyabhicārasya, atha darśanasāmagrīsamavadhānavirahād iti nirṇetum aśakyam eva sahacāramātradarśino vimarśaśīlasya |
ata eva vācaspateḥ svābhāvikasambandhaghoṣaṇam api śabdapuṣṭimātram, tadatiriktārthāpoṣaṇāt | bhūyodarśane hi vyabhicārādarśane svābhāvikavyavasthā | vyabhicārādarśanaṃ ca vipakṣe 'darśanamātram uktaṃ bhavati | yat punar etad upādher anupalambhena vyabhicārāsiddhir iti, tatra nopādhir nāma dṛśyacihnasthānīyaṃ kiñcid asti, yad anupalambho 'vyabhicāraṃ vyavahārayet | kiṃ tu vyabhicāradarśanamātreṇaiva tatparikalpaḥ | tadadarśanāt ca svābhāvikatvam iti viśeṣābhāvāt na svābhāvikavādena kiñcit, sādhyena saha bhūyo dṛṣṭo hetur vyabhicāre ca na hetur itīyataiva paryāptatvāt | etac ca sarvaṃ vyāpticarcāyāṃ vivicya kvacid arthāntarasya pratibandho nāma tadutpattim antareṇa, sā ca pratyakṣānupalambhasādhanenaiveti vyavasthāpitam iti tat evāvadhāryam | etena śaṅkaravācaspatimatāvalambinaḥ pratyuktāḥ |
astu tarhi prayatnavatāpi kāryasya tadutpattilakṣaṇa eva pratibandho dhūmasyeva vahninā | yathoktaṃ vittokena | tathā hi kumbhakāravyāpārāt prāk mṛtpaṇḍadaṇḍacakrādiṣu satsv api kāryaṃ kumbhākhyam upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptam anupalabdhaṃ tadvyāpārānantaram upalabhyata iti hetuphalabhāvasiddhau kuto vipakṣavyāvṛttisandehaḥ? satyam atra pakṣavipakṣavṛttir eva na sandehaḥ, atra hi pratyakṣānupalambhayogyasvarūpasvīkārād abhivyakto 'nupalabdhapuruṣavyāpārair vṛkṣavīraṇādibhir vyabhicāraḥ | pakṣīkṛtāstṛṇādayaḥ, na ca pakṣīkṛtenaiva
[244] vyabhicāra iti cet, na, pratikṣiptasya pakṣīkaraṇe nyāyābhāvat | anyathā anuṣṇo 'gniḥ prameyatvād ityādāv api pakṣīkaraṇam eva śaraṇaṃ syāt | tathā hi

sandigdho hetuvacanād vyasto hetor anāśrayaḥ | (PV IV 91)

iti nyāyaḥ | adhyakṣam eva pratiyoginaḥ pratiyogyantarāpekṣayānupalabdhir ucyate | tato 'nupalabdhibādhitam api pratyakṣabādhitam eva | vyavahārasādhanāpekṣayā tu sānumānam | na cānumānabādhite 'py anyāvakāśaḥ | sā tarhi dṛśyaviśeṣaṇāpannasyaivābhāvaṃ vyavahārayati, dṛśyādṛśyaśarīretarasādhāraṇaṃ ca buddhimattvam iti dṛśyatāniyamānupapatter buddhimataḥ katham anupalabdhimātreṇa tṛṇādijanmani niṣedhaḥ? tataḥ sandehāt pakṣīkaraṇaṃ nyāyyam iti cet? tad etad vikrītagavīrakṣaṇam | vyāptisādhanāyādhyakṣānupalabdhyor avakāśadānād eva dṛśyaviṣayatāsvīkārasya prasahyāyātatvāt | na hy adṛśye pratyakṣam anvayasādhanam anupalabdhir vā vyatirekasādhanī bhavitum arhati | tad ayaṃ bhede saty anvayavyatirekarūpam adhyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ hetuphalabhāvam avataran na dṛśyatām ativartituṃ sādhyasya śaktaḥ | dṛśyatve ca niyatatṛṇādinā vyabhicāra iti sādharaṇānekāntaḥ ||
atha vyabhicāracamatkārād adhyakṣāgocareṇa prayatnavatā vyāptiṃ gṛhṇīyāt? gṛhṇātu, na tu pratyakṣānupalambhāśrayaḥ śreyān asya | nanu dṛśyādṛśyaviśeṣaṇam anapekṣya prekṣāvanmātreṇa vyāptigrahaḥ? naivam, tāvatāpi hi pratyakṣakṛtāyā vyāpter anavakāśa eva | dṛśyaikasvabhāvaniyatā hi sā kathaṃ dṛśyādṛśyaviṣayā bhavet? tad dhi dṛśyam adṛśyaṃ ca rūpam ekabuddhimattvādidharmānuvṛttāv api svabhāvaviprakarṣetarābhyām atyantaṃ bhinnajātiḥ | tataḥ pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyaikajātisvīkāreṇa pravṛttam itaravārtānabhijñaṃ tadviśiṣṭam eva sādhāraṇam api dharmaṃ vyāpakam ādarśayati |
yadyapi deśakālaviprakṛṣṭam api na dṛśyam, tathāpi tadarśanayogyatayaikajātyeveti (tadadarśanayogyatayaikajātyeveti) svabhāvaviprakṛṣṭasyaiva pratyakṣeṇa parihāraḥ | sarvānyavarjane hi svalakṣaṇaikaparyavasānād vyāptir eva na syāt, dhūmāgnivat, kampamārutavac ca | yathā hi svapravṛttiyogyajvalad bhāsurākārapuraskāreṇa pravartamānādhyakṣakṛtā vyāptiḥ saptārciṣi na jaṭharānalasādhāraṇarūpaparyavasāyinī, anyathā tārṇādibhedavad abhimate 'pi rūpe sandihāno na tatsādhyārthakriyālābhaikāgrabuddhiḥ pravarteta | pratibandhavaikalyavad vāsati jaṭharyatva ity āmṛśataḥ
[245] pravṛttiḥ syāt | yathā vā pallavollāsena samīraṇena vyāptir adhyakṣajakṛtāspṛśyarūpapuraskārānnastimitamārutasādhāraṇarūpaparyavasāyinī, anyathādyāpi kisalayakampena mātariśvānam anumāpayan spṛśyaprabhañjanānurūpapravṛttinivṛttī niścayenācaret, tathā puruṣe 'pi pratyakṣakṛtā vyāpitāgṛhītir adṛśyarūpaparihāreṇaiva | tasmāt pratyakṣāvyājena yadi param iṣṭamātram eva sādhanaṃ nādhyakṣaṃ dṛśyādṛśyasāmānye 'pīti vyāpter abhāvāt sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvam eva |
prayogaḥ, yo yaḥ pratyakṣakṛtaḥ kāraṇatvaniścayaḥ, nāsau dṛśyādṛśyarūpaparyavasāyī, yathāgnau jaṭharajātajātavedaḥsādhāranarūpaṃ pariharan | pratyakṣakṛtaś cāsau buddhimatīti vyāpakaviruddhavyāptopalabdhiḥ | pratyakṣakṛtatvaṃ hi dṛśyaviṣayatvena vyāptam adṛśye tasyāpravṛtteḥ, tadviruddhaṃ dṛśyādṛśyaviṣayatvam, tadvyāptaṃ dṛśyādṛśyarūpaparyavasāyitvam | kiṃ ca yadi dṛśyādṛśyaviśeṣaṇam avadhūya dhīmanmātreṇa vyāptirvivakṣitā, evaṃ sati yadā buddhimadabhāve kumbhakāryasyābhāvam upadarśayed vyatirekapratipādanāya, tadā dṛśyādṛśyaviśeṣaṇarahitacetanamātrasyābhāvaḥ kena pramāṇena siddhaḥ, dṛśyānupalabdher dṛśyasyaiva pratiṣedhe 'dhikārāt? anyathā tṛṇādinā vyabhicārasyāśakyaparihāratvāc ca?
na ca dṛśyapuruṣaviṣayaivānupalabdhir buddhimanmātrasya vyatirekabodhasādhanībhavitum arhati, ātyantikaviṣayabhedasya vyaktatvāt | anyathā tṛṇādijanmany api dṛśyapuruṣaviṣayaivānupalabdhis tadvyabhicārasthirīkaraṇakāraṇaṃ syāt | na hi lābhe praveśaś chede niḥsaraṇam iti nyāyam | tasmāt dṛśyaviśeṣaṇāpo@ḍhapakṣe vyāptigrahaṇakāle vyatirekagrahaṇopāyābhāvād avyāpteḥ punar api vipakṣavyāvṛttisandehaḥ | na ca nabhasy ubhayābhāvavibhāvanam upāyo vyatirekagrahaṇasya, kāryābhāvasya buddhimad vyāpārābhāvaprayuktatvaniścayānupapatteḥ | tadaparakāraṇasākalye hi tanmātrābhāve 'bhāvaḥ kāryasya tadabhāvaprayuktaḥ pratyetuṃ śakyaḥ | yathā tripañcakacintāyāṃ cintitam | dvayos tu kvacin nivṛttimātram akāryakāraṇabhūtayor api sulabham |
kiṃ ca buddhimatkāraṇavyāpāravirahāt vihāyasi kāryatvābhāva uta kāraṇamātraviprayogād iti ko niṣṭaṅkaḥ? tathā ca sati viphalaḥ sakalo yatnaḥ | anvayo 'pi hi kāraṇamātreṇa kāryamātrasya gṛhyatām utasvit puruṣaviśeṣaṇena kāraṇeneti sandeha eva | atha dṛṣṭa evāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ kathaṃ parihartuṃ śakyaḥ, dhūme dahanātmavat | yady evaṃ dṛśyaśarīrarūpo
[246] 'pi viśeṣaḥ pratīta eva, kathaṃ parihartuṃ śakyaḥ, citrabhānor bhāsurākāravat? sa tarhi viśeṣaḥ kāryeṇa vyabhicaryata iti cet? vyabhicaryatām | kārye 'pi kāraṇavad yathā pariḍṛṣṭaviśeṣaniṣṭha evānvayo bhavatu ghaṭavat saudhādāv api dṛṣṭatvād iti kiṃ niśchinnam? etac cānvayamātraṃ gajanimolitena dūṣaṇam avadhīryābhidhīyate | vastutas tu pratyakṣānupalambhayor ekasyāpi vyāpārāyogān nānvayo na vyatirekaḥ | asti ca kāryatvam urvīdharādau, na ca darśanātikrānte kartary anvayavyatirekau spṛśati | tādṛk cetanakṛtetaratvābhyāṃ ca rāśyantarābhāvād gandhādivad asādhāraṇānekānta eva | tasmān na pratyakṣeṇa kāryamātrasya vyāptigrahaṇam iti siddham |
yātāś caivaṃ yad amī pratyakṣānupalambhāviśiṣṭakāryajātyullekhenaiva kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahaṇapravṛttayo na kāryamātrollekhena | tathā hi pratyakṣānupalambhapravṛttisamanantaram īdṛśāt jvaladbhāsurasvarūpavastuviśeṣād īdṛśaṃ dhavalimaliptakaṅṭhāmbakavikārakāri vastu jāyata ity anenākāraṇe hetuphalabhāvavyavahāraḥ sarvāparakāryakāraṇajātivyudāsena viśiṣṭam eva jātiyugmam ullikhan pravartate | iyam eva gatiḥ sarvatra hetuphalabhāvavyavahṛtau, īśvarānurodhāt tu prasiddhanyāyolla (prasiddhanyāyollaṅghanam etat) iti paśyāmaḥ |
kaḥ punar atrāparādho yadi tārṇādibhedam udasya vahninā dhūmamātrasyeva bhūdharādibhedam apy udasya kāryamātrasya buddhimatā vyāptiṃ pratīyāt pratyakṣam? yathaiva tarhi varhiṣā kāryajātiviśeṣasya dhūmasyāvāntarasūkṣmajātimātram antarbhāvya vyāptigraho na tu tadvijātīyasparśaḥ, tathā buddhimatāpy astu vahnādeḥ | yathā vātyantavisadṛśor api kāryajātīḥ antarbhāvya bhūtimanmātrasya cetanena vyāptiṃ jighṛkṣasi, tathā vahnināpi gṛhṇīyāḥ | indriyapratyakṣasyaiva hi vyāpāra ubhayatra kathaṃ bhinnāṃ vṛttim āśrayeta? vyabhicāradarśanādarśanakṛto 'yaṃ vibhāga iti cet? tat tarhi darśanādarśanaṃ saṅkalpam anārūḍhaṃ gacchat tṛṇasaprśavad akiñcitkaram iti tad anurūpavimarśenāvaśyabhāvyam | na cāsti |
na hi kaścid agnidhūmādiṣv anvayavyatirekagrāhipratyakṣānupalambhapravṛttau kāryajātiḥ akhilānalād utpadyata iti saṅkalpam anubhūya bhūyo vyabhicāradarśanāt yato vā kāryāntarāṇi vahnim antareṇāpy upalabdhāny upalabhyante vā tato dhūma evānena janyata iti niścayaṃ paricinoti, kiṃ tu jhagity eva pratyakṣānupalambhāntaram asmād agnyāder idaṃ dhūmādīti jātiviśeṣadvayaṃ hetuphalabhāvavyavahārabhājanīkurvann anubhūyate 'nusandhānapratyayaḥ | pratyakṣagocare
[247] (anvayavyatirekayī R) na kaścid viśeṣaḥ | yadā ca vikalpāntarasthitasya jhagiti kaṇṭakād vyathety anupalambhapūrvakādhyakṣavihitā hetuphalabhāvagrāhiṇī matiḥ, tadābhivyakto vyabhicāradarśanavimarśavirahaḥ, samasamayāsambhavād vikalpānām | tad ihāpy asmāt śilpina idaṃ pṛthubudhnodarādyākāraṃ kāryam ity avāntarasūkṣmabhedamudasya vyavahāraḥ | yadā tu paṭaśakaṭādikam api puruṣād utpadyamānaṃ paśyati, tadedam apīdam api puruṣeṇa janyata iti matiravisaṃvādinī samudeti |
kiṃ ca vyabhicāro nāma kiṃ siddhāyām eva vyāptāv anumānamātraṃ khaṇḍayati? atha vyāptir eva mithyeti vyavasthāpayati? atrāpi pakṣe svasāmarthyena sphuraty eva vyāptigrāhiṇi pramāṇe | yad vā tasyaiva prāmāṇyakṣayamādadhānaḥ, adyāpi sarvatra viṣaye niyate vā? niyate 'pi kim iṣṭivaśāt, atha pratyakṣasya tatraiva pravṛtteḥ? Prathamaḥ pakṣas tāvan na yukto virodhāt | na hi sādhyāvinābhāvalakṣaṇā ca vyāptir hetoḥ sādhyābhāvasambhavakṛtaś cānumānābhāvaḥ saṅgacchate, anyatrāpi vyāptāvanāśvāsāc ca |
evaṃ vyāptigrāhiṇi pramāṇe prāmāṇyād apracyutibhṛti vyāptimṛṣātvabodhanam apy asambaddhaṃ boddhavyam | sarvatra ca vyāptigrāhiṇaḥ prāmāṇyakṣaye dhūmād agnir api nānumātavyaḥ, anyasya vyāptigrāhiṇo 'bhāvāt | kimidānīṃ śaraṇam īśvarānumānasya bhaviṣyati? svecchayā ca niyate viṣaye vyāptivihitau pramāṇaṃ varākam udāsīnam iti na kaścit hetur ahetur vā tattvataḥ, dhūme 'pi svecchayā vyāptikhaṇḍanaprasaṅgāt | niyataviṣayatvaṃ tu vyabhicāragocarasyāpi pratyakṣasya katham, yāvatā yathā niyatajātipravṛttaṃ vyāptigrāhi sarvaviṣayam iṣṭam, tathā vyabhicāragocaram api sarvaviṣayam evānyūnānatiriktaśaktitvād ubhayoḥ? tad ekaviṣaya eva vyāptigraho vyabhicāravedanaṃ ceti kim adhunā sādhanam asādhanaṃ vā syāt? bhavatu vā bhavad uparodhād bādhabodhinaḥ pramāṇasya niyataviṣayatvam | tathāpi na khalu sakṛd eva vyabhicāravatāṃ bādhabodhaḥ, kiṃ tu krameṇa | tadā ca vyabhicāriṇām api vyabhicāradarśanam āhatya nāstīti dhūmasya tato viśeṣaṇābhāvāt punar ahetutvam, hetutvaṃ vānyasyāpi |
na ca sarvasyānyasya vyabhicāradarśanair dhūme vyaptiviśvāsa iti vācyam | evaṃ hi purastād dhūme vyāptigrahaṇānantaram eva parvatanitambe dhūmād dahanānumānaṃ na śārdūlād iti na syāt, vyabhicāradarśanavilambāpekṣaṇāt | aśakyaṃ caitad anyatra vyabhicāradarśanair abhimate
[248] vyāptiviśrāma iti | vyabhicāraviṣayāṇām apy anantatvād deśādiviprakarṣavatāṃ gocarīkaraṇakālāpekṣayā puruṣāyuṣasya kanīyastvāt | tasmād vyabhicāradarśanavan niyataviṣaya eva vyāptigraho nirapavādaḥ, śuddhekādhyavasāyasya vibhāgena pravṛtteḥ | ata eva ca svābhāvikavikalpasyaiva kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahaṇe 'dhikāro naupādhikasya |
asti hi śuddhaviṣayajanitālocanājñānamātrāpekṣo bālatiryaksādhāraṇo vikalpaḥ | sa śuddhaḥ svābhāvika iti cocyate, yadvaśāt paśavo 'pi kṣutpipāsāpraśamādisādhanāni tatraiva samarthānyavadhārayantaḥ punas tadanvitayā tathaiva tatas tatra pravartante, nivartante vānanvitayā | asti ca saṅketasmaraṇasacivālocanājñānajanito vikalpaḥ, yathā dīpāt kajjalamālokayato nīlam idaṃ rañjanādyupayogīty eva vikalpaḥ pūrvadṛṣṭārthakriyāsmaraṇasahāyānubhavabhāvitas tādṛgaupādhika ucyate | na ca tadā nīlavikalpa ity eva pradīpād akhilaṃ nīlam utpadyata iti prekṣaḥ kaścin niścinoti | kiṃ tu yad eva kajjalāvalokanamātrānurūpavikalpapuraskṛtaṃ vastu kajjalaśabdasaṅketayogyaṃ jātiyogāt svarūpaviśeṣād vā tad eva pradīpakāryaṃ vyabhicārālambane coktam |
evaṃ dhūme 'pi dhavalam idaṃ vastu vahner jāyata iti saṅketānusārī vikalpa aupādhika evākṣipati kāryatvena tuhinādikam | śuddhe tu vikalpe dhūmajātir eva parisphuratīti tata eva tuhināder vyāptau nirāso na vyabhicārālambanaṃ sādhviti boddhavyam | tadvat kāryavikalpo 'pi sarvatra aupādhika eva | apekṣitaparavyāpāro hi svotpattāvandhaḥ | kāryam iti saṅketasmaraṇasahāyād indriyajñānād utpattir iti na hetuphalabhāvavyavahārasyāṅgam | tato yady api puruṣāt ghaṭodayadarśane ghaṭo 'yam asmād iti vikalpavat kāryam idam asmād ity api sulabho vikalpaḥ, tathāpi svābhāvikatvābhāvān na tatpuraskṛtasvarūpasya tatkāryatvavyavasthā | naisargikavikalpaviṣayīkṛtasya tu bhavatu |
nanu śuddhāvasāyagocare 'pi vikalpaḥ saṅketasmṛtijanito dṛśyate 'yaṃ ghaṭaḥ pauruṣeya iti nāmollekhāt | tataḥ so 'py aupādhikaḥ prāptaḥ | na, tanmātravikalpane smaraṇasya aprayojakatvāt, vācakāṃśollekha eva tasya sāmarthyāt | yady api ca vācyavācakākārotkalitākhaṇḍavikalpodayaḥ smaraṇasāhāyakena, tathāpy apoḍdhāradvāreṇa tanmātre tadvyāpāra ucyate, mṛnmayatvamātre kulālasyeva | jātyantarasamavāyikāryatvadhavalatādidharmakalpanaṃ tu saṅketasambandhagrahaṇādiprācīnavyāpārasmaraṇam antareṇa śuddhādhyavasāyasya
[249] tanmātrajāty ullekhenaiva kṛtārthatvād bālakādivat, atas tanmātraviṣayaiva pratyakṣakṛtā vyāptir ity anavadyam | tasmād vyāptigrahaḥ pratyakṣakṛto vyabhicārapratyayo vā bhinnaviṣaya eveti siddham |
evaṃ tarhi vyabhicāradarśanena sādhāraṇānekāntavyavasthā duḥstheti cet? evam etad yadi buddhipāṭavaniyamaḥ sarveṣām | mandabuddhis tu sādṛśyādinā jātiviśeṣapravṛtte 'pi pratyakṣe jātyantareṇaikīkṛtya vyāptigrahaṇābhimānād anumānam ātiṣṭhamānaḥ paṭunā pareṇa vyabhicāram ādrśya vyāptidurgraham āpādyate | ataḥ sādhāraṇānekāntavyavasthā | yathā dhūme pravṛtte 'pi pratyakṣe vyāptigrāhiṇy ucchaladbahalarūpam analavyāptim anusmaran mārutoddhūtadhūlipaṭalād analam anumāpayan vāṣpodayena prasiddhoṣarbudhavaidhuryeṇa vyabhicāram ādṛśya vāryate, tato 'pi kāraṇāt jātiviśeṣaviṣayaiva vyāptiḥ pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyata iti siddham |
yadi hi dhūmaikajātipratibaddhapratibandhabodham adhyakṣam, tadā sādṛśyāpekṣo 'nyatra tadrūpāropaḥ, sadṛśāntaravyabhicāreṇa ca vāraṇaṃ yuktam | yadā tu kāryajātau sarvatra vyāptigrahaḥ, tadā kiṃ sādṛśyāpekṣayeti? yadi tarhi jātiviśeṣapratibaddha evādhyakṣeṇa pratibandhabodhaḥ katham atyantavijātīyo 'pi (atyantavijātiyā 'pi) ghaṭakuṭakuṅḍyādayaḥ sādhāraṇarāgayogino haridrādidravyasaṃskāram anumāpayanti? kathaṃ vā kuṭḥārādi cchedakriyāyāṃ dṛṣṭavyāpāraṃ karaṇam atyantavijātīyāpi buddhiḥ kriyātvenānumāpayati?
evam atyantavijātīyā api kailāsakuliśādayaḥ sādhāraṇakāryatvādidharmakāḥ puruṣam anumāpayiṣyantīti cet? naivam, vyāpyasya gamakatvāt, tad apekṣayaiva sajātīyavijātīyatāyāś cintyatvāt | vyāpyaṃ ca nirvartyavikāryakam āpekṣayā dvividhaṃ dharmirūpaṃ dharmarūpaṃ ca | tatra sarvathāpūṛvotpattau dharmiṇo vyāptir ucyate, dhūmādivat | tadā ca dhūmāntaram eva sajātīyam, vijātīyam anyad vastu | yadā tu pūṛvasthitasyaiva dharmāntarotpattivyavasāyaḥ, tadā dharmavyāptir ucyate, payasi auṣṇyādivat, tadā ca auṣṇyāntaram eva sajātīyo dharmaḥ, nādhunā dharmijāter apekṣā |
evaṃ rāgo 'pi ghaṭakuṭādidravyavaijātyam avamatya svayaṃ svajātīyakāryāpekṣayaiva rāgadravyasaṃskārasya gamakaḥ | ata eva tadviśeṣe kvacit kuṅkumasya samparkaḥ kvacit haridrāder anumīyate | na caivaṃ pūṛvasthite bhūdharāmbhodharādau kāryatvādimātranirvartakaḥ puruṣa iṣṭaḥ, kiṃ tu kumbhādivad apūṛvakotpādaka eva | tadā ca dhūme dhavalatādivat kāryatādayaḥ
[250] santo 'pi jātyantarasamavāyino dharmā vyāpter bahir bhāvād kiñcitkarā eva | tasmād dharmivastuvyāptigraho na dharmamātrapratyāsattim anurudhyate | nāpi dharmavyāpter dharmiṇaḥ sajātīyatām | śuddhaikavimarśāpekṣayā cā sajātīyetaravyavasthānam uktam | nāto rāgavad dharmivaijātye 'pi kāryatvādīnāṃ gamakatvam | anyathā pāṇḍudravyād api havyāśanānumānaprasaṅgo duṣpariharaḥ, vyabhicārottarasya duṣitatvāt |
indriye tv evam anumānam | yad anyakāraṇasannidhau kādācitkam, tat kāraṇāntarāpekṣam, yathā pāthaḥpṛthvīsannidhāvaṅkuraḥ, viṣayamanaskārālokasannidhau ca kādācitkī buddhir iti svabhāvahetuḥ | anapekṣatve vipakṣe kādācitka (kādācitkaṃ? ) virodhād anavasthāyīti bādhakāt vyāptisiddhiḥ | yat tadanyad apekṣyaṃ tad indriyam iti vyavasthā, tato na kriyātvena kāraṇānumānaṃ, nāpi pratyakṣaṃ vyāptigrāhi | avaśyaṃ ca svābhāvikavikalpāmukhīkṛtajātibhedapuraskāreṇaiva sāmānyagrahaṇam eṣitavyam adhyakṣasya, anyathā yadā pratyakṣeṇa vyāptim ekām uparadśāyaṃ ghaṭa iti saṅketaḥ kriyate, tadā kim asau kāryatvādidharmayogi viśvam āviśati? vyabhicāradarśanena ca niyataviṣayatām upanīyate? upadeṣṭaiva vā sarvānyajātiṣu niṣedhan viṣayaniyame niṣṭḥāpayati? atha sāmānyaviṣaya eva nāsau samayaḥ?
evaṃ vācakajātibhede 'pi draṣṭavyam | kāryaśabdas tu pratyakṣam anapekṣya vikalpamātragocarite parāpekṣodayamātre niveśita iti na viśeṣavṛttiḥ | yadi tu so 'pi pratyakṣavartinyayaṃ kārya iti niveśyeta, so 'pi tatparyāyāntaravān niyatavṛttir eva syāt | tasmāt kāyajātiviśeṣaviṣayīkaraṇam eva nisargaḥ pratyakṣasya | yadi ca kāryajātibhede pravṛttam api pratyakṣaṃ kāryamātram adhiṣṭhānīkaroti, kāraṇe tarhi pravartamānaṃ kāraṇamātram eva vyāpakam avadhārayatu, kasmād upādānādivedanaviśiṣṭam avalambate? tato yadi na bhavad abhiprāyānurodho 'dhyakṣasyobhayatra sāmānyāvalambinā viśeṣāvalambinā vā bhavitavyam anena, sāmānyālambane kāryāt kāraṇānumānam iti kā vārteśvarasiddheḥ? viśeṣāvalambane ca kāryamātravyāpter asiddher iti | tasmād anubhavād yuktaś ca viśiṣṭām eva kāryajātiṃ hetuviśeṣavyāptām uparadśayati pratyakṣam iti | prayogaḥ | yad yat kārakāraṇabhāvagrāhi pratyakṣam, tad viśiṣṭajātipratiniyatavyāpāram, yathāgnidhūmayoḥ | tathā cedaṃ buddhimatā kāryasya vyāptisādhanam iti svabhāvahetuḥ | nāsyānyathāvyāpārāśaṅkayānekāntaḥ, kāraṇānupalabdhibādhitatvāt | kāraṇabhedo hi kāryabhedasya kāraṇam, anyathā sarvasyāhetukatvaprasaṅgāt | na cāsya kāraṇabhedo
[251] 'sti, viṣayendriyālokādilakṣaṇasamānasāmagrīprabhavatvād iti | dṛṣṭānte sādhyaśūnyatāśaṅkāyāṃ ca yad yat pratyakṣam, tat tad viśiṣṭajātyaiva sāmānyāvalambanam, yathā vyabhicāragrāhi pratyakṣam, pratyakṣaṃ ca vyāptigrāhīti svabhāva eva | sa evānekāntaparihāraḥ | buddhimatkāryayog api vyāptigrāhiṇi dharmiṇy ayam eva vā prayogaḥ | athavobhayatrāpi yad yat sambandhagrāhi pratyakṣaṃ tad viśiṣṭajātyaiva, yathā vācyavācakayoḥ, sambandhagrāhi ca pratyakṣaṃ kāryakāraṇayor api pūrvavat | tad ayaṃ yadi tattvataḥ kṛtsno 'pi kāryagrāmaḥ prayatnavan nāntarīyakaḥ, tathāpi kāryajātīnām atyantavilakṣaṇānām ānantyāt, pratijātibhedaṃ ca vyāptigrahanāpekṣaṇāt, yāvaj jātikaṃ kāryaṃ puruṣapūrvakaṃ paricchinnam, tāvata eva tadanumānam āñjasam iti yuktam uktam

 siddhaṃ yādṛg

 ity ādi | tathā ca vahner eva (dhūmabhasmāṅgārapākapāradotsāraṇavīkṣaṇakṣatiprabhṛtiṣu) dhūmabhasmāṅgārapākapāradotsāraṇavīkṣaṇakṣatiprabhṛtiṣu kāryeṣu yatra yatraiva pratibandhasādhakam adhyakṣaṃ pravṛttam, tata eva tadanumānam, nānyasmāt | evaṃ devakulakalasaprāsādasyandanadukūlādiṣu vastuvṛttyā pauruṣeyeṣv api yajjātīyeṣv eva puruṣakriyopalabdhir āsīt, tajjātikād eva kāryāt tadanumānam anumanyāmahe | dhārādharadharādharādijātau punas tadvyāpārānavadhāraṇāt kānumānavārtā, jātivaijātyasyātyantikasya sambhavena vyāpter agrahāt? gṛhītavyāpteś ca kāryasyādarśanāt |

 krīḍāparvatakādinirmitadṛśāṃ śaulādiṣu jñānumā
 nāpi nāyasahā skhaladgati yatas tannāmamātraṃ samam |
 kiṃ cānekasamānamānavakṛtāḥ sidhyanti cedīśinaḥ
 kā vārtā phalasāmyasaṃvidi kuto hetorviśeṣasthitiḥ ||

iti hy antaraślokaḥ |
kīdṛśī punaḥ kāryajātiḥ prayatnavatā vyāptetyāśaṅkya tasyā apy ānantyāt saṃkṣepārtham ucyate, yaddṛṣṭer arthakriyādarśino 'pi kṛtabuddhir bhavatīti | tatra ca kṛtabuddhir iti na sādhanabuddhiḥ, nāpy upādānādyabhijñalakṣaṇaprakṛtasādhyabuddhiḥ, kiṃ tu kuvindādisvabhāvasādhyabuddhiḥ | tadabhāvāc ca na sākṣādbhavadīyahetvasiddhiḥ prakṛtasādhyasiddhir vā vivakṣitā, kiṃ tu ātyantikavaijātyapradarśanam etat | taddvāreṇa ca hetor asiddhir avyāptir vābhimataiva |
[252] tathā hi śūnyanagaraparidṛṣṭadevakulādau uklālādiśilpibuddhir (uklālādidamaśilpibuddhir) āvirasti, na malyamakarālayādau | tasyāḥ śilpibuddher bhāvābhāvau na jātibhedam ātyantikam antareṇa ity abhiprāyaḥ | vyatirekagrahaṇe smaraṇasaṃskārabhraṃśe vā devakulādāv api na syād iyaṃ samānaṃ śilpibuddhiḥ | tato yathā dhūmād agnibuddhir bhavantī gardabhādabhadantī dhūmād gardabhasya niyataṃ jātibhedam āpādayati, tatheyam api pariniścitapauruṣeyabhāvebhyo bhāvebhyaḥ kailāsakuliśādīnām |
kathaṃ punar anumānābhāva eva pratyetavya iti cet, kumbhakārād ambhodadambhāliprabhṛtisambhava iti svapne 'pi śaṅkāvirahāt | anyathā kuvindapādamardanādanāvṛṣṭikaṣṭam āviśet na lokaḥ, paracakrākrāntikātaro vā kṣitidharajaladhivyarvādhamabhilkaṣaṃs tata eva nirvṛttim āsādayet | kuvindasthānīyas tatrāparo 'pekṣyata eveti cet, na, samāne kāryajanmani vijātīyakāraṇagaveṣaṇānupapatteḥ kuvindenaiva sādhyasiddheḥ | na hi paṭāntare api kuvindād aparasyāpekṣā |
asti ca vastraviśeṣe viśiṣṭaśilpino 'pekṣeti cetasti, yāvad eva tu vastrāntareṇaikajātiparāmarśo dṛḍhaḥ, ata eva kuvindasyaiva śilpinaḥ kalpanam | tadvimarśābhāve pauruṣeyatāyā eva sandehaḥ | merumandarādayas tu na kenacit pauruṣeyeṇaikapratyavamarśabhājaḥ | tadeṣām adhyakṣasiddham atyantavaijātyaṃ śāṭhyād apahnavānaḥ samānaśilpy anumānaviraheṇa svīkāryate | siddhe ca jātibhede yādṛk kāryaṃ kumbhādi puruṣapratibaddhaṃ siddham, na tādṛggarbhārbhakādi | yādṛk cedaṃ na tādṛk puruṣavyāptim iti siddhā asiddhiḥ avyāptiś ca dvayoḥ | evaṃ ca sthite prakṛtasādhyabuddhyajananadvārāṇi dūṣaṇāni dūram apāstāni ||
na hi vayaṃ prakṛtasādhyabuddher abhāvāt kāryatvādihetor asiddhiṃ brūmaḥ | kiṃ tarhi? mandarādau kuvindasamaśilpibuddherabhāvād ambarādisajātīyakāryatvāsiddhim | tataś ca prakṛtasādhyabuddhivaidhuryam iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ | kuvindasādhyāpekṣayā ca vyāptigrahaṇasmaraṇasaṃskārabhraṃśa eveṣṭa iti na bhūṣaṇavikalpāvakāśaḥ | kṛtakatvamātrapratītis tu na vivakṣitaiva | abhraṣṭasmaraṇānāṃ tāvad bhavaty eva puruṣakṛtabuddhiḥ kṣityādiṣv iti tu dūram aprakṛṣṭam | bauddhakṛtasya hi kṛtabuddhiniṣedhasyāsiddhiḥ prastutā abhidhātum | na ca sā śakyā, kṛtabuddhiśabdena śilpibuddher asya vivakṣitatvāt | puruṣakṛtabuddhibhāvavibhāvanaṃ
[253] punar anupayogi | pratīta eva tasmin dūṣaṇacinteyam | tatrāpy abhraṣṭasmaraṇānām ity asaṅgatam, atyantavaijātyasiddheḥ sindhvāder anyato na vyāptipratīteḥ, smaraṇasaṃskārabhraṃśasya parihartum aśakyatvāt | ata eva jagat kenacit sṛṣṭam iti pralāpamātre ka āśvāsaḥ? Prakṛtasādhyabuddhyāsiddhicodanaparihārād eva ca vedeṣvapīty ādi pratyādiṣṭam |
yadi tu puruṣeyavākyāder atyantaṃ vedasya vaijātyam upadarśayet Mīmāṃsakaḥ, tat kiṃ samayamātreṇa parājetavyaḥ? na tu tayoḥ svarūpadvārakaḥ śaktidvārako vā kaścid viśeṣo 'sti | tathā ca tat dvayam agṛhītasaṃketasya puraḥ paṭhitvā pratīhi kasya kīdṛśaṃ viśeṣaṃ vyākurvīta śrotā, kiṃ na vā paśyasi garuḍādimantrakṛtaṃ viṣāpākaraṇādi? tad etad āyātam,

 ekaḥ kāryaviśeṣam eva kalayan hetor viśiṣṭam nijaṃ
 lakṣyāgner iva kāryamātram amunā vyāptaṃ samutpaśyati |
 tajjātīyakam eva kāryam aparo nāvaiti taddhetukaṃ
 hanta dhvāntaviśeṣa eṣa viduṣām adhyakṣavastuny api ||

tasmāt,

 yad vācaḥ puruṣānvayavyatiricos tadbhāvabhājaḥ sthitā
 nānyasmād vacasaś ca vaidikagirāṃ bhedo 'sti śakyātmanoḥ |
 tulyātīndriyasūcanā ca niyataṃ naikatra cāśvāsanaṃ
 vedas tena na pauruṣeyapadavīmaprāpya viśrāmyati ||

yadi tat, kā kathā vicāragocarātītātyantikajātibhedeṣu kumbhād ambhodadambholiprabhṛtiṣu tajjātiniyatapratīteḥ pauruṣeyatāyāḥ? yad apy anityatāsādhanāyopālabdham, tad api nyāyabāhyam | pratyakṣeṇa pratibandhabodhādhikāre hi tādṛśī sajātīyetaratvamīmāṃsā | anityatve kṛtakatvamātrasya viparyayabādhakapramāṇād anumānasvabhāvāt prabidandhasiddhir iti na tatra jātiviśeṣānurodhaḥ | jātiviśeṣānavacchinne tu kṛtakamātre vyāptisādhanasamartham asamarthaṃ vā tat pramāṇam iti cintanīyam | śaktau na doṣasparśaḥ | ata eva tatra ghaṭaśabdabhedena bhedodbhāvanaṃ dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikavaidharmyābhidhānam iti na yuktam | yato dharmirūpādākṛṣṭadharmadvayasya vyāptivyavasthāpanād dharmavastv eva dharmīti tadbhedābhidhānasya dharmimātrabheda evārthaḥ |
[254] ihāpi tarhi kāryeṣu dharmiṣu pauruṣeyatvaṃ sādhyaṃ kāryatvamātraṃ hetur iti na viśeṣaḥ kaścid iti cet? ucyate, kāryatvamātraṃ hetur iti ko 'sya bhāṣitasyārthaḥ? kiṃ tāvan mukhyatayā dharmamātre kāraṇasya kuṅkumāder eva rāge vyāpārād evam ucyate? utasvit kātsnaryena kārye vyāptisiddheḥ, dhūmatvamātraṃ hetur itivat? yathā kṛtsno dhūmaḥ sādhyavyāptaḥ, tathā yāvat kāryaṃ tat kṛtsnaṃ puruṣavyāpārajanmakam iti niścayāt | tad etad ubhayam api nirastam | kṛtakatvamātram anityatvavyāptam iti tu kārtsnyapara eva bhāvanirdeśaḥ, yāvat kṛtakaṃ tat sarvam anityam ity ayam evārthaḥ | atrārthe pramāṇabale milite siddhe ca dhvaneḥ kṛtakatve ghaṭa eva kṛtako 'nityo dṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ śabdaḥ syād iti niravakāśam evety ayam evārtho dharmimātrabhedo 'yam ity anayā rītyā prakāśyate |
yathā hi svabhāvahetvadhikāraprastāvāt sādhyasādhanadharmau vikalpārūḍharūpāpekṣayā bhinnau vyavsthāpitau tathā dharmy api śabdādiḥ, anyasya taddharmaṇo 'bhāvāt | na cānyatra dharmiṇi kṛtakavastunā anityavastusādhane dhvaner anityatāsiddhiḥ | tasya ca dharmiṇo ghaṭaśabdabhāvena bhedamāpādayan dūṣaṇam abhidhāya nigṛhyate dharmimātrabhedadvāreṇa | prastute tu kāryahetvabhimānād dhūmasthānīyaḥ kāryarāśiḥ sādhyaś ca bhinno 'gnivat puruṣaḥ | kevalaṃ nāgnivat taddeśakāla eva | kiṃ tu janmadeśakāle sannihito niśceyaḥ, bhasmakumbhābhyām deśasannihitavyāpāraḥ kulālo niścīyate, ghaṛaś ca hetur vastutaḥ, tathā puruṣe 'pi sādhye vastv eva hetur na kāryatvadharmaḥ, tathā sati puruṣavyāptāt kāryād vilakṣaṇaṃ kṣoṇīdharādikāryāmati vadatā sādhanavaisadṛśyam udbhāvitam, na dharmivaisadṛśyam | tadā hi tadudayadeśakālam eva dharmi, na ca kalasādikāladeśāt kailāsādikāladeśavaisadṛśyaṃ kaścid vaktum upakrānto yena dharmivaisadṛśyodbhāvanaṃ bhavet |
tasmād dahanarūpamātrād dahanānumānavat sādhanavaisadṛśyodbhāvanam etad asiddhim avyāptiṃ vā darśayituṃ dharmiṇa iti tu viplavaḥ pareṣām | ayam evārtho yādṛk kāryatvaṃ devakulādau puruṣavyāptaṃ pratītam, na tādṛg yugandharādāv ity anayā diśopadiśyate | yajjātīyaṃ devakulādi puruṣavyāptaṃ na tajjātīyaṃ yugandharādīty arthaḥ | atyantavaijātyāc ca kāryaśabdamātrasāmyam ucyate na punar kāryavyāvṛtteḥ kvacit nyūnabhāvaḥ | vyāptau tu kāryatvāder anantarbhāvaṃ brūmaḥ | ata eva tanmātreṇa sāmyaṃ nopayogi, mūrtatvādineva dahanānumāne |
[255] mañjariyas tu paryanuyogo 'sthānapatitaḥ | ghaṭādijāniter eva puruṣavyāptā siddheti vadatāny atra saṃśayamātrasya vivakṣitatvāt | kulālādimanuṣyakṛtabuddhiś ca kṛtabuddhir uktā | tadabhāvaś ca jātibhede uttarīkṛtaḥ | sa cobhayasiddhatayā na visarjanāny avakāśayati | na cātyantikajātibhedam antareṇopapadyata iti niveditam |
evaṃ Vācaspater api viśeṣagaveṣaṇaṃ kṛtabuddhivaidhuryasyābhidheyaprayojanayor aparijñānaprayuktam iti veditavyam | yadi hi kṛtabuddhir nāstīti prakṛtasādhyabuddhir nāstīti vivakṣitam, tadā pratītikalahe 'muṣmin kuto viśeṣād anyatra sā bhavati parvatādau tadabhāvān neti cintyate | yadā tu kṛtabuddhir nāstīti sāmānaśilpikṛtabuddhir nāstīty abhidheyam, tatra ca na vivādaḥ | prayojanaṃ ca kumbhādibhyo 'mbhodharāder atyantavaijātyakhyāpanam | tad apy aśakyaparihāram | tato gṛhītavyāptikebhyo 'tyantavilakṣaṇāt kathaṃ prakṛtasādhyabuddhir ity abhipretam? tadā plavata eva sakalam evaṃvidham | utpattimanmātre ca vyāptinirasanāt hantotpattimad ityādy uttaraṃ kāladaṇḍakhaṇḍitam eva | tena ghaṭe dṛṣṭavyāptikasya ghaṭasajātīyam eva buddhimatpūṛvakam | yadā tu prāsādādāv api vyāptigrahas tadā tajjāter api tatpūrvakatvasiddhir ity apy uktam |
yaccā (yaccātha) yajjātīyam ity āśaṅkya kiṃ kāryajātīyam? tathā na dṛṣṭam ity uttaram, tad api svābhāvikavikalpāvabhāsinaḥ sāmānyasya pratyakṣeṇa vyāptigrahaṇayogyatāsamarthanāt kadarthitam | tasmād yad api aupādhikavikalpapratibhāsināpi rūpeṇa tajjātīyavyavahāro duṣparihāraḥ, vyāptigrahaṇe tu pratikṣiptatvān mahān viśeṣa iti |
ata eva vittokavikalpā api na kiñcit | tathā hi, yady asmadabhiprāyapraśnaḥ, tadā viśiṣṭaiva kāryajātir devakulakalasādilakṣaṇā buddhimadvyāptā yaddṛṣṭer hi parokṣakriyasyāpy anubhūtasajātīyaśilpyanumānam, sā na siddhā sindhubhūdharādau | kāryatvamātraṃ tu na vyāptam ity uccais tarāṃ tanvanta evāsmahe | tatra kim ebhir vikalpair iti cintaya | yadviśeṣād viśiṣṭā kāryajātiḥ sa viśeṣaḥ kim anirūpitarūpa evety api pāpīyaḥ, pratyakṣasiddhānāṃ kāryajātīnāṃ parasparavaisadṛśyasyāpahnotum aśakyatvāt | vyāptis tu viśiṣṭāyāṃ jātau bhavatu kāryamātre vety atra paramāpātato vimantum arhati | katham anyathā svayam api vastutvasyāgnikāryatvāsaṃjananaṃ vyabhicāram ālambya parihṛtam? vyabhicārabuddhīnāṃ niyatajātiviṣayatve vivādābhāvād ity āvirbhāvitam eva | tasmād ākārārthakriyāsāmarthādivedanāt
[256] citrākāre jagati niyatam īśvaraprasādād evālaukikam ekākāram ālokitam asyetyupekṣaiva jyāyasī |
yad api prācīnam upādānodāharaṇam asya kāryamātre vyāptisamīhayā, tad api naupayikam, tatrāpi pratyakṣavyāpārasyāśakyasādhanatvāt, naisargikavikalpaviṣayatvāt, upādānasya dṛśyādṛśyasvabhāvatvāc ca | tat kim idānīm upādānena kāryarāśer vyāptir eva nāsti? āhosvit pramāṇāntaragamyā bhavatv iti cet? ubhayatra saṃśayaḥ, sato 'pi vyabhicārasya viparyayabādhakānumānasya hānullekhasambhavād idānīm ekāntahetor abhāvāt | tad ayaṃ sopādānaṃ sarvotpattir iti sarvatantrasiddhānto 'virodhād anuvṛttaḥ, yāvac ca kāryam ālokayāmas tāvad upādānavadevety avigānena vyavahāro 'pi | na ca kāryaparyantabodhaḥ pṛthagjanasyeti tanīyasāpi viparītāṃśena saṃśayo durvāraḥ | buddheś ca buddhir upādānaṃ niścitā iti vijñānasya vijñānānupādānāc (vijñānānyānupādānāc) ca sidhyatīti na virudhyate, tato yadi siddhāntād api tadvyāptivyavasāyo na kācit kṣatiḥ | pratyakṣāt tu mā bhūt, kevalam atra pakṣe 'cetanopādānatvahetur ekadeśasiddhaḥ śaṅkyeteti vyavasthā | sā cāyātaiva, kiṃ kriyatām? viparyayabādhakapramāṇalābhe tu sāpi na syāt | kevalaṃ pratyakṣeṇa kṛtsnakāryavyāptivāde 'nudāharaṇam evedam | ataḥ pratyakṣasya jātiviśeṣe vyāpāraniyamaprasādhanād viśeṣahetvabhāvād ity ādy api dhvastam?
yat punar aparasya viparyayabādhakapramāṇopanyāsapauruṣam, tatrāpi prathamadvitayaṃ tāvad bādhakaṃ dhūmasyeva siddhāyām eva tadutpattau tatsādhakapratyakṣānupalambhasya viśiṣṭajātyadhikāreṇa pravṛttisādhanād viśiṣṭam eva ghaṭādikāryaṃ prati śakyam | evaṃ ca yadi buddhimantam antareṇa jāyeta sakṛd api tato na bhavet, aniyatahetutve vāhetutvam iti na kāryamātraṃ prati, tasya puruṣād utpattiprasādhanābhāvāt | tataś ca tat kāryaṃ yat puruṣapūrvam ity api niravakāśam ||
nāpi kāryāvirāmaprasaṅgasaṅgatiḥ, svakāraṇāyattasannidher adṛṣṭapariṇāmasahakāriṇaḥ kāraṇāvasthāviśeṣasya satatam abhāve 'pi kāryāṇāṃ kādācitkatopapatteḥ, yad apekṣayā nityaśakter api īśvarasya śaśvan na karaṇam (karaṇatvam) | ekāvasthāniyame hi kāraṇāntarāṇāṃ pravṛttinivṛttisādhanīcchā prārthyeta | sa ca nāsti, bījasyocchūnataratamādibhāvavat pariṇāmaparamparāparicayasya
[257] teṣām apahnotum aśakyatvāt | astu vā ekāvasthāniyama īśvarasya icchāyā api nityatvāt tadavasthaḥ kāryāvirāmaḥ, anitye tu yadapekṣo 'syāḥ kadācit bhāvaḥ, tad apekṣayā kāryagrāmasya yadi syāt kīdṛśo doṣaḥ? kumbhādikāryakrame 'pi tarhi kiṃ puruṣecchayā, yadapekṣo 'syāḥ kramaḥ, tadapekṣa eva kumbhāder apy astīti vaktuṃ śakteḥ? tad ayuktam, pramāṇena dṛṣṭasāmarthyasya hetor apohitum aśakyatvāt | prastute tu pramāṇābhāvāt kāryakādācitkatāmātram āśritaṃ tadanyathāpy upapatsyata iti kutaḥ puruṣāpattiniyamaḥ kāryasya?
atha kumbhādeḥ kadācidbhāvaḥ puruṣādhīno dṛṣṭa iti kāryāntarasyāpi tatheti cet? evaṃ tarhi tad eva darśanādarśanamātraṃ vyāptisādhanam āyātam, kim atra viparyayabādhakopanyāsaśauṭīryeṇeti tṛtīyam api nirastam ||
yac cocyate, kāraṇasannidher dhīdhanādhīno niścita iti, tatrāpi tathā darśanamātrāśraye etad eva vācyam | viparyayabādhakaṃ ca na kiñcid uktam | pratyakṣānupalambhaśaraṇīkaraṇe ca vātopadhātādimilajjambālabījādisāmagryā anaikāntikatvād sarvam āpekṣaparihārasametaṃ kāryavad avagantavyaṃ sāmagrīviśeṣa eva vyāptiyogya ity etat paryantam | tan na kāraṇasāmagryāḥ puruṣeṇa vyāptisiddhaḥ, yato vipakṣe vyāpakānupalambhād asambhava iti caturtham api kadarthitam ||
tāvataiva Vācaspater api hṛdayaśūnyaḥ pralāpo 'pahastitaḥ | yathā hi vitatānāṃ tāvad ajananabījamuktam avasthāviśeṣābhāvo nāma | yady api daṇḍacakrādīnāṃ puruṣād eva milanam upalabdhaṃ tatprayatnasacivānāṃ ca kāryārambhaḥ, tathāpi sarvatra sarvadā vā tathaiveti niyamayituḥ pramāṇasyābhāvāt kāryotpādavyāpakasyāpi kāraṇasamavadhānasya buddhimad adhīnatvena vyāptyasiddhes tadavastho doṣaḥ | yathā ca kāraṇāntaradaśāviśeṣāśrayeṇaiva kāryāṇāṃ kadācid bhāvas tathā prakṛtiviśeṣo 'pīti pañcamaṃ ca pañcatām añcitam ||

 kāraṇamātrāpattisādhanaṃ punar etad iti darśitaṃ śāstre ||

etenaiva śaṅkaroktam api nāpi kaścid viśeṣa ity ādi kāvyaracanāmātramāpāditam, pratibandhasādhakapramāṇaparyādānāt | yady api ca nirabhiprāyavyāpāratvena prāsādādihetubhyo bhūbhūdharādihetūnāṃ na viśeṣas tathāpi prayatnavad apekṣānapekṣābhyāṃ yadi syāt ko doṣaḥ? yathā pārthivatvāviśeṣe 'pi lohalekhyatvālohalekhyatve | avaśyaṃ ca nirabhiprāyatvāviśeṣe
[258] 'pi viśeṣa evāmeṣitavyaḥ śakteḥ, katham anyathā kāryavaijātyam ātyantikam? tad asau śaktiḥ prayatnavad apekṣāvaimukhyam api yadi kṣameta kā kṣatiḥ? kiṃ ca kartur api karādivyāpāram antareṇa samīhāmātrāt na mūrtakāryasiddhir upalabdhā, tam ativartamānānāṃ bhūdharādīnāṃ kā gaṇanā samīhāmātre?
kārādayo 'pi samīhayā pravartyanta iti cet? samīhāpi sanniveśini śayādivyāpāravirahe na kiñcitkarīty uktam | tato yayā śaktayā karādivyāpārapāravaśyamapāsya mahīdharādihetavo nirabhiprāyatve saty api na kāryakarmaṇi pratihanyante, tayā samīhām api nātikrameyur iti ka evaṃ śraddadhīta? na hi dhūmodayakāle ucchaladbahalarūpaṃ vastu vahnīndhanajanyatayā sambhāvitam ekābhāvaniścaye niścīyamānam anyābhāve 'pi na bhāvaśaṅkāyāṃ niveśyati, tādṛg etad api ||
śarīrasvīkāre tu prādeśikakāryānityānekāsarvajñatvāt sādhu sādhitaḥ sudhībhirīśvaraḥ | etenaiva vā vyabhicāraḥ kāryatvādeḥ | na hy anadhiṣṭhitānām ity ādicanād (ādivacanād) darśanādarśanamātrād anyam upāyam asya vyāptisādhanāya spṛśati, tac ca kṛtottaram | yadi ca darśanādarśanam eva śaraṇam, tadā yathā samīhāvataḥ kāryakriyā dṛṣṭeti kārye sati samīhāvato 'numānam iṣṭam, tathā karādimata eva mūrtakriyā dṛṣṭeti karādivyāpāranupapattau puruṣasyākriyaiva kasmāt na niścīyate? na khalu kāryahetuvyāpakānupalambhayoḥ prāmāṇye kaścid viśeṣaḥ | yadi tu darśanādarśanamātramanāsthāya pramāṇāntaram ekaniyataṃ syāt, syād ekasādhyabuddhiḥ, tadabhāve tu pratibandha eva tayoḥ parasparam, na bādhā tulyakakṣatvād iti prakaraṇasamaḥ parābhiprāyāt |
prayogaḥ, yo na svāṅgavyāpāravān nāsau mūrtanirvartanasamartho dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā kulāla eva saṃhṛtakarādivyāpāradaśāyām | nāsti ca svāṅgavyāpāraḥ prakṛte puṃsīti vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ | nāśrayāsiddhiḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgādhyāyanyāyeneti vastutas tarhi dūṣaṇāntaram eva yuktaṃ, kaḥ pratihetor avakāśa iti cet, na, bhūyodarśanasya vyāptisiddhāv anaṅgatvapratipādanārtham asyopanyāsāt | yadi bhūyodarśanam upāyaḥ tadaivam api syād ity ukter iti vyāptigrahaprakārāṇām ayogād anekānta iti sthitam |
astu vā vyāptigrahaḥ kathañcit, tathāpi neśvarasiddhipratyāśā phalavatī, buddhimataḥ sādhyasyaikatvaniyamaniścayābhāvāt | ekatve hi tasya siddhe nityavibhusarvajñatvasiddhir
[259] īśvaravyavahāram āropayet | yadā tu bhinnadeśakālakalitaṃ kāryajātam anekena saṃkhyātikrāntena kartrā kṛtaṃ sambhāvyeta, na tadā vibhutvanityatve, svasvaviṣayopādānādimātravedanasiddhau ca kva sarvajñatvam?
atha bahūnāṃ vyāhatamanasāṃ vyāpāre kāryasyānutpattir upanyasya vilopādiprasaṅgaś ca syād iti cet? pratyekaṃ vaibhavādiguṇayogād īśvarāṇāṃ vyāpāre syād apīyam āśaṅkā, adya punar eko 'pi tādṛṅ na sidhyatīty ucyate | arvācīnaśaktayaś ca bhūyāṃsa ekam anekaṃ ca kāryam ārabhya niṣpādayanto dṛśyanta eva | nanv anekatrāpi pradhānabhūtenaikena bhāvyam, balīyasā vā, sūtradhāravat, senānīvad vā | atas tasyaiva kartṛtvam itareṣāṃ tadanuvṛttitvād iti cet, na, tatrāpi niyamābhāvāt, svasvaprayojanānurodhena svatantrāṇām api keṣāñcid ekasattvādighaṭanādarśanāt | tatrāpi kaścid eva prathamaḥ prayojaka ity api nāsti, anekasya tathā hṛdayotkalikāyā anivāraṇāt, nīcasyāpi prayojakatvasambhavāt |
tasmād bhramaramadhumakṣikāvalmīkajantuvat kṣudraprāṇibhir apy ekaikam ainākādikaraṇasambhāvanāyāṃ kā vārtā viśvasyaikena kriyāyāḥ? tatrādṛṣṭajanmānas tāvat tāvataiva kṛtārthīkṛtacetanānumitayaḥ kṣitir adharādayaḥ | te ca kṣudrajantava upādānam atikṣudraṃ pṛthvyādidravyam upakaraṇaṃ sukhādisampradānam ātmanaṃ sthitisukhādi ca prayojanaṃ jānanta eva valmīkajantuvat pravarteran | siddhe ca nāvaśyam adhiṣṭhāyakā dṛśyeran, vicitraśaktikarmāpekṣāt svabhāvaviprakarṣād vā | ye 'pi dṛṣṭajanyamāno vṛkṣādayaḥ pauruṣeyāḥ, tatra cintaiva nāsti | adṛṣṭapuruṣavyāpārās tu ye bindhyayugandharādiparisaradbhāvās te 'pi piśācādiprakārair adhitṛbhir (adhiṣṭhātṛbhir) asaṃkhyaiḥ kartṛmanta iti kaḥ sarvavedī bhavatu? deśakālayoś ca bhinnā evepri kva vibhutvanityatve? na caivaṃ śaṅkāyā bādhakaṃ kiñcid asti vastubalapravṛttam anumānam |
nanu caivaṃ tāvad bhavadbhir api na svīkṛtam eva | etāvac cātikaṣṭataraṃ kalpanayo varam īśvarakalpanaiva lāghavād iti cet? satyam, yadi kalpanāmātretaranyāsaḥ, tadā bhavad upanyāsam eva puraskariṣyāmaḥ | yāvat punar anumānavyājaṃ na varjayasi, tāvad avaśyam asmākaṃ dṛḍhanirūpaṇābhiyogaḥ | atha kṣudrair asaṃkhyair nirmitā narmadādaya iti dunoti cetaś cet? ekenāśarīreṇa nirmitā iti suṣṭutarām | tasmāt pramāṇam eva sarvato balavad yathā sthāpayati tathārthasthitiḥ | ata eva tad dṛḍhaṃ nirūpyate | na ca kṣudreṣv anurodhaḥ kaścit |
[260] kṣudrair akṣudrair dṛśyaiḥ samānaśaktibhir adhikaśaktibhiḥ svatantraiḥ pradhānasammataikaikajantusanāthāparimitayuthair vā sthūlāṇukaikānekasvakāryabhāgopādānādimātravedibhiḥ ṣaḍgatiparyāpannaiḥ kṛto bhavatu bhuvanasanniveśaḥ, eka eva tu kartā 'sya mā bhūt |
nāpi bauddhais tathānupagamāt ato hetuvyāvṛttiḥ, ekato 'pi vyāvṛttiprasaṅgāt | na ca vastubalapravṛtte 'numāne paropagamāpekṣā | upagamamātrasya tyāgenāvirodhāt | tad evaṃ buddhimanmātre sādhye upādānādyabhijñatālakṣaṇaviśeṣanāntarīyakatayā sākṣād upādānādyabhijñakartṛsādhanād vābhimatasiddhir naikāntikī, sarvakāryakriyāyā ekakartṛtvasiddheḥ | upādānādyabhijñamātrasādhane ca vaiphalyam, bhāratādikathāvat | tataḥ sādhanāntarābhāvād asmād eva sarvajñādiguṇavataḥ siddhir iṣṭeti tadapekṣyaiva dūṣaṇam abhidhānīyam anekāntalakṣaṇam iti sthitam |
ato yāvatīm arthagatim ityādi durlaṅghyam | sādhyasāmānyapratibandhākṛṣṭatve 'pi viśeṣasya siddhiḥ sādhanādhīnaiva, tadekaparatayā sādhanopanyāsād anyasādhanābhāvāc ca | bauddhasyāpi hi nairātmyasiddhiḥ sādhanādhīnaiva | yadi hi nairātmyatyāge tpi kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanaṃ caritārthaṃ bhavet, tadā kiṃ kṣaṇabhāṅasādhane nairātmyasiddhiḥ syāt? bhavatas tu sārvajñyādisiddhim uddhūyānyathāpy upādānādyabhijñānalakṣaṇo viśeṣa upapāditaḥ | ata eva nātmopanyāsapūrvako tnvayo dṛṣṭānte pradarśyate iti anupayuktam | sākṣāt tadanvayadarśane api tannāntarīyakatvaṃ sādhyasāmānyasya darśayitavyam eva | taccaikatvena sakalakriyādhārasya vyāpter abhāvād aśakyam |
etenaiva Vācaspatyo 'pi sārvajñyasādhanābhinayaḥ prativyūḍhaḥ | siddhe tu sarvajñe kartāri kartur ekatvanirūpaṇaśramo tsmākam anuyogīty (anupayogīty) uparamyate | yad apy ayaṃ vyatirekiprayogam āha, tad apy ekatvāniścayād eva dūṣitam, anityāsarvaviṣayabuddhitve tpy upādānādivedanasambhavasyopapāditatvāt |
vittokasamādhāne tu dhūmād dharādharāvyavacchedavat (dharādharāyogavyavacchedavat) agneḥ pañcavarṇaśikhākalāpatāyā apy anumānaprasaṅgaḥ | nātra sāmarthyam iti cet? tatrāpi pakṣāyogavyavaccheda eva sāmarthyāt | pṛthvībhṛti prayatnavataḥ siddhāv apy ekatvāniścayāt kva sarvavedanasiddhiḥ?
nanu dvyaṇukasyāpi kāryatvāt kartā tadupādānaparamāṇudarśī niyamena eṣitavyaḥ | na ca māṃsacakṣuṣas tathā bhavitum arhanti | anyathā kim asmad ābhir aparāddhaṃ yena
[261] tathā na bhavāmaḥ? tad avaśyaṃ kartātīndriyadarśī svīkriyamāṇo neśvarād anyo yuktaḥ | tad api yat kiñcit | na hi māṃsacakṣuṣṭve tpi sarvasādhāraṇaṃ karaṇasāmarthyam, asmad atyantam apakṛṣṭānām api gṛghrādīnām indriyapāṭavātiśayadarśanāt | kṣodiṣṭhānām eva ca keṣāñcit paramāṇudarśanam api syāt karmaśaktiviśeṣāt, yathā pipīlikānām asmad agocaragandhāṇugrahaṇam | na ca tanmātrasūkṣmam īkṣamāṇair deśakālaviprakṛṣṭasyāpi sūkṣmāntarasya grahaṇam, sakalasthūlasya vā? tan na tāvataiveśvarasiddhipratyāśā |
evaṃ tarhi bhavatu paramāṇor darśanasambhāvanā sakalakṣetrajñatatsamavetadharmādharmāśayaviśeṣāṇāṃ tu katham? na kathañcit | na hi kāryakriyā kṣetrajñasvarūpādiparijñānenāpi vyāptā kulāladṛṣṭānte dṛṣṭā, kiṃ tu sampradānopakaraṇavedanadvāreṇa tadākṛṣṭir iṣyate | sā cāśakyā, sāmarthyānupapatteḥ, uktakrameṇāpi tanmātravedanasya caritārthatvāt | karmaṇi svasyābhipreyamāṇatvena sampradānatāyā durvāratvāt; yathā svasmai mandiraṃ karotīti | anyathā tenaiva vyabhicāraprasaṅgaḥ sampradānajñānāpekṣāyāḥ |
anumīyamānas tatrāparaḥ sampradānavedī bhaviṣyatīti cet, na, vyabhicāradarśanena kartuḥ sampradānajñānāntarīyakatvāsiddher anumānavārtāvirahāt | na cānumīyamānāpekṣayā tasyākartṛtvam | evaṃ hi kulālasyāpy akartṛtvaprasaṅge kartṛtve, svātmāpi sampradānam eṣitavyaḥ | na ca param api sampradānaṃ vyavahāraprasiddham uddhūya kṣetrarūpam asau jñātum īśaḥ karmāśayabhedārthopakaraṇaśabdasaṃgṛhītān api | tato yathā kulālas tān aviddhān daṇḍacakrādivedanenaivopakaraṇajñaḥ, tathānumīyamānā api jantavaḥ svakīyakaramukhādijñānenāpy ante bhaviṣyanti |
tat kutastyam etat kṣetrajñarūpatadīyadharmādharmāśayabhedaparijñānam? athāśarīrasya kva svāṅgavyāpārasaṅgatiḥ? aśarīrasya siddhisaṅgatir api kīdṛśī? ekatve hi siddhe śarīrī prādeśiko na sarvakarmaṇi samartha iti sāmarthyād aśarīrisiddhipratyāśā, ekatvaṃ ca duḥsādhanam ity uktam | na cāśarīratve tpi daṇḍacakramukhādyupakaraṇānupapatteḥ pāriśeṣyāt karmāśayabhedajñānenaivopakaraṇajñānaniṣṭheti sauṣṭhvāya | dikkālasamavāyāder apy upakaraṇasaṃgṛhītasya jñānena tajjñatāmātrasya kṛtārthatvāt |
kaḥ punar asau viśeṣo yatas tadavasthasya digādijñānenaivopakaraṇajñatā? na dharmādharmādijñāneneti | ubhayajñānenaiva bhavitv iti cet? tad apy uktam | na hi yāvad upakaraṇaṃ
[262] tāvat kartrāvaśyaṃ jñeyam iti dṛṣṭam | na ca digādijñānenaivopakaraṇavittis tadavasthasyeti niścayaṃ brūmo yato viśeṣaparyanuyogaḥ, kiṃ tūpakaraṇāntarasambhavān na pāriśeṣyaviśrāntiḥ atrety ucyate | tato yathā parāparakartṛṣś daṇḍacakrāditurīvemādyupakaraṇavirahaparamparāyām anyānyair upakaraṇair dharmādibāhyair upakaraṇajñatāsthitir upalabdhā, tathā kimadyāpy astu? uta dharmādīnādāyaiveti sandeha eva | yadi punar anyad upakaraṇaṃ na syāt pāriśeṣyavyākhyānaṃ śobheta | abhyudayaniḥśreyasamārgādisandehe ca kiṃ tādṛśā tena kartavyam īśvarābhidhānena dhanavirahiṇeva?
tasmād aśarīratve tpi na dharmādijñānākṛṣṭiḥ, kiṃ punas tadasiddhau? mā bhūd upakaraṇatayā dharmāder vedayitā niyamena kāryatayā bhaviṣyati, yataḥ kartā kāryarūpādivedakaḥ sa ceśvara ity api niḥsāram | dānahiṃsādikaṃ hi kurvantas tad vedayanta eva svarūpamātreṇa, na tāvatā ta eveśvarāḥ | na cānyaḥ kārtsnyena tadvedī siddhaḥ | dharmādharmatvena tu niścayaḥ tatkāriṇo tpi nāvaśyam bhāvī kumbhakāravat | tatkāriṇāṃ tarhi tattvena niścayābhāvāt tattvaniścayaḥ kāryatvāt kartāram īśvaram eva sannidhāpayed ity api nāsti | dharmādharmatvaniścayo tpi hi samīcīnaḥ sandigdhasattāka eva vartate | kathaṃ tataḥ pratyāśā? anirastaviparyayāśaṅkasaṅkalpasvabhāvas tu bhūyasāmāgamadvāreṇa | devajātismarādisvīkārāc ca teṣām apy asti leśena samyakkarmaphalasambandhabodhaḥ | na ca tāvataivaiśvaryaparyāptir iti | tad evam īśvarāsiddheḥ sakalajanmināṃ śubhāśubhakarmāṇi nopakaraṇam, kiṃ tu kāraṇāny eva lokavaicitryasyeti dhīmatām upādeyaḥ prathamaślokārtha iti ||

|| īśvaradūṣaṇam samāptam iti ||
ĪŚVARAVĀDĀDHIKĀRE VĀRTTIKASAPTAŚLOKĪVYĀKHYĀNAM
prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ

 karmanirmitavaicitryam anīśaṃ yo jagaj jagau |
 praṇamāmi pramāṇena tam avyāhataśāsanam ||
 nityapramāṇapratiṣedhasiddhau yad apramāṇatvam anityabhāve |
 vibhāvayann āha kṛtī tadaṃśe vimohadaṃśāpaha eṣa mārgaḥ ||
 svayaṃ nirasyāpi parasya sādanānyasaṅgatau vārtikakārakīrtane |
 na nirvṛtiś cet punar asya varṇanād varaṃ hi tadvarnanayaiva vikramaḥ ||

yad yat kāryaṃ tat tad buddhimatpūrvakam, yathā ghaṭaḥ | kāryaṃ ca mahīmahīdharādi | yad vā, yad yat na buddhimatpūrva (buddhimatpūrvakaṃ) tat tan na kāryam, yathā ākāśam | kāryaṃ ca tarugirisāgarādīty arthataḥ kāryahetuḥ | evam acetanopādānatvam, arthakriyākāritvam, svārambhakāvayavasanniveśanāviśeṣavattvam, sthitvā sthitvā kāryakarmāṇi, pravṛttidharmakatvaṃ ca prayojyam iti katham ucyate,

 anitye 'py apramāṇateti ?

etac ca nityānityayoḥ sādhāraṇam eva sādhanam | anityatāprakramaṇe tu parasya pramāṇaparyeṣaṇā pravarteta | tad upanyāsanidānatvamātreṇānityaśabdānuvādaḥ | na punaḥ asāv anitya eva bhagavātn asmābhir iṣyate | tathā hi;

 eko vibhuḥ sarvavid ekabuddhisamāśrayaḥ śāśvata īśvarākhyaḥ |
 pramāṇam iṣṭo jagato vidhātā svargāpavargārthibhir arthanīyaḥ ||

atrocyate | kim ebhir eva hetubhir upadiṣṭaguṇagaṇāgārapuruṣātiśayasādhanamanoratho 'tha hetvantarabalāt? tatra na tāvad ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ | tathā hi yat sādhanaṃ yāvatīm arthagatiṃ vyāpnoti tatas tāvatyeva sidhyati nārthāntaram | na hi yāvān icchayā vyāpto 'rthaḥ, tāvati pramāṇasya sāmarthyam | api tu yāvati pramāṇasya sāmarthyam, tāvato 'rthasya tan nimittā siddhiḥ | na ca kāryatvādi cetanapūrvakatvena vyāpyamānam api tadekatvādiniyatāṃ matim utpādayituṃ śaktam, tadviśeṣaṇe vyāpter evāpratīteḥ, anyathā viparītarūpaniścayasyāpi
[266] prasaṅgāt | na hi dahanasāmānyena vyāptaṃ dhūmam upalabhya kaścid visphurat pañcavarṇaśikhākalāpakam anīyam analam anumātum īśaḥ |
nanu tathāpi deśakālaviśeṣaviśeṣaṇam anumimīta eva pakṣadharmatābalāt, evaṃ bhūdharādāv api buddhimadadhiṣṭhānādhīnaṃ kāryatvam upalabdhavato 'bhimatasiddhir adhikaraṇasiddhāntanyāyena bhaviṣyatīti cet, na, sāmarthyānupapatteḥ | yathā hy etad deśakālena vahninā janyamānasya na taddeśakālatvam iti dhūmādyanumāne sāmarthyam, na tathā cetayitur ekatvasarvajñatvādikam antareṇa tarūṇāṃ vāsaniveśādyanupapattim ākalyāmaḥ | tataḥ pakṣadharmatābalāt kulālādau tadutpādanasamarthatvasiddhir api bhavantī nābhimataṃ viśeṣam avalambitum alam |
nanu yadi bhūdharādinirmāṇasamarthaḥ siddhaḥ, kim aparaṃ prārthyate? tat kim idānīm apariniṣṭhitavācyarūpeṇa vācakamātreṇa parituṣṭiḥ? na hy evam abhimataprastutavastusiddhiḥ | utpādanavyāpāro hi notpitsukāryaṃ prati niyataprāgbhāvitvamātrād atiriktaḥ | sa cācetanasādhāraṇo buddher api naikasarvagatvādiviśeṣapratibaddhaḥ siddhaḥ | tato vivakṣitasādhyāpekṣayā vacanamātrasiddhyā na kiñcit |
kaḥ punar evaṃ pratijānāti sarvajñapūrvakāḥ purvatādaya iti? api tu buddhimaddhetukā ity āśaṅkya sādhanenāntarupahasann āha,

 sthitvāpravṛttisaṃsthānaviśeṣārthakriyādiṣu |
 iṣṭasiddhir      (PV II 10 ab'c)

iti | sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇakarmanirmito hi samasto vasturāśir iṣyate | karma cācetanasvabhāvam iti sakalajñānahetavo 'sidhyantaḥ sindhubhūdharādayaḥ kim aniṣṭam asmākam āvahantīti bhāvaḥ | tanmātrasādhyābhiprāye ca virodhāsiddheḥ sādhanopanyāsavaiyarthyaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmāt upāttaviśeṣa evānena sādhyaḥ | na ca tatra sādhanasāmarthyam ity uktam | astu tarhi sādhanāntarād eva tathā siddhir iti dvitīyapakṣāpekṣayā niścayābhāvam udbhāvayann āha,

 asiddhir veti |

na pramāṇāntaraṃ na vā hetvantaram asti yato 'yaṃ niścayaḥ syād ity arthaḥ | athavā atīndriyatvenādhyakṣāsambhavād anumānam abhyardhanīyam, tad arthaṃ ca sarvaṃ hetum adhikṛtyāha,

[267] asiddhir veti |

uktānumānato hi prativādisādhāraṇasarvakṛc cetanamātre siddhe 'pi viśeṣaśāṃśī na kaścid dhetur yo na svarūpāsiddho 'nyatra sattāyāḥ, tanmātrasattātirekiṇi dharme 'numānasyānavasarāt | sattā tu kṣaṇabhaṅgaśaṃsinīti nityaikatvāpekṣayā āha,

 asiddhir veti |

viparītasiddhir ity arthaḥ | adharmādivat paryudāsena nitye 'pi hi parasādhanavad duṣaṇasyābhimatatvāt, prastāvamātraphalatvād anityokteḥ | vyāptitvāpekṣayā anekāntam apy āha,

 asiddhir vā dṛṣṭānta

iti | vyāptitvasya paramārthato 'bhāvād eva dṛṣṭānte darśanābhāvān na tena kasyacid dharmasya vyāpti (vyāptiḥ) sidhyatīty uktaṃ bhavati | sarvabodhasya tu bhāve 'pi na vyāpakatvapratītiḥ | kuta ity āha,

 dṛṣṭānte saṃśayo 'thavā

iti, arvāgdarśanena viśeṣaniṣṭhatayā vastuto niścetum aśakyatvāt | tasmād upagītaguṇasya yathoktasādhanebhyo na sākṣān nādhikaraṇasiddhāntanyāyena, nāpi sādhanāntarāt siddhiḥ iti siddhaḥ sādhakapramāṇavirahaḥ | tadviśeṣavirahiṇi tv iṣṭasiddhir iti ||
athavā kāryatvādihetuṣūpanyasteṣu sādhyasāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena vikalpa iti siddhir asiddhir vety āha | tatra karmavāditāprasiddhyā siddhasādhanaṃ vyaktam ity asiddhinibandhanaṃ viśeṣe 'nugamābhāvam ādarśayann āha,

 asiddhir vā dṛṣṭānte saṃśayo 'thavā

iti, sādhyasyeti prakṛtam | tatra vibhūtvādipratyanīkadharmaṇaḥ kulālāder avivādena siddheḥ asiddhir iṣṭasya dṛṣṭānte | atha dehātiriktabhāgasyānisargadurvibhāvasya vaibhavādikam iṣṭam iti matis tathāpi saṃśayo 'stu, kim idānīm atra nirbandheneti bhāvaḥ |

 sāmānye siddhasādhyateti,

[268] tasmāt sādhyavikalpāt sandigdhasādhyadharmatvād vā na dṛṣṭānte sādhyena kāryatvāder vyāptir iti viśeṣasyāsiddher eva, anekāntas tu hetudoṣaḥ |
nanu dhūmānugame 'pi,

 viśeṣe 'nugamābhāvaḥ sāmānye siddhasādhyatā |

iti samāno nyāyaḥ, tadanayor aikaniyataṃ prāmāṇyam anyad veti | niyataṃ cet? na samīcīnam ālocitam | tathā hi na tāvad viśeṣasiddhim avadhūya prāmāṇyam anumānam anubhavatīti siddham | sa tu viśeṣaḥ pakṣāyogyvyavacchedamātralakṣaṇas tadatiriktaś ca sambhavati, yathā agnir atra dhūmāt, evaṃrūpo vā? tatra prathamāpahnave syād anumānasyāpalāpaḥ, tanmūlatvād atiriktasiddher api | na cāsau tathānvayānusaraṇam antareṇāpi nirasituṃ śakyaḥ | pakṣadharmo hi yat pratibaddhaḥ siddhaḥ sa tena dharmiṇam aviyuktamanādarśayan svarūpasattayaiva viyujyeta, yadi paraṃ pāryahetvadhikāreṇa kālādyapekṣātiricyate | dvitīyasiddhis tu tanmātrasādhyeti tajjanyaviśeṣagrahaṇanāntarīyakatayānvayānusaraṇam antareṇābhavanty api nānumānāpalāpāya prabhavati, tadviśeṣavirahiṇā dharmeṇāyogavyavacchedasiddhyāpi tasyāś caritārthatvāt | anumānaviśeṣāpalāpas tu syāt, yathā kaścit pañcavarṇaśikhaṃ śikhinam anumātum abhipretya vahnir atra dhūmād iti sādhane pareṇa siddhasādhanānanugamābhyām abhiyujyamānas tarhi dhūmamātrocchedeneha cānumānam api na syād iti bruvāṇaḥ śobheta | na tv anumānoccheda eva syāt, tadaiva dahanasāmānyānumānasya tena pramāṇikriyamāṇatvāt | tasmāt,

 pakṣāyogavyavacchedamātrabhedena dūṣaṇam |
 iṣṭasiddhyanvayābhāvāvatirikteṣu dūṣaṇam ||

naitau dūṣaṇatve 'dūṣaṇatve vā niyatau, viṣayabhedena tu dvayī sthitir iti matam | tadvad ihāpi jaladhibhūdharādau buddhimadadhiṣṭhānāyogavyavacchedam aṅgīkṛtya vivakṣItaviśeṣāntarāpekṣayā tau dūṣaṇam udbhāvayataś citrakāntiśikhānumānoccheda eva prasañjayitum āñjasaḥ nānumānocchedaḥ | tato 'numānaviśeṣāpekṣayā naikaniyataṃ prāmāṇyaprāmāṇyaṃ veti yuktaṃ na sāmānyena |
[269] nanu cādyāpi bhedo 'nvayam anapekṣyaiva siddha iti bhedāntare kaḥ pratirodhaḥ? na vai niranvayā kāpi siddhir asti | sāmānyānvaya eva tu taṃ viśeṣam anākṛṣya nāvasthātuṃ śaktaḥ | na caivaṃ viśeṣāntare 'pi tasyāvaśyaṃ śaktir iti śakyam, yathopavarṇitaṃ prāk, anyathā pañcavarṇaśikhādyanumānasya durnivāratvāt | atrāsambhavādikṣepaṇam ekacittatvādimati puruṣe 'pi samānam | tādṛg anumānodgāras tatrāpi samānaḥ | tasmād atirekaviśeṣaśaṃsināvaśyam anenānvayaḥ pradarśanīya iti tadabhāvād anekānta eva | buddhimanmātrasādhane ca siddhasādhanam iti sthitam ||
syād etat | buddhimān iti na caitanyamātravān, api tūpādānādyabhijñaḥ prayatnavān vābhimataḥ, tena cānvayo ghaṭādikārye siddha iti bhūdharādāv api kāryatvam upalabhyamānaṃ tādṛśam eva kartāram upasthāpayatīti nobhayadoṣaḥ (noktobhayadoṣaḥ) | tathā hi tadupādānādyabhijña ity eva sarvajñaḥ, deśakālaniyataś ca, na tadbheda upādīyamānakāryagrāmanirvartanasamarthaḥ syāt iti nityatvavibhūtvādayo 'pi taddharmāḥ siddhā iti cet? seyaṃ chinnamūlaviṭapasya phalabhogapratyāśā | ekatve hi siddhe siddhir eṣāṃ guṇānām, anyathā bhinnadeśakālasya kāryasyānekakṛtau sambhāvyamānāyāṃ kasya vaibhavādayaḥ, svasvavyāpāraviṣayamātravedanāc ca kasya sārvajñam iti?
ekatve siddhe sādhyam aśeṣam ākṛṣyeta, na ca tanniścaye kiñcin nibandhanam asti | na ca kṣityādinirmāṇasamarthaḥ siddha ity ekavacanaprayogapatanāt tatsiddhiḥ, pratibandhābhāvāt | pratibandhe vā siddhaikatvaḥ paraḥ katham enam upekṣeta? Jātyapekṣayā tu syād apīti na nirbandhaḥ, aparāparadhūmapramitasyeva vahneḥ | na ca vicitre 'pi citrakarmaṇi sajātīyarekhādyanugamād ekakartṛsiddhivat kāryabhedeṣu guṇaviśeṣānugamāt tadekatvasiddhiḥ tathāvidhasya kasyacid anugatasyaivānupalabdheḥ | upālabhyamānaṃ ca kāryatvavastutvādi naikatvasādhanaṃ citravad eva | guṇāntarasambhave 'pi hi sadṛśa eko vā karteti sandeha eva kiṃ punas tadabhāve 'py ekaniścayaḥ? niyatam idam abhitticitrakarmaiva, yad abhedāniścaye sarvajñatvādi vyavasīyata iti |
itarastv āha ekatvam api kāryotpattyaivāvagantavyam | katham? bahūnāṃ vyāhatamanasāṃ svātantryeṇa parasparavirodhena mithaḥ svānukūlābhiprāyānavabodhena yugapat kāryānupattiḥ (kāryānutpattiḥ), utpannasya vilopanādiprasaṅgaś ca syād iti |
[270] atra cintyate bahubhiḥ karaṇe yugapat kāryānutpattir iti bhinnakālānāṃ bhinnadeśānāṃ kāryānutpattir vivakṣitā, ekasyaiva vā mahāvayavinaḥ kṣitidharādirūpasyeti pakṣaḥ | tatra naikatrāpy anekena karaṇe utpattivirodhaṃ paśyāmaḥ | yathā hy ekasya pravṛttis tathānyeṣām api syād valmīkavat | kiṃ prayojanam abhisandhāya teṣāṃ pravṛttir iti cet, na, vicitravṛttitvān manasāṃ pravṛttinibandhasya viśeṣaniścāyanāśakteḥ | anyatheśvarasyaiva kim abhipretyeti cintānirbandho nirboḍhuṃ na śakyaḥ | śakyo vā anyeṣām abhipretādibādhyatāvadhāraṇapaṭīyasām, na mṛdupakṛter īśvarasya |
nāpi bahūnāṃ parasparavyāhatiniyama upapādayituṃ śakyaḥ, valmīkaukasāmekārambhadarśanāt | puruṣāṇām ahamahamikayā sambhāvyata eva tad iti cet? sadvivekino hy ekakāryārambhiṇaḥ santy apīti tathāvidhair aparair apy atipracuratarair ekasya krameṇa sthavīyasaḥ karaṇe sambhavini ko 'smākaṃ nareṣv anurodhaḥ? nāpi yugandharāder yugapanniṣpattiḥ kenacid upalabdhā, yata ekasyaiva kasyacicchaktiḥ sambhāvyate | na cāhamahamikayā puruṣeṣv api vyāghātaniyamaḥ śakyanirvāhaḥ, parasparāvyāghātena puruṣasya virodhadvayasyānupapatteḥ | tasmāt sambhāvanāmātram etat, na pramāṇavartma ity upanyāsam arhati, nānekenaikamainākādeḥ karaṇam iti samayamātrānusmṛtir vā |
nanv ekatrāpi pradhānabhūtenaikena bhāvyaṃ balīyasā sūtradhāravat, senānīvad vā atastasyaiva kartṛtvam itareṣāṃ tadanuvartitvād iti cet, na, tatrāpi niyamābhāvāt, svasvaprayojanānurodhena svatantrāṇām api keṣāñcid ekasetvādighaṭanādarśanāt | tatrāpi kaścid eva pradhānaḥ prayojaka ity api nāsti, anekasya tathā hṛdayotkalikāyā nivārakābhāvāt, apradhānasyāpi vā prayojakatvasambhavāt | na tāvataiva prādhānyaṃ lokavirodhāt | kiṃ ca sūtradhārasthānīyāparimitaikaikajanasanāthaiḥ sārthair aparimitair eva khaṇḍaśaḥ sthūlārambhasambhave 'pi kā nāma kām asiddhiḥ? etena valmīkajantuṣu mukhyopanyāsaḥ pratyuktaḥ |
api ca yathaikahṛdayānuvartibhir anekair abhinirmīyamānasya prāsādasya sukhopadhānāvayavasanniveśaviśeṣa upalabhyate, na tathā visaṃsthūlasthūlaśilājālakaliteṣu kulagiriṣv api, yena tathaivaikapradhānabhūtapuruṣapūrvakatvam eṣām api syāt | tasmād ekaikakailāsādisampādane bādhitum aśakyo 'nekavyāpāraḥ katham aparadūrāntarānekadeśakālakaliteṣu bhāveṣu bādhyaḥ?
 [271] āgamād ekatvasiddhis tarhi iti cet? so 'yaṃ sannipātāpannasya sarṣapai rakṣābandhavidhir abādhaka eva bauddhānadhikṛtyāgamavicāraikacaturacetasaḥ | yadi hi parīkṣāgamagrahaḥ tadāyam eva parīkṣākāla iti kas tadanurodho 'dhunaiva? atha parīkṣānapekṣaḥ, tadāpi tata evābhimatasamastavastusiddhir astu, kim anumānopanyāsavyasanena prayāsaikasāreṇa? kaṣṭo hi hetuśodhanavyavasāyaḥ sūkṣmaprativedhavidhurabuddhīnām, sukaras tu śāstraikadeśapāṭhenābhimatalābhaḥ |
yad apy (apyayam) eva vādī prāmāṇyam āgamānāṃ samarthayan na hy apramāṇatve samastāśramiṇām saṃvādo nāma, tasyāpramāṇatve kasyacid aprāmāṇyabodhena visaṃvādasyāpi sambhāvyatvāt, saṃvādaniyamasya ca pramāṇeṣv eva pratyakṣādiṣūpapatter iti nāpramāṇāni ṛgyajuḥsāmāni, samastāśramiṇām saṃvādijñānasādhanatvāt pratyakṣādivad ity ādi pañcālakaṃ paṭhati, tad api śiṣyasamitāv evoyujyate (evopayujyate) | tathā hi saṃvādo nāma pramāṇāntarasaṅgatir arthakriyā vā syāt, na ca tadubhayam api,

 sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ (Ṛgveda X 10,1)
 sa veti viśvaṃ na ca tasya vettā (Śvetā Up  3,19)
 dyāvābhūmiṃ janayan deva eka ākṣīt (Saiva 3,3)

ity ādivākyārtheṣu svargasādhanāgniṣṭomādau vā kasyacit sambhavati | āśramiṇas tāvad yathaikasya eko vibhuḥ śāśvataḥ sraṣṭā jayato 'stīti matiḥ, tathānyasyāpi | tad anurūpānuṣṭhānaṃ ceti cet? sā punar eṣāṃ matis tadekāgamaprabhavā, tādṛg anyaprabhavā vā, ākasmikavikalpamātrarūpā vā syāt, na tu pratyakṣānumānarūpā, anāśramiṇām apy avakāśaprasaṅgāt, pratyakṣādeḥ puruṣāntaraiḥ anaparādhāt | āgamāśrayaṃ tu jñānam aśrutavato 'nādṛtavato na syāt, bhavāntarābhyāsavāsanāvaśād vā sambhavet nānyasyeti yuktam | tatredaṃ svatantratayā na pramāṇam, saty asati vā vastuni sambhavinaḥ abhyāsāt prasūteḥ | tadāgamaprabhavatvena pramānāntarasaṅgatir uktā bhavati, tādṛkprabhavatvāt, tasyāpy aprāmāṇyāt | tad asiddhaṃ yad asiddhena sādhyata iti nyāyaḥ | tasmāt
[272] tādṛksamayānusmaraṇamātram etad evambhūtaḥ kaścid astīti | kiṃ ca, āśrama ity api darśanamātraṃ vidmaḥ, tataś ca samastāśramiṇām iti viśeṣaṇāsiddhiḥ, bauddhadigambarādeḥ saṃvādāsiddheḥ | katipayasaṃvādaś ca viparītamate 'py astīti nopanyāsaḥ saphalaḥ | ata eva visaṃvādasyātyantanivṛttir asiddhā, yataḥ prāmāṇyam avatiṣṭheta | abhimatam āśramiṇām tv anādikālapravṛttasamānasaṃmohasāmarthyād api syād iti yat kiñcid etat |
 tasmād ekatrāpi mandarādāv aparimitapuruṣavyāpāraviṣayabhāgopādanādivedināṃ prayatnavatāṃ katamaḥ sarvavedī? bhinnadeśakālaiś ca tādṛśāṃ karaṇe kuto nityavibhūtvādayaḥ? na cādṛṣṭabhāgajñānāvakāśaḥ, tad antareṇāpi kumbhakāreṇa svavyāpāraviṣayasya niṣpādanopalabdheḥ | na ca bahubhir utpāditasyāvaśyaṃ vilopanādiprasaṅge saṅgatiḥ kācid iti ekatvāpāye 'numṛtatvam anivāryaṃ sarvajñatvādīnām anumatam iti | evaṃ ca sati, etad apy anibandhanam eva, yad āha -
 teṣāṃ bahutve sarvajñatve sati sarvakartṛkatvāt taddeśakālapratiniyateṣu kāryeṣu pravṛttau yaugapadyapramāṇābhāvād iti sarvajñānakriyayor ekādhārāsiddheḥ | ata evaikanirākaraṇe bahutarādyapagamaprasaṅgo 'pi na bādhakaḥ | yadi hi sarvajñāḥ sarvakartāraś ca bahavaḥ siddheyur ekanirākaraṇam evānupayogi syāt, bahutaraprayāsaś cābhyupagato bhavati | yadā punar anekam ekaikajanakaṃ valmīkajantuvaj jantujātam āsajyate prakṛtaguṇāsaṃsparśi, tadā kā nāma hāniḥ? na hi tadā ta eva,

 svargāpavargārthibhir arthanīyāḥ bhaveyur

iti, etena yo 'pi manyate, bhavadīyasarvajñavadīśvaro 'py aneka eva bhaviṣyatīti, tad api anavakāśam, sarvakriyādhikaraṇasyaikasyāpy asiddheḥ | asmākaṃ tu na sarvakriyayā sarvabodhasiddhiḥ, kiṃ tv abhyāsāt | sa ca sakalasākṣātkartavyākāravikalpasambhavāt sambhavānumānam anvetīti tādṛksārvajñyasiddhir yathaikasya tathānyasyāpi syād iṣyate vā ity adoṣaḥ |
 abhyāsād eva tarhi sarvanirmāṇam api bhaviṣyatīti cet, na, aśakyatvāt | tathā hi, sthāvarajīvajananaṃ jaṅgam āpattir vā nābhyāsaphalam | pariśiṣṭapratikṛtinirmāṇakalpanāyām api kaścid evam api syād iti syāt | na tu idam eva paridṛśyamānaṃ bhavatu vanādikaṃ na tatheti niścayaḥ, viśeṣoddeśena sambhavānumānasyāpravṛtteḥ | tatrāpi durlabhabāhyopakaraṇasambhavātiśayaparādhīno
[273] na cittamātraparāvṛttivat sukaras tadabhyāsa iti adhyavasāyaḥ | prabhāvātiśayasahāyāpekṣāyāṃ kiṃ śilpena? na tad antareṇa tasya śaktir iti apramāṇakam, tathaivānyatra darśanād iti cet, na, dṛṣṭakrameṇa garbhasthaśarīrādinirmāṇaprāpteḥ | tad avaśyaṃ prabhāvetaraḥ | na ca tādṛkprabhāvādhigataye mārgasya kāscin niścayaḥ | astu vā vyāptiśilpasiddhir ādiśabdasaṃgrāhyaś cābhyāsaḥ | tathāpy āha, sanniveśādiṣu hetuṣu iṣṭasyākartṛtvasya siddhir asiddhir vā, asiddhir eva, upayogābhāvāt |
 na hi narakādinā tāvat kaścid upayogaḥ saṃvittyānuṣṭhātuḥ sukhopakaraṇamātrasṛṣṭāv api nārthaḥ | śrameṇa svaśreyasaḥ sambhave hi tāny anyathā bhavanti, bhūtāni vā sukham ādhāsyanti | yadi paraṃ tanmārgam aviduṣām tadupadeśa evānugrahakaraḥ, atas tadarthaṃ mārgasākṣātkaraṇābhyāsa eva śreyān iti vaiyarthyānadhyavasāyābhyāṃ nābhyāsaḥ | tarhi pratiparamāṇu jñānābhyāse 'pi kathaṃ tadvad vā sarvakaraṇe 'pi na kṣatir ity āha sarvasarvavidi,

 dṛṣṭānte saṃśayo 'thavā

iti, upayuktasarvajñapakṣasya mukhyatayā vakṣyamāṇatvāt | athavā vaiyarthyānadhyavasāyayos tatra saṃśayo nābhāvaniścaya ity arthaḥ | uddeśaś cānyatropadarśanam iti na pareṇa saha sāmyam | tataḥ prakṛtahetubhyaḥ prayatnavatāṃ siddhāv api na kṣatir iti |
 nanu prayatnavatā jantujātena janitā gandhamādanādaya iti bhavatām aniṣṭam eva, tataḥ prakārāntarābhāvenānekato nivartamānaḥ prayatnavān eka eva sakalakāryakartā sidhyan sarvajñatvādikam api pratyujjīvayatīti cet? naitad asti, vastupratibandhānupapatter icchāyāḥ, tatkṛtāyā anekato nivṛtter asādhanatvāt | yadi ca kathañcid asau na svīkurute, svīkārayituṃ tarhi caraṇam adarśanādinārādhanīyaḥ prativādīti,

 nāyaṃ nyāyaḥ svatantrasya prasaṅgo 'pi na saṅgataḥ |
 prasahyaikyam apāye 'sya na hy anekatvam īhitam ||
 viparyayaparyavasāyivyāpāratvāt tasyeti |

nanūbhayathāpi tāvat parasyāniṣṭam eva, na hi sattvalokaḥ sakalo 'pi prayatnadvāreṇa kāraṇam iṣyate, api tu cetanālakṣaṇakarmādhipatyamātreṇa, tataḥ prayatnavannāntarīyakaṃ
[274] kāryatvam ekam anekaṃ vā prayatnavantam antike dadhānaṃ sādhanam aniṣṭasyaiveti cet? tat kim idānīṃ parāniṣṭamātrasiddhaye sādhanam upanyastam, kiṃ nu svasādhyasiddhaye? tatra ca pareṣṭasiddhir asiddhir vātmana iti na kiñcit sādhanopanyāsaphalam iti vaktum āha,

sthityāpravṛttyādiṣu, iṣṭasiddhir asiddhir vā

iti | samānam idam ubhayasādhanāṅgavacanatvanibandhanamān arthakyād iti bhāvaḥ | na ca para eva sādhanavādī, yato 'sya dvidhāniṣṭam āpādyamānaṃ śobheta | aniṣṭam apy asya prakaraṇāpannaṃ nityaikasarvajñatve tattvam eva viśvasyāpādayitum ārabdhaṃ na yat kiñcid iti | evaṃ tarhi sādhanopanyāse 'pi kim asiddhinibandhanam iti vaktavyam | yat punar uktam,

viśeṣe 'nugamābhāvaḥ

iti, tatra yadyapi sarvagasarvajñatvādibhir anvaye 'siddhisaṃśayau yathāyogam, tathāpy ekatvena mā bhūtām, tad ekapratyatnavat kartṛsiddhau siddham aśeṣaṃ sādhyam | dṛṣṭaś ca kulāla eko 'nekaghaṭapiṭharādikāraka ity āśaṅkya ekatve 'py anvayam āpādayann āha,

dṛṣṭānte

iti | asiddhir iti vartate | ayam abhiprāyaḥ | na prakṛtam eva ghaṭapiṭharādikāryam ekena kṛtam iti sarvasya tathābhāvaḥ | tatrānekakulāladivyāpāraḥ sphuṭam avadhāryate | tat kuta ekena yatnavatā dṛṣ ṭakāryāṇām anvaya iti? athavā kulālo nāmaikaḥ kaścid asti bhūtabhautikasaṃvittirāśir ayaṃ kumbhakārādiprajñaptiviṣayaḥ, karacaraṇasamudāyo veti | vastutaḥ kenaikena karaṇaṃ kumbhāder upalambhagocara ity arthaḥ |
atha kim anena nirbandhena? yādṛśa eva kaścid ekavyahāragocaro dṛṣṭaḥ, tādṛśaḥ saṃhatasvabhāva evaikaḥ kartā sarvasyopādānādyabhijñaḥ sidhyan sarvajña eva sidhyati | tato guṇāntaratiraskāre 'pi tāvataivopādeyatvam ubhayapuruṣārthaśaṃtitir asyopapadyata iti na kācit kṣatir iti, atrāpi pakṣe tenaiva sarve 'mī kāryatvādihetavo vyabhicāriṇa iti vyaktam anaikāntikatvam abhipretyāha,
 [275] iti | sādhyasyeti śeṣaḥ | kulālavat saṃghātamātratayā kāryatvasanniveśādibhāve 'pi prayatnavatkartṛpūrvakatvasyābhāvāt, etad abhāve 'pi vā tasya bhāvāt | tatrāpy anyatkārakeṣṭau vā anavasthānād apratipattiḥ |
 nanu cācetanasvabhāvaḥ svayam utpattau paraṃ cotpādayituṃ prayatnavantam apekṣate | sa tu svayam eva tathāvidhabuddhyādhāra iti kim apareṇa? na hi jaḍā ghaṭādayaḥ prakāśam apekṣanta iti prakāśenāpy aparaḥ pradāśo 'pekṣitavya ity asti niyamaḥ | tataḥ keyam anavastheti?
 evaṃ tarhi kulālasaṃjñita eva prayatnavān buddhīndriyādikalāpaḥ katham aparam apekṣate? tasmāc cetano 'cetano vā kalāpaḥ svabhāvenaivāparacetanam apekṣya jāyate janayati vety upagantavyam ity anavasthaiva | atha cetanavargaś cetanāntaranirapekṣa eveṣyate, tadā ghaṭādivartinaḥ kāryatvādayo 'bhimatakārakādhiṣṭhāyakaviparītanāntarīyakāḥ sidhyanto na virodhadūṣaṇaparihāreṇa sthitim anubhaveyuḥ | tathāvidhādhiṣṭhānasvīkāre tu svabhāvaviprakarṣād anupalabdhāv api tadvyāpārasambhāvanāyāṃ na tadviparītadṛṣṭaikanāntarīyakatvam eṣām iti viparyayavyāpter abhāvād abhāvo viruddhavyavahārasya syāt | tadāpi yadi kāryakāraṇavyavasthānāya vyatirekacintācaturaḥ kaścin na pratyavasthānam ādriyate, na cedānīṃ tadārabdham ity āstāṃ tāvat,
 tat kim anena nirbandhena? nirbandhe vā virodhyadhyakṣasthūladoṣāvatāraprasaṅgāt tathāpy asiddhir veti viparītasiddhir yojayiṣyate iti sāntargarvo gajanimīlitenaiva vā 'vadhīrya yathaivānena sarvakāryotpattau nimittakāraṇam īśvaro gṛhītaḥ, tathainaṃ sambhāvya cetanasyāpi cetanāntarāpekṣāyām anavasthānabhīros tenaivāvyabhicārānāśritya saṃśayam āha, atha prayatnavān api kulālo na svaśarīre kiṃ tu kumbhādau, tataḥ svaśarīrasiddhaye kiṃ na param apekṣeta? tarhīśvarābhimato 'pi prakaraṇaprayatnavān na svaśarīra eva, svātmani kāritravirodhād iti kiṃ na param apekṣeta? na cāpekṣate | tato yadarthakāri kāryādi vā tatpratiyatnavad adhiṣṭhitam iti tattenaiva vyabhicārīti saṃśayasiddhiḥ |
 nanu tasya śarīram eva nāstīti kuto 'nekānta eṣaḥ? tad etat prakaraṇavismaraṇaphalam | tathā hy anvayopadarśanasamīhayā kulāle sāṃvṛtam ekatvam aṅgīkṛtya tādṛksāṃvṛtaikapuruṣanirmeyatvaṃ jagato bhavataiva svīkṛtam ity ayam asmākam avakāśaḥ | yadi tu vāstavam eva
[276] ekatvaṃ śarīrasahacāraviruddham anurudhyate, na tarhi sāṃvṛtam ekatvam upanetavyaṃ dṛṣṭānte vyāpakatvena kāryādeḥ | nāpi nāmamātrapareṇa tena vyāptā tattvatas tathāsiddhipratyāśā phalavatī | na khalu dahanopacaritamāṇavakapratibaddhavacanaviśeṣādikāryam upalabhya pāramārthikaṃ kaścid dahanam anumīyate |
 askhalantī ekapratītiḥ puruṣāvayavinīti cet? kaḥ punar iha sākṣād upacāratvam āha? atasmiṃs tadvyavahāras tu dvayoḥ samāna ity ucyate | śarīratve 'vayavibādhakāt ekādyavasāyasya bhramatvam avasātavyam, sattve 'pi vāvayavinaḥ śarīrāvayavī karādyavayavā buddhir ity eṣa kalāpa ekaśabdābhidheyaḥ, bhūtādikalāpo vety apāramārthikatvaṃ siddham adhiṣṭhātuḥ |
 syād etat | puruṣa eva tatrādhiṣṭhātā, kartā vā, sa ca śarīrādibhyo labdhavyatireka eka eveti cet?
 saṃdṛṣṭakāraṇakalāpakṛte 'pi kāryajanmany adṛṣṭam aparaṃ parikalpyate yat | tatrāpi dṛṣṭam avadhūya tad eva tac ca nānekanavadhir (nānekamityanavadhir) vividho vimohaḥ ||
adṛṣṭasya tāvad bhāva eva duravadhāraḥ sahajavaiṣamyād atrānumānasyety uktam | tasyāpi dṛṣṭānupalambhasacivapratyakṣasādhyaḥ kāraṇabhāvaḥ | sa ca dṛṣṭavyavacchedena tasyaiva | anyathā karacaraṇāder api vyāpārasambhave tasyāpy anumānaprasaṅge punaḥ sa eva vyabhicāraḥ | anyathā puruṣasyāpy anumānam anibandhanaṃ syāt | etena caitanyasantānasyaikapuruṣatvaparikalpanaṃ pratyuktam, asyāpi karacaraṇādisahakṛtasyaiva śaktipratīteḥ, kāryāt tattvata evānumānaprasaṅgo dhūmād iva sendhanaśikhinaḥ |
 caitanyamātreṇa vyāptir gṛhyate nāpareṇāpīti cet, na, samānanyāyatayā vibhāgasya kartum aśakyatvād iti | tad ayaṃ buddhiśarīrāvyatirekiṇaḥ kāraṇatām anyayogavyavacchedenaiva vaktum arhati, yatas tanmātram anumātum pratibandhena śaknuyāt, pāramārthikaikatvena ca vyāptiṃ grahītum | tathā ca sati dṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭānvayavyatirekaṃ kārakasamudāyam apahāyānyad eva kāraṇaṃ kalpitam ity ayam aparo dhikkāraḥ | tad api yadi kathañcid anekaṃ syād viphalaḥ sakalo
 [277] yatna ity ekam eva parikalpanīyam ity ākāśakamalaparimalākṛṣṭamadukarakolāhalaprāyam idam akhilamākalyāmaḥ |
 tad alaṃ dehādivyatiriktopakṣepeṇa | tasmāt prayatnavataḥ kartur ekatvena vyāptir na mukhyā, kartṛvācyasya kulālādes tattvata ekatvānupapatteḥ | sāṃvṛtāśraye ca tādṛśasyaivānumānaprasaṅgena tenaiva vyabhicāraḥ kāryatvāder iti saṃśayaḥ sādhyasyety uktam |
 nanu tathāpi tādṛśaḥ sādhyasyāsiddhau kena vyabhicāraḥ, siddhau ca vyabhicāraḥ kiṃ kariṣyati? vyabhicārād asiddhir eveti cetasiddhau tarhi vyabhicāro 'pi nāstīti kuto 'siddhir iti siddhir iti vā vyavatiṣṭhate? kāryatvādeś ca vastudharmasya vastusann eva dharmī bhavitum arhatīti na codyam, abhyupagamavirodhasyānena krameṇa pratipādayitum ārabdhatvāt tattvataḥ | asti cāsau sādhyasya sādhanatrairūpyeṇa trirūpasādhanasya ca yathābhimatasādhyena, tatra sādhyasattve vipakṣavyatirekasyāsattvāt, svābhyupagamasiddhatayā pramāṇasiddham iti sādhāraṇānaikāntikam ucyate,

 tatrābhyupāyaḥ kāryāṅgam

iti vacanāt | parābhyupagamaḥ khalu na pramāṇam iti yuktam, tadbādhanāyaiva pravṛtteḥ | ata eva na svatantrahetāvasyāśrayaḥ | prasaṅgasya ca viparyaya eva phalam | svopagamasya tv apramāṇatve vacanoccāraṇam eva na syāt | svadṛṣṭārthaprakāśanaṃ ca vacanaṃ parārthānumānāt | na caivaṃ svadṛṣṭarūpatrayaprakāśanam anena kṛtaṃ bhavatīti tadvādino 'sādhanāṅgavacanaṃ nigrahasthānam ucitam | parasya tu doṣodbhāvanam eveti sthitam | athavā anvayaghaṭanārtham evaikena karaṇam upanītam āśaṅkyāha,

 dṛṣṭānte saṃśayo 'thavā (PV II 12)

iti | dṛṣṭānte 'siddhir eva tāvad ekena karaṇasya | siddhāv api vā sandeha eva kasya, yadartham upanīyate dṛṣṭāntaḥ? sarvopasaṃhāravatyā vyāpter iti yāvat | tathā hi na dṛṣṭānte dṛṣṭam ity eva yasya kasyacid vastuno vyāpyavyāpakabhāvapratītiḥ, atiprasaṅgāt, api tu pratibandhasiddheḥ | na ceha kiñcin nibandhanam astīti sādhyadharmiṇi sidhyanto 'pi kartṛtvādayo naikatvaniyatam ātmānam ātanvantīti viparyaye bādhakapramāṇābhāvāt
[278] prayatnavat kartṛniyatā 'pi kāryatvādaya ekakartṛkatve sādhye sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatayā saṃśayahetava eveti | tathā ca śaṃkara evāha, na kartur ekatvenācetanopādānatvasyāvyabhicāra ity ādi | yat punar āha, na caivam acetanopādānatvasya prayatnavad adhiṣṭhānamātreṇa vyabhicāra iti, na tanmātreṇa prastute kaścid upayogaḥ | vivādādhāradharmasiddhes tatsiddhau pratibaddhatvasya pūrvaṃ pratipādanād iti |

  || prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ||
dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ

[279] tad evaṃ sādhyaveśeṣapekṣayā vyāptidūṣanam abhidhāya prayatnavanmātre 'py abhidhātuṃ vitarkayann āha,

 sthitvā pravṛttisaṃsthānaviśeṣārthakriyādiṣu |
 iṣṭasiddhir asiddhir vā dṛṣṭānte saṃśayo 'thavā || PV 2.10

iti | dṛṣṭo 'nto dṛṣṭāntaḥ siddhānta iti yo 'rthaḥ, prayatnavanmātreṇa vyāpteḥ siddhatvāt, ekānekarūpānatikramāc ca vastunaḥ | sthitvāpravṛttyādiṣūpanyasteṣu vādina iṣṭadsiddhiḥ kim astu ekatvapakṣe, asiddhimātraṃ vānekatve, atha vyāptir eva nāstīti siddhānte saṃśaya eva ubhayatrāpīti praśnārthaḥ |
 atra cānantaram abhedasādhanādhikāreṇa sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvād bhāvanena dattam evottaram | atas tṛtīya eva pakṣaḥ | na hi prayatnopayogam antareṇāpi kāryajanmani sambhāvyamāne bādhakaṃ kiñcid ālocayāmaḥ | tat kutas tatra niyamaḥ kāryādeḥ? atha kāladeśādyaniyamaprasaṅgo bādhakaḥ `tad ayuktam, yataḥ pratiniyataśakter asarvakālabhāvinaḥ svakāraṇāyattasannidheḥ kāraṇadaśāviśeṣasya vyatireke 'pi vyatirekaḥ kāryasya sambhavan na prayatnavannāntarīyakatvam upakalpayituṃ kalpate | sarvathā hetvanapekṣāyāṃ tadbādhakam upapadyamānaṃ kāryasya hetumātreṇa vyāptiṃ sādhayet | na tu hetuviśeṣeṇa prayatnavatā |
 nanu kāraṇaṃ nāma sarvatra kalāpa eva, sa ca na vyagrāvasthāyām | tatsaṃhatiś ca prayatnavantam antareṇa yadi syāt, nityam eva syāt | evaṃ deśe 'pi vācyam | tataś ca sa eva deśakālaniyamaprasaṅga iti, caitanyanirapekṣatvena kalāpakāryatvasya vyāpakasyābhāvena kāryatvādayo 'sambhavantaḥ prayatnavad apekṣatvena vyāpyanta iti cet? evaṃ tarhi so 'pi prayatnavān yadi kṣaṇikaḥ prādeśikaś ca tatkṣaṇaikadeśatvam eva sarvakāryagrāmasya syād iti sanātana evāṅgīkartavyo vyāpī ca | tataś ca sa eva deśakālāniyamo 'dyāpi prasakta iti kim asyopagamena? atha so 'dṛṣṭam apekṣya janayan niyataṃ janayet? jaḍānāṃ tu nādṛṣṭaṃ locanam iti |
 evaṃ tarhi tadadṛṣṭaparipākasahāyā eva pratyayā niyatam utpādayiṣyanti nirālocā apīti kiṃ caitanyeneti cet? evaṃ bruvataḥ kulālāder api vaiyarthyaprasaṅgaḥ, na hi tatrāpi nādṛṣṭam asti sahakāri | na caivam | tasmād viparyayaḥ | yā yā sāmagrī sā nādṛṣṭāpekṣayā puruṣaprayatnaṃ viphalayati | yathā sūtrapiṇḍadaṇḍacakrādiḥ | sāmagrī ca

[280] girisāgarādijaniket viruddhavyāptopalabdhiḥ | prayatnaviphalīkaraṇaṃ hi tadanapekṣatvam ambarādau siddhaṃ niṣedhyam | tena yad viruddhaṃ prayatnāpekṣatvaṃ tadvyāptaṃ sāmagrītvam, tasyā yatnakāryatvāt |
 atrocyate | yadi prayatnakāryaṃ sāmagrī sarvopasaṃhāreṇa sidhyed, yuktam etat | na caivam, na hi tatrāpi viparyaye bādhakaṃ kiñcid asti | yathā hi kāryaṃ svakāraṇāyattasannidheḥ kāraṇāvasthāviśeṣasyāpekṣayā asarvakālabhāvi sambhāvyate, tathā sāmagry api kiṃ na syāt, yato nityaṃ bhāvaprasaṅgaś codyeta? tataś cānivartitavipakṣavṛttiśaṅkā sāmagrī yadi prayatnāpekṣāṃ niyacchet [? ], sākṣātkāryatvādibhir eva kīdṛśo 'parādhaḥ kṛtaḥ, yena tadupanyāse saṃśayitasya sāmagrī śaraṇam upakṣipyate?
 mṛdādayaḥ puruṣād eva milanto dṛṣṭā iti cet? kāryam api prayatnavata eva jāyamānam upalabdham iti kiṃ nocyate? yathā ca yady api kim api kāryaṃ prayatnavato dṛṣṭam, tathāpi kāryāntaraṃ tiraskṛtyāpi buddhimantaṃ bhaviṣyatīti śaṅkā, tathā sāmagry api sambhāvyamānā kam arthaṃ puṣṇāti? tato 'nuktasamam etat | tasmāt sāmagrīm api madhye prakṣipya kumbhādiṣu sāmagryās tathā darśanam eva pramāṇayitavyam | tathā ca sati kāryam eva pratyakṣānupalambhaiḥ prayatnavannāntarīyakaṃ siddham ity eva sādhu | kim atra vyāptisiddhaye bādhakapramāṇopanyāsaśaiṭīryeṇa? atha vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa pratyakṣānupalambhā jātiviśeṣam eva viṣayīkartuṃ śaknuyur iti na kāryamātraṃ prayatnavatā vyāptaṃ sidhyet? tad arthaṃ viparyayabādhāśrayaṇam, evaṃ tarhi sāmagryā api prayatnavatkāryatve ta eva pratyakṣānupalambhāḥ śaraṇam iti evaṃvidhā saṃhatiḥ prayatnavatā kriyata iti yuktaḥ sarvopasaṃhāraḥ | tathā ca,

 na vyagrād udayaḥ kvacin na ca cayaś caitanyaśūnyād bhaved
 bhāve kiṃ na sadā sadātanatanor apy eṣa doṣaḥ samaḥ |
 tasyādṛṣṭam apekṣya kālaniyame kiṃ cetasā cet tadā
 kumbhādāv api śilpino viphalatā naitac ca tadvyatyayaḥ ||
 kumbhādau yadi darśanād abhividhiḥ kiṃ vyatyaye bādhayā
 pratyakṣānupalambhataḥ kimu matā na vyāptir evaṃ sati |
 teṣāṃ jātiviśeṣa eva viṣayo yady evam evaṃvidho
 vyūhaś cetanato bhaved iti bhaved anyatra ko niścayaḥ ||

iti saṃgrahaślokau ||
 [281] na ca sāmagryantarasyātatpūrvakatve asyā api mā bhūd iti yuktam, asarvaṃ vyāpinām api dharmāṇāṃ pradeśavṛtter darśanāt lohalekhanasyeva pārthive, asiddhaśarīrapūrvakatvasyeva vā kārye | tatra bādhakān na sarvavyāpitvam iti cet? tatasphuraṇe tarhi saṃśayaḥ kena nivāryate | yathā hi na parasya bādhakaṃ kalāpāntare 'pi kāryāntarādau vā cetanāpekṣāyāḥ, tathā bhavato 'pi sarvajātau tayāvaśyaṃ bhāvyaṃ iti na sādhakam asti | yathā ca tava kvacid buddhimadapekṣādarśanam asti, tathā parasyāpy ekatra dṛṣṭasya dharmasya bhinnajātīyavyāptidarśanam asti | tato lohalekhanasya śarīravyāpārasya ca kvacid bādhakāradśanaṃ sandehasādhanam upayuktam eva parasya, anyathā saṃśayasyaiva nirbījatāprasakteḥ |
na ca sādhāraṇānaikāntaḥ prārabdho 'dhunābhidhātum, yatas tadvad atra bādhakānupadarśanaṃ bādhakaṃ syāt prativadituḥ, api tu sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvam eva | tac ca siddhaṃ, dṛṣṭānte dṛṣṭimātreṇa vyāpter asiddheḥ, nibandhanānantarasyābhāvāt | etena kṣityādihetūnāṃ acetanatve sati niyatapravṛtttitvena prāsādādihetuvat prayatnavad adhiṣṭhānāsiddhir ity api pratyuktam | acetaso 'pi kālādiniyatāyāḥ pravṛtteḥ prayatnavannāntarīyakatvasādhakapramāṇasya tadvad evābhāvād iti |
nāpi kāryāvirāmaprasaṅgaḥ saṅgatim āvahati, aparāparapratyayayogajanyasvabhāvabhedasambhavena bhāveṣv ekaśaktinirvāhasya dūrīkṛtatvāt | tataś ca kartur ekatve sandehodbhāvanena samānanyāyatayā āgatam eva buddhipratibandhaṃ paraparitoṣāya sādhāraṇānaikāntikatvena dūṣayitum āha,

 sthitvāpravṛttisaṃsthānaviśeṣārthakriyādiṣu |
 iṣṭasiddhir asiddhir vā dṛṣṭānte  PV 2.10abcd'

iti. vāśabdaḥ samuccaye. eṣu satsu yad iṣṭaṃ caitanyam, tasya dṛṣṭānte sādhanavati dharmiṇi siddhir asiddhiś ca ghaṭādau viṭapādau ca yathākramam. tato vyaktaṃ vipakṣaikadeśe vṛttir eṣām iti bhāvaḥ. etena yadi kṛtakādivad viparyayabādhābhidhānam aśakyam, dhūmādivat pratyakṣānupalambhābhyām anvayavyatirekapratītiḥ prayatnena saha kāryādīnāṃ bhaviṣyatīti gatyantaram apāstam, tamantareṇāpi kāryasyodayād vyatirekasyaivābhāvād ity uktam |
nanu buddhimattvaṃ nāma dṛśyādṛśyaśarīretarasādhāraṇo dharmaḥ kṣmāruhādijanmani vyāpriyamāṇaṃ nāstīti katham avagantavyam, anupalabdhimātrād abhāvasiddheḥ? yuktam etat,
[282] yadi dṛśyaśarīropādhividhureṇa buddhimātreṇa vyāptir abhimatā syāt | vāḍham eveti cet? evaṃ tarhi dhūmavad vyatirekam evādhikṛtyāha,

 saṃśayo 'thavā

iti | yadā kumbhakāravyāpārāt prāk kalasasya vyatirekaḥ pratyetavyaḥ, tadā na sādhyābhāva (sādhyābhāvakṛto ghaṭa) vyatirekaḥ pratītaḥ syāt, sādhyābhāvasya sandehāt | na hi tathāvidhaśarīropādhikena cetasā vyāptir jijñāsitā, yato 'nupalabdhiviśeṣeṇa niṣedhaḥ sidhyet, kiṃ tu prayatnavanmātreṇa | tasya ca yathā vṛkṣādijanmasamaye sambhāvanā niṣedhasyāśakyatvāt, tathādyāpīti, tatsambhave 'pi sambhāvyamānaḥ kumbhābhāvas tadabhāvaprayuktatvam ātmano bādhayituṃ na śaknotīti sandigdhavyatirekaḥ |
 nanu sādhyābhāve sādhanasya bhāvasaṃśaye sandigdho vyatirekaṃ iti yuktam, na tu kulālavyāpārāt prāk kumbhabhāvaḥ sandihyata iti cet? tad apy uktam, sādhyavyatirekaprayukto vyatirekaḥ sādhanasya vyāptivādinā darśayitavyaḥ | sa ca sādhyābhāvasandehād vā svayam ato 'pi na darśitaḥ | sādhyābhāve 'pi vā svabhāvasandehād iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ, ubhayathāpi tasya saviśeṣaṇasya sandigdhatvād iti | ata eva sandigdhasādhyasādhanadharmitvaṃ dṛṣṭāntayor doṣa ucyate |
 yadi tu sādhanābhāvamātram abhidhīyeta sādhyābhāvam anapekṣya, tadā yuktam etat | na ca tāvatā vyāptigrahaḥ | anyathā pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ vyāptiṃ pratipadya pavanopaghātasādhanopanīyamānaḥ kampo yadā mardanādisambhavena kampena sādhāraṇaṃ kriyate, tadā stimitamārutam asparśayogyatayā niṣeddhum aśakyaṃ sambhāvya pariharann anivāryaḥ syāt |
 tatra viśeṣasādhanād vyabhicāra eveti cet? kutaḥ punar etadviśeṣas tena sādhyate iti? upahatiśabdastv aśarīravyāpāravat tadanurūpaviṣayo bhaviṣyati, pratyakṣānupalambhena vyāptivarṇanād iti cet? tad api bhavataḥ samānam, yathā cāsya tādṛgmarunmātrāpekṣayā adṛśyatvena vyabhicāraparihāre vyāptigrahaṇakāle 'dṛśyatvenaiva vyatirekāsiddhis tathā bhavato 'pi śarīravirahiṇi caitanyamātre | tato yadā tadabhāvasaṃśaye 'pi kāryābhāvamātreṇa vyāptigrahaṇābhimānas tathā aspṛśyaprabhañjanābhāvasaṃśaye 'pi kampābhāvaḥ siddha iti syād vyāptiḥ |
