[283] atha na kaścit dehavat eva dehavirahiṇāpi vyāptiṃ karoti, kiṃ tu caitanyamātreṇa, tac ca kāyavatkāle 'py asti viśeṣasambhave sāmānyasyāvaśyambhāvād iti tadapekṣayā vyāptigrahaḥ sāmānyaviṣaya evāvatiṣṭhate, vahnāv iva vahnyantarasvarūpānupraveśād iti | etad api samānaṃ samīrānumāne | na ca kaścit cetanāvān vepathumātreṇa mārutam anumimīte, sarvagatvādhyavasāye 'pi kampamātrasya sādhanasāmarthyāpratīteḥ | na hi rājyam iṣṭam iti tannāmakaraṇānantaram upajāyamānam api tadupāyavādinaṃ pramāṇīkaroti, sādhanam api vā kṛtakatvaṃ vastutaḥ asādhanāṅgo vyāpakatvenopanīyamānam anityatāsiddhau |
 tasmāt na koṣṭhaśuddhyā prameyatathābhāvena paritoṣaḥ, pramāṇaguṇas tu nirūpyate | na ca kampasya marunmātreṇa vyāptisiddhau kiñcid viparyaye bādhakam asti, pratyakṣānupalambhās tu svagocarībhāvayogyam eva svabhāvadeśakālaviprakṛṣṭam api tadā tv asannihite 'ntarbhāvayituṃ śaknuvantīty avaśyam eṣitavyam, nānyam | anyathā vyāptigrahaṇavad vyabhicāro 'pi tanniṣṭha eva prasajyeta | tato yathā viśeṣaviṣayānvayavyatirekau pratyakṣādyagocaracaitanyamarunmātraviṣayau vyavasthitau, tathāpi viśeṣaviṣayo vyabhicāro 'pi tanmātraviṣayaḥ kiṃ na vyavasthāpyate? na hi lābhe praveśaḥ, chede niḥsaraṇam iti labhyam |
 vahnis tu deśakālaviprakṛṣṭo 'pi tadātmā sannihita iva svabhāvaviprakṛṣṭapratyakṣādiyogyatayā tadanupraveśamāsādayatīti yuktam, yatas tadekādhyavasāyāt sarva eva dhūmavyāpakatayāvadhāryamāṇo na duṣyati, jāṭharaṃ tadayogyatayā tathā niścāyi | ata eva dhūmād abhimate śikhini pravṛttir asaṃśayānasya yujyate | itarathā pratyakṣāyogyenāpi vyāptiḥ āśrayabhujā gṛhyamāṇā dhūmasya tadyogyāyogyadahanasāmānyaviṣayaiva vyavatiṣṭhata iti tārṇādibheda ivābhimate 'pi rūpe sandihāno na tatsādhyārthakriyālābhaikāgrabuddhiḥ pravarteta | pratibandhavaikalyavad vā asati jāṭharatva ity āmṛṣataḥ pravṛttiḥ syāt | na caivam, tasmān na svarūpaviśeṣaniṣṭhaṃ pramāṇaṃ sāmānyena vyāptiṃ prapadyate |
 anityatvena tu kṛtakatvasya vyāptiṃ viparyayabādhakapramāṇam abhigacchad bhūtvābhavanamātreṇa viśeṣānavacchinnena pravṛttam iti sāmānyenaivādhigacchati | nāpi kṛtakāt pravartamāno 'bhimatānityaikāgrabuddhiḥ kaścit pravṛttim arhati | ataś ca sāmānyaparyavasitam api pramāṇaṃ na viśeṣeṇa vyāptiṃ ghṇātīti siddham | uktaṃ ca nyāyānusāriṇā śaṃkareṇa, yat pramāṇaṃ yāvatīm arthagatiṃ vyāpnotīty ādi | yat pramāṇaṃ yatsvabhāvasāpekṣapravṛttikaṃ tannaiva taditarasvabhāvena kasyacid vyāptiṃ pratipadyate, yathā viparyayabādhakaṃ bhūtvābhavanamātrāpekṣam
[284] anityaviśeṣeṇa kṛtakatvasya | yathā vābhimatasvarūpaviśeṣāpekṣam adhyakṣānupalambham agner jāṭharasādhāraṇena rūpeṇa dhūmasya | svarūpaviśeṣāpekṣapravṛttayaś ca pratyakṣanupalambhāvh prabhañjanena kampasya vyāptigrahaṇa iti vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiḥ, mātariśvalaghutvavat pratyakṣapravṛtter abhāvāt |
 nāpy anekāntaḥ | vivakṣitasvabhāvena hi kasyacit vyāptigrahaṇaṃ pramāṇasya tatsvarūpāpekṣapravṛttikatvena vyāptam, anyathātiprasaṅgaḥ pravṛttisaṃkaraś ca doṣaḥ | tadviruddhā ca taditarasvabhāvāpekṣā pravṛttiḥ, tasmāt svarūpaviśeṣāpekṣaṃ pratyakṣānupalambhaṃ nānilamātreṇa stimitetarasādhāraṇena kampasya vyāptiṃ pratipadyata iti pramāṇārthaḥ | tato na paramārthataḥ kampena pavanānumānam asti |
 atha ca na kācid bhavadīyasamayasamādhānakalpanā, yā nainam anudhāvati, na caitadīyam aprāmāṇyanibandhanaṃ kim api, yan na bhāvatkam anumānam upanīyate, tataś ca vahnidhūmavat prayatnavatkāryayor yadi vyāptisiddhaye 'dhyakṣānupalambhaṃ śaraṇam āśriyate, tadā tatpravṛttiyogyasvarūpāpekṣayā prayatnavato niyato vyabhicāraḥ kāryamātreṇa tṛṇādinā |
atha vyabhicāracamatkāragocareṇa cetanāvatā vyāptir iṣyate, tadā mahīruhādijanmanīva śilpivyāpārād api prāk niṣeddhum aśakye prayatnavanmātravyāpāre vyatiricyamāno ghaṭādiḥ kasyābhāvaprayuktābhāvo 'vadhāryatām, yatas tena vyāptaḥ sidhyed iti sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatayā punar anekāntaḥ pūrvaṃ dṛśyādṛśyaviśeṣam anapekṣya viparyaye bādhakābhāvaṃ svayam upadarśya kṛtaḥ, idānīṃ vādina evābhyupagamena tadiṣṭapramāṇāpekṣayā vyatirekāsiddher iti bhedaḥ | vipakṣabādhakaṃ tu hetumātreṇa vyāptiṃ pratīyāt na tadviśeṣaṇabuddhimatety uktam |
nanu vṛkṣādayaḥ pakṣīkṛtā iti kathaṃ tair vyabhicāraḥ? trividho hi bhāvarāśiḥ, sandigdhakṛtako buddhimatkartṛko 'kartṛkaś ceti | tatra buddhimatkartṛke ghaṭādau pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ vyāptim ādāya sandehapade bhūdharādau kāryatvam upasaṃhṛtya prayatnavā sādhyate | na punar asau vyabhicāraviṣayo bhavitum arhati |
yad āha, na ca sādhyenaiva vyabhicāra iti, tad ayuktam | na hi vyabhicāraviṣaya eva pakṣo bhavitum arhati,

[285] sandigdhe hetuvacanād vyasto hetur anāśrayaḥ | (PV IV 91)

iti nyāyāt | tataś ca kṣmādharādir eva sandigdhakartṛkaḥ pakṣīkartum ucitaḥ | kṣmāruhādiḥ tv acetanakartṛka iti caturtho rāśir eṣitavyaḥ | vyāptisamīhayā pratyakṣayogyābhimatasya vṛkṣādijanmany anupalabdher iti kathaṃ pakṣīkaraṇam? mā bhūd aśeṣasādhāraṇānaikāntikocchedaḥ |

 kāryatvasya vipakṣavṛttihataye sambhāvyate 'tīndriyaḥ
 kartā ced vyatirekasiddhividhurā vyāptiḥ karhaṃ sidhyati |
 bādhā tv āhitahetumātraniyatir bhedena na vyāptaye
 nāpy adharmo vyabhicāragocaracaraḥ pakṣīkriyāyāṃ kṣamaḥ ||

iti saṃgrahaślokaḥ ||
nanu tathāpi katham avyāptir ākāśasya vyatirekagrahaṇādhikaraṇasya sambhavāt? yad āha, buddhimatkāraṇasadbhāve bhāvo ghaṭādāv utpattyādeḥ, abhāve cābhāvo gamanādiṣu, sa ca tathāprasiddhāvinābhāvo yatraiva kṣityādāv upalabhyate, tatraiva tadvinirmāṇasamarthakartṛbuddhiṃ tadvido janayatīti | utpattyāder iti kāryatvāder ity arthaḥ | atrābhidhīyate | na sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa vā dṛṣṭāntamātram astīti sādhyasiddhiḥ, yadṛcchopanatāv api tathā sambhavāt | tasmān nidarśanaṃ nāma gṛhītavismṛtapratibandhasādhakapramāṇasmaraṇadvāreṇaiva hetāv upayogi, na svasannidhimātreṇa |
sa ca pratibandho dvārāntareṇa vā gṛhīto vihāyasā smaryeta, svādhikaraṇapramānaprasiddho vā? tatra tāvat prathamakalpanam apāstaṃ, prāg eva dṛśyaśarīropādhinā dhīmātreṇa vā kāryatvāder ghaṭāv api pratibandhagrahaṇopāyāpāyāt | caramaṃ cāsambhavi | tathā hi, yadi nāma vyomni dvayanivṛttir upalabdhā, tathāpy ekābhāvaprayuktatvaniścayāyogād anyābhāve viśvarūpasya ca tatrāvṛtteḥ kasya kena sambandhabodhaḥ syāt? karabhagardabhāder api kāryakāraṇabhāvagrahaṇaprasaṅgāc ca | anyatrānvayadarśanasahāyasya tathā pratītir iti cet? nanu sahadarśanam evānvayārthaḥ, tac ca kadācit karabhāder apy astīti sādhvī vyavasthā |
na sahadarśanam anvayasyārthaḥ, kiṃ tv ekasambhavaprayukto 'nyabhāvaḥ | sa ca buddhimatkāryatvayor asti nānyatreti cet, na, tadbhāvaprayuktatvaṃ nāmāparabhāvasya na tadvyāpārāt
[286] prāgabhāvinaḥ sattālābhād anyaḥ prāgabhāvaś ca nānupalabdhivyāpāram antareṇeti pratyakṣānupalambhābhyām anvayavyatirekayor niścaye saṃśayo nāma kīdṛk hetuphalasthitāv iti tatpratītipratibandhasmaraṇam eva vihāyasā vidhīyata iti prathamapakṣa evāyam |
kiṃ ca kim idam īśvare 'nujo vivṛttāvivṛttāviṣkaraṇamātram atra bhavataḥ, utra vandīkṛte (pratīvandīkṛte)? dhūmānumāne 'pi saiva gatiḥ, ekatrobhayasambhavam upalakṣyāntarīkṣe ekavyāpāranivṛttau anyanivṛtter upalakṣaṇād vyāptigraha iti | yady eṣa eva nyāyaḥ, tadā tadicchatām anibandhanaḥ prakṛtapradveṣaḥ, kevalam evaṃ vilapatā dahanānumānam api hāritaṃ, dūratarā tu prakṛtasiddhiḥ, uktakrameṇa gardabhetāpi [? ] tasya prasaṅge vahnāv api hastakatyāgāt | yadā tu gatyantaram api tatra prakṛtāsambhavi sambhavi, tadā kuto vandīkaraṇaṃ śaraṇam?
evaṃ tarhi pratyakṣānupalambhavyāpāraḥ tadatiprasaṅgabhayād evāśrīyate, na tu sa eva samaya iti cet? evaṃ sathi bhavataiva kim ayam atiprasaṅge bharo datto neti kośapānam kartavyam, yo hi pratyakṣānupalabdhi vihāya vihāyasi vahnivyāpāranivṛttyā dhūmanivṛttim ādāya vyāptim abhidhatte, taṃ prati yathā vastumātrasyāpi tatra vyāpāroparamāttenāpi vyāptisiddhiḥ syād ity atiprasaṅgaḥ, tathā yo 'pi pratyakṣānupalabdhīr uddhūya tadyogyapuruṣaviśeṣavyāpāraviraheṇa vyomani ghaṭādikāryatvanivṛttiṃ darśayitvā tena vyāptim asya manyate, taṃ prati puruṣamātrasyāpi tatra nivṛttyā tenāpi vyāptiḥ, tathā kāryāntaratvasyāpi nivṛttyā tasyāpi syād iti vyaktam atiprasaṅgamātram etat, na nyāya iti paśyāmaḥ |
dhūme gardabhādivyabhicāradarśanān na vastumātreṇa vyāptir iti yuktam, puruṣamātrasya tu vyabhicārānupalabdher nedam atipsaraṅgamātrodbhāvanaṃ bhaviṣyati | naivaṃ, samānanyāyānām ekatra bādhakadarśanam anyatrāpi śaṅkām utpādayati | yadi hi vihāyasi ubhayanivṛttidarśanaṃ pratibandhasādhakaṃ bhavet, vastudhūmayor api na bādhyeta, tatra tu bādhyamānam anyatrāpi katham ekāntāvasāyasādhanaṃ syāt? na ca pakṣīkṛte naiva vyabhicāra ity api, na pakṣīkaraṇaṃ mantraprabhāvaḥ, kiṃ tu vyāptigrāhakadārḍhyam | tac ca yadi nabhasi ubhayābhāvamātram, tadā tatra bādhakādhigater astaṃ dārḍhyam iti saty api pakṣīkaraṇavyabhicārāśaṅkā na nivartata iti |

 vyomāsti vyatirekabhūmir iti ced dhūmasya dhūmadhvajād
 utpattāv api kiṃ sa eva samayo nātiprasaṅgodayāt |
[287] yady evaṃ bhavataiva kiṃ vinihito nātiprasaṅgetaras
tasmin bādhavilokanaṃ punar ihāpy ārekam ākarṣati |

iti saṃgrahaḥ ||
tasmāt nākāśe dvayanivṛttyā vyāptisiddhiḥ, siddhavyāptikayos tv abhāvadarśanaṃ gṛhītavyāptismaraṇakāraṇaṃ syāt | na ca vyāptigrāhakaṃ kiñcid upapadyata ity uktam | tasmāt anvayamātrabhāve 'pi vyatirekābhāvād anekānta eveti sthitam | vastutas tu vyatirekavad anvayo 'py asya durlabha eva | yasya hi pratyakṣāgocaratayā abhāvaprayuktaḥ kāryābhāva iti pratyetum aśakyaṃ tasyānvayo dūrotsārita eva, pratyakṣagrāhyatvāt tasya | pratyakṣaṃ hi paridṛśyamāne vastuni deśakālaviprakṛṣṭam api svapravṛttiyogyam evāntarbhāvya vyāptim avakalpayet, na svabhāvaviprakṛṣṭam apīti uktaprāyam | tataś cānvayamātraṃ gajanimīlitenāvadhīrya vyatirekābhāvenaiva dūṣaṇam uktam | vastutas tu nānvayo na vyatireka iti prayatnavanmātre sādhye kāryatvam asādhāraṇam eveti vā darśayitum āha,

 saṃśayo 'thavā

iti | pratyakṣādiyogyāpekṣayā sādhāraṇānaikāntikam, caitanyamātrāpekṣayā asādhāraṇam ity arthaḥ | nanu śarīropādhibuddhikṛtaṃ kāryaṃ sidhyat buddhimātrakṛtaṃ sidhyaty eva, śiṃśapākṛtam iva vṛkṣakṛtam, viśeṣe sāmānyānapahnavād iti katham ucyate 'nvayābhāvaḥ? evaṃ sati vyatireko 'pi tadapekṣayā syād iti cet? kā no hāniḥ, buddhimati kāryahetor anvayavyatirekavattvābhyupagamād iti? uktam atra, evam anvayavyatirekakalpane jāṭharacitrakādigatenāpi rūpeṇa dhūmād anumitam agniṃ saṃśayāno nābhimataikāgracittaḥ pravarttety ādi |
api ca na tatra sambhavatīty eva pratyakṣeṇa yat kiñcid vastuno rūpaṃ kāryasya vyāpakam avadhāryate, api tv adhyavasāyāpekṣayā | adhyavasāyaś ca puruṣeṇa kṛta eva iti buddhimatā veti viśiṣṭaviṣaya eva pravartate, tādṛśyeva puruṣādiśabdasya rūḍheḥ | na tu karādivyāpāranirapekṣeṇa caitanyamātreṇeti, caitanyamātraṃ sadapyudāsīnam anvayagrahaṇakāle 'dhyavasāyasya viśeṣonmukhenaiva pravṛtteḥ, sāmānyaśabdatve 'pi vā prakṛtaviśeṣamākṣipyaivāgnivyāptivat | sa cādhyavasāyaḥ pratyakṣavyāpārānusārī tadyogyam eva rūpaṃ bahiḥ kuryāt, na tu tadayogyam api jāṭharādivat, tārṇādivac ca | evaṃ puruṣeṇāpi vyāptau kasyacit
 [288] śarīropādhividhurasya buddhimātrasya tadayogyasya pratikṣepaḥ syād eva | apratikṣepas tu kharvādibhedasyaiya | ayam eva nyāyaḥ sarvatra pratyakṣeṇānvayagrahaṇe |
 athāṅgārasaṅgād agurukhaṇḍajanitaṃ dhūmam upalabdhavataḥ pratyakṣayogyatayā indhanādyantareṇāpi tadanvayaprasaṅga iti cet? tatkimidānīṃ pramāṇaviṣayapratiniyamam anādṛtya yatra kvacit pravṛttam adhyakṣaṃ yena kenacid anvayaṃ pratyetv iti vivakṣitam? evaṃ sati hetumadābhāsavyavasthāvilopāt sarvasya sarvasiddhir iti pratiniyatasādhanānveṣo viphalaḥ |
 atha pratyakṣeṇa svayogyamullaṃdhyāpi vyāptir gṛhītety ucyate? tad asiddham | yadāpi pratyakṣaṃ svapravṛttiyogye 'pi vastuny avāntarabhedāpekṣayā sāmānyam udāsayad anvayaṃ pratipadyate, tadā kaiva kathā svapravṛttyayogyasyātyantaṃ vijātīyasya? na cāsmākaṃ pakṣaḥ pratyakṣayogyeṇa sarveṇa vyāptir iti, kiṃ tu pratyakṣayogyeṇaiva tatkṛtā vyāptir iti | anyathā gardabhādibhir api dhūmakumbhāder evānvayaprasaṅgaḥ | kim ataḥ param? kathaṃ punar atrāvāntarabhedāpekṣa eva vyāptigraho na darśanayogyatāmātrāpekṣaḥ? vikalpas tu vāsanāprabodhamāgrārtham apekṣitapratyakṣādisannidhir aniyatodayākāratayā na pratiniyataṃ viśeṣam āveśayitum arhatīti |
satyam, ata eva vyatirekasādhanyā anupalabdher avatāraḥ | tatra yathā vahnipuruṣābhyāṃ dhūmakumbhayor anvayādhyavasāye sahāyatām anupalabdhiḥ pratipadyate, pūrvasthitir anyata utpattir anyata āgamanam iti tridhā bhinnasambhavavyatirekaṃ sādhayantītarathānupayogāt, tathā yadi gardabhānvaye vedanamātrānvaye vā pratipadyeta, syād eva tābhyām api vyāptiḥ, nānyathā yato na pratyakṣamātraṃ vyāptiṃ pratipadyate, nāpy anupalambhamātraṃ, kiṃ tu pratyakṣānupalambhānvayonyasahāyāv iti nirṇītaṃ śāstra bahuśaḥ | asmābhir api trikapañcakacintāyāṃ kiñcid iti |
 na ca gardabhādyanvaye tasyāḥ sāhāyakam asti | etena dhūmaviśeṣāpekṣayānupalambhavyāpārābhāvo vyākhyāta iti naivaṃvādini kaścit paryanuyogaḥ | yas tu pratyakṣagocare 'pi tatkṛtāṃ vyāptim upavarṇayati tasya tadviṣaya eva vyāptigrahaviraha iti duḥsthā vyavasthā | pratyakṣayogye 'pi tatkṛtavyāptivādino 'nupalambhavyāpāravirahe 'pi tatkṛtavyāptim icchataḥ
[289] kaḥ pratiroddhā? yadi hy asya vrīḍā syād apratyakṣayogya eva tadvyāpāraṃ kathaṃ varṇayet? athopādānādividā prayatnavatā kāraṇadarśanād eva gardabhasya nirāsaḥ, kim atrānupalabdhyā?
 evaṃ tarhi dṛśyamānenaiva vyāptim upavarṇayan na ca darśanapathātikrāntena, na ca śarīropādhiṃ vyavadhūya caitanyamātram upalabdhaṃ kvacit | yadi ca darśanabalād eva vyavasthā caitanyamātrādhiṣṭhitaṃ śarīraṃ kumbhādi janayat dṛṣṭam eveti na gardabhenānvayavirodhaḥ, tat katham anupalabdhipratikṣepaḥ? vyāpakagatāḥ sāmānyadharmā eva vyāptau sādhakāḥ itareṣāṃ vyabhicāradarśanenānyatra śaṃkāvakād (śaṃkāvakāśād) eva na gardabhenānvaya iti cet? nanu vyabhicāradarśanam iti tadabhāve 'pi bhāvadarśanam ity anupalabdhivyāpārābhāve 'sādhanatvam upanīyamānam anupalabdher eva sādhanāṅganiścaye vyāpāraṃ paridīpayati |
 yadi ca viśeṣe vyāpāraśaṃkākulaḥ sāmānyam anusarati bhavān, upādānādyabhijñam api viśeṣam apahāya caitanyamātreṇa gardabhasādhāraṇena siddhasādhanayogyena tato 'pi vā sāmānyena kāraṇamātreṇa vyāptim abhidhattām | evaṃ hi sati sarvathā dūrīkṛtaḥ śaṃkāvakāśaḥ syād iti | etāvat tu sāmānyam avamanya upādānādyabhijñaviśeṣe sthitir na tu tad apy avajñāya yathādṛṣṭa iti kim atra sāmarthyam anyatra jāḍyāt? pratyakṣānupalambhavādinas tu yāvati yādṛśi sāmānye pratyakṣānupalambhavyāpāro na tatra śaṃkā, śaṃkāvakāśini ca na vyāpāra iti nāsau kvacana svayam icchayā vyāptim upanayaty apanayati vā pramāṇenaiva samarpaṇād iti na doṣaḥ |
 nanu so 'pi hetumātrakṛtaṃ vā kāryagrāmaṃ bruvan pratyakṣayogye 'pi pratyakṣavyāpāropalambhaṃ kiṃ na paśyati? paśyaty eva viparyayabādhakād āgamāc ca tasya tadābhyupagamāt | pratyakṣānupalambhaṃ tu śarīraviśeṣādhika eva cetasi sa pramāṇayati | icchāyām api karādivyāpāroparame kāryābhāvāt taddvāreṇaiva kulālādivyapadeśaviṣayasya samudāyasya pratyakṣatvavyavahārāt | na tv iyaṃ gatiḥ prayatnasacivacittamātre | tadāpy anumānād anvayaḥ pratyeṣyate | na ca pratyakṣasyaiva kaścid anurodhaḥ | upalambhānupalambhābhyām anvayavyatirekaniścayaḥ kartavyaḥ | sa copalambhaḥ pratyakṣarūpo 'numānarūpo veti nātra nirbandhaḥ |
 atra cintyate | kiṃ tad eva śarīropādhikaṃ cittaṃ prayatnavac cittamātraśabdenābhimatam, utānyat? tattve kim anumānena, pratyakṣasiddhau vivādābhāvāt | tena cānvayavyatirekau siddhau kāryamātreṇa ca tadvyabhicāro vyaktaḥ | anvayatve liṅgābhāvadoṣaḥ,
 [290] bhāṣaṇādeḥ kāryasya śarīriṇaiva caritārthatvāt | na ca tenānumitenāpi vyāptiḥ svīkriyate, vyatirekāniścayāt pūrvavat | evaṃ tarhi barhiṣāpi dhūmasya vyāptir na deśakālāvasthāniyatena, kiṃ tu vahnimātreṇa | tac ca dṛśyamānād anyenaiveti vikalpe vyabhicārādidoṣaḥ sādhāraṇa iti tādṛgviśeṣavirahiṇā sāmānyena vyāptir vaktavyā |
 tathehāpīti cet? evam api jāṭharādigatenāpi rūpeṇa vyāptiprasaṅgo dhūmasya | tasmān na sāmānyam ity eva vyāptāv adhikriyate, nāpi viśeṣa ity eva pratikṣipyate, dhūmānumānasyaivocchedāt, abhimate śikhani pravṛttimandehāt | tato yadi na svecchaiva saṃgrahaparicchedasādhanī, tadā pramāṇavyāpāram anviṣya vyavasthāprakrame kiñcit sāmānyaṃ svīkārapravṛttenāpi pratyakṣeṇa pratikṣiptam arthād eṣitavyam, yadviśeṣātikrameṇa nāsyāvatāraḥ | yathā jvaladbhāsurākāra pātikrame dhūmavyāptigrāhiṇaḥ | kiñcit tu pratyakṣasvīkṛtam apy anupalabdhiḥ pratikṣipati, pīṭharādivat sāmarthyāt |
 sā hi dahanābhāve kāryābhimatābhāvaṃ sādhayantī dahanabhāvaprayuktatadbhāvavibhāvanād ayogyavyavacchedena tatkāryatāsādhanapravṛttāpy anyasya hetutāṃ sādhayaty eva, yadabhāve svayaṃ na vartate | anupalambhapūrvake tu pratyakṣe prāgbhāvādibādhanapravṛttayānupalabdhyānekavasturūpasattvābhāve 'bhāvasiddhau yadekavastusvabhāvasannidhau sannidhir adhyakṣeṇa pratīyate prāg api tadabhāvaprayuktābhāvavibhāvanāt taddhetubhāvasādhane yadapravṛttiyogyatayā pratikṣiptam adhyakṣeṇa tatpratikṣiptam eva |
 tato na jāṭharāder anvayaḥ | nāpi kāladeśabhedabhinnasvabhāvapratikṣepaḥ (kāladeśadaśābhedabhinnasvabhāvapratikṣepaḥ), sarvasya pratyakṣeṇa svajanmayogyatayā svīkārāt | nāpy anupalabdhyā, sā hy atādṛksvabhāvābhāve 'bhāvantī tadvijātīyahetutāṃ pratikṣipatīti yuktam, na tu tasyaiva, anyathā tadāśrayaṇavaiyarthyāt | nanu deśādibhinnasvabhāvābhāve 'py ayaṃ dhūmo dṛṣṭaḥ, na deśādibhinnasyāpy ekākārapratyavamarśapratyayena paridṛśyamānarūpeṇa sahaikīkaraṇāt, darśanāyogyasvabhāvād anyatra | ata eva vahnimātraśabdābhidheyaṃ tad eva paridṛśyamānayogyād bhedākṛṣṭāv apy abhedāvabhāsāt |
 nanu deśādiviprakṛṣṭam apy adarśanayogyam eva | satyaṃ, kevalaṃ kadācit kvacit | svabhāvaviprakṛṣṭaṃ tu sad ety atyantavijātīyatayā svīkāraparihārayor bhedena vṛttir na virudhyate | tato yathānumānavādinā sāmānyam anusaraṇīyam avyāptisambhavaṃ vā parihartu, tathā
[291] dṛśyaviśeṣāpekṣayātiriktasāmānyam api parihartavyam ativyāptiparihārāya | evaṃ sati yathā darśanāyogyavahnisāmānyaparihāreṇa tadyogyāvāntarasāmānyena vyāptir ekatvavyavasthā ca yuktā, na prayatnavanmātreṇa, pratyakṣapratikṣiptatvād iti |
 tatra vyāmohāt pramāṇāntareṇānvayam icchan tattvānyatvābhyāṃ paryanuyujyate | dahane tu tatpakṣeṇaiva samādhir ity uktam | tasmāt pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ vyāptijighṛkṣāyāṃ tadyogyasāmānyāpekṣāyā ghaṭaviṭapādau dṛṣṭānta iṣṭasya siddhir asiddhiś ceti sādhāraṇānaikāntikatvaṃ kāryasya | caitanyamātreṇa tu tadayogyenānvayavyatirekayor ekasyāpy aniścayāt sandigdhānvayavyatirekatvaṃ vaktuṃ yuktam uktam,

 saṃśayo 'thaveti |

siddhyasiddhyor iti prakaraṇāt | tābhyāṃ ca bhāvābhāvāv uktau | yathāha - upalabdhir eva sattā anupalabdhir asatteti | tataḥ kāryatvādisādhanavati dharmiṇi dṛṣṭānte sādhyatveneṣṭasya prayatnavanmātreṇa sattvāsattvasandehāt, tadadhiṣṭhānābhyāṃ ca sarvasaṃgrahād ekatānvayavyatirekānupapatter yuktam asādhāraṇānaikāntikatvam |
 nanu tathāpy anekānto 'py astu, anvayamātraṃ kim iti pratikṣipyate, kāryotpattau buddher eva vyāpāradarśanād? jāṭharasādhāraṇenāpi rūpeṇa tarhi dhūme 'nvayaprasaṅgaḥ, dahanavyāpāradarśanāt | tataś ca tadapekṣo vyatireko 'pi syād iti prācīnadoṣaḥ | pratyakṣapratikṣepas tu sādhāraṇaḥ |
nanu jāṭharādyabhāve 'pi dhūmabhāvān na prācīnadoṣaḥ, saty apy anvaya iti cet? kailāsakaraṇakauśalavikalenāpi kalasasya karaṇaṃ kiṃ na kīrttyate? atha karaṇakauśalasāmānyenānvayo 'tra? tatrāpi dāhakamātreṇeti na vyaktyupakṣepeṇa kiñcit | jātyapekṣayā tu tadānyadāpīti kathaṃ tadabhāve 'pi dhūmabhāvaḥ? atha dāhakatvamātraṃ paridṛṣṭaviśeṣād bhinnāṃ jātim āsthāya vyabhicāra ucyate, tadā tadapekṣayānvayo 'pi kutaḥ, pratyakṣeṇa viśiṣṭāyā eva jāter adhigamāt? anvaye vā punar vyabhicārānupapatter iti |
yat punaḥ sajātīyena pratyakṣataḥ pratibandhaniścayam āśaṃkya, na hi sarvatra samānajātir anumīyate, pratyakṣaś ca yasmād asamānajātiḥ, apratyakṣaś ca rūpādivyaktibhir anumīyate cakṣurādigrāmaḥ, tathā candramasaḥ pṛthivyāś ca parabhāgādhibhāgāv ity uktam, tad api pāpīyaḥ | tathā hi na tāvad vyāptiśūnyam anumānam, vyāptiś ca sāmānyena sāmānyasya
 [292] bhavantī katham asamānānumānam anusaheta? tathā ca sā dvidhaiva pratyakṣānupalambhataḥ viparyayabādhakād vā | ubhayathāpi dṛṣṭāntadṛṣṭasajātīyasyaivānumānam | anyathānyajātīyena dharmeṇa vyāptim upādāyānyajātīyam anuminotīti mahatī prekṣā |
sāmānyato dṛṣṭānumāne 'pi hi yad eva gatisāmānyam anyasthānaprāptinibandhanam upalabdham, tad evādhikaraṇāntare niścīyata iti kathaṃ vijātīyadharmānumānam? athādhārabhedāpekṣayā sāmarthyasādhyam avāntarabhedam abhipretyocyate, tad anuktasamam | na hi kaścit anumānavādo tanmātreṇa viśeṣam anicchan phalinam anumānaṃ samarthayitum īśaḥ | yadi ceśvarānumāne 'pi tādṛśo vyāptiḥ syāt, tanmātreviśeṣasiddhyā ceṣṭasiddhiḥ syāt, kas tatra matsaram ācaret? na ca tanmātraviśeṣāpekṣayā na hi sarvatra samānajātir anumīyata iti vaktuṃ yuktam, kvacid asamānajātyanumāne 'pi tathocyate, tanmātraviśeṣaś ca sarvatrānumāne 'sti | viśeṣato dṛṣṭasya sāmānye 'pi tad eva niścīyata iti tadapekṣayā na sarvatra tad evānumīyata iti vaktavyam, bhedādhiṣṭhānatvāt samānajāticintāyāḥ |
tat punar aprakṛtam eva | sa tu na sarvaḥ pratyakṣo 'numīyata iti | yadi prakṛtam agnivat pratibandhagrahe pramāṇam adhikṛtyocyate, tadā pratyakṣasyaiva sarvatrānumānam anyatrāpadiṣṭapramāṇapravṛtteḥ | atha viparyayabādhakāpekṣayā, tadā na vaktavyaṃ na kaścid viśeṣo 'gnisādhanāt īśvarānumānasyeti | anityasādhanād iti tu vaktum ucitam | atha kāryahetutāmātreṇaivam ucyate, tadā kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ pratyakṣānupalambhasādhana eveti sa eva doṣaḥ | na ca viparyayabādhakaṃ kiñcid astīti carcitam eva | deśādyaniyamaprasaṅgaś ca hetumātrāpattiṃ sādhayaty api | tasmāt prakṛtaprameyānavagāhanāt plavata etat na sarvaḥ pratyakṣo 'numīyata iti |
anumānakālāpekṣayā tu sarvaḥ parokṣa evānumīyate, na ca tatra kācid vimatiḥ ity anuktasamam | indriyaṃ tu na sākṣād buddher anumātuṃ śakyam, pratibandhāgrahaṇāt | buddhikāryaṃ tu keṣucit satsv abhāvābhāvavat tadatiriktakāraṇasāpekṣatām āvahatīti tādṛśīndriyaghoṣaṇā | tatrāṅkurādiṣu dṛṣṭajātīyam eva sāpekṣatvaṃ yathā sādhyate, tathā parabhāgādhobhāgāv api ghaṭādikāryeṣu | arvāgaikasāmagrīpratibaddhau sāmānyato dṛṣṭāv evānumīyete iti sādhyaśūnyam udāharaṇam api ity alaṃ bahunā | athavā kāraṇasāmānyena kāryasāmānyaṃ vyāpyate, kāraṇaviśeṣeṇa tu kāryaviśeṣa eveti nyāyaḥ | adhyavasāyamātrato vā kāraṇasāmānyena kāryaviśeṣa iti pravādaḥ | tatrāyaṃ kāraṇaviśeṣeṇa buddhimatā kāryasāmānyaṃ vyāptam iti bruvāṇaḥ pramāṇāvaṣṭhambhena nāma prasiddhim ullaṅghayet |
 [293] tac ca pramāṇaṃ vyāptisādhakaṃ dvividham eva pratyakṣānupalambham vā, viparyayabādhakaṃ vā, anayoḥ pratyakṣānumānasvabhāvatvāt, anyato niścayāyogāt | tatra tāvad uktakrameṇa kāryasāmānyasya,

no bhedena vipakṣabādhakavaśād vyāptiḥ samastasya ca pratyakṣānupalambhato na tadatajjātīyabhedaspṛśaḥ |
prāgbhāvādiniṣedhapūrvakatayā dhūmādivaj janmadhīr anvetīdṛśam īdṛśād iti yataḥ sāmānyabhedadvayam |

idam upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptam anupalabdham asyopalambha upalabhyate ity evaṃ hi pratyakṣānupalambhayor vyāptigrahaṇakramaḥ | tatredam ity ekajātīyatayā ekapratyavamarśapratibhāsi dhūmādikam anekakāryajātyantaravyudāsenānekakāraṇajātyantaravyudāsena cāsyeti vahnyādeḥ ity arthaḥ | tataḥ kāryakāraṇayoḥ pratyekaṃ tajjātīyetarayor itaretarato bhede paramārśapūrvikā pravṛttiḥ, anyathā sāmarthyavaiyarthyābhyām anupayogāt |
tathā hy akāryarāśivyavacchedena vā, kāryāntaravyavacchedena vā idam etad bhāvābhāvānuvidhāyīty avadhāryeta? ādye pakṣe etāni vastuni etan niyatāni ity ayam artho naitad vastv iti, ekākāravirahād ekākārapratyavamarśānupapatteḥ | nanu kāryatvādinā sāmānyena idam iti kāryaṃ sanniveśo vety ādi vaktuṃ śakteḥ, asiddham etad iti cet? ucyate, iha bhāvābhāvavidhānabuddhir dvidhā sambhavati, dharmiviṣayā dharmaviṣayā ca, kāryasya nirvarttyavikāryabhedena dvaividhyāt | tatrādyā sarvātmanotpattiniścayam upādāya dharmiṇam eva viśiṣṭākārakroḍīkṛtam kāladeśādibhedabhinnam api svabhāvam antakapratyavamarśād (antarbhāvyaikapratyavamarśād) viṣayīkarotīti tadviṣayety ucyate | sa hi sambhavinam apy atadākārabhedavirodhinaṃ dharmam udāsayati, dhūmādiṣu dhavalatādivat |
yatra punar avasthitasyaiva dharmiṇo dharmāntaram udayam āsādayati, tatra dharmamātrasyaiva hetubhir anvayavyatirekāv iti dharmaviṣayety ucyate | sā punar ākāram evodāsayantī dharmamātram adhiṣṭhānīkaroti rāgādivat | na hy ākārakriyādivaijātyam atyantam anubhavantaḥ paṭakūṭādayaḥ sādhāraṇarāgayogino gṛhītasāmarthyarāgadravyāntarayogam anumāpya tṛpyanti | prathamā tv ākāraśaraṇaiva sarvātmanotpatteḥ | yathaiva hi viśiṣṭākāroparaktaṃ vastu kutaścid upajāyate tathaiva tadbalotpannenendrijñānenānubhūyānantaraṃ viklapadvāreṇa vyavahāragocarīkriyata iti
[294] katham ākāraparihāraḥ? ata eva dhūmakumbhādivyaktirekatrānupalabhyaprabhavā upalabhamānasya anyatra tadaiva yadyuktibhedena vyāptisiddhis tatraiva tatkāraṇāvasāyo jāyate, nānyatra vyabhicāradarśanādarśanam apekṣyāpi | anantaraṃ tv ākāram udāsayet kevalaṃ vyavasthite dharmiṇi dharmamātrodayadarśinaḥ |
na ca vyavasthite kumbhādau kāryatvādidharmamātrotpattir īkṣyate, kṣitidharādau vābhyupeyate, yenākāram anādṛtya rāgavattanmātram eva hetum anumāpayet | sanniveśas tarhi sthita eva tadātmani kumbhakārād iti cet, na, drāg api saṃsthānavinākṛtāyā mṛdo 'nupalabdheḥ | atha tādṛśasyābhāva eva pūrvaṃ yaḥ kumbhaprajñaptigocara iti cet? tad eva saṃsthānaṃ tarhi puruṣād iti na tāvanmātravyāptiḥ,

 tathāpi yadi saṃsthānasāmānye puruṣakriyā |
 haridrādravyayogo 'pi varṇamātravidhāyakaḥ ||

nanu tathāpi na pūrvasiddhadarśanam ity eva vyaktyantare gṛhyamāṇāyā vyāpter vyāghātaḥ, tadbalāt tv anumānam eva tatrety anantaram eva samarthitam | na ca tāvatā varṇamātraṃ kusumbhasambhavasādhanasādhu, vyabhicārālambanaṃ tu durbalam iti kim atra prāptam ?

 guṇe 'pi dravyavat tasmāt sajātīyaparigrahaḥ |
 tatpūṛvasiddhe 'py anumā na varṇāt kuṅkumasya ca ||

tanniyataviśeṣāparigrahe hi rāgād api kutaḥ kuṅkumānumā? davīyasī tu varṇamātrāt | varṇavac ca saṃsthānasyāpi vicitram eva vaijātyam anubhavaviṣayaḥ | tad anayor ekatra jātiniyamena vyāptivyavasthānam aniyamena vā vyaktau vyabhicāro naikaniyataḥ | tasmād varṇavad anekajātini saṃsthāne 'pi tattvaṃ sāmānyam anuvartamānam api vyāptigrahād bahirbhūtam eva | evam arthakriyāpi pūrvam asati vastuni puruṣād iti vaktum aśakyam | sarvasāmarthyavirahiṇaḥ prāgabhāvaprasaṅgenāpūrvotpattiprāpter iti viśiṣṭe vārthakriyāpi puruṣānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyinīti siddham | tasmād evaṃvidhā dharmaviṣayāpi vyāptibuddhir na sāmānyam anudhāvati | yadā tu kāryahetvadhikāreṇa dharmiviṣayaiva, tadā yathāparidṛṣṭākārārthakriyāsāmānyaṃ samāśritya yathā dāraṇe pratiniyatasvarūpasāmānyena vyāpakatvāvasāyinī, tathā kārye 'pi pratiniyatākārasāmānyapuraskareṇaiva vyāpyatvāvasāyinī samakṣabuddhir iti na sandehaḥ |
[295] anyathā kāryavat kāraṇe 'pi buddhimadādiviśeṣavyudāsena pravṛttimatī matiḥ kim abhimatam upanayet? tasmāt kāraṇavat kārye 'pi tathābhūtākāraviśeṣam evam ayam avasātum arhati | tatredānīṃ tadākārabahirbhūteṣu bhūtalādiṣu sad api kāryatvam abhidhīyamānam anupayuktam eva, dharmaviṣayahetuphalagrāhipratyakṣavyāpārāpekṣayā dharmamātrasāmyasyākiñcitkaratvāt | na hi tad evākārārthakriyādirūpaṃ tatsāmyonmīlanahetur vā | tad anena sāmyaṃ na kiñcid arthaṃ puṣṇāti agauṇakāryaśabdapravṛtter anyatra | sa hi saṅkalpaniveśiny udayārtham apekṣitaparavyāpāramātre arthe akārādikam udāsya kṛtasamaya iti na tasya vyāghātaḥ | upapattyantareṇa vyāpakatayā yaḥ pratīto dharmaḥ tatraiva nāśavat pratyakṣavyāpāra eva tu svodayasamayaparisphurad ākārādisādṛśyam apekṣate, deśādikṛtabhede tu vaisadṛśyāvasāya iti na virodhaḥ |
tasmād ekakāravirahāt (ekakāraṇavirahāt) pratyekaṃ pratyakṣānupalambhāpekṣāyām etāni vastūni etat kāraṇānugāmīnīty anenaivākāreṇa vyāptiniścayaḥ kāryaḥ | kevalam adyāpi na vyaktikārtsnyenopayoga iti sarvakāryaprakāreṣv ekaikaviṣayo 'vatiṣṭhate | sa cāśakyaḥ kramayaugapadyābhyām ayogāt | tathā hi na tāvat sakṛd eva teṣām anvayaḥ, sarvaprakāropanipāte darśanasya draṣṭur evāntardhānaprāpteḥ | vyatireko vā śakyaniścayaḥ, aśakyaparihāratvāt keṣāñcid ādhārālokaśarīrādīnām |
nāpy ekena narāyuṣā kṣamam idaṃ sarvaprakārekṣaṇaṃ kāryasyāntaviyogataḥ katipayāpekṣāsu kārtsnyaṃ kutaḥ ?
na khalu bhūyaso 'pi bhāg asyābhividhibodhe nivṛttiḥ, na hi tad api yad yat kāryaṃ tat tad evam iti śakyam abhidhātum, etāvad iti tu syāt |
yat punar ekatra pravṛtto vicāraḥ sarvabhāvāṃs tathābhāve vyavasthāpayatīty ucyate, tat sādhāraṇākārapravṛttim adhikṛtyākṛtyādivyudāsena pramāṇāntarāvalambanāt | pratyakṣavyāpāra eva hy ekajātigrahaniyama uktaḥ | nanu tatrāpy avāntarānekabhedasambhavād ayam evam ity abhidhātum aśakter anāśvāsaḥ | atra vā bhedatiraskāreṇa dhūmādijātyantaram avalambya saṃvyavahāre kāryatām āśritya jātyantareṣv api kīdṛśo doṣa iti cet? na vayaṃ svecchayā kañcid bhedaṃ tiraskurmaḥ, puraskurmo vā kām api jātim | adhyakṣapūṛvakas tu saṃkalpo yathā arthān upasthāpayati bhedenābhedena vā, tathā hetuphalabhāvavyavahāram avatarāmaḥ | sa tu  [296] prakṛtiviśeṣam āsādya yadi sūkṣmasthūlabhāvena bhedeṣv abhibhūtisāmarthyāsāmarthyābhyāṃ bhinatti vṛttim, kim atra kaiścit kartavyaṃ (kecid iti mātṛkāyām) tadvivartas tu cintyaḥ | tatra,

 dhūmo 'vāntarabhedavaty api yathā jātyantarāpohitaṃ
sārūpyaṃ viṣayīkaroti hṛdayaṃ kiṃ kāryamātre tathā ||

ekasaṃsthānādyanugamānanugamayoḥ, pratyātmavedyatvāt nāparam atra prārthyate nirṇayanibandhanam, anyathā ca vyapadeśārthakriyāviniyogādisaṃkaraprasaṅgaḥ | tasmān na kvacit kāraṇe sarvakāryaprakāraṇāṃ krameṇa yaogapadyena vā adhyakṣānupalambhasambhavā vyāptir upapādayituṃ śakyeti kim ābhyām? ata evaṃ mukhena sarvakāryavyāptivādinaḥ svabhiprāyanivedanamātram etad, vartmani sthāṇūpadeśaghoṣaṇavat | tathā ca sati icchāmātraṃ sādhanam astv iti sphuṭam anayor apārthakatvam | tasmād ābhyām ata idam iti matiḥ kāryāntaravyavacchedenaiva bhavantī na kāryamātragocarīkaraṇasaṃvādam āsādayati | tato niścayam upādānādivido 'panudan nāha

 saṃśayo 'thaveti ||

pareṣṭasiddhir na parasya bādhane prasādhane vedanatnamātrayoḥ (vedanayatnamātrayoḥ) |
 ananvayo 'bhīṣṭaviśeṣasādhane vipakṣasandehasahaṃ tu sādhanam ||
 sādhye ca dṛśye vyabhicāra eva dṛśyaṃ na cen na vyatirekasiddhiḥ |
 na cānvaye 'pi vyatirekavad vā vyāptir viśeṣeṇa na cetarasya ||

  || dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ||
tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ
 [297] evaṃ sati saty api vyāptir aśakyaniścayā sambhāvyata iti kim atra sāmpratam iti cet? paśya,
 kāryaṃ tāvad anekajāti, janakaścaiko jaḍo vīkṣyate nānābhedavato na caikaniyamajñāne 'nyabhede 'pi tat |
 yadyajjātikam ekahetuviditaṃ tattattadaṅgaṃ tato naivaṃ ced atisañjanaṃ na ca mataḥ sādhyopame 'yannayaḥ || na hi nānāprakārakāryajananaṃ nāma prayatnavaty eva niyatam, vahnyāder api vividhasāmagrīmadhyamadhyāsīnasya dhūmabhasmāṅgārāṅgatāpapākapāratsāraṇavīkṣaṇakṣatiprabhṛtivicitrakāryakriyādarśanāt (dhūmabhasmāṅgārāṅgatāpapākapāradotsāraṇavīkṣaṇakṣatiprabhṛtivicitrakāryakriyādarśanāt) | yadi paraṃ prayatnavato 'dhiṣṭhānenety atra vivādaḥ, na caikasya tatra niyame jñāte kāryāntare 'pi niyamajñānam upapadyate, yathoktaṃ prāk | tato yāvantaḥ prakārā ekahetavo niścitāḥ, tāvantas tasya hetoścetanasyetarasya vā sādhanaṃ yujyante | anyathā stimitendhanasakhena śikhinā gṛhītadhūmavyāptir aparicitatatkāryabhāvair bhasmādibhir api dahanam anuminuyāt | na caivaṃ, tasmāt tajjātibhedo vyakti vyāptigrahaś ca pṛthak pṛthagapekṣyamāṇo yatra kvacit tadgrahaṇena yena kenacid anumānam unmūlayati | kaḥ punar evam āha, yatra kvacid gṛhītavyāptir yena kenacid anumimītām iti, ekadharmānuvṛttivirahe hetor evābhāvāt? na hi tadā bhasmasādhanam avyāpteḥ | nāpi dhūmo 'siddheḥ | kuṭakūṭādau kāryatvam evānyadharmānanuvṛttāv apy anumāne vartamānaṃ hetuḥ syād iti cet, na, kāryatvasyāpi prāgavyāpter vistareṇa sādhanāt | tatra yathā kulagiriḥ kulālavyāpārakāle svabhāvavaikalyādikalitaniyamah, tathā sad api kāryatvaṃ prāmāṇyapravṛttyā dhūmajanmanīva rāsabha iti pramāṇena vyāptigrahavirahe na kaścid viśeṣaḥ | tad ayaṃ ghaṭādau kāryaviśeṣe gṛhītavyāptiḥ sarvato na kāryatāmātreṇa vā vyāpakam anumātu | na tu vyāptigrahaṇasādhanavyavasthayor bhinnādhikaraṇatām atikrāmatīti katham atiprasaṅgopālambhaparihāraḥ?
tasmān naikadharmānuvṛttimātreṇopayogaḥ | kena vā dhūmasambhavinaḥ kāryatvavastutvādayo bhasmani bhasmasād eva kṛtāḥ? santo 'pi vyabhicāriṇa iti cet? nanu savyabhicāro vyāptiviyogād eva, vyāptau tadgandhasyābhāvāt | sa ca vyāpty abhāvaḥ kāryatvenāpi arjita (avarjita) iti tatrāpi vyabhicāro durnivāraḥ | āhaty ādarśanaṃ tu viprakarṣād api syāt |
 [298] na tāvatā tadabhāva eva, tanmūlabhūtāyā avyāptes tādavasthyāt | yadi tu vyāptāv eva savyabhicāraḥ, tadā nitarāmavyāptāv ity alaṃ mithyābhiniveśena | tad yady api sādhāraṇadharmā tanmātraṃ vyāptim anādṛtya sādhanam iṣyate, kiṃ na bhinna evaṃ bhūdharādisādhāraṇaṃ dharmam, anādṛtyety atiprasaṅgas tadavasthaḥ?
nāpy ayaṃ nayaḥ sādhyasamānīkṛte kalasādāv apy asti, tatrāpi yathāyathā pratisaraśarābodañcanādiṣu kumbhakārakṛtim upalabhāmahe, tathātathaivam apīdam apy anena sujyata iti pratiyantaḥ paricitakriyebhya eva prakārebhyas tadvyāpāram avadhārayāmaḥ, anyathā taddoṣānativṛttiḥ | tasmād yadi paramārthataḥ prayatnavannāntarīyaka evāyaṃ sakalaprakāraḥ kāryagrāmaḥ, tathāpi svayam akiñcitkara iti pramāṇavṛttyapekṣayā,

 siddhaṃ yādṛg adhiṣṭhātṛ bhāvābhāvānuvṛttimat |
 sanniveśādi tadyuktaṃ tasmād yad anumīyate || (PV II 13)

iti || yaddṛṣṭer akriyādarśino 'pi kṛtabuddhir bhavati, śūnyanagaraparidṛṣṭadevakulādivat sanniveśādi,

 tādṛg eva yadīkṣyeta tannagādiṣu dharmiṣu |
 yuktaṃ tatsādhanād asmād yathābhīṣṭasya sādhanam ||

tac cāsiddhim ity ākūtam |
nanu bhavaty evāsmākaṃ sarvatra pauruṣeyabuddhiḥ, kṛtabuddhiḥ sā, sādhyabuddhir evānumānam iti niyamaḥ, kathañcit kasyacit tatrāpy abhāvāt | kiṃ ca kṛtabuddhir iti kāryamātrabuddhir vā, puruṣamātrabuddhir vā? yadi kṛtamātrabuddhiḥ, sā bauddasyāpi siddhā sindhubhūdharādiṣu | sāvayavatvāc ca tadārambhasambhavitvam eva kṛtatvam | atha pauruṣeyabuddhiḥ kṛtabuddhiḥ? sā sādhyabuddhir evānumānam iti cocyate, tatas tadabhāvān nānumānam iti katham ucyamānaṃ nopaplavate ?
yadāha, na ca vyāmohāt kasyacit sādhyabuddhyabhāve hetor asiddhatādoṣaḥ, sarvānumāneṣu tadbhāvaprasaṅgād iti | yad apīdam ucyate, tādṛkkāryatvādi niṣiddham acalādiṣv iti,
 [299] tatrāpi na kāryatvādinā kailāsakalasādeḥ kiñcidviśeṣam upalabhāmahe | āha ca, nāpi kaścid viśeṣaḥ kṣityādihetūnāṃ prāsādādihetubhyo yenāmī nirabhiprāyāḥ santaḥ prayatnanirapekṣāḥ pratiniyamavatā ca vyāpāreṇa tadvantaḥ syuḥ, na hy anadhiṣṭhitānāṃ prayatnavatā karaṇadharmāṇāṃ kriyāsu svātantryam upalabdhipūrvam, sarvatra buddhimadadhiṣṭhiteṣv eva prāsādādiprasavopalabdher iti |
atrocyate, neyaṃ kṛtabuddhiḥ siddhāntābhiniveśavāsitabuddhīn adhikṛtya kīrtitā, kiṃ tu saṃvyavahārapragalabhapuruṣamātrāpekṣayā | tasya ca pūrvapratītapratibandhasmaraṇavataḥ kāraṇaparāmarśavaimukhyābhāve bhavaty eva devakulādau tādṛśī buddhir na tu malyamakarālyādau | tad anayor asyā dhiyo bhāvābhāvau na jātibhedam avyavasthāpya sthātuṃ prabhavataḥ, dhūmadvayadarśane 'pi tathābhāvaprasaṅgāt | iyaṃ ca kāmaṃ sādhyabuddhir eva, kaḥ punar enām etadvato 'numānanibandhanam āha, tadabhāvād vā bhūdharādau tadabhavam? kiṃ tu jātibhedamātropalakṣaṇārtham asyā bhāvābhāvopanyāsaḥ samānajanāpekṣayā kasyacid durvidagdhabuddheḥ pratibodhasādhanāya | jātibhede hi tāvati siddhe naikatra pravṛttim adhyakṣānupalambham anyatra pratibandhasādhanasamartham iti vaktuṃ samarthaḥ syāt |
tato nāpratibaddhāt sanniveśādeḥ sādhyasiddhiḥ, pratibaddhaś cāsiddha iti katham anumānam ity antato 'numānaniṣedhāyopanyāse 'pi naikasyaiva tadabhāvāt tadabhāva ity uktaṃ bhavati | nanu tathāpy anyasyānumānodayābhāvād anyasyāpi na bhavitavyam ity uktaṃ bhavati | tac ca kathaṃ saṅgatimālambeta? uktaṃ hi, na ca vyāmohād ity ādi | tad ayuktam | samānasādhanasāmagrīsambhave sādhyasyaikapratiniyamānupapatteḥ | yad yena viśiṣṭasāmagrīkaṃ tat tenāviśiṣṭaphalam eva, yathā sādhāraṇadhūmasādhanendhanadahanādisamudāyam pradeśadvayam anyonyam, aviśiṣṭānumānasādhanapratibandhagrahaṇādisāmagrīkaś ca bhavatā saha sāṃvyavahārikaḥ puruṣa iti svabhāvahetuḥ prasaṅgaḥ | bhavato 'pi hi pratyakṣānupalambham eva pramāṇaṃ pratibandhasādhanaṃ devakulasūtradhārādyadhikāreṇa pravṛttam | etac ca parasyāpi sādhāraṇam | asādhāraṇaṃ tu viparyayabādhakapramāṇam eva durabhūyatayā bhavet | tac ca bhavato 'pi nāstīti prāk prakāśitam |
tad yadi svamatābhiniveśamātram anubhavato nāvṛṇoti cetaḥ, kiṃ tu tad eva sādhanam itarasādhāraṇam, tadā tasyāpi śūnyanagaraparidṛṣṭadevakulādivan merumandarādāv api pauruṣeyānumānam anivāryam | na caivam | tato yasya yatpratibandhagrāhakapramāṇavyāpāre
[300] yathāvat smaraṇavato yaddarśanān na tadanumānaṃ na tasya yatra pratibandhaḥ siddho, yathāgnau dhūmapratibandhasyānusmarato gardabhadarśanād agniman anuminvataḥ | na bhavati ca cetanena devakulādipratibandhasmṛtimato malayahimālayādau puruṣānumānam iti kāryānupalabdhiḥ smaraṇakāraṇānusaraṇavaimukhyādipratyayāntarasambhave prācīnapratibandhasādhakapramāṇena viṣayīkaraṇavaikalyaṃ sādhayati | tac ca jātibhedātiśayam antareṇāvāntarabhedavato 'pi, dhūmād gardabhavat |
vyāptigrahaṇasmaraṇayor aparādhe tu neyam iṣṭasiddhiḥ | tadarthaṃ yathāvad grahaṇam | tatra smaraṇāparādhe devakulāntarād api nānumimīta, grahaṇāparādho 'pi pratyakṣāpekṣayā 'sambhāvī, ekapratyavamarśayogyatāyā evābhāvād ity ukteḥ | anyathā jaladharādyarthino 'pi kumbhakārasūtradhārādīnapekṣeran | apekṣata eva tatrāpi sūtradhārasthānīyo 'nyo yathā kumbhakārasthānīyaḥ kvacit sūtradhāra iti cet, na, kāryajātivaisadṛśyābhāve kāraṇasāmarthyavaisadṛśyāpekṣānupapatteḥ | anyathā kumbhāntare 'pi na kulālamātreṇa toṣam aśnuvīta | tadvad vā kṛṣīvalaḥ kulālapauruṣāpaneyānāvṛṣṭikaṣṭaḥ syād iti siddha eva tādṛśo jātibhedaḥ, tasmād ekākārapratyavamarśāśnupapatter adhyakṣasādhyā vyāptir viśiṣṭaviṣayatayā na durgrahadoṣam āvahati, yato 'numānābhāve 'pi jātibhedātiśayasyāsiddheḥ siddhasādhanadoṣaḥ syāt |
tataś ca yathāvad grahaṇasiddher yatra nānumānaṃ tatra vyāpter evāgrahād iti nānekāntaḥ | kathaṃ punar anumānahānam eva tādṛśi lokasyāgantavyam (lokasyāvagantavyam) iti cet? uktād eva jaladharārthino 'pi kulālajaṅghāmardanaprasaṅgāt, paracakrākrāntikātarasya vā kulagirijaladhivyavadhim abhilaṣataḥ, cetanamātreṇa vyāptiṃ pratīmo no kumbhakārādyavasthāniyatena tena nāyaṃ prasaṅga iti cet? tadavasthāniyatenaiva vyāptigrahe kīdṛśo doṣa iti kim atra vaktavyam? na ca samayāpakṣālakalāṅkitadhiyaṃ bhavantaṃ prati kācic cintā, api tu lokaṃ prati | so 'pi vyabhicārān na tena pratipadyate iti cet? evaṃ tarhi kalasāntarād api nānumānam ayaṃ kuryāt |
anyatraiva vyabhicāradarśanād atra ko doṣa iti cet? tad etaj jātivaisadṛśye 'sati na labhyate | tataś ca viśiṣṭāyām eva jātau vyāptigrāhi pratyakṣaṃ pravṛttam ato nānyatra tadvyāpārānumānam ity evaṃ kiṃ nocyate, kim atra vyabhicāropakṣepeṇa? avaśyaṃ ca pratyakṣasya pratiniyatajātivyavasāya eṣitavyo 'nyathā vyabhicārāgocaram api pratyakṣaṃ na niyatajātikam iti kalasāntaram apy āskandet | tathā ca sati sa eva doṣaḥ | vyāptigrāhiṇaiva
[301] kalasāntarasyādhiṣṭhitatvād iti cet? nanu tadadhiṣṭhita eva viṣaye vyabhicāracāri cetaḥ pracarat kathaṃ tam eva pariharet?
ubhayor niyataviṣayatve tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ | kevalam idānīm adhyakṣeṇa viśiṣṭaviṣayasvīkārān na vyabhicāropanyāsaḥ saphalaḥ | vyāptigrāhiṇas tu pramāṇasya viśiṣṭaviṣayapravṛttismaraṇādhānārtham upayujyante mūḍhaṃ prati | na tu parito visāriṇī vyāptigṛhītarasya niyataviṣayā kriyate vyabhicāreṇa | nāpy anumānakhaṇḍanamātram uktanyāyād eva | tasmād viśiṣṭaviṣayaiva vyāptiḥ kumbhakārādinā gṛhyate vyabhicāradarśanādarśanāpekṣyapratyakṣasyaikajātyapekṣayaiva pravṛtter iti siddham |
evaṃ cetanamātreṇāpi vyāptijighṛkṣāyāṃ vyabhicāro darśanābhāvāt yajjātini vastuni pratyakṣapravṛttis tad eva tena vyāptam sidhyatīty api siddham | tat kathaṃ sāmānyena vyāptim abhidadhānaḥ samayānuvādamātreṇa nopālambham arhati? yadi tu puruṣamātreṇa vyāptiṃ jighṛkṣor adhyakṣapratikṣepeṇa pramāṇāntaraṃ śaraṇam, tadā naiṣa doṣaḥ | tat tu vicāritam | yadi veśvaraprasādād asya vādino jagataś citrākāraparihāreṇa sarvatraikākāraṃ pratyakṣam udayam āsādayati, taccāsādhāraṇam iti na vyavahārāṅgam | saśarīrāśarīrayoḥ prayatnavator na kaścid viśeṣaḥ karmadharmāpekṣayā pratyakṣeṇa vyāptigrahaṇe, yato jaladharārthinā kumbhakārānanusaraṇena tatkṛtānumānavirahānumāne prakārāntareṇāpi sambhāvanāyāṃ jātibhedaikanibandhanāpratibandhāt siddhasādhanaṃ punar apy āsajyeta | tato jātibhedakṛtas tatrānumānābhāvaḥ saṃsidhyan pratiniyatajātipratibaddham anumānam upapādayati |
viśiṣṭajātipratibaddhapauruṣeyānumānāsiddhau vā anubhavasiddham api jātibhedaṃ śāṭhyād apahnuvānaḥ paralokasya jātibhedānantarīyakeṇa tathā pravṛttyabhāvasiddhena kulālādikṛtatvānumānābhāvena | anyathānumānodayaṃ prasajya jātibhedam āpādyate, yathā sthāṇukākābhyāṃ bhinnaḥ saṃyogo nāma yadi syād dṛśyo loko 'py enaṃ tṛtīyam īkṣeteti ucyate | tathā ca yadi yādṛśaḥ sanniveśo buddhimatpūrvako dṛṣṭas tādṛg eva jaladharādāv api syāt, lokasyāpi puruṣakṛtabuddhiḥ syāt, ghaṭāntaravat |
na caivaṃ tajjātibhedakṛto 'yaṃ vibhāgo 'nyanimittābhāvād ity uktaṃ bhavati | tataḥ kīdṛśaṃ punaḥ sanniveśādyadhiṣṭhātṛanāntarīyakaṃ siddham ity apekṣāyāṃ yāddarśanād akriyādarśinaḥ apīty ādy ucyate, paryāyaparikalpitānekaprakāraparigaṇanagauravaparihārārtham, tatra puruṣakṛtabuddhir iti prayatnavad anumānaṃ vā kumbhakārādivyāpārānumānaṃ vety ubhayasyāpi saṅgateḥ
 [302] prāguktakramāt | kevalaṃ prayatnavanmātraniṣedhasādhanasāmagrīkatayā kulālānumānābhāva eva liṅgam, tadvitsiddho vā vyāptigrahaṇābhāvaḥ | etac ca parecchām anulāpya pallavitam |
lokas tu yathādarśanānusārī yajjātikaṃ puruṣapūrvakaṃ paśyati, tattattādṛśā tanumataiva kṛtam avabudhyate, na tu śarīraviratisandeham apy ullikhatīti samānamānavānumānaparyavasānaiva kṛtabuddhir avatiṣṭhata iti | yadāpi yadi kasyacit siddhivaśād āsurīṃ māyālim ālocayato 'cale 'pi kaścid ullekho jāyate, kenāpi kair api vā kaccit kṛto 'yam api bhaved iti, tadāpi kenāpi | karacaraṇāṅgoparakta evātyantaṃ pratibhāti | niścayas tu sudūra eva | na caikajātitve tadupapadyate, dhūmakumbhāder ivānalakulālādeḥ | na ca karacaraṇādivyāpāravirahiṇa ullekho 'pi | na ca tāvatā kṣaṇikādivādino 'numānāpalāpaḥ śakyate | adhyakṣapūrvavyāptigrahasahāyaṃ tu jātiviśeṣāpekṣavṛttikam anumānam ubhayor api sādhāraṇatvān na sambhavati laukikaparīkṣayor iti brūmaḥ | yady api ca dvitīyam api laukikam eva, tathāpi kaścid viṣayo 'nabhyastatayā tīvratarābhyūhasāpekṣaḥ kṣmadhiyaḥ (sūkṣmadhiyaḥ) sāṃvyavahārikasyāpi sambhavati | tatra pratyakṣākṣamatve 'pi vipakṣabādhakenānumānāntareṇa lokapratītim evāśritya gṛhītā vyāptir anumānaṃ prayojayed iti na kṣatiḥ, yathā yatrārthāpattighoṣaṇāviśeṣo lokasya | tasmāt sādhyabuddhirūpā kṛtabuddhir bhāvābhāvābhyāṃ jātibhedaṃ prasādhayatīti yuktam eva | yadāpi kṛtamātrabuddhiḥ kṛtabuddhiḥ, tadāpi na doṣaḥ | tathāpi kṛtakatvaṃ nāma svajanmany apekṣitaparavyāpāratvam | tac ca na tāvad vṛkṣādivat pratyakṣataḥ kṣitidharādiṣu siddham | parābhyupagamamātrasiddhaṃ tu svatantrasādhanādhikāre 'naṅgam eva |
tato 'numānasiddham āśrīyamāṇaṃ dṛṣṭasajātīyaṃ yathā kathañcid vāśrīyate? anantyapakṣe yady anādyupādānaśaktisaṃtanyamānakṣaṇaparamparārūpam eva kāryatvaṃ niyatadeśatayā vyavasthāpyamānaṃ sidhyet, tādṛśāt, kīdṛśī puruṣādhiṣṭhānapratyāśā? dṛṣṭasajātīyaṃ tu tadaṅgam ucitam | cetanācetanādhiṣṭhānakṛtaṃ viśeṣam avadhūya vitatānekakāraṇakalāpamilanalabhyodayaṃ hi puruṣavyāpāram ākarṣed api, milanasya tadadhīnādhyavasāyāt | acetanopādānatvamātram api hi prācīnakrameṇa caritārthaṃ na prakṛtaṃ viśeṣam ākarṣet | etad eva tu kāryatvaṃ loke viditam | tac ca nācalādau siddham iti katham asiddhiparihāraḥ? kevalaṃ na
[303] sākṣād asiddhisādhanam idam, kiṃ tu vijātīyatvasādhanārtham | na ca kāryatvamātram adhikṛtya, kiṃ tu sarvam |
tad ayam arthaḥ, kiṃ tadadhiṣṭhātṛbhāvābhāvānuvṛttisanniveśādisiddham, yaddarśanād akriyādarśino 'pi lokasya kṛtabuddhir bhavatīti | tato yadi sāvayavā kṛtabuddhir api bhavato bhavati, tathāpi lokasya nāstīti bhinnajātīyatvaṃ vyavasthāpyate | anyathā kumbhakārādināpi bhūdharādivyāpyaṃ pratīyāl loka iti pūrvavat prasaṅgaḥ | tato jātibhedād anyad eva pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāṃ puruṣakṛtaṃ pratītam iti siddham |
yat tūktaṃ kāryatve na kaścid viśeṣa iti | atra sarvasādhāraṇadharmatve 'pi kāryatvasya yadi pratyakṣasādhanā vyāptir abhimatā, tadā sad api tadudāsīnam evety uktaprāyam | yadi tu viśeṣam utsṛjyābhūtvābhāvamātrasya cetanāvyāptir vivakṣitā, tadā pratyakṣavyāpāram apy utsṛjya pramāṇāntaraṃ śaraṇam astv ity api | tadabhāve vā na kiñcit kāryatvena satāpi |
yad apy āha: nāpi kaścid viśeṣaḥ kṣityādihetūnām ity ādi, tad api grāmyajanadhandhīkaraṇamātropayogi na vivakṣitārthagater gatir bhavitum arhati | yathā pārthivatvena vajropalānāṃ lokalekhyatvaṃ sādhayan sandihāne prāha | nāpi kāṣṭhapāṣaṇādibhyo dambholīnāṃ kaścid viśeṣo, yenāmī pārthivāḥ santo lohalekhyatāvirahiṇaḥ syuḥ | na hy alohalekhyānāṃ kadācit pārthivatvam upalabdham | sarvatra lohalekhyatāsvīkṛteṣv eva ghaṭaviṭapādiṣu pārthivatvopalabdher iti | tadvat prakṛtam api vacanaracanāmātram ābhāti |
yathā hi nirabhiprāyatvena sāmānyam anu (anuyantaḥ) sarve puruṣāpekṣakāryārambhabhājaḥ pratīyante, tathā pārthivatvena lohalekhyatvasvabhāvabhājaḥ | yathā ca tathā bahudarśanaṃ vihāya nānyā gatis tathā atrāpi | yathātra kim etal lohalekhyatvaṃ pārthivatvamātrānubandhi, uta pārthivatve 'pi kiñcid viśeṣam apekṣyeti śaṅkā bahuladarśane 'pi, tathā kim acetanam ity eva kāryakriyāsu cetanāpekṣam uta kriyāviṣayāpekṣayaiveti samānam |
kiṃ ca yadi dahanādiṣv iva sūkṣmāvāntarabhedatiraskāreṇaikapratyavamarśayogyatāpekṣayā nāpi kaścid viśeṣa iti ucyate, kārye 'py aviśeṣaprasaktyā dhūmādivat saudhasādhanasyāpi kulagirikaraṇaprasaṅgo durvāraḥ | īśvarasvīkāre kadācid anyathāpi syāt, sarvadā viparyaye śālibījasyāpi śālyaṅkurakaraṇanirākaraṇaprasaṅgaḥ, saudhāntarakriyāniṣedho vā syāt | athātyantajātibhede 'pi nirabhiprāyatvadharmamātrāpekṣayā? tad api viplava
[304] evāyam, na hi kvacit sādhāraṇo dharmo durlabha eva | nāpi tāvatā svabhāvaparabhāvo bhāveṣu viṣāmṛtayor ekakriyāprasaṅgāt kim aniṣṭam asaṃśitāny eva vā saudhādisādhanāni aśakyaparihāranirabhiprāyatvaṃ sādhāraṇam avajñāya yayā svabhāvabhedādhiṣṭhānayā śaktyā kāryabhedam ātyantikam ārabhante tatkṛtaprayatnāpekṣāniyamaniṣedho 'pi yadi syāt kīdṛśo doṣa ity arthapadam etan nāsti kaścid viśeṣa ity ādi |
tasmād vividhaviśeṣavyāptigrahaṇaprakārasyābhāvāt śaṅkāyā anivṛtteḥ, svahṛdayasyāpi sampratyayākṣamatayā sambhāvanārakṣāmātram evaṃvidhaḥ pralāpaḥ | tato 'vasthitam etad adhyakṣasādhyapratibandhāpekṣayā yajjātīyaṃ sanniveśādi prayatnavatā vyāptaṃ siddham, na tad bhūdharādau asti, yādṛśaṃ cāsti na tadvyāptaṃ siddham ity asiddhir anekānto veti |
etena yadāha Trilocanaḥ – nanu keyaṃ kṛtabuddhiḥ kiṃ sādhanabuddhir atha sādhyabuddhiḥ ? sādhanabuddhis tāvat bhavatāṃ siddhaiva, karmajaṃ lokavaicitryam ity abhyupagamād iti | athottaraḥ pakṣaḥ? tenāyam artho bhavati, nedaṃ kṣityādiṣūpalabhyamānaṃ sādhyānumānasamarthaṃ kāryatvam, kiṃ tv anyad eva sādhyabuddhyajananāt | na caitad yuktam, sarvānumānocchedaprasaṅgāt | dhūmādiṣv api hi śakyam evedaṃ vaktuṃ nāyaṃ vahnyanumitisamartho dhūmaḥ kiṃ tv anyad eva sādhyadarśinaḥ sādhyabuddhyajananāt | tathā ca tāvat sādhanaṃ na sidhyati yāvat sādhyabuddhir na sidhyati, yāvat sādhyabuddhir na sidhyati tāvat sādhanaṃ na sidhyatīti sphuṭaram itaretarāśrayatvam iti tannirastam |
na hi sākṣād asiddhicodanam idam, kiṃ tu yato na vyāvahārikasya kṛtabuddhiḥ sindhvādau ghaṭādivyāptiṃ smarato 'pi tato naikajātitvam iti jātibhedamātrasādhanam idaṃ syāt | tato viśiṣṭajātīyavyāptidvāreṇāsiddhir anekānto veti yuktam eva | tatra ca kṛtabuddhyabhāvo nāma sādhyabuddhyabhāvaḥ sādhanabuddhyabhāvo vety ubhayam api nirvyūḍham |
yad api bhūṣaṇakāraḥ, kṛtakatvena ca pratītau kathaṃ na kṛtabuddhiḥ? sarveṣāṃ prāsādādiṣu api kṛtabuddhir na bhavati, yathā cirantaneṣu prāsādādiṣu vyāptyabhijñasyaiva kṛtabuddhir bhavati, vyāptivimūḍhānām akṛtabuddhir eva, tathā kṣityādiṣv apīti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ | puruṣakṛtabuddhiḥ prāsādādiṣv iva kṣityādiṣu na sambhavatīti cet? kiṃ prasiddhāvinābhāvānām utāprasiddhāvinābhāvānām? prasiddhāvinābhāvānām api kiṃ vyāptigrahasmṛtivikalānām, athānyeṣām? abhraṣṭasmaraṇānāṃ tāvad bhavaty eva puruṣakṛtabuddhiḥ | loke api hi vicitraṃ jagat kenacid dhātrā nirmitam ity asti pratītiḥ | vyāptigrahasamṛtivimūḍhānāṃ
[305] api ceyaṃ vedeṣv api puruṣakṛtabuddhir mīmāṃsakānāṃ nāstīty ataś ca tatrāpi puruṣakṛtatvasādhanāyoktā vākyatvādayopy asiddhāḥ syūḥ | kiṃ cānityatvasiddhyarthaṃ yatkṛtakatvasādhanam uktam, tad apy asiddhaṃ syāt | na hi yādṛśyaṃ kṛtakatvādi ghaṭādiṣu dṛṣṭam śrotrāgrāhyatvarūpam, tādṛśyaṃ śabde 'stīti | tasmāt dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikavaidharmyam etat sarvānumāneṣu samānaṃ neśvarānumānasyaiva bādhakam iti, tad apy etenaiva pratyuktam |
yat punaḥ sādhyabuddhim adhikṛtya vikalpitaṃ kiṃ prasiddhānumānabhāvānām ity ādi | atra brūmaḥ | ya ekadā sūtradhārādivyāpāre devakulakalasādisambhavam upalabhya kālāntare kalasādisaṃdarśanāt puruṣakṛtim anumimīte sa kīdṛśo vaktavyaḥ, prasiddhāvinābhāvasmaraṇavān na vā? ādye pakṣe tasyaiva nācalādau puruṣakṛtabuddhiḥ, kulālānumānasyāpi prasaṅgād ity upapāditam | tat katham abhraṣṭadarśanānāṃ tadbhāvaniyamaḥ? tata eva vicitraṃ jagad ityādimatir api na vyāptigrahasmaraṇabalāt, kiṃ tu darśanāntaraprabhavapravādavaśāt, tamaśṛṇvatām abhāvāt, viparītavādavat |
vyāptivimūḍhānāṃ tv ity ādi siddhasādhanaṃ ca | udāharaṇam api pāpīyaḥ, kṛtabuddhyabhāvasya jātibhedamātropadarśanaparatvāt | na ca vādiprativādyapekṣayā tadbhāvābhāvacintety uktam, svayaṃ vā abhiniveśenānyathāpi saṃkalpasambhavāt | pratyakṣāpekṣayā tu vyāvahārikādhikāreṇa cinteyam | tasya cāviditavedādisaṃketasya vaidikavākye tatpraticchandena ca racitam aparaṃ śṛṇvato nipuṇam api nirūpayaś (nirūpayaāṃś) cintaya tāvat kīdṛśo viśeṣāvasāyaḥ, kalasakuliśādivat sarvaprakārāṇāṃ puruṣaiḥ kāraṇadarśanāt, pratyakṣasvabhāvānāṃ śabdānāṃ pratyakṣabhedakalpane dhūmādiṣv api prasaṅgāt | tataś ca,

 yadbhāvaḥ puruṣānvayavyatiricos tadbhāvabhājaḥ sthitā
nānyasmād vacasaś ca vaidikagirāṃ bhedo 'sti śakyātmanoḥ |
 tūlyātīndriyasūcanā ca niyataṃ naikatra cāśvāsanaṃ
vedas tena na pauruṣeyapadavīm aprāpya viśrāmyati ||

yadi tadā ko 'vakāśas tadbhāvasya pratyakṣamahāvaijātyeṣu śailādiṣu | tad etad āyātam,

 [306] ekaḥ kāryaviśeṣam eva kalayan hetor viśiṣṭaṃ nijaṃ
lakṣyāgner iva kāryamātram amunā vyāptaṃ mudhā manyate |
 tajjātīyakam eva kāryam aparo nāvaiti taddhetukam
hanta dhvāntaviśeṣa eṣa viduṣām adhyakṣavastuny api ||

na ca laukikavaidikavākyayor vaijātyasambhave samayamātreṇa parājetavyo Mīmāṃsakaḥ | na ca pratyakṣākṣiptavyāptikaṃ vākyatvam eva tatra śaraṇam | kṛtakatve tu yad uktaṃ tad api cintitaṃ cintayiṣyate cānantaram iti | nanu tathāpi tadvyāpte 'pi kārye kāryatvād dṛṣṭam itaratrāpīti yathā ghaṭādi prayatnavannāntarīyakam, tathā pṛthvīdharādy api syād iti cet? nanūktam atra kāryatvādi vidyamānam api tatrāśakyavyāptigrahatayodāsīnam eveti tenābhidyamānād api kāryāntarān na yatnavataḥ sparśo 'pi labhyate, kevalaṃ kāryaṃ kāryam iti śabdamātram abhidyamānam avaśiṣyate | tad yadi tad eva dvārāntareṇa śaraṇīkṛtam āyuṣmatā tatra sākṣād dūṣaṇāśravaṇāt, tadā tad api kākabhakṣaṇaprāyam ity ādarśayann āha:

 vastubhede prasiddhasya śabdasāmyād abhedinaḥ |
 na yuktānumitiḥ pāṇḍudravyādivad dhutāśane || (PV II 14)

etena yad apy uktaṃ, nāpy atra śabdasāmyād acetanopādānatvasya samāropeṇa sādhyasiddhiḥ, anityatvādinā kṛtakatvādiṣv iva pratyāsatter ihāpi vāstavatvāt | na ca jātibhedo dharmiṇor dharmayoḥ sarvatra vāstavīṃ pratyāsattiṃ bhinatti, kṛtakatvānityatvayoḥ śabdaghaṭajātibhedena pratyāsatter abhāvaprasaṅgād iti | tad apy anavakāśam | na hi nagādāv acetanatvasya sopādānatvasya samāropaṃ brūmaḥ | tanmātraṃ tu vyāptibahirbhāvād asatkalpam iti |
yadi cānyad evācetanopādānatvaṃ cetanāpekṣi siddham anyad eva cācalādau dṛśyata iti kiṃkṛto 'yaṃ vibhāga iti cet? upādhikṛtaḥ | kiṃ na bhinnadharmiṇor dharmayor apīti cet, na, vaiṣamyāt | acetanopādānaṃ dhūmasthānīyaṃ kāryahetvabhimānāt na ca kaścit tasya dharmibhedād bhedam āha - yadā tv acetanopādānatvād acalādau cetanāpekṣatvaṃ vivakṣitam, tadā dhūmatvena dhūmo vahnimān ity evamprāyā sthitiḥ | evaṃ ca sati dhūmadvaye dhūmatvayor bhedaḥ prasañjanīya iti kathaṃ sāmyam? evam evāstv iti cet, na, bhidyamāno hy upādhir upādhimantam
[307] api bhindyāt | bhedaś caikapratyavamarśabahirbhāvalakṣaṇo na dhūmam upādhiṃ spṛśati, yena svagataṃ bhinattu, yathā kumbhāmbhodharādir acetanatvopādānatvam ity acodyam etat |
nanu na dṛṣṭas tāvad dharmibhedena dharmabheda iti cet? yadrūpapuraskārena pratibandhasādhakapramānavṛttis tasyābhede bhidyamānāpi dharmijātir abhinnavad ābhāsamānā na bādhikā | tadbhede tu tadgataṃ dharmāntaram abhidyamānam api bhinnavad ābhāsamānaṃ na sādhakam iti nyāyaḥ | anyathā jaladharārthināpi kumbhakārasya paryeṣaṇāprasaṅgaḥ | tadapāye 'pi vihāyasi balāhakodayadarśanān neti cet, na, tatprabhavasyaiva ghaṭasyeva tasya maruto kṣepaḥ kiṃ na sambhāvyate? atha ca vāridhāritvamātram ubhayatra dṛṣṭam iti yathā tatra saṃjñābhedamātrabhedo vyavasthāpyate, tathātrāpīti yuktam | pratibandhaniścayo hi pramāṇaviṣayasvabhāvaniyame sati bhavati, tadviruddhāniyamarūpaṃ ca sādhāraṇatvam |
pramāṇapratibaddho hi niścayas tadviṣayasvarūpollaṅge 'pi bhavan pramāṇāpramāṇasādhyaḥ syāt | na caivaṃ, tasmān nānekāntaḥ | nāpy asiddhir adhyakṣavyāpārānusārāt | tad iha pānḍutvasyāgnivyabhicāro dṛṣṭa iti dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyaśūnyatāniṣedha eṣaḥ | ata eva nānumānam iti pratibandhābhāvād aniścayaphalam idam ubhayatra | na tu siddhavyāptikayor dahanapāṇḍutayor vyabhicāreṇa sādhanavaidhuryam, vyāptisiddhāv anumānāpavādasyāśakyasādhanatvāt vyabhicārasyaivāyogāt | sarvopasaṃhāravatī hi vyāptiḥ, tadbhāve tadbhāvaḥ kathaṃ syāt?
tato 'yam arthaḥ | yathā pāṇḍutvān nāgnimattve 'numānaṃ tasya tatrāpratibandhāt | sa ca vyabhicāreṇābhivyaktaḥ | anyathā tatrāpy anumānam aṅgīkrtyaiva svastham āsīt | sa ca vyabhicāraḥ pramāṇaviṣayasvarūpetarasādhāraṇaṃ dharmaṃ sarvam apratibaddhatve niyatam ādarśayatiti yathoktasādhāraṇatvākṛṣṭād apratibandhāt | tathaiva yathā kāryatvādimātrād api na cetanādhiṣṭhānānumānam iti | ato vyabhicāradarśanam upakārakam eva parasya | tasmāt pramāṇaviṣayasvarūpaparamārśāt tathāvidhopādhikam eva kāryatvādisādhanaṃ dhiya iti siddham | tathāvidhasya ca vāstava eva pratyāsattibheda iti saṃjñāmātraṃ śaraṇam āpatitam |
tena dharmijātibhedasya dharmabhedakatvaṃ siddham apīti kathaṃ sarvatra tanniṣedhaḥ? atha sarvatraiva yadbhedakatvaṃ tanniṣidhyate kvacid abhedakatvam apīty arthaḥ, tadā siddhasādhanam | uktaṃ hi pramāṇaviṣayasvarūpāpekṣayā tadubhayavsavasthānam iti | tathā ca sati bhedasthitir eva,
[308] kṛtakatvādisparśaś cāparibhāvakatayā kriyate | na hi tatrāpi pratyakṣabalād vyāptir upapādayituṃ śakyā, kiṃ tu viparyayabādhakānumānāt, tadabhāve 'nanumānasyeṣṭatvāt |
tato 'bhūtvābhavanābhidhānadharmamātrasya bhūtvābhavanena dharmeṇa vyāptisādhakaṃ dharmiṇo yadi jātibhedam udāsayati dhūmasyāgninā vyāptisādhakam eva mahānasādi, tadā prastute kim āyātam yatra pratyakṣavyāpārāpekṣayā jātibhedaniṣṭhaiva vyāptigṛhītirītir iti? yadi tu prakṛte 'pi kāryavastustomagatāḥ kāryatvādaya eva dharmāḥ pratītavyāptayaḥ syuḥ, tadāyaṃ na doṣaḥ | kevalam upāyaprakāradvayasyāpy ayogād ayuktaiva vyāptir iti darśitam | tatra viparyayabādhakapramāṇaparicayas teṣām asambhavo, bauddhagandher eva kasyacit tathā yatnadarśanāt | na ca prakṛte vaktuṃ śakya iti tatrāsthām avadhūya | pradeśāntare ca,

 nityaṃ sattvam asattvaṃ vetyādinā (PV II 180)

karaṇamātre viśeṣatyāgena kāryamātrapratibandhaṃ viparyayabādhakabalena sūcayato nirvṛttiṃ vidadhāno bhagavān vārtikakāraḥ parasya darśanādarśanamātreṇa vyāptivādinaḥ tadyogapratipādane pratyāsannaṃ pratyakṣānupalambhabalāv alambanam avalokayan tad āhatya dūṣayituṃ jātibhedakṛtaṃ dūṣaṇam udbhāvayatīti veditavyam | tasmāt pratyakṣavyāpārāvadheyajātibhedasyātyantaṃ vyaktatvāt saṃjñāmātraṃ śaraṇīkriyamāṇam apy akiñcitkaram ity uktam ||
athavā, astu ghaṭādyapekṣayā kṣoṇīdharādīnāṃ jātibhedo yataḥ, -

 siddhaṃ yādṛg (PV II 13)

ityādi ucyate | krīḍāparvatādayas tu pauruṣeyās tadekajātibhavāḥ, taiḥ sahaikahetavaḥ kiṃ na bhavanti? tato 'yam arthaḥ, yo yaḥ śailaḥ sa sarvaḥ pauruṣeyo yathā krīḍāśailaḥ śailaś ca kailāsa iti | evaṃ kulyāmahāsarovaraprabhṛtayo nadīsamudrādīnām udāharaṇāny ūhanīyānīty āśaṅkyāha,

 vastubhede prasiddhasyetyādi,

ayam arthaḥ, krīḍāparvatakādinirmitidṛśāṃ śailādiṣu jñānumānāpi nyāyasahā skhaladgati yatas tannāmamātraṃ samam |
[309] kiṃ cānekasamānamānavakṛtāḥ sidhyanty amī cen nagāḥ kā vārteśvarasādhanasya kim ihopāttaṃ samāptaṃ ca kim ||

jātibhede siddhe 'dhikaraṇasiddhāntanyāyānusāraḥ pūrayed api pratyāśām, abhede tu tad api nirāspadam | na hi sajātīyakumbhāntare tadvijātīyasya nirmituḥ siddhir ity anubhavāt abhyupagamād vā bhinnaiva jātir anayor na samānaṃ hetum āvahati saṃjñāmātrasāmye 'pīti | kaḥ punar ayaṃ niyamo ya uktaprakāradvayenaiva vyāptigraho nānyathety āśaṅkyāha,

 anyathā kumbhakāreṇa mṛddhikārasya kasyacit |
 ghaṭādeḥ karaṇāt sidhyet valmīkasyāpi tatkṛtiḥ || (PV II 15)

iti | na hi sudūramanusaratāpi sa kaścit pratibandhasādhanavidhir labdhavyo yaḥ kumbhakāreṇa mṛnmayamātravyāptiprasaṅgaparihārakārī prayatnavatā kāryamātravyāptiṃ sādhayiṣyatīti bhāvaḥ | kumbhakāreṇa hi kāryamātravyāptisādhanāya prabhavatas tadviśeṣamṛnmayasya sādhane kaḥ śaktivyāghātaḥ? astu vā prakāradvayenaiva vyāptigrahaḥ | yat tūktam,

 no bhedena vipakṣabādhakavaśād ityādi

tato 'nyathā bhaviṣyatīti āśaṅkya jaladharārthinā kumbhakāraparyeṣaṇāprasaṅgam uktam eva prakārāntareṇa sambhāvayann āha,

 anyathetyādi |

yadā hi bādhātmakoddeśenāpi pravartamānaḥ sāmānyenaiva vyāptiṃ sādhayati, tadā kuto mṛnmayāt kulālānumānaṃ kuryāt kāraṇamātrasya siddheḥ? yadāpi pratyakṣāpekṣayā hetuviśeṣeṇa kulālena karaṇavyāpāropadheyaviśeṣasya kumbhādikāryaviśeṣasya vyāptis tadāpi kutas tat prasaṅgaḥ? yadāpy adhyavasāyamātrāpekṣayā sāmānyena viśeṣasya tadāpy ayaṃ dūrataraḥ | evaṃ tu vyavasthāto 'nyathāvyāptigrahaṇe viśeṣeṇa sāmānyasya bhavatīti kathaṃ mṛnmayāt kulālānumānam aprasaṅgi? tatkāryakumbhādyapekṣayā atyantavisadṛśād api prasaṅge kathaṃ kiyatāpy aṃśena pratyāsannāt na syāt? tathā caivaṃ sajātīyād apy avāntarabhedānusāripratyakṣavyavasāyāpekṣayā nāumānaṃ pratibandhāniścayāt tadā kaiva vārtā vijātīyād? Atyantavijātīye dṛṣṭavyāptikasyeti daṇḍāpūpanyāya eṣa iti darśayituṃ mṛnmayagrahaṇam |
 [310] nanūbhayathā vyākhyāne 'pi vyabhicārād eva nānumānaṃ, tat katham atiprasaṅga iti cet? uktakrameṇopakāraka eva vyabhicāro 'smākaṃ na bādhakaḥ | tathā hi pramādvayavyāpārātikrame 'nantaraprakārabahirbhāve vā pratijñātapratibandhaniścayābhāvasādhaka eva vyabhicāra iti | api ca, vyabhicāro nāma sāmānyena gṛhītāyā vyāpter niyataviṣayāpekṣayā vighātam ātanoti, atha vyāptigrahaṇam eva tan na bhavatīti vibhāvayati, atha saty api vyāptiprasare 'numānamātraṃ khaṇḍayati, ata evābādhitaviṣayatvam api liṅgalakṣaṇam ākhyātam iti pakṣāḥ |
tatra prathamapakṣe sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ, anyatrāpi tadbalād eva sādhyapratyāśā, sā ca niścitāpi khaṇḍitā kvacid iti anyatrāpi śaṅkānivṛtteḥ, tata eva tadgrahaṇavaiyarthyāt |
dvitīye tu viśeṣaś cetane | yathā hi kumbhakāreṇa kāryasāmānyasya pratyakṣeṇa vyāptir gṛhītā vyabhicāreṇa durgṛhītā vyāvasthāpyate, tathā caitanyamātreṇāpi, tatrāpi pratyakṣavyāpāre viśeṣābhāvāt |
tṛtīye tu vyāptau satyām eva vyabhicāreṇānumānam apāsyata iti mahīyasīyam ayogaparamparā | kevalam atra pakṣe etad āpatitaṃ yadīdam atra sādhanaṃ sādhyaṃ vyabhicarya na sthitaṃ tadā sādhyaṃ sādhayatīti | etac ca sādhyavidhuraṃ sarvārthasākṣātkāriṇo nānyaḥ kartuṃ śaktaḥ | sa hi ya eva dharmī tathāvidhamadhyamadhiśayito na bhavati tam eva vā vyabhicāragocaratayā anumānabhājanīkaroti, sarvavipakṣānīkṣaṇe tu vyabhicāraś ca vyāptidurgrahaṇam eva sādhayatīti kāryamātravyāptiḥ prakṛtakāraṇaviśeṣeṇāsambhaviny eva sādhur iti |

 gṛhītāyāṃ vyāptau yadi vihatir āśvāsaviraho graho
nāsau vyāpter yadi ca na viśeṣo matimati |
abādhāpekṣāyāṃ na sakalavipakṣekṣaṇam ṛte
nirātaṅkas tasmān na khalu phalamātre grahavidhiḥ |

iti saṃgrahaḥ |
 kiṃ cādāya samastavastuviṣayāṃ vyāptiṃ punaś cen matā tattajjātiṣu bādhakakramavaśāt svavyāpya (svavyāpyatattat) sthitiḥ |
 [311]  tajjātiṣu sādhakakramavaśād unnīyate kiṃ na sā
yenāyāsakaśaktisaṃśayapadaṃ santo viśantīdṛśam ||

ity antaraślokaḥ |
aparigaṇito nāma vastuvyāpāraviṣayo 'parigaṇitatam astv aviṣayaḥ | tatra ka evam anātmīyakāryajātinikarasya pratyekaṃ vyabhicārāt dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā svakāryajātiṣv eva niyantuṃ hetum apāravyāpāraḥ pārayate? tathā ca sati yasyaiva sākṣād anīkṣito vyabhicāraḥ tadaiva tasya gamakam āśaktam | tadā śaṅkāsambhavān neti cet, na, kvacid atīndriye tarhi niścayam ayaṃ kuryāt | yajjatīyoddeśena pravṛttam adhyakṣaṃ sāmānyaviṣayam avasthātaṃ (avasthāpitaṃ) tatra kaḥ sandeha iti cet? evaṃ tarhi parāparatadīyavyāpyajātiṣu tathaiva saṃśayapravṛttipratyanīkapramāṇavṛttyanusaraṇe āyātas tṛtīyapādāpatito 'rthaḥ | tasmān na kāraṇaviśeṣeṇa buddhimatā kāryamātrasya vyāptiḥ pratyetuṃ śakyeti,

 siddhaṃ yādṛg (PV II 13)

ityādi siddhāntaḥ |
athavā yad uktaṃ na śarīranirapekṣaprayatnavanmātreṇa kāryasya vyāptiḥ pratipattuṃ pāryate, pratyakṣeṇa pratikṣepāt tādṛśasyetyādi, tad evopasaṃharati, -

 siddham iti

yādṛkṣo 'sau śarīrādiyogī adhiṣṭhātā ceti | śeṣaṃ subodham | tādṛśaś ca pratyakṣabādhādidoṣaviṣaya ity ākūtam | nanu śarīravaty api cetanatvaṃ dṛṣṭam itaratrāpi sambhavati iti yathā śarīriṇā vyāptam kāryādi sidhyati, tathābhimatenāpi ity atrāpi prāg uktanyāyāt saṃjñāmātrād avaśiṣyamānāt sādhanamanoratham unmathnann āha, vastubhede kumbhādau prasiddhasya kulālāder yā vācakaḥ śabgdaś cetana iti tanmātrād abhidyamānasyābhimatasya pramāṇavyāpārāpekṣayā dūrīkṛtasya na yuktānumitir iti vyāptābhimatāt vastuna iti prakṛtam arthāpannaṃ vā katham ivety āha,

 pāṇḍadravyādivad dhutāśana iti |

ayam abhiprāyaḥ, yadi śabdamātrasāmyenābhidyamānasyānumānaṃ śabdasāmyenābhidyamānād api pāṇḍumnaḥ kiṃ na dhūmadhvajasyānumānam? atha tatra viśiṣṭakāryasvabhāvāpekṣam
[312] adhyakṣam anyavyāptiṃ pratikṣipatīti nānumānam ucyate, tathā cetanamātrapratikṣepeṇāpi pratyakṣaṃ kiṃ na tad anumānaṃ nirasyati? etena yadā dṛśyam api kāryāntaraṃ tiraskaroti pratyakṣaṃ tadā kaiva kathā dṛkpathātiriktasya cetanamātrasyeti? astu tāvad vyāpyāpekṣayā vibhāga eva, loke tathaiva pratīteḥ, anyathātiprasaṅgāc ca |
vyāpakāpekṣayā tu yady eṣa niyamo na syāt ko doṣa ity āśaṅkyā pūrvoktam eveti prasaṅga bhaṅgyantareṇa taruṇayati, anyathety ādi | valmīkasyeti valmīkajantor ity arthaḥ | tatkṛtir iti ghaṭādikṛtiḥ | ayam arthaḥ, yadi viśeṣeṇāpi vyāptim avasāya cetanamātraṃ sāmānyam anumātavyam, tadā kumbhādikaraṇasya kulāle niyatasya cetanamātraparyavasitatvāt ghaṭāder api valmīkajantuḥ kartānumeyaḥ syāt, yathā hi kumbhādeḥ kumbhakāreṇa vyāptigrahaṇe caitanyamātreṇāviśeṣāt tasyāpy anumānam evaṃ valmīkaukaso 'pi caitanyenānyāviśeṣāt kiṃ nānumānam? yadā ca śarīriṇā vyāptigrahe śarīriṇo 'py anyasya pratikṣepaḥ, tadā (katiratyanteti mātṛkāsthaḥ pāṭhaḥ) ka vārtātyantavisadṛśasyeti | na cātra bahutvenopayogaḥ, ekātmano 'pi yaitanyād iti valmīkasyeti nirdeśaḥ | etena dhūmāder api jāṭharāder anumānākṣepo vyaktaḥ | vyabhicāracarcāyāṃ ca pūṛvavat sarvam āvartanīyam iti |
yad uktaṃ, prayatnavatā yad vyāptaṃ sanniveśādi tan na siddhaṃ sindhubhūdharādau, yac ca siddhaṃ tan na vyāptam iti tatraitat syāt, nanu jātyuttaram idaṃ dharmabhedavikalpanāt, tato yathā yat kṛtakaṃ tad anityaṃ ghaṭavad iti kṛte kaścid āha, yadi ghaṭagataṃ kṛtakatvaṃ hetus tad asiddhaṃ śabde, śabdagataṃ tv anityasaṃghāte ghaṭapaṭādāv abhāvād viruddham | atha sapakṣavad vipakṣe 'pi nāstīti matiḥ, tadā asādhāraṇam anaikāntikam iti | na ca tāvatā kṛtakatvaṃ tattvato 'śaktam eva anityatvasādhane, tathedam api | tathā hi yac ca siddhaṃ tan na vyāptam ity anena sapakṣāvṛtter virodhaḥ, vipakṣād api nivṛttipakṣe vā asādhāraṇatvam ākṛṣṭam iti | atha prakṛtakāryānurodhād adūṣaṇam evedam udghoṣyate? tathā sati kṛtakatvāder api asādhanatvaprasaṅgaḥ sūtrakāravirodhaś ca, kāryasamasaṃjñayā asya dūṣaṇasya tena pratijñānāt | yadāha,

 kāryatvānyatvaleśena yat sādhyāsiddhicodanam |
 tat kāryasamam etat tu tridhā vaktrabhisandhitaḥ ||

[313] iti upacāramātrakṛttvenānyatvasya leśa uktaḥ, vaktrabhiprāyeṇa traividhyaṃ ca darśitam iti |
tad etad ubhayam apy asāram, prathamapakṣasya tāvat pūrvam eva pratikṣepāt | uktaṃ hi vyāptisādhakapramāṇapuraskṛtasvarūpasyābhede bhidyamānā api sambandhino vidhūtabhedā iva bhāsamānā na bādhakaḥ | tasya tu bhede abhedino 'pi bhinnavad ābhāsamānāḥ kāryatvādayo dharmā na tadvyāpakasya sādhakā iti | vyāptigrahaṇaprakramaś ca dvividho darśitaḥ | tatra yadi nāśena kṛtakatvasyeva viparyayabādhakabalād buddhimatāpi kāryatvāder avinābhāvagrahaḥ syāt, tadā abhūtva bhavanamātram iva sanniveśādimātram adhikṛtya pravṛttaṃ pramāṇam iti kas tatra dharmibhedena bhindānaḥ sādhanaṃ śobheteti yujyate jātyuttaram iti |
yadi tu pratyakṣanupalambhavaśāt sanniveśādikam iva kṛtakatvam api vyāptam avadhāryeta tadā śabde 'pi śādhanatvaṃ kṛtakatvādeḥ kena nivāryeta, jātiviśeṣollekhenaiva pratyakṣānupalambhavyāpārasya pariniṣṭhitatvāt? anyathā dhūmagatā api kāryatvādayo jātiviśeṣānavacchedena dahanāvinābhāvinaḥ sidhyanto nāśakyaparihāram atiprasaṅgam upanīya svāsthyam āsādayeyuḥ | kāryāntarasya vyabhicāropakṣepo 'pi kṣodiṣṭhaḥ pratividhiḥ | tadā hi yatraiva sākṣād vyabhicārānupalambhaḥ tad eva sādhanaṃ jātam iti kiyal lāghavaṃ doṣabhārasya?
na ca vahnikāryāntarād api bhasmādeḥ svapnepy alabhyavyabhicārād dhūmaikakāryavyāptiṃ gṛhītapūṛviṇas tadanumānam astīty api niveditaprāyam | tasmād anukrāntapramāṇāpekṣayā dharmijātibhedadharmāṇāṃ bhedaka evābhyupagantavya iti katham ucyate jātyuttaram iti? nyāyavādinas tu sūtrakārasya,

 sādheynānugamāt kārye sāmānyenāpi sādhane |
 sambandhibhedād bhedoktidoṣaḥ kāryasamo mataḥ || (PV II 16)

ayam arthaḥ | yadā tāvad viśiṣṭaviṣaya eva vyāptigrahaḥ pratyakṣavyāpāropekṣayā tadā sambandhibhūtajātyantarabhedāt kāryatvāder bhedoktir doṣo bhavatu, nyāyaprāptatvāt | yadāpi vināśādinā sādhyena viparyayabādhakavaśāt sāmānyenābhūtvā bhāvitvamātram anugatam āsthāya sādhanam anuṣṭhīyate, tadāpi sambandhibhedād bhedoktidoṣaḥ, kvacid darśanāt pramāṇaparirotim
[314] anālocyocyate sarvakāryasamaḥ saṃmato 'smadguroḥ | anyadā tu sādhanasya doṣa eṣa ity adoṣaḥ | nanu tathāpi sarvopasaṃhāravatī vyāptir na siddheti siddham | na tu tāvatā sādhyāsiddhir eva, yadi paraṃ paramatānurodhena vyāptigraho nirvyūḍhaḥ |
asmākaṃ tu dṛṣṭāntadṛṣṭam eva rūpaṃ vyāptam avadhāryate yathā mahānasaparidṛṣṭaṃ dhūmaṃ dhvajādhīnam (dhūmadhvajādhīnam) avadhārya sādhyadharmigataṃ sāmānyenānupraviśyāpi sādhyadharmiṇi dhūmam upalabhya yatra dhūmas tatrāgnir dṛṣṭo yathā mahānasa iti evam agnim anumīmahe, tathā prayatnavatā ghaṭādijātīyamātrasyaiva vyāptisiddhāv api yatra kāryatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tatra prayatnavatā kṛtir iti vaktuṃ śakteḥ | tataś caivam api sādhyasiddher avirodhāt ko 'nurodhaḥ sarvopasaṃhāravyāptigrahaṇasya? maulasādhanānarthakyasādhanasyeti cet? evaṃ tarhi vyaktam idam āyātaṃ jātyantare vyāptim ādāya jātyantarād evānumānam iti | yadi paraṃ vyāpyaliṅgayoḥ saṃjñāsāmyam apekṣya, tathā ca sati na vastuliṅgam uktaṃ bhavati | kevalaṃ kāryādiśabdavṛttimātram eva | tac cāyuktam ity ādarśayann āha - prayatnavato,

 jātyantare prasiddhasya śabdasāmānyadarśanāt |
 na yuktaṃ sādhanaṃ gotvādvāgādīnāṃ viṣāṇavat || (PV II 17)

iti |
nanu kāryādīti na śabdamātrabhūtvā (śabdamātram, abhūtvā) bhāvitvasāmānyasyānugamasambhavāt, gośabdas tu svargādiṣu rucimātraśaraṇo na kiñcid artham anugamya vartate iti mahān viśeṣaḥ | etad api plavata eva, na hy abhūtvābhāvitvamātraṃ (nāntaravan nāntarīyakam iti mātṛkāyām) vannāntarīyakaṃ (prayatnavannāntarīyakaṃ) siddham, yena tadanugamasamāśrayaḥ phalaṃ syāt | siddhau ca punaḥ sa eva saropasaṃhāra iti kim anena parihṛtaṃ svīkṛtaṃ vā? tasmāt tad api sāmānyam kāryajātibhedena bhedam āveśayato na kaścid vastvanugama iti śabdamātram eva sādhanam āśritaṃ bhavatīti paśyāmaḥ | tataś ca na kaścid viśeṣo gatvena vāgāder viṣāṇasādhanād asyeti |
evaṃ dṛṣṭānte 'py ayam eva ślokaḥ | tadā ca jātyantara ity anyadhūmajanmani prasiddhasya vahner iti yojyam, yadi sarvopasaṃhāraparihāraḥ | yadā tu sarvam eva dhūmarūpam ekākārapratyavamarśavaśād ekīkṛtya vyāptim avadhārayati, tadā na śabdamātrasāmyam | sa eva vyāptaḥ
[315] artho 'trāpīti na sādhyasiddhivirodhaḥ | nāpy evaṃ maulahetuvaiphalyopalambhasambhavaḥ | na hi yatra yatra sādhanaṃ tatra tatra sādhyam iti sāmānyena pravṛttāpi buddhir abhimatadeśakālādibhedam āspadīkartuṃ prabhuḥ | ato viśeṣasya pravṛttinivṛttiviṣayīkaraṇāya na pakṣadharmam anālambyāsituṃ śaknuyāt | tat katham aphalaṃ maulam aṅgam?
tasmād vyāptigrahe sarvopasaṃhāraparihāriṇo 'pi dhūmo 'pi nāgner anumāpaka iti lābham icchato mūlasyāpi nāśaḥ | na hi yatraiva dhūmajanmani vyāpṛto vahnir upalabdhas tad eva deśāntare 'pi, kevalaṃ so 'pi dhūmaśabdavācyo 'yam apīti śabdasāmyam avatiṣṭhata iti na gotvena vācaḥ śṛṅgasādhanād asyāpi kaścid viśeṣaḥ | nanu tathāpi kīdṛśī punar iyaṃ vācaḥ śṛṅgasiddhir adhyakṣakṣiptatvāt svayam eva hi,

 vyasto hetor anāśrayaḥ

ity abhichīyata iti cet? satyam iyān apy abhūyaḥ sambhavī bhavata iti mahān lobho 'smākam | kadācid evaṃ pratiṣedhataḥ saṃjñāmātrato 'pi sādhyasiddhipratyāśā parigalayatīti citraṃ cātra yac chāstrapariśramānurūpam,

 mānagras te girāṃ śṛṅge sādhanaṃ neti paśyataḥ |
 saṃjñāmātreṇa sādhyasya siddhiḥ kasmāt samīhitā ||

yan na gopālāṅganājanasyāpi sāmpratam, evaṃ ca samīhamānas tad api śraddadhīteti tadanurūpam uttaraṃ parihāsaparam abhidadhāno vacasi viṣāṇānumānena sakalam anucitānumānamātram upalakṣayati | yadā hi dahanādīnām api gardabhādibhyo 'pi labhyāvakāśam anumānaṃ tadā kasya kasmād apratītir ity ākūtam, yadi paraṃ sākṣād adhyakṣabādhā mā bhūt? nanu vyāptavastusādhāraṇābhidhānavṛttes tadvyāpiniścayaprasaṅgaprakrame ko 'vakāśo gardabhād dahanānumānasya? na hi dahanvyāptavastusādhāraṇā dhūmabhasmādiśabdā gardabhe sambhavina iti cet, na, vastvādiśabdenāpi śabdasāmyasiddher ity etac ca,

 pāṇḍudravyādivad dhutāśane

ity anenaiva prativarṇitam antarṇīya pakṣāntareṇa toṣayann āha,-

[316] vivakṣāparatantratvān na śabdāḥ santi kutra vā |
 tadbhāvād arthasiddhau tu sarvaṃ sarvasya sidhyati || (PV II 18)

etena gardabhādiṣv api tāvad eva dhūmādiśabdānām asambhavo yāvan na samayasamīhā | tato 'numānābhāvo 'pi dhūmādiśabdāpravartanāvadhika eva | pravṛttau tu kaḥ sādhyaṃ ruṇaddhīty uktam | na tv evaṃ vastuni sādhane | tathā hi,

 avinābhāvaviṣayān na vinābhāvasambhavaḥ |
 vivakṣāparatantratvān na śabdāḥ santi kutra vā ||

vāśabdo yathārthe |

 tadbhāvād arthasiddhau tu sarvaṃ sarvasya sidhyati ||

na tu pratibuddhavastuvṛttitaḥ sādhyasiddhāv abhimatāyāṃ śabdādivat sarvasiddhiḥ ullaṇṭhamātraphalā, kiṃ tu tattvata eva vyāpakasya sarvasiddhir iti bhāvaḥ | tad evaṃ dṛṣṭāntadṛṣṭamātrasya vyāptivacane vacanasāmyamātraparatantrā siddhir asiddhir evāpatatīti tāttvikasiddhinibandhanavastusādhanānveṣiṇā sarvopasaṃhāriṇy eva vyāptir upapādayitavyā | sā ca dvidhāpi na sanniveśādibhyo buddhimato 'numānaṃ mānabhājanīkaroti | tanmātrasiddhāv api vā nābhimatā viśeṣasiddhiḥ, yataḥ śreyo 'rthibhir ity artham abhidhīyamānam īśvarābhidhānasya kovidair ādriyeteti saṃkṣepataḥ prakaraṇārthaḥ | tasmāt sthitam etat, tādṛśī pramāṇasaṃmate anitye 'py apramāṇateti ||

 || īśvaravādādhikāre vārtikasaptaślokīvyākhyānāṃ samāptam ||

KĀRYAKĀRAṆABHĀVASIDDHIḤ

[317,3] pratyakṣānupalambhena trividhenāpi sidhyati |
[317,4] kāryakāraṇayor ātmā pañcakeneti kecana ||1||
[317,5] pratyakṣānupalambhasādhanaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāva iti nyāyaḥ | tatra sāmānyena prākpravṛtta-
[317,6] anupalambhasahāyam ubhayaviṣayaṃ krami pratyakṣadvayam | yadi vā sāmānyenobhayagrāhi-
[317,7] pratyakṣasahāyaṃ kramikam anupalambhadvayam iti trividham eva tatsādhanam ity eke | anye tu tat
[317,8] trayam antyadvayashāyam eveti pañcavidhaṃ niyatānupūrvīkam ity āhuḥ | ādyatrayasambhave 'pi hi
[317,9] pratipattur nāsandhigdhā buddhir upajāyate, antyadvaye tu labdhe sidhyati | anvayavyatireka-
[317,10] lakṣaṇo hi hetuphalabhāvaḥ, tatra trayeṇānvayaḥ pratīyate, dvayena vyatireka iti
[317,11] pañcakena sādhvī siddhiḥ | tayor ekaikāniścaye tu sandeho durnivāra iti bhāvaḥ |
[317,12] atra ucyate,
[317,13] prācīnānupalambhaś ced anyataḥ saṅgamādikam |
[317,14] na niṣedhati, kiṃ tena niṣedhe paścimena kim ||2||
[317,15] anupalambhadvayena vyatirekasādhanārtham eva hy anupalambhaḥ prārthyate | sa cānena
[317,16] hetvabhimatābhāve kāryābhimatasya bhāvaṃ bādhamānena sādhanīyaḥ | sa ca bhāvas tridhā
[317,17] sambhāvyate | tatraiva deśe sthitiḥ, anyata āgamanaṃ, tadviviktakalāpād evotpattir iti |
[317,18] evaṃvidhabādhāvaidhurye kim atra kāraṇam ayam apekṣate? na vyatireke 'syopayogaḥ | kiṃ tv anvayagrāhiṇi pratyakṣe sāhāyakam āvahatīty upadarśitam eveti cet?
[317,19] asmin satīdaṃ bhavatīty akṣajena gataṃ na kim |
[318,1] na hi bhāve bhāvād anyo nāmānvayaḥ | sa ca siddho 'dhyakṣeṇeti kim atrānupalambha-
[318,2] sāhāyyena? nanv evam anyo yadṛcchopanatasyāpi syāt pratyakṣamātrasambhavāt | prāgabhāva-
[318,3] grahaṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ tu pratyakṣaṃ tadgrāhīti nātiprasaṅgaḥ (55a) sa tarhi trividhabheda-
[318,4] bhinnabhāvaviparyayasvabhāvaḥ, prāgabhāvo 'nupalabdheḥ, siddho 'bhāvamātraṃ vā? ādye pakṣe etad āyātam,
[318,5] asmin satīdaṃ bhavati,
[318,6] anyathā 'sambhavād iti vyatireko 'yam eva saḥ ||3||
[318,7] na sthitaṃ tatra nānyasmāj jātaṃ nāyātam anyataḥ |
[318,8] yasya bhāve bhavet kāryaṃ na cet tasya na kasyacit ||4||
[318,9] etac cānupalabdhipūrveṇa siddham adhyakṣeṇeti na kiñcit paścimadvayena | tad api hi
[318,10] hetvabhāve phalasya tatra sthitim anyata utpattim anyayatnenānyatra gamanam bādhamānam eva
[318,11] vyatirekasādhanam, na pāścāttyadvayam ity eva, tadvyāpārābhāve śatenāpy abhāvāt | tac cādi-
[318,12] mena ekena kṛtam iti nāparasyopayogaḥ |
[318,13] atha punar abhāvamātram ādimo 'nupalambhaḥ pratyetīti matiḥ,
[318,14] abhāvamātrabādhe 'pi prācyasyānupayogitā |
[318,15] asyaitadvyāpṛteḥ prāg ity evaṃ kim avaśiṣyate ||5||
[318,16] abhāvamātrapratītau tāvat kasya kenānvayaḥ? asya bhāve 'sya bhāva ity apy anvaya-
[318,17] pratītir yadṛcchopanatenātiprasajyamānopayogaparipanthiny eva | etadvyāpārāt pūrvam abhāvaḥ asyeti tu pratītau saiva trayī gatir āyāteti kiṃ pariśiṣyate, yato 'ntimam advayaṃ na vaiphalyam
[318,18] āvahet?
[318,19] anvaye vyabhicārāc ced vyatireko 'nugamyate |
[318,20] pratyakṣamātravyāpāre 'py evaṃ kiṃ nābhidhīyate ||6||
[318,21] yad artham arthyeta prāktanaḥ anvayavyatirekau hi pratyekaṃ vyabhicārād eva sahitau
[318,22] hetuphalabhāva ucyate | tata ekaikasyātadbhāviny apy sambhavo 'bādhaka eveti samānam āvayoḥ |
[318,24] samarthitaḥ |
[319,1] tato nāntyayor ādimasyopayogaḥ, ādye vāntimayor iti siddham | na siddham |
[319,2] ādimena hi prāg asya vyāpārād etan nāsīd iti pratiyann api etadvyāpāraprayukto 'syābhāva-
[319,3] iti nāvadhāritam, carameṇa tv avadhāryata ity ayuktam, ādimasya punar anupayogasya tādavasthyāt |
[319,4] api ca,
[319,5] tanmātrābhāvato 'bhāvāt paścimena viniścayaḥ ||
[319,6] tannyāyasya samānatvāt prācyenāpi na kiṃ mataḥ ||7||
[319,7] etadvyāpārāt prāg nāsīd ity api hi tanmātrābhāvād evābhāvaṃ khyāpayati, yathokta-
[319,8] sattātraividhyavidhūter ākṣepāt | tatas tenāniścaye paścimenāpi mā bhūt | tatra pūrvena dvayoḥ
[319,9] abhāvasya sannidhimātram, naikasyānena prayuktir iti paśyataḥ paścime 'pi ka āśvāsaḥ?
[319,10] tadanāyattau tadabhāve 'pi utpattiprasaṅge dvitīyābhāvasyāyogaḥ samānaḥ | atha vahni-
[319,11] rāsabhayor āgamanānantarajanmano 'pi dhūmasya gardabhābhāve 'py abhāvaḥ prācyenānubhūyata
[319,12] ity ucyate | ubhayāpagame 'pagacchataḥ paścāttanenāpi, ity aparāparopāyaparamparānusāreṇa
[319,13] pañcakavyavasthāhāniḥ | tathā sati trayaṃ, na dvayaṃ iti cet? paścimenāpi na śakyate
[319,14] ity etāvad ucyate | sa tu dvayos trayor veti (55b) kim anena? asty upayogo dvayasyānyasya
[319,15] apy abhāve niścayāyogād iti cet? yadaiva tarhi kevale hetvabhāve 'nupalambhas tadaiva prācyaḥ
[319,16] api samartha iti kiṃ neṣyate? no cet? sarvathānupayogād ity uktam, anyathā pratyakṣam api
[319,17] trayaṃ, na dvayam iti vaktuṃ śakyatvāt | ki(kiṃ) ca pañcavādinaḥ samānasamayatayaivāvibhāgāt
[319,18] prācyo 'nupalambha eka iṣṭaḥ | sa cāgnigardabhāpagame 'stīty anantaradhūmānupalambhāpekṣayādyāpi
[319,19] dvaitam eva |
[319,20] api ca,
[319,21] prāg adṛṣṭau kramāt paśyan veti hetuphalasthitim ||
[319,22] dṛṣṭau vā kramaśo 'paśyann anyathā tv anavasthitiḥ ||8||
[320,1] tattadāśaṅkānirākaraṇārtham uttarottarapūrvapūrvopalambhānupalambhaparyeṣaṇāprasakteḥ | tatra
[320,2] yatheṣṭaṃ trayādivyavasthā kriyatām | na tu pratyakṣaṃ madhyam adhivāsyānupalambhayoḥ kaścid
[320,3] upayogaḥ anyaśaṅkane dvayor apy anāśvāt, tadvivecane caikenaiva siddheḥ |
[320,4] tasmāt,
[320,5] pratyakṣānupalambhābhyām anvayavyatirekayoḥ |
[320,6] niścaye saṃśayo nāma kīdṛk hetuphalasthitau ||9||
[320,7] arthāntaratve tayor eva tadbhāvarūpatvāt | tayoś ca na pratītiniyamaḥ kaścit,
[320,8] dvidhāpi siddheḥ | syād etat, vyatirekadārḍhyād evaṃ vyavasthā | atas tadgrahiṇo 'nupalambhasya
[320,9] anvayaviṣayapratyakṣātivṛttir ucitaiva | na nāntarīyakatvam eva hi pramāṇasya prameye
[320,10] draḍhimānam āropayati | na bāhulyam pramāṇābhāseṣv api darśanāt | eka eva ca dṛśyānupalambhas
[320,11] tadabhāve 'tyantam abhāvasādhanasādhur iti kim adhikadhāvanena? na hi tadā
[320,12] gandho 'pidhūmasya sambhāvanīyaḥ | nanu bhūyasām abhāvāt kasyābhāve na bhūto dhūma iti
[320,13] niścetavyam iti cetata evānvayagrāhipratyakṣam apekṣyate anyābhāvaprayuktatve
[320,14] hy etadabhāvasya, nāsya sambhavam ayam ādriyeta | evam anvayagrahaṇapūrvake 'pi niścaye bhūyasāṃ sambhavāt kasya bhāvaprayukto 'sya bhāva iti jijñāsāyām anupalabdher yadabhāvaprayukto 'syābhāvaḥ
[320,15] samprati tadbhāvaprayuktaḥ prāg apy asya bhāva iti sidhyati | tatra vaikaikasyopanaye 'panaye
[320,16] vā tathā pratipattuṃ śakyam | tathā ca sati prācyasya paścimasya vā vyatirekasiddhau śaktiḥ,
[320,17] anekopanayādau tu dvitayasyāpy aśaktir iti sthitam ||
[320,18] avyāpinī ceyaṃ pañcakavyavasthā | bhasmānalakalasakumbhakārādiṣu paścimābhāvāt,
[320,19] nīrādhārādiṣu ca prācyābhāve 'pi siddhaḥ | tathā hi sati setau payaḥpūra-
[320,20] sthemānam upalabdhavatas tadbhāve tadbhāvadarśitas tayor hetuphalabhāvaniścayaḥ prācyānapekṣa
[320,21] eva | tadvad anyatrāpi trikāpekṣa eveti veditavyam |
[320,22] atha prāg adṛṣṭvā vahnisannidhau dhūmadarśane vahnim apekṣyānya eva janayatīti ki(kiṃ) na
[320,23] kalpyate? evam api vahneḥ kāraṇatvam evendhanasyeva | evaṃ tarhy anyasyāpi yadṛcchāsannihitasya
[321,1] gardabhādeḥ kāraṇatvam astu, tataś ca tasyāpi dhūmād anumānaprasaṅga iti cet? tat
[321,2] kiṃ vahneḥ kāraṇatvaniścaya (56a) ity evaṃ gardabhasyāpi? atha pratyakṣānupalambhayos tatrāpi
[321,3] vṛtteḥ ubhayasyāpy ayogāt | na cānyasya tathā niṣedhāya trayāśrayaṇam, api tu
[321,4] vahner vidhaye | sa ca siddha ity anyasyāniṣedho 'bādhaka eva | ananumānaṃ tu kāraṇatvā-
[321,5] niścayād eva | na kadācid agnim apekṣya gardabhaḥ karotīti śaṅkaiva niścayo virodhāt,
[321,6] tasyāḥ saṃśayarūpatvāt | tanniṣedho 'pi tasyaiva parīkṣayā nānyasyety asthānam evaṃvidha-
[321,7] pralāpasya | nanu tathāpi vahniḥ kāraṇam ity avadhāraṇānupapatter dusthaiva sthitiḥ | na hi vahnir
[321,8] eva kāraṇam, anysyāpy anirākaraṇāt, indhanasyāpi paramārthataḥ kāraṇatvāc ca | na ca
[321,9] kāraṇam eva, anārabdhadhūmasyāpi sambhavād iti na codyam, dvividhasyāpi vyavacchedasya
[321,10] siddheḥ |
[321,11] tathā hi,
[321,12] sāmagryapekṣayānyasya cchede dravyavyapekṣayā |
[321,13] yogyatāyām ayogasya siddho 'tyantaṃ ca karmaṇi ||10||
[321,14] yadā hi dahanaśabdena tadupalakṣitā sāmagrī samāsenābhidhīyate, tadā sa eveti anya
[321,15] yogavyavacchedaḥ | yadā tu dahanadravyam eva tadāpi kāraṇatvam nāma yadi yogyatā, tadā
[321,16] kāraṇam evety ayogavyavacchedaḥ | atha kriyaiva, tadāpi bhavaty evety atyantāyogavyavacchedaś ca
[321,17] siddhaḥ | sa cāyam iyān vyāpāras trividhasyaiva pratyakṣānupalambhasya śakya iti yuktam atra bhāge
[321,18] bhaṭṭārcaṭapādavyākhyānam eva |
[321,19] bhagavato vārttikakārasyāpi svayam eva,
[321,20] kumbhasya kumbhakāreṇa karaṇaṃ bhasmano 'gninā |
[321,21] śāstrādinā vraṇādeś ca bruvato matam eva tat ||1(11)||
[321,22] kathaṃ punaḥ kāryatvāviśeṣād iva bhasmano 'pi nāgner anumānam? na, deśakālādya-
[321,23] pekṣayā abhimatatvāt | tathā hi;
[321,24] kim apy udayamātrāya kāryaṃ hetum apekṣate |
[321,25] prabandhasthitaye 'py anyat kālavit tadapekṣayā ||12||
[322,1] tatra kalasabhasmādibhyo janmany evāpekṣitaparebhyaḥ, ata evārthāntarāpekṣaprabandha-
[322,2] vaidhuryebhyaḥ, atīta eva hitusannidheḥ kālaḥ śakyaniścayo, na tu vatramāna iti na pravṛttyādi-
[322,3] saṅkaraḥ | uttarebhyaś ca dhūmālokādibhyo daśāviśeṣāpekṣānapekṣaprabandhavaidhuryebhya upādāna-
