YOGINIRṆAYAPRAKARAṆAM

  [323,3] yad yad bhāvyate tat tad bhāvanāprakarṣaparyante sphuṭābhaṃ sambhavati | yathā kāmukasya kāminyākāraḥ | bhāvyante ca paramapuruṣārthinā kṣaṇikatve nairātmyādayo vastudharmā iti | atredaṃ cintyate bhavatu bhāvanayā mānasya sphuṭābhatā, kevalaṃ bhūtābhūtārthasādhāraṇatvād bhāvanodbhūtavaiśadyasyāpi saṃvādaniyamānupapatteḥ kutaḥ prāmāṇyam iti kathaṃ pratyakṣatā yogijñānasyeti?
[323,8] athānumānavyavasthāpitavastubhāvanāyās tadvyabhicāraśaṅkāvirahāt tajjasyāpi jñānasya kutaḥ śaṅkāvakāśa iti cet? āstāṃ tāvad anumānapauruṣapratyāśā, pratyakṣeṇāpi vidyuddahanādikaṃ gṛhītvā bhāvanāprakarṣaparyantajātaṃ sthirataratadākāraṃ ca jñānaṃ bhaved yāvan na viparītabhāvanābhiyogaparyantaḥ | astaṃ gataś ca tadviṣaya iti kathaṃ pramāṇopanītavastugocaratve 'pi saṃvādāśvāsaḥ? anastaṅgame 'pi vā tāvatkālam analasya nāvasthāniyamaḥ | samudrāder apy evaṃ | mahīruhādīnāṃ cālpālpakālena vaisadṛśyaṃ dṛśyate | mahīdharādīnāṃ ca dahanāśaniprabhṛtibhiḥ | bhāvanā tu yām avasthām abhiniviśya bhavati tadekāvasthāniyataḥ sphuṭābhāva iti tadviṣayāpekṣayā bhrāntir ākārabhedād iti na prāmāṇyaṃ na ca pratyakṣatā | yadā ca hālika eva havyāśanam anumāya bhāvanayā sphuṭayet, tadā na tad yogijñānaṃ paramārthaviṣayatvābhāvād iti pratyakṣāntaraprasaṅgaḥ |
[323,18] atrocyate | na hi tāvad iyam anantarāśaṃkā sambhavinī | bhāvanā hi rāgaśokādyāveśād vā svayam upanamet, prayojanānurodhād vā prekṣavatā saṃcintyārabhyeta? tatra paramaprayojanavārtāvirahād dāhapākādimātram anumitenaiva hutabhujā taddeśopasarpaṇāt siddham, anupamṛṣṭadeśe 'pi bhāvanāvaiphalyam | punastāt tu bhāvite parisphurati tadarthāpekṣayā bhrāntiḥ | evaṃ śokādyupanatāyām api bhāvanāyām | tat kathaṃ pratyakṣāntaraprasaṅgasaṅgatiḥ?
[323,23] astu vā yathā kathañcit tādṛgarthabhāvanā, śirasi śṛṅgabhāvanāvat | athāpy abhramapakṣe yogijñāna evāntarbhāvaḥ | yogo hi samādhir manasa ekāgratālakṣaṇa iti na doṣaḥ | śṛṅgākārasphuṭobhāve tu pṛthvī kṛtsnetyādivad apratyakṣataiva nirālambanatvāt |
yad vārttikam,

tatra pramāṇaṃ saṃvādi yat prāgnirṇītavastuvat |
tad bhāvanājaṃ pratyakṣam iṣṭaṃ śeṣā upaplavāḥ || (PV II 286)

[324,4] yat punar astaṃ gate 'pi vastunyākārāntarabhāji vā sthirākāratayā bhāvanā, yasya nirālambanatvam āpāditaṃ sarvasya, tad api vastubhāvanāpakṣe śobhate, na vastudharmabhāvanāpakṣe | vastudharmāś ca kṣaṇikatvādayaḥ saṃsāravairāgyāt sphuṭībhāvabhājo bhāvayitum upakrāntāḥ | athaikatra pramāṇapariśuddhe 'pi bhāvanājanitavaiśadyasya vastuni visaṃvādasaṃdarśanād anyatrāpi ka āśvāsaḥ, pramāṇapariśuddhim antareṇāśvāsahetor apy asyābhāvāt, tasyāś ca saṃvādaniyatāv asāmarthyāt? tan na, sthirāsthiraviṣayatvena viśeṣāt | asthiraṃ hi vastu pradhvaṃsavikārābhyāṃ grasyata iti na saṃvādaḥ, vastudharmāstu kṣaṇikatvādayo na kadācid vicchidyanta iti tadviṣayaḥ sphuṭībhāvaḥ sarvadā sālambana eva |
[324,8] nanv etad api na yuktam | na hi kṣaṇikatvādikaṃ nāma kiñcid asti vastu, sattve vā tad eva nityam asāktam iti sarvam ayatnaśīrṇam | avastutve ca tad eva nirālambanatvam | tasmād bhavanmate 'pi kṣaṇikatvaṃ nāma kṣaṇikā eva bhāvarāśayo 'parāmṛṣṭabhedāḥ bhedāntaratiraskāreṇocyante | tathā ca sati kṣaṇikatvabhāvanety api kṣaṇikapadārthasārthabhāvanety evārthaḥ | tāvatā tāny eva vastūni bhāvyamānāni sphuṭībhavantīti sa eva doṣaḥ | athābhinnāny api kṣaṇikatvādīni bhinnānīva tāvatpratibhānti? tathāpy adhyavasāyād vastugatāny eva bhāvyanta iti na taddoṣānmuktiḥ, taṭasthatayā bhāvayitum aśakyatvāt | tathā ca truṭyadrūpam etad vastujātam ity ayam evākāro bhāvanāyāḥ |
[324,21] tat kathaṃ vastutattvabhāvanāpekṣe 'pi vastusaṃsparśaparihāraḥ? parihāre cāvastvantarabhāvanaiva syān na dharmabhāvanā | satyam | yady api vastutattvabhāvanayāpi sāmānyenākṣiptaṃ vastu, tathāpi na tasya sphuṭībhāvaḥ, tattvamātratātparyaparyavasānāt | tattvabhāvanaiva hi sphuṭībhavantī saṃsārāpasāraṇasaraṇiḥ | na hi kāminīkalevaraṃ sākṣātkṛtaṃ rāgasaṃkocam ācarati, kiṃ tv anityaduḥkhāditvam eva | atas tatraiva tātparyāt tad eva vaiśadyam āpadyate bhāvanayā, na vastu | nanu tatra tārparye 'pi vastudharmaḥ sphuṭībhavati na vastv iti kā saṅgatiḥ, bhāvanayā dvayor api kroḍīkaraṇāt? kīdṛśo vā dharmiṇam aspṛśato dharmamātrasya sphuṭībhāvaḥ? tadetadākāśacitraṇam na khalu hālikasyāpi pratyayam ātanoti |
[325,1] naiṣa doṣaḥ, dharmiṇaḥ sphuṭībhāvam aspṛśato 'pi dharmamātrasya sphuṭībhāvadarśanāt | kevalaṃ vastupratyāsattyanapekṣya na sphuṭasphuraṇam iti syāt | sphuṭībhāvo 'pi tasya tadviṣayasannidhau yatnam anapekṣya jhagiti tajjñāne tattadākārasphuraṇaṃ nāma, vastupratyāsattyapekṣā tu na kṣīyate, dharmatvād eva, priyatvādivat | tathā hi nimbarasādau tāvat priyatvam abhyasyamānaṃ sphuṭībhavad dṛṣṭam | na ca nimbādeḥ sa dharma iti tadbhāvanayā nimbādy api svajanmadeśasthaṃ rasanāprasaṅgi vā sphuṭaṃ sphurad asti yāvan na viparyayabhāvanābhiyogaprakarṣaḥ | na ca sphuṭībhūtaṃ priyatvam api taṭastham upalabhyate nimbādyanubhavam anapekṣya kiṃ tu yadā yadā nimbādyanubhavaḥ tadā tada jhagiti priyatvam anubhavaviṣayaḥ, na prāgivodvejakam anubhayaṃ vety eṣa eva dharmasphuṭībhāvārthaḥ |
[325,9] tathā hi kāminyādivastuni sphuṭībhūte 'pi na yathā samayasiddhas tattvasphuṭībhāvaḥ, tathā tattvabhāvanayāpi na vastusphuṭībhāva ubhayoḥ parasparāvyabhicāre 'pīti kīdṛśo doṣaḥ? atha na bāhyadharmaḥ priyatvam asādhāraṇatvād bhāvanādheyatvāc ceti cet? kasya punar ayaṃ dharmo 'stu priyatvādiḥ pratyātmavedyatvenāpahnotum aśakyaḥ? jñānasya cet? bāhyasya priyatvam abhayasyamānaṃ jñānasya sphuṭībhavatīti ka eṣa nyāyaḥ? utkṛṣṭam idaṃ nimbād iti bhāvanākāro 'pi na tajjñānam utkṛṣṭam iti | athāpi jñānasyaiva priyatayā sphuṭībhāve na jātu kaścidapriyam anubhavet | na hi bahir iva jñānam api kādacitkasannidhānam | jñānasyāpi kasyacid eva priyatvavyaktir iti cet? kiṃkṛtaḥ punar ayaṃ vibhāgaḥ? yady abhyāsakṛtaḥ, yatraivābhyāso bāhye tatraiva bhavatu | tadanapekṣāyāṃ kasyacid api pratyāsattiviprakarṣābhāvān manomātram adhiṣṭhānībhūtam iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ |
[325,19] bāhye tu viśiṣṭajātinimbādikam abhyāsaviṣayīkṛtam iti nātiprasaṅgaḥ | jñānam api tarhi bhāvitanimbagocaram eva pratyāsannam iti viśeṣaḥ | evaṃ tarhīdam āyātam, yad vastu kenacid rūpeṇa bhāvyate tadvastu vihāya tatpratyāsannasya sphuṭībhāva iti kāminīṃ bhāvayatas tatprayāsann asya pitrāder eva sphuṭībhāvaprasaṅgo na kāminyāḥ | atha viṣayasya viṣayiṇā jñānena saha viśiṣṭaiva kācitpratyāsattiḥ? evam api nimbe priyatayā abhyasyamāne tajjñānaṃ priyatayā sphuratīti nimbādikaṃ prāgvadapriyam eva bhavet | tato yathā sarpādāv apriye parihārāṅgatayā tanniścayaḥ priya eva na sarpādis tathedam apīti kṛtaṃ bhāvanayā |
[325,26] atha bhāvanābalāt priyakāram eva tadviṣayaṃ jñānam upajāyata iti kalpanā? evaṃ sati nimbarasaḥ priyo bhāvyata iti tadviṣayajñānam eva priyākāraṃ bhāvyata ity āpannam | sphuṭābhatāpi tasya tadviṣayopanidhau tadgrahijñānasya jhagiti yatnam anapekṣya priyākārasphuraṇaṃ, na viṣayasyaivāsannihitasya sākṣādbhāvaḥ | evaṃ kṣoṇīdharādayo 'pi kṣaṇino bhāvyanta iti tadviṣayajñānam eva kṣaṇikākāraṃ bhāvyata iti | tasyāpi sphuṭībhāvo bhūdharādisannidhau tadgrāhakasya kṣaṇikākārodayo na bhūdharāder asannihitasyāpi sphuṭībhāvaḥ | iyam eva dharmabhāvanā śabdārthaniṣṭhaniṣṭheti na prastutavastukṣatiḥ |
 [326,6] vastutas tu priyatvaṃ nāma sukhakaratvam | tatra yadviṣaye yasya priyatvabhāvanā taccittasantānaṃ bhāvanāpariṣkṛtam upādānam upādāya sa viṣayaḥ sahakārī sukham utpādayatīti sthitau na sarvaṃ priyatvam | tatra prīṇakatvaṃ tu tasyaiva dharmaḥ, sarvaṃ ca prīti na doṣaḥ | sa cābhyāsād eva | evaṃ kṛpādiṣv api mānaseṣu dharmeṣu yojyam | duḥkhinam uddharāmīti duḥkhiparoddharaṇabhāvanāyāḥ sphuṭībhāvas tadviṣayasannidhau jhagiti tadjñānaṃ tadanurūpānuṣṭhānaprasavahetuḥ | evaṃ śucikapālabhāvānāyām api nairghṛṇyasphuṭībhāvo nāma karparopasarpaṇe veditavyaḥ | na tu sambandhinaiva pratyāsannennetareṇa vā sahasphurattā | yathoktaṃ sarvajñasiddhau, labdho bodhadayādibhis tv atiśayas tadgocaropasthitau naivaṃ yatnam apekṣate svarasataḥ pratyātmam unmīlati |
 [326,16] tasmat kṣaṇikatvadharmābhyāse 'pi prakarṣagāmini yāvad anubhavitavyam anena, tāvat truṭyadrūpam asmadādidarśanavilakṣaṇam eva | yathāsmākam atyantasadṛśe 'pi bhinnadeśapaṭutarabhedānukāri darśanaṃ vikalpaś ca jhagity eva tathā syāt, anuṣṭhānaṃ vā tadanurūpam, evaṃ yoginaḥ kṣaṇabhedini bhāvadvaye darśanavikalpau | sthairyādibhramodbhavarāgādikalaṅkānaṅkitaṃ cāsya ceta iti iyatī tasya sphuṭābhatā |
 [326,21] nanu paribhāṣāmātram etat, iyaty eva tasya prakarṣagatir iti | tathādṛṣṭatvād iti nottaram | yady api dṛṣṭam evaṃ tathāpi tāvataiva sthitir iti na śakyaṃ prastute | kadācid atiricyamānaḥ prakarṣo viṣayeṇaiva saha sphuṭayed iti na pūrvadoṣaśoṣaḥ | priyatvādāv api ca kadācid anyaiva niṣṭheti cet? bhavatv iti bhāvanayā abhimatāṃ sthitimullaṅghya sphuṭībhāvaśaṅkā | yas tu prekṣāpūrvakārī svārthaṃ parārthaṃ vā bhāvanābhiyuktaḥ, tasya tāvataiva kṛtārthatvaṃ jātam iti kim iti śramāntaram āviśet, anarthakatvād arthakaratvāc ca? yathā bhojyabhaiṣajyādiṣv abhimatapākaprāptau | yathā cātra sambhavaty api pākāntare 'bhimate tāvataiva pākaprakarṣaparyantavyavahāraḥ, tathā prastute 'pīti na kaściddoṣaḥ | tad evaṃ yady api dharmiviṣayabhāvanāyāḥ sphuṭībhāvo visaṃvādasaṃvāsī sthairyaviparyayād viṣayasya, tathāpi na yathoktadharmagocarāyās tadāśaṅketi sthitam | yady evam anucitaḥ kāminīdṛṣṭhānta iti na codyam, bhāvanāyā vaiśadyamātranidarśanasya vivakṣitatvāt | ata eva vārtikam,

ghṛṇāvairāgyarāgavat

ity āha |
 [327,8] tat tarhi yogijñānam indriyajñānād bhinnam abhinnaṃ vā? kiṃ cātaḥ? abhedapakṣe na yogijñānaṃ nāma pratyakṣabhedaḥ, indriyajñānenaiva saṃgrahāt | na ca bhāvanopaskṛtasantānasya tathodayād bhedavyavasthā, rasāyanādisaṃskārāpekṣayāpi pratyakṣāntaravyavasthāprasaṅgāt | bhedapakṣe ca bhāvanāsambhavaṃ kṣaṇikatvasākṣātkārijñānam anyad anyatheti sādhvī śuddhiḥ, indriyajñānasyāpi tadavasthāyām asthairyasākṣātkaraṇe kṛtaṃ yogijñānena | na ca tasyākasmikaḥ kṣaṇikatvabodhaḥ | bhāvanodbhatavaiśadyasya hi tadbodhaḥ | na cendriyajñāne bhāvanā, api tu manasaḥ | tām antareṇāpi sākṣātkriyālābhe ca bhāvanāvaiyarthyam |
 [327,15] kiṃ ca bhinnakālaṃ vā taddvayam abhinnakālaṃ vā? tatrābhinnakālatvam anupapannam | indriyajñānopanītasya hi dharmiṇaḥ kṣaṇikatā sākṣātkartavyā bhāvanābhāvinānubhavena | anyathā dharminaṃ dharmaṃ ca svātantryeṇa sākṣātkurvato dharmidvārakaṃ dūṣaṇam anivāryam | na ca dharmabhāvanāyā vastusākṣātkāravyāpāro nimbādivad iti niveditam etat | tasmād indriyajñānagocarād adhika eva tattvasākṣātkāra iti prathamam indriyajñānaṃ dharmigrāhi, paścānmānasaṃ kṣaṇikatāgrāhīti niyataḥ kālabhedaḥ | kālabhede ca prācīnāpekṣayā paścim asya gṛhītagrāhitvād aprāmāṇyam ekārthatve | bhinnārthatve tv indriyajñānagocarād anyatra pravartamānaṃ svātantryeṇa dharmiṇam upasthāpayatīti na ca prācyadoṣān muktir iti |
 [327,23] atra brūmaḥ | prathamapakṣe tāvan na vastudūṣaṇam, tādṛkpuruṣaviśeṣasya sādhyasya siddhatvāt | vyavasthādūṣaṇam api nāsti, sādhyatayaiva tādṛśādaśaviśeṣasya lokātikrāntarūpatve tatsādhanaviśeṣapratipādanāya pṛthagjanasādhāraṇendriyajñānād bhedena nirdeśāt | na cendriyajñānaśabdena koṣṭhaśuddhyā rasāyanādijanitaviśeṣasyeva saṅgrahamātreṇa śāstrasāphalyam | ata evāñjanādikṛtaviśeṣāpekṣayāpi na bhedanirdeśaḥ, lokātikrāntarūpasya viśeṣasyābhāvāt | prayojanāpekṣayā hi bahulam ekaprakārasaṃgrāhyasyāpi prakārabhedanirdeśa iṣyata eva, yathā samprayuktasaṃskāraskandhasaṃgṛhītayor api vedanāsaṃjñayoḥ, vikalpasaṃgṛhītasyāpi kliṣṭamanojñānasya | tasmān nendriyayogijñānayor abhedapakṣe tāvad doṣaḥ | tad eva dharmirūpāpekṣayendriyajñānaṃ dharmāpekṣayā yogijñānaṃ, yathā dharmipratyakṣam eva niṣedhāpekṣayānupalabdhiḥ |
 [328,6] bhedakapakṣe 'pi na tāvat sthairyetarasphuraṇakṛtopālambhasambhavaḥ indriyajñānenāpi vastu sarvātmanā gṛhṇatā truṭyadrūpayaiva grahaṇāt | adhyavasāyo 'pi pūrvaṃ durlabhaḥ sa samprati bhāvanābalāvalambinā manasā āsāditapāṭavena ghaṭita iti viśeṣaḥ | nanv indriyasyāpi taddaśāyāṃ niratiśayaviśeṣalābhād dūrasūkṣamādyanubhavaṃ ko nivārayati bāhyayogivat, niraścām api kutaścit karmākṣepānmātrayā tathopalabdheḥ? vidyamānānāṃ ca kṣaṇānām avaśyaṃ vaisadṛśyam aṇīyo 'pi sambhavi, anyathā sarvātmanā sādṛśye tattvaprasaṅgāt | tat tathāvidhasūkṣmabhedāvadhāraṇadhūryeṇākṣavijñānenaiva śādhyasiddher anarthakaṃ yogijñānam |
 [328,14] etena duḥkhānātmādisākṣātkāro vyākhyātaḥ | puruṣavapuṣā cendriyam antareṇa bhavitum aśakyam iti yogijñānam anutpādanīyam astu | tad apy ayuktam | na hi sambhāvanāmātropanītaṃ netrabalam avalambya saṃvyavahāriṇā prekṣeṇa pramāṇaprarāyaṇo mārgaḥ parihartuṃ śakyaḥ | tadabhyāsasahakārikam eva vā tathāvidhendriyaśaktisādhanam ity aparihāryeṇa yogijñānena samānakakṣatāyām api indriyajñānasya na kaścid dośaḥ | vaiyarthyam ekasyeti cet? katareṇa punaḥ svakāraṇopanidhānadharmaṇor anayoḥ svavyāpāravaiyarthyabhayān nirvitatavyam, bījādiṣv ivāntyakṣaṇaprāpteṣu |
 [328,21] aprāmāṇyam ekasyāstv iti cet? bījādiṣv apy ekasyākāraṇatvam astu | sarveṣāṃ samānasāmarthyānāṃ katamad ekam akāraṇam avasthāpayituṃ śakyam iti cet? paricchedabalavator jñānayor api kim ekam apramāṇīkriyatām | prasparāpekṣayā mā bhūdubhayam api pramāṇam iti cet? bījādiṣv api naikam api kāraṇatvam astv iti samānam | gṛhītagrāhitvaṃ nāma nāsty eva | tarhi doṣa iti cet, na, kālabhedena tasya svīkārāt | gṛhītagrahaṇaṃ hi tad ucyate, na gṛhyamāṇasya, yathā kṛtasya karaṇasvīkāre 'kārakatvam, na tu kriyamāṇakaraṇe bījādivad eva | tasmād abhinnakālapakṣe naiṣa doṣaḥ |
 [329,1] nanu tathāpy ākāradvayasphuraṇaprasaṅga iti cet? satyam, satyajñānākāras tāvad dhanta samānadeśaḥ, anyathā bhramatvaprasaṅgāt | atas tāvākārāvapratighau kayā rītyā sphurata iti ko nirṇetuṃ kṣamaḥ, yadāha;

acintyā yogināṃ gatiḥ (PV III 532)

iti? tasmād dṛṣṭāntābhāvāt kim ivāniṣṭaṃ kim iva vā na doṣa ity ubhayayor api nāvasaraḥ | samasamayatayā tarhīndriyajñānānapekṣāyāṃ svātantryadoṣa uktaḥ kathaṃ parihartavyaḥ? indriyāpekṣayaiva parihariṣyata iti nottaram | tadā hi tadapīndriyajñānam eva syāt, tadvyāpārānuvidhānāt | na yogijñānaṃ nāma kiñcit |
 [329,10] tadvaram ekam eva svīkṛtam iti na bhedapakṣaḥ kṣamaḥ | naivam, tathā hi mā bhūd indriyāpekṣā | vīkṣaṇaṃ tu yathā svasāmarthyānurūpāṃ yogyadeśāvasthitim apekṣya svavijñānajanane pravartate tathā mana indriyāpi pravartiṣyate, aprāpyakāritāyā ubhayoḥ sādhāraṇatvāt, arthavattāyāś ca namaso 'pi tadānīm iṣṭatvāt | pṛthagjanasantānasya tu na tādṛśī śaktiḥ yato netraśrotravanmano 'pi tādṛṅmaryādayā yogyadeśastham arthasahakāriṇam āsādya vedanam utpādayed iti nātiprasaṅgaḥ | taddaśāyāṃ tu śrutinayanayor iva manaso 'pi kiyaddūreṇa viṣayasannidhivyavastheti ka evaṃ pramātuṃ kṣamaḥ? kevalam etāvad ucyate, yāvat tena śakyam adhigantuṃ svākārārpaṇasahaṃ sahakāri vastu tāvad itarajanāsādhāraṇatruṭyadrūpatayā tasya gocarībhavati | tathā ca sati vastvākāro vastukṛta eva na bhāvanājanita iti na visaṃvādaśaṅkā |
 [329,20] nanu cakṣurādes tāvad dūrataragocarīkaraṇe dṛṣṭā saktiḥ, manasas tu nendriyātikrameṇa sarvaviṣayasyeti cet, na, paracittajñānādīnāṃ sambhavāt | tad api neṣṭam ekeṣām iti cetadṛṣṭamātreṇa pratikṣepāyogāt | upāyābhāvād iti cet? upāyābhāve 'pi nānupalambhamātrād anya upāyaḥ | tasmād yady evaṃ syāt tadā yoginām indriyamanojñānayor bhedapakṣe 'pi na nirvāha ity upakṣepārthaḥ | nirvāhas tv anythāpi darśita eva | evaṃ ca sati kālabhedapakṣe 'pi na doṣaḥ, yadi  [sā] prathamaṃ manojñānavṛttiḥ, yadi cendriyapathātikrameṇa vṛttiḥ | indriyajñānaṃ tu tasya tadapekṣayā prāmāṇyavirahe 'pi na vyathayatīty alaṃ vistareṇa |
 [330,1] tad evaṃ yogijñāne tattvabhāvanādhikārād arthakāro 'rthakṛta eva | bhāvanayā punas tadīyasantāne netra ivāñjanaviśeṣeṇa śaktir atiśayavatī kācid arpitā yayetarajanāsādhāraṇaṃ darśanam asya | yathoktaṃ prāk | yadi tarhi viṣayajanyam eva yogijñānam atītānāgataparijñānasya kā vārtā? tadetatprastāvānavagāhanasya phalam | upayuktasarvajñādhikāreṇa hi vastudharmabhāvanopakṣepaḥ kṛtaḥ | na sarvasarvajñapakṣāpekṣayā tato 'tītānāgatam apratīyamānam api na bādhakam | tāvataiva duḥkhanirodhasiddheḥ, parasmai ca niṣkampadeśanāvatārāt |
 [330,7] yat punaḥ kaṇikāyāṃ kṣaṇikāditattvabhāvanādvareṇa taddharmiṇāṃ samastavastūnām eva bhāvanayā tadākārajñānotpādanāt sākṣātkaraṇam utthāpya dūṣaṇam abhidhīyate yogijñānasya, tadavadhīraṇīyam eva, vārtikabhāṣyādivādabahirbhāvāt | anyathārabdhaiva nityaduḥkhādibhāvanā, sā ca sarvasarvajñatvam evārpayatīti yady abhipretaṃ syāt, kathaṃ yatnenotthāpya tatparihāro vārtike,

nāsmābhiḥ śakyate jñātum iti santoṣa iṣyate  (PVA)

ityādinā bhāṣye ca? yadi punas tadavasthāprāptau nirāvaraṇāntaḥkaraṇasya kāruṇyātiśayāt sarvākāraparārthaprārthanaparatayā sakalagocaracāriṇi cetasi ciravirūḍhotsāhasya tādṛgupāyaviśeṣādhigamo bhaviṣyati, yam anutiṣṭhataḥ, pratiparamāṇu sarvavastuviṣayaṃ yathādeśakālaṃ pratyavasthānukāri sphuṭataraṃ jñānam udīyāt | tadā na tāvad vastuvyabhicārakṛtaṃ visaṃvāditvam, nāpi nirālambanatvam, vastūnām eva pratibhāsanāt |
 [330,19] athotpattisārūpyābhyām ālambanavyavasthā,

[bhinnakālaṃ kathaṃ grāhyam iti ced] grāhyatāṃ viduḥ |
hetutvam eva yuktijñā jñānākārārpaṇakṣamam || (PV II 247)

iti vacanāt, tataḥ sārūpyam ekam akiñcitkaram iti katham anālambanatvaparihāraḥ?
 [330,24] tad ayuktaṃ, tat khalu lakṣaṇaṃ pṛthagjanāpekṣayā bahir arthaṃ prati samasamayabhāvinānupakāryeṇa jñānena grahaṇaniṣedhaparam, tathā prastāvāt | tattvatas tu yad eva yatra pratibhāsate tad eva tasyālambanam ucyate | yathendriyapratyakṣe bāhyam anyatra svākāraḥ, pratibhāsavaśāt pratyakṣasya grahaṇāgrahaṇe iti hi prathamaparicchedavṛttiḥ | tatra bāhyasya pratibhāso nāma tadākārotpattimātram | tathā hi bahirvicchinnākārodayasaṃvedanamātrād idaṃ dṛṣṭam iti bhavati | na khalu tatsaṃkalpakāle utpattir aparāpekṣyate, tasyāḥ paścān niśceyatvāt phalaprāptyā vā ubhayāsena vā | sa ca tadākārodaya indriyapratyakṣe 'rthād bhrame viplavāt | vikalpe vāsanātaḥ | tatrārthajanye saṃvādo 'nyatra viparyayo bahirapekṣayā, svarūpe sarvatra saṃvādaniyamāt | tato 'bhipretasaṃvāde vedane tadutpattim antareṇa [na] saṃvādo nāpi tādrūpyam iti tatra tadutpattiprārthanā | ata eva tadākārataiva prāmāṇyam, sārūpyatadutpattī ca saṃvedyalakṣaṇam ity ubhayam avirodhi |
 [331,9] yatra tu bhāvanāviśeṣabalād eva devatādhipatyāt satyasvapnavad arthākāram arthayāthātmyanāntarīyakaṃ jñānam, tatra na kiñcit tadutpattyā | yad vārttikam -

[rūpādeś cetasaś caivam] aviśuddhadhiyaṃ prati |
grāhyagrāhakacinteyam acintyā yogināṃ gatiḥ || (PV III 532)

iti | tasmād bāhye pṛthagjanasya sārūpyotpattibhyāṃ vedyasthitiḥ yoginaḥ sārūpyamātreṇāpi | svarūpe yogyatāmātreṇaiveti nyāyaḥ | bhāvibhūtayos tarhi yadi svarūpasphuraṇaṃ vartamānataiva syāt |
 [331,16] atha svarūpam asannihitaṃ jñānam eva tadākāram iti nirālambanaṃ niyamena, tad api nāsti | yasmād asannihite 'py arthe bhāvanābalāc cet? taddeśakālānukāri vijñānaṃ katham anālambanam? sphuraṇarītiviśeṣeṇa tu kālabhedavikalpodayāt tadanurūpānuṣṭhāne niyatatvāt tatprāpteḥ | yad bhāṣyam,

yathā sa dṛṣṭaḥ śaradādikālayuktas tathā tasya na bādhitatvam (PVA II 615)

iti | yad vā saṃcityaiva kālabhedabhāgivasturūpapratītaye samādhisamāpatter vyutthāne kālabhedādhyavasāyaḥ | yathoktam,

yad yad icchati vai boddhum

ityādi | krameṇa tvanābhogam api jñānam avirodhi | jñānamātrasya tattvataḥ sphuraṇāc ca na vartamānatāprasaṅgaḥ, yathā nirākāravāde vastusvarūpasyaiva sphuraṇād iti | yady api ca vartamāne 'pi jñānākārasyaiva sphuraṇaṃ tathāpi vartamānatayaivādhyavasāyas tatra | evaṃ dūrāsannādibhede 'pi veditavyam | tatra yathādhyavasāyaprāptau niyamena saṃvādāt prāmāṇyam anyadā viparyayaḥ yathā svapnakāminyādau | pratibhāsvargasādhanāgniṣṭomādivikalpe ca bhāvinaḥ spaṣṭarūpasya pratibhāsābhāvād eva na cintā | na ca tatra prekṣavyāvahārikasya prāptiniyamaniścayo 'sti |
 [332,7] prastute 'pi ko niścaya iti cet? kasya punar atra niścayaś cintyate, tasya tadanyasya vā? yadi tasya, tadā yathābhyāsāt parito nirastavibhramāśaṅke sādhanajñāne pṛthagjanasya tathā yogino 'py atyantābhyāsād bhāvibhūtādipratibhāsaḥ kena vāryate? athānyasya, tadedam āyātām | yāvad anyasya na prāmāṇyabodhas tāvan na pramāṇam | yāvac ca na pramāṇaṃ tāvan nānyasya prāmaṇyabodho 'bhrānta iti na kiñcit pramāṇaṃ syāt | tannābhiveśapāravaśyena kiñcit | tasmād upāyaviśeṣasacivabhāvanābhedasyāhatyāsphuraṇāt tādṛksiddhāv eva saṃśayo, na tu siddhe 'pi nirālambanatvādidoṣair upadravaḥ śakyaḥ |
 [332,14] yac ca vikalpena bāhyasyāgrahaṇe 'py adhyavaseyatayā sphuṭībhāvam āśaṃkya, yad anumānena gṛhyate yac cādhyavasīyate te dve 'nyanivṛttī na vastunī, svalakṣaṇāvagāhitve 'bhilāpasaṃsargayogyapratibhāsānupapatter ity āha, tad apy asambaddham | tathā hi yathā tathā vā bauddhasiddhāntagandhena vyavahāraḥ, kāminyākāravikalpabhāvanavat, kṣaṇikākārasyāpi paryante viśadopādeyakṣaṇaprasavas tu durnivāraḥ | yadi punar īdṛgapohasthitiḥ kṣaṇikavikalpaikatalpaśāyinī na kāminyādivikalpam avetīty upapādayiṣyasi tathaiva grahīṣyāmaḥ | na cādhyavaseyam avastunivṛttimātraṃ vā | dharmottare 'pi hi mate svalakṣaṇam adhyavaseyam iti sthitiḥ |
 [332,21] nanu vahniḥ pratīto mayety adhyavasāyākāraḥ | tatra ca svalakṣaṇasphuraṇam iti sāhasam, vikalpādhyavasāyayor ekārthatvāt | satyam, na tu tatra sphuratīti tāvatā svalakṣaṇam adhyavasitam ucyate | aphuraṇe tarhy abodhāt katham avsāyaḥ? sphraṇe 'pi pratibhāsa evāsau, katham adhyavasāyaḥ? na ca pratibhāsādhyavasāyāv apy ekārthau | pratibhāso hi sākṣātsphuraṇam asphuraṇe 'pi pravṛttiviṣayīkaraṇam ekavyāvṛtyullekhasāmarthyād adhyavasāyo bhāṣyamataḥ | ato yad anurūpam anuṣṭhānaṃ tad adhyavaseyam, pratibhāsamānarūpān anuprativiṣṭam eva | tac ca kvacid āropitamātram | kvacid vasturūpam | prakṛtaṃ tu pramāṇavyāpārasvīkārād vasturūpam eveti katham ucyate nivṛttimātram avastu vādhyavaseyam ity āstāṃ tāvad anārabdhanirbandhaḥ | pratibhāso 'pi vikalpe vyāvṛttākārasya, na vyāvṛttimātrasya, yady anubhavānusāraḥ | sarvadā yad vā tad vā rākṣasādi pratibhāseta | bhāvanayā punar adhyavasitākāreṇa pariṇitiḥ abādhyā tatrāropitamātre 'dhyavaseye nirālambanatvam | sati tu tad evālambanaṃ yathānantaram uktam ||
 [333,5] yat tv āha, arthasyālambanapratyayatvaṃ vijñānaṃ pratīndriyāpekṣatvena vyāptam | tac cāsmāt svaviruddhopalabdhyā nivartamānam ālambanapratyayatvam apy arthasya nivartayatīti, tatrālambanapratyayatvendriyāpekṣatvayor vyāpyakabhāvam aprasādhya pramāṇena vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiṃ sphuṭayatīti mahadvaidagdhyam | tathā darsanād iti cet? darśanādarśnam eva tarhi pramaṇīkṛtya sthīyatām, kim evaṃvidhapramāṇopanyāsavyasanena? tasmād indriyam anapekṣyāpi yady ālambanabhāvaṃ bhāvaḥ svīkuryāt na bādhakam utpaśyāmaḥ | athātroktam eva na khalv indhanaviśeṣo dhūmahetur iti vināpi dahanaṃ sahasrteṇāpi saṃskārair dhūmam ādhatte | tadādhāne vā samastakāryahetvanumānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmāj jñānam apīndriyasāpekṣād arthād utpattidharmakam |
 [333,14] indriyavyāpāravirahe ca samastāparakāraṇasannidhāvasannidhīyamānasattākaṃ tatpratibaddhaṃ siddham iti katham indriyānapekṣyasyārthasya svavijñānaṃ pratyālambanabhāva iti cet? etad api paracittajñānasambhavena prativyūḍham | iṣṭāś ca paricittavedinaś cārvākamīmāṃsakavyatiriktaiḥ | cārvākāder api sandehān nāparā gatiḥ | sandehe ca vipakṣād ekāntavyāvṛtter ayogaḥ | nanu jñānakāryasyendriyāpekṣāniyamād eva nānyatra sandeho dahanāpekṣadhūmavat | yady evaṃ rūpajñānasya vīkṣaṇāpekṣaṇe yādṛśī sāmagrī sā na saṃcaraṇaviśeṣasya caraṇāpekṣaṇe kalayāpi hīyate, tat kathaṃ na dhūmadṛṣṭāntaś caraṇavarihiṇām uragādīnāṃ gamananiṣedhāya prabhur abhūt? kathaṃ vā karādivyāpārasaṅgi sāvegamantrodgāraparamparāsādhyam ekeṣāṃ viṣaśamanādikāryaṃ samādhimātrād anyasya? na caivaṃ dhūmo 'pi kvacid indhane dahanānapekṣodayo dṛṣṭo yato 'trāpi tathā śaṅkyeta |
 [333,25] tasmād bahirbhuvo bhāvā yathā hetuphalabhāvenopalambhabhājaḥ te tathaiva niyatavṛttayaḥ | cittasantānasya tu vicitrakarmābhisaṃskārasāmarthyād vicitra eva vivartaḥ | atas tadāśrayakāryam ekatra yāvad apekṣaṃ tāvad apekṣam anyatrāpīti na niyantuṃ śakyam | tat kathaṃ paracittavedanāder abhāva eva? yadi ca dhūmavad analam anapekṣya nendriyaṃ buddhiḥ, tadā svaviṣaye 'py utkarṣaghoṣaṇāvīkṣaṇādīnāṃ dīnaiva syāt | tathā hi yāvad deśaṃ dahanendhanādidhūmādisādhanam upalabdhaṃ na tāvad deśātikrame samartham | evaṃ yāvaddeśe 'smākaṃ viṣayendriyādivedanam utpāditavat kathaṃ tadatikrame gṛdhrādīnām utpādayet? utpādane vā nendhanadahanādikakṣāṃ kṣamate cittasantānāśrayā sāmagrī |nāpi dhūmakakṣāṃ buddhiḥ |
 [334,4] ataḥ sahakāriṇo 'tivyavadhānavadvaikalye 'pi kiṃ na kutaścit viśeṣāt sambhāvyate? jātikṛto 'sau vibhāgaḥ, na cittasantānāśrayād iti cet, na, jātir api hi vicitrakarmādhipatyād eva vicitrasvarūpopasaṃhārasvabhāvā, karma ca na cittād anyad iti na cittāśrayatvaparihāraḥ | athendriyasya prāpyakāritayā sarvaiva vijñānajananasāmagrī sādhāraṇadeśety ucyate | tathāpi kasmāt punas tāvad dūradeśasthitim iti kvacillocanaruḍhāṃśaśleṣaḥ kvacid arvāgeva viśrāma iti kim atra vaktavyaṃ karmādhipatyād anyatra? tasmāt tadāśrayasya cittasantānasya citraiva śaktiḥ |
 [334,11] na hi bahir api śakyam evam | anyathā sadṛśapradeśasthāyinoḥ pradīpayor alpakasya kasyacid dūrasāriṇī kiraṇasaṃhatir itarasya punar arvācīnacāriṇī syāt | atha mantraprabhāvād evam api syāt, sarīsṛpadṛśā ca māndyamādadhātīti cet? sa tarhi cittasantater eva prabhāvaḥ | mantre 'pi puruṣamāhātmyakṛta eva | yathā vārtike nirṇītam, apauruṣeyatve 'pi mantrāṇāṃ na puruṣanirapekṣāṇāṃ śaktiḥ | tataś ca puruṣa eva mantrādyupāyena bāhyavastuśaktivyavasthāṃ dusthayatīti āyātām iti prastute kim asambhāvanam? yathā ca locanāpekṣaḥ padārthasyālambanabhāvo dṛṣṭa iti tanniyata iṣṭaḥ, tathālokāpekṣo 'pi dṛṣṭa iti na saṃtamase paśyeyur ulūkādayaḥ | tathā dṛṣṭatvān na doṣa iti cet? tathā dṛṣṭatvād eva hato 'si | tathā hi netrālokayoḥ samāne 'py apekṣāsādhananyāye cittasyācintyaśaktitayā anyatarollaṅghanadarśanam anyad api śaṅkayā kalaṅkayati | na tv adarśane śakyam evam | atha tādṛśi jñānatvasāmānyavanty api kāryāṇītarajātibhedabhāñjīti nānapekṣya sādhanasāmagrībhedam udiyur ity ucyate |
 [334,24] kena punaḥ prakṛtajñānasyāpy alaukikasya pṛthagjanajñānena sahaikajātitāyāṃ pratārito 'si? asattvād eva tarhi tasya na jātibheda iti cetasattvam iti jātibhedābhāvād evendriyāpekṣayā niyamasambhavād itītaretarāśrayaḥ | tasmāt sādhāraṇakarmanirjātānām asmadādīnām anubhavabhedaṃ pratīndriyāpekṣatvam ālambanatvasya vyāpakam api na svanivṛttyā anubhavamātraṃ prati nirvartakaṃ bhavitum arhati, viśeṣoddeśenaiva vyāptisiddheḥ | athānubhavamātram ekīkṛtya vyāptir iṣyate? tadā virpayayādhakābhāvāt vyāptir eva na sidhyati hetuphalaniyamāśrayas tu dhvasto dhūmādisādhāraṇyānupapatter vicitrakarmābhisaṃskārād acintyaśaktisvāntasantānasambhāvino 'nubhavamātrasya | viśeṣāśraye ca na sarvopasaṃhāravatī vyāptir iti sa eva doṣo viśeṣavattvaṃ nāma |
 [335,4] yad apy ayam āha, bhāvanāyās cābhūtārthāyā arthānapekṣāyā eva viśadajñānajananasāmarthyam upalabdhaṃ kāmāturādivartinyā iti bhūtārthāpi tannirapekṣaiva samartheti nārthasya ālambanapratyayatvaṃ śakyāvagaman iti | tatrāpi keyam arhtanirapekṣatā? kim arthāviṣayatvaṃ sākṣādarthāpratibhāso vā, yad vā arthāhetutvam athārthavyabhicāra iti pakṣāḥ | prathamapakṣe bhūtārthatvam aviṣayatvaṃ ceti vyāhatam, tatprabhavānumānasyeva tasyāpy adhyavasāyāpekṣayā tadviṣayatvāt | pratibhāsāpekṣayā tu mā bhūt tadviṣayatvaṃ tasyās tajjanitajñānasyaiva tadiṣṭer iti na dvitīyo 'pi pakṣaḥ | tṛtīyo 'sambhavī, svaprabhavānumānadvāreṇa tasyāpi bhūtārthakāryatvāt | ata eva vyabhicāro 'pi siddha iti na carurthaḥ | atas tajjaviśadajñānasya saṃvādaniyamād arthasya katham ālambanatvam aśakyāvagamam? tasmāt prācīnarītyaiva codyaṃ cāru, parihāraś cokta eva |
 [335,14] yac cānena punas tāttanā evāsya viṣayakṣaṇā grāhyā yujyante na pūrvatarā itādinā bhūtānāgatabodhiniṣedhāya prayattaṃ, tat prāg eva pratyādiṣṭam | prakṛtasarvajñapakṣe tu yāvanto jñānam upajanayantaḥ svajñānagocaratām anubhavanti tāvantaḥ kṣaṇikaduḥkhānātmākāreṇaivety etāvataiva sādhyasiddhiḥ | pratītātīteṣu smaraṇaṃ bhāvini sambhāvaneveti | yady atīte smaraṇam eva, tat kathaṃ samudayākārāṇāṃ sphuṭībhāva iti cet? pañcaskandhā evottarāpekṣayā samudayaḥ | tatrāyam eva samudayākārasphuṭībhāvo yadabhimukhībhūteṣu parāpekṣayā jhagati tadanurūpavikalpānuṣṭhānādiprasavahetuḥ sphuraṇarītiḥ kācit, yayā pṛthagjanād vibhāgabhāgī bhavati pūrvavat | atīteṣu ca tathaiva paṭutarasmaraṇodayaḥ | parānapekṣasvarūpamātreṇa tu kṣaṇikādyākārair duḥkhasatyapratītiḥ | nanu vikalpānām asahasambhavasvabhāvatvād yadā duḥkhākārāṇām avasāyaḥ, tadā na samudayākārāṇām, pascāc ca nirviṣayaḥ avasāya iti cet? satyam etad ekaikasatyasyāpi nākāracatuṣṭayavikalpanam ekakālam | na ca kācid evaṃ kṣaṭiḥ | grahaṇarītiviśeṣa eva hi sphuṭībhūtasakalākāraḥ sākṣātkāraṇam | yato bījavikalpāvakīrṇābhimatavikalpakramāvirbhāvaḥ | yathā hi nīlacalavikacādiviśeṣaṇam utpalaṃ paśyato janasya na vikalpakrameṇa tadviṣayasakalākārasākṣātkriyāvyāghātaḥ, tathā prasute 'py unneyaḥ | aparasparāś ca kṣaṇāstavaivāparāparair anubhavaiḥ sākṣātkriyante | vikalpāś ca yathābhimataṃ pravartante gṛhītānusandhānarūpāḥ | anubhavenaiva ca sārvajñasthitir iti veditavyam | evaṃ nirodhadharmamāgrasatyayor api svasaṃvedena vedane sakalam ūhyam ||
 [336,5] yac ca sarvavastuno mithaḥ kathañcit sākṣāt paramparyeṇa ca sambandhadvārakaṃ katipayadarśane sarvadarśanasya dūṣaṇaṃ tadanabhyupagamenaiva gatam | sambandhadvārakas tu viśeṣaṇatayā samastavastuviṣayaḥ saṅkalpo yadi tadavasthāyāṃ janmaparamparāsmaraṇasambhave bhavet, na doṣam utpaśyāmaḥ | yathābhyāsavato hutāśādidarśane jhagity evaidhasya kāryam hetuś ca pāvakasyāyam iti vikalpaḥ, tathā vikalpagṛhītānāṃ bhāvanāprakarṣe vaiśadyam apy astu | na tu sambandhamātreṇaikadarśanād anyadaśanaṃ saṅgirāmahe | mā bhūd vā vaiśadyam api sarvaviṣayavikalpamātreṇaiva saṃvādinā sārvajñyakāryaparyāptes tadavasthasya | athavā svālambanapratyayamātragocaram evāvikalpakaṃ samastavastuviśiṣṭālambanādhyavasāyahetuḥ | tenāvasāyānugatavyāpāram avikalpam api samastavastuviṣayaṃ bhavati | yad āha,

vyavasyantīkṣaṇād eva sarvākārān mahādhiyaḥ || (PV II 107)

 [336,16] etat tv āśaṅkya yad āha katipayavastvavalambanasyānubhavasya kutastya eṣa mahimā yataḥ samastavastvavasāyaḥ? rāgādyāvaraṇavigamād iti cet? tarhi yathāvad vastūni paśyet, na tu punas asmād aśeṣavastuvyavasāyanirmāṇakauśalam asya yujyate | tattvāvarakatā hi sulabhā malānāṃ na punarvijalpanirmāṇapratibandhateti |
 [336,20] atra paryanuyogaḥ kiṃ tāvad vastuni dṛśyamāne vikalpapratibandha eva na dṛṣṭa uta kleśakṛto veti? tac ca dvayaṃ nāsti | na hy anubhavavat sarvākārakalpanaṃ kvacit | na ca tadvikalpavaikalyaṃ kleśānantareṇa | yadā hi priye vastuni dṛṣṭe doṣavaty api doṣāvikalpanaṃ tadā vaktaṃ rāgo hetuḥ | yadā punar apriye guṇavaty api guṇāvikalpanaṃ, tadā dveṣaḥ | anabhyāse tu sarvasadrūpāvikalpanaṃ mohakṛtam eva | na ca kambalādivadāvaraṇaṃ, kiṃ tu santānavaiguṇyādhānena | tato yathā yathā mohādiparājayaḥ tathā tathā yatnena vaiguṇyavyāvṛttyā tāvatsu ākāreṣu yadā dhiyo vyavasāyabhājaḥ paryante sarvākāreṣu sarvastuṣu yadi syur na kaścidvirodhaḥ | buddhipāṭavaparamparayā dṛṣṭeṣu smṛteṣv api smaraṇasambhavādīkṣamāṇeṣu ca gāḍhatarasmaraṇasaṃskārādhānād anādyanantatvāj janmaḥ ekaprakāraniścayasya ca tajjātīyāśeṣaniścayasvabhāvatvān na sarvaviṣayasaṅkalpānudayakṛto doṣaḥ |
 [337,3] yac cedam ūce, apramāṇaṃ ca tannitāntaviśadābhatve sati bhāvanājanitatvāt | yan nitāntaviśadābhatve sati bhāvanājaṃ vijñānaṃ tad apramāṇam, yathā anumitabhāvitaviṣayaviśadaṃ jñānam iti | tatra vahner anumāya bhāvanaiva nāstīti darśitatvāt dṛṣṭāntābhāvaḥ |
 [337,7] yac cānena kāvyāyitam, asti ceha śiśirabharasambhṛtajaḍimam antharatarakāyakāṇḍasyānumitavahnibhāvanābhiyoga iti | tatra yadi jāḍyāturatayā svayaṃ cittāveśād bhāvanopanatiḥ, tadā kvānumānavārtā? anumānaṃ hi pravṛttipāṭavabhṛtā prārthyate | tadavasthasya tathā aśaktau ca kiṃ bhāvanayā? sphuṭībhāva eva vā punastād astu kvānumānāvakāśaḥ? na hi kāmuko yāvan na kāminīm anumimīte, tāvan na bhāvanāyām abhiyujyata ity asti sambhavaḥ | tasmāt jāḍyāturasya bhāvanājanitavaiśadyam agnijñānamātram astu dṛṣṭāntaḥ | tad api kāminīdṛṣṭāntena svakāvyālaṃkṛtena gatam | na caikasya bhāvanābhuvo jñānasya visaṃvādād aprāmāṇye 'prāmāṇyam anyasya saṃvādino 'pīti nyāyaḥ, indriyodayasyāpi sarvasya keśādiviplavavad aprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt |
 [337,16] yac ca bhāvanāprakarṣalakṣaṇasya kāraṇasya sāmyena phalayor api dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ sāmyaniyamāya prapañcitam, tatrāpi kiṃ na cakṣur eva dvicandaikacandradarśanayoḥ samānaṃ kāraṇam utpaśyasi? timiropaghātānupaghātakṛto viśeṣaś cakṣuṣor iti cet? bhāvanayor api bhūtābhūtaviṣayatvena kiṃ na bhedaḥ? cakṣuṣi timirakṛto vikāra eva kaścid bhedakaḥ, bhāvanāyā tadvaiśadye vā kaścit svarūpabhedo 'bhede 'pi viṣayasyeti cet, na, saṃvādetarakāraṇatvena śaktibhedasyaiva balīyasaḥ sambhave kim apareṇa? saviṣetarayor iva annayo rūparasadṛṣṭīnāmabhedena hetuhetvābhāsabhāvinyor iva vā sādhyabuddhyos tatkṛtapravṛttyoś ca kiṃ ca locane 'pi na vikāra ity eva doṣaḥ añjanajanite 'pi vikāre doṣavyavasthāprasaṅgāt | kiṃ tu bhrāntihetutayeti śaktikṛta eva tatrāpi bhedaḥ | tad evaṃ bhāvanāprakarṣeṇa sphuṭābhatvam eva sādhyate na prāmāṇyam, yato dṛṣṭāntāsiddhyādidoṣāvakāśaḥ | prāmāṇyaṃ tu bhūtārthatvena saṃvādāt pratyakṣatvaṃ ca kalpanāpoḍhābhrāntatveneti tāvataivāsyāśeṣo 'py avidyāduṣṭanayaḥ pratihato veditavyaḥ ||
 [338,1] nyāyaprakīrṇakakārasyāpy abhūtaviṣayatopalambhas tāvat kṣaṇabhaṅgādisādhanād eva prativyūḍhaḥ | yac cānumānasya vikalpatāṃ prastuty āha, tatra yāvad vikalpair upadarśitaṃ tat sarvam asat, śabdasaṃsṛṣṭatvāt | tasmiṃs ca bhāvyamāne asatye tāvakasya vikalpasya bhāvanayopahite viśadabhāve śabdasaṃsṛṣṭagrāhyatvanimittaṃ vikalpakatvaṃ vyāvartate | tadvyāvṛttau ca grāhyasarvaśabdasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ nivartate | ato nirvikalpakam api yogijñānaṃ nirviṣayaṃ prasaktam iti |
 [338,6] tatra kim idaṃ nirviṣayatvaṃ nāma? grāhyākārabhraṅśād anākāratā vā, yad vānyākāratā, atha tadākāratve 'pi tadvasturūpāsaṃsargiteti? prathamapakṣas tāvad asambhavī, jñānasya nirākāratvānupapatteḥ, kāminyādau bhāvanayā tadākārasyaiva vaiśadyadarśanāt | ata eva na dvitīyo 'pi pakṣaḥ | yad ayam evāha śokāturasyāpi niruddhendriyavyāpārasya tanayabhāvanayā pitrādipratibhāsaprasaṅgād iti | kevalaṃ na cāsmin saṃsṛṣṭe bhāvyamāne sphuṭam anyadrūpaṃ bhavatīti prastutyākulaḥ pralāpa eṣaḥ | anena hi bhāvanayā sarvathā sphuṭībhāva eva niṣiddhaḥ, vikalpam antareṇa bhāvanānupapatteḥ | vikalpasya ca śabdasaṃsargam antareṇeti kva sphuṭībhāvaḥ? tanayabhāvanāyāṃ ca pitrādipratibhāsaprasaṅgavādinā tanayapratibhāso 'nujñāta eva | anyathā tanayābhāvanayāpi tanayapratibhāsaprasaṅgād ity abhidadhīta | na cāniṣṭimātraṃ dṛṣṭāpalāpāya prabhavati |
 [338,17] tathā ca kaṇikākāra eva kāminyākāravaiśadyaṃ kāmukasya vacanaceṣṭāviśeṣakāvyaracanayā draḍhayati sma | svayaṃ cāyam bhāvanayopahite viśadabhāve ityādivacanaṃ kenākāreṇa caritārthīkuryāt? tasmād anyabhāvanayā nānyasphuṭībhāva ity adhyavaseyāpekṣayā anyatvavyavasthāpanaṃ sādhu | na vikalparūpasya gocarābhimatasya ca parasparam, tayor ekatādhyāsāt | spaṣṭībhāvo 'pi hi bahirabhimatasya paryante vikalpopādeyakṣaṇasyaiva sphuṭasyodayaḥ | tāvataiva sa viṣayas tena sākṣātkṛta iti vyavahāraḥ | kevalaṃ sati vastuni tadākārajñānaṃ saṃvādi, visaṃvādi tv asatīti cintitaprāyam |
 [338,24] ata eva tṛtīyo 'pi vikalpaḥ pratyuktaḥ | saṃvādasākṣātkriyābhyām anyasya jñānena vasturūpasaṃsparśasya nirvaktum aśakteḥ | api ca tanayabhāvanāyām ity atra kas tanayabhāvanārthaḥ? tanayasya punaḥ punaś cetasi niveśanam iti cet? cetasi niveśanārtho 'pi tadākāravikalpanam eva | evaṃ tarhi yad ayaṃ pralapati kṣaṇikatve bhāvye samāropite vāstavaṃ kṣaṇikatvam eva yogijñānapratibhāsīti cet, na, sattvāsattvayor ekatvābhāvātmake hi bhede [satya] satyabhāvane 'pi yadi satyapratibhāsaḥ, sa tarhi satyatanayābhyāse 'pi śabdasāmyād abhedinas tanayasaṃjñakasya kasyacid aparasya svarūpapratibhāsaprasaṅgaḥ | tasmād abhūtaviṣayād abhyāsān nirvikalpakam api saṃvādān na pramāṇam iti, tad api dhvastam, samāropitabhāvanāyā evābhāvāt |
 [339,6] yathā hi tanayas tanaya iti vikalpābhyāsas tathā yadi samāropitaṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ samāropitaṃ kṣaṇikatvam iti vikalpaḥ, tadā samāropitakṣaṇikabhāvanā bhavet, na caivam | kiṃ tu kṣaṇikāḥ saṃskārā iti | tataḥ satyatanayavad vāstavam eva kṣaṇikatvaṃ bhāvyate | satyatanayabhāvanāyā vā anya ākāro vaktavyaḥ | kṣaṇikavikalpena kṣaṇikasvalakṣaṇāsparśāt kathaṃ tadvikalpo bhāvanā veti tanayavikalpe 'pi samānam | adhyavaseyāpekṣayā tadvikalpatvavyavasthā ca samānaiva | na hi tanayavikalpe 'py āropitād anyasya pratibhāsaḥ | tad ayaṃ tanayabhāvanāyām āropitaśabdasaṃsṛṣṭapratibhāse 'pi satyatanayasphuṭībhāvam icchan prastutaṃ pratikṣipatīti kim anyamohamahāgrahagrāsībhāvāt |
 [339,14] etac ca vikalpasphuradāropitāpekṣayā bāhyatvamātreṇa satyabhāvanāsāmyam uktam | bāhyāpekṣayā tu śokātur asya tanayabhāvanam abhūtabhāvanaiva | ata eva tadabhūtaṃ punaḥ sphurattanayakāraṃ tadā tādṛktanayābhāvād apramāṇam | kṣaṇikabhāvanā tu sadā tatprakṛtitvād dharmāṇāṃ bhūtaviṣayaiveti, tajjanitavaiśadyam avisaṃvādāt pramāṇam | atha vikalpasyāvastuviṣayatayā tanaye tanayabhāvane 'pi bhinnam eva vaiśadyam āpadyate nāsmanmata iti hṛdistham | tad api hṛdaya eva jīryatu | yoginirṇayo hi prārabdha eṣaḥ, tasya cobhayathāpi na kṣatiḥ | apohasyāpi pramāṇena pariśuddhāv adhyavaseyasyaiva vaiśadyaṃ dṛṣṭam iti kim atra kriyatām? anumāne vastunirbhāsābhāvāt kathaṃ tadapekṣayā pramāṇapariśuddhir iti cet? prastāvāntaram etat |
 [339,23] tac cedam, api ca bhāvyasya vastunaḥ punaḥ punaś cetasi niveśanam abhyāsaḥ | sa ca brahmacaryeṇa tapasā sādaradīrghakālanirantaram āsevito dṣḍhabhūmir asphuṭākārasya vikalpasya sphuṭābhatvajanana iṣṭaḥ | sa ca kṣaṇikanairātmyavādinā draḍhayitum aśakyaḥ | tathā hi, bhāvyagrāhī yādṛśo vikalpa utpannas tādṛśa eva niranvayaṃ nirudhyate | tasmiṃś ca niruddhe punar utpadyamānaḥ pratyayas tādṛśa evāpūrva utpadyate | tad anena paryāyeṇa kalpasahasre apy apūrvotpatter aviśeṣān na tajjanyaḥ saṃskāro 'bhyāsa utpadyate | etena viśiṣṭavijñānotpādo 'bhyāso vyākhyātaḥ | niranvayaniruddhaṃ hi pūrvavijñānaṃ kathaṃ uttarottarāvasthāntaraṃ viśiṣṭaṃ janayet? sarvathā kramabhāvibhiḥ pratyayair avasthitam eva rūpaṃ śakyaṃ saṃskurtum iti |
 [340,4] tad etad saṃgatam | na hi yādṛśa [eva] bhāvyagrāhī pratyayaḥ prathamo niranvayaniruddhaḥ, tādṛśa evāpara utpadyata iti niyamaniścayakāraṇaṃ kiñcid asti caṇḍadevatāsparśād anyat | kṣaṇikatvād iti cet? nanu kṣaṇikatvaṃ sthāyitayā virudhyate, na visadṛśotpādena | tad dhi prācīnaṃ niranvayanirodhi yathā sadṛśaṃ kṣaṇānta[ra] m ārabhte, tathā yadi sāmagrībhedaleśato viśeṣaleśaniveśikṣaṇāntaram utpādayati tadā kā kṣatiḥ? na hi bhavata iva bhāvasyāpi kṣaṇikatāyāṃ pradveṣaḥ | asti cehāpi leśena sāmagrībhedaḥ | tathā hi kṣaṇikāḥ sarvasaṃskārā ity anuvādamātrāpekṣayā saṃsāraduḥkhakṣayārthitayā bhāvanāyām abhiprayujyamānasya viśiṣṭa eva saṃkalpaḥ, so 'pi viśiṣṭam aṇumātrayātiriktaṃ janayati yāvat taratamādikrameṇāntimāt phalalābhaḥ, bījādivat | yadi tu vyāsaṅgādyo madhyamadhyāsīran mandatāditāratamyam eva syāt | yad bhāṣyam,

saṃskārasya balīyastve vyākṣepasya nivartanam |
vyākṣepasya balīyastve saṃskāraḥ syāt parāṅmukhaḥ || (PVA II 500)

iti | niranvayavināśe tarhi prācīnaviśeṣāsaṃkramaṇād dvitīyasya kuto viśeṣalābhaḥ? evaṃ tarhi sāmagryantare 'pi tādṛśā viśeṣeṇa bhavitavyam, asya tatrāsaṃkramaṇāt | tasmād asann api sa viśeṣaḥ kāraṇabalād udapādi yathā, tathāyam api | samānas tarhi tenāyam iti cet, na, hetuviśeṣāt phalaviśeṣasya durnivāratvāt |
 [340,18] tathā hi prathamo viśeṣas tādṛgviśeṣavinākṛtād utpannaḥ | ayaṃ tu tādṛśaviśeṣasacivād iti kathaṃ samānaḥ syāt? anvayas tu vicārāsaha eva | yo hi hetutaḥ saṃkrānto bhāgas tatra nāparasya hetor vyāpāraḥ, ya eva vyāpāraḥ sa pūrvam asann eva | evaṃ yad aṅgasya nirodho na tasya sthitiḥ, sthitam ataś ca na nirodhaḥ | tat kathaṃ sānvaye nirodhajanmanī? tena sahavṛtter iti cet? ākāśenāpi sānvayatvakalpanāprasaṅgāt | ubhayakālānuvṛttimātrajanyasya sahārthasyābhāvāt | tac ca kalasakapālayor nidhanasambhavakāle 'ntarālasya na vāryate | śeṣaṃ prakriyāmātraghoṣaṇaṃ pramāṇaparipanthīti kiṃ tena? haripadavad avasthite tvātmany uktakarṣāyoga iti bahuśaś carvitam āstāṃ tāvat |
 [341,3] yac cāha, kiṃ ca cittam ekāgram avasthāpayituṃ vikṣepatyāgārtham abhyāso 'nuṣṭhīyate, na ca kṣaṇikavādināṃ vikṣiptaṃ cittam asti, pratyarthaṃ niyatatayā sarvasyaikāgratvād iti | tad apy asambaddham | anubhavasiddhaṃ hi cetasaḥ kasyacit tattvasaṃmukhīkaraṇam, kasyacid viparyayaḥ, kāryādimātraparāmarśo 'parasyeti | tatra nairātmyāditattvaparāṅmukhaṃ sarvam eva cittaṃ vikṣiptam ucyate | uktakrameṇa tu tattvaikaniṣṭhaṃ samāhitam ity etāvatā kiṃ na paryāptam? yad avaśyam ekasyaiva vicitragocaracāritvam anveṣitavyam | atha ca tattvasākṣātkriyākālāt prāgaham ity ekākārāvagrahasambhavād vyāvahārikaṃ tad apy asati, yato mamaiva doṣakṣayo bhāvīti mārgābhyāsapravṛttir avyāhṛtā bhavati | prāpyasaṃkalpo hi sarvatra pravartakaḥ | sa cedasti vastutathābhāvavyatireke 'pi kaḥ pravṛttiṃ nivartayati? yena hi tarhi tathānumānena niścitaṃ kṣaṇikatādi tasya pravṛttir iti cet? niścayasya sātmībhāvābhāvād anādyavidyāv āsanāvaśīkṛtena cetasā niścayānucitasaiva vyavahārasya pravartanāt | ata eva darśanamārge 'pi labdhe bhāvanāmārgāpekṣaṇam uktaṃ vārtike 'nveṣaṇīyam | tasmāt tatphalalābhād arvāgabhyāso 'vidyayaiva sampādyate | abhyāsāc ca siddhaḥ sarvajña iti ||
 [341,16] nyāyabhūṣaṇasya ca yogācārapakṣāpekṣayā dūṣaṇam aprastutam, bahirartham abhyupagamyaiva sādhanaprakramāt | tatrāpi sarvasarvajñapakṣopakṣipto bādhas tadanabhyupagamād eva nirastaḥ | na cāsau bādha eva, saṃśayamātrasādhanatvāt | tathā hi, yat tāvad atītānāgataviṣayatvaniṣedhārtham uktam, na hy asataḥ kaścid ākāro 'stīti, satyam idānīm evam etat | tatas tajjanyajñānenāgrahaṇam api satyam | satyasvapnādivad anyathāpi tu sambhāvanā na śakyaniṣedheti darśitam | na ca yathedānīṃ na kaścid ākāras tathā kālāntare 'pi bhūtabhāvinoḥ | tathā sati bhūtabhāvitvam api na syāt, karikesaravat | abhramāvisaṃvādau ca prāg eva cintitau ||
 [341,24] yat puar āha, na cāvisaṃvāditvam api tvanmate yuktam, yataḥ prāpyārthadarśakatvaṃ vā pravṛttiviṣayopadarśakatvaṃ vāvabhātārthakriyāniṣpattir vā bhavatām avisaṃvāditvam abhipretam | na caitadatītādyarthajñānasya sambhavati, vartamānārthajñānasyāpi kṣaṇikatvapakṣe nopapadyata eveti | tad apīrṣyāpār avaśyamātram, upapattividhuratvāt | yadi tāvad bhāvibhūtayoḥ kālavyavadhānena tathocyate, tadā deśavyavadhāne 'pi eṣa prasaṅga iti pravṛttiyogyadeśe 'pi pradarśakam apramāṇaṃ syāt | tad asti tāvad iti cetanyad api, bhāvi bhūtaṃ vā tatkāle nāstīti cet? taddeśe vartamānam api nāstīti samānam | arthakriyāpi yathā taddeśasannidhau tathā tatkālasannidhāv iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ | vartamānasya kṣaṇikatve 'pi ekatvāropasāmarthyān na vyāvahārikaṃ prati pramāṇatāyāḥ kṣatiḥ, tadabhiprāyāt saṃvādasya vyavasthitatvād iti ||
 [342,9] yac ca kaumārilaiḥ sarvasarvavidi kāraṇānupalabdhim upakramya tasya kāraṇam indriyajñānaṃ vā mānasaṃ vā bhāvanābalajaṃ vā, bhāvanābalajam api cākṣuṣaṃ mānasaṃ veti vikalpya dūṣaṇam ārabdham, tat sambhāvanādaurbalyāviṣkaraṇamātraṃ nābhāvaniścayaphalam, yathendriyāpekṣālambanatvacintāyāṃ carcitam | na ca kāraṇānupalabdher aniścayaḥ phalam, tata eva dharmādharmaviṣaye 'pi bhāvanābalajasya balam apalapitum aśakyam | tataḥ kāśikākārasyāpi yogināṃ dharmādharmayor aparokṣapratibhāsaṃ jñānaṃ nāsti, indriyasannikarṣābhāvād asmadādivad ity anumānam anaikāntikam, vipakṣavyāvṛtter ekāntena pratipattum aśakyatvāt | kiṃ ca dharmādhramajñānam iti karmaphalasambandhamātraparijñānam etat | tac ca jātismaratvasambhave durnivāram | tataḥ parijñānasambhavāt bhāvanāpariniṣpattau idaṃ suvarṇādy evaṃ prayujyamānam etat sādhanam iti jhagiti vikalpotpādanapaṭīyaḥ pratyakṣam udayam āsādayed iti kim anupapannam | kevalaṃ jātismṛttau pratipattavyam | tatra cādarśanamātram apramāṇam iti na sarvathā niṣedhābhidhānaṃ sādhu | yathā hi sannipātādibhir abhyastavismaraṇasambhave 'pi smaraṇam api keṣāñcid dṛṣṭam, tathā garbhāvāsapīḍayāpi kasyācit prajñātaikṣṇyāt puṇyodayāt pīḍāmāndyāc ca samanantarajātismaraṇam api bhavat sarvathā niṣeddhum aśakyam acārvākeṇa |
 [342,25] sambhave cāsyānekajanmāntaragocarīkaraṇasyāpi sambhavāt krameṇa sarvaviṣayasaṃkalpasambhavāvirodhād viṣayānavagamakṛto bhāvanānudayadoṣaḥ parihṛtaḥ, āgamāc ca lokasanniveśaṃ yathāvat parigṛhya bhāvanāsambhavāt | yady api nāgamaḥ pramāṇam, tathāpi gambhīrapramāṇāntarasaṃvādasaṃdarśinaḥ śraddhāvataḥ kiṃ na sambhavet? tatprameyasyāvaitathye ca siddhaṃ sādhyam | samudāyavikalpābhyām evāvayavasyāpi sphuṭībhāvo dṛṣṭa eva | krameṇa sūkṣmādyabhivyaktiś ceti |
 [343,1] etena tad api nirastaṃ yad abhyastaikaśāstrasyānyatrāśaktir ubhayā vā bahu bahudhāpratirūpate paramapuruṣārthā padādibhiḥ | na hy atra vimatiḥ | idaṃ punar asti, prathamaśāstrābhyāse prayāso yāvān na tāvān vijātīyābhidheye 'py anyatra | evaṃ pāṭavaprakarṣaparamparāyām aśrute 'pi kasyacit tathā prakarṣo yathā nānyasya śrute 'pi | tato janmāntarasmṛtisambhave bhūyo 'bhyāsād anabhyasteṣv api vasturūpeṣūhāpohasambhavān na niḥkleśāvasthaḥ parārthasamarthatayā tāvataiva sthāsyati | yad vā sarvasaṃkalpasambhavād bhāvanābhiyuktā vyaktīkariṣyanti sarva svecchāto yoginaḥ | ata eva sarvāvagatipakṣe bhāvanānarthakyodbhāvanam apy anarthakam, niṣpannāvaśyakāryacaturāryasatyabhāvanasya sarvaviṣayānumānasambhave svecchāyāḥ pratipādanāt |
 [343,10] atha sarvavastusākṣātkāre 'nyad eva sukhaṃ parārthasādhanaṃ veti paśyen na bhāvanayā parikhedaḥ kaṣcit tadavasthasya sukaraś ca sarvasphuṭībhāvaḥ sambhavatīti mahodadhināpi nādhikaṃ kiñcid uktam | uktaṃ ca tāvataiva pratyuktam | tasmād yathā yathā cintyate saṃśayamātraphalaḥ sarvavidi dūṣaṇopanyāso naikāntena bādhe vikalpaḥ | prakṛtasarvajñasya tu sādhanam ekāntenaiva | tatrāpi na deśakālapuruṣaniyama iti cet, na, tadapekṣāyāṃ sādhanasya aprayuktatvāt | sarvathāpavādinaṃ prati hi sādhanam etat | tac ca deśādyaniyame 'pi kṛtārtham | tathā caivaṃvidham udbheditam asmābhiḥ sarvajñasiddhāv iti ||

||yoginirṇayo nāma prakaraṇaṃ samāptam ||
ADVAITABINDUPRAKARAṆAM

[345,3] iha bahirarthābhiniveśino manoratho yad yathā pratīyate tat tathā sad iti [345,4] vyavasthāpyate, yathā kuvalayaṃ nīlarūpatayā | vijñānād vyatiriktarūpatayā ca pratīyante
[345,5] ghaṭādaya iti svabhāvahetuḥ | nātrāsiddhiḥ, grāhakāṅgād vicchinnena tarjanīnirdeśayogyena
[345,6] puro 'vasthāyinā rūpeṇa ghaṭādyākārasya pratibhāsādhyavasāyābhyāṃ kroḍīkaraṇāt | tathā
[345,7] hy ayaṃ ghaṭo nāyaṃ ghaṭa iti pratītiḥ pratyātmavedyā sarvapuruṣāṇām avyutpannasaṃketānām api
[345,8] saṃjñāviśeṣollekhavimukhas tadanurūpa evāntarjanyaḥ | bālo 'pi sukhasādhanaṃ stanam avalokya
[345,9] tadabhimukhe karamukhe prahiṇvan bahiravasāyasacivam ātmānam ātanoti | tataś ca vyatiriktena
[345,10] rūpeṇa ghaṭādyākārasya pratītir nāsiddhipathaprasthāyinī | nāpi virodhinī sādhyena, sapakṣe
[345,11] sambhavasya darśitatvāt | viparyayavyāptasya ca viruddhasya tadasambhavāt |
[345,12] ata eva ca nāsādhāraṇatvam, nāpi sandigdhānvayatvam, vipakṣe 'darśanāc ca na
[345,13] sādhāraṇānekāntaḥ | na ca vaktavyaṃ kāmalinaḥ pītaśaṅkhapratītāv api na tathaiva vyavasthā
[345,14] keśoṇḍūkapratītau vā taimirikasya, ataḥ sādhāraṇatvam eveti, bādhakagrastatvena tatpratīteḥ
[345,15] bhrāntatvena pratyakṣavyāpāravirahāt | prastutas tu bādhakābhāvād bhrāntyasiddher adhyakṣavyāpāra
[345,15] eva | na ca kadācid atrāpi syād bādhakam ity anāśvāsaḥ, sarvatra pratyakṣavyāpāroccheda-
[345,16] prasaṅgāt | tasmāt,
[345,17] deśakālanarānyatve bādhake sati nākṣajam |

[345,20] evaṃ tarhi pratyakṣavyāpāre kim anumānenety api na codyam, vyavahārasādhanasya
[345,21] vivakṣitatvāt | pratyakṣagocare hi vivādasambhavo nānumānaprayojye viśrāmyati | tatra

[346,9] sādhye tathā pratīyamānatvaṃ tadanyānapekṣatvena vyāpyate | yadi ca kvacit tathā pratītāv api
[346,10] tathā vyavahāravirahaḥ syāt, tadā tadanyāpekṣaṃ syād iti sādhyasya tadvyavahārayogyatvasya

dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ

[387] yadi tarhi nirākārasya cetaso 'sattvaṃ tattvata iti saṅkleśavyavadānavyavasthāvilopaḥ, upapluto hy ākārakalāpo 'tasmiṃs tadgrahād bhrāntir eva saṃsāras tatprabhavavāsanāsaṅghātasamuddhāte copapalavavigamād anābhāsamamalaṃ prakāśamātram (79b) avaśiṣyamāṇaṃ nirvāṇam iti na kṣatiḥ | anyathā tu

sākārabuddher bādhāyāṃ vyavadānam asaṅgatam |
abādhāyāṃ tu saṅkleśavyavasthādausthyam āgatam || (=RNA 1,29)

tathā hi sattvair eva prakāśair aviparītasvarūpasaṃvedanāt bhrānter atyantam abhāvaḥ syāt | tataś ca sarvasattvāḥ sadaiva muktāḥ sadaiva samyaksambuddhā bhaveyuḥ | vikalpikā buddhir bhrāntiḥ, svapratibhāse 'narthe arthādhyavāsyād iti cet? | katham avasīyamānas tayā so 'rtho na prakāśate | prakāśyamāne vā katham asau tasyāṃ na prakāśate | atha prakāśata eva, tadā arthasya tādātmyaprasaṅgaḥ | asati cārthe sā na syāt | abhūn māndhātā, bhaviṣyati śaṅkho 'sty ātmā, nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti sarvātmanā ca niścayaḥ syāt | gaur iti spaṣṭena ca svena lakṣaṇena prakāśeta | svalakṣaṇe ca saṅketāyogād vikalpikaiva sā buddhir na syāt |
tasmād aśeṣagovyaktisādhāraṇena gotvena gobuddhir alīkena sābhilāpena viplavāt prakhyātīti tathā prakāśanam asyā gavārthāvasāya ity eṣṭavyam | evaṃ hy ete doṣā na syuḥ, apratibhāsamānasyāpi svalakṣaṇasya bhrantyavasāyāt | yathā cālīkasya gotvasya gobuddhau prakāśas tādātyaṃ ca, tadvyatirekād vastutvam anāropitatvaṃ vā, tathā nīlādiprakāśe nīlādīnām alīkānāṃ prakāśasiddhyaiva tādātmyasiddhiḥ, nānārūpaniṣṭhayor alīkatvānalīkatvayor ekatrāpi vastuny avirodhāt | yadi ca vastutve 'nāropitatve sā sādhye tādātmyamātraṃ hetus tadā gotvādibhir anekāntaḥ | athānāropitaṃ tādātmyaṃ hetus tad asiddham iti | atrābhidhīyate,

atasmiṃs tadgraho nāma bhramaś cet sarvasammataḥ |
alīke 'pi tadākāre satyavan na samañjasaḥ ||

[388] marīcāv ajale jalagraho bhrama iti loke, śāstre ca svapratibhāse 'narthe 'rthādhyavasāyena pravṛtter bhrāntam anumānam ityādi bahudhābhidhānāt | atasmiṃs tadgraho nāma bhrāntir viditā | tasyā yadi sākāranaye 'nupapattir alīkākāra eva katham upapattir iti cintyatām | jñānaṃ hi kenacid ākāreṇa satyena vālīkena vopajātaṃ nāma, bāhyāropas tu tadākāre tatkṛto 'nyakṛto vā syāt, tatkṛtatvena tāvat tatkāla eva vyāpārāntaram anubhūyata iti kutas tadāropaḥ | kālāntare ca svayam evāsan kasya vyāpāraḥ syāt |
dvitīyapakṣe jñānāntaram api nākāroparāgasaṅginīm utpattim antareṇa vyāpārāntareṇa kvacit kiñcitkaraṃ nāma | tad etad arvācīnaṃ prācīnajñānākāragocarīkaraṇe 'pi na bāhyāropavyāpāram aparaṃ spṛśati tadākāraleśānukāram apahāya, śabdākārasyāpi svarūpe 'ntargatatvāt | yadi ca vyāpārāntaram api sambhaved bāhyāropāya, nākāram, anumāne 'pi sādhanam abhidadhyāt | adhigataye tatsādhanaṃ nāropāyeti cet, na, svarūpanirbhāsasya anumāne (80a) pratikṣepād āropa evāsau | āropa iti asatyaviṣaya iti cet | nanu rūpādhigatir eva tarhi vahner anumānasiddhasya syāt | tasmād āropo 'vasāyo 'bhimānam ity anarthāntaram etat | saṃvādetarābhyāṃ tu viśeṣaḥ, yato na vikalpamātraṃ pramāṇam iti syāt |
tasmān nākārād anyo jñānasya vyāpāraḥ, āropyamānāś cāsāv artho bāhyas tatra buddhau yadi svarūpeṇa parisphurati satyapratītir evāsau ka āropārthaḥ | sphuraṇe ca dvitīyākāravedanaprasaṅgaḥ | tadākārasphuraṇam eva tasya sphuraṇam iti cet, na, tasyāropaviṣayatvāt | na hi marñcivisphuraṇam eva jalasphuraṇam, tena sahaikīkaraṇād iti cet | ko 'yam ekīkaraṇārthaḥ | yady ekatāpattau prayojakatvam, tadāropyāviṣayayoḥ kadācid ekībhāvābhāvād asambhavam eva | na hi śaśaviṣāṇe kāraṇaṃ kiñcit | na ca pūrvam anekam ekatām etīti kṣaṇikavādinaḥ sāmpratam | arthāntarotpattimātraṃ tu syāt, na ca tad apy upalabdhigocaraḥ anyatrāropaviṣayāt | na ca tāvatāpy arthasya kiñcid iti kutas tasyāropaḥ | athaikapratītiḥ ekīkaraṇam | tathāpi na dvayoḥ, āropyānubhavābhāvāt | na ca dvayoḥ pratītir ity evāropaḥ, nīlapītavat, āropyabodhagandhābhāvāc caikatvena pratītir ity api nirasanīyam | yadi hi bāhyaṃ pratibhāseta, ekatvenānekatvena vā satāsatā vā pratītir iti yuktam |
sarvākāratatsvarūpatiraskāreṇa sā pratītir ity ekapratītir iti cet | tatsvarūpatiraskāre tarhi tadapratibhāsanam eva | kasyacid aṃśasya pratibhāsanād iti cet? na, niraṃśatvād vastunaḥ sarvātmanā pratibhāso 'pratibhāso veti śāstram evātra paramate vistareṇa

[389] adhyavasāyād iti cet | so 'pi vikalpāparanāmā svākāram antareṇa vārtām api bāhyasya na jānātīti uktaprāyam | athābhedena pratītiḥ | adyāpi paryudāsapakṣe aikyapratītir evoktā bhavati pratyuktā ca | bhedena pratītiniṣedhamātre 'pi na bāhyasya pratītir ukteti kutas tadāropaḥ | bhedena neti ca nirūpayogam, abhedenaikyena pratītivyavasthāvirahāt, āropaviṣayamātrapratīteś cāpahnotum aśakyatvāt | tanmātrānuvādinā na kaścid viśeṣa ukto bhavati |
tasmād yāvac cintyate tāvad āropyasparśābhāvan nāropo nāma | yathā kathañcit tatpratibhāsaparibhāṣayā ca tadāropeṇa bhramavyavasthāyām alīka iva satye 'py ākāre uparodhaḥ, na tu tāvatā tāttvikatvam uktaṃ bhavati | evaṃ tarhi tasya svarūpanirbhāse 'pi sutarām na bhrama iti kathaṃ bhrāntisthitiḥ | na kathañcit, yadi vicāre ādaraḥ | avicāraramaṇīyam ābālasiddhaṃ vyavahāram upādāya pudgalādivādāropam api vyavaharāmaḥ | vicāryamāṇas tu viśīryata eva ||

ātmā yathā yathā bāhyaṃ yathā saṃvādataḥ pramā |
tathānekaviparyāsau vyavahāraparāyaṇau ||

tatra yāvad avicāras tāvat saṃsāro yāvac ca svarūpaparicchedaniṣṭhā tāvan nirvāṇam |

parijñānaṃ bhavasyaiva nirvāṇam iti kathyate |

iti nyāyaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi bhavaparijñānam, kathaṃ vā tattvato 'sato bhramāt pravṛttyādir iti vakṣyāmaḥ | yathā tu nirākāravādī tattvato bhramavyavasthām upasthāpayati tathā pratīmaḥ tāvat | tasyāpi tarhi parāroparūpā bhrāntir mā bhūt | alīkākārayoga eva bhrāntiḥ tatkṣepaḥ kṣemaś ceti kim ayuktam | prathamamideva(?) tāvat yallokaśāstrayor atikramaḥ, rajjau hi janaḥ sarpāropād bhramaṃ vyavaharati, na tu jñānaṃ kenacid ākāreṇa janaṃ spṛśati | sa ca sarpāropo nirūpyamāṇaḥ kiyatīṃ koṭimāṭīkata iti nodyamaḥ, nāpi paryantanayanaśaktir itarasya | tallakṣaṇāṃ tāvad bhrāntimayaṃ vyavaharatīti siddham |
śāstre 'pi svapratibhāse 'rthādhyavasāyena pravṛttir bhrāntir ucyate | na tu svapratibhāso 'narthaka ity eva | tathā dṛśyavikalpayor ekīkaraṇāder apy ayam evārthaḥ | na tv atrāpi

[390] vikalpyam alīkam ity eva, kiṃ tu dṛśyāropād iti |

nirvikalpe 'pi candradvayamiddham dṛśyata iti vikalpena svavyāpārasya tatraivāropād avicāritaramaṇīyaṃ (avicāritaramaṇīyaṃ) syāt |

bhramatvam avikalpe 'pi vikalpān na tataḥ param |
ato vikalpe viśrāntam avikalpe 'pi kathyate ||

tasmāt sarvatra parāropād eva bhramasthitir iti | tadasamādhāya paribhāṣāntaraṃ nāmeti kim aprayuktam ataḥ | athāyogād eva parihāra iti ka eṣa doṣaḥ, samarthanāsāmarthyasya svīkṛtatvād iti cet | yady evam,

samasti tāvad vyavahārasiddho bhramo vicāraś ca virodhako 'sya |
etāvataivābhimataprasiddheḥ śeṣo viśeṣo 'bhiniveśaleśaḥ ||

sa hi sāṃvṛto bhramaḥ satyālikapakṣayor aviśiṣṭaḥ kevalam ākārasyāpi mayā alīkatvam abhyupetam iti tasyāpi paryante sthitir mā bhūd iti bhramatvāpādanam abhiniveśamātraṃ saṅkleśavyavadānayor anyathāpi siddheḥ |

yāvad eva vicāreṇa bhramabhraṃśo 'stu śobhanam |
sarvathāsann iti punaḥ sundarād api sundaram ||
ata eva prayatnena vicāra ucitaśramaḥ |
sato 'panayane jātu śaṅkā syād api dhīmatām ||

ity antaraślokau ||
tasmād alīkasambhavo bhrama iti kim anena | tadasvīkāriṇo 'pi paramatānupagamamātram etat, ta dṛṣṭanyāyātikramaḥ | yad apy ucyate, ayogāt tatparihāra (tatparihāra) iti tadayogadarśino 'satyaprakāśo bhrāntir iti kīdṛśī yogadṛṣṭiḥ | tathā hi asatpratibhāsa iti asadīśvarādeḥ khyātiḥ, bhāsamāno vā ākāro 'san, san vā kaścit na khyātīti vivakṣitam | tatra,

[391] yasya svarūpanirbhāsas tad evāsat (81a) kathaṃ bhavet |
bādhāto yadi sāpy ekā pratyakṣānumayor nanu ||
pratyakṣe yady aviśvāsa ekatrānyatra kā gatiḥ |
tatpūrvam anumānaṃ vā katham āśvāsagocaraḥ ||
(ṭhese two verses can also be found in RNA1 125,2, RNA2 132,7-10)
svarūpasākṣātkaraṇād adhyakṣatvaṃ na cāparam |
(cf, RNA1 126, RNA2 132,33-133,2:
śāstre 'pi svarūpasākṣātkāritvam eva pratyakṣatvam uktam |)
vikalpabhramabhūmitvam ata eva hi bādhitam ||
yadi nādhyakṣatā tasya rūpanirbhāsa eva na |
tatas tadasadīśādi pratibhātīty asaṅgatam ||
yadi tu pratibhāseta rūpam asya sad eva tat |
tad asat pratibhātīti pratibhāty asad eva vaḥ ||
(these three verses can also be found in RNA2 133,17-22)

etena dvitīyo 'pi pakṣaḥ pratikṣipto veditavyaḥ | pratibhāsād eva sattāsiddher bādhakāvakāśabhāvāt | nanu,

dṛṣṭam eva dvicandrādipratibhāse 'pi bādhitam |
na dṛṣṭe 'nupapannatvaṃ tatpūrvoditam apy asat ||

 last pada reads tajjñātam api bādhyate for tatpūrvoditam apy asat)

buddhyākārasya nirbhāso bādhā bāhyasya vastunaḥ |
rūpasyaiva hi nirbhāsaḥ sparśāder api bādhanam ||
(cf, RNA1 125, RNA2 133,14f,, where the second half
reads sphūrtāv apy aviśvāse kva viśvāsa iti kīrtitam ||

sa hi rūpamātrapratibhāso rūparasagandhasparśasamudāyaviśeṣatayā adhyavasīyate | ata eva keśādau karaparāmarśodyamādisambhavaḥ sato bādhāpi tatsahacaritasyaiva rūpasya, na rūpamātrasya | tathāvidhārthakriyārthī hi sarvas tatsādhanasyaiva

siddhibādhayor avadhatte, na yasya kasyacit |
ṣaṇḍasya rūpavairūpye kāminyāḥ kiṃ parīkṣayā ||

[392] tattvacintakā eva tu prayojanāntarāpekṣayā sāmānyādikam api parīkṣante | tatra yad rūpamātram ābhāti ye ca sahacāriṇaś catvāraḥ samudāyarūpatayādhyavasīyante tad ubhayeṣām abhedābhimānī jano vivecanābhāvād idam asad alīkaṃ veti vyavaharati | atas tadabhimānād eva yāvān atra vidhiḥ pratiśedho vā sarvo 'dhyavasitaparyavasāna eva, anyāropeṇa tadrūpasya pracchāditatvat | tato na tattvatas tasya bādhām, śabdārthavat | yasya ca kalāpasya bādhā na tasya pratibhāsa iti siddham |
tato 'bhimānamātrakṛtā bādhāpi pratibhāsino yadi syāt tattvam astu mā bhūd iti na kṣatiḥ sāṃvṛtam uccāvacam īdṛśam anubhūyata eva jagati | ata eva tattvacintāvatāraḥ | kevalam uktaprakrameṇa tadasphuraṇe kathaṃ tadavasāya ity āyātam asatprakāśanam | tathā abhedābhimāne abhedasyāsataḥ khyātiḥ, pracchādanam anyāropeṇety api nānyapratibhāsanaṃ vineti sphāragalam utthānaṃ syāt | tatrākṣiṇī nimīlya yadi cintayet svayam ātmānam upahaset | tathā hy uktam etad adhyavasāyasyāpi nākāraviśeṣollekham uddhūyāparaḥ parāropaprakāro nāma | na cānātmanaḥ saṃvedanam | na ca svākāraniṣedho 'bhimato janasya, śakyo vā, svarūpanirbhāsino niṣedhavirodhāt | tato yat sākāravāde jalpitaṃ, nityādayaḥ santa eva syur iti tadātmana evāpatitam |

pratibhāse 'pi bādhā cen na sattvam asataṃ matam |
(81b) nāniṣiddhopalabdhīnāṃ niśedhasya niṣedhataḥ ||
yasya svarūpanirbhāso bādhakād yadi tan na sat |
bādhake 'pi ka āśvāsaḥ svarūpāntarabhāsinī ||
 anyasvarūpopanayāt tatsvarūpanivāraṇam |
tatrāpi saṃśayo jātaḥ pūrvabādhopalabdhitaḥ ||
iyam evāgrahe bādhā nākṣajasyāparā yadi |
asyāḥ pūrvaiva bhavatu rūpanirbhāsanaṃ samam ||
nānyāvabhāsinīty atra pramāṇaṃ kiñcid asti vaḥ |
api svarūpanirbhāse yadā bādhakasambhavaḥ ||
(the last four verses are quoted in RNA1 129, RNA2 136; see there for variants)

[393] tasmāt,

anirbhāse svarūpasya hetuśodhanaviplave |
bādhaśaṅkāvinirbhāse 'py evaṃ ced viplavo mahān ||
(quoted in RNA1 129, RNA2 137)

ity antaraślokāḥ |
tataḥ sarvathā nirastam asatprakāśanam anavadhāritārthavyavasāye śabdaśravaṇamātreṇa pratyujjīvayituṃ saṃrambha iti kim aparam upahāsakāraṇam |

pramāṇena nirastasya śabdād ujjīvanaṃ punaḥ |
daṣṭasya phaṇinā mantaprabhāvād iva kautukam ||

tasmād ātmagotvādiśabdaprayogavat vyavasthātadbñjayor anveṣaṇamātraṃ svataḥ parato vā ādriyante santa ity eva sādhuḥ | tad ayam atra paramārthaḥ, vividhānādivāsanāvaśāt prabodhakapratyayaviśeṣāpekṣayā vikalpaḥ kenacid ākāreṇopajāyamāna eva bahirmukhapravṛttyanukūlam arthakriyāsmaraṇābhilāpādiprabandham ādhatte | tataḥ puruṣasyārthakriyārthino bahirarthānurūpāṇi pravṛttyavadhīraṇāni bhavanti | pṛthagjanasantānajñānakṣaṇānāṃ tādṛśo hetuḥ bhāvasya niyatatvāt | aniścitārthasambandhavikalpakāle 'pi sadasattādinirṇayādipravṛttiprasavaḥ |
tatra yad ubhayathāpravṛtte sādhanasāmarthyam asya svahetubalāyātam ayam eva pravṛttiviṣayavastvāropo 'dhyavasāyāparanāmā, yathā candrādijñānasya bhrāntasyābhrāntasya vā taddarśanāvasāyajananam eva grahaṇavyāpāraḥ | svacid apīyam arthavid eva kāryato draṣṭavyeti nyāyāt, tathā vikalpasyāpy agnir atretyādinākāreṇotpadyamānasya pravṛttyākṣepakatvam eva bāhyādhyavasānam | yathā ca nirvikalpasya candrādyākārataiva tathāvasāyasādhanī, evam avasāyasya api tādṛśākārataiva viṣayāntaravimukhapravṛttisādhanī | tatas tadākārāvabhāvo 'syānadhigatārthakāraṇabhāvo 'py āropaviṣayatvena pṛthag iva vyavasthāpyate, āropyajñānaṃ ca |
evaṃ tarhi tad eva trayam asad vyavasthāpyate, vyavasthā ca pratītir iti nāsatpratīter muktir iti cet | so 'yaṃ pravāhe 'ṅganyāsaḥ | uktaṃ hi tadanurūpapravṛttyākṣepa eva tadāropo na paramapratītir nāmeti |

[394] tato 'dyāpi trayasyāsato 'dhyavasāya iti tadanurūpavyavahāramātram asatpratītivādānād anādyavasthālakṣaṇam (: arādyavasthālakṣaṇam) asad idam ityākāraṃ jñānaṃ ca phalam iti na kaścit doṣaḥ |
evam anyatrāpīdṛśi kṣudropadrave 'bhyūhyam | iyam īdṛśī sarvavikalpānā atasmiṃs tadgraharūpā bhrāntir anubhavānusāriṇī | etad eva dṛśyavikalpyayor ekīkaraṇaṃ vyavahriyate svapratibhāsavedanamātrāt paratra pravartanaśaktir yā tadapekṣā ca pararūpeṇa svapracchād anastitiḥ | pratibhāsāpekṣayā tu pararūpaṃ svarūpeṇa saṃvriyate ity ucyate, tasyaivaprakāśāt | sato 'pi bāhyasya prakāśād eva tattvato nirviṣayatvam | ākārasya cātmarūpatvāt, anadhyavasāyāc ca | ata eva yathādhyavasāyam, yathāpratibhāsam, yathātattvaṃ ca tridhāpohasthitiḥ |
vijātivyāvṛttaṃ dhvanibhir abhidheyaṃ yadi bahirvikalpe tatkalpo bhavatu punar aṅgaḥ kṛta iti | nidānenedānīm ubhayam api bhāsādhyavasiter (bhāsādhyavasiter) apohena
abhāvena bāhyasya hi pratibhāsābhāvaḥ | dhvanijanitavijātivyāvṛttavastusadṛśasyākārasya cādhyavasāyābhāvo yadi tarhi na kiñcid vācyam iti kas tattvataḥ apohārtha iti cet | apohaḥ sphuṭam ayam asau yan na kim api || abhidheyam iti sambandhaḥ pūrvavākyavat | ayam arthaḥ, apoho vācya iti tattvato vācyasyaivāpohaniṣedha ity arthaḥ | yathā abhāvo bhavatīti bhāvo na bhavatīty arthaḥ | tasmāt śabdaviṣayaḥ svalakṣanam iti siddham | yat sūtram

yena yena hi dharmeṇetyādi |

etāvati mūle kiyantaḥ pallavāḥ prādurbhavantv apohavādināṃ nātra nirbandhaḥ | yataś ca vikalpasya bāhyaniścayanaṃ nāma dharmo bahirmukhapravṛttihetutattvalakṣaṇo niṣṭhitas tata eva sarvākāraniścayo 'pi prasajyamānas tadanurūpaparavṛttyupayoganiṣṭhitātmā syāt | na caikākārollekhino vikalpasyākārāntareṇa pravartanaśaktir anabhavaviṣaya iti kutaḥ śabdapramānāntarāpekṣeti yuktam |

[395] tatra nirvikalpakaṃ bhrāntam api spaṣṭapratibhāsavaśat grāhakam avasthāpyate | vikalpas tu vimarśākāratayā svayam anyānapekṣapravartakatve 'py aspaṣṭaikavyāvṛttyullekhād āropakādivyavahārabhājanam | sarva eva vikalpo bahir aspṛśann eva saty asati bāhye pravṛttiprayojakatayā bhrānta ucyate | asati tu tādṛgvikalpotpādanaśaktigarbhākārayogo nirvikalpakasya bhrama iti sthitam |

sarvā nirviśayaiva kalpanamatir vyavṛttibhedānuga-
svākārotkalitā tu vīkṣitaphalasmṛtyādimātanvatī |
lokasyākṣipati pravṛttim anapekṣaivānyad adhyakṣavad
vastvāropa itīrito 'cirṣi jalāropo jalānām iva ||

iti saṅgrahaḥ ||
evaṃ ca sati yad adhyavasitaṃ bahiḥkalāparūpam iti pravṛttiyogyatāṃ nītam uktakrameṇa bādhyaṃ ca tasya na pratibhāsaḥ | pratibhāsinaś cākārasya na bādhaka iti sthitam ||
na hi tadarthakriyāyāṃ kaścid vivādaḥ | arthakriyāpahitasya pṛṣṭhajo 'dhyavasāya eva na ca tasyāḥ kṣatiḥ | kṣatis tu kalāpaviśeṣasādhyāyā eveti tasyaivābhāvaḥ | tat kathaṃ pratibhāsamānasya bādhā iṣṭety ucyate, vyāpakānupalambhāpekṣāyāṃ ca sarvaṃ pūrvam āvartata iti ||

vyāpakābhāvacintāyāṃ na poto na ca pippilī |
doṣo (82b) 'ntareṇa sākāre saṅkleśādiparīkṣaṇam ||

ārabdham | tatra satyasvākārasaṃvedane 'pi sarvajñānāṇāṃ vyavahāraprasiddham anantakālabñjanirjātavyavasthaṃ bhramatvam āśritya na saṅkleśakṣatiḥ | yathā ca bāhye sati kvacid bhramavyavasthā, tathā nirṇaye sarvatra | kevalaṃ bahirmukhapravṛttyapekṣayā kriyamāṇo nātmani kaścid bhrama ity uktaṃ bhavati |

yad yathā bhāsate jñānaṃ rūpaṃ tasya tad eva hi |

evaṃ śabdayojanāyāṃ bahiravasāyāt tatraiva vikalpakatvam aspaṣṭatvaṃ ca, jñānāntarāpekṣayā tasyaivārthasya kevalasya spaṣṭasya cāvasthānāt | ātmarūpe tu tādṛśākārā vyabhicārāt tasyā buddheḥ sāmagrīviśeṣajanmanaḥ kutas tathāvyavasthā |

[396] yadāpy anayaiva anyāviṣayīkṛtya yojayitum iṣyate śabdena, tadāpi paratraiva yojanā nātmanīti śāstram atra cintyam | tasmād vikalpikaiva na syād iti svāpekṣayā siddhasādhanam paratra tu vikalpakatvam evādhyavasāyavyavasthābalāt |
atha vastusvarūpanirbhāsabalād evam ucyate, tad etat sākārapakṣe 'bhidhātum api mahat sāhasam | adhyavasāyena tadākṛṣṭer iti cet, na, tasyānyathāvyavasthāpitatvāt | na hi tatsphuraṇe 'vasāyo nāma, pratibhāsasyaiva prāpteḥ | ata evāpratibhāsamānasyāpi svalakṣaṇasya bhrāntyā tatrāvasāyād iti na yuktam | avasāyena tadvittisparśe pratibhāsaḥ ko 'paraḥ | aspaṣṭatvād iti na yuktam | tadrūpavittau tasyaivāsiddheḥ |

jāto nāmāśrayo 'nyonyaḥ | (PV III 235a)

ityādi smaryatām |
na ca tadā bhrāntir bhavitum arhati, vasturūpasyaiva nirbhāsāt, alīkavitter iti cet | saivāstv arthādhyavasāyaḥ katham | saiva sa iti cet, na, alīkam idam iti viduṣo bāhyādhyavasāyavyavasthābhāvāt | nālīkavijalpanam api tu tatsaṃvedanaṃ bāhyādhyavasāya iti cet | evam api paryāyatāmātraṃ syāt, nābhimatārthavyaktiḥ | bahiḥsvarūpasparśavirahe hi yāvad uktam alīkākārajñānam iti tāvad uktam avasāya iti | tato na viśeṣaḥ kaścid uktaḥ | tathā ca sati yathālikākārajñānaṃ na bāhyasyeti sambandham arhati, tathāvasāyo bāhyasyeti na sambandhī bhavet | tadbodhābhimānadvārikā hi ṣaṣṭhī tadabhāve bhavet katham ||

tataḥ paramparāyātam alīkaṃ yadi tasya tat
tāvatā ca bhramo naivam analīke 'pi duṣyati ||

tato yad ucyate, tad ayam abhilāpasaṃsargayogyaḥ prathibhāsaviśeṣa eva buddher arthādhyavasāya iti tannirastam, arthasyeti sambandhānupapatteḥ, bodhe ca bhramābhāvāt | api cālīkaḥ pratibhāsa ity evāvasāyo 'stu kim abhilāpasaṃsargayogyaviśeṣaṇena | nirvikalpavyavacchedārtham iti cet | yady evam analīkavāde 'pi tadviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭam eva jñānaṃ bhramo na sarvam iti na sarvathā saṅkleśaviśuddhivaidhuryam, bhramabhraṃśe 'pi jñānajātiviśeṣasyaiva viśleṣāt | ubhayamate 'pi cābhilāpasaṃsargayogaḥ parāpekṣa iti na kṣatiḥ | kevalaṃ tadapratītau tadavasāyavyavasthā dustheti doṣaḥ | sa cāvayoḥ sādhāraṇa iti |

[397] tasmāt sudūram api dhāvatā pratītim antareṇāpi śaktiviśeṣād eva bahiṣṭhāṃ vṛttim ākṣipaṃs tadgrahopacārād avasāyo bāhyasyeti sambandhayadvṛttim adhyāsta ity upagantavyam | tadā cālīkāḥ satyo vā ākāra iti na viśeṣaḥ | evaṃ cāvasāyārthe 'vasīyamānatvena prakāśyatām āsañjyārthasya tādātmyam asaty arthe 'bhāvādikaṃ ca yuktam, tat sarvam anupapannam | adṛṣṭvā buddhir arthaṃ pravartayatīti ayam eva viplavaḥ | ata eva vikalpākāre 'py apohe vācye arthasya sparśābhāvāt kva sarvākāraparicchedaprasaṅgadoṣa ity āha,

upaplavaś ca sāmānyadhiyas tenāpy adūṣaṇā | (PV I 169)

iti, ekavyāvṛttyākāratayā tatraiva pravṛttyākṣepāt | tāvatā ca puruṣaḥ paritoṣalābhāt nāparaṃ vivecayati | tanmātrasyālābhe tu visaṃvādam āha - yasya ca sato 'pi na vikalpabuddhau kasyacit prakāśaḥ, tasyāsato nāmeti yuktidūram etat | na ca prakāśamānasyāsattvam iti | tat kathaṃ gotvadṛṣṭāntena nīlasyāsataḥ prakāśanaṃ, tādātmyakalpanaṃ ca | etena nānārūpaniṣṭhayor ityādy api nirastam | asatprakāśayor virodhasādhanād ekavastunīti cāyuktam, prakāśasya nīlavyatiriktasya vastuno 'bhāvāt bhedakalpane ca na prayojanam, dvayor ekaniṣedhamātrasya vivakṣitatvāt | sa caikatra pratibhāsiny anyatra kalpite syāt, ghaṭa iva paṭatvasya, bhinnapratibhāsayor api vā śaśakamaśakayor iva | abhinnapratibhāsayoḥ punar atadvyāvṛttimātravyavasthāpitabhedayor na kvacid ayaṃ nyāyaḥ siddhaḥ |
varṇasaṃsthānayor abhinnapratibhāsane 'pi saṃsthānam asad iti cet, na, vyatiriktasyaiva avayavasaṃsthayogākhyasya kalpitasya saṃsthānasya tatrāpi niṣedhaḥ, parimaṇḍalādivyavahāragocaradaśāvyāvṛttodayaś caturasraśabdābhidheyo varṇātmā kathaṃ niṣedhyaḥ | tathehāpi bhinnasya kalpitasyaiva niṣedhaḥ prakāśasya nīlasya vā nīlātmā prakāśātmā vā nīlo na niṣeddhuṃ śakyaḥ, avytirekapratibhāsād eva | tataś ca vastutve 'nāropitatve vā sādhye nīlasya bhāvāt |
prakāśabhūtabuddhyākārāpekṣayā ca na sādhyābhāvaḥ | na hi gotvākāraprakāśasya kenacid āropaḥ sadvyatiriktasyāropakasyābhāvāt, svayaṃ ca svahetor gotvākārasyaiva prakāśasya niṣpatteḥ | na cātmanaivātmana āropaḥ, nāpy anyenānyasyāropo, nāmakaraṇaṃ [398] tu syāt (83b) tataś ca prakāśātmakatvaṃ sarvatrānāropitam eveti nāsiddhigandhaḥ |
kiṃ ca, āropitaṃ jalādivad asphuṭam eva bhavitum arhati | nīlasya ca prakāśatā sphuṭataraiva vedyate | na tu bhinnaprakāśasya tu bhinnanīlatvasyeva, sphuṭatve vā nīlavat prakāśasya sataḥ khyātir āyāteti |
evaṃ yatra yatra tarkāgamayor asad alīkaṃ vā pratibhātīti pratītiḥ bhāṣyakāravyākhyānād anyatra tatrādhyavasitāpekṣayaiva vyāvahārikābhiprāyād vā | sa hi tadākṛtikalpitabāhyasādhyārthakriyābhāvamātrād alīkādi vyavaharati | tadanuvādena bāhyaniṣedhamātram etat | tattvatas tu sadantaram evāsat, iṣṭād anyatayā cālīkam ucyate | athāpi syāt | yadā nityākārā buddhiḥ, tadānekakālavyāpitayodayād ākāravan nityaṃ sad eva syād ity api yat kiñcit | anukāramātreṇa hi tadākāratā, na tu tādātmyena, agnivikalpamātreṇa dāhaprasaṅgat | tato yathā tāvad deśavyāpako vaṭaviṭapī patramātrapidheyenāpi darpaṇatalapratibimbenānukṛtaḥ kuto 'py ākārabhedāt tathā ksaṇikenāpy ākāreṇa nityaḥ | anubhavaś cātra, nityātmādivikalpanakāle buddhyantarāvakāśaparipanthinīṃ sakalakālavyāptim antareṇaiva tadanukāraḥ |
alīkatve 'pi hi na tāvat kālavyāpinaivālīkena bhavitavyaṃ nityākāreṇa, anyathā tadanurūpasadasattāvicārādipravṛttyākṣepakatvābhāvāt | ato leśena tadanukāraḥ kālavyāptiṃ vināpīti yuktam | yathā cordhvadaṇḍādipratikṛtir yadā (pratikṛtir yadā) kadādriyate | adha ūrdhvam adhyabhāgair atītānagatapratyutpannarūpopalakṣaṇaparair nityasya sarvāvasthājanyam ekasyām eva syād iti darśayitum, tathā buddher api kṣaṇam eva tadākārāyā nodayavirodha iti | tasmāt yad asat tan na prakāśate, adhyavasitamātraṃ tu syāt | yathoktaṃ prāk | yaś ca prakāśate svātmanāsāv asann iti siddham | tataś ca nāsataḥ khyātir nāma bhramalakṣaṇam asambhavāt | ata eva san na prakāśata iti na tṛtīyo 'pi prakāraḥ, prakāśavyāptatvāt sattāyāḥ, aprakāśasyāsattayā grasteḥ (ṭhakur: vyāpter ity arthaḥ) |
nanu prakāśo nāma vastunaḥ sādhakaṃ pramāṇam | na ca pramāṇanivṛttāv arthābhāvaḥ | arthakriyāśaktiś ca vastusattvam | tac ca nāprakāśasyāpi virudhyata iti cet | satyam etad bahirarthavāde 'prakāśasyāpi tasyābhyupagamāt | keśādipratibhāse 'dhyavasitasyārthaśaktiviyogād
